target.recipe_text:
pork tenderloin  the best ever

i have tried many recipes for pork tenderloin and this is the absolute best ever. it is so tender and juicy and great tasting. hope you enjoy.

1. pre-heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. trim as much of the fat off as you can
3. season with salt& pepper
4. roll tenderloin in flour and coat well
5. heat olive oil in cast iron skillet
6. brown the tenderloin on all sides
7. mix the soups together with the hot water
8. add the soups slowly to the roast allowing the onion pieces to rest on the top of the tenderloin as much as possible
9. cover and bake in oven for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes or until the inner temperature reaches 170 degrees
target.review: Not worth doing again. Gravy....very thin. Flavor...non-existent. Not for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttery bread machine rolls

these golden, fluffy, butterfy rolls are great hot from the oven. the dough is very easy to shape. this recipe is from a quick cooking magazine

1. in bread machine pan , put all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is completed , turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
4. divide dough into 24 portions
5. shape dough into balls
6. place in a greased 13 inch by 9 inch baking pan
7. cover and let rise in a warm place for 30-45 minutes
8. bake at 350 degrees for 13-16 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: WOW!!!  These are soooo good and sooooo easy...even "I" can't mess them up. This is a GREAT roll recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
macaroni   hot italian sausage

a macaroni casserole is always welcome in most families. use mild sausage or bratwurst if you prefer.  i like a bit of spice so i like to add a couple of jalapenos chopped and perhaps some olives or some hot sauce.  make it as hot or as mild as you like. good meal for those fall/winter days ahead. serve with a green salad and crusty rolls and there's your meal.

1. spray a skillet with oil , heat
2. add sausage , cook until crumbly , break it up as you are cooking the sausage , pour off excess fat
3. add mushrooms and onion , cook until tender
4. turn sausage , mushrooms and onion into an oven proof dish
5. pour sherry into the skillet and bring to a boil , stirring constantly to scrape up the brown bits
6. pour sherry over the sausage mixture
7. stir in the tomato sauce , beef consomm , water and pasta
8. bake in 375f oven for 1 hour or until pasta is tender
9. stir in sour cream
10. sprinkle with parmesan and parsley
11. serve
demonstrations.review: I made this twice....doubled it the second time and STILL didn't have enough!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fish with tomato chive butter

the sauce makes this recipe.....it's absolutely wonderful. i clipped this out of a local paper and made it using tilapia and i'm still drooling!

1. have your broiler preheated when you start
2. tomato-chive butter: in small saucepan over med-hi heat combine shallots , wine and vinegar
3. simmer until 2 tbsp remain
4. add cream and return to simmer for 2 1 / 2 minutes
5. remove from heat and begin whisking in butter , cube by cube
6. as you add cubes you may want to place pan back over very low heat briefly
7. continue whisking in butter until it is all incorporated
8. pour into a warm bowl and add tomatoes , chives , lemon juice , salt and pepper
9. fish: position broiler rack 4 to 5 inches from heat
10. about 10 minutes before sauce is done sprinkle fish with salt and pepper
11. place on an oiled broiler rack and broil 4 to 5 minutes a side or until cooked through
12. place on a serving plate and top with about 3 tbsp butter sauce
demonstrations.review:
Very Good!!!
I used white wine for vinegar and added several shakes of Tabasco to give it a kick. Very good recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pickled garlic with hot pepper

i have made these garlic pickles for the last 8 years and friends love them. the original recipe was in 

1. combine vinegar & sugar over medium heat , stirring until the sugar dissolves , bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes add garlic and hot peppers , also add sweet red pepper if using
2. bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes
3. put a hot pepper into each sterilized jar , add the cloves of garlic to within 1" of the top of the jar fill with boiling sugar / vinegar mixture to within 1 / 4" of the top of the jar
4. release air bubbles , ensure the rim is clean and seal the jars
5. let the pickled garlic rest for 2 weeks and believe me you will enjoy
demonstrations.review: OMG....wow-wee!!!  This stole the show at a cocktail party I had at the lake.  This stuff is dynamite!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken amandine

i don't remember where this recipe came from but it is quick, easy, and good...the three things that i am always looking for in a recipe. served with rice and broccoli, it is much requested meal.

1. on waxed paper , mix flour , salt , and pepper
2. use to coat chicken breasts
3. in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat , in 1 tablespoon hot margarine or butter , cook chicken breasts until browned and fork-tender , about 10 minutes
4. remove chicken to platter
5. in same skillet over medium heat , in 1 more tablespoon hot margarine or butter , cook almonds until lightly browned
6. stir in lemon juice
7. spoon sauce over chicken
8. garnish with parsley sprigs
demonstrations.review: Very good!!! I got a little off the track and threw some capers into the sauce (a la chicken picatta).  Enjoyed this very much thanks for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
chinese five spice pork chops

easy to make pork chops.  cook time does not include marinating time of 2 hours.

1. arrange the pork chops in a single layer in a non-metallic baking dish
2. sprinkle on the five spice powder , then drizzle over the soy sauce and garlic oil
3. using clean hands rub the mixture into the meat
4. cover the dish with plastic wrap and chill for 2 hours
5. preheat the oven to 325c / 160f
6. uncover the dish and bake for 30-40 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and tender
7. serve immediately with a green leafy vegetable or broccoli and plain boiled or steamed rice
target.review: Well Jen - having tried your apple cream sponge and loved it, i thought i'd have a look at what else you had posted, i'm SO glad i did! These chops were so easy and simple and taste really really good! This will be one of those that i will remember - i had chops at a friends and i suggested that i bring these ingredients to jazz it up, everyone was unsure until they tasted them! I had to leave the recipe and print myself off another! Yum - can't wait to try out some more of your recipes - keep posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
linda s cheesy chicken marsala divan

i love experimenting in the kitchen, and this is one that i came up with one night when i felt like having a creamy chicken dish...  it was wonderful, so i thought i would share it with you!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. put the chicken breast in a 9x13" baking pan
3. slice the onions , and put over chicken breasts
4. in the side of the pan mix the soup and water together
5. it will be lumpy
6. cut up the fresh broccoli , and put in soup mixture
7. mix together
8. add the mushrooms , and mix
9. sprinkle with salt and pepper , to your liking
10. pour the wine into the mixture , and mix well
11. pour over the chicken
12. every 15 minutes spoon the mixture over the chicken while baking
13. bake for 45 minutes
14. remove pan from oven , and add the shredded cheese on top
15. put back in the oven , and bake for another 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted
16. serve
17. delish !
demonstrations.review:
I was perturbed by how watery this was once i'd cooked it. I certainly wouldn't make it again but it may be okay if you take out the extra can of water, at your own risk!
Thanks Linda but no thanks.

Ryan England.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy and delicious ranch parmesan chicken

there are plenty versions of this recipe, this is mine and can be on your table in less that an hour, my family loves this chicken! --- the ranch dressing is the secret it holds in all the flavor and moistness while the chicken is baking and also adds flavor, i find that hidden valley ranch dressing works the best but kraft or any other brand will do, i sometimes top the baked chicken with mozzarella cheese or cheddar, but that is optional --- although i have only made this using breasts i imagine that chicken pieces could be used although you would have to increase the breadcrumb mixture slightly, you can marinate the chicken breast in the ranch dressing for a few hours in the fridge, although you will need more than 1 cup of dressing if you are marinating .... *note* to avoid a soggy bottom crust, place the chicken breasts onto a flat rack on top the baking sheet, also it is important not to bake the chicken in a small baking pan, if you do not have a rack bake on a large baking sheet so any juices in the pan will spread out and not accumulate under the chicken causing a soggy bottom ---------------
for low-fat option: use low-fat ranch dressing and omit the melted butter on top or use a healthy butter alternative such as smart balance 50/50 blend.

1. set oven to 400 degrees
2. in a shallow bowl mix together the dry breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese , seasoned salt , black pepper and garlic powder
3. dip the chicken into the ranch dressing to coat both sides
4. coat in the breadcrumb mixture
5. place in a single layer onto a greased baking sheet or line with non-stick foil
6. lightly drizzle the melted butter over each breast
7. if desired you can sprinkle black pepper over the chicken pieces
8. bake uncovered for about 30-35 minutes or until the chicken is cooked)
demonstrations.review: OMG! This was exceptional! I cooked this for friends last night and i am still recieving text messages this morning raving over this dish! It is so easy and tasty, i will have to makes copies of this recipie for the numbers of people asking me for it! Well done Kittencal! I now have a few more of your recipies i can't wait to give a go!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken wellington  puff pastry wrapped chicken

this is not at all hard to put together, it's an amazing dish to serve to dinner guests and i have done so many times over the years and have always receive rave reviews from everyone at my table and you will too! --- to save time saute the onion, garlic and mushrooms up to a day ahead,  the cream cheese and dijon mustard mixture may be increased slightly -- i always serve this with recipe#149547 drizzled over or on the side of the plate, you will *love* this!

1. season the chicken breast with seasoning salt and pepper on all sides
2. heat butter and oil in a skillet
3. brown the breasts on all sides until almost completely cooked through
4. transfer to a plate
5. to the same skillet add in onions , garlic and sliced mushrooms
6. saute until the mushrooms lose their moisture and the onions are tender
7. stir in parsley
8. on a floured surface , roll out each puff pastry sheet to a 14-inch square
9. cut into four even 7-inch squares
10. place each breast over each puff pastry square
11. set oven to 375 degrees
12. in a small bowl combine the softened cream cheese with mustard , then spread over each breast
13. then top with about 2-3 tablespoons mushroom / onion mixture
14. brush the edges of each pastry square with water
15. wrap pastry around the chicken breast , pressing edges to seal tightly
16. place seam-side down on greased baking sheets
17. brush the tops with egg wash
18. bake for about 20 minutes , or until puffed and golden brown
19. serve with mushroom sauce over the wellington or on the side of the plate
20. delicious !
demonstrations.review:
I was looking for something different to do with a chicken breast and i am so glad i decided to try this! Served to friends last night and they loved it so much ALL asked for the recipe! i had never thought of doing CHICKEN Wellington but i will always think of this if i want to impress. My only problem was getting the pastry to stick together, the water just didn't seem to do it so i used the egg wash to seal and coat them which worked much better.
Highly recommended! 
Ozzy

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate cobbler

this cake makes it's own chocolate sauce. it's wonderful served warm with ice-cream.

1. in bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt , sugar and the 2tbs cocoa
2. stir in milk and oil until smooth
3. pour into a greased 8in square baking pan
4. combine brown sugar and the 1 / 4 cup cocoa
5. sprinkle over batter
6. pour hot water over the top
7. bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when touched
demonstrations.review: WOW WOW WOW! i seriously can't rave about this enough! Thank you MizzNezz for such a wonderfully simple yet scrumtious desert, i know i will make this one again and again. I was drawn to this purely because i had all the ingredients in the cupboard, so easy to do and impressive too! I LOVED the gooey sauce that it created - hot chocolate heaven! Hope you like the photo.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fannie farmer s classic baked macaroni   cheese

to me fannie farmer's recipe is the only "real" macaroni & cheese. it's from my 1946 edition of "fannie farmer's boston cooking school cookbook". with time on it's side - this recipe is hands down the best for traditional, homemade baked macaroni & cheese - comfort food.

please note: if you use cheap cheese you will end up with a bland and flavorless dish!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. cook and drain macaroni according to package directions
3. set aside
4. in a large saucepan melt butter
5. add flour mixed with salt and pepper , using a whisk to stir until well blended
6. pour milk and cream in gradually
7. stirring constantly
8. bring to boiling point and boil 2 minutes
9. reduce heat and cook 10 minutes
10. add shredded cheddar little by little and simmer an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese melts
11. turn off flame
12. add macaroni to the saucepan and toss to coat with the cheese sauce
13. transfer macaroni to a buttered baking dish
14. sprinkle with breadcrumbs
15. bake 20 minutes until the top is golden brown
16. (you can also freeze this recipe in zip-lock bags for later use - once you have mixed the macaroni along with the cheese sauce allow to cool to room temperature before adding to your freezer - i generally pull it out the night before and allow macaroni and cheese to reach room temperature
17. i then add the macaroni and cheese to a buttered baking dish , sprinkle with bread crumbs and then bake for 20 to 30 minutes , until golden brown on top and bubbling
demonstrations.review: I generally dont like Macaroni Cheese, but my daughter dared me to try this version and I am so impressed, it was so full of different flavours, but she did add mustard powder, garlic granules and a pinch of celery salt as per other reviews recommended. I would definitely eat this again!!!!

target.recipe_text:
baked garlic parmesan potatoes

easy and so delicious!

1. mince garlic and combine with melted butter in a large mixing bowl
2. add potatoes and toss well to coat
3. mix remaining ingredients and add to potato mixture and toss well
4. turn potatoes out onto greased cookie sheet
5. bake at 375 for 1 hour or until cooked through , turning 2 to 3 times while baking
target.review: These were very tasty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my favorite decorator cake icing

this recipe is being posted because i can never remember the amounts of the ingredients.  sometimes, i crave this (minus the cake) and just whip up 1/4 a batch and eat it with a spoon till it gets too rich for me to take another bite.  sometimes, you just gotta have a little (or a lot) sweet.

1. cream together in a stand mixer the butter and crisco until completely blended
2. add the vanilla
3. sift in the powdered sugar a little at a time , scraping down the sides of the bowl as you go
4. keep sifting and blending until the whole 2 lbs
5. is incorporated
6. if the icing is thick and will not spread easily , add 1 tablespoons of milk at a time until desired consistency is achieved
7. add food coloring
8. blend well
demonstrations.review: Thanks for posting this one, I use it all the time :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cake mix extender

a simple way to make a bigger and better cake mix. makes a 13x9 pan come out very high and moist.

1. mix all together
2. add to your already mixed cake mix batter
3. bake per directions but may need and additional 5-10 minutes longer to become done
demonstrations.review: I love this extender! I've used it several times, when I use it for chocolate cake I add a heaping scoop of cocoa powder (as someone sugested before). It always truns out great! (and really moist, too)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
carrie s banana cake

this cake was brought to a luncheon by a coworker. it was delicious. since then, i have been making it, people love it and it is a great, easy way to use up those overripe bananas that sneak up on you.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. mix cake ingredients in blender
3. pour into a greased 9x13" cake pan
4. bake for 25-35 minutes
5. allow cake to cool completely
6. mix cool whip , pudding mix , and milk
7. spread on top of cooled cake
demonstrations.review: Delicious! I just made this for a party today, it was is good! My Blender doesn't work so well, so I mashed the bananas with my potato ricer, lol, then mixed with a hand mixer. Turned out so good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
absolutely the best chocolate chip cookies

these are divine!  they come out perfect.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease cookie sheets
3. in a large bowl , cream together the butter flavored shortening , brown sugar and white sugar until light and fluffy
4. add the eggs one at a time , beating well with each addition , then stir in the vanilla
5. combine the flour , baking soda and salt
6. gradually stir into the creamed mixture
7. finally , fold in the chocolate chips
8. drop by rounded spoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets
9. bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven , until light brown
10. allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely
demonstrations.review: Very good. A nice change from the regular recipe (tollhouse). Thanks for posting.......

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy chocolate trifle

this trifle is so easy to throw together for a last minute party or if the kids decide to have friends over.

1. first layer
2. prepare brownie as directed on box and add about a half cup of choc chips
3. once brownies are cooked cut them up or spoon about half of them out of pan and into bottom of trifle dish
4. then heat up fudge and randomnly spoon fudge over brownies
5. use half of jar
6. 2nd layer
7. prepare pudding as normal with a cup of mini choc chips
8. then pour half of pudding on top of the brownies
9. 3rd layer
10. then spoon 8oz of whipped topping onto the pudding
11. try to spread evenly so the layers are clean looking
12. then repeat all three layers and garnish with mini chocolate chips
13. then cover & chill in fridge until time to serve
demonstrations.review: This was so good I couldn't stop myself from eating more. I made them in indiviual cups for easier serving, the turned out great.

target.recipe_text:
garlic lover s chicken  potatoes  and carrots

this is a wonderful one-dish meal that presents itself beautifully. it is fairly simple, and guaranteed to knock the socks off of the garlic-lovers in your crowd!!! i have also substituted various other veggies for the carrots (such as brussels sprouts, broccoli, or zucchini) and i get rave reviews every time!! my fave is the brussels sprouts, i know i'm weird!! well, either way, this dish is simple enough to serve as a weeknight family meal, yet elegant enough to serve to guests. i just love it!!! i usually serve this with steamed rice and a fresh green salad. yummy!!!!

1. place potatoes , carrots , and onion in greased or sprayed 13x9-inch baking dish
2. top with chicken
3. combine tarragon , sage , salt , and pepper and sprinkle over chicken
4. cut the top off of garlic bulb so that each clove is exposed
5. place cut side up in baking dish
6. drizzle oil over garlic and chicken
7. cover and bake at 350 degrees for 60 minutes
8. uncover and bake 10-15 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear and garlic is soft
9. transfer chicken to serving platter and keep warm
10. cool garlic 5 minutes
11. gently squeeze garlic into small bowl and lightly mash with fork
12. toss garlic with potatoes , carrots , and onion
13. arrange around chicken
14. sprinkle with dried parsley
target.review: Very good!  Robust garlic flavor, I couldn't eat too much it was so rich, but delicious.  After one hour in my oven, chicken was perfect so I didn't bake any longer, and my potatoes got a little too soft, when I mixed with the garlic they turned a little mushy, but it was still great.  I'll just cook for less time next time.  I cut my baby carrots in half because another reviewer said they were still crunchy, and they came out perfect.  Super easy meal, thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kielbasa and potato bake

i found this on all recipes.com. it was submittted by geneva. i tweeked it a bit and everyone loves it. it's also an excellent dish to take to a potluck dinner. some reviewers stated it was "soupy".i adjusted the milk to 1/2 cup. i just keep baking it until it get's thick. sometimes i have to bake it 2 hours. it really does get thick. the last few times i made it i made it with 1 cup of milk. it seemed to get thicker quicker. i am going to change the amount of milk. one reviewer noted that the spices were too much. my family does not like all the garlic either. they said that there is enough in the kielbasa. i don't use it when making this recipe to please them not me. i sometimes top this bake with frenches french fried onions (cheddar cheese or original)

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. in a large mixing bowl , mix together soup , onion , milk , garlic , salt and pepper
3. stir , in potatoes and kielbasa
4. spoon into a 7x11 inch casserole dish
5. place casserole on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes or until potatoes are tender
demonstrations.review: I also found two cups of milk to be too liquidy,  but it had delicious flavor.  A creamy, comforting meal.  I used a beef bratwurst thing, and added cheddar cheese over the top for the last 1/2 hour of baking.  This went over well, my family gobbled it up.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken breasts in lemon cream sauce

my family loves chicken, and this is a quick & tasty way to spruce up the everyday bird. we love this over all types of pasta.

1. melt 3 tbs butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. add mushrooms and saute until tender
3. remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
4. sprinkle chicken with salt& pepper , dredge in flour , shaking off excess
5. melt remaining 3 tbs butter in skillet
6. add chicken and saute 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until golden brown
7. transfer chicken to a serving platter
8. add broth to skillet , scraping up browned bits
9. bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until reduced to approximately 3 / 4 cup
10. stir in cream and lemon juice
11. cook over medium heat until slightly thickened
12. stir in mushrooms , white pepper& salt to taste
13. add chicken and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until sauce is a medium thick consistency
14. serve over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: This was good, I was afraid the lemon would be overpowering, as I've tried a Chicken Francese dish with lemon that was a bit much, but it was just the right amount. I did use a little less butter, and didn't have any mushrooms, but it was still good, I served this over mashed potatoes (bf doesn't like noodles or rice) and we both really liked the recipe. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my flour tortillas

my family cooks everything by touch, i've never been able to duplicate their tortilla recipe until now.

1. in a mixing bowl , stir in flour , salt , and baking powder
2. add the shortening , the mixture should have a small mealy texture to it
3. make a well in the middle and pour a small amount of water at a time until the dough comes together
4. remove the dough from the bowl and continue to knead until it looks smooth and feels elasticy
5. place in covered bowl and let rest for 10 minutes
6. at this time , preheat ungreased griddle over medium-high heat
7. tear off golfball sized pieces and lightly flatten , so they don't roll
8. using a rolling pin , roll out each ball into a circle , thickness of a cracker
9. cook for each side for about 1 minute
10. both sides should be slightly freckled
11. cooking time could vary
demonstrations.review: These were good, but making them the thickness of a cracker made them very thick.  I rolled the last few as flat as possible and they turned out better.  Also put them in a plasic bag as soon as they came out and the heat softened them, otherwise they wouldn't been way too hard.  Much better than store bought, though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven baked parmesan chicken strips

these are so fast and just plain delicious as either an entree or an appetizer. the aroma is just like pizza as they're baking, very tempting! they're nice with a marinara dipping sauce, but i actually like them plain, with garlic bread and a salad. and if you line your baking sheet with foil, clean-up is a snap!

1. spray a baking sheet with non-stick spray
2. in a shallow dish , combine milk and egg
3. in a plastic zipper bag , combine parmesan cheese , bread crumbs , onion powder , garlic powder , thyme , basil , pepper and paprika
4. dip chicken strips first in milk mixture , then toss to coat evenly in the breadcrumb / cheese mixture
5. place on baking sheets and bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes or until golden
demonstrations.review: These are quite good, and they were super easy to make. Dinner was on the table much earlier than normal. The chicken has good flavor, be careful not to overcook, my strips only needed about 15 minutes, but I cooked for the full twenty and they were a bit dry.  Good flavor, I followed the recipe to a tee.  These are probably best with marinara, but I didn't have any so we dipped in ranch dressing. Will probably make again for a quick weeknight meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s moist cheddar garlic oven fried chicken breast

this is for serious garlic lovers. the chicken bakes out so moist and tender! grated cheese may be sprinkled on top of the breast the last 5 minutes of cooking if desired but that is optional. double all ingredients for more than four breasts and adjust the amount of garlic to suit taste. for the coating amount you might be able to get away with 5 or maybe 6 very small chicken breasts, but i would suggest to increase the amount slightly --- to take this dish to yet another level, about 10 minutes before the cooking time is finished, drizzle the top of the chicken with a little pasta sauce, then sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. return to oven for about 10 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked and sauce is hot and cheese has melted. for a lemon-garlic flavor add in 3 tablespoons lemon juice to the melted butter/garlic mixture ---  *note* for a healthier alternative smart balance butter blend may be used in place of the melted butter --- you will love this chicken!
visit my food blog, www.kittencalskitchen.com, for more of my recipes.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. butter an 11 x 7-inch pan
3. in a bowl , combine melted butter with fresh minced garlic , 1 teaspoon garlic powder and salt
4. in another bowl , combine the dry breadcrumbs with 1 / 2 cup finely grated cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder and coarse ground black pepper
5. dip chicken in butter mixture
6. then in crumb mixture
7. place in prepared pan and bake uncovered for 35-45 minutes or until cooked through , larger breasts may take more time
8. top with shredded cheddar or mozzarella the last 5 minutes of cooking (this is only optional
demonstrations.review: This was SO GOOD!  I used chicken tenders so I didn't have to bake as long, they came out moist, cheesy, garlicky, buttery, (or I should say margarine-y since that's what I used)and delicious.  This will be a chicken staple in my house!

target.recipe_text:
homemade italian salad dressing

it's easy to make your own salad dressing and far cheaper than buying it.

1. combine all ingredients in a jar with a lid
2. cover and shake to mix thoroughly
3. let stand at least 2 hours to blend seasonings
4. shake well before using
5. wonderful on italian lettuce salad
target.review: This is an excellent recipe, it tastes so much better than store bought.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach salad with raspberry dressing

my doctor told me i had to add a little more iron to my diet and since i am not crazy about eating more red meat i found this recipe on the food network website. i love this salad. i add either pecans or walnuts to give it a little more crunch.

1. in a large bowl , whisk together olive oil , mustard , vinegar , pepper , garlic salt , dried basil , sugar , and salt until dressing is well combined
2. in another large bowl , combine the spinach , mushrooms , strawberries , and red onion
3. add the dressing and toss well
demonstrations.review: I found the only problem with this recipe was simply too much oil in it,  I think that if you reduce the amount of oil that this recipe would be great.  Sorry I would really like to rate this a lot higher, please consider revising.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach ricotta pie with a hint of feta

we've got a new local dairy (in such a small country, local also means national), that makes some of the best cheeses (and soy milk and soy puddings). this recipe really showcases their ricotta and feta cheeses. this is a great vegetarian dish to serve, we usually have some kind of variation after the yom kippur fast day. i also like to add some za'atar in with the oregano.

1. preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. heat the oil in a heavy pot over high heat
3. add the onion and saute until translucent , about 3 minutes
4. add the spinach in batches , if necessary , and saute until the ribbons are just wilted
5. lightly beat the ricotta and the eggs together in a bowl
6. add the spinach mixture , feta , oregano and salt and pepper
7. mix thoroughly
8. pour the batter into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan
9. bake for about 40 minutes , until the top is lightly browned
10. serve warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: This recipe is definately a cirwd pleaser, use it at your next party or celebration!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
annie s spinach salad

eat for your health!mmm...

1. combine first five ingredients in blender and mix thoroughly
2. refrigerate dressing until ready to serve
3. combine remaining ingredients and toss with dressing
4. sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and mix well
demonstrations.review: this was the best spinach salad I have ever tasted, it is good for any occasion.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon   garlic spinach

this recipe was a side dish at a restraunt we ate at. i ate so much i couldn't finish my salmon. the spinach is not cooked so the flavor is very fresh. since finding this recipe we have gone through 5 pounds of spinach!! (in 2 weeks)

1. in large pot , add olive oil , butter , garlic and the juice of 1 / 2 lemon
2. let cook over low heat for about 20 minutes so the flavors meld
3. take off heat , add spinach , toss well and serve
demonstrations.review: It waqs by far the best spinach recipe I have ever tried.  I would most definately recommend it to anyone.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baby spinach salad with lemon and parmesan

i love simple, yet delicious, recipes and this one qualifies for that description. this is perfect for spring and is an excellent recipe for low-carbers. be sure to use very fresh baby spinach for this salad. i found this in the chicago trib's 'good eating' section and they give credit to "the modern vegetarian kitchen" by peter berley and melissa clark.

1. place the lemon juice in a small bowl
2. whisking constantly , slowly add the oil in a steady stream , whisking until the vinaigrette is creamy
3. set aside
4. rub the inside of a large bowl with the cut sides of the garlic halves
5. add the spinach
6. drizzle with the reserved lemon vinaigrette
7. toss gently to coat
8. divide the salad among 4 plates
9. shave the cheese in wide sheets over each salad with a vegetable peeler
10. season with salt and pepper and serve
demonstrations.review: Thanks for posting this great recipe, it goes well with anything.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot tamale casserole supremo

absolutely flavor filled. easy to make and economical.

1. brown the ground beef and chorizo together
2. drain most of the fat off
3. pre-mix the egg , milk and cornmeal
4. except for the cheese , put all the other ingredients into the crock pot
5. mix them thoroughly
6. put the cornflour-egg-milk mix on top
7. set the crock pot to high or low
8. cook for 5-6 hours on high or 10-12 hours on low
9. 5 or 10 minutes before serving , cover the top with the grated cheese
target.review: Love this! Have added it to my regular recipes! My chorizo comes in 10 oz packages, but we don't really care for overly spicy things, and with 4 kids (oldest is 5), it works out well to use 2 - 2.23 pounds burger and 10 oz chorizo, then divide that in half. I freeze 1/2 and use it the next time I want to make this!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cake mix peanut butter bars

this is a great peanut butter bar recipe that reminds me of my school days. for some reason, i keep losing this recipe, so i thought i would post it this time.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. grease a 9x13-inch pan
3. mix first four ingredients
4. spread mixture into pan
5. bake for 20-25 minutes or until puffed and light golden brown
6. cool completely
7. in a small bowl , combine: cup crunchy peanut butter , 1 can pillsbury creamy supreme chocolate fudge frosting
8. spread on cooled bars
9. top with: cup chopped peanuts and 1 cup milk chocolate chips
demonstrations.review: These are good. I didn't put the chocolate on top--didn't have a taste for something so sweet. If I make them again, I will probably add more peanut butter. To Here 2 Learn: If you mix the egg, peanut butter and water first, it is much easier to incorporate the cake mix. I do it that way, even with my mixer, so that I don't have to over-mix the flour mix. Thanks for the recipe, Mamalovesakm.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
boboli pizza crust clone

tasty "premade" pizza crust.

1. add all ingredients to breadmaker in order listed by your manufacturer
2. set breadmaker on dough setting
3. when cycle is done , form two crusts on pizza pans , sprinkle with parmesan cheese , cover and let rise again
4. bake 5-10 minutes at 450 f until light brown
5. cool
6. wrap tightly in foil and freeze
demonstrations.review: Super! Great flavor, easy recipe. I used mine right away and it was most excellent!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cream cheese cinnamon crescents

these are so yummy.  would be perfect for breakfast or brunch or anytime!  i just made a batch late this evening.  a parent brought these in for a teacher's luncheon and everyone loved them.

1. roll out one can of crescent rolls in bottom of 9x13 pan
2. i sprayed pan with cooking spray
3. cream together: 2 8oz
4. cream cheese
5. 1 cup sugar
6. 1 teaspoon vanilla
7. spread this mixture over crescent rolls
8. lay second tube of crescent rolls over mixture
9. melt 1 / 2 cup butter , mix in 3 / 4 cup sugar ,
10. 1 teaspoon cinnamon , and pour over top
11. bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes
demonstrations.review: So yummy. Putting this in my arsenol!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot   style loaded baked potato soup

if you like loading your baked potatoes will all those delish dairy ingredients, then you'll love this soup recipe, too! original recipe calls for only four slices of bacon, but i -- being a little piggy -- love the bacon, so we always use more like 8 to 12 slices. you decide which you prefer.

1. combine first seven ingredients in a large crock pot
2. cover and cook on high for 4 hours or low for 8 hours
3. mash mixture until potatoes are coarsely chopped and soup is slightly thickened
4. stir in cream , cheese and chives
5. top with sour cream , sprinkle with bacon and more cheese
demonstrations.review: This is going to be one of my repeatable recipes! Easy, crock pot, and soooooo delicious!! (So I might have used 2 cups of sharp cheddar....I didn't really measure; and I didn't have a full cup of sour cream, but I could still taste it). Just absolutely wonderful!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry rhubarb streusel pie

this great pie recipe comes from the company's coming - gifts from the kitchen. i find a large pie is sometimes too much for me, so i have made 6 or 7 small 5

1. combine fruit , sugar , flour and lemon juice and stir well
2. turn into pie shell
3. to make topping
4. combine dry ingredients and cut in margarine until crumbly
5. sprinkle over rhubarb mixture
6. bake at 375 degf for about 50 minutes
7. cut into 8 wedges
demonstrations.review: This is the most fabulous strawberry rhubarb pie ever! I don't think I had the quantity of strawberries and rhubarb listed, I didn't measure, just used what I had. It was awesome, though! What an awesome topping! I will be trying it on other pies, too! Oh, and I used frozen strawberries, and thickened up the juice a little with cornstarch before I mixed the filling together; I still used the flour, too.

target.recipe_text:
the club 21 burger

finally found the legendary, infamous recipe for ny's club 21 burger! this is the burger you dream about...perfection. i dare you!

1. in a mixing bowl add the beef , crisco or duck fat , fennel , cayenne pepper , ground pepper , thyme , rosemary , egg and onion
2. mix until all ingredients are incorporated evenly
3. divide the beef mixture into four , 8-ounce burgers
4. pack and shape them tightly
5. on a hot grill place the burger and cook for approximately 4 1 / 2 minutes on each side for a medium rare temperature
6. serve on a bun
target.review: Skipped the egg and cooked em' on the George Foreman. Super tasty! My mom and dad loved these. Will make them again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
warm blue cheese dip w  garlic and bacon

got this a few years ago from allrecipes.com
i hate blue cheese, but i love this

1. place bacon in large deep skillet
2. cook over medium high until brown
3. remove bacon from skillet , drain on paper towels and crumble
4. place garlic in hot bacon grease
5. cook and stir about 1 min , or until soft
6. remove from heat
7. preheat oven to 350
8. place cream cheese and half and half in a medium bowl
9. blend with mixer
10. stir in bacon , garlic , blue cheese and chives
11. transfer to medium baking dish
12. bake covered for 30 minutes
13. serve with french bread
demonstrations.review: I made this yesterday actually. I got it from the Spring chapter in the Vera Bradley cookbook... except it was spell bleu cheese. I wasn't hungry when i made it for my christmas party but when my guests arrived, they attacked it... It was a big hit. Although it was salty, it balanced out well with fresh green apple slices. My friend lynn couldn't wait to write this down!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bourbon   glazed salmon

a great blend of flavors.  i would suggest not adding the marinade to the skillet until the salmon has been turned for the final 4 minutes of cooking.  the sauce tends to burn if it gets too hot or is cooked too long.

1. combine first 7 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag
2. add fish to bag , seal
3. marinate in refrigerator 1 1 / 2 hours , turning occasionally
4. heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat coat pan with cooking spray
5. add fish and marinade to pan , cook fish for 4 minutes on each side until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork or until desired degree of doneness
6. place 1 fillet on each of 4 plates
7. drizzle each serving with about 2 t
8. sauce
9. sprinkle each serving with 1 t
10. green onions
11. and if using , sprinkle with the toasted sesame seeds
12. i did and was glad i did
13. since there are just the two of us , i also put the remaining two uncooked pieces of salmon in the freezer and added half the marinade to the bag
14. i'll include an update when i cook the salmon
15. i'm not sure if freezing it in the marinade might not be too much for a delicate piece if fish
16. update: worked great !
demonstrations.review: I'm not a big fan of drinking bourbon but I did have some left over after a party. Great salmon! It was tasty but i added a little more lime.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
girl   the goat magic beans

these are absolutely amazing.  recipe courtesy stephanie izard, total genius and mastermind behind girl and the goat in chicago.

1. to make dressing:
2. combine all ingredients in a separate bowl
3. stir until well mixed
4. to make aioli:
5. whisk mayo and 1 / 3 cup green bean dressing together in a separate bowl
6. to make green beans and assemble:
7. heat a small amount of oil in a frying pan
8. add green beans and some sliced shallots for flavor
9. add enough vinaigrette to coat the green beans
10. let steam
11. add a handful or two of cashews for flavor
12. season with salt
13. transfer to serving dish & drizzle with aioli
14. serve hot
demonstrations.review: I love the dressing. IT IS AMAZING!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peanut butter and jelly wraps

breakfast or snack on the run for the busy mom and kids

1. in a small bowl , stir cream cheese with a spoon until soft
2. add peanut butter
3. mix well to combine
4. spread about 1 / 3 cups mix over each tortilla
5. evenly spread 1 1 / 2 tbs fruit spread over top of each
6. roll up tortillas
7. serve at once or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
demonstrations.review: make this all the time. my aunt nancy's plum jelly is really great with fat free cream cheese and crunch peanut butter... mmm

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese joes

years ago a friend use to make these whenever my boyfriend (now dh for 34 years) would be invited to dinner. very inexpensive and the kids loved them growing up (without the tomato). i always served them with tomato soup. quick and easy.

1. split hamburger buns and toast in oven till lightly brown
2. fry ground beef , till no longer pink , drain
3. add tomato sauce , parmesan cheese and salt / pepper
4. mix well
5. divide meat mixture evenly among buns , top each with a tomato slice and a cheese slice
6. broil till cheese is melted
7. watch closely can burn quickly
8. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I used ground chuck and the Parmesan/romano cheese mixture. This was good but it was a little bland on the seasonings side as is. I love the concept though. I will make this again but add a little garlic powder or chopped onions to the meat mixture. Made for Potluck 09'

target.recipe_text:
my famous dill pickles

i have to keep a big stock of these pickles on hand. i have a lot of visitors that raid my pantry for jars of these to take home with them.

1. in each of 7 canning jars put all the ingredients
2. after jars are filled cover cucumbers with boiling water leaving 1 / 4 inch space at top
3. seal firmly
4. process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes
target.review: I just tried them after having them sit for about 2 weeks and they taste just like the sour pickles my Grandmother used to make. How long should they sit before eating? I usually wait a good month.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jger kohl  hunter s cabbage

i found this at teri's kitchen, a site about pennsylvania dutch cooking. it's become a favorite in our family. since we don't eat pork, we substitute beef ingredients for the sausage and bacon. however, the pork version is more authentic. it is very hearty and filling.

1. in a large skillet over medium heat , brown kielbasa and bacon
2. add sliced potatoes and just enough water to make steam
3. cook , covered , for 15 minutes
4. add cabbage and sprinkle with flour , salt , pepper , and vinegar
5. stir to combine
6. cover and cook 45 minutes , or until cabbage is tender , adding water as needed
7. serve with sour cream and caraway seeds , if desired
demonstrations.review: Very good. Almost like Kohl Cannon Nova Scotia style.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashioned potato and egg salad

this is a great summer dish that tastes even better if made the day before.

1. cook peeled potatoes until tender firm , about 20 minutes
2. drain and dice potatoes- season with oil and vinegar while still warm
3. season to taste with salt and pepper
4. add vegetables
5. mix mustard with mayonnaise and blend with potato mixture
6. add eggs and parsley and toss again
7. taste and adjust seasoning , adding more mayonnaise if needed
8. garnish with radish slices and paprika
9. cool , cover and refrigerate overnight
demonstrations.review: Usually my partner likes very creamy salads, but he preferred this one because the flavouring is so nice. And to top it off, its low fat. Perfect for my low fat, low sodium diet.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
featherweight buttermilk biscuits

very light and delicious! try with your next breakfast or ham dinner!

1. preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. sift together first 6 ingredients into large bowl
3. add butter and rub in with finger
4. add buttermilk and stir until dough forms
5. turn dough out onto floured surface
6. knead until smooth , about 8 turns
7. roll out the dough to 1 inch thickness
8. using 2 inch diameter biscuit cutter , cut out biscuits
9. gather scraps and roll out to 1 inch thickness and cut out additional biscuits
10. transfer biscuits to large ungreased baking sheet
11. bake until golden , about 12 minutes
12. serve warm
demonstrations.review: My family and I found them light, fluffy and tasty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cucumber relish

nan

1. combine cucumbers , celery , onion and peppers in a large bowl
2. add salt and water
3. cover and refrigerate overnight
4. drain
5. rinse and drain again
6. combine remaining ingredients in a large kettle
7. bring to a boil
8. add vegetables
9. simmer for 10 minutes
10. ladle hot mixture into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4" headspace
11. adjust caps
12. process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath
demonstrations.review: Mine doesn't look like the picture you offer. But the taste is really tangy. Next time I think I will mince everything.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fillet of sole in an oil sauce

a very easy to make fish recipe that goes very well with cooked spinach. i developed this for my wife over 25 years ago as she would not eat fish before. it is now a regular fish dish in our home.

1. in a glass jar , mix together lemon juice , olive oil , minced garlic and dried oregano
2. shake well until creamy
3. divide sauce in half and set aside
4. preheat oven to 400 f degrees
5. rinse fillet of sole in cold water and pat dry with paper towelling
6. sprinkle each side of fish with dried dill weed and black pepper
7. place fish in a oven-proof casserole dish
8. pour half of the creamy sauce mixture over fish
9. bake in preheated 400 f oven for 10 minutes on each side or until fish is flaky
10. in the meantime , in a cooking pot or large saucepan , bring 4 cups of water to boil
11. add chopped spinach and cook for 2 minutes
12. drain immediately and cover with cold water and some ice cubes to cool
13. drain when cooled and pat spinach dry on paper towelling
14. divide spinach equally on 4 serving plates
15. place 1 piece of cooked fish on each plate
16. pour remaining creamy mixture sauce over fish
17. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Very nice and easy to make. Could a drop of wine go into the sauce?

target.recipe_text:
peach pie

although i haven't made this yet i am planning on making this yummy sounding peach pie before peach season is over. recipe source: newspaper.

1. preheat oven to 400-degrees f
2. prepare pastry or use pre-packages pastry and put bottom crust in a 9-inch pie pan
3. in a large skillet combine sugars , cornstarch , ginger , cinnamon and vanilla
4. fold in peaches and simmer for 5 minutes or until filling thickens slightly
5. remove from heat and stir in lemon juice
6. spoon filling into prepared pie pan
7. fit top crust on top of filling
8. crimp and seal edges
9. cut slits in dough on top of pie
10. place pie on baking sheet and cover loosely with foil
11. bake for 15 minutes , remove foil and bake for 45 more minutes or until crust is brown and filling is bubbly
target.review: This was the most delicious pie I've ever had. I left out the ginger, and added extra vanilla and cinnamon. My peaches were not very ripe, but it didn't matter at all. I used Pillsbury pie crusts. This is my family's new favorite recipe. You must try it! Thank you, submitter!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic lime chicken breasts

this came from my friend liz's recipe box. few ingredients but great flavor, chicken always turns out moist. she makes extra to have leftovers for mexican lime chicken soup.

1. whisk together lime juice , oil , garlic , salt , and pepper in a large bowl
2. add chicken , turning to coat
3. marinate chicken , covered and refrigerated , turning once or twice , for at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours
4. put a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees
5. remove chicken from marinade and arrange skin side up , without crowding , in a shallow baking dish
6. season with salt and pepper
7. roast until just cooked through , 25 to 30 minutes
8. if chicken has a skin , turn oven to broil
9. broil chicken about 2 inches from the heat until skin is crisp , about 2 minutes
10. serve with lime wedges
demonstrations.review: The marinade was really nice. I made it with thighs, baked on 425 for 30 minutes, then crisped the skin under the broiler. They were really moist and had plenty of flavor. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quinoa soup with avocado and corn

most people know they should be eating more whole grains.  most people don't have the time to.  whole grains may taste better and be healthier for you than refined grains, but they also generally take much longer to cook.  this easy, flavorful soup uses quinoa (prounced keen - wah), which is available alongside rice at most grocers and natural foods stores.  canned black beans or chopped cooked chicken are excellent additions to this soup.

1. in a large saucepan over high heat , bring broth to a boil
2. stir in quinoa , reduce heat to medium-high and continue boiling , uncovered , for 15 minutes
3. stir in corn and salsa , then return to a simmer
4. remove pan from heat and stir in avocado
5. season with salt and stir in cilantro
6. ladle into large bowls , accompanied with lime wedges
demonstrations.review: This is really a delicious quinoa salad. I wouldn't really call it a soup. The quinoa absorbed all of the broth, even after I added extra. However, as a quinoa salad, this is really delicious. I love the fresh flavors of the lime and cilantro. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tsr version of applebee s oriental chicken salad by todd wilbur

this recipe is from www.topsecretrecipes.com. this actually tastes like the salad from applebees. it is a bit of work, but worth every second!!

1. preheat oil in deep fryer or deep pan over medium heat
2. you want the temperature of the oil to be around 350 degrees
3. blend together all ingredients for dressing in a small bowl with an electric mixer
4. put dressing in refrigerator to chill while you prepare the salad
5. in a small , shallow bowl beat egg , add milk , and mix well
6. in another bowl , combine flour with corn flake crumbs , salt and pepper
7. cut chicken breast into 4 or 5 long strips
8. dip each strip of chicken first into egg mixture then into the flour mixture , coating each piece completely
9. fry each chicken finger for 5 minutes or until coating has darkened to brown
10. prepare salad by tossing the chopped romaine with the chopped red cabbage , napa cabbage , and carrots
11. sprinkle sliced green onion on top of the lettuce
12. sprinkle almonds over the salad , then the chow mein noodles
13. cut the chicken into small bite-size chunks
14. place the chicken onto the salad forming a pile in the middle
15. serve with salad dressing drizzled over it or on the side
demonstrations.review: This rating is just for the dressing - to me, it didn't taste much like the one at Applebees, but it was delicious all the same. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta with asparagus and balsamic reduction

my mother made this for a dinner party i loved it so much she gave me the recipe

1. bring water to boil cook pasta
2. mean while
3. place balsamic in a pan cook at med heat untill it reduces to a syrup
4. chopp asparagus in about 1 inch pices place in frying pan with red onion and a bit of the oil and a bit of water cover alow to stream untill asparagus changes dark green and onion is cooked
5. drain pasta
6. top with asparagus and red onion then drizzel balsamic over and top with lots of parm
7. add salt peper to taste
demonstrations.review: This was really delicious. We probably used a little more parmesan and a little less oil, but that's the only change we made and we really enjoyed this pasta.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
melt in your mouth chicken breasts

the mayonnaise make these chicken breast very moist and tender--enjoy!

1. mix mayonnaise or yogurt , cheese and seasonings
2. spread mixture over chicken breast and place in baking dish
3. bake at 375f for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: Excellent! I only had to cook it for 25 minutes. I've used this mixture, minus the cheese and with some lemon juice, on salmon before. I had never thought to use it on chicken, but I will be making this often! Oh, and I did use lowfat mayo, and it was still delicious.

target.recipe_text:
healthy honey oatmeal cookies

these are easy to make! and healthy for you too (small amount of butter & sugar), but still so very sweet and wholesome. the cookies are chewy and go great with any other add-ins (raisins, cranberries, chocolate chips, etc.) courtesy of foodnetwork.com

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. spray a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray
3. using a mixer with the paddle attachment , mix together the butter , brown sugar , honey , egg and water thoroughly
4. sift together the dry ingredients then stir in the oats
5. add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix
6. add any additional ingredients you've chosen
7. drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto the cookie sheet
8. bake 12 to 15 minutes
9. cool on a wire rack
target.review: I loved these cookies. Instead of whole wheat flour I used white all purpose and didn't use any of the add ins.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
scrambled eggs hotel style    very simple

when i was a newlywed 15 years ago, i burned eggs every time i made them and the only way to get good scrambled eggs was to go out for them. one day i saw a cooking show and it changed how i made eggs. today my whole family loves this fluffy, delicious breakfast dish. my own mother who is a great cook extraordinaire loves these and when she just recently learned the secret was shocked at how simple it is. so without further ado, here is the recipe for hotel style eggs

1. in a medium mixing bowl crack 6 large eggs into the bowl and then add 6 tablespoons of cold tap water
2. beat together , then add to a non stick pan with 2 tablespoons of margarine or whipped butter
3. cook over medium heat and be vigilant by constantly stirring
4. when done , sprinkle with your desired amount of salt and pepper
5. the key is to always add one tablespoon of water per egg and one teaspoon of margarine or whipped butter per egg
demonstrations.review: Great scrambled eggs! I scaled the recipe to 3 eggs, 3 T. of water, and 3  t. margarine. Turned out very fluffy and delicious. I added these eggs into the fried rice that I was cooking.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dill sour cream mashed potatoes

my very picky traditionalist husband not only loved this recipe, but now insists i make it all the time instead of the old-fashioned recipe. i think it came from southern living magazine.

1. place milk& butter in a medium bowl
2. cook potatoes in boiling water to cover , 15 minutes or until tender
3. drain
4. mash with milk& butter in the bowl
5. stir in remaining ingredients
6. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: To make these lighter, I used low fat milk and sour cream, and margarine instead of butter. They still were delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick n easy quiche crust

need a fast, flaky crust? this delicious recipe is so much cheaper than ready-made pie crusts! high altitude tested.

1. mix flour and salt with fork
2. beat oil and water with whisk or fork to thicken
3. pour into flour and mix with fork
4. press into 9" pie crust
5. fill with quiche mixture and bake at 400f until done
6. you can double the recipe , divide dough in half , and roll out into a pair of rounds for two-crust pies
7. this recipe is not suitable for baked pie crust shells
8. it makes a nice , flaky crust that's suitable for everyday use
demonstrations.review: This crust is excellent. It stayed together perfectly and came out delicious. I didn't add in the salt and used corn oil instead of olive oil. I added in the quiche filling and baked it at 400F. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chickpeas with spinach  greek

nothing fancy about this dish - just good eating. round off with some feta cheese and crusty bread.

1. in a large saucepan , over medium heat , saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until the onions are tender
2. add the chickpeas , tomatoes , pepper flakes , and oregano , and paprika
3. cover and simmer for about 18 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. add spinach and cook about 7 minutes longer , or until spinach is cooked
5. add the lemon juice , salt and pepper
demonstrations.review: We liked this recipe, including my 4 and 2 year olds. I used cannd chickpeas, frozen spinach, and fresh tomatoes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lucky sweet and sour sauce

my most favorite sweet and sour sauce. i often add pineapple, sliced green pepper and maraschino cherries. you can use it as a dipping sauce or add it to cooked meat or poultry.

1. mix juice and cornstarch
2. heat oil in a small saucepan and add remaining ingredients and cornstarch mixture
3. cook over medium to medium high heat , stirring until sauce thickens
demonstrations.review: I've used this recipe a couple of times. I serve this sauce over roast chicken and rice. I use pineapple juice from a can of pineapple slices and then add the pineapple slices and green pepper strips to the sauce. Very good!

target.recipe_text:
orange pineapple cake

this is an easy cake, but taste so devine. be prepared to be very popular where ever you take it. it is pretty so it looks like you worked a lot harder on it than you really have to. yummy!!

1. cake: grease and flour 3 8 inch round cake pans
2. mix cake mix , oil , eggs , & mandarin oranges including juices
3. pour in to prepared pans
4. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until tooth pick is clean
5. do not over cook layers
6. icing: drain pinapple and save juice
7. mix cool whip , instant pudding , and pineapple in large mixing bowl
8. spoon pineapple juice over each layer before icing
9. spread icing over each layer and ice cake
target.review: I just pulled up another recipe called mandarin orange cake & it said to use juice and all with the mandarin oranges-I plan on making this soon.I will let you know how it is. Sound great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach balls  appetizer

very handy to have in the freezer for the holidays - easy to make

1. cook spinach according to instructions , drain in a sieve , use back of a wooden spoon to press the spinach against the sieve to get as much moisture as possible out in a bowl combine the spinach , stuffing mix , cheese , eggs , butter , salt& pepper mix thoroughly& roll into small balls 3 / 4 to 1" size
2. place on a cookie sheet& freeze
3. when frozen place in a plastic zip lock bag
4. to serve place frozen balls on a cookie sheet and bake at 350f 10-15 minutes or until lightly browned if you are doing them fresh or thawed only bake for 7-10 minutes
5. serve hot
demonstrations.review: Great little appie. The texture threw me off at first but I stuck with it and they got thicker.The flavour was great- dipped them in sour cream. Friends gobbled them up. Thanks bergy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
avgolemono soup  greek egg lemon soup

a classic and flavorful soup, originating in greece.

1. stir the milk and cornstarch together and beat in the egg yolks
2. set aside
3. bring the stock to boil in a 4 quart soup pot and add the rice
4. cook , covered , until the rice is puffy and tender , about 25 min
5. remove the soup from heat , add milk and egg mixture , stirring carefully
6. continue to cook for a moment until all thickens
7. remove from the heat again and add the butter , chopped parsley , lemon juice , and finely grated lemon peel
demonstrations.review: I made this soup for a greek dinner party-everyone loved it. Instead of rice I used orzo - It was a nice difference.I didn't use all the lemon called for -I suited it to my taste.This was a real hit.- reheats very well-just thin with chicken broth.I will make this soup again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shrimp fradiavolo

a very easy recipe from the executive chef at trattoria via veneto! serve as an appetizer or entree.

1. peel shrimp , leaving tail on& cut halfway lengthwise to butterfly them
2. heat oil in a medium sized frying pan
3. add shrimp& brown lightly
4. throw out oil and flambe shrimp with garlic& brandy
5. add remaining ingredients& cook for 5 minutes
6. place shrimp on a serving platter
7. continue cooking sauce for another 2 minutes to reduce
8. pour over shrimp& serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Country Lady- these we a huge hit at my dinner party. I got shrimp already marinated in garlic and butter and they were already butterflied with the tails on. (great appitizer from M & M )So half the work was done already.I just followed the recipe from step 2 and served them in small lasagna boat style dish to each quest. Loved them - this is a keeper. thanks again

demonstrations.recipe_text:
onion poppy seed biscuit loaf

i found this recipe in a magazine while waiting in a doctor's office. it looked so good, i made it that evening with dinner. this is tasty & quick, and i would imagine you could experiment with any number of seasonings to go with a variety of menus. these can also be baked separately on a cookie sheet instead of the loaf pan.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. lightly grease a 9x5 loaf pan , or use a non-stick loaf pan& set aside
3. melt butter or margarine in a medium-sized bowl
4. stir in the minced dried onion& poppy seeds
5. open the cans of biscuits& separate them
6. dip each biscuit quickly into the butter mixture , turning to coat both sides
7. line up the biscuits in the loaf pan , standing them on edge , forming two long rows
8. drizzle any remaining butter mixture on top of completed loaf
9. bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: This tastes great. My guests just raved about it. I didn't have a loaf pan so I put it in a bundt pan. It turned out beautiful. I'm not sure I would even use a loaf pan now after seeing these results. I will experiment with different spices and additions to the biscuits. This is a sure keeper.Thanks again mary scheffert.5 stars all the way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
greek baked shrimp with feta

this is a delicious recipe, and one i have enjoyed many times. it would make an excellent appetizer for entertaining as well as a great dinner idea!

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. remove shells from shrimp , leaving last segment and tail intact
3. remove vein
4. rinse and dry
5. in a pan saute onion in oil until transparent , , add garlic and green onion and cook 2 minutes more
6. to the onions add the tomatoes , wine , half the parsley , oregano , and salt and pepper to taste
7. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes until thickened
8. pour half the sauce into a shallow casserole , and arrange the shrimp on top
9. pour the rest of the sauce on , and sprinkle crumbled feta over the shrimp
10. bake at 450 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until prawns are pink and feta is lightly browned
11. garnish with remaining parsley and serve
demonstrations.review: Hi! I made this recipe for a greek diner party I was giving. It was a hit. The preparation was so easy.The taste was exceptional.The other couple wanted the recipe to take home. I loved the taste & the ease of everything involved.Your recipe was great keep up the good giving.I like to get.

target.recipe_text:
chicken breasts with lemon and brandy

this is easy enough to do on a week night and glamorous enough to have at a dinner party.

1. combine flour and oregano
2. season with salt and pepper
3. wash chicken and pat dry
4. dredge in seasoned flour , shaking off excess
5. melt 4 tblsps butter in heavy , large skillet over medium heat
6. add chicken and cook until springy to touch , about 8 minutes per side
7. increase heat
8. add lemon juice and brandy to skillet
9. tilt skillet and ignite brandy to flamb
10. when flames subside , remove chicken
11. whisk remaining 4 tblsps butter into sauce , 1 tblsp at a time
12. pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with chopped parsley
target.review: This dish is very tasty and easy to make. I did not flambe` it and it was still great.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
popular filipino adobo

this is very authentic filipino dish. you can use pork or chicken or both. very tasty.

1. mix all ingredients in a pot
2. cook in a medium heat for 45 minutes to 1 hr or till meat is very tender
3. garnish with chopped spring onions
4. best served with rice
demonstrations.review: I made this using Lambribs and it was incredibly Good. Also instead of pineapple chunks I used pineapple-orange juice-about 1/4 Cup. This is a Yummo Keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken teriwacky

from reader's digest july 2006

1. combine all ingredients in a large ziploc bag and marinate for at least and hour or up to 24 hours
2. transfer to baking dish and bake uncovered at 350 degrees for about 30-40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
3. spoon remaining sauce over chicken and serve
4. thes recipe also works great on the bbq
5. grill over mediumheat for about 10-15 minutes , flipping occasionally until chicken is cooked through
6. for oamc: freeze after step one
7. defrost overnight in fridge and then bake as directed in step 2
demonstrations.review: I made this with 2 tablespoon yellow onions, as I had no green ones. Also I used 2 tablespoons Spaghetti sauce instead of ketchup. The smell wafting from the oven is delicious. I know its going to be great. I agree with the less honey idea.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon basmati rice

ahhh! basmati rice!  a staple in indian cuisine.  i love this version with my roasted chicken with curry leaves and spices topped with my curried béchamel.

1. bring water to a boil in saucepan
2. slowly add rice then cinnamon , cloves and cumin
3. cover and reduce to simmer
4. cook until rice is tender and water is absorbed , about 10- 15 minutes
5. remove from heat
6. fluff with a fork and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this minus the cloves and used powdered cinnamon 1 1/2 tsp and it was delicious and surprising.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fantastic chicken amaretto

this is a restaurant quality chicken dish that is delicious, i have made it many times for my family and also have served it to guests and always receive rave reviews! --- you will love this!

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a shallow dish , combine flour , salt , pepper , paprika and garlic powder
3. roll / coat the chicken in the flour mixture
4. saute chicken in oil until golden brown and transfer to a greased casserole dish
5. in the same skillet , increase the heat to med-high and melt butter
6. add in dijon mustard , orange juice concentrate , water and amaretto
7. stir constantly until liquid is reduced
8. pour the sauce over chicken
9. bake covered for 35-40 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was very delicious--I did however omit the mustard and substituted some Mrs Dash spice seasoning instead. I would make it again--Its a Hubby Pleaser! 4 Stars!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
monastery lentils

those monks know their stuff! the sherry makes this wonderful - don't leave it out! i like this best with parmesan on top, but cheddar is awfully good too. serve with crusty bread for a hearty, meatless meal.

1. in a large pot , saute the carrot and onions 3-5 minutes in the olive oil
2. add and saute one minute more: thyme and marjoram
3. add the stock , lentils , salt , parsley , and tomatoes
4. bring to boil , then cover and reduce heat
5. let cook until lentils are tender
6. add the sherry and allow to cook for just a few minutes more
7. top with cheese to serve
demonstrations.review: Not bad Definitly cheesy tasting but ESAUS Pottage made with Sesame oil onions and garlic is far better

target.recipe_text:
chicken cordon blue cheese

a simple but elegant sharp flavoured dish.

1. prepare your boneless skinless chicken breasts by slicing them almost in half through the side - butterflying them
2. spread them open and set aside
3. pour your milk on a plate the appropriate size for your chicken breast to sit on
4. sprinkle your shake 'n' bake mixed with pepper to taste on another plate the same size
5. place two slices of ham together neatly
6. in the center of the ham sprinkle two teaspoons of blue cheese
7. roll the ham rather tightly to avoid losing your cheese
8. place the ham in the middle of the chicken breast and close it - secure with a couple of toothpicks
9. gently place the chicken in the milk and with your hand pat the top with the milk - a gentle milk bath will secure the shake 'n' bake and keep the chicken moist
10. now gently place in the shake 'n' bake and pat crumbles on the top and sides
11. place the breasts in a baking dish and cook at 350 degrees for 1 hour
12. allow the chicken to cool for 5 minutes before removing the toothpics and serve
target.review: Very easy if you have everything in place before you start handling the chicken.  I reduced the cooking time to 45 minutes for a very thick breast.  The Shake and Bake made it a bit too salty.  I think I'll use seasoned bread crumbs next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon   butter braised beet greens

this is from the earthbound farms organic foods website.  it says....
choose baby leaves, 4 to 6 inches in length, for the mildest taste and most tender greens. mature leaves have a much more pungent flavor and are best boiled until tender. this simple saute takes just a few minutes to cook and makes a lovely accompaniment to roast chicken or steak.

1. heat the oil and butter in a large skillet or dutch oven over low heat , and add the garlic
2. cook gently , stirring frequently , until the garlic is fragrant but does not take on any color
3. add the moist greens , raise the heat to medium-high , and cover the pan
4. cook until the greens wilt , about 2 minutes , shaking the pan once or twice
5. remove the cover
6. if there's any excess liquid , cook until it evaporates
7. toss the greens with the lemon juice , salt , and pepper , and serve hot
demonstrations.review: Wow!  I used beet greens and collard greens.  Just rough chop the collards and put them on the bottom of the pan.  I had to stop myself from eating it all before my husband got home.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
new potatoes with cumin

this is a lovely, spicey way to prepare small new potatoes from madhur jaffrey's quick and easy indian cooking.

1. scrub potatoes and put them in a saucepan
2. cover with water to come about 1 inch above the potatoes
3. add 1 t salt to the water and bring to a boil
4. cover and boil till potatoes are just tender
5. drain and peel
6. put the oil in a frying pan and set over med-high heat
7. when the oil is hot , put in cumin seeds
8. let the seeds sizzle for a few seconds
9. put in potatoes
10. turn heat down to medium
11. brown potatoes lightly on all sides
12. turn heat to low and add 3 / 4 t salt and ground cumin , garam masala and cayenne
13. cook , stirring , for a minute
14. add the cilantro just before serving and toss to mix
demonstrations.review: Wonderful flavor!  I used fingerling potatoes and left the skins on.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beet salad with pistachios and feta cheese

this recipe is from the sept. 16, 2008 edition of the "living" section of our local newspaper, "the democrat & chronicle".  dh and i were blessed with an abundance of beets in our vegetable garden this year and have been searching for different ways to use them.  i thought this recipe sounded interesting.  i have not made this yet but have plans for the near future.

1. in a small mixing bowl , whisk together orange juice , vinegar , honey and olive oil until well blended
2. place beets through the shredding disc of a food processor , then toss with half the dressing mixture
3. toss romaine lettuce with remaining dressing and divide among four salad plates
4. top each plate with beets and sprinkle with pistachios and feta cheese
demonstrations.review: I'm obsessed with beet salad, and this one's great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
freezer cucumbers

this is a old family recipe. my great aunt hazel has been making these for a very long time. they are just wonderful. my mom uses a little of both.

1. mix and stir the first three ingredients till disolved
2. then mix the rest and add the sugar / vinegar mixture and let rest 10 minites
3. freeze
demonstrations.review: The recipe as written was much too sweet for our tastes, even though I only used 1 1/2 cups of sugar.  I added 2 more cucumbers and another 1/2 cup of vinegar to balance it out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sauteed chicken with capers and lemon butter

this is a super, fast recipe. it comes from an old, out of print cookbook of quick, easy recipes. this is great served over rice or mashed potatoes.

1. season cutlets with salt and pepper
2. grate 1 / 2 tsp lemon zest and squeeze 2 t juice from the lemon
3. set aside
4. heat butter and olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat
5. add the chicken and cook , turning once , until golden brown and cooked through
6. remove chicken to serving plates , leaving drippings in the pan
7. add 3 t water , lemon juice , lemon zest and capers to the pan and cook , stirring up browned bits from bottom of pan , for about 1 minute
8. mash a few of the capers into the sauce with the back of a spoon
9. pour the sauce over the chicken and serve
demonstrations.review: So simple and so mouth-watering!  I doubled the recipe, eye-balled all the ingredients, and dusted the chicken with flour (as previously suggested).  Served with whole wheat spaghetti, we couldn't get it in our mouths fast enough.  I'll add sauted veggies next time.

target.recipe_text:
linguini with prosciutto and asparagus

from iga booklet.

1. cook the linguini according to the package instructions and set aside
2. heat the olive oil in a saucepan and saut the onion for 2 to 3 minutes
3. add the asparagus and continue cooking for 3 to 4 minutes
4. pour in the cream and simmer for 3 minutes to thicken
5. incorporate the prosciutto and parsley
6. season to taste
7. serve the sauce on a bed of linguini
target.review: This was very nice. I liked it, it was very tasty. However, I thought there wasn't enough sauce for the amount of pasta which made it a little bit dry. Next time I'll make slightly more sauce, because the flavours deserve for this to be a five star recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple pies for the freezer

it is so nice to be able to have these prepared frozen pies waiting for you to bake and serve within an hour's notice. i like to mix my favorite apples, cortlands and granny smith, for this recipe. the brine will keep the apples from turning in this easy recipe.

1. make the crust recipe in 2 separate bowls
2. using an electric mixer , mix first three ingredients until the texture resembles course meal
3. beat one egg in a 1 cup measuring cup
4. fill cup with water to make 1 full cup
5. add to flour mixture
6. mix well , chill for 15 minutes
7. for each batch , divide dough 5 ways
8. roll out 5 crusts on a floured surface
9. place bottom crusts in 5 pie tins
10. filling: add apples , sugar , cinnamon nutmeg
11. roll out 5 more crusts on floured surface
12. top pies with crusts
13. crimp to seal
14. place in ziplock bags
15. seal and freeze
16. to bake: place frozen pie on a baking sheet in a 350 degree f preheated oven
17. bake 1 hour
demonstrations.review: I made this over the weekend. Perhaps my pastry dish is smaller, but there were enough apples for double the amount of pies! I still have a freezer full of apples I'll use at some stage. I baked one pie straight away and have put two in the freezer. Once the apples were picked, peeled and cored, this was actually really easy and I cannot recommend it highly enough. Hubby even commented that it might be the best apple pie he's ever had. Loved it and soon as I have some time I'll be making the rest of the apples in to pie so that I have a ready winter supply. Thanks for this superb recipe - 26 October - Just to add, the frozen pies were as perfect as the fresh one. I served among other deserts at my birthday party and it's the only one that was completely finished. Everyone loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai mince with fragrant rice

there are so many great flavours associated with thai food.  here i have taken a classic bolodnese and added some of those flavours to create something really special.

1. cook the rice in a pan of boiling water for about 15 minutes
2. meanwhile , heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 3-4 minutes until golden
3. stir in the garlic and red pepper and cook for 4 minutes , then add the mince and chilli powder and cook for 2-3 minutes until well browned
4. stir in the stock , bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes
5. blend the cornflour with 1 tbsp of water and the soy sauce until smooth , add to the pan and stir until slightly thickened
6. season and stir in the basil leaves
7. drain the rice and spoon onto plates , top with the thai mince and serve with a scattering of fresh basil leaves
demonstrations.review: This was really tasty. The basil particularly was a great addition as it came in random surprise bursts of flavour. Very yummy. I also added some lemongrass to the rice and it was stunning. I also added a few other dried herbs and spices as we like our food like that. Great recipe. Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
avocado pudding

don't mock it till ya try it!  i love this pudding and so does my family (including a toddler!).  adjust the cocoa powder and sugar to your liking.  i add chopped hazelnuts to the top of mine.

1. in blender combine avocado and banana
2. blend until smooth
3. add milk , sugar , vanilla and cocoa powder
4. blend again
5. pour into small dessert bowls and chill for at least 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: This had a really unusual flavour, and although it was nice, it looked more like a chocolate pudding than it was. I found this quite deceptive. I tried it because it was interesting, but I'm afraid it isn't one of my favourites.
