sabrett s onion sauce for hot dogs by todd wilbur

from top  secret recipes www.topsecretrecipes.com. posted in response to a request, this recipe is supposed to be a copycat for the sauce served on sabrett hog dogs, one of the more popular street hot dogs in new york.

1. heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. saut the onion in the oil for 5 minutes , or until the onions are soft , but not brown
3. add the water , tomato paste , corn syrup , cornstarch , salt , and red pepper flakes , and stir together
4. bring the mixture to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes
5. add the vinegar and continue simmering for an additiona1 30-45 minutes , or until most of the liquid is reduced and the sauce is thickened
6. makes about 1 cup
demonstrations.review: this was much better used the next day. the first day the vinegar seemed a bit too strong for me. It was very good though and for a new yorker like me the only way to eat a hot dog! I will make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honeyed cantaloupe with blueberries

side dish to salsa pasta ole

1. squeeze 1 tablespoon lemon juice into a medium bowl
2. add the honey and cinnamon and whisk until blended
3. pick over the blueberries , rinse , and drain well
4. add the blueberries and cantaloupe to the lemon honey and toss gently to coat
demonstrations.review: So so good! You can really mix the lemon honey and cinnamon to your personal liking, no need to follow exact measurements!! ;)<br/>I also made it with strawberries instead of the blueberries and it was just as good. Thanks for the great recipe!!

target.recipe_text:
lemon blueberry scones

my family loves these, they get eaten up right away. i like them with butter and honey right out of the oven. the recipe came from my grandmother.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. mix the first four ingredients in a bowl
3. cut in shortening
4. add lemon rind
5. add egg and milk and work in gently and quickly with hands
6. add blueberries and gently fold in
7. pat into round one inch thick on a baking sheet score into 8 pieces
8. brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar
9. bake 15 minutes or until slightly golden--do not over bake
target.review: Yummy!  Yummy!  Yummy!  I substituted butter for shortening and they came out great.  This recipe is a keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy moist banana blueberry muffins

these muffins are super easy and super moist.

1. mash bananas in a large mixing bowl
2. add sugar and egg
3. add butter and blueberries
4. combine dry ingredients and gently stir into banana mixture
5. pour into 12 well-greased muffin cups
6. bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: Nice, moist muffins, but way too much sugar for my taste. I reduced it to 1/3 of a cup and they were much better. Next time I'll try 1/4 cup. The sweetness of the bananas has to be taken into consideration. They freeze well.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
maple nutty granola

my mouth is watering just thinking about it!  recipe courtesy of ellie krieger.  i have not tried this recipe.  i love homemade granola, but loathe all the extra fat and sugar that can sneak into my bowl!  this give you a healthy dose of omega-3's, protein, carbs and tastes great too.

1. preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray
3. combine oats , nuts , maple syrup , salt , cinnamon and the raisins , if using
4. spread mixture onto baking sheet and bake until golden brown , stirring occasionally for about 30 minutes total
5. cool completely , then store in refrigerator in an airtight container
6. serving size is 1 / 2 cup
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe!!  Super easy and not too sweet and heavy.  I didn't have almonds so I substituted sunflower seeds and I also substituted chopped, dried apricots for the raisins.  This is a keeper.  Thanks for posting it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
french italian salad dressing mix

okay, there is italian salad dressing and then there is french salad dressing. this mix combines both for a wonderful unique result. this recipe come from more make a mix cookery cookbook, 1980 vintage.

1. mix all the dry ingredients together
2. keep in airtight package until ready to use
3. can be stored for up to 6 months
4. when salad dressing is needed , combine 1 packet of mix with oil , viegar and ketchup in a blender at high speed for about 7 seconds
5. pour into a 2-cup container with tight fitting lid and allow to stand at room temperature for about 5 hours
6. refrigerate 30 minutes before serving
7. pour over salad and enjoy
demonstrations.review: We love, love, love this salad dressing!  Great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best cream of broccoli soup

this recipe is thick and flavorful. simple, delicious, and quick to make. hope that you enjoy it as much as my family does. i have added chicken to this soup, very good

1. melt 2 tablespoons butter in medium sized stock pot , and saut onion , garlic and celery until tender
2. add broccoli and broth
3. cover and simmer for 10 minutes
4. pure soup or mash with potato masher
5. return to heat
6. in small saucepan , over medium heat melt 3 tablespoons butter , stir in flour and add milk
7. stir until thick and bubbly , add to soup
8. add cheese
9. stir until melted
10. season with pepper and serve
demonstrations.review: Really yummy.  I added some additional cooked, chopped broccoli before serving because we like chunky soups.  I also threw in a cup of grated cheddar (you can never have too much cheese - LOL).  I'll definitely make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
paul s favorite spinach walnut pesto

i got this recipe from my brother-in-law - - it is his signature dish.  i know he got the original recipe from a cookbook, but i do not know the name of the book.  the pesto has an intense green color and a pleasingly bold flavor.  serve over thin to regular spaghetti noodles.  also, this pesto freezes very well.

1. place all ingredients in a food processor and pulse several times until coarsely chopped
2. scrape sides of bowl from time to time
3. process continuously until the sauce is smooth
4. if the pesto is too thick , add a little hot water and pulse again
5. at this point , you can either freeze the pesto for future use or toss immediately with prepared , hot spaghetti noodles
6. serve with crusty bread and a good white wine
demonstrations.review: Easy and delicious!  A new use for the mountain of spinach in my garden.  Give Paul my thanks.  It's a keeper.

target.recipe_text:
taffy apple pizza

a pampered chef winner! one of my favorites. the crust is sugar cookie dough! did you know taffy originated in germany? and apples are used extensively in germany too! i guess that makes this a german recipe!(lol)

1. put sliced apples into the lemon-lime soda to soak so they won't brown
2. preheat oven to 350
3. roll cookie dough into a 12-inch circle on a 13" baking stone that has been lightly floured
4. bake approximately 5 minutes longer than directions on package say
5. let cool
6. in a bowl , mix peanut butter , cream cheese , sugar and vanilla
7. spread over cooled cookie crust
8. then drain apples and arrange in a spiral , to cover entire "pizza"
9. srinkle with cinnamon and pour over caramel topping
10. it's ready to serve !
11. enjoy !
target.review:
Very easy and quick to make. LOVED the tip w/ the lemon-lime soda. 
  A Keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
reeses squares   5 ingredients   no bake  reese s

these bars are extremely rich and not for people with a fear of chocolate and peanut butter (if those people actually exist)!!! very easy no bake 5 ingredient recipe!

1. combine graham crumbs , sugar and peanut butter and mix well
2. blend in melted butter until well combined
3. press mixture evenly into a 9 x 13 inch pan
4. melt chocolate chips in microwave or in double boiler
5. spread over peanut butter mixture
6. chill until just set and cut into bars (these are very hard to cut if the chocolate gets "rock hard"
demonstrations.review: These were easy to make-I lined pan as suggested. DH took them to work and they were gone b/f he got a chance to try one! Luckily, I saved some.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fried cabbage with bacon

this is delicious!  from my friend miranda's kitchen--just can't get enough! perfect to serve over rice.  it's really good leftover, too!  can be prepared without mushrooms and onions.

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. saut mushrooms , onion , and garlic in vegetable oil
3. cook bacon in large fry pan , remove from pan and allow to cool
4. place cabbage in fry pan with bacon grease , stir until cabbage is coated with bacon grease
5. cook slightly , salt and pepper to taste
6. combine ground beef and saut mixture into the cabbage pan
7. cook until cabbage is slightly crisp
8. crumble bacon and add to mixture , stir
9. serve over rice if desired
10. salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: Loved this! Added a bit of sausage. This is a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach dip ii

yum

1. stir all ingredients until well mixed
2. cover
3. chill
4. makes 3 cups
demonstrations.review: This dip is excellent!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dessert crepes with strawberry cream filling

yummy!! this recipe will knock the socks off any guest! this recipe my mother originally found out of a cookbook, but unfortunately i do not know which. this works well with both frozen and fresh strawberries. i'd imagine almost any fruit could be substituted as well. (prep time does not include chilling of strawberries).

1. to make strawberry cream: combine the strawberries and sugar and chill , anywhere from an hour to overnight
2. drain excess water from strawberries and sugar
3. in mixing bowl blend cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth
4. stir in reserved strawberries
5. to make dessert crepes: beat eggs
6. add remaining ingredients
7. heat pan over med-high heat
8. when a few drops of water sprinkled on the pan bounces is about the right temperature
9. pour about 1 / 8 c of batter into pan , tilting to spread evenly
10. when the crepe has turned a light brown color you may or may not want to turn to brown other side
11. turn to brown other side if batter has not set
12. fill crepes with strawberry cream
13. may serve immedietly or chills well in the refrigerator
14. before serving i usually sprinkle a little extra powdered sugar on the crepes
15. the dessert crepe receipe will also work well with many other fillings
demonstrations.review:
I am re-rating after having made the filling. Great crepes! Easy to make and virtually non-stick. 
 Paid $6.00 for just one at a restaurant the other day. Came home and found the recipe and made them again. Thecream cheese filling makes all the difference! I did not put the strawberries in the filling, so that we could experiment with differeny fruit toppings.
 OH YUM, YUM, YUM!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with lime butter

this is a quick summer meal that we have a lot with fresh fruit salad...and rice pilaf

1. sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper --
2. heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
3. saute chicken until light brown , about 3 minutes per side
4. cover , reduce heat to low
5. cook 10 minutes or until chicken is tender
6. remove chicken to serving platter
7. drain oil from skillet
8. add lime juice --
9. cook over low heat until juice begins to boil
10. about 1 minutes
11. add butter , one tbls at a time , until butter becomes opaque and forms a thick sauce
12. remove from heat and stir in chives and dill
13. spoon sauce over chicken --
14. serve immediately
demonstrations.review:
GREAT RECIPE! Fast, easy and delicious. 
 I agree w/ Knitaholic about getting lime and butter to thicken.

target.recipe_text:
greek potatoes  oven roasted and delicious

these potatoes are a staple in our home. whether accompanying roast lamb or chicken, or just on their own, we have them a couple of times a week. they are delicious and the ones that get overly-brown in the pan and stick a bit are mine!  clean up is a little tricky with this recipe, unless you line your pans with foil, but i find that just filling the pan up with hot, sudsy water and forgetting for an hour (something i apparently have no problem doing ;-)) helps a lot.

1. preheat oven to 420f a reviewer has suggested spraying the baking pan with pam - that sounds like a great idea !
2. put all the ingredients into a baking pan large enough to hold them
3. season generously with sea salt and black pepper
4. make sure your hands are very clean and put them in the pan and give everything a toss to distribute
5. the garlic will drop into the water / oil solution but its flavour will permeate the potatoes , and this way , it won't burn
6. bake for 40 minutes
7. when a nice golden-brown crust has formed on the potatoes , give them a stir to bring the white underside up , season lightly with a bit more sea salt and pepper and just a light sprinkling of oregano
8. add 1 / 2 cup more water if pan appears to be getting dry , and pop back into oven to brown other side of potatoes
9. this will take about another 40 minutes
10. do not be afraid of overcooking the potatoes- they will be delicious
target.review: I LOVE these potatoes! I used 3 small potatoes for the two of us. I sprayed the pan with PAM first.  I sprinkled 1-2 TBSP of Penzey's Greek seasoning over the potatoes and baked for 2hours adding additional water and flipping the potatoes as needed. We like our potatoes crispy and these did not dissapoint!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted asparagus with feta

very simple to make and so flavorful- this is a real treat!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. heat olive oil , minced garlic , lemon zest , oregano , and red pepper flakes in a small pan over low heat until garlic becomes golden and oil becomes fragrant
3. remove from heat and allow to cool
4. bend asparagus gently until it breaks at a natural point and discard ends
5. toss asparagus pieces with infused olive oil and place in a single layer on a baking sheet
6. season asparagus with salt and pepper
7. sprinkle asparagus with crumbled feta cheese
8. roast at 400f for 12 minutes or until cooked to your liking
9. sprinkle with chopped parsley and squeeze the lemons over the asparagus , being careful to catch the seeds
10. serve hot
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe :) I have to admit that I usually take the lazy way out and just toss the asparagus in olive oil, sprinkle a little bit of gray sea salt then sprinkle the feta on top. I also throw in a handful of grape tomatoes. Absolutely delicious!! Thank you for sharing :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best pasta salad

great pasta salad for summer. very easy and inexpensive.

1. cook pasta according to directions , about 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. while pasta is cooking , chop tomato , peppers and onion into very small pieces
3. add olives and mix
4. drain rotini
5. rinse with cold water for about 3 minutes
6. mix pasta with tomato , peppers , onion and olives
7. refrigerate for about 1 / 2 an hour
8. add salad dressing
9. mix well
10. add parmesan cheese
11. mix well
12. serve immediately
13. if you have left overs , you will have to "re-wet" salad by adding a little more salad dressing the next day , especially if you substitute the dressing with a fat-free dressing
demonstrations.review: I love this pasta salad! It's the best I've tried! I sometimes leave out the tomato, red pepper and onion if I am not sure what the crowd will like. I also add tomato and herb feta cheese along with the parm cheese. thanks for a wonderful recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco ritos

this recipe comes from denver fire fighters favorites cookbook published in 1976. this is a quick and very tasty dish and you can increase ingredients to make a larger batch, if needed. it's always been a big seller in my house.

1. brown ground beef and drain off grease
2. add refried beans
3. remove from heat
4. soften tortilla in microwave for 20-25 seconds
5. place 2 tbspns
6. of ground beef mixture and 1 tspn
7. of onion on tortilla and roll like a burrito
8. place in shallow roasting pan
9. repeat filling and rolling instructions until you fill approximately 8 tortillas
10. mix mushroom soup and green chile enchilada sauce together and pour over rolled tortillas in pan
11. top with both cheeses
12. bake in 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and everything is hot
13. allow to stand about 5 minutes
14. serve with toppings , as desired
demonstrations.review: I served this to guests and it was a huge hit! I made my own refried beans from a recipe I found on this site. I use 9 inch flour tortillas and sprayed the pan with Pam cooking spray. I also made this in the morning and placed in the fridge until I was ready to bake it later in the evening. I baked it for 45-60 minutes until I though it was heated through. This makes alot and is very fillling. I froze the leftovers in FoodSaver bags so my husband and I can enjoy dinner for two. I plan to use this recipe with ground Elk and ground buffalo. Thank you for sharing such a delicious and easy meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
frosted fudge brownies

these are the best brownies that i have ever tried. they make large brownies with thick yummy frosting on them. i got the recipe from country woman magazine.

1. in a saucepan , melt butter
2. remove from the heat
3. stir in cocoa and cool
4. while cooling , beat eggs and sugar in mixing bowl
5. combine the flour , baking powder and salt
6. gradually add to the egg mixture
7. stir in the vanilla and cooled chocolate mixture and mix well
8. spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-in
9. pan
10. bake at 350 for 25-28 minutes of until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. cool on a wire rack
12. for frosting , in a mixing bowl , cream the butter , confectioners' sugar , cocoa and vanilla
13. add enough milk until it achieves spreading consistency
14. spread over brownies
15. cut into bars and enjoy
demonstrations.review:
These Brownies are absolutely delicious. I've made then for several years and got the recipe from Country woman also. Be sure to check out the picture!

Marianne

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baby pacifiers  shower favors

i saw this on an episode of 

1. unwrap all the lifesavers
2. take one lifesaver and apply a thin layer of frosting around the inner hole
3. grab a jellybean and place one of the short , round ends in it , so the length of the jellybean is coming out of the hole
4. flip the lifesaver over
5. on the other side , take the frosting and make a slightly thicker layer of frosting around the inner hole / center , and place another lifesaver perpendicular attaching edge of 2nd lifesaver to center of 1st lifesaver with jellybean attached to it
6. place on flat surface and allow to dry
7. after drying for 3-4 hours , thread curling ribbon through the hole of the 2nd lifesaver and tie in a knot
demonstrations.review: I made these recently and they were a hit! I used a tube of WIlton's Fondant Icing Writer because I couldn't find a small tube of Royal Icing. It worked well. I just had to allow for extra drying time. I made them 2 weeks in advance and stored them in an airtight container. The picture isn't a close-up, but this is how I displayed them on the "sign-in" table, Along with a Baby diaper cake, MTB corsage, grandma corsages, and the Diaper Pins. Too Cute!!

target.recipe_text:
ground beef enchilada casserole

to serve a crowd double all ingredients and bake in a large casserole dish. to save time prepare the ground beef filling up to a day in advance just warm slightly when ready to use. see recipe#168653

1. set oven to 400 degrees
2. grease an 11 x 7-inch casserole dish
3. in a large skillet cook the ground beef with the green chiles , onions , garlic , bell pepper , dried chili flakes and chili powder
4. cook over medium heat until beef is no longer pink
5. drain fat completely
6. season with seasoned salt and black pepper to taste then transfer to a large bowl
7. stir in the tortilla pieces with cream of mushroom soup , black olives , enchilada sauce , sour cream and 1-1 / 2 cups shredded cheese
8. mix to combine
9. transfer to prepared baking dish
10. cover and bake for about 30 minutes
11. uncover and sprinkle with about 2 cups (or more of shredded cheese then chopped tomatoes
12. return to oven and bake uncovered until casserole is bubbly and the cheese has melted
13. serve with toppings
target.review: Holy cheeseballs! What a great supper! Made as written!  Great the second time around too, as the heat really kicks up overnight. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach and potato frittata

great for breakfast or brunch as well as a light dinner.

1. heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
2. place potatoes in the skillet , cover and cook about 10 minutes until tender but firm
3. mix in spinach , green onions and garlic
4. season with salt and pepper
5. continue cooking 1 to 2 minutes , until spinach is wilted
6. in a medium bowl , beat eggs and milk
7. pour into skillet over the vegetables
8. sprinkle with cheddar cheese
9. reduce heat to low
10. cover
11. cook 5 to 7 more minutes or until eggs are firm
12. cut into wedges and serve
demonstrations.review: Made this for Christmas brunch!  DH and I loved this frittata!  Sadly, time was running away from me, and I had to bake my potatoes in the microwave to soften them (tacky, I know) but it got the job done.  I halved the spinach but added a small handful of mushrooms! Yummy! Great recipe, thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s moist cheddar garlic oven fried chicken breast

this is for serious garlic lovers. the chicken bakes out so moist and tender! grated cheese may be sprinkled on top of the breast the last 5 minutes of cooking if desired but that is optional. double all ingredients for more than four breasts and adjust the amount of garlic to suit taste. for the coating amount you might be able to get away with 5 or maybe 6 very small chicken breasts, but i would suggest to increase the amount slightly --- to take this dish to yet another level, about 10 minutes before the cooking time is finished, drizzle the top of the chicken with a little pasta sauce, then sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. return to oven for about 10 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked and sauce is hot and cheese has melted. for a lemon-garlic flavor add in 3 tablespoons lemon juice to the melted butter/garlic mixture ---  *note* for a healthier alternative smart balance butter blend may be used in place of the melted butter --- you will love this chicken!
visit my food blog, www.kittencalskitchen.com, for more of my recipes.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. butter an 11 x 7-inch pan
3. in a bowl , combine melted butter with fresh minced garlic , 1 teaspoon garlic powder and salt
4. in another bowl , combine the dry breadcrumbs with 1 / 2 cup finely grated cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder and coarse ground black pepper
5. dip chicken in butter mixture
6. then in crumb mixture
7. place in prepared pan and bake uncovered for 35-45 minutes or until cooked through , larger breasts may take more time
8. top with shredded cheddar or mozzarella the last 5 minutes of cooking (this is only optional
demonstrations.review: DH and I loved this chicken; which is a great thing, considering he doesn't like chicken too much!  Did not have minced garlic, so I used 2T of garlic powder.  Turned out excellent! Very crunchy on the outside, which I love, and super moist on the inside :)  Truly great Kittencal!  Definately a keeper!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
poverty meal

when i was a child, my family used to eat this at least once a week due to the fact that it is inexpensive and a little goes a long way. we also added fresh herbs or sometimes whole kernel corn. its even better the next day and it freezes well.

1. saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent
2. brown ground beef and drain
3. add ground beef , tomatoes , water , raw macaroni , salt and pepper to the onion and garlic mixture
4. cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. if desired , top with parmesan cheese
6. serve with crusty bread and a salad
demonstrations.review: I too, have made this for years... my mom called it goulash.  But nevertheless, this meal is always timeless.  As I've gotten older I've changed it quite a bit (adding lots of canned tomatoes, ROTEL, fireroasted and others) and either making it a mexican style or italian. Love, love, LOVE this supper.  We're making it tonight, as a matter of fact. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roast duck l orange

i found this recipe on the internet and modified it slightly. this is the best roast duck recipe i have made so far. the combination of seasonings goes very well with the duck and the l'orange sauce. i used the skin, bones and drippings to make a soup base that was out-of-this-world good!

1. sprinkle chili powder , garlic powder , and salt all over ducks
2. cut 1-inch slice in skin of ducks on both sides of breasts
3. puree garlic , sage and olive oil and fill in slices in skin with mixture
4. chop apple into 1-inch pieces and stuff inside ducks
5. bake at 350f for 1 hour 30 minutes for a slightly rare duck , or 2 hours for a well done duck
6. put the ingredients for the l'orange sauce in saucepan and heat until alcohol simmers off , about 6 minutes
7. serve l'orange sauce over sliced duck breasts or other parts
8. makes about 1 cup
demonstrations.review: Whoops! I hadn't realized I hadn't made a review! We made this for Thanksgiving.  It was excellent.  No changes were made at all.  This is the 3rd time I've made duck for the holiday, and we didn't miss the boring turkey at all.. :) Thanks for a great duck recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Another winner! I used s/b thighs (it's what I had on hand) and shredded it, serving over homemade spanish rice as a previous poster did. Great flavor (only I felt I needed to add a bit more salsa) and super easy.  I cooked this over the stovetop though... simmering the chicken in the salsa/corn/bean mixture until cooked thoroughly and adding the cream cheese last..  I didn't have the time to slow cook, but it was still excellent! Great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
cheesecake fudge

nan

1. combine flour , butter and brown sugar in large bowl
2. beat with electric mixer on low until butter is cut into dry ingredients
3. place this mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan
4. bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes
5. meanwhile , mix frosting and cream cheese until combined
6. add eggs and beat until smooth
7. carefully spread chocolate mixture over hot crust
8. sprinkle with almonds
9. bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until chocolate mixture is set
10. cool
11. cut into bars and store in refrigerator
target.review: In the directions you have to combine with brown sugar, but I don't see how much to put in with the ingredients??

demonstrations.recipe_text:
10 minute   quick and easy chocolate brownie pudding cake

this is not a gourmet cake, but it is a quick chocolate fix. this cake cooks in about 5-7 minutes in the microwave, yes the microwave believe it or not! depending on your microwave as to how much pudding will be in it,it will be a cakey,brownie,pudding like dessert.i like to top it with ice cream and fudge and whip cream for a quick ice cream brownie treat or powdered sugar and chocolate sauce.

1. boil water with 3 tbsp of sugar and set aside
2. combine all dry ingredients in a bowl , then add eggs , melted butter and vanilla until well blended , mixture will be thick
3. butter a 9 inch microwavable pan or tupperware , even if its a tad smaller it's ok
4. spread mixture evenly into the buttered pan
5. very slowly pour water into the center of the mixture and do not stir !
6. cover well , with plastic wrap or lid
7. cook in microwave on regular power for 5 minutes , check it to make sure it's set and if not put back in microwave for a couple more minutes
8. sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with your favorite toppings
9. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Great recipe! DH wanted a quick desert the other night, and we loved this one so much we are making it again tonight! We added some chocolate chips and walnuts this time! Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cake mix apple crisp

this is very quick and easy to make! the yellow cake mix is what gives this apple crisp its special flavor! try it & see for yourself.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. cut apple slices crosswise in half
3. place in 9-inch square pan
4. sprinkle with dry cake mix
5. in small bowl , combine sugar & cinnamon
6. sprinkle over cake mix
7. drizzle with butter
8. bake 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown
9. serve warm with ice cream , if desired !
demonstrations.review: Great easy recipe, and turned out delicious. I also sprinkled some nutmeg and allspice on top before I put it in the oven. I also added a few more tablespoons of butter than just the 1/4 cup. Delicious! Thank you for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
no dough meat crust  pizza for the low carb dieter

tastes like a pizza, cuts like a pizza, yet there is no dough....though do have a fork and knife on hand for eating purposes because it can get a little messy if eaten with hands only. i am a south beach dieter with a love for italian foods and this is what curbs my craving for pizza. i love mine with the turkey pepperoni slices, onion, green peppers and mushroom. serve with a tossed salad or marinated veggies.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. meanwhile , brown the ground beef
3. drain
4. place meat in a mixing bowl and mix with 1 cup of mozzarella
5. spread the mixture into a circle on a round pizza pan or baking stone
6. and top with 1 / 2 cup pizza sauce
7. top with the rest of the mozzarella , optional toppings and seasonings
8. bake for about 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned
demonstrations.review: HB and loved it so much we made it 2 nights in a row for dinner!! I am on South Beach Phase 1, and I couldn't kick my craving for pizza, so this fit in just in time. We added zuchinni sliced thin, and ground sausage along with everything else. Thank You for this life saver!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blueberry crunch

not sure where i got this recipe from--on another website somewhere i think. kind of a "dump" style recipe. use fresh berries, canned or frozen (thawed).

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. grease a 9 by 13 inch baking pan
3. spread undrained pineapple evenly in pan
4. follow with the blueberries
5. sprinkle 3 / 4 cup sugar over the blueberries
6. sprinkle the cake mix evenly over the blueberries
7. drizzle the melted margarine evenly over the cake mix
8. followed by the 1 / 4 cup sugar and the pecans
9. bake for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: Instead of yellow cake mix I used lemon cake mix which added a good tangy twist the the flavors. I would agree to cut down on the sugar over the blueberries. But this was a great quick recipe. Husband and friend at work loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
southern barbecued beef tips

a southern classic that is delicious and easy to make. the sauce is a sweet and tangy barbecue sauce that cooks with the meat, flavoring both the sauce and meat. my family loves this dish! thanks barbiann!

1. in a large skillet over medium heat , saute onions in butter , when onions are tender add meat and cook until browned
2. mix in mustard , worcestershire sauce , vinegar , salt , pepper , sugar and catsup
3. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: Awesome recipe!! Husband made it for dinner tonight and WOW!! We especially loved the homemade barbecue sauce, and plan on using it on several other recipes!!

target.recipe_text:
cauliflower white cheddar soup

i received a pamphlet from kitchen basics stock called healthy cooking with stock at the taste of home cooking school recently.  i hope to try this recipe soon as the weather gets cooler.  dh loves cauliflower and white cheddar, so it seems like it will be a hit.  let me know how you like it if you try it before me!

1. heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. add the onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , 5-8 minutes
3. add the cauliflower and cook , stirring occasionally , until light golden brown , about 5 minutes
4. add the stock , milk , nutmeg , and pepper and bring to a boil
5. reduce the heat to low and simmer until the cauliflower is easily pierced with a fork , about 10 minutes
6. remove 1 cup of cauliflower florets and set aside
7. , puree soup in blender or food processor until smooth
8. return soup to pot and stir in the cheese and remaining cauliflower florets and adjust seasonings to taste
target.review: Nice and filling. Loved the flavor but I like to kick it up a bit with red pepper flake. Very good soup. Made for Football Pool, week 5.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage with polish sausage

this is another recipe from the 1983 southern living cookbook.  to me this is real comfort food.

1. saut onion in butter in a dutch oven over low heat until tender
2. add flour , stirring until smooth
3. cook 1 minutes , stirring constantly
4. gradually add water and vinegar
5. cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture thickens
6. stir in remaining ingredients
7. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: I agree with you, Jim, this is real comfort food. Delish! Made for Football Pool 2012

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage salad cups

inspired by the light, summery flavors of vietnamese salad rolls, these cabbage salad cups bring crunch and a flavorful sauce to delight your tastebuds. feel free to chop the veggies in a food processor if you have one, and adjust the chili pepper flakes to your heat preference in the sauce. enjoy!

1. bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. add chicken and boil 30 minutes , or until cooked through
3. allow chicken to cool to room temperature when done
4. meanwhile , separate 8 large cabbage leaves from cabbage gently cut into the large core at the bottom to ease them out leaf by leaf
5. gently remove the thickest part of the cabbage rib / stem by cutting a v in the base of each leaf and removing it
6. prepare rice noodles according to package directions and allow to cool to room temperature
7. toss with the 1 t sesame oil
8. from remaining cabbage , shred to 1 cups worth
9. combine shredded cabbage , carrot , radishes , and green onions in a medium bowl and mix
10. reserve any excess cabbage for another use
11. when chicken is cooled , shred meat , discarding skin and bone
12. add shredded chicken and rice noodles to veggie mixture and mix well
13. prepare sauce by whisking together all of the sauce ingredients
14. adjust chili pepper flakes to taste
15. place the 8 large cabbage leaves onto a serving platter
16. spoon chicken veggie mixture equally into each of the 8 cups
17. drizzle each with sauce and serve
demonstrations.review: I liked the flavor and the texture inside the cabbage leaf, but would have liked a less crunchy vessel, maybe a lettuce leaf to hold it all together. The cabbage leafs were too crunchy and firm. You could easily use prepared rotisserie chicken to save time, but I realize for this contest, the recipe had to use chicken drumsticks. Good flavors!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jalapeno cheese grits

my husband's favorite. we eat this with just about everything, in place of mashed potatoes.

1. bring water and salt to rapid boil
2. add grits , reduce heat , and cook until grits are thickened , about 3-4 minutes
3. stir in butter and velveeta cheese until melted
4. mix eggs , milk , and black pepper together , and then add to the grits mixture
5. stir in the chopped jalapenos
6. pour into casserole dish
7. bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until set in a 300 degree oven
8. sprinkle jack cheese on top , and return to the oven for 15 more minutes
demonstrations.review: Your husband is sooooo right! this is a great dish! Had it for New Year's along with a big pot of black eyed peas. Delicious, I'll make this all the time. This good old Southern girl loved these grits!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mini shrimp cocktail appetizers

from kraftfoods(dot)com website.  i made these for a party and i've had so many people request the recipe.  kraft calls for using finely chopped onions but i skipped that just to make it an even faster appetizer to get on the table.

1. spread each cracker with 1 tsp of the cream cheese spread
2. top evenly with the cocktail sauce and one shrimp
3. sprinkle some of the finely chopped onions on top
demonstrations.review:
Such a beautiful presentation! Looks like you've slaved all day in the kitchen, but it only takes minutes to put these together. A great appetizer! Thanks,
P

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jane s best ever peanut butter cookies

this recipe came from my mother, jane hand, when i asked her for her best recipes so that i could save them for my daughters.  not being a pb cookie lover, i set this aside until needing a sweet for work.  my co-workers raved about it.  i had lost the recipe until today so now that i have found it, i figured i had better post it for posterity. enjoy! a recent reviewer thought the temp was too high so i have adjusted. new temp and time is listed.

1. in a mixer , cream together the margarine , shortening , peanut butter , brown sugar , granulated sugar and eggs
2. into a bowl sift the flour , baking soda and baking powder
3. add the dry ingredients to the creamed ingredients in the mixer until just combined
4. add the peanuts and peanut butter chips until just combined
5. using an ice cream scoop , place dough onto a lightly greased cookie sheet
6. bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until lightly brown
demonstrations.review: My DH who is a peanut butter fanatic rated this 3 stars. It is a good recipe but watch the time and temp on this one! 12 -14 minutes at 375 degrees will burn them. I turned my oven down to 350 and watched them closely. It took about 11 minutes for a light brown cookie, not burnt. I know the temp is correct because I have an internal thermometer in the oven and checked it. Be careful on the cook time. I had to throw out a dozen cookies that were baked at 375 for twelve minutes. Thanks for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s moist cheddar garlic oven fried chicken breast

this is for serious garlic lovers. the chicken bakes out so moist and tender! grated cheese may be sprinkled on top of the breast the last 5 minutes of cooking if desired but that is optional. double all ingredients for more than four breasts and adjust the amount of garlic to suit taste. for the coating amount you might be able to get away with 5 or maybe 6 very small chicken breasts, but i would suggest to increase the amount slightly --- to take this dish to yet another level, about 10 minutes before the cooking time is finished, drizzle the top of the chicken with a little pasta sauce, then sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. return to oven for about 10 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked and sauce is hot and cheese has melted. for a lemon-garlic flavor add in 3 tablespoons lemon juice to the melted butter/garlic mixture ---  *note* for a healthier alternative smart balance butter blend may be used in place of the melted butter --- you will love this chicken!
visit my food blog, www.kittencalskitchen.com, for more of my recipes.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. butter an 11 x 7-inch pan
3. in a bowl , combine melted butter with fresh minced garlic , 1 teaspoon garlic powder and salt
4. in another bowl , combine the dry breadcrumbs with 1 / 2 cup finely grated cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder and coarse ground black pepper
5. dip chicken in butter mixture
6. then in crumb mixture
7. place in prepared pan and bake uncovered for 35-45 minutes or until cooked through , larger breasts may take more time
8. top with shredded cheddar or mozzarella the last 5 minutes of cooking (this is only optional
target.review:
Was looking for a quick and easy chicken recipe for supper.  
This was it!  Delicious, simple to make and so moist.
Definitely a keeper.  My hubby loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pineapple carrot bread

delicious. makes 2 loaves.

1. combine flour , soda , salt and cinnamon
2. set aside
3. combine eggs , sugar and oil in a medium mixing bowl
4. mix well
5. stir in carrots , pineapple and vanilla
6. add dry ingredients , mixing well
7. stir in pecans
8. pour batter into 2 greased 9x5x3 inch loafpans
9. bake at 325 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done
demonstrations.review: I doubled this recipe and got 6 mini loaves and two large loaves.  It is absolutely delicious.  I am going to freeze some of these for gifts.  Very easy to make. Wonderful recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy crock pot wingers

nan

1. remove the
2. place them in a crock pot
3. combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken
4. cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
demonstrations.review: Made these for my nieces birthday party and didn't bring a one home! They are delicious.  I made them just the way the recipe states.  Did remove the lid last hour.  Still had a lot of liquid so I took some out and they got nice and sticky.  Yummy

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy rice pudding

i like this recipe because it is easy, quick (compared to other rice pudding recipes), and uses ingredients you probably always have around the house...and it's good!

1. bring water and rice to a boil
2. reduce heat to low , cover , and simmer 14 min
3. all water should be absorbed
4. heat oven to 325 degrees
5. beat eggs in ungreased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish
6. stir in sugar , raisins , milk , salt , and spice
7. stir in rice
8. bake uncovered 45 minutes
9. stirring occasionally
10. remove from oven and stir well
11. it will still be pretty wet
12. let set for 15 minutes to thicken
13. serve warm or chilled
demonstrations.review: Made this for my brother in law and he devoured it.  He said it was delicious and I say, it's very simple to make!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick shepherd s pie

i like it because you don't need to take long to make it and my 3 yr old loves it.i kind of got it from a neighbor.

1. follow directions on box for frozen veges
2. brown ground beef and drain if neccessary
3. mix in onion soup and water into gr
4. beef until it looks like a gravy
5. mix in veges when they are cooked
6. mix instant mash to directions on box
7. put gr
8. beef mix into a 3 quart casserole dish
9. layer mash potato on top and sprinkle with cheese
10. put casserole into oven on broil till cheese at least melts
11. serve and enjoy
12. i am really unsure about serving size as we just pile it onto our plates and there is still enough left for 2 lunches for 1 person
13. prep time is for overall work and cook time is oven time
14. when i find it i will also put the english recipe on here
15. that is a from scratch recipe
demonstrations.review:
This was quick and easy.  I added a package of brown gravy mix also and it really gave it a nice flavor.  
Great kids meal

demonstrations.recipe_text:
portuguese chourico and peppers

another recipe using portuguese sausage.  the sausage can be found on line at furtados.com or gaspars.com.

1. in a slow cooker , combine the chourico , green pepper , onion , tomato paste , wine , water , and crushed garlic
2. stir so that everything is evenly distributed
3. cover , and set on low
4. cook for 8 hours
5. uncover the pot , and cook an additional 2 hours to allow some of the liquid to evaporate
6. serve over rice , or with portuguese rolls
demonstrations.review:
So glad I tried this recipe.  Have been looking for a good Chourico and Pepper recipe for a long time.
Quick and easy to make and absolutely delicious and it makes the house smell soooo good when it's cooking!!

target.recipe_text:
sonoran hot dog

there are different variations of this served throughout the southwest.  it calls for a bolillo, which is a mexican-style bun.  if you're unable to locate these you could substitute it with a bakery-fresh, soft, hot dog bun. you could also use montery jack cheese in place of the shredded mexican cheese if needed.

1. wrap the bacon around the hot dog and fry on medium high until crispy
2. cut the bolillo to create a pocket in the center of the bun , do not slice through the ends
3. this will help keep the toppings from escaping
4. spread the mustard inside the bun
5. spoon the refried beans and guacamole into the bun
6. sprinkle cheese over the guacamole
7. top with the bacon-wrapped dog
8. sprinkle with tomato and onion
9. top with the salsa verde and the mayo
10. for more authenticity , use a squeeze bottle for the mayo , applying at an angle over the other toppings
target.review: My husband put these together tonight--he saw them (or something very similar) on Man vs. Food.  They are incredibly delicious, and I don't generally care for hot dogs.  We didn't use guacamole because we didn't have any and couldn't find it at our local store, and we used a can of diced tomatoes and green chiles, so we didn't use salsa verde.  We also used turkey bacon.  We will no doubt make them again sometime.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hunter s steak

very tasty crock pot recipe. unbeleivable smells to come home to after a long day at the office.

1. trim fat from beef
2. cut beef into 6 serving size pieces
3. combine undrained tomatoes , mushrooms , celery , and carrots in 5-6 quart slow cooker
4. place beef on vegetables
5. stir together broth , soup , and seasoning mix
6. pour over beef
7. cover
8. cook on low-heat setting for 8-10 hours , or on high-heat setting for 4-5 hours
9. serve with cooked noodles
demonstrations.review: The meat ended up so tender and yummy.  I added two rice mix packages to it, which amounted a lot of rice, and was a really savory side dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy microwave peanut butter ice cream topping

an easy treat for peanut butter lovers! :)

1. combine brown sugar , corn syrup , butter and pinch of salt in a 1-1 / 2-quart microwave-safe dish
2. cover an microwave on high for 4 minutes , or until mixture boils , stirring twice
3. add in peanut butter
4. stir until smooth
5. stir in evaporated milk
6. serve warm over ice cream
7. top with chopped peanuts if desired
8. cover and store in refrigerator
9. to reheat: microwave on medium heat for 1-2 minutes , or until heated through
demonstrations.review: Superb!  I've been searching for a long time to find a peanut butter sauce similar to what you get at ice cream stores.  The search is now over.  This recipe is simple, scrumptious, and cheap to make.  It will be used repeatedly.  Thanks for posting it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
french country casserole

i am sure that the french used actual dried beans, soaked and cooked. however, this one is very quick to make if your evening is hectic.

1. combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. transfer to an ungreased 3-quart baking dish
3. cover and bake at 375f for 60 to 70 minutes or until carrots are tender
demonstrations.review: This is a good recipe.  I've made it several times--I have it in a cookbook.  I have used canned carrots so that the baking time is reduced a little.  I also omit the brown sugar, because we don't care for sweet beans.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
eggplant pasta bake

this is a bit quicker than making eggplant lasagna. simple ingredients make this a quick weeknight meal. great as a main dish or serve it with some chicken for a wonderful meal.

1. cook pasta according to directions , rinse and drain
2. saute eggplant , onion , garlic and herbs de prevonce in olive oil until cooked through
3. mix all ingredients in a bowl and transfer to a lightly greased casserole dish
4. sprinkle desired amount of grated parmesan cheese on top of dish
5. bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes or until heated through
demonstrations.review: It was good--really no eggplant taste, because it cooks up so nicely.  We used a whole pound of pasta, so to compensate, we used a big jar of spaghetti sauce.  My husband thought it could have used more sauce still.  We don't have the herbes de provence on hand, but we seasoned with a variety of Italian seasonings.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ground turkey crock pot dinner

an easy and cheap dinner. put it all in the crock in the morning and go about your day. serve by itself, or for a more filling dinner, on top of rice.

1. put potatoes on bottom and sides of crock
2. then add turkey , onion , and garlic salt
3. then add soup and other wet ingredients
4. cook on low for 7-9 hours , or high 4-6 hours
demonstrations.review: Everyone really liked this recipe!  The only complaint was everyone wanted MORE!!  I think I will double the recipe next time.  Also, I will definitely add more potatoes.  We omitted the wine.  We served it with green beans and peas on the side.

target.recipe_text:
big ol cowboy cookies

these are the best cookies! i always mix the chocolate chips (mini's, milk choc chunks, and semi sweet morsels). they are big, almost a meal in themselves!

1. heat over to 350
2. mix flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt in bowl
3. beat butter on medium speed until smooth and creamy , gradually beat in sugars , beat to combine
4. add eggs one at a time , add vanilla
5. stir in flour mixture until just combined
6. add chocolate chips , oats , coconut and pecans
7. for each cookie drop 1 / 4 cup dough onto ungreased baking sheet
8. bake at 350 for 17-19 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
9. cool cookies on rack
target.review: These are wonderful! I also made them just as written but could easily see substitions of the type of chips or dried fruit and type of nut. The recipe says 2 to 3 dozen but I got 5 dozen using an ice cream scoop. Great cookies.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pina colada sherbet

tropical flavors of coconut, pineapple, orange, and island rum combine for a four-ingredient wonder of sublime taste. transform a favorite summer cocktail into a cool and refreshing dessert. the 8 hrs of "cooking" time is freezing time.

1. in a blender container or food processor bowl combine cream of coconut , undrained pineapple , orange juice , and rum
2. cover
3. blend or process until nearly smooth
4. pour into a 9x5x3-inch loaf dish or a 2-quart baking dish
5. cover
6. freeze about 4 hours or until firm
7. break sherbet into pieces
8. place sherbet , about half at a time , in a blender container or food processor bowl
9. cover
10. blend or process until fluffy
11. return pineapple mixture to pan
12. cover and freeze at least 4 hours or until firm
demonstrations.review: Wow, yummy! I made this for a July 4th dinner party and everyone loved it. I used my counter top ice cream machine.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asian pork and noodle soup

from betty crocker simple winter meals.

1. spray 3-quart saucepan with cooking spray
2. heat over medium-high heat
3. add pork , garlic and gingerroot
4. stir-fry 3 to 5 minutes or until pork is brown
5. stir in broth , water and soy sauce
6. heat to boiling
7. reduce heat
8. simmer uncovered 5 minutes
9. stir in noodles , carrot and bell pepper
10. simmer uncovered about 10 minutes or until noodles are tender
11. stir in spinach
12. cook until heated through
demonstrations.review: We really enjoyed this soup! Made as written except I had a little cabbage to use instead of the spinach. Loved that it uses common ingredients but satisfies that Asian food craving. It also seems very adaptable as far as protein and veggies.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
100  whole wheat burger hot dog buns

i found a recipe on the internet and substituted and added different ingredients to make a white hamburger bun recipe 100% whole wheat and healthy. i have been making them for years and my family and friends just love these buns! never will i buy buns again! as with any bread machine recipe, add flour and/or water as needed. you can add other ingredients such as dried onion flakes, ground flax seed or whatever. sometimes after cooling i wrap and freeze them and defrost as needed. i hope you will love this recipe as much as i do! also, this recipe also makes great dinner rolls. just divide dough into 12 to 24 balls, depending on the size of roll you want.

1. place all ingredients in order according to your bread machine
2. select dough cycle
3. allow cycle to run
4. dump out onto lightly floured surface
5. divide into 8-10 pieces
6. shape each piece into a hot dog or hamburger bun
7. place on greased cookie sheets , cover
8. let rise 30 to 40 minutes
9. bake in preheated 375 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes until golden
10. cool on wire racks
demonstrations.review: Like others, I have searched for really good whole wheat burger buns. This is it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled steak salad with crumbly bleu salad dressing

a lovely summer salad topped with grilled steak slices and served with a delicious vinaigrette dressing with crumbly bleu cheese added.

1. in a small bowl , combine the first seven ingredients and mix well
2. stir in blue cheese
3. cover and refrigerate
4. brush olive oil on steaks and sprinkle with monreal steak seasoning
5. grill steaks , uncovered , over medium-hot heat for 6-10 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness
6. thinly slice meat
7. on a serving platter or individual salad plates , arrange lettuce , tomato , carrot , onion and olives
8. top with steak and dressing
demonstrations.review: The dressing is fantastic!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh orange muffins

i got this recipe from one of my sils after having them at her house. next time i make them i think i will add miniature chocolate chips!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. spray a muffin tin with non-stick cooking spray like pam and set aside
3. put orange quarters in food processor along with orange juice and process or blend until pureed
4. add egg and butter to food processor and combine
5. pour into large bowl
6. combine dry ingredients together in a separate bowl , then add all at once to orange mixture
7. stir to combine
8. fill muffin cups about 3 / 4 full
9. bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes
10. remove from oven and let stand in tin for 5 minutes before removing muffins
demonstrations.review: I too was skeptical about "with peel" but these were really easy and delicious. The only change was that I added 6 oz semi-sweet chocolate chips. I will keep this recipe handy!

target.recipe_text:
fake rotisserie chicken

this is so easy to prepare - and it tastes so good!

1. spray large crockpot with non-stick spray
2. form six pieces of aluminum foil into balls the size of a golf-ball and place in the pot
3. rinse the chicken thoroughly inside and out
4. rub your favorite seasonings both inside and out
5. poke holes in the lemon and insert it in the cavity
6. insert the onion in the cavity
7. place the chicken on top of the foil
8. add nothing else
9. cover and cook on low for 8 hours
target.review: This was really good!!  My husband couldn't believe how tender and moist it was.  I cooked it for 9 hours because my chicken was a little larger.  Yum!  Will definitely make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oat n  toffee cookies

to die for!!!

1. cream butter and sugars
2. add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. beat in vanilla
4. mix flour , oats , baking soda , baking powder and salt
5. gradually add to creamed mixture
6. stir in toffee bits
7. drop by rounded tbs onto ungreased baking sheets
8. bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes , until light golden brown
9. cool 1 minute before removing from pans to wire rack
demonstrations.review: These were pretty darn good!  I added about 3/4 cup of coconut also.  There was a recipe on the back of my bag of toffee pieces for an oatmeal toffee cookie that included coconut so I figured I'd give it a try.  I did follow this recipe though which was quite different than the one on the bag.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy potatoes

tired of mashed, baked and fried potatoes? well i was. this recipe came to me through experimentation. i have taken this side dish to pot-lucks, various outings, and picnics and i am always asked for the recipe. excellent side dish and very easy to make. hope you enjoy it too!

1. scrub potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes
2. cut up onions and pepper
3. place stick of margarine into gallon-size zip lock bag and place in microwave until melted
4. add potatoes , green pepper , onions and onion soup mix in bag
5. mix throughly in bag
6. empty contents of bag into glass baking dish
7. bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until potatoes are tender
demonstrations.review: This was pretty good.  Very easy to make.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crispy potato bites

i thought of this the other week when i was tired of the same old potato dishes. similar to what my mum used to make. my dh has requested twice since.

1. preheat oven to 220c
2. dice potatoes into bite size pieces
3. pour olive oil& melted butter into ovenproof dish
4. toss diced potatoes in oil& butter
5. season to taste
6. sprinkle cheese& breadcrumbs over potatoes
7. toss mixture til potatoes are covered in cheese& bread crumbs
8. cook in oven for approx 30 mins turning once half way thru
9. secrets to success , make sure oven is hot& adding the olive oil stops the butter from burning
demonstrations.review: Mmmmm!!  These are so good!  I only hope there are some left when my husband gets home for dinner.  I will definitely make these over and over again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spaghetti with tomatoes and feta

an easy, fast, meal with ingredients you usually have on hand. tastes even better the next day. (weight watchers - 7 points. serving size about 1 1/4 cups.) from a ww cookbook.

1. heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
2. add oregano and garlic , and saute 30 seconds
3. add tomato , green onions , 2 tablespoons parsley , and lemon juice
4. cook 2 minutes or until heated
5. combine tomato mixture , spaghetti , and 3 / 4 cup cheese , toss gently
6. top with remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese and 2 tablespoons parsley , and sprinkle with pepper , if desired
7. serve at room temperature or store in a an airtight container in refrigerator
demonstrations.review: Wow, this is my new go to dish when  I need a meal fast and don't have any meat.  I'm eating it right now hot and it's really good.  I can't wait to try it cold!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sour cream and ground beef layered casserole

this is a great casserole that i have been making for years, it's one of my family's favorite dishes. feel free to adjust all ingredient amounts to suit taste. i usually season the ground beef/onion mixture with seasoned salt and add in some cayenne pepper for heat but that is optional.

1. set oven to 350f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. in a large skillet , cook the ground beef with onion , garlic and chili flakes over medium heat until meat is browned and no longer pink
4. drain fat then stir in the parmesan cheese
5. add tomato sauce and sugar
6. bring mixture to a boil
7. cover , reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes stirring occasionally
8. transfer meat mixture to a greased baking dish
9. set aside
10. in a bowl beat cream cheese and sour cream at low speed until smooth
11. add in green onions then stir to combine
12. spread the cream cheese mixture over the ground beef in the dish
13. top with cooked noodles , then sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the noodles
14. sprinkle with paprika
15. bake for 25-30 minutes or until hot and bubbly
demonstrations.review: This was really good!  I halved the recipe and mixed everything together before baking.  It's pretty rich, so we got more servings out of it.  I will definitely be making this again!

target.recipe_text:
the best chili you will ever taste

this is the best chili recipe i have ever tried. i'm not sure where the recipe originated, but it is amazing! sometimes, i don't bother adding all four cans of the kidney beans and it still turns out wonderful. once anyone tastes this chili, they will be begging for the recipe!! enjoy!

1. heat oil
2. cook onions , garlic and meat until brown
3. add tomatoes , beer , coffee , tomato paste and beef broth
4. add spices stir in 2 cans of kidney beans and peppers
5. reduce heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. add 2 remaining cans of kidney beans and simmer for another 30 minutes
target.review: Made this chili for Super Bowl Sunday and it was great. I left out the sugar and chili sauce since I wasn't interested in the sweetness, and used canned tomatoes with chilis already in instead of the fresh chilis since we don't enjoy super spicy foods. Really liked mixing the ground beef with the sirloin! Oh, and I just used two cans of beans since we weren't having a huge crowd. Can't wait to eat the leftovers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my no roll pie crust

the only pie crust i will use anymore. its flaky and slightly sugary and oh so easy to do. note: due to some major discrepencies please use a good quality oil, preferably a vegetable and a good name brand like mazola, it may not seem like it will make a difference but in the end it will, also use new oil not something that has been sitting around for a while.

1. mix dry ingredients together with a fork in a pie pan
2. make a well in the center and add the oil and milk
3. mix with a fork til it makes a ball
4. flatten and press into the pan in pie crust shape and flute the edge
5. bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes until golden
6. one crust pie , excellent for cream pies and crumb topped baked pies
demonstrations.review: I made two versions of this recipe today, one for a quiche and one for the Yummy Crunchy Caramel Pie. The quiche went first. I halved the sugar and used all the salt. The crust was great but a little too salty so in the apple pie I halved the salt and left the sugar and voila -- perfection. Thanks for this super easy, super perfct recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
aloo gobi

great aloo gobi recipe from the film bend it like beckham

1. heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan
2. add the chopped onion and one teaspoon of cumin seeds to the oil
3. stir together and cook until onions become creamy , golden , and translucent
4. add chopped coriander stalks , two teaspoons of turmeric , and one teaspoon of salt
5. add chopped chillis stir tomatoes into onion mixture
6. add ginger and garlic
7. mix thoroughly
8. add potatoes and cauliflower to the sauce plus a few tablespoons of water
9. ensure that the potatoes and cauliflower are coated with the curry sauce
10. cover and allow to simmer for twenty minutes
11. add two teaspoons of garam masala and stir
12. sprinkle chopped coriander leaves on top of the curry
13. turn off the heat , cover , and leave for as long as possible before serving
demonstrations.review: Really delicious and easy (once I settled on the right garam masala). Didn't use any coriander or ginger and used powdered cumin vs. seeds but it still tasted wonderful. Oh, and I used about 2T of olive oil which was plenty for our tastes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sauteed zucchini  cherry tomatoes  olives and basil

great way to use those fresh garden vegetables.  courtesy of september 2007 issue of bon appetit.

1. heat oil in large skilled over medium-high heat
2. add zucchini , garlic , and rosemary
3. sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. saute until zucchini is just tender , about 5 minutes
5. add tomatoes and olives
6. saute until tomatoes just begin to soften , about 2 minutes
7. mix in basil and vinegar
8. season vegetables to taste with salt and pepper
demonstrations.review: This was delish! Clean, simple and very tasty. I made it with summer squash instead of zucchini and hubby agreed it was a great side dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pan roasted chicken and veggies

only one pan to wash with this wonderful casserole type dish which combines potatoes, rosemary, onions and garlic with quartered boneless chicken thighs and fresh spinach.

1. preheat oven to 475f
2. in large roasting pan , combine potatoes , onion , garlic , oil , salt , pepper and rosemary and toss to coat
3. roast veggies 25 minutes , stirring once
4. lightly salt and pepper chicken and add , tossing to coat and roast 15 minutes longer or until chicken is done
5. place spinach over chicken mixture and roast for 5 minutes longer or until spinach wilts
6. toss before serving
demonstrations.review: This is a really great dish! Simple and tasty. I left out the spinach due to family tastes but the onions and potatoes cooked up crispy and the chicken was tender and delicious. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red snapper livornese

a tangy, easy recipe for almost any firm-fleshed fish fillets: red snapper, sea bass, grouper. adaptable for sole, flounder, tilapia, and other thin fillets by adjusting cooking time. serve with white rice or couscous, and a salad or steamed broccoli. from ro on allrecipes.com.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. in a medium skillet , heat olive oil and saute onion until tender , about 5 minutes
3. add garlic , and saute for 1 minute
4. stir in tomatoes , capers , black olives , red pepper flakes , and parsley
5. bring to a boil , and simmer for 10 minutes
6. spread 1 / 2 cup of the sauce in a 11x7 inch baking dish , and arrange the snapper fillets in a single layer in the dish
7. drizzle lemon juice over the fillets , and then pour the remaining sauce over all
8. bake for 15 minutes for 1 / 2 inch thick fillets , or 30 minutes for 1 inch thick fillets
9. baste once with the sauce while baking
10. snapper is done when it flakes easily with a fork
demonstrations.review: I personally thought this was great. My husband and son were ambivalent. I may not have used enough tomatoes -- I was trying to use up cherry tomatoes from my garden. I subbed Kalamata olives for the black olives and a little feta cheese too as other reviewers suggested. I also added some white wine to make it a little "saucier" since my fresh tomatoes weren't as juicy. All in all a good recipe that would probably be good for company.

target.recipe_text:
hot mulled apple cider

.

1. combine brown sugar , allspice , 1 teaspoon cloves , salt , nutmeg , cinnamon and apple cider in large saucepan
2. bring to boiling
3. cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. strain to remove spices
5. serve in mugs with clove-studded orange wedges
target.review: I was having four generations for Christmas dinner and was looking for something that I could prepare ahead and all would like. I cooked it up and put it in the crockpot on low so people could just serve themselves. It was a big hit with everyone from the 2 year old to the 87 year old matriarch. I think the new 2 week old was the only one who didn't have some.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
winter fruit salad with lemon poppy seed dressing

i had this at a friends house & had to have the recipe. everyone i have made it for begs for the recipe. everyone just loves this!

1. in a blender or food processor , combine sugar , lemon juice , onion , mustard and salt
2. process until well blended
3. with machine still running add oil in a slow steady stream until mixture is thick and smooth
4. add poppy seeds and process just a few seconds more to mix
5. in a large serving bowl combine the romaine lettuce , shredded swiss cheese , cashews , dried cranberries , cubed apple and cubed pear
6. toss to mix then pour dressing over salad just before serving and toss to coat
demonstrations.review:
I LOVE this recipe. I discovered it just before Christmas and made it, as written, for my coworkers. I made it again for my family at Christmas and through the winter.
I was asked to bring a salad to a fourth of July party and I used this recipe and switched out the fruits. I used white peaches, raspberries and blueberries. Another mega hit! Thank you Ivy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
limoncello martini

perfect for a warm summers night when the kids aren't home! sweet, slightly sour, a perfect martini!

1. fill a shaker with ice
2. add vodka , limoncello and simple syrup
3. shake well and strain into oversized martini glasses
4. garnish each with a lemon twist
5. simmer , stirring , over low heat until sugar is dissolved
6. chill before using
demonstrations.review: I made this over the summer and then lost the recipe. It is fantastic. I make it with my homemade limoncello and then add the lemon zest that I froze after making the liqueur. Bellissima!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
make ahead mashed potato casserole

time saver casserole and the taste is excellent! originally from canadian living magazine.

1. in a large pot of boiling water , cook potatoes for 20 minutes or until tender but not mushy
2. drain and let cool slightly , peel
3. with a potato masher , mash until smooth , do not use an electric mixer , blend in cream cheese and butter until melted
4. mix in onions , sour cream , parsley , marjoram , and salt and pepper to taste
5. transfer to 8 inch baking dish , smooth top
6. sprinkle with crumbs , bake in 400 degree oven for about 20 minutes or until heated through and top is lightly golden
demonstrations.review: Made this to take to my daughter's for Christmas. It was a huge hit with everyone wanting to take some home. The only change I made was to butter the bread crumbs. Oh I forgot, my fresh parsley patch was covered with four inches of snow so I used dried.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
limoncello   lemoncella

this is a great lemony flavored vodka that is great for sipping after dinner, or anytime. i always try to keep some in the freezer.

1. wash the lemons well with a vegetable brush and hot water to remove any residue of pesticides or wax
2. pat the lemons dry
3. using a vegetable peeler , peel the lemons
4. if you do get some of the pith with the zest , carefully scrape it away with the
5. fill the jar with one bottle of the vodka and the zest
6. cover the jar and let it sit forty days at room temperature in a dark cabinet
7. combine the sugar and water in a saucepan , bring it to a boil and cook until thickened , about five minutes
8. let the syrup cool before adding it to the limoncello mixture , along with the other bottle of vodka
9. cover and return to the cupboard for another 40 days
10. strain the limoncello into bottles and discard the lemon zest
11. store them in a cupboard or the freezer
demonstrations.review: "sole in uno bicchiere" I spent nine days in Italy this summer and had a wonderful time. One of the first things I did when I got home was look for a recipe for limoncello. The first one I tried was OK. This is the "sunshine in a glass" that I enjoyed in Italy. It is worth the wait! Bravo!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
john and erin s beer butt chicken   beer can

this was our first attempt at beer butt chicken and it was awesome! you can change the flavor a bit by changing the beer you use.

1. mix dry ingredients together and rub chicken inside and out
2. open can of beer , pour half into a spray bottle and add orange juice , olive oil and vinegar to spray bottle
3. insert the can into the cavity of the chicken
4. with the chicken resting on the can , cook for about 2 hours over medium-hot grill with grill cover on spray chicken with the basting spray while cooking
5. when done , carefully lift the chicken off the grill and remove the can-- be careful , liquid is hot !
demonstrations.review: This was my first ever "beer butt chicken" and it was wonderful. I used a special tripod that had a "plate" on the bottom for vegetables so I put some baby redskins and chopped onions on it. I cooked the whole thing over inderect heat for two hours and it was about 15 minutes too long for the chicken and 45 minutes to long for the veggies. But the flavor was to die for. I also think you can halve the amounts in the spray bottle. I had LOTS left over.

target.recipe_text:
creamy chilled grape salad

this may easily be doubled to serve crowd, make certain to wash the grapes well with cold water then dry thoroughly using paper towels ---  i recommend using my recipe#300387 --- this is very good!

1. in a large bowl , beat the cream cheese , sour cream and vanilla until smooth and well blended
2. add in white sugar starting with 3 tablespoons and adding in more to taste
3. add grapes and toss to coat
4. transfer to a serving bowl
5. cover and refrigerate until serving
6. sprinkle with brown sugar and pecans just before serving
target.review: I took this salad to a potluck and it was gobbled up and the recipe was asked for.  I tell them to look it up and Food.com!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best banana bread

you'll never need another banana bread recipe ever again!

1. remove odd pots and pans from oven
2. preheat oven to 350 / 180
3. cream together butter and sugar
4. add eggs and crushed bananas
5. combine well
6. sift together flour , soda and salt
7. add to creamed mixture
8. add vanilla
9. mix just until combined
10. do not overmix
11. pour into greased and floured loaf pan
12. bake at 350 / 180 for 55 minutes
13. keeps well , refrigerated
demonstrations.review: In one word, "Yum". I added a 1/8  cup of oats and the same amount of rolled oats. I also used whole wheat flour.  It had a moisture and texture that was perfect.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sesame ginger beef and asparagus stir fry

delicious and quick to prepare. i serve this with steamed jasmine rice for a nice after-work dinner. adapted from bon appetit

1. combine beef and cornstarch in a large bowl
2. using your hands , rub to coat well
3. heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in a large skillet over high heat
4. working in batches , add beef in a single layer and cook , undisturbed , until meat begins to blacken on the bottom , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
5. turn over and cook until second side browns , about 1 minute
6. transfer beef to a large plate
7. heat remaining 2 tablespoons peanut oil and 1 tsp sesame oil in same skillet over medium-high heat
8. add asparagus , green onions and ginger
9. saute until vegetables are tinged brown and crisp-tender , about 2 minutes
10. add broth , fish sauce and sugar
11. bring to a boil
12. return beef to skillet and cook until sauce is slightly thickened , about 1 minute
13. transfer to a platter and serve
demonstrations.review:
This is quick, nutritious and yummy!
I too used white onions only because I was out of green.  But it was still wonderful.  I used brown rice because out of the white rice again. I like this!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate walnut strudel

a very special strudel filled with creamy chocolate and crunchy walnuts, served warm from the oven with a dusting of sweet powdered sugar. sound yummy? it is, and oh so easy to make! a classic from pepperidge farm.

1. thaw sheet of puffed pastry for 30 minutes at room temperature
2. preheat oven to 375f
3. in a small bowl , combine egg and water
4. in a large bowl , microwave the chocolate , milk , and butter on high for 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes , stirring occasionally , until chocolate is melted
5. unfold the pastry sheet on a lightly floured surface
6. roll into a 16" by 12" rectangle
7. spread chocolate mixture evenly on puffed pastry to within 1 1 / 2 inch of edges and sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the chocolate
8. beginning with short end , roll up jelly-roll style
9. place seam side down on an ungreased baking sheet
10. tuck ends under to seal and brush with egg mixture
11. bake for 35 minutes or until golden
12. cool 30 minutes on baking sheet on wire rack
13. sprinkle with powdered sugar
14. slice and serve warm
demonstrations.review: This is such an easy yet  showy and delicious treat! Made it with unsweetened chocolate because it was what we had, added our sweetener to it and some homemade whipped topping, and my husband and I enjoyed the treat as our Christmas finale this year,

demonstrations.recipe_text:
heart smart oatmeal date chocolate cookies

from health, january 2008.  i made these with dried figs (soaked thoroughly in water) in place of the dates.  very chewy and delicious cookies and plenty sweet.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat
3. remove from heat and add brown sugar
4. stir until smooth
5. in a medium bowl , combine all-purpose flour , whole-wheat flour , baking soda , oats , and salt
6. combine the butter mixture with the dry ingredients , and add egg , vanilla , and chopped dates
7. fold in bittersweet chocolate
8. mix well and spoon mixture by tablespoon-fulls out onto lightly greased baking sheets
9. bake for 12 minutes , until tops are dry to the touch
demonstrations.review: This is a delicious cookie recipe even if you don't have the whole wheat flour. I thought I had the WW on hand, but was able to use the all purpose for both flour portions instead.  I am sure that the nutrition changed because of that.  I also used a mixed dried fruit in place of the figs.  The batter seems dry, and does not stick together very well, but the cookies turned out fine.  They are very flavorful, and I appreciate the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best ever peanut butter fudge

peanut butter lovers, this is perfect for you. very rich flavor. can't stop eating.....

1. grease 9x13 cake pan
2. mix sugar , evaporated milk , and butter in pan
3. stir constantly over medium heat
4. bring to a full boil and stir for 4 more minutes , or until a candy thermometer reads between 234 and 240 degrees f , or until a small amount of syrup dropped into cold water forms a soft ball that flattens when removed from the water and placed on a flat surface
5. remove from stove and stir in peanut butter , vanilla , and marshmallow cream
6. spread evenly into pan and chill in fridge until firm
7. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This is yummy but take a word from the wise make sure you cook at least as long if not longer as the recipe suggests, it is gritty with sugar if not. I also had a challenge with the marshmallow, where it seemed like it would seem to stir in completely.  I think this is more a personal experience, and maybe next time it will go better.  Anyway, my family ate the whole tray over Christmas.

target.recipe_text:
creamy grape salad

absolutely fabulous!!  i first tasted this wonderful dish at a potluck dinner after our homecoming service at church.  i was fortunate to find the person who had brought this salad.  i never knew grapes could be so delicious with cream cheese!  i hope you enjoy it as much as our family does.

1. remove any stems from grapes and wash
2. set aside
3. in a medium size bowl , mix cream cheese , sour cream , sugar and vanilla
4. fold in grapes and pour into a large serving dish
5. spread mixture evenly in serving dish
6. mix brown sugar with cinnamon and pecans
7. sprinkle over top of grape mixture
8. place in refrigerator to chill
9. serve and enjoy !
