demonstrations.review: Amazing! I sauteed my onions with some garlic before adding to the broth, reduced the salt to a dash, added 2 1/2 c. chopped ham, and used 1/4 c. potato flakes to thicken just a little more. Perfect for a cold, snowy day.

target.recipe_text:
gluten free french bread

this french bread is amazing!! it tastes so similar to the wheat containing french bread. plus it freezes wonderfully!!! it's crusty on the outside, and soft and tender within. it is fabulous alone, or made as little brushetta', using 'joanne's creamy brushetta' recipe(#108383).you can make it from start to finish in about one hour!!

1. in the bowl of a heavy-duty mixer , place flours , xanthan gum , salt , and egg replacer
2. blend with mixer on low
3. in a small bowl dissolve the sugar in the water , and add yeast
4. wait until the mixture foams slightly , then blend into the dry ingredients
5. add the butter , egg whites , and vinegar
6. beat on high for 3 minutes
7. to form loaves , spoon dough onto greased and cornmeal-dusted cookie sheets in two long french-loaf shapes or spoon into special french-bread pans
8. slash diagonally every few inches
9. if desired , brush with melted butter
10. cover the dough and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk , 20 to 25 minutes
11. preheat oven to 400 degrees
12. bake for 40 to 45 minutes
13. remove from pan to cool
target.review:
Taste wise, this is the most incredibly wonderful bread for GF.  The chef is correct in saying it tastes much like the real thing.
  I made the mistake of not noting that most people needed extra flour when I printed the recipe out.  I am an experienced bread maker but not an experienced GF bread maker.  The few things that I have made had a different texture and density even raw so didn't think to add more flour.
  The result was a flat bread instead of a loaf.  I was a bit bummed when I saw that but after tasting it, was feeling better about the time, effort and product that I had used not being wasted.
I will try it again and add more flour to get it more like a loaf but did want to say that the mistake was well worth it as I can see how that would be an excellent pizza crust (bake first then top and stick under broiler to melt the cheese) and means of making Crazy Bread......... which in case you don't know is pizza dough brushed with lots of melted butter and garlic and salt.  Baked till crispy and you will think you died and went to heaven. :-)
Oh Yes, I made it with the Tom Sawyer GF flour and that saves having to buy and measure different items.  That flour has it all in it.  I just measured out the total of what the first 3 items were.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I wish I could give this 10 stars.  It is incredible and incredibly easy.  I served it to company twice and all wanted the recipe.   I have already shared it with 8 other people who have also been passing it on.  My boss said her husband almost drowned himself in it as he loved it so much.  Thanks big time for a real winner.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
eggs in bed

in their own bed, not in yours, although you can eat them in your bed, whatever floats your boat. super easy, you don't even have to pre-heat the oven.

1. use 9 x 12-inch cooking dish
2. spray the dish with cooking spray
3. line bottom of pan with the bread
4. butter the bread , then salt and pepper it
5. sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese on top
6. in a bowl , beat eggs then add an equal amount of milk
7. pour over bread
8. cover with tin foil and refrigerate overnight
9. in the morning , put in cold oven , then turn oven on to 400 degrees
10. bake for an hour
demonstrations.review: This was good but for dinner I felt it needed a little spark so I added 1 Tbl. mustard and 1 tsp. Worcestershire sauce.  That seemed to give it that little extra umph for dinner. It was an easy recipe and I thank you for it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mendenhall sourdough gingerbread

last summer i enjoyed an alaskan cruise, and we had a fabulous time at the mendenhall glacier. :) alaska is also well-known for its sourdough... and brought together here is a delicious combination of sourdough and gingerbread. enjoy!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. cream together the brown sugar and shortening
3. then add molasses and egg , beating continuously
4. set aside
5. in a separate bowl , sift dry ingredients together and blend into hot water
6. then beat this mixture into creamed mixture
7. as the last step , add the sourdough starter slowly , mixing carefully to maintain a bubbly batter
8. pour into lightly buttered and floured 8"x8" baking pan and bake at 375 degrees f for about 30 minutes or until done
9. best served with ice cream or whipped cream while still hot
demonstrations.review: I too doubled the spices but this is an awesome dessert.  It is very rich and moist but with that nice little zip that sourdough gives.  My husband enjoyed it with the whipped cream topping but that was a little much for me.  I think I will just dust my next piece with a little 10X sugar.  I believe that would make the gingerbread the star.  Thanks for a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best ever chocolate chip cookies

these are our favorite. i usually make 1/2 and freeze the rest for later in the week when we run out.

1. mix flour , soda and salt in a bowl
2. set aside
3. cream together margarine and sugars
4. beat eggs into sugar mixture
5. add vanilla
6. beat until fluffy
7. add the dry ingredients
8. add chocolate chips
9. drop onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes
10. cookies should be brown around the edges and will finish cooking on the sheet when removed from the oven
demonstrations.review:
Chocolate Chip cookies were not my most favorite cookie but the family loves them so decided to try this recipe when my grandkids were coming. Of course I made a ton of them since I didn't know who fast they would be attacked.
I don't know what the texture is with margarine or the crisco/ margarine blend but I made them with all butter.  They came out thin and crispy.  I also used the 60% chocolate chips.
Well, I want to tell you..... I have become a chocolate chip cookie lover with this recipe.  I like the thin and crispy, yet tender consistency and they make killer ice cream sandwiches as well.
Also, if you do manage to keep them around, they stay nice for a really long time.  I kept them in a tin and my husband and I just finished off the last one from 6 weeks ago and it was as wonderful as the first ones.
Thanks so much for such a great recipe.
From the Chocolate Chip Cookie Convert!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stir fry shrimp

a wonderful recipe for shrimp stir fry, i have made this many times --- chop veggies in advance to save time, once your veggies are chopped this stir fry takes little time to make ---i have made this without the snow peas it is still good but better with them added, white wine only for this

1. heat the sesame oil in a wok or a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. saute the garlic and ginger for about half minutes
3. add in the shrimp and cook for 30 seconds
4. add in veggies and stir fry for about 2-3 minutes ,
5. stir in oyster sauce , soy sauce , honey and wine
6. toss and cook for about 2 minutes
7. delicious !
demonstrations.review: What a yummy sauce!  The nice thing about this recipe is that you can use what veggies you have available and it is still excellent.  I used garlic, sweet onion, red bell pepper, broccoli florets, diagonally sliced the tender stalk, and celery.  It was a real winner.  I did serve it over rice so we got every drop of that heavenly sauce.  Thanks for the recipe

target.recipe_text:
world s best cookies aka that 70s elusive cornflake cookies

this wonderful recipe was in circulation when i was a kid in the 70s. years later, a woman brought a tray of these to the office, which i instantly recognized as those cookies from my childhood, and she refused to give me the recipe (said it was her babysitter's secret recipe)! i searched online (tried several recipes) and asked my friends and family off and on if they'd heard of it, for 10 years. i finally just found this online! they are so good! bake them for your friends and family and share the recipe with the world! note, the number of cookies you get will vary - depending on how big you roll the balls.

1. preheat oven to 325
2. cream butter , sugars , vanilla and egg
3. add oil
4. mix in dry ingredients
5. form dough into walnut sized balls
6. place on cookie sheet and flatten with a fork dipped in water
7. bake for 10- 12 minutes
8. cool on pan for a minute or two , then transfer to a rack to cook
target.review: OK -- how'd I miss these in the 70s!  Really very good cookies. The only thing I did different was leave out the nuts. Hubby and kids just loved them.  I know I got way more than 4 doz. out of them, but not sure how much more as I kept eating them as soon as they were out of the oven.  Mine also didn't flatten out (I did press down with a fork), but stayed thick -- very good that way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked texas jalapeo peppers

another recipe submitted by a co-worker for our chili cook-off at work. these were gone in nothing flat!

1. cut jalapeo peppers in half lengthwise
2. remove seeds
3. place peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes
4. drain well
5. combine cream cheese , cheddar cheese and worcestershire sauce
6. stir well
7. place one heaping teaspoon cheese mixture on each pepper half
8. sprinkle with bacon
9. place on a baking sheet
10. bake at 400f for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted
demonstrations.review: Another 5 stars.  Made these for our Halloween Party last night and they were among the first to go. I was able to make them up well in advance.  I did the boiling the night before and in the morning mixed up the filling and stuffed the peppers.  I held them in the fridge for close to 6 hours and then baked with no problem.  I did mix the bacon in with the cheese mixture.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fruity  fluffy pistachio salad   dessert

i found this on another website.  so fluffy and yummy.  one of my favorite desserts.

1. beat together pudding , cool whip , and milk until well mixed
2. fold in remaining ingredients
3. place in refrigerator for at least 1 hour prior to serving
demonstrations.review: Awesome dish!  Mixed this up to go with dinner yesterday and had a really hard time staying out of it until then!  We didn't eat this as a dessert, but rather used as a fruit salad and had with our dinner.  I followed the recipe exactly and can't think of a thing I'd change.  Thanks for posting.  We'll be having this again and again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy skillet cheese topped chili macaroni

this is a quick and easy recipe for a weeknight meal. its very tasty and very filling. dh loves it when i make this and always takes leftovers to work!

1. in a large skillet , brown onion and garlic with ground beef
2. drain and return to pan
3. add kidney beans , tomato sauce , water , chili powder , and salt
4. cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes
5. add cooked macaroni and stir
6. add grated cheddar to top , cover and simmer just until cheese melts
demonstrations.review:
I made this for dinner last night.  The kids couldn't get enough.  Instead of tomato sauce, I did use canned tomatoes and a combo of colby jack, cheddar and mozzarella, just because I had little bits left in each bag to use.
I served each topped with a scoop of sour cream.  Definitely a keeper, thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best darn sugar cookies ever

i don't care for sugar cookies at all and i thought these really were the best darn sugar cookies ever! these cookies are so light and have a fabulous texture. everyone is sure to love them.

1. cream sugar , butter , powdered sugar , and oil
2. then cream in eggs and vanilla
3. in a separate bowl mix baking soda , cream of tartar , and flour
4. start adding dry ingredients to creamed ingredients less than 1 cup at a time
5. chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours
6. drop 1-2" balls on the cookie sheet
7. if you would like , you can flatten the balls with the bottom of a drinking glass that has been dipped in sugar
8. bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are browned
9. you can also sprinkle on cinnamon and sugar , colored sugar sprinkles , etc
demonstrations.review: These were very good.  I didn't read the recipe all the way through and didn't have time to chill the dough for more then 20 minutes but it didn't affect them at all.  Definitely a keeper, thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rye party puffs

perfect bites for super bowl sunday and st. patrick's day parties! i came up with this recipe years ago, and it won in taste of home magazine and better homes and gardens magazine. it makes a lot, but they disappear fast! enjoy!

1. in a saucepan over medium heat , bring water and butter to a boil
2. add flours , parsley , garlic powder and salt all at once
3. stir until a smooth ball forms
4. remove from the heat
5. let stand for 5 minutes
6. beat in eggs one at a time until smooth
7. drop the batter by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheets
8. sprinkle with caraway seeds
9. bake at 400 for 18-20 minutes or until golden
10. remove to wire racks
11. immediately cut a slit in each puff crossways through center , but not all the way through , to allow steam to escape
12. let cool
13. in a mixing bowl , mix well the first 8 ingredients , then stir in olives
14. open puffs , stuff with filling , lightly close tops of puffs over filling
15. cover , chill til serving
16. makes 4 1 / 2 dozen
demonstrations.review: These are excellent!  I first made them when the came out in the TOH mag and have made them MANY times since.  Great recipe Kelly!

target.recipe_text:
toasted ravioli

these italian appetizers are crunchy and delicious dipped in a warm marinara sauce. they are very addictive! make a bunch, you'll need to have a lot!

1. cook ravioli in boiling salted water until they float to the top
2. remove from water and drain
3. set aside to cool
4. heat vegetable oil in fryer at least 2" deep to a temperature of 375 degrees
5. dip ravioli in beaten egg , then cover in breadcrumbs
6. fry in batches in hot oil until golden brown , about 5 minutes
7. drain
8. sprinkle hot ravioli with parmesan cheese
9. heat marinara sauce and set aside in serving bowl
10. serve ravioli with dipping sauce
target.review: Tasted good- used panko bread crumbs instead. I cooked the ravioli first. The only thing they were kind of gooey, but still delish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
montreal steak seasoned roasted baby potatoes

a simple little nothing recipe, that results in big flavor.  i use white onion with red potatoes, or red onion with white potatoes.

1. wash and slice baby potatoes into 1 inch thick slices
2. put in roasting pan along with thinly sliced onion
3. sprinkle with the montreal steak seasoning
4. pour oil over top , toss to coat well
5. bake in 400f oven for approximately 30 minutes , turning once
6. potatoes are done when they are golden brown , with soft centres
demonstrations.review: This was really good. Used baby yukon golds -cut in half and microwave for 10 min to get them soft then finished off in the oven since i was short on time. Still yummy! Left out the onions (DH does not like) Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexicali round steak

i made this tonight with great reviews. the recipe game from fix and forget it lightly. thanks marcia s. myer for a tasty meal that doesn't require much work.

1. cut beef into 6 pieces
2. place in slow cooker
3. combine remaining ingredients , except cheese , and pour over beef
4. cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours
5. sprinkle with cheese before serving
6. serve vegetables over cooked white rice
demonstrations.review: Made this yesterday- thought it was just ok. Not sure what was missing- the beef was really tender.Probably will not make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled tequila lime chicken

marinates overnight.

1. in a marinating container add and mix well the first 8 ingredients
2. add chicken
3. turn to coat
4. cover container or seal container and refrigerate overnight
5. drain chicken from marinade and discard marinade
6. grill chicken over medium heat until cooked through , turning occasionally--usually 16-18 minutes
demonstrations.review: Grilled this tonight- DH liked this- I may have used to much jalapeno - had the taste, not the heat. Marinated over 24 hours. Good recipe- served with the Recipe #154918 El Torito Sweet Corn Cake.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chip cheesecake dip

this is an amazingly easy recipe to prepare and it's a hit at parties and gatherings.  my mom has made it for a few years, and it's always the first to go... enjoy!

1. beat cream cheese and butter until smooth
2. mix in sugars and vanilla
3. stir in chocolate
4. cover and chill 2 hours
5. shape into a ball
6. wrap with saran wrap and chill at least 2 hours
7. roll in chopped nuts if desired
8. serve with graham cracker stix
demonstrations.review: Taste like choc chip cheesecake. I used the graham cracker sticks to dip with. Fantastic

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easier than making tacos taco salad

i've always loved tacos but i think the assembling part can be a pain, especially if i'm making mine and the kids' because they were too small to make their own. once i had taco salad this way, i never made tacos again! (salsa pictured in my photo is recipe #97428)

i have found that squeezing some lime juice over the prepared salad makes it even better! yum!!

1. brown hamburger and drain
2. add taco mix and water , mix
3. heat thoroughly , about 2 minutes in the microwave , stirring once
4. layer ingredients on each plate
5. i use the following order: chips , meat , cheese , lettuce , tomato , onion , black olives , taco sauce and sour cream
6. use whatever taco toppings you enjoy
7. mix and eat
demonstrations.review: great salad- used ground turkey instead of beef

target.recipe_text:
lo mein like evergreen

my fave chinese restaurant has the best lo mein i ever put across my lips.  it's simple, cheap, and very filling if you need that kinda dish.  this can be made for literally pennies and everyone will appreciate this because it can be dressed up or dressed down.  cook and prep times approximate.

1. break noodles and boil in water for three minutes
2. do not add seasoning packet
3. drain when done and set aside in serving bowl
4. immediately return pot to stove over med
5. heat
6. add oils , soy sauce , carrots , garlic , onion , and peanut butter
7. stir well and let cook for just a few seconds with a fork
8. toss noodles back in and stir to coat
9. make sure noodles are well-coated and blended well with the garlic and veggies
10. return to serving bowl and enjoy !
target.review: Excellent even though I didn't have sesame oil. Next time I will add it. It has just a hint of peaunut butter and lots of garlic. I loved the crunchy carrots. Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey glazed  dump  chicken

this is from another website. i'm posting this to try later. let me know how it is if you try it before i do.

1. place all ingredients in a 1-gallon freezer bag
2. to thaw & cook:
3. take the bag out of the freezer the night before , thaw in refrigerator over night
4. preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. empty chicken and marinade into baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray
6. bake for 20-30 minutes or until juices run clear
demonstrations.review: This is very good. I ended up being a little short of soya sauce but it was still delicious. I did add a little garlic and would do so again. I cooked it in the slow cooker, 1 hour on high and 3 hours on low. It is a sweet sauce and that made my husband very happy. I am mixing up some more sauce and chicken and putting it in the freezer to have ready for another day. Thanks for sharing your recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s vegetable bake

this is my favorite thing to eat at thanksgiving, but it is good any time! usually the first thing to disappear at our house.

1. cook vegetables according to package directions and drain
2. place cooked vegetables in ungreased 9x13" pan
3. mix cheese , mayonnaise and onions together and pour on top of vegetables
4. top with crushed crackers and then melted butter
5. bake uncovered 35 minutes at 350
demonstrations.review: Even though I screwed up my quantities a bit it ended up delicious. I made a half recipe but put in the full amount of cheese (how could that be bad!). I used Tex-Mex cheese and it worked out fine. The crackers on top were crunchy which was a nice contrast in texture to the veggies. It was a real hit here and will be made again. Thank for sharing your recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked farmer sausage  potatoes  and carrots with gravy

this used to be the traditional mennonite sunday lunch at our house -- it has since become more likely at supper, but it's just as traditional and just as delicious!  i'm not sure where farmer sausage is all available or whether it's one of those local specialties just available in manitoba, so i've posted a recipe for that as well for those of you who make your own sausages. (#184513)  if you can't buy it nearby or make it yourself, i'm terribly sorry -- you're definitely missing out!  this recipe is for those of you who can.

1. if desired , peel frozen farmer sausage
2. break sausage into 4-6 chunks
3. place potatoes and carrots into a roaster or large casserole dish
4. add water to cover the bottom of the dish
5. place frozen sausage chunks over top , cover , and bake at 375f for 1-1 / 2 hours
6. remove from oven and drain juices from casserole dish into a saucepan
7. for gravy: mix flour and milk together , adding milk gradually so a paste forms and slowly gets thicker -- you don't want lumps !
8. add milk mixture to drippings and bring to a boil , stirring constantly , until gravy is thickened
9. add salt and pepper to taste and serve
demonstrations.review: This is a very tasty meal. The prep time is generous as I think I had it in the oven within 10 minutes. I didn't use frozen sausage so it cooked a little faster. The cream gravy is nice. It reminded me of the cream gravy they used to serve with perogies at a Mennonite restaurant in our little Saskatchewan town. Thanks so much for sharing your recipe. It will find it's way to our table again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
denver omelet sandwich

i make these when i have extra time, pop them in the freezer and the kids have something to grab, pop in the microwave and out to the bus on those hectic mornings!

1. combine eggs , meat , onion , peppers , mushrooms and salt and pepper in a bowl , mix well
2. spread butter on one side of each slice of bread
3. place 6 slices butter side down on a baking sheet
4. layer with egg mixture
5. top with slice of cheese
6. top with remaining bread butter side up
7. brown bread on both sides under broiler
8. serve immediately or freeze for later
demonstrations.review: I cooked it more like a regular omelet and then transferred it to the broiler with the buttered bread and cheese. It tasted very good, the veggies were great. It is quite greasy just as a grilled cheese but good just the same. I can't see myself scrambling the eggs and having the veggies seperate. I thought I would but then it seemed easier and less messy to go the other route when I already had the frying pan out. Thanks for sharing your recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super corn salad

a great 'make ahead' salad to have on hand when expecting family and friends for the weekend. this is one of our favorites and most salad lovers request the recipe. be sure to refrigerate preferably in a covered jar which i find keeps it crisp and fresh. only the salad itself goes into the serving bowl - the marinade remains in the jar. using one of your special glass bowls adds to the presentation.

1. in mixing bowl add: 2 cans of drained kernel corn
2. add the prepared vegetables
3. in a small bowl combine the marinade ingredients
4. combine and toss , cover and allow to marinate for at least 4 hours
5. store in fridge
demonstrations.review: Absolutely yummy! This got a thumbs way up from everyone at the table. I thought I had tarragon in the cupboard but didn't so had to do without but it was still worth at least 5 stars. I will be making this again and again. Thanks so much for sharing your recipe. This was made for ZWT4.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy no fail make anytime turkey gravy

i have been using this recipe for many years, my family loves this gravy and i have served it to dinner guests over the holidays and always receive rave reviews! --- you don't need to make this gravy using all pan drippings, if you do not have 4 cups of drippings you may mix with chicken broth to make the 4 cups, or it may be made with only chicken broth, please see note on the bottom of the recipe--- this may be made slightly ahead and kept uncovered on top of the stove until ready to serve, just whisk before using if you have any left over this gravy freezes very well or you may reduce all ingredients down to half and for a thinner gravy reduce flour by 1 tablespoon  --- also see my recipe#314890
for more of my recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. drain the pan drippings for the roasted turkey through a fine strainer
2. let sit and then remove any fat from the top of the drippings
3. add in chicken broth or water to make 4 cups if necessary
4. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine or butter
5. add in lots of black pepper
6. add in 1 / 2 cup flour plus 3 tablespoons
7. constantly whisk for about 3 minutes over low heat
8. slowly add in the 4 cups turkey broth / drippings
9. whisk constantly over medium-low heat until bubbly and thickened
10. use right away or keep warm over lowest heat setting , whisk again before serving
11. options to make this gravy using all chicken broth prepare as directed using 4 cups low sodium chicken broth and 1 tablespoon chicken boullion powder ---- or you may add in low sodium chicken broth omitting bouillon powder to pan drippings to make up 4 cups
target.review: I always make thanksgiving dinner for family and friends.  I am a very good cook, but when it came time for me to make the gravy, I just couldn't get it right until this year!! The gravy was perfect.  I added kitchen bouquet for color. Thanks for a great recipe Kittencal!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easiest chicken marsala  make the night before

used for our gourmet club. so, easy and delicious i kept thinking am i forgetting to do something. may seem like a lot of wine, but alot gets absorbed overnight by the chicken. raves from the club.

this is a 5 star recipe for flavor & appearance however baking it in the dish that you have marinated it in does not allow the bottom of the breast to crisp and it remains very soft. next time i would place it on a shallow rack in the oven or pan fry in a non stick pan so both sides get that lovely golden texture.

1. scramble egg in small bowl
2. dip chicken breasts into egg and dredge into bread crumbs on both sides
3. saute breasts in a small amount of olive oil in a frying pan
4. set aside
5. saute mushrooms and garlic in a small amount of olive oil
6. add broth and wine and bring to a boil
7. lay chicken breasts side by side in baking dish
8. pour mushrooms and wine sauce over chicken
9. marinate overnight in fridge
10. bake chicken at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes uncovered until hot
11. serve with rice or noodles
12. the sauce absorbs into the chicken so you want alot of sauce to begin with
13. also realize the alcohol burns off during the cooking
14. if you choose to have less sauce , broth and wine should be of equal proportions
demonstrations.review: this was a really good and easy dish.  I really liked it w/angel hair pasta.  The best part is that you make it the day before.  I'll defintely make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simply corn

it's fresh corn season and this is the best way to enjoy its perfect sweetness.  easy and quick too.

1. remove husks and silks from corn
2. place a dish towel over cutting board
3. stand corn up on end and using sharp knife slide down cob cutting off all the kernels
4. go all the way around
5. pick up towel and then pour kernels into medium sauce pan
6. using dull side of knife , scrape any "milk" from the cob into pan
7. repeat with remaining corn
8. pour in water
9. place lid on pan
10. heat to boil and cook 3 minutes
11. turn off heat
12. let pan set one minute
13. using lid as strainer pour off all water
14. stir in butter until melted
15. salt to taste
demonstrations.review: We tried this corn tonight, and it was delicious!!!  What a great way to make fresh corn when you're tired of coc.  I served with Mediterranean Chicken and boiled potatoes.  I'm definitely going to make this again this summer.  Thanks for a great recipe!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the deen brothers  bbq chicken

you can bake this barbecued chicken in the oven or on your outdoor grill.  either way, it should be covered while cooking.

1. preheat oven to 375 or prepare a grill
2. in a large bowl , stir together all ingredients except the chicken
3. reserve 1 / 3 cup of the barbecue sauce and set aside
4. add the chicken to the remaining sauce in the bowl , turning to coat
5. arrange the coated chicken in a roasting pan or on the grill
6. cook , for 40 to 45 minutes or until cooked through , basting with the reserved 1 / 3 cup sauce after 20 minutes
7. if oven roasting , cook uncovered for the last 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a really good barbeque chicken, especially for someone like me that doesn't have a grill.  I'll definitely make it again this summer.  I did bake the chicken for almost an hour, only because I had two large thighs w/the drumstick attached and one large breast.  I'll definitely make this again this summer.  Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ham   cheese quiche

you can serve this for dinner or for breakfast. delicious.

1. beat eggs with milk , salt and pepper in bowl
2. add ham and cheese
3. pour into pie shell
4. bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
5. let stand for several minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: My first attempt @ quiche, had left over ham from Easter.   I used swiss cheese and also added canned mushrooms.  Used ff half and half.  A really good quiche.  I will definitely make it again.  Thanks for a great recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with mushrooms and mustard

this creamy dish is not only delicious but it is quite low in fat. suitable for dinner guests or a quick meal for your family. what do they say. . . "try it you'll like it."

1. pound breasts until 1 / 4" thick
2. dredge in flour mixture
3. heat oil over medium heat
4. add chicken and saute about 7 minutes , turning once
5. remove and keep warm
6. add butter to frypan and increase heat to high
7. add onion and mushrooms
8. saute about 5 minutes
9. reduce heat to low
10. add cream , parsley , mustard and lemon juice
11. bring to a boil stirring constantly
12. add juices from chicken into cream mixture
13. pour sauce over chicken and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this tonight, and it was pretty good.  I wouldn't say it was fabulous, but I always like any dish with chicken and mushrooms.  It needed some other flavor, but I'm not sure what.  Maybe garlic would have helped, but my husband doesn't like garlic.  I served it with angel hair pasta, which is my favorite.  I did add basil to the flour, which did help the flavor of the chicken.

target.recipe_text:
cha ching  carrot spice muffins

you'll think you hit the jackpot when you take a bite of these babies. happily healthy with whole wheat flour and other nutritious goodies, put your money on these muffins for breakfast or as the perfect anytime snack. recipe is from the la leache league international cookbook 

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. mix together dry ingredients- flour , soda , powder , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , ginger , allspice
3. mix together wet ingredients- honey / brown sugar , egg , buttermilk / yogurt , oil , vanilla and the carrots , raisins and nuts
4. stir the wet and dry ingredients together until just moistened
5. bake for about 15 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean
target.review: Excellent, big hit at preschool.  Big hit with me because they are so healthy AND YUMMY!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
overnight eggnog baked french toast

another do ahead, enjoy your family & guests recipe. serve this with some good bacon fried crisp or sausages. have it as part of your christmas brunch. whenever i'm sure they will enjoy it.

1. beat together eggs , eggnog , rum , sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon , salt& vanilla
2. dip both sides of each slice of bread in this mixture and place them side by side in a greased oven proof pyrex dish pour any remaining mixture over the slices
3. cover and refrigerate overnight
4. bake in 450f on bottom rack for 20-25 minutes
5. place on rack to cool slightly& dust with icing sugar
6. serve with canadian maple syrup and the melted butter
demonstrations.review: Very easy, convenient and had great flavor.  I missed the crispiness that comes with pan fried french toast.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
40 minute hamburger buns

homemade hamburger rolls with only a 10 minute rising time.  these are really good.  recipe from taste of home.

1. in a mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water
2. add oil and sugar and let stand for 5 minutes
3. add the egg , salt and enough flour to form a soft dough
4. turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. do not let rise
6. divide into 12 pieces and shape each into a ball
7. place 3" apart on greased baking sheets
8. cover and let rest for 10 minutes
9. bake at 425 for 8 to 12 minutes or until golden brown
10. remove from pans to wire rack to cool
demonstrations.review: Yummy!  My kids ate them up right away.  I used half whole wheat and half white wheat.  Turned out soft and fluffy.  Thank you.  I am going to try to use the dough for cinnamon rolls next!  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
denny s style french toast

i do not remember where i got this recipe, but my husband says it tastes just as good as what he had at denny's. i am just amazed at all of the great reviews on this recipe!! my family loves it, so i thought i would share it here and i'm so glad i did because it seems you all love it just as much!!! thanks to all of you who have tried it!

1. mix together the eggs , milk , flour , sugar , vanilla , salt& cinnamon
2. heat a large skillet , or griddle
3. when the skillet is hot , add 1 tablespoon butter
4. if the butter smokes , your pan is too hot
5. turn down the heat
6. dip each slice of bread into the batter for 30 seconds on each side
7. let some of the batter drip off , then put in skillet
8. cook each slice 1 1 / 2-2 minutes per side until each side is golden brown
9. add more butter , if necessary , to cook all of the slices
10. to serve , put on plate , dust with powdered sugar
11. serve with butter & hot syrup
demonstrations.review: Wow, all I can say is Wow!  So delicious, totally and completely company worthy!  Can't wait to try this with some homemade buttermilk bread.  I used half-n-half because that is what I had, but I think it would be even better with milk because it would soak in more.  So great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy night before french toast raphael

my family and friends just love this recipe! it's easy, delicious, and you make it the night before so there is no work in the morning. just pop it in the oven and by the time the table is set and coffee is on, it's ready! i believe this recipe came from the best of bridge cookbook. great served with fresh fruit or yogurt. can also be cooked in casserole dish on the barbeque so you don't heat up your house on a hot day!

1. put half the bread into the bottom of a greased 9 x 11 pan
2. dot cubed cheese on top
3. cover with the rest of the bread
4. combine remaining ingredients and pour over bread mixture
5. cover and refrigerate overnight
6. bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes in the morning
7. drizzle with more syrup over top when finished baking
8. serve while hot
9. another variation is to add a layer of your favourite fresh fruit
10. on top the first layer of bread cubes
demonstrations.review: Pretty amazingly good!  All my friends loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best apple pie muffins ever

i got this  recipe from a friend.  i make these often and take them to many potlucks, office parties, the cottage, picnics, children's lunch and the list goes on. recipe from the cookbook "just the best."

1. cinnamon could be added to the batter
2. topping: in a small bowl toss together sugar , flour , butter and cinnamon until crumbly
3. set aside
4. muffins: in a large bowl whisk together brown sugar , oil , egg and vanilla until smooth
5. in a separate bowl , sift together flour , soda and salt
6. stir oil mixture into flour mixture alternately with buttermilk
7. fold in apples , mixing just until combined
8. spoon into greased muffin cups filling 3 / 4 full
9. sprinkle topping over evenly
10. bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and tops spring back
demonstrations.review: Excellent!  These were huge hit with the kids at preschool, thank you!

target.recipe_text:
mango  avocado and arugula salad

warning this is hot!   enjoy!

1. combine all the ingredients for the salad dressing in a jar , close it tight and shake until the ingredients are well mixed
2. soak the onion slices in warm water with a dash of salt and 1 tbs lime juice for about 10 minutes
3. rinse and drain the onions slices
4. toss the arugula leaves with half of the vinaigrette
5. add the avocado slices , mango slices and onion slices to the arugula mix , drizzle the remaining vinaigrette on top
6. serve immediately
target.review: Great salad to accompany rich, spicy enchiladas. I served it with Crock Pot Chicken with Black Beans http://www.geniuskitchen.com/recipe/crock-pot-chicken-with-black-beans-cream-cheese-89204

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach feta and artichoke pizza

this pizza is so good! and what an added bonus to provide your body with power-foods like spinach, garlic, artichokes and tomatoes... packed with antioxidants and other excellent health benefits!

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees , if using pizza stone , preheat on bottom rack for 1 hour
2. in a bowl , mix together the spinach , artichokes , garlic , onion , olives , parmesan and salt and pepper
3. spread pizza sauce on prepared pizza dough
4. evenly place the spinach mixture on the pizza and top with the sliced tomatoes
5. sprinkle the feta and mozzarella on top
6. bake for 15-20 minutes until done
demonstrations.review: We loved this pizza - especially the artichoke hearts and feta!  This is a great, quick, veggie dinner for a week night. I use Pillsbury Whole Wheat Artisan pizza dough.   I'm sure we will make this often and try different veggies.  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta e fagioli soup with ground beef and spinach

this is a delicious hearty soup that is best if prepared a day ahead to blend the flavors, you can use fresh plum tomatoes in place of canned, make certain to blanch then peel the tomatoes firsly. use your own favorite pasta sauce for this, homemade or purchased, if you like more beans then add in more! this makes a lot of soup but you can reduce to half or freeze for another meal. it is important to simmer this soup over a low heat uncovered for a longer time so that the soup will reduce and thicken and the flavors blend together, the longer it is simmered the better it will be, this soup can also be made in a crockpot but you will need to brown the beef with veggies in a skillet firstly --- the spinach may be replaced with zucchini or use both  --- you will love this soup!

1. in a large pot cook the ground beef with onion , garlic , celery , oregano and dried chili flakes until the beef is well browned
2. drain fat , then add in 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese along will all remaining ingredients except the shell pasta , spinach and the tabasco
3. bring to a boil and simmer uncovered overlow heat for about 1-1 / 2 hours
4. add in the spinach and shell pasta about the last 15 minutes of cooking and continue to simmer over low heat until the pasta is cooked
5. season with salt and pepper and tabasco
6. ladle into bowls and top with more parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: We enjoyed this hearty soup! I used pre-cooked, frozen Italian meatballs and added some chopped red & green bell peppers, along with about 4 oz. chopped fresh spinach I had on hand.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amazing pot roast

ahh two of the secret ingredients are dark beer and cocoa chili blend by mccormick giving this a mole feel. all the ingredients meld together creating a dark rich sauce.  can't find the blend no worries just substitute a mix of cocoa powder, chili powder chipotle chili powder, paprika and a touch of brown sugar. make a large piece of pot roast for delish leftovers.

1. mix the flour , pepper and salt together , season the roast with the flour mixture
2. fry bacon till crisp in a heavy cast iron pot , remove bacon from pan and set aside
3. wipe pot from most of the fat
4. over high heat brown one side of roast
5. flip then top with onions and garlic to brown the other side
6. about 4 minutes per side
7. top with the bacon bits , cocoa chili blend , chipotle chili , raisins , peanut butter , parsley and cumin
8. add the beer and add enough water to come about half way up the roast
9. you want to braise and not boil
10. cover tightly and simmer gently over low heat on top of the range , or in a cast iron pot place in a preheated 325 degree oven , roughly 45 minutes per pound or until the beef is fork-tender
11. or place the browned roast and remaining ingredients in your crock pot on low heat for 6-8 hours
12. the cooking liquid may be thickened with broken tortillas , flour , or cornstarch or reduced for gravy or sauce as desired
13. garnish with parsley
14. served over noodles , mashed potatoes or slice for an open faced sandwich
demonstrations.review: I've made this terrific roast 3 times now, and it our favorite. Every time I see that McCormick Cocoa Chile Blend in my spice cabinet, I start thinking about this.  I leave out the chipotle chili pepper to reduce the heat, but otherwise make it just as described. We don't drink dark beer, so last time I asked for advice in the beer aisle and the guy was happy to recommend Left Hand Brewing Co. Nitro Milk Stout!  So, now I keep one of those in the pantry, too. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot hot apple cider with mango and orange

perfect for the holidays, this cider keeps warm in a crock pot for as long as you need it to. it won't let me add the description to the tea bags, but i use 4 mango tea bags, and 4 orange spice.  you could use any flavors you wish.

1. add the apple cider to a crock pot , add cinnamon sticks , tea bags and brown sugar
2. slice the oranges in slices and add to crock pot
3. turn on high until heated through , 1 hour , depending on your crock pot
4. turn to low and let people serve themselves from the crock pot
demonstrations.review: Wonderful recipe! This is the second year I have served this on Christmas Eve and my family loves it. The mango tea bags are a bit hard to find, but add a unique flavor. This cider tastes as good as ever after staying warm for 4 hours, but be sure to remove the teabags before serving.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
basil shrimp with feta and orzo

i got this recipe from cooking light.

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. spray the inside of the foil bag with cooking spray and place on a large shallow baking pan
3. cook the pasta in boiling water for 5 minutes
4. drain
5. place the pasta in a large bowl and stir in 1 teaspoon of the oil and the next 7 ingredients
6. place the orzo mixture in teh foil bag
7. combine the shrimp and basil
8. arrange shrimp mixture on the orzo
9. fold edges of bag to seal
10. bake at 450 degrees for 25 minutes
11. cut open the bag with a sharp knife and peel the foil back
12. drizzle with remaining 1 teaspoon of oil
13. serve
demonstrations.review: My clipping of this recipe torn from March 2000 Cooking Light is a favorite I pull out year after year. I make it exactly as written; my DH and mother say this is their favorite shrimp dish. I have had difficulty finding the foil oven bags lately, so I just make my own with foil. My kitchen foil is much lighter weight so I have to carefully create the "bag" on a cookie sheet and handle it gently so as not to puncture it.

target.recipe_text:
kiwi jam

goodie, goodie, yum-yum.

1. combine kiwi , pectin and pineapple juice in a large saucepan
2. bring to a boil stirring constantly
3. add sugar , stirring until disolved
4. return to a rolling boil
5. boil hard for 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. remove from heat-skim off foam
7. ladle into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
8. process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath at altitudes up to 1000 feet
target.review: I did make this jam from your recipe, and it was extremely easy and absolutely wonderful to eat.  My 3 yr old thought it was cool to eat "frog eggs" on his toasts the next morning.  If you have a picky eater, it may be a little trickier because it is very green on the toast...but tastes WONDERFUL!  Thanks for the recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crisp baked pork chops

nan

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. combine cornflake crumbs , flour , paprika , thyme , garlic powder , cumin , salt , pepper and sugar in a large resealable plastic bag
4. brush egg white over both surfaces of each chop
5. place them , 1 or 2 at a time , in bag with mix , and shake bag to thoroughly coat pork
6. bake for 15 to 18 minutes , or until the pork is cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees
demonstrations.review: This was awesome, and so easy!  When I filter what I want to cook, and there are recipes by you Dancer, I almost always pick that one because you never disappoint!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot teriyaki steak

this steak comes out very tender and i love the sauce. i serve over rice.

1. combine all ingredients and pour over steak
2. cook on low 4 to 6 hours in crock pot
3. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: This was very good, my whole family enjoyed it.  I added some white wine to the sauce over the meat for extra flavor, and thickened the leftover sauce with some cornstarch to pour over the meat, and served it over rice.  I think next time I will add some red pepper flakes to give it some zip.  Wonderful and easy recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cook down home pork chops and gravy

i don't even like pork, but was tricked into tasting this dish when i was told it was chicken. wow! the meat was sooo tender and juicy; so tender in fact, that it was literally falling apart! it was like nothing i'd ever tasted before! definitely not like my mother's hard, crusty pork chops! lol! this recipes goes hand in hand w/ some mashed potatoes. just pour the leftover gravy on the taters' and enjoy!

1. combine 1st four ingredients in a shallow dish
2. dredge chops in flour mixture and set aside
3. combine what is left of the flour mixture w / the chicken broth and pour into your crock pot
4. pour oil into a large skillet and cook the chops in hot oil until browned on both sides
5. place chops in crock pot and cook covered on high for about 2 to 5 hours or until tender
6. serve w / hot rice and / or mashed potatoes
7. ++if the gravy becomes too thick just add a little water
8. if you accidentally add too much water then add a little more flour
9. season w / salt and pepper too your taste
demonstrations.review: Wow, not only was this easy to make, it tasted FABULOUS!!  I threw this in the crockpot yesterday before heading off to our sons last 2 baseball games of the season, and came home to the house smelling awesome, and dinner ready to go!  I did 6 chops (bone in), used Old Bay Seasoning instead of salt, and chicken boullion (doubled the boullion to more closely match the condensed stock the recipe called for.  Since we love gravy, I mixed up another gravy for the top of the chops.  I'll use this again and again, thanks for posting!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
round steak in rich gravy

tender and delicious!

1. sprinkle one side of meat with half the flour
2. pound in with meat mallet
3. turn meat and pound in remaining flour
4. cut meat into 6 to 8 serving pieces
5. melt shortening in large skillet
6. brown meat in shortening over medium heat , about 15 minutes
7. sprinkle onion soup mix over meat
8. mix water and mushroom soup
9. pour over meat
10. cover tightly
11. simmer 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours or until tender
12. place meat on warm platter
13. heat remaining gravy mixture to boiling , stirring constantly
14. pour over meat
demonstrations.review: I have used this recipe several times, and simply cannot say enough about how delicious it is!  I don't care for mushrooms so I usually use cream of chicken or celery, still so wonderfully tasty!  I'm from the South, so this is most definitely "comfort food" for me, and I usually make biscuits for the gravy as well.  My entire family gobbles this up!!  Thanks for a super recipe that is so simple to prepare!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican short ribs crock pot

prep time is for browning the ribs.

1. in large skillet brown ribs
2. pour off excess fat
3. mix beef consomme
4. with dry taco mix
5. add green pepper
6. add to meat to crock pot
7. pour sauce over ribs
8. cover over and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
demonstrations.review: This recipe was too easy to taste so good!!!  I didnt have consomme, so I mixed up beef bouillon and water, and mixed in the taco seasoning.  I also didnt brown the ribs first, and they came out so tender and wonderful!!  No leftovers with this one, my family ate it up!!!  If I could give more than 5 stars I would!!

target.recipe_text:
chocolate mint candy  fudge

i love this recipe because it is so easy to make and yet it always gets 'oohs' when people see the candies and 'aahs' when they taste them!

i've gotten several z-mails asking about the candy coating. they are wafers that you melt to then dip candies into to coat them. they are usually sold in the candy section of craft or baking stores. i've seen them in the candy making section of wal-mart also. if you look at the ingredients photo on recipe #104941, you'll see a photo of them. they are a different 'stiffness' than white chocolate chips but some reviews have successfully used those when they can't find the candy coating. hope that helps!

1. in a heavy saucepan , melt chocolate chips with 1 cup milk
2. remove from the heat
3. stir in vanilla
4. spread half into a waxed paper-lined 8-in
5. square pan
6. chill for 10 minutes or until firm
7. meanwhile , in a heavy saucepan over low heat , cook and stir candy coating with remaining milk until coating is melted and mixture is smooth
8. stir in peppermint extract and food coloring
9. spread over bottom layer
10. chill for 10 minutes or until firm
11. warm remaining chocolate mixture if necessary
12. spread over mint layer
13. chill for 2 hours or until firm
14. remove from pan
15. cut into 1-in
16. squares
target.review: This candy was really good! My husband thinks these taste like giant andi's mints...he said to give this recipe 5 stars. i used white chocolate chips for the white candy coating and it worked out fine. i'll definitely make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
million dollar potatoes

southern living; family favorite

1. wash potatoes , and rub with oil
2. bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour or until done
3. cut potatoes in half lengthwise
4. carefully scoop out pulp , leaving shells intact
5. mash pulp
6. stir in butter , 1 1 / 2 cups cheddar cheese , sour cream , milk , parsley , salt , and pepper
7. stuff shells with potato mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese
8. bake potatoes at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: these were soooo good. i had tons of the potato mixture left, so we saved it and warmed it up in the oven a few days later. this is a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chip or m   m oatmeal cookies

these are really good, i like to use red and green m and m's to replace the chocolate chips and serve them as christmas cookies.

1. cream the butter and both sugars
2. add eggs and vanilla
3. mix together with flour , oatmeal , salt , baking powder , and soda
4. add chocolate chips , and nuts
5. roll into balls and place two inches apart on a cookie sheet
6. bake for 10 minutes at 375 degrees
demonstrations.review: this recipe was great! i loved the oatmeal blended in cookies...seriously one of the best oatmeal choocolate chip cookie recipe i have ever had! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
olive garden fettuccine alfredo

just like the famous restaraunt's dish.

1. in a medium saucepan , melt butter
2. when butter is melted , add cream cheese
3. when the cream cheese is softened , add heavy cream
4. season with garlic powder , salt , and pepper
5. simmer for 15-20 minutes over low heat , stirring constantly
6. remove from heat and stir in parmesan
7. serve over hot fettucine noodles
demonstrations.review: this was way good...i used a whole block of cream cheese. we used it with fettuccine, and we also dipped bread sticks in it...like you can do at olive garden. the only thing i didn't like is how fattening this is, but most good things in life are very fattening!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
granny s apple cake

this was one of my favorite recipes that my grandmother made. she always seemed to have the ingredients on hand and would whip one up in no time!

1. cream eggs , oil and sugar together and then add flour and mix well
2. add apples and nuts and mix well
3. bake in a greased and floured 9x13 pan in 275 degree oven for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: this apple cake was okay...i didn\'t think it was sweet enough, and it needs something (maybe some frosting or glaze). also, my husband didn\'t like the apples with the peels still on them, but that is just his personal preference....overall, it is an easy cake and not too bad, but i probably won\'t make it again

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mac s meatloaf

this was given to me by a friend 25 years ago.

1. mix all ingredients well
2. place in sprayed loaf pan
3. bake at 350 for 1-1 / 2 hours , or until done
4. tent with foil if necessary to prevent overbrowning
demonstrations.review: i have made this recipe several times and it always turns out great. i do add one more egg, garlic, and a little red pepper if i have it. great meatloaf recipe...thanks mizznezz! i'm a big fan of your recipes :)

target.recipe_text:
italian gazpacho

from the balsamic vinegar cookbook. an italian version of the traditional spanish dish. this is wonderful with fresh from the garden vegetables.

1. in a food processor , combine the tomatoes , cucmber , bell pepper , onion , and garlic
2. pulse a time or two , or until the vegetables are coarsely chopped
3. add in the tomato juice , vinegar , salt , and red pepper flakes
4. process until the vegetables are finely chopped
5. be careful not to over process
6. the gazpacho should not be smooth
7. may need to process the gazpacho in batches
8. transfer mixture to a large bowl and cover tightly
9. place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight is better
10. add more seasoning , if needed , right before serving
11. ladle cold soup into chilled individual bowls
12. sprinkle with chopped fresh basil
13. it is recommended to serve with a cruet of extra virgin olive oil so you can drizzle your soup with oil , to taste
target.review: Gosh, I really wanted to love this, but the balsamic vinegar gave the gazpacho a sweetish, heavy taste that was unhappy. It could be the dose of vinegar that was the problem -- 1/3 of a cup is alot. Maybe a tablespoon of balsamic vinegar for flavor plus a tablespoon of regular red wine vinegar for piquancy?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
top of the stove ziti

a stovetop meal that is easy to make and quick to get on the table.  i love that it uses broccoli too!  the kids really enjoyed it in our house! time includes bringing water to a boil.  found in a woman's day magazine march 08 (funny as i got the magazine in february!)

1. cook pasta in a large pot of water as package directs
2. adding broccoli 4 minutes before pasta is done
3. mix pasta sauce and the ricotta in a large saucepan
4. cooking over medium-low heat until hot
5. drain pasta and broccoli
6. return to pot
7. add sauce mixture
8. toss to mix and coat
9. immediately add mozzarella and about half the parsley and parmesan
10. stir until mozzarella melts
11. transfer to a large serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining parsley and parmesan
demonstrations.review: 500 stars. We use our own sauce which has a squirt of Tabasco.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hoisin shrimp   broccoli

mary kisinger of calgary, ab submitted this tasty recipe to taste of home's healthy cooking.  from the magazin -- "this healthy, dish looks great and is easy to prepare.  you'll love it."

1. in a small bowl , combine cornstarch and broth until smooth
2. stir in the soy suace , hoisin sauce , and seasame oil
3. set aside
4. in a large nonstick skillet or wok , stir fry broccoli in canola oil until crisp-tender
5. add the onions , garlic , and gigner
6. stirfry for 3-4 minutes or until vegetables are tender
7. add shrimp
8. stir fry for 4-5 minutes longer or until shrimp turn pink
9. stir in corstartch mixture and add to the pan
10. bring to a boil
11. cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. serve with rice
demonstrations.review: We've been using this wonderful recipe for years -- it's one of my favorites. I do make some adjustments, though: I double the quantities of the broth and hoisin, and I add some water when cooking the broccoli. It's also great with chicken, and sometimes I add tofu if I want to stretch it. A pinch of red pepper flakes is also a nice touch.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chana and aloo  chickpea and potato curry

this is a west indie dish, that will please any curry lover.  friends are always asking me for this recipe, so i will post it up here for all to enjoy!  you can take this recipe and use it as a base adding in other veggies, tofu or meats.  enjoy!

1. heat a medium sized pot on medium high with some oil
2. when oil is hot add in onion , bay leaf , chili , cumin & mustard seeds
3. saut until the onion starts to go translucent add in garlic
4. saut until mixture starts to brown add in sugar and curry powder
5. add in more oil as needed
6. fry until mixture becomes dark brown not burnt it doesn't take to long and add in coconut milk , stir well
7. add in your potatoes and chickpeas , at this point you may need to add in some water , you want the liquid to be about one inch below the vegetable level
8. stir well
9. bring mixture to a boil , stir and turn heat down to medium low , cover and cook , stirring the curry every few minutes , until potatoes are done
10. it is ok if the potatoes fall apart in fact it is yummier that way
11. takes 15-20 minutes
12. add salt to taste
13. great on it's own , with some naan bread or on some rice
demonstrations.review: Good. A tablespoon or two of lemon juice at the end of the cooking time brightened the flavors. And I served it over steamed broccoli flowerets, which was nice.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven fried chicken chimichangas

a fast and healthier way to serve chimichangas than the traditional deep fried. these are very good, and you may dress them up to you own preference. i like to serve with green chile sauce sometimes instead of the picante sauce.

1. mix chicken , picante sauce or salsa , cumin , oregano , cheese and onions
2. place about 1 / 4 cup of the chicken mixture in the center of each tortilla
3. fold opposite sides over filling
4. roll up from bottom and place seam-side down on a baking sheet
5. brush with melted margarine
6. bake at 400f for 25 minutes or until golden
7. garnish with additional cheese and green onion and serve salsa on the side
demonstrations.review: I bow down to you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
broccoli and bell peppers

this is a great healthy side dish for most meats and main dishes. presentation is great.

1. for sauce , in a small bowl stir together soy sauce , lemon juice and sesame oil
2. set aside
3. place a steamer basket in a 12 inch skillet
4. add enough water to come just below bottom of basket and bring to a boil
5. place broccoli in steamer basket and reduce heat to medium low
6. cover and steam for 4 minutes
7. add sweet peppers
8. cover and steam for 3 to 4 minutes more or until vegetables are crisp-tender
9. transfer vegetables to a serving bowl
10. drizzle sauce over vegetables and toss gently to coat
demonstrations.review: We adore this simple preparation -- it is now our default side dish when we dine asian. The first time I steamed it in a skillet, but subsequently I steam it in a pot because it's easier for me.

target.recipe_text:
chunky brownie cookies

fast, easy, and so yummy! i had a brownie mix to use up, and my 4 year old was sick and needed a pick me up. thank you duncan hines! these would be great for kids to make. just 5 ingredients, and you've got great chocolate-chocolate chip cookies. and don't forget the ice cold milk to have with these!

1. heat oven to 375 , line cookie sheet with parchment paper , or grease cookie sheet
2. mix the brownie mix , egg , water and oil in a large bowl
3. stir until blended , fold in chips
4. drop by teaspoons , 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheet
5. bake 7-8 minutes until they are set in the center--do not overbake !
6. cool 1 minute on sheet before moving to cooling rack
target.review:
Quick, Easy, Delicious, what else is there? I had some peanut butter and chocolate chips left over from another recipe and some pecans..yummmm
thanks Ciao!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bill s ultimate bundt cake

this is my dh's favorite, favorite cake. a wonderful woman who worked with me at a real estate office made these at christmas and gave them to everyone. instead of a bundt pan, she prepared these in mini loaf pans and gave them to everyone in the office. when i brought this home and we tried it, we went nuts! my husband begged me to get the recipe from her. ever since, i've been making this in a bundt pan. but you can, like i mentioned, make it in mini loaf pans, regular loaf pans or even make them into muffins. warning....it is soooo good. i also apologize because i cannot remember the name of the woman who initially made this for me.

1. mix together sugar , nuts and cinnamon for topping and put aside
2. in a large mixing bowl mix together dry cake mix and dry pudding
3. add oil and sour cream
4. beat in eggs , one at a time
5. mixture will be thick and green
6. generously grease a bundt pan
7. sprinkle 1 / 2 of the topping into the bottom of the bundt pan
8. put half of the cake batter carefully over the topping
9. it is very , very thick so you will not be able to pour it
10. take a well greased spoon and put dollops evenly around the pan
11. then using the greased spoon , spread the batter evenly over the topping at the bottom of the bundt pan
12. sprinkle the rest of the topping mixture over the batter in the bundt pan
13. again , take the rest of the batter and using the greased spoon , put the dollops over the topping
14. using the greased spoon , smooth the batter evenly around the pan
15. bake that cake for 40-45 minutes at 350 degrees
16. cool the cake
17. then invert the cake onto a nice serving platter
18. warning- one taste and you'll be hooked !
demonstrations.review: Fantastic! I made this for Christmas and everyone loved it. DH asked for it again and took some to work. Everyone is asking him for recipe. I'm not a cake lover but even I must say this cake is very special. And the icing on this cake is that It's so easy to make!!! Thanks so much for this wonderful recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mushroom cheese puff spirals

these are packed with wonderful flavor using the vegeatable cream cheese spread! the chive kind is also good when wanting a mild onion flavor!

1. process first five ingredients in food processor til blended and chopped
2. unroll crescent roll dough and separate into four rectangles
3. press perforations together
4. spread each rectangle with cream cheese mixture
5. roll each up jelly-roll style starting with long sides
6. cut each roll into 5 slices
7. place on ungreased cookie sheet
8. bake in 425 oven for 8-11 minutes
9. makes 20 appetizers
10. serve warm
demonstrations.review: These are so easy and quick and oh so good. Such and wonderful blending of flavors. Thanks for the great recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
death by chocolate cake aka chocolate heaven cake

deliciously moist and rich chocolate cake. a chocolate lovers dream! very quick and easy to prepare. our family's favorite cake recipe!

1. prepare cake by the directions on the box and add dry pudding mix , then add morsels and nuts mix well with electric mixer
2. bake as directed in 2- 8 inch round cake pans sprayed with pam and lightly floured
3. when cakes have cooled , spread icing on first layer and sprinkle with additional morsels and nuts
4. add second layer and repeat the process icing the sides of the cake as well
5. enjoy this chocolate heaven !
demonstrations.review: I made this cake for church exactly as per recipe. I got one bite while slicing it. Yummmmmm...I'll  have to make it again for me...The best chocolate cake I've ever had and I'm not a chocolate cake fan.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon wrapped water chestnuts with ketchup sauce

this is my favorite version of the bacon wrapped water chestnuts appetizer.

1. combine sauce ingredients
2. set aside
3. cut bacon slices in thirds
4. wrap bacon pieces around water chestnuts
5. secure with toothpicks
6. place in 2 casserole dishes
7. bake at 425 degrees for 10-15 minutes
8. drain grease
9. pour sauce over water chestnuts
10. bake for about 30 minutes more or until bacon is cooked
demonstrations.review: I never had these before and thought they would be something my DH liked. When I tasted one..it was on! DH and I got more competitive than superbowl we were watching. Thanks Chris, yummy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panko crusted shrimp

found this gem on the canadian food network. christine cushing is the author. it has become our favorite shrimp recipe. use your imagination to season the flour. do keep it simple so your don't overpower the crisp, clean flavor of the shrimp. i like to use 1 teaspoon of lemon pepper. this can be used as an appetizer, or a main dish served with your favorite rice recipe. our rating system for keeper recipes is simple. "make again", "can i have seconds", and the very rarely used "orgasm". this recipe rates a definate "orgasm".

1. add seasoned flour to a shallow baking dish for dredging
2. in a bowl , beat together eggs , milk , and parsley
3. add panko to a second shallow baking dish
4. dredge shrimp in flour , then egg mixture , and coat with panko
5. pour oil in a heavy skillet and heat to medium high
6. place 6 to 8 shrimp in the hot oil and cook until golden brown , about 1 to 2 minutes
7. transfer to a plate lined with paper towels
8. repeat with remaining shrimp
9. while shrimp is cooking , mix plum sauce and horseradish
10. serve shrimp with sauce on the side
11. prep time does not include de-veining and cleaning shrimp
demonstrations.review: You are my new best friend...This is the best shrimp I've ever had. It got such rave reviews at my dinner party. Actually I didn't mention Orgasm to anyone but a couple of guests brought it up! A definate keeper! Can't wait to have it again! Made exactly as per recipe with sauce

target.recipe_text:
ten minute cheater s pizza

if you keep the right ingredients around, a pizza is only a few minutes away.

1. want pizza ? it takes a few minutes ! here's the trick: keep pitas or tortillas , meat , and cheese in the freezer
2. you can freeze a 2 inch stick of pepperoni in the freezer , and cut off the amount you need with a good sharp , warm , knife
3. if you have a bag of shredded mozza in the freezer , it is easy to take only the amount you need
4. always keep a can or jars of plain tomato sauce in the house
5. put tomato sauce on pita , put on basil and oregano , then cheese , then veggies , then meat
6. stick it in the oven or toaster oven at 375f degrees for about 7 minutes
7. sometimes i make the original recipie with hot italian sausage
8. you can keep a link of italian sausage in the freezer
9. just make sure you skin and cook it first
10. a good snack or appetizer i make uses a tortilla , tomato sauce , basil , a little freshly ground pepper , and feta cheese
11. simple , and tastes gourmet !
target.review: I've made these using sliced fresh tomatoes, feta cheese and basil. Simple, delicious and low fat. The possibilities are endless... and so much better than the english muffin pizzas of my youth.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave bread pudding

this is a very quick and easy dessert to make when you are short on time. and oh, so tasty!

1. place bread cubes in 8" round dish
2. sprinkle evenly with brown sugar , nutmeg , salt , then raisins
3. measure milk into a 1 qt measuring cup
4. add butter
5. microwave at high for 2 minutes , or until butter is melted and milk is warm
6. rapidly stir in eggs with a fork and mix well
7. pour over bread cubes in dish
8. microwave at medium high 9 to 12 minutes
9. when cooked , center may still be slightly soft but it will set up as pudding cools
10. serve warm or chilled
11. this recipe was tested in a 1000 watt microwave and 9 minutes is plenty of time
demonstrations.review: Great recipe. Very easy to follow. My microwave took a bit longer, almost double the times listed in the recipe. However, it set well, was tasty... even better than I expected.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
island ribs

this combination of flavors accents the subtle taste of pork.

1. whisk together the soy , sugar , garlic , honey and ginger
2. pour over the ribs and marinate for two hours
3. place on a hooded grill over medium coals
4. cook until tender
5. baste with the marinade 15 minutes longer
demonstrations.review: Excellent recipe. We made this with pork ribs over the weekend and our guests devoured every last rib. We did overcook them a bit, but still, they were delcious. Definitely a keeper. We served them with vegetable brown rice & barley, braised bok choy, roasted chili peppers and pineapple salsa.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple banana cake

very moist, very delicious. the recipe was given to me by a friend.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. combine all the wet ingredients in large bowl and mix well
3. combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl and mix well
4. add dry to wet ingredients and mix thoroughly
5. pour into an ungreased 9"x13" pan
6. bake for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Very tasty and moist. My husband made this a few nights ago. He omitted the nuts and used a bundt pan. I would suggest sticking with the 9x13-inch pan, I don't think it cooked all the way through. We're both eating it every night, just the same. While it was still warm, we served it with a scoop of coffee ice cream. Delicious. Hubby says this was an easy recipe. I say it was yummy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yogurt chicken

i make this and serve it with tabbouleh, pita bread and tomatoes. my husband especially likes it as it is somewhat middle eastern.

1. wash the chicken and put in a container big enough so that the chicken is flat , side by side
2. combine the rest of the ingredients in a bowl and pour over chicken
3. allow at least 4 hours for chicken to marinate
4. you can grill the chicken or bake it in the oven
5. it is great on the grill !
demonstrations.review:
This is great base recipe. I've made this several times-- adding mustard, honey, fresh basil, olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, miso, paprika, oregano or lemon juice. You can easily change this to suit your tastes. We've used this with breasts (boneless & bone-in), thighs, legs and whole chickens. 

It's imporant that the chicken marinate in the mixture for at least 4 hours. 

Enjoy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
downeast oven scallops

easy and delicious! a 

1. preheat oven 450 f degrees
2. mix salt , peppers , crumbs together
3. beat together egg and water
4. roll scallops in crumbs
5. dip scallops in egg wash
6. roll scallops in crumbs
7. place in greased baking dish
8. let set for 30 minutes
9. pour melted butter over scallops and bake
demonstrations.review: I love low-maintenance recipes and this fits the bill. Very simple & tasty dish. I'll definitely make this again.

target.recipe_text:
black bean and corn salad   dip

refreshing! light! great way to use that last cob of grilled corn. gives the dish a light smokey flavor. good for picnics, camping,& pot luck. makes a good side as well as a meal. using it as a relish to top grilled salmon or tuna. try dipping tortilla chips into it.

1. in a large bowl , combine salad ingredients
2. in a small bowl whisk together dressing ingredients
3. pour over the bean mixture and toss until all ingredients are coated
target.review: We loved this!  Used Trader Joe's frozen roasted corn (I do apologize if you don't have one in your area).  Also added 1 can of drained diced fire-roasted tomatoes.  I also put it all together several hours early and let the flavours meld all afternoon. This will definitely become a summer favourite!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bow tie pasta with smoked salmon and cream cheese

this is one of my favorite "ripped out of a magazine recipes".

1. cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente , according to package instructions
2. reserve 1 / 2 cup pasta water
3. add onion to pot
4. immediately drain pasta mixture , and return to pot
5. add cream cheese , dill , capers , and salmon to pasta
6. toss , adding reserved pasta water a little at a time to create a thin sauce that coats pasta
7. season lightly with salt and pepper
8. serve
demonstrations.review: straight from Martha Stewart

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach feta frittata

this is a beautiful frittata. we eat it for breakfast, lunch or dinner. with fresh fruit or salad depending on the meal. enjoy

1. preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. cook onion in olive oil until opaque in a medium skillet
3. add mushrooms and cook for about 1 minute
4. add the spinach and cook until warmed through
5. grease a 9" casserole dish with cooking spray
6. put the vegie mixture in the bottom of the casserole dish
7. add crumbled feta to the eggs and pour over
8. top with mozzarella cheese
9. bake at 350f for approx 30 minutes , or until the eggs are solid
10. cool for about 5 minutes then cut into serving size squares
demonstrations.review: YUM!  This is soooo good- but I do have to admit I changed it a bit but simply because of what i had on hand and because we are in the middle of a huge kitchen remodel and are cooking with a barbeque and a microwave!  I used 3/4 bag of fresh baby spinach instead of frozen and crumbled leftover bacon instead of ham.  I sauteed onion and mushroom on the barbeque side burner then added the fresh spinach to wilt it and poured the egg feta mix on, lowered the burner, put on a lid and let it cook that way.  It only took a few minutes and added the mozarella on top last few minutes.  My husband's addition was the best however - some wonderful bloody marys to go with this perfect sunday breakfast.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked tomatoes

nan

1. cut each tomato in half and arrange cut side up on a baking dish
2. sprinkle each half lightly with bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and thyme
3. bake for 15 to 20 min at 375 degrees
demonstrations.review: I've been serving these for years because me family just loves them.  This time I added a bit of melted butter (could also use EVOO) some salt and pepper and substituted dill for the thyme because we served them with fresh cod - YUM!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rhubarb crumble pie

this easy, old fashioned family recipe goes back more than 5 generations - from kate kelly of kanata, ontario! make your own pastry base or buy a ready made shell to save time. you can aso make this with a full pastry or lattice top. try adding a tsp of orange zest to the filling - its delicious!

1. topping: combine flour& sugar in a bowl
2. using a pastry blender or 2 knives , cut in butter until mixture is in fine crumbs
3. set aside
4. pie: combine sugar , flour& salt in a bowl
5. whisk in egg until smooth
6. add rhubarb& toss to coat
7. scrape into pie shell& dot with butter
8. sprinkle topping evenly over filling
9. bake in the bottom third of a preheated 425f oven for 10 minutes
10. reduce heat to 350f& continue baking until topping is golden& filling is bubbly , about 40 minutes
11. remove from oven& cool on a rack
demonstrations.review: Excellent Rhubarb Crumble Pie!! I had just a bit more rhubarb to use and ended up with 6 cups. Used the same amount of sugar called for in the recipe but increased the flour to 4 tablespoons. I didn't use any butter. Served this warm and topped with some homemade vanilla ice cream ~ so yummy! Definitely a keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: These are truly THE BEST!! My 12 year old granddaughter made these for our dinner and they were perfect - held together nicely and tasted wonderful. The added bonus was the great boost to her ego! Thank you for yet another "keeper" recipe. If the recipe says Kittencal I know I can trust it to be one that is straight forward to make and yummy tasting too!

target.recipe_text:
