5. if needed , gently spread to make even
6. bake for 7 minutes
7. while toffee is still hot and bubbly , pour chocolate chips evenly on top of candy
8. when the chocolate chips begin to melt , gently spread chocolate over toffee
9. freeze for one hour
10. break into pieces and enjoy !
11. i have sprinkled nuts and / or drizzled white chocolate over the top of this candy to make it even better , but the basic recipe is outstanding as well
12. you can also change the type of chocolate that you use in the chips
13. white chocolate chips and milk chocolate both work , but make the candy incredibly sweet
demonstrations.review: Perfectly wonderful in every way!!  Tastes just like (but better than!) a Heath or Skor bar.  I used saltines (love the sweet/salty combination).  Also covered the cookie sheet with Pam sprayed foil.  I covered the melted chocolate w/ finely chopped pecans.  Perfection!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked buffalo chicken breasts

these buffalo chicken breasts are as good as buffalo chicken wings without all of the mess.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. spray skillet with cooking spray
3. add chicken and cook 4 minutes each side until browned
4. place chicken in an 11 x 7 baking dish coated with cooking spray
5. combine hot sauce and next 4 ingredients
6. pour over chicken and bake uncovered for 25 minutes
7. serve with dressing
demonstrations.review: Wowza!  DH and I love, love spicy food and I figured this would be on the mark, but WOW.  Still trying to figure out how this combination results in such a HOT sauce.  Loved it.  Served w/ blue cheese dressing, roasted potatoes.  WONDERFUL.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy cajun chicken pasta

n'awlin's style of chicken with an updated alfredo sauce.

1. place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
2. in a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. reduce heat add green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
4. pour over hot linguine and toss with parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: Love it!!  Reminds me of a dish I used to order at a restaurant years ago (only this is better!).  So rich and filling.  DH and I were very pleased!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
world s best chicken noodle soup

my mom started making this soup after finding it in a magazine (?), but i made a few adaptions and here it is!

1. bring water and bouillon cubes to boil in 5 quart pan
2. add noodles
3. when noodles are cooked , add chicken and soup , stir until combined throughly
4. remove from heat and add sour cream
5. salt and pepper to taste
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Really, really good!  I did add another quart of liquid (used 2 qts. chicken broth and 1 qt. water and a few buillion cubes) and I also added a bag of frozen peas and carrots as well as some chopped onion.  Didn't add the sour cream (shocker - I LOVE sour cream!) but the soup was so wonderfully thick on its own so I didn't feel it needed it.  Next time I'll add the sour cream and experience it all the way!   I'll be making this often!  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy baked salmon

one of my husband's recipes.  we like to make this with lemon basil; it gives the dish great flavor!

1. saut onion and garlic in butter on medium high until onions are translucent
2. add tomatoes and cook on high for 5 to 10 minutes untill tomatoes start to break a part
3. add cream and simmer on medium low for 5 minutes
4. stir basil , salt and pepper in to cream sauce
5. in an oiled baking dish , pour cream sauce over salmon
6. cover and bake for 12 minutes at 350f
7. serve over pasta , rice or steamed veggies
demonstrations.review: DH and I loved this.  The sauce was so good, so creamy.  We used fresh basil (of course!).  I did cook our salmon closer to 15 mins.   I'll make this again and again.  Thank you!

target.recipe_text:
chicken stuffed   chili  bell peppers

i love stuffed peppers and i think that this is an interesting take on them. ground turkey would probably work well too. i got this from family circle magazine.

1. heat oven to 350f
2. slice peppers lengthwise and clean out seeds
3. in a large skillet heat oil over medium-high heat
4. add onion , cook and stir about 3 minutes
5. add red pepper , cook and stir about 2 minutes
6. add ground chicken , cook , stirring occasionally , until no longer pink
7. stir in chili powder , oregano , salt , pepper and cumin
8. cook 2 minutes longer
9. mash half the beans coarsely
10. stir all beans , barbecue sauce and tomato paste into chicken
11. cook about 2 minutes and remove from heat
12. fill each pepper with the mixture and top with cheese
13. bake peppers until heated , about 10 minutes
14. garnish with sour cream
target.review: You and I read the same magazine. I have made this several times and it is delicious. I usually use all red peppers because I prefer them but either way this is a tasty and fairly easy recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple pear cucumber salad

this crunchy, sweet and tangy salad mixes familiar fruits and veggies with a whole grain mustard dressing and apple cider vinegar. from whole foods.

1. for the dressing:
2. mix together the mustard , dill , vinegar , sugar and olive oil
3. set aside
4. for the salad:
5. core and slice apples and pears into thin slices , leaving skin on for color and flavor
6. slice cucumber into rounds
7. if cucumber is waxed , peel it
8. otherwise leave skin on
9. slice onion any way you like
10. add all to bowl with dressing and toss to coat
demonstrations.review: I like the idea of this salad but it was not as sweet as I had imagined. It was actually more tart. I will make it again but add more of some kind of sweetener. Three of my 10 guests raved about it. I imagine there is some variation in sweetness depending on how sweet the fruit is.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spaghetti squash patties

i have not tried this recipe. i got this recipe from obesity help. this recipe was posted by ms jay.

1. add eggs , onion or chives , salt and pepper to cooked spaghetti squash
2. form into 3 inch patties
3. heat oil in a skillet
4. melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. spoon 1 / 4 cup squash mixture into skillet
6. with a fork , press to form an evenly thick cake
7. repeat
8. cook cakes until bottoms are lightly browned , turn over and brown second side
9. cook for 3-4 minutes on each side
10. continue until you've used all the squash mixture
11. use additional butter if necessary
12. sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve with sour cream
13. for a different flavor , you can saute the patties in butter
14. for an asian flair , saute in canola oil mixed with a few drops of sesame oil , serve with soy sauce
demonstrations.review: This was very tasty. I made it as directed using green onions. I had to use more oil to keep them from sticking to the skillet which made them a little greasier than I would like. Next time I will try baking them.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
made from scratch broccoli cornbread

to my surprise, every broccoli cornbread on zaar calls for "cornbread mix" this recipe is completely from scratch and well worth the extra steps!  i don't remember where i found this... i've been making this for years... great with chicken, or chili.

1. in a large bowl mix together the corn meal , flour , salt , baking powder , and sugar together
2. make a well in the center of the bowl
3. melt butter in a small fry pan
4. add onion and saute until onions are translucent
5. in a separate bowl , combine the eggs , thawed broccoli , cottage cheese , and melted butter with onions
6. pour into well of flour mixture
7. stir until just combined
8. pour batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
9. bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes , or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: Kittycatmom_42 this was very good. It was easy to make and went great with the chili I made. I too, prefer not to use mixes. I added more sugar because I like sweeter cornbread. The broccoli was a nice touch. I went back and forth between 4 and 5 stars I think because I would have liked a more muffin like texture. Perhaps I did not bake it long enough in my oven. I will definitely make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy ground beef and vegetable soup

this is a spicy soup - not hot spicy - but cloves and cinnamon - spicy.  my family loves this delicious soup with rolls and an apple salad.  it is great for busy families; just throw it together in the morning and dinner is ready when you get home.  don't let the long list of ingredients scare you away....they are all things you have on the shelf, in the freezer or in the fridge.  it is from "your family will love it" by rodale   press - healthy food in a bowl.

1. in a skillet
2. brown ground beef , onions and garlic
3. drain off any fat
4. combine meat mixture and remaining ingredients in slow cooker
5. stir to mix
6. cook over low heat 7-9 hours
demonstrations.review: My family and I really enjoyed this. It was easy to put together and quite tasty. I will probably experiment with adding more vinegar to see if that gives it a little extra zing and I might change out the corn for green beans to reduce carbs. It is definitely going into my recipe repertoire

demonstrations.recipe_text:
black bean tart

a friend of a friend - first taste did it! she made two and hid one for herself.

1. crust:
2. preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. press the potatoes between paper towels to remove any excess moisture
4. mix the potatoes , butter , salt and pepper in a bowl
5. pat the potato mixture over the bottom and up the side of a greased 9 inch pie plate and bake for 20-25 minutes or until light brown
6. maintain the oven temperature
7. filling:
8. heat the oil in a skillet and add the bell pepper and onion
9. saute until tender and remove from the heat
10. stir in the beans , corn , jalapeno chiles , cumin and chili powder
11. fold in the cheese and cilantro
12. spoon the bean mixture into the potato crust and bake for 20 minutes
13. cool in the pie plate on a wire rack for 10 minutes
14. topping:
15. mix the sour cream , lime juice , salt and pepper in bowl
16. top the tart with the topping and garnish with the cilantro
17. enjoy with your favorite chips / crackers !
demonstrations.review: This is delicious! I substituted olive oil for the butter in the potato crust and added more than double the amount of cumin and chili powder. I added the cilantro and lime to the filling and left off the topping. A little healthier and still a great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
amazing nacho dip for a crowd

this is one of the best dips, the amounts listed is enough about 15-20 people but may be cut in half if desired. i have served this many times at my get togethers and everyone loves it --- this may be prepared in advance up to step#8 refrigerated and baked later --- see my recipe#168653

1. lighty grease a shallow 3-quart oven-proof dish
2. in a frypan , brown the ground beef with onion and garlic , crumbling with a fork into fine pieces
3. drain , season with salt
4. spread the refried beans into the bottom of the dish
5. top the green chilies over beans
6. top with cooked beef over beans
7. top with shredded cheese
8. drizzle taco sauce over all
9. at this point , you may cover and refrigerate to bake later
10. bake at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes
11. spread the mashed avocado over baked mixture
12. then top with sour cream
13. sprinkle / garnish with chopped green onions and olives
14. serve with tortilla chips
target.review: Much easier than Taco's, and a whole lot more fun!  I added sides of avacado, sour cream and the works.  Served the dip in a jalapeno bread bowl - Perfect!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
olive garden fried mozzarella

you can't go wrong with this one. it is also very inexpensive to make. you can easily match the taste of the restaurant. from copykat.com (http://www.copykat.com)

1. if your cheese is in a brick , slice it thick , and cut the cheese crossways to made triangles
2. beat the eggs with water and set aside
3. mix the bread crumbs , garlic salt , and italian seasonings and set aside
4. blend the flour with corn starch and set aside
5. heat your vegetable oil for deep frying to 360 degrees
6. dip cheese in flour then in egg wash and then coat
7. with bread crumbs
8. place carefully in hot oil and fry until golden , this takes just a few seconds so watch carefully
9. when golden remove from hot oil and drain
10. serve with you favorite italian spaghetti sauce and enjoy
demonstrations.review: DH does not eat leftovers - but he was fishing these out the next day eating them cold!  Taste just like restaurant style!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
basically the best bruschetta ever

i've enjoyed bruschetta in the past, but it always seemed to be lacking some zip so i started experimenting. now, i have a bunch of people asking me to can it and give them some! hope you enjoy as much as the rest of them!

1. combine all ingredients above and refrigerate for several hours , check for taste and season accordingly
2. serve on garlic bread with some parm cheese or bake on the bread with a little feta or assagio cheese for a change of pace
3. enjoy
demonstrations.review: This was my first bruschetta- it IS great!  I didn't have quality balsamic vinegar on-hand so I had to add a bit of brown sugar to what I did have access to.  Turned out spectacular.  I went heavy on the garlic (personal preference) - adding some garlic powder to get the taste throughout.  Fantastic.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
smoky cheese log

taste of home magazine serve with wheat or sesame crackers.

1. in a mixing bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. mix well
3. shape mixture into a log
4. cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
5. for topping , combine the bacon , sesame seeds and chives
6. roll cheese log in topping
7. serve with vegetables or crackers
demonstrations.review: I SO wish my camera was working.. this is a great manly-man cheese ball. It was devoured. I garnished it with Italian parsely and served it for a football party with water crackers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wonderful salsa

this is the best salsa recipe i've found so far and i've tried about a dozen. i got it from one of the local hospital cookbooks that are sold in my area. i changed it a bit and have been canning it for years. the reason i plant a garden is for this salsa. we would be lost without it. hope you like it as much as we do.  one of our members who is a food scientist took this salsa to work, tested the ph and found it measured under 4.0 (well within the safety limit for boiling water bath processing).

1. mix all together and bring to a slow boil for 10 minute
2. seal in jars and cook in hot water bath for 10 minute
3. this is a medium salsa
4. this is also a chunky salsa so if you want a smoother salsa cut your veggies into smaller pieces
5. yields 3-6 quarts or pints
demonstrations.review: This really is a great recipe.  I am somone who always tries to add more spices, etc - and this one (given the reviews) I left alone and was amazed.  It's a sweet-spicey kinda salsa that DH and I (who both have very different tastes) enjoyed.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot thai chicken thighs

throw six ingredients into the crock pot and 6 hours later enjoy a delicious treat!

1. put all ingredients in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours
2. garnish with cilantro , scallions , and peanuts
3. serve with jasmine rice made with half coconut milk and half water
demonstrations.review: The chicken tasted very good, however I would say the instructions might need a bit of direction on a suggested crockpot size.  I have a 5 quart, and even though I doubled the sauce, after 6 hours it was still dried (almost burnt) around the edges. The chicken, which was in the center was yummy - but the meat-to-sauce ratio seems like it's geared for a small crockpot.  Overall, great recipe taste and A+ on odd ingredients that came out great - but for anyone with a larger crockpot, I would suggest tripling the sauce.

target.recipe_text:
chili dog pizza

i found this recipe on kidskuisine.com. it was a huge hit with my kids, even my most picky eater asked for seconds! (i actually enjoyed it myself!) and the best part is it was so easy to prepare.

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. mix together bisquick mix and water
3. stir until a soft ball forms
4. roll or pat dough into a 12 inch circle on an ungreased cookie sheet or pizza pan
5. pinch the edge of the circle to form a crust
6. spread the chili over crust , and then add cheese , and top with hot dog slices
7. bake in the oven for 20 to 25 minutes
target.review: This was very good and really child/adult friendly and very easy to make.  Like, "why didn't I think of it".

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage kielbasa supper

this excellent recipe is from taste of home magazine.

1. in a 5-qt slow cooker , combine the cabbage , potatoes , onion , salt and pepper
2. pour the broth over all
3. cut sausage into serving-size pieces and place on top
4. cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours
demonstrations.review:
Excellent, made this today for Sunday dinner.  It smelled heavenly all day.  Comfort smell.
It was done way before direction time so potatos were a little too soft.  Next time I make this I will add more cabbage and some carrots and a shorter cooking time.
I would think that you could use most any meat. It reminded me of  Boiled Dinner.

Thank you talldoc for submitting this great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot kielbasa   sauerkraut

delicious comfort food.

1. slice 1 onion into thin strips and caramelize
2. drain and rinse sauerkraut
3. slice kielbasa into 1-inch lengths
4. combine water , cider and brown sugar
5. combine all ingredients well in crock pot
6. cook on high 6 hours
demonstrations.review: Great recipe, made it today.  Only thing I change was the length of cooking time.  Six hours on high is too long and cooks away any juice.  Had to add more water and set on low.  The sauerkraut was really good.  Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
8 layer casserole

this is quick and easy to prepare, makes for a filling supper, and is practically idiot-proof!

1. crumble ground beef evenly over bottom of a slow cooker
2. sprinkle with bacon bits , then onion
3. in a medium bowl , combine tomato sauce , water , chili powder , salt , and black pepper
4. pour half over beef and onion layers
5. sprinkle rice evenly over top , then corn
6. top with remaining tomato sauce mixture , then bell pepper
7. cover and cook on low about 5 hours or until rice is tender
demonstrations.review: Family thought this was delicious.  Easy assembly and great taste. I did not add the chili powder because we do not like too much spice.  All in all, a great one dish recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potato  cheese and bacon soup

this is in answer to a question on the threads, it is based on a recipe from the australian womens weekly

1. melt the butter in a large pan , add the bacon and cook until crisp
2. remove the bacon from the pan with a slotted spoon , leaving as much fat as possible
3. add the onion to the same pan and cook for 5 minutes , or until very soft and golden
4. add the paprika and cook for further 30 seconds
5. return the bacon to the pan and add the potato and stock
6. bring to the boil , then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are very soft
7. stir or mash lightly to break up the potato
8. add the cheddar and stir well , until it is melted through
9. season with salt and pepper to taste and serve topped with a sprinkling of chopped chives
demonstrations.review: Excellent soup.  Made it for my husband who is the best one to experiment on.  He raved.  Thanks for your posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb cheeseburger quiche

a low carb but not low fat version of a quiche using meat as a crust. it's actually pretty tasty and can definitely be used during an induction phase of a low carb diet.

1. preheat oven to 350 , brown ground beef in skillet with onion and garlic
2. drain off fat and mix in crisp crumbled bacon
3. mix well to break up any large clumps
4. press this mixture in the bottom of a deep dish pan or plate
5. combine eggs , mayo , half and half and mix well
6. sprinkle cheese over beef crust mixture
7. pour egg mixture over the beef mixture
8. bake 40-45 minutes at 350 , until browned and set
demonstrations.review: Made this on Thursday for supper.  The whole family enjoyed it.  I will be making this again soon.  I added another egg and more cheese.  Did not change the taste, just made more.  Thanks

target.recipe_text:
toffee dip with apples

i served this at a party and people kept raving about it and asking for the recipe. i must admit, i was addicted and was hoping for left overs - but it was all gone.

1. combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl
2. beat at medium speed of a mixer until smooth
3. add toffee bits and mix well
4. cover and chill
5. combine juice and apples in a bowl
6. toss well
7. drain apples
8. serve with dip
target.review: This was outstanding and highly addictive.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramel gold

if you love caramel candies, this recipe will be like heaven to you! it is soft and wonderful. i use it to make homemade turtles candy, but you can use it to make anything you want. it is excellent!!
note: i like to use a metal spatula to stir with so it helps  keep it from burning.

1. melt butter in a heavy 3 quart sauce pan
2. add sugar and salt
3. stir thoroughly
4. now stir in corn syrup
5. mix well
6. add sweetened condensed milk , stirring constantly
7. cook and stir over medium heat and heat to firm ball stage , about 12 to 15 minutes
8. remove from heat and add the vanilla
9. pour into a 9x9x2 buttered pan
10. cool , cut into squares
11. enjoy when cooled
demonstrations.review: This is one of my favorite recipes!!!  I can't stop eating them.  These are a sugary addiction you cannot resist, plain or dipped!  It's nice and chewy, which sadly makes it hard to cut.  Could be made in a slightly larger pan, this fills up fairly high and takes a long time to set up.  Couldn't find a 15 ounce can of sweetened condensed milk, 14 ounces works perfectly.  I will definitely be making this many times more.  THANK YOU michEgan!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken breasts in lemon cream sauce

my family loves chicken, and this is a quick & tasty way to spruce up the everyday bird. we love this over all types of pasta.

1. melt 3 tbs butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. add mushrooms and saute until tender
3. remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
4. sprinkle chicken with salt& pepper , dredge in flour , shaking off excess
5. melt remaining 3 tbs butter in skillet
6. add chicken and saute 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until golden brown
7. transfer chicken to a serving platter
8. add broth to skillet , scraping up browned bits
9. bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until reduced to approximately 3 / 4 cup
10. stir in cream and lemon juice
11. cook over medium heat until slightly thickened
12. stir in mushrooms , white pepper& salt to taste
13. add chicken and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until sauce is a medium thick consistency
14. serve over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: I adore this!  I don't make any changes as the recipe is perfect. Thank you for a new family favorite!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
edna s apple crumble  aka  apple crisp

a simple and easy to make but oh so yummy recipe. known as apple crumble in the uk and apple crisp in the us

1. put apples in an 8 or 9 inch square baking dish
2. combine the rest of the ingredients in a separate bowl and mix
3. spread crumble mixture over apples and bake for 35 minutes in a 375f degree oven
4. for an added treat top off with a little english custard
demonstrations.review: This was a great crisp! I doubled the recipe and used only seven granny smith apples. The ratio of crumble to apples was perfect. I also changed the cinnamon to 1 tsp, and the nutmeg to  1/8tsp. Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s best deep dark chocolate layer cake

this will probably be the only layer cake you will ever use, it's a rich, moist chocolate cake that tastes more like chocolate fudge than a cake, you will be making again and again! --- i have also made this using room temperature crisco butter-flavor shortening in place of butter --- to take this to yet another level add in 2-3 tablespoons of your favorite liqueur in place of the vanilla, i like kahlua!  --- also see my recipe#89207

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. line bottoms of two buttered 9-inch round cake pans with parchment paper
3. in a large bowl , beat butter and brown sugar , until light and fluffy
4. add in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. beat in vanilla and coffee granules
6. sift together flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt in a bowl
7. add the flour mixture into the creamed mixture , alternating with the buttermilk , in three additions , scraping down the sides of bowl each time
8. divide batter between prepared pans
9. bake for 30-35 minutes , or until cake tests done
10. turn onto a rack and remove paper
11. cool and frost
12. for frosting: beat butter until creamy
13. blend in cream and vanilla
14. beat until very smooth
15. add the cocoa and icing sugar
16. beat on high for 45 seconds
demonstrations.review: This is the best chocolate layer cake I've ever had!  A lot of chocolate cakes don't taste chocolaty, but this was delicious!  It really does taste like fudge.  Very rich, so eating small slices are ideal (if you can hold back).  Thank you KITTENCAL!  I added a tsp. of instant coffee granules to the frosting too.  As I frosted this scrumptious confection, it began to fall apart.  I wonder if it would be easier to frost as a sheet cake?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave brownies in 5 minutes

this is my son's quick fix for a chocolate attack. easy enough for kids to make themselves.

1. cream sugar and butter together
2. add eggs and vanilla , mix well
3. stir flour and cocoa together , then add into egg mixture
4. mix well
5. grease a glass pie pan and then coat with sugar
6. pour brownie mixture into sugared pie pan
7. microwave 4&1 / 2- 5 minutes
8. let sit until cool
9. optional:to sprinkle powder sugar over the top of the brownie
demonstrations.review: These turned out great! I added a squirt of Ghirardelli chocolate sauce, 1/2 bag peanut butter chips, and 1/2 bag mini chocolate chips. They were so fudgey and delicious. Thanks for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
speedy gingerbread oatmeal

this is a really quick, delicious way to start your day.  all you need are few simple ingredients and in less than 5 minutes, you've got breakfast.  you can tailor this recipe to your wants/needs.  put as much or as little sugar and spices in the oats as you desire.

1. mix the oats , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , salt , raisins and water in a microwave-safe bowl
2. microwave on high for 1-1
3. 25 minutes , stirring every 15-30 seconds until the oatmeal has reached the desired consistency
4. stir in the brown sugar , walnuts and a few drops of milk , serve warm
target.review: I'm sorry, this one just didn't rock my world.  I used instant whole grain oats, but did everything else exactly by the measure....and it tasted gritty, the spices didn't really meld together, etc.  It sounded great when I read it, and I really wanted to love this--but I didn't.  It went uneaten after a couple of bites.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
one bowl creamy potato casserole

i make this often as a side dish for my family it's an easy one-bowl dish that is big on flavor!

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. butter a 2-quart baking dish
3. in a large bowl , combine all ingredients except the parmesan cheese until well blended
4. transfer to prepared baking dish then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
5. bake uncovered for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Carb heaven!  I made one substitution and 2 additions.  Substituted cilantro for parslay (added a nice flavor).  In the last 10 minutes I threw bacon bits and a handful of cheddar cheese on top.  YUM, Yum, yum.  I'm bloated and blissed......5 stars!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zesty italian crescent casserole

this is a very good, easy dish that's sure to impress.  i've had great results from others when i've made this.

1. heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. in large skillet , brown beef and onion then drain
3. return meat to pan
4. add spaghetti sauce
5. meanwhile , in a medium bowl combine mozzarella cheese and sour cream
6. pour hot meat into an ungreased 12 x 8 inch dish
7. spoon cheese mixture over meat
8. unroll crescent roll dough over the top of the mixture
9. mix parmesan cheese and butter together , then spread over the top of the dough
10. bake 18-25 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: I'm mixed on this one.  It was a little bland, but I do think with modifications it will be better next time.    I added more spaghetti sauce than called for as other reviewers indicated (1-1/2 cups), but mine was a tad runny as a result.  I also added more cheese "just because" (a mozarella / provolone blend) and it was definitely too much.  The meat / spaghetti sauce did need more seasoning, so next time I will definitely add italian seasoning as someone else mentioned.  It was a pretty dish, though.....I'll definitely try it again, and scale back the sauce & the cheese.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy cajun chicken pasta

n'awlin's style of chicken with an updated alfredo sauce.

1. place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
2. in a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. reduce heat add green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
4. pour over hot linguine and toss with parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: Definitely a keeper.   If you love the Alfredo taste, this is for you.  My family said 4 of 5 stars, nothing wrong with it at all, we just aren't huge fans of Alfredo.   But definitely easy and good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
french martini

another great martini recipe for all you chambord lovers!

1. mix all ingreidents in shaker
2. shake well
3. strain and pour into a martini glass
demonstrations.review: HHHmmm, I used vanilla vodka and this one has more of a bitter bite than I was hoping for.  Next time I'll go with the unflavored vodka and see what happens

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spinach artichoke quiche

for rsc 11, this can be an appetizer, or lunch

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. saut garlic and shallots in butter until softened , 1-2 minutes
3. add spinach and saut until wilted
4. add chopped artichokes , pine nuts , seasonings and remove from heat
5. pour into a large bowl to cool
6. add eggs , milk and cheeses , stirring to mix everything well
7. add to pie shell
8. bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until set
demonstrations.review: This was OK.  It had a nice flavor, I realized I just wasnt crazy about the artichokes in it.  It was very pretty coming out of the over.

target.recipe_text:
one dish chicken and rice bake

this recipe goes together in 5 minutes and bakes in 45. best of all it is mixed and baked in the same casserole! enjoy this recipe from american century cookbook.

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. mix soup , water , rice , and 1 / 4 tsp each of paprika and pepper in ungreased shallow 2-quart casserole
3. lay chicken on top and sprinkle with remaining paprika and pepper
4. cover and bake until bubbly and chicken shows no signs of pink in the center--about 45 minutes
target.review: I made this tasty little dish last night, and my family and I enjoyed it so much, there was none left.  I did use whole chicken legs instead, and added creole seasoning as well.  This is a keeper which I will be making again.  Thanx for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
should be illegal oven bbq ribs

after not being able to find restaurant ribs that satified my hot sweet appetite, i carefully attempted various combinations of flavors until i found one that i and my family thought was perfect. hope you enjoy them too.

1. place all ingredients together in large roasting pan
2. cut ribs apart for easier serving
3. mix together making sure to coat all ribs with this semi-dry paste
4. spread ribs out evenly on bottom of pan
5. cover lightly with foil
6. bake at 375 degrees for approximately 1 hour
7. turning or stirring occasionally
8. you can use broiler for these ribs , just watch more closely , and adjust cooking time
9. these ribs are also great finished on the grill for a few minutes on each side
demonstrations.review: This sauce is simply delicious.  I used the sauce on Beef Baby Back Ribs and they turned out simply scrumptous. This is a winner and I will be using the recipe from now on. Thanx for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
traditional lasagna

this recipe by lorri foockle won "grand prize" in a "taste of home" magazine. with five kinds of cheese it is by far the best lasagna i've ever tasted!

1. in a skillet , cook beef and sausage over medium heat until no longer pink
2. drain
3. add the next seven ingredients
4. simmer , uncovered , for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
5. in a bowl , combine the eggs , parsley , cottage cheese , ricotta and parmesan
6. spread 1 cup of meat sauce in an ungreased 13x9x2-inch baking dish
7. layer with 3 noodles , provolone cheese , 2 cups of cottage cheese mixture , 1 cup of mozzarella , three noodles , 2 cups of meat sauce , remaining cottage cheese mixture and 1 cup of mozzarella
8. top with remaining noodles , meat sauce and mozzarella
9. cover and bake at 375f for 50 minutes
10. uncover
11. bake 20 minutes longer
12. let stand 15 minutes before cutting
demonstrations.review: This recipe is extremely good and rich in flavor.  My oldest, who is a great fan of lasagna tried to eat the entire pan.  This is definately a winner.  Thanx for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hamburger skillet supper

this is something new that our family tried that i got from a magazine. we were surprised that we would all like it so much! it doesn't take very much time at all so it is great when time is limited.

1. in a skillet , cook beef until no longer pink
2. drain
3. add noodles with contents of seasoning packet and water
4. bring to a boil
5. cook for 3 minutes or until noodles are tender
6. add the veggies and cook until tender , about 3 minutes as well
7. makes about 4 servings
8. here is another way to do it: cook the beef as stated previously
9. during this time , heat up a saucepan of water to cook the ramen noodles in
10. rather than just using 1 packet , use 2 packets of the beef flavor ramen noodles
11. when cooking the noodles , cook them without the flavoring
12. during this time , add the veggies to the meat and continue to cook
13. as the veggies become cooked , add the two packets of flavoring to the beef-veggie mixture
14. the ramen noodles don't take long to cook , so be sure to watch them
15. when they are done , drain them , and add them to the beef-veggie mixture
16. the completed dish will have more flavor , and more noodles for the noodle lovers ! enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was terrible.  What a waste of time and food. Yucky

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amish apple crisp

another wonderful amish inspired dish. we serve this for dessert, or for breakfast. very tasty!

1. place apple mixture in a deep dish pie pan
2. sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
3. mix topping ingredients , except the cinnamon and butter , with a fork until blended
4. sprinkle topping over apples
5. drizzle melted butter over topping
6. sprinkle with cinnamon
7. bake at 375f degrees for 40 minutes
demonstrations.review: I have been in search for an apple crisp recipe to suit my sweet tooth for many years.  This has got to be the best.  Thanx so much for helping me conclude my search.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic  broccoli   lemon

garlic and lemon goes well with this simple broccoli dish. do not overcook the broccoli leave it crisp.

1. steam the broccoli for about 3-5 minutes or until the crispness that you prefer
2. meanwhile heat oil in a fry pan and over moderate heat saute the garlic until golden
3. stir in the lemon zest
4. put broccoli in a bowl pour the garlic and zest over it and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: I am not a broccoli fan, but this recipe made a liar out of me.  This was sooooo... good.  I didn't quite know what lemon zest was, so I used lemon pepper instead and VIOLA!!!!!!

target.recipe_text:
hamburger  rice and gravy

homemade hamburger helper! a childhood favorite.

1. brown together beef , onion and garlic
2. when meat is cooked and onions are translucent , stir in flour until well distributed
3. allow flour to brown slightly
4. add remaining ingredients
5. bring to a boil , then reduce heat and cover
6. simmer 15 minutes or until rice is cooked
target.review: When I saw your recipe tonight I simply had to make it right then and there and it didn't disappoint me in the slightest. The directions were quite clear and I can see that the recipe could be added to according to taste quite easily. When the dish was done I did not have any "gravy" to speak of so may add just a tad bit more water next time around.  I may try it with some mushrooms or maybe some sliced water chestnuts next time too but I certainly will be making it again. Thanks so much for posting such a down home comfort food.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potatoes lyonnaise

this recipe was printed in our newspaper years ago and has become one of my old reliables. it is quick and easy to make in the microwave and has a delicious flavor my family loves.

1. combine all ingredients in a deep , 3 quart micro-safe casserole dish
2. cover
3. cook on high 9-11 minute or until potatoes and onions are tender , stirring every 5 minutes
4. let stand 5 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: Thanks so much for this yummy quick potato dish. I made a couple of minor changes as I have a ton of red potatoes to use up so just quartered them and left skins on. I also only used one small onion and probably used a bit more garlic than called for cause we do love our garlic in this family. It was quick, easy and best of all we got potatoes without heating up the kitchen. It's definately a keeper and have shared it with friends already.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
awesome slow cooker pot roast

i found this on the all recipes site. this is a very easy recipe for a delicious pot roast. it makes its own gravy. it's designed especially for the working person who does not have time to cook all day, but it tastes like you did. you'll want the cut to be between 5 and 6 pounds.

1. in a slow cooker , mix cream of mushroom soup , dry onion soup mix and water
2. place pot roast in slow cooker and coat with soup mixture
3. cook on high setting for 3 to 4 hours , or on low setting for 8 to 9 hours
demonstrations.review: I have been hunting for a good slow cooker pot roast ever since my electric skillet bit the dust a few months ago and this recipe hands down is the best.  It has a wonderful flavor. I used 2 cans of golden mushroom soup and of course in this family we have to have our garlic so added some of it to the mix. Very yummy and so till I get my electric skillet for Christmas this recipe will get used often. My oldest announced last night that I can even use this recipe for pot roast after I get my skillet every so often. High praise indeed. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
deep south stew

"borrowed" this from a friends cookbook. its yummy and quick and gives you your five a day in one bowl! i was told to add the folllowing information when i posted it. "3 weightwatchers points values per serving

1. spray the pan with the cooking spray and fry the onion and garlic until soft
2. add the remaining ingredients and seasoning
3. bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: Excellent stew and would have given more stars if allowed. Very easy to assemble with ingredients that you likely have in your kitchen.  It doesn't take all day to cook but tastes like you did. I prepared it as directed except I increased servings to 4. It is now residing in my keeper file and will be made often in this family.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
old fashioned crock pot onion soup

this easy soup is excellent.

1. put sliced onions in slow cooker
2. pour in melted butter and mix to coat onions thoroughly
3. stir in cubed bread
4. add chicken broth to cover and stir well
5. cover and cook on low 10-18 hours or on high
6. 4-5 hours , stirring occasionally
7. stir well during last hour
demonstrations.review: Easy to assemble. Only occasionally stir for several hours. Salivate over the wonderful aroma coming out of your kitchen. Curl up on a cold night and enjoy this treasure of a soup.  Pure comfort food. I made as recipe directed and it turned out wonderful. This recipe has been put in the keeper file and is now our staple onion soup. thanks for posting this great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy no fail make anytime turkey gravy

i have been using this recipe for many years, my family loves this gravy and i have served it to dinner guests over the holidays and always receive rave reviews! --- you don't need to make this gravy using all pan drippings, if you do not have 4 cups of drippings you may mix with chicken broth to make the 4 cups, or it may be made with only chicken broth, please see note on the bottom of the recipe--- this may be made slightly ahead and kept uncovered on top of the stove until ready to serve, just whisk before using if you have any left over this gravy freezes very well or you may reduce all ingredients down to half and for a thinner gravy reduce flour by 1 tablespoon  --- also see my recipe#314890
for more of my recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. drain the pan drippings for the roasted turkey through a fine strainer
2. let sit and then remove any fat from the top of the drippings
3. add in chicken broth or water to make 4 cups if necessary
4. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine or butter
5. add in lots of black pepper
6. add in 1 / 2 cup flour plus 3 tablespoons
7. constantly whisk for about 3 minutes over low heat
8. slowly add in the 4 cups turkey broth / drippings
9. whisk constantly over medium-low heat until bubbly and thickened
10. use right away or keep warm over lowest heat setting , whisk again before serving
11. options to make this gravy using all chicken broth prepare as directed using 4 cups low sodium chicken broth and 1 tablespoon chicken boullion powder ---- or you may add in low sodium chicken broth omitting bouillon powder to pan drippings to make up 4 cups
demonstrations.review: Thanks Kittencal you saved the day. This recipe is going to be my staple from now on.  My oldest daughter had done the holiday grocery shopping and had bought by mistake a precooked turkey. I had never had one before so had no idea how much pan drippings I was going to get off it so I printed out your recipe since you gave instructions for chicken broth to be used also.  Well turned out to have enough drippings but used your recipe anyways and it is truely fantastic. Loved it :)

target.recipe_text:
fudge icing

i usually use this on a sheet cake.it really is like having fudge for a topping!

1. combine first 4 ingredients and bring to boil , stirring constantly
2. boil hard 1 minute without stirring
3. remove from heat , add vanilla and beat until spreading consistancy
target.review:
This is a favorite from my childhood, the best frosting ever!
To the one who rated it a 2, you must have boiled it too long. I lick the spoon and bowl when I am done frosting a cake:)  it is that good! Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white castle cheeseburgers

i love white castle. i admit it, but i'd have to drive two hours to get to the nearest white castle, so, i found this recipe in the top secret recipes book. it is very well worth the effort if you love white castles. nothing compares to this taste.

1. separate the beef into 16 1 oz portions
2. on wax paper , form the portions into square , very thin 2
3. 5" patties
4. poke 5 holes in each patties with a circular object such as a straw
5. freeze the patties until firm
6. toast the faces of the dinner rolls , either in a hot frying pan or under the broiler in a hot frying pan or skillet , preheated to medium heat , arrange tablespoon sized piles of onions 3 inches apart
7. salt and pepper each pile
8. spread the onions flat and place a frozen patty on each pile
9. salt each patty
10. cook each patty for 4-6 minutes , steam from the onions should cook each burger without having to flip it
11. turn the bottom half of the bun onto the patty
12. hold it down as you scoop a spatula under the onions , turn the sandwich over onto a plate cut the american cheese into 2" portions and place on the onions and patty
13. replace the top of the roll
14. serve hot
demonstrations.review: I have made these before, only I mix a package of lipton onion soup mix to 2 pounds of hamburger, then press in a cake pan, prick the meat with a fork, bake about 10 minutes, then I cut into little burgers, put cheese on each, and then put the top side of dollar buns on top. Very easy to lift out of pan and place on the bottom half of bun. I love these!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandmother s gingersnaps

recipe passed down from my husband's grandmother

1. in a mixing bowl , cream first 4 ingredients until fluffy
2. sift together the 6 dry ingredients and stir into molasses mixture
3. form dough into small balls
4. roll balls in granulated sugar
5. place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet
6. bake at 375 degrees for 12 minutes
demonstrations.review: Very good. I added a pinch of pepper, for that added snap, and I used butter, they turned out great :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick dinner buns

this dinner buns are nice for dinner on the run! they're so cute!

1. preheat oven to 400f grease a 12-cup muffin pan
2. in a mixing bowl , stir together the flour , baking powder and salt
3. add the milk and mayonnaise
4. stir with a fork until everything is blended and mixture is smooth
5. spoon into well-greased muffin pan , filling the cups about 2 / 3 full
6. bake for 20-25 minutes , until the tops are lightly browned
7. remove from pan , let cool and serve slightly warm
demonstrations.review: Not what I expected, very bland.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nutty soda cracker candy

this makes a wonderful treat to serve at the holidays or to bring as a gift. i use the non-stick foil for this but a piece of buttered parchment paper lined in the pan will work fine also ---  servings is only estimated, really it should be only one serving i could eat the whole thing myself, these are very addicting :)

1. set oven to 400f
2. line a 10 x 15-inch baking sheet with non-stick foil
3. place each cracker in a single layer in the baking sheet
4. in a medium saucepan bring the butter and brown sugar to a boil over medium heat
5. when the mixture comes to a full boil , boil for 3 minutes you may reduce the heat so that the mixture does not boil over the saucepan
6. mix in vanilla then immediately pour the hot mixture over the top of the crackers
7. bake in a 400f oven for 5 minutes
8. sprinkle the chocolate chips over the crackers , then spread using a back of a spoon to smooth out and cover
9. sprinkle the nuts evenly over the top
10. place in the refrigerator for about 3-4 hours or until set
11. break into pieces and store in a covered container in the refrigerator
12. delicious !
demonstrations.review:
Yum. So easy, I even used whole wheat saltines and they are so very good. I sprinkled some coconut on top of the toffee layer, then the chocolate chips. I wish I would have had the milk chocolate chips, but I used semi-sweet ones, still great!
It took only 10 minutes to make, the hardest part was letting them cool ;)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
demonstrations.review: I have used this exact recipe for years now. It was posted in an old cookbook, with the title of "chewy brownies". Absolutely the best home made brownie ever! Even better with a home made chocolate frosting! I find if I use Hershey's Cocoa, they taste better!

target.recipe_text:
red lobster cheddar bay biscuits copycat

these are copycats of the delicious "cheddar bay biscuits" served at red lobster.

1. heat oven to 450 degrees
2. mix bisquick , milk and cheese until a soft dough forms
3. drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet
4. bake 6-8 minutes or until golden brown
5. mix butter or margarine and garlic powder
6. brush mixture over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet
target.review: I agree, very close. I loved them and so did my guests!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot onion potatoes

i've made these in the oven before, and they turned out great! but it's summertime, and i don't like the way the oven heats up the house, so i've found this recipe.

1. combine potatoes and oil in plastic bag or large mixing bowl
2. add remaining ingredients
3. pour into slow cooker
4. cover and cook on low for 6 hours or 3 hours on high
demonstrations.review:
Really delicious. I would cut back on the oil if I made them again. They seemed really greasy.

Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate chocolate chip sour cream banana bread

do not let this banana bread's long name fool you! very easy to make, and wonderful bread is the result.

1. cream the butter , sugar and vanilla together
2. then add the eggs and mix
3. then put in the dry ingredients and mix well
4. add the bananas and sour cream and mix
5. then add in the chocolate chips and pour into 3 greased loaf pans
6. bake at 350 for 1 hour , or until a toothpick that has been inserted into the center comes out clean
demonstrations.review: Utterly scrumptious!!!! I gave one loaf away, froze one and turned the other into muffins. We loved these. Thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
very moist banana nut bread

this is a very easy, "no mixer" bread to make. it is very moist and a little heavy type banana bread. the really important thing to remember is using all black bananas to get my same results. i always use 5 medium sized bananas and this recipe makes 2 loaves. also, i've never used buttermilk, but sour milk instead..a little vinegar added to regular milk. i've used this recipe since 1972 and last year made 32 loaves to give away for christmas! it's truly a wonderful bread. i only bake it until the toothpick comes out almost clean, as we like it really moist. if you over bake it, or wait til the toothpick is completely clean, the bread will be a lot dryer. i realize some like it this way, so thats why i've given this hint. my family and friends would rather have it a little under done than over. it's so good with coffee, butter/jelly or i like mine just plain. i bake it in tin foil pans and it freezes wonderfully. i try to always have one or two in the freezer for company, or a little gift. this recipe came from a ladies club cookbook. the kind where everyone contributes recipes, they are made into a recipe book and sold to make money for charities. all the cooks are just plain "down home" country gals that produce miracles in the kitchen. it's my favorite cookbook and i've almost worn it out and it can't be replaced. i know there are many banana bread recipes here, so thanks for trying this recipe. i hope you enjoy it!

1. heat oven to 350
2. grease or spray 2 loaf pans
3. in a large bowl , mash bananas with a masher or by well washed hands
4. dissolve soda in buttermilk-- use a larger container as it will foam up quite a bit
5. mix all ingredients by hand and add in 1 cup chopped nuts
6. bake at 350 for 1 hour , or until toothpick comes out almost clean
7. totally clean will mean a dryer loaf
8. let cool 15 minutes after removing from oven and remove from pans
9. or , let cool , cover with foil , slide into freezer bags and freeze
10. great when using tin foil pans
demonstrations.review: Very moist and yummy. I left out the nuts and added 1/2 cup of mini chocolate chips instead. All I can say is scrumptious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
snapple iced tea  5 flavors

quick, easy and refreshing!

1. for any of the flavors , boil the water in a large saucepan
2. when the water comes to a rapid boil , turn off the heat , put the tea bags into the water , and cover
3. after the tea has brewed about 1 hour , pour the sugar or sweetener into a 2 quart pitcher , then add the tea
4. the tea should still warm , so the sugar or sweetener will dissolve easily
5. add the flavoring ingredients
6. chill
demonstrations.review: Extra easy and delicious!!! I was blown away by this clone recipe. Thanks for sharing :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rhubarb crunch

nan

1. mix flour , rolled oats , brown sugar , margarine and cinnamon until crumbly: press half of this mixture into a 9" greased pan
2. cover with chopped rhubarb
3. combine sugar , cornstarch , and water
4. cook until thick and clear in a small saucepan
5. remove from heat and add vanilla
6. pour over rhubarb
7. top with remaining crumbs
8. bake at 350f for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Really great taste and crunch. We had this for dessert last night. I served it with a large blob of whipped cream. It was the perfect finishing touch!

target.recipe_text:
eggplant parmigiana   weight watchers

eggplant parmigiana for 3 points a serving! woo-hoo!

1. preheat oven to 350f coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray
2. set aside
3. combine bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , italian seasoning and garlic powder in a medium-size bowl
4. set aside
5. remove skin from eggplant and trim off ends
6. slice eggplant into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
7. dip eggplant first into egg whites and then into bread crumb mixture
8. bake eggplant on a nonstick cookie sheet until lightly browned , about 20 to 25 minutes , flipping once
9. place a layer of eggplant on bottom of prepared baking dish , then add 1 / 3 of tomato sauce and 1 / 3 of mozzarella cheese
10. repeat with 2 more layers in same order
11. bake until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling , about 10 minutes more
12. slice into 4 pieces and serve
target.review: I am giving this recipe 3 stars only because I think it technically worked and was edible but I found it very bland overall. I followed the recipe to the t but I did add the step of sweating the eggplant before breading it. I think this would be better with more added seasonings to the italian bread crumbs and a regular pasta sauce as opposed to the plain tomato sauce. The texture came out nicely so I may try it again with some more seasoning... I think I'd also incorportate zuchini slices to bulk up the recipe a bit.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s low fat baked parmesan fish fillets

a great lower fat alternative to fried fish, use you choice of fish for this --- all spice amounts may be adjust to taste, depending on the size of your fish fillets you may have some breading left over just refrigerate to use for another time.

1. preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. set oven rack to lowest position
3. coat / spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
4. in a shallow bowl whisk egg whites with water
5. in a bowl combine the breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese and next 7 dry spices
6. dip the fish firstly into the egg whites allowing any excess to drip off
7. place a small amount of the crumb mixture onto a plate then coat in the breadcrumb mixture pressing down with hands to firmly pack the coating onto the fish adding more crumbs onto the plate as needed to coat each fillet
8. place the breaded fish onto baking sheet
9. bake in preheated 500 degree f oven for about 10 minutes or until the fish flakes with a fork
demonstrations.review: This is my go-to breaded fish recipe in my book of printouts in my kitchen! So easy to change up the spice blend if you're in the mood for something different, but following the recipe's spice blend is delicious! Thanks for another great one kittencal :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh tomato   mozzarella salad

a friend of mine brought this for dinner and it was so good and fresh... a great summer side!

1. cut up the tomatoes and mozzarella into large cubes
2. add basil leaves and drizzle w / vinegar and olive oil
3. stir lightly
4. sprinkle with a little salt
5. chill at least one hour
6. store in refrigerator
demonstrations.review: This is one of my GO TO easy and delicious summer salads when the tomatoes are perfection. I sometimes add cucumber and/or red onion if I have it around. It's similar to a caprese salad taste but it feels lower maintenance. A must try!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chops that will make you eat til you pop

these have to be, hands down, the best meal i have ever made in a crock pot. i borrowed a friend's crock pot one weekend and made this for my honey. low and behold, i got a crock pot for my next birthday along with a request for this recipe to be the first thing i made. i really wish i know where i got the recipe from because i would love to give credit for it. i beg of you, do yourself a favor and try this. you will not regret it. let me know what you think!!

1. salt and pepper pork chops if desired
2. add all ingredients except water and cornstarch to the crock pot
3. cook on low for 5 1 / 2 hours
4. mix cornstarch and water together and stir into crock pot
5. cook 30 minutes more
6. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: This is a go-to recipe in my cook book... but not for pork chops! It has all the makings of a perfect recipe for delicious moose or venison steaks, cuts the gamey taste and makes them oh so tender! I have also used this recipe for pork chops and they turn out delicious! One change I always make is diced tomatoes instead of stewed... I have used BBQ sauce instead of the ketchup once or twice...and I have added extra veggies if I had them kicking around.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s spinach parmesan rice bake

this is a wonderful easy side dish to chicken or meat and any leftovers freeze wonderful,  it may also be baked in a 10-inch deep-dish pie plate and cut into wedges, this may be doubled but i would still only use one package or spinach or maybe 1-1/2 packages adding in too much spinach will overpower all other ingredients,  prep time does not include cooking the rice --- for freezing prepare recipe as directed but do not bake, wrap pan in plastic wrap then tightly in foil and freeze, to serve thaw over night in refrigerator, remove wrapping bake at 350°f for 25-30 minutes or until hot.

1. set oven to 350f
2. generously grease a 11 x 7-inch baking dish
3. in a large bowl , combine all ingredients with a wooden spoon , mixing very well to combine
4. season with salt , pepper and cayenne to taste
5. transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. bake uncovered or covered for 25 minutes or until set
7. top with mozzarella cheese the last 5 minutes of baking
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe to use up some frozen spinach I had in the freezer! I followed the recipe exactly- it was simple to make despite the long ingredient list, nutritious and tasted great. A definite keeper for a sidedish, especially if you're feeding a group of people. (My bf and I were eating it for days!)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
salmon and asparagus in foil

this is a quick and easy dinner.  pop the packets into the oven while you set the table and in 15-minutes you have a nutritious dish with virtually no clean up.  serve this with a rice or couscous dish and extra lemon on the side.  this recipe was found at another web site.

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. snap the ends off asparagus spears and divide into 4 equal portions
3. spray the center of each foil sheet with non-stick cooking spray
4. place one salmon fillet in the center of each sheet , top with a serving of the asparagus and drizzle with lemon juice
5. sprinkle with fresh ground pepper and salt or seasoning blend as desired
6. bring up the sides of foil and fold top over twice
7. seal ends , leaving room for air to circulate inside the packet
8. place packets on a cookie sheet and cook in oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until salmon is opaque
9. serve with lemon wedges on the side
10. please use caution when opening the foil packs , as the steam is very hot
demonstrations.review: This recipe changed the way I think about cooking fish. It also got me and the bf eating asparagus! I make this at least every other week. It's great exactly as written or you can experiment with different spices/sauces. One of my favorite variations is soya sauce and maple syrup with garlic. I've also used brocolli and/or yellow zuchini when I didn't have asparagus on hand. I usually use the affordable frozen portions of salmon and it always turns out great, you can it even cook it from frozen for a few minutes longer and it turns out the same! Thanks for a keeper!

target.recipe_text:
excellent pulled pork

okay so here it is and it is fabulous,.  i know it's long and it's not a fast meal, but i promise it's well worth the trouble.  i can't tell you how important it is to me that people like what i cook, and this has gotten the best reaction to date.  i hope you agree--please let me know :d

1. mix dry rub ingredients
2. rub all over pork
3. cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight
4. preheat oven to 300f
5. place pork in a roasting pan and roast for 6 hours or until it falls apart
6. while pork is roasting , make bbq sauce: simmer for 10 minutes and remove from heat til ready to use
7. when pork is done , take it out of the oven and place on a platter and let it rest for 10 minutes
8. while it's resting , de-glaze the pan over medium heat with 3 / 4 cup water , scraping up all the good stuff from the pan
9. reduce by half and combine to bbq sauce
10. pull pork apart with forks and then put in a large pot or bowl and add bbq sauce
11. mix well and serve
12. if you like coleslaw , put it on the roll and top with bbq pork
target.review: Hey, I finally got around to making this, it was really good and simple! It was a little more tangy than I like for pulled pork, so I added a little bit of worcestershire sauce for some smokey flavor. I will make this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s parmesan garlic bread or garlic toast

for a nice change substitute finely shredded white cheddar cheese for the parmesan cheese and fresh chopped chives for the parsley and also you could add in 1/4 cup mayo in with the butter mixture :)

1. set oven to 375f
2. for garlic bread
3. cut slices down the length of the bread about 1-inch intervals without cutting all the way through
4. in a bowl , combine the softened butter with garlic , parsley and parmesan cheese
5. mix well to combine
6. spread the butter / garlic mixture between bread slices , and then on the top of the loaf
7. wrap the bread in heavy-duty foil leaving the top partially uncovered
8. bake until heated through
9. for garlic toast
10. slice the bread into slices , then spread the garlic butter mixture over the top of each slice of bread , then sprinkle more parmesan cheese over the top of each slice or you can sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese on top in place of the parmesan
11. place onto a baking sheet and bake until lightly toasted to desired doneness
12. serve warm
13. to make ahead: combine all ingredients store covered in refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze in a covered container ----- this bread can be made without the addition of the parmesan cheese if desired , but of course it's better with the cheese !
demonstrations.review: Incredible. I really dont have much more to say than that. I made this with my goulash (which everyone raves about, its a favorite of everyone I cook for), and this bread stole the show. I've never gotten so many complements on something so simple and easy to make. So thank you, your recipe is perfect!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandma s soft sugar cookies

not sweet. great with coffee or tea. more like biscuits and not chewy-crunchy!

1. beat together eggs , oil , vanilla and sugar
2. add flour , baking powder and salt and mix well
3. drop by heaping teaspoon approx 3" apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
4. flatten with bottom of glass moistened with water and dipped in sugar
5. bake at 400f for 6-10 minutes or just until lightly golden
demonstrations.review: I've never made cookies before and didn't have vegetable oil so I substituted pure olive oil, the cookies still came out great, but I think using the wrong oil dried them out a little bit. Still very good and easy to make, will make them again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
louisiana sausage jambalaya

oh boy, is this one good! it's a simple, but very authentic louisiana jambalaya recipe given to me by a friend who grew up in new orleans! nice and spicy!

1. melt butter in large pot over medium-high heat
2. add the onions , green onions , bell pepper , garlic , serrano chile , bay leaves , creole seasoning , cayenne pepper and thyme
3. cover and cook until vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
4. add sausage , broth , tomatoes and rice
5. bring mixture to simmer
6. reduce heat to low , cover and cook until rice is very tender , stirring occasionally , about 30 minutes to 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was wonderful! I changed it up a little bit and used spicy italian sausage and some leftover chicken breasts for the meat. I also used fresh red chili peppers instead of serranos. It came out great though, this will definitely be made again, thank you!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken san remo

this is an incredibly, delicious chicken dish. i have make it twice, once using regular fresh spinach and once with the fresh baby spinach and i highly recommend using the baby. you're gonna love this!!!!

1. chicken: heat oil in skillet
2. mix flour , salt& pepper
3. light beat egg& water
4. dredge each chicken piece in flour , then dip each side of chicken in egg wash
5. place in pan in single layer& saute to a golden brown , turning once
6. about 2 min
7. per side
8. transfer to a baking pan just large enough to hold the chicken in a single layer
9. tent with foil to keep warm
10. preheat broiler sauce: wipe out the skillet& add oil over med heat add shallots& spinach
11. saute until spinach is completely wilted
12. stir in chick broth , wine and cream
13. bring to boil& cook 12 minutes until reduced by half season with cayenne& salt remove foil& spoon sauce over chick breasts
14. divide the mozzarella over the tops of each piece of chick
15. broil chicken 4 to 5 inches from the heat 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese bubbles& is light golden brown
demonstrations.review:
Nice for something different. I really like the chicken itself, but the sauce seemed to fall a little flat for my tastes. Everyone I have made this for though has loved it.

I recommend doubling the sauce (not the spinach though) and cooking it up with linguine and adding some garlic to the recipe for some extra flavor.

I can't stress enough making sure you let the sauce cook down to a thicker consistancy, the thicker the sauce, the better.

Overall it was a very savory dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tomato cucumber salad

easy to make, healthy, and rather tasty

1. sprinkle salt over cucumber
2. toss gently and let stand 30 minutes
3. drain cucumber slices and press dry between paper towels
4. combine cucumber , green pepper , onions& tomatoes
5. combine vinegar and next 6 ingredients in a jar
6. shake vigorously
7. drizzle over vegetables
8. toss gently
demonstrations.review:
I made this last night and really got into it. I'm not a big salad person but I love tomatos, onions and cucumbers so this hit the spot. 

I left out the green pepper and used grape tomatoes cut in half instead, but I think what really brings this dish together is the dressing. It fringes on the acidic side, but the cucumbers I think really contrast the dressing and just taste fantasic.

It's definitely a keeper and I plan on using the dressing on my bruschetta. Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
crispy tilapia

crispy! serve with tartar sauce. you can cut into small pieces before breading so the kids can eat like nuggets. you can also deep fry! stays crispy for packing in a lunch or picnic!
 a major importance in artisanal fishing in africa and the levant, and are of increasing importance in aquaculture around the world.

1. salt and pepper fish
2. dust fillets with 1 / 3 cup of flour
3. mix egg with buttermilk in one bowl
4. mix flour , corn meal , baking soda and baking powder , old bay in another bowl
5. dip all floured fish into egg then flour mixture
6. heat oil medium-high in large pan
7. fry , turning after 2 minutes on each side
8. salt as soon as you take out of pan
9. should be done in three batches
target.review: excellent! I used more oil than the recipe, in a cast iron pan. 3 minutes per side. The Old Bay is the secret!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttermilk pancakes

this is our favorite pancake recipe. i got it from williams-sonoma site. try it.. it's great.

1. in a bowl , using an electric mixer , beat the eggs on medium speed until frothy
2. add the buttermilk , melted butter and vanilla and mix well
3. add the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt , and beat on medium speed just until blended
4. you can also mix this together using a wooden spoon or whatever you have
5. heat lightly greased griddle at 350 degrees
6. pour about 1 / 3 cup of the batter onto griddle for each pancake
7. cook until the tops of the pancakes are covered with tiny bubbles and the batter is set , about 4-6 minutes
8. flip pancakes and cook until the undersides are golden brown , about 4 minutes more
9. repeat with remaining batter
demonstrations.review: Now THIS---is a pancake recipe! Absolutely fantastic! I followed it to the letter. The secret ingredient might be the vanilla extract. I have tossed out all other pancake recipes. Next time I'll throw in some blueberries! MMM!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pan seared cod with basil sauce

this has a fresh pesto-like feel without the nuts, and a lot less fat. any flaky white fish can be used here - i usually have tilapia or whitefish around rather than cod. i had an open bottle of reisling and so i used that in place of the broth.  from cooking light.

1. combine basil , broth , cheese , oil , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and garlic in a small bowl
2. sprinkle fish with 1 / 2 tsp salt and pepper
3. coat a large nonstick pan with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat
4. saute fish for 5 minutes on each side or until it flakes easily with a fork
5. spoon basil sauce over fish to serve
demonstrations.review: a great recipe! My only problem was with cooking time. 3 minutes a side is more than enough, I had 1" thick cod filets. I seasoned with salt, pepper, and a wee bit of Old bay seasoning. I used basil from my garden, maybe a little too strong so  cheated and used basil pesto sauce. PerfectI highly recommend  checking temperature of filets with a device: my favorite is a "Thermopen". stop cooking at 135 degrees. Also, don't put filets in pan until it is hot. enjoy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kelly s crock pot  smoked  beef roast or brisket

this is awesome!  if you love brisket or beef cooked in the smoker and just don't have time to, or maybe the weather won't permit- you have to try this.  i have used every cut of beef roast or brisket, it always comes out great!  enjoy!

1. trim beef of any large extra fat
2. a little is good for flavor
3. place the roast in the middle of a large piece of aluminum foil
4. rub beef all over with all of the spices
5. sprinkle liquid smoke over beef and rap tightly in foil
6. make sure it's completely wrapped
7. do not add any liquid to the crockpot !
8. place in crock pot and cook on low setting for 8-10 hrs
9. unwrap beef and serve with the "smoker" juices in the crock pot or with your favorite barbecue sauce
demonstrations.review: MMMM good! followed directions to the T, except used a nice cut of boneless chuck. and the gravy! outstanding! I like the method as well as the recipe. Will try with wine!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
inside out stuffed green bell peppers

this is a lot easier to make than the regular stuffed green peppers. my husband just loves it this way.

1. in a skillet , brown beef
2. drain
3. transfer to a greased 2-quart casserole dish
4. add the next 8 ingredients
5. cover and bake at 350f for 1 hour or until rice is tender
6. uncover and sprinkle with the cheese
7. return to the oven until cheese melts , about 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: Pretty bland. I perked it up with 3 garlic minced garlic cloves a stalk of chopped celery, 2 tsp of Italian seasonings, a pinch of red pepper flakes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stuffed baked trout

a delicious and savory stuffing to enhance the wonderful flavor of fresh trout. serve with a nice side of fresh green beans and warm soda bread, makes a wonderful meal.

1. cook and stir onions and pepper in butter until tender
2. removed from heat and add gread crumbs , parsley , lemon juice and basil
3. rub cavities of trout with salt then stuff each with approx 1 / 4 cup of stuffing
4. place fish in baking dish
5. cook uncovered in 350 degree oven until fish flakes easily
6. approximately 30 - 35 minutes
7. garnish with cherry tomatoes and parsley if desired
demonstrations.review: I had three trout, about 10 to 12 inchers in the freezer I caught some time ago in Iowa, so I thought I better cook up or toss. I must say the stuffing was very good! Didn't change a thing! Bigger fish may have been better, small guys are best suited to pan frying, but this is a "keeper"!

target.recipe_text:
basic machine french bread

this is my winner with tammiev and our friends. this recipe is for a 2 pound loaf and has never failed me. i think it is the lack of oil and sugar that they like in this one.

1. add to the bread pan in the order yours needs
2. for mine it is water first
3. then i add half the flour and the salt followed by the rest of the flour and the yeast on top
4. this will run well on the normal , rapid , and delay start cycles
target.review: Beautiful!! We enjoyed this with a pasta dinner tonight. I followed Ms. Diggy's suggestions and am thrilled with the result. Easy and fabulous..what more can you ask for?! I am so glad that I took my machine out of storage and am finally able to use it. :) Update: I had been using A/P flour but switched to bread flour. Fantastic!! I have some in the machine on the dough cycle right now. TY TY TY!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lu s rum or bourbon balls

these are great make ahead rum balls. quick and easy to make and taste better after they've aged a bit so making them ahead of time is a good idea. i make them a few weeks before christmas and add them to my cookie plates.

1. sift cocoa and sugar together
2. add the rest of the ingredients and mix well , using enough karo to make it workable
3. shape into balls an inch or so in diameter
4. roll in powedered sugar
5. store in a tin with wax paper between layers
demonstrations.review: I lost the rum ball recipe that I had gotten from an ex co-worker of my husbands so I tried this one. It is wonderful!  I made a batch to bring to my son's but I ended up eating too many and had to make more! Thank you so much for posting this recipe. It is a real keeper. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade hamburger buns  bread machine

you will never want to buy hamburger buns again after trying this recipe. easy to do using a bread machine and so awesome! you can also top rolls with sesame seeds after brushing with melted butter.

1. place all ingredients , except butter , in pan of bread machine according to manufacturer's directions
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is complete , turn out onto floured surface
4. cut dough in half and roll each half out to a 1" thick circle
5. cut each half into six 3 1 / 2" rounds with inverted glass as a cutter
6. place on greased baking sheet far apart and brush with melted butter
7. cover and let rise until doubled , about one hour
8. bake at 350 for 9 minutes
9. some reviewers baked these anywhere from 12 to 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: These turned out great!! No more store bought for us. Thanks so much for posting. :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
black beans and rice

this spicy recipe tastes so good, it's hard to believe it's healthy. it's convenient as a one-pot meal, but a cooling side dish such as fresh sliced mango or a cucumber salad would be good too. i use red pepper flakes because i don't like the acidity of fresh; instructions are included for fresh red pepper if you prefer. you can also replace the chicken broth with vegetable broth for a vegetarian meal.

1. heat oil in a stockpot over medium-high heat
2. saute onion and garlic until onion softens , about 4 minutes
3. add rice and saute for 2 minutes
4. add broth and tomatoes
5. bring to a boil , cover and lower the heat
6. cook for 40 minutes until rice is done , stirring occasionally
7. add beans , spices , and fresh cilantro
8. to replace the red pepper flakes with fresh: saute a chopped red pepper with the onion and add a 1 / 2 teaspoon cayenne pepper with the beans
demonstrations.review: This is a wonderful recipe that we will definitely make on a regular basis. Thanks for posting..we really enjoyed it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rice   vegetables

this recipe is yummy for rice lovers! hubby and i eat all the time, we got the recipe from my husbands grandmother.

1. cook 3 cups of instant rice as directed leave covered on stove
2. cook 1 pound ground beef thouroughly and drain
3. chop celery and onions and saute' in skillet with butter until cooked to your liking
4. combine all ingredients and add soy sauce to your liking and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this tonight since I was short on time and energy, I almost didn't because DH said that he wasn't really hungry but would have a "bite" of whatever I made.
