He had two full bowls!  Thist is a tasty, easy, no-fuss satisfying meal. Thanks for posting...I will be making it again! Also we used vegetarian crumbles since we do not eat meat. I added a little olive oil to my saute pan in addition to the butter and it worked out great. Veggie crumbles are not "fatty" like regular ground beef can be so the little bit of extra oil made up for it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegetarian pasta e fagioli  pasta and beans

this is one of my many variations of the old italian standby. please feel free to adjust the types and/or amount of the dried herbs to suit your taste

1. in a large heavy pot , heat olive oil over medium high heat
2. stir in onion with a pinch of salt and pepper , and cook for 2 minutes
3. add dried herbs and red pepper flakes into the oil and toss to coat to bring out some of the dried herbs' flavors
4. stir in garlic , and then celery , and carrots and cook for about 3 minutes
5. stir in tomatoes and stock and bring to a boil
6. reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes
7. if necessary add an additional cup of stock or water and stir in beans and tiny pasta
8. simmer for 6-8 minutes or until pasta is tender
9. stir in parsley and serve hot with grated parmesan and freshly ground black pepper
demonstrations.review: This was really really good! I did not post a review the first time I made it because I used too much rosemary and needed to do it right. Well I made it again tonight and we just loved it. I did add more broth at the end and it was perfect. Thanks! Update: I found that making this earlier in the day and then re-heatng really helps the flavors blend. I make soime extra broth to add if needed. Fabulous! I served this with red pepper flakes, freshly grated cheese on top along with rickv's Basic machine french bread #4651

target.recipe_text:
spicy sweet chicken thighs

barbecue-type sauce is what makes this one special. one serving is 2 chicken thighs. prep time does not include 1 hour to marinade.

1. combine first five ingredients in a plastic zip-locked bag
2. marinate for 1 hour , turning occasionally
3. preheat oven to 425
4. remove chicken from bag and reserve marinade
5. arrange chicken in a shallow baking dish coated with cooking spray
6. pour reserved marinade over chicken
7. sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. bake at 425 for 20 minutes , baste chicken with marinade
9. bake an additional 20 minutes or until chicken is done
10. serve with lemon wedges
target.review: Great marinade.The chicken thighs were very moist and tender. I think I might even try this marinade with pork chops. Thanks Michele for this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
surprise chicken

when you bite into these succulent chicken breasts, you will get a surprise of flavors!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. split chicken breasts to make four half breasts
3. place between some plastic wrap& pound to flatten
4. layer prosciutto , jack cheese& sun dried tomatoes , if used , on chicken breasts
5. add one or two parsley sprigs
6. roll up
7. secure with toothpicks
8. mix together bread crumbs , minced parsley , garlic , cayenne pepper& parmesan cheese
9. dip chicken breasts in melted butter , then coat with bread crumb mixture
10. place chicken breasts in baking dish
11. sprinkle with leftover bread crumbs
12. bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until cooked through
demonstrations.review: Excellent dish. I think this would be a great dish to serve to company. You can prepare it ahead of time and put it in the oven when company arrives. The only change I made is that I used Asiago cheese instead if Monteray Jack. I'm a big fan of Asiago. Thanks for a great recipe Jodi.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken curry in a hurry

watch out or you might get pulled over for a speeding ticket in the kitchen! ready in 20 minutes. :)

1. mix together flour , salt and cayenne pepper in a plastic bag
2. add chicken in small batches , shaking to coat
3. heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. add chicken and cook until lightly browned
5. then add curry powder and toss to coat
6. remove from pan
7. add onion and garlic to pan , adding a little more oil if necessary , and cook for 2 minutes , then add broth , raisins , and tomato paste
8. return chicken to pan and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened
9. garnish with cilantro and a dollop of yogurt
10. serve with quick cooking minute rice , if desired
demonstrations.review: Absolutely delicious. I was hesitant on making it due to my non-curry loving husband but followed the recipe exactly except for using 1/2 the amount of curry and it turned out beautifully. It was thoroughly enjoyed by all. This is definately a keeper and I will be sure to make this again soon. Thanks Sue.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
double decker fudge

i make this just about every christmas and we all love it. don't wait for a special occasion, however, it can be enjoyed anytime. use butterscotch chips instead of peanut butter if you like.

1. measure peanut butter chips into one bowl and choc chips into another
2. set aside
3. butter 8" square pan and set aside
4. combine sugar , marshmallow creme and evap milk and butter in heavy 3-qt saucepan
5. cook over med
6. heat , stirring constantly until mixture boils
7. continue cooking and stirring for 5 minutes
8. remove from heat
9. stir in vanilla
10. immediately stir 1 / 2 the hot mixture into peanut chips until completely melted
11. quickly pour into prepared pan
12. stir remaining hot mixture into chocolate chips until completely melted
13. quickly spread over top of peanut butter layer
14. cool until set
15. cut into 1" squares
16. store in an air-tight container in a cool dry place
demonstrations.review: A very good fudge recipe. My family really enjoyed it. A nice change from my usual chocolate fudge.Thanks for a great recipe Bert.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
healthy carrot cake

this is a really good lower-fat version of carrot cake. it is from a book called dr. cookie, which includes healthier versions of popular desserts.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. coat a 9x13 pan with spray and dust lightly with flour
3. tap out the excess flour
4. whisk the flours with the baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
5. set aside
6. beat the egg , egg whites , brown sugar and oil with an electric mixer until smooth
7. add the carrots and beat for 1 minute
8. add the buttermilk , pineapple and raisins and beat again
9. add the flour mixture and beat until well mixed
10. scrape the batter into the pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. cool the cake in the pan set on a wire rack
12. frost , if desired , when completely cool
13. store the cake in the pan in the refrigerator
14. to make the frosting , beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla with an elecric mixer set at medium-high speed until smooth
15. reduce the speed to medium-low and add the milk , a tsp
16. at a time until the frosting is at spreading consistency
17. spread the frosting on the cooled , uncut cake
demonstrations.review: I was on the mission to find a good low fat carrot cake recipe and this fit the bill. I was always turned off by the amount of oil in a regular carrot cake recipe. This was light and moist and everybody enjoyed it. Thanks Chris for a great recipe. I will be making this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
citrus ambrosia cake

a friend gave this to me years ago. it's a stand-by that everyone loves. it's easy, too.

1. beat together cake , margarine , eggs , and mandarin oranges on medium speed
2. use three pans and bake at 350 for 25-30 until toothpick comes out clean
3. let cool well
4. for the topping , combine vanilla instant pudding , pineapple , and cool whip
5. beat until well mixed
6. frost each layer and refridgerate until set
demonstrations.review: A delicious cake. I served it to company and everybody  loved it.Very easy to make also. Thanks Pat for a great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
aztec guacamole

i recently visited my brother and sister-in-law.  she is a fabulous cook who learned from her mother growing up in mexico city.  she doesn't cook from recipes, but from memory and experience of how she was taught.  we had a fabulous meal of beef tacos with this guacamole.  i watched so i could make it at home. it's different than most because of the tomatillos, and it's wonderful with the beef. i posted the beef taco recipe separately.

1. rmove the husks from the tomatillos , wash them well , and roughly chop them
2. put the tomatillos , onion , garlic , and pepper in a food processor or blender
3. process for about eight seconds
4. add the avocado chunks , cilantro , salt , and lime juice to the food processor bowl
5. process an additional ten seconds
6. the texture is supposed to be somewhat chunky - not a puree
7. taste to adjust seasoning
8. you may need to add more serrano pepper
9. the tomatillos and lime will keep the guacamole fresh and it won't turn brown
target.review: A very excellent guacamole recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon and tater tots crock pot breakfast

adapted from linda larsen. if you want breakfast done more quickly, you can also bake this in the oven (read reviews for more specifics).

1. in 4-5 quart crock pot , layer ingredients in order: one third of the tater tots , bacon , onions , green peppers , and cheeses
2. repeat layers two more times , ending with cheeses
3. in a medium mixing bowl , combine eggs , milk , and flour and beat with whisk or egg beater until combined
4. season with salt and pepper to taste
5. pour mixture over layers in crock pot
6. cover crock pot and cook on low
7. the cooking time may take anywhere from four hours to overnight , depending on your crock pot
demonstrations.review: I made this for a breakfast potluck at work and it was AWESOME!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cream of asparagus soup

this soup is wonderful served hot or cold. half & half or milk may be substituted for the cream if fat content is a concern, although it won't taste quite as good.

1. soak and rinse asparagus
2. remove top 1 inch of each spear , discard tough lower part , and reserve middle portion of stalks
3. in a 3-quart saucepan , over medium heat , saut onion in butter for 3 to 5 minutes or until translucent
4. add chicken stock , asparagus
5. cover and bring to a boil
6. reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are soft
7. remove from heat and let cool
8. remove asparagus
9. place half of the soup at a time in a blender container
10. cover and blend at high speed for 20 to 30 seconds or until very smooth
11. pass through a fine sieve and return blended soup to saucepan
12. add reserved asparagus
13. be sure to adjust the seasoning after you add the cream , especially if you plan to serve it cold
demonstrations.review: I never thought I could be addicted to asparagus - YUM!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy chicken and stove top stuffing casserole

this recipe is the ultimate comfort food when paired with buttery mashed potatoes, corn or green beans, and hot rolls. wash it all down with a tall icy cold glass of milk!

1. oven@ 350
2. cook chicken and cut into bite sized pieces
3. place into a casserole dish
4. prepare stove top according to directions
5. heat both cans of soup with the milk in a saucepan until hot
6. pour over chicken
7. spoon stuffing over top of chicken and soup
8. bake for 30-45 minutes or until bubbly
demonstrations.review: I don't know what went wrong here, but the stuffing came out hard and didn't cover the entire surface. Overall I thought it was kind of blah, but my kids liked it. Super easy recipe though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crispy green bean fries tgi friday s  by todd wilbur

recipe from www.topsecretrecipes.com green beans, coated with yummy breadcrumbs, fried till golden brown and served with creamy wasabi dipping sauce, hungry yet?

1. combine dip ingredients in blender
2. blend until smooth
3. place in bowl
4. cover and chill till ready to use
5. dip will thicken as it chills
6. place beans in the broth
7. bring to a boil and cook 15 minutes , then place in cold water to stop cooking process
8. mix beaten egg with milk in a shallow bowl
9. measure 1 cup of flour into another shallow bowl
10. combine bread crumbs , 3 / 4 teaspoons salt , black pepper , onion powder and garlic powder into a third bowl
11. take a handful of beans out of the water and shake off excess liquid
12. coat the beans with the flour , shaking to remove excess flour
13. dip the beans , one at a time , into egg / milk mixture , then dip in breadcrumb mixture
14. place the beans on a plate until all are coated
15. heat the shortening or oil to 350f in a heavy skillet
16. use enough to cover the beans , about 1 1 / 2 inches
17. fry until golden brown , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
18. drain on paper towels
19. to serve , place on a large platter and serve with the wasabi cucumber ranch dip
20. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I didn't have any cucumber for the sauce, and I used double the wasabi powder & more cayenne and horseradish to give it more oomph, and also added a drop of green food coloring! I also didn't have enough breadcrumbs so I used some saltine crackers and it was amazing!  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s chicken crescent roll casserole

this will also work great with turkey; if you do not have chicken breasts, then use any leftover cooked chicken. if desired you can fill the crescents just with the filling mixture and omit the soup, just brush with butter before baking. they are wonderful just stuffed with the filling! a few members have experienced a soggy bottom, so you might want to consider just drizzling half (or even a little less) of the soup mixture on top and a little around the sides of the crescents, then save the rest of the soup mixture for another time (this will help prevent a soggy bottom). you may use the jumbo crescent rolls and stuff with more chicken mixture :)

1. set oven to 350f
2. butter a casserole dish
3. in a saucepan , mix half and half cream , 3 / 4 cup grated cheese and undiluted chicken soup
4. heat just until the cheese melts
5. for the filling --- in a bowl , mix the soft cream cheese with butter until very smooth , then add in garlic powder
6. add in the chopped chicken , onion and cheddar cheese
7. mix well until combined
8. add in 2 tablespoons whipping cream or mayonnaise
9. mix to combine
10. season with seasoned salt or white and black pepper to taste
11. unroll the crescent rolls
12. place 1 heaping tablespoon chicken mixture on top of each crescent triangle , then roll up starting at the thicker end
13. drizzle a small amount of soup mixture on the bottom of the dish
14. then place the crescent rolls seam-side down on top of the creamed mixture in the casserole
15. drizzle the remaining sauce on top and sprinkle with 1 cup grated cheese , or amount desired
16. bake for about 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: SO fattening, but SO VERY delicious! I served this for supper tonight with a side of green beans and it was wonderful. Next time I think I will wait until later in the baking to put the cheese on top; cheese started browning when crescents were still doughy & I had to cover with foil. DELICIOUS!!!

target.recipe_text:
mama s supper club tilapia parmesan

you asked for it. here it is. thanks so much to mama's supper club. wish we could all go there.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in buttered 13-by-9-inch baking dish or jellyroll pan , lay fillets in single layer
3. do not stack fillets
4. brush top with juice
5. in bowl combine cheese , butter , mayonnaise , onions and seasonings
6. mix well with fork
7. bake fish in preheated oven 10 to 20 minutes or until fish just starts to flake
8. spread with cheese mixture and bake until golden brown , about 5 minutes
9. baking time will depend on the thickness of the fish you use
10. watch fish closely so that it does not overcook
11. makes 4 servings
12. broil 3 to 4 minutes or until almost done
13. add cheese and broil another 2 to 3 minutes or until browned
14. thank you mama's supper club in wisconsin
target.review: SO good! Thanks for sharing this recipe. We loved the flavors and how easy it was to put together!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
braised red cabbage with red onion and apples

posted in response to a request, taken from the new canadian basics cookbook. the cookbook states this is a wonderful side dish to serve with pork, poultry and sausages, and i'd have to agree.

1. in a large heavy saucepan , over medium heat , heat the oil then add onion and cook for 5 minutes or until softened
2. stir in cabbage , garlic and apples
3. cook , stirring frequently , for 5 minutes or until cabbage begins to wilt
4. stir in stock , vinegar , sugar and bay leaf
5. reduce heat , cover , and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 45 minutes or until cabbage is soft and liquid has evaporated
6. remove bay leaf and season with salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: Not normally my favorite dish (just not a big red cabbage fan), but I still enjoyed it. My other half ate it up and asked for seconds.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
subway s chipotle southwest sauce

the chipotle in the recipe can be adjusted according to taste.

1. combine mayonnaise , mustard , lime juice , chipotle and garlic
2. add salt to taste
3. cover and chill before sandwich preparation , or before using as a salad dressing
demonstrations.review: This is right on the money! Easy to make and delicious on any deli sandwich!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
snickerdoodle blondies

i've seen this recipe on several food blogs and was obsessed with them.   being a big fan of snickerdoodle cookies, i knew the moment i saw these i had to give them a whirl. what impressed me most about this recipe was that it was super basic, no need to run out and buy anything special, just raid your fridge and pantry and bake away! these are super easy to make and will have your house smelling heavenly in 10 minutes. these bars go great with a cup of piping hot coffee! now get obsessed with these bars and get to baking!  my hats off to julia of dozen flours who i adapted this from and tweaked to create this new favorite of my family and friends :) now everyone asks me for the recipe! i have not seen a recipe on zaar like this, so i am posting it here to share!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. lightly grease and / or line a 913 inch pan
3. combine the flour , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt and set aside
4. in large bowl , beat together butter and brown sugar for 3-5 minutes
5. add in the eggs one at a time , then the vanilla , and beat until smooth
6. stir in the flour mixture until well blended
7. spread evenly in prepared pan
8. combine the granulated sugar and cinnamon , in a little bowl
9. evenly sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture over the top of the batter
10. bake 25-30 minutes or until surface springs back when gently pressed
11. cool before cutting
12. makes 20-24 bars
demonstrations.review: So yummy and easy to make. If you like snickerdoodle cookies try this now... it's so good and bigger bites.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ginger me up chicken  low fat honey   ginger chicken breasts

this is a recipe i have been making for yonks now.....i first devised it about 18 years ago, when i was following rosemary connely's "hip & thigh diet"!! it's a very easy low fat chicken dish, which can be pan fried or baked in the oven - i prefer the latter method, it's much easier! serve it with a medley of gently steamed vegetables, rice or pasta. (nb: please note, one of the reviewers has stated that she cooked this in a crockpot!! i would never suggest cooking this recipe in a crockpot, that's why it is not mentioned as a cooking method anywhere in the recipe - only pan-fried or oven baked. thanks! )

1. preheat the oven to 180c or 350f
2. select a sturdy oven dish - preferably non-stick
3. place the chicken breasts into the baking dish
4. mix the honey , mustard , water , ginger & crushed garlic together in a measuring jug
5. pour over the chicken breasts , easing them up slightly so the mixture runs underneath them
6. season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste and bake in the oven for 45 to 60 minutes
7. serve one chicken breast per person with some of the cooking sauce drizzled over the top of the chicken
8. garnish with chopped parsley & serve with a medley of steamed vegetables & pasta
9. to pan fry , heat up a frying pan and add the chicken breasts - dry fry them briefly to give them a bit of colour and add the cooking sauce , mix well and cook for about 20- 30 minutes over a medium heat
10. serve as before
demonstrations.review: I was afraid I would not like this at first, but wanted to use up some ginger root and try something new. The smell of it cooking was so lovely and the taste even better. My fiance and I now call this one of our favorites. Thanks so much for sharing... this recipe rocks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flawless sesame chicken  restaurant style

this is the recipe you've been looking for!  it makes a perfect sesame chicken.  this excellent recipe comes out perfect every time with little fuss and inexpensive ingredients you probably have on hand.  this recipe is truly restaurant quality... try it, you won't be disappointed! (recipe courtesy of "reykjaviky" at all recipes)

1. cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes
2. mix the marinade ingredients and marinate the chicken for 20 minutes
3. to prepare the sauce:
4. mix together all of the sauce ingredients
5. pour them into a small pot and bring to a boil , stirring continuously
6. turn the heat down to low and keep warm while you are deep-frying the chicken
7. to deep-fry the chicken:
8. add the marinated chicken pieces a few at a time , and deep-fry until golden brown
9. drain on paper towels and then place chicken in warm oven while you continue frying
10. repeat with the remainder of the chicken
11. just before you are finished deep-frying , bring the sauce back up to a boil
12. place the chicken on a large platter and pour the sauce over
13. sprinkle with sesame seeds
14. serve the sesame chicken with rice
demonstrations.review: I made the recipe as is. While the overall flavor was ok... it's not something I'll make again. Maybe we are spoiled with the best Chinese takeout ever, but something was missing here. Can't really put my finger on it.

target.recipe_text:
white fish in herbed butter

frequently requested, easy to make.

1. mix all but fish in small bowl
2. heat skillet
3. add butter mixture
4. add fish and saute for about 6-7 minutes on each side
5. garnish with lemon wedges
target.review: My fish-loving husband and sons thought this was too bland.  I followed the recipe exactly, and used cod.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
okra and tomatoes

this is the best thing my mother in law makes and i can't wait for the okra to grow in the summer so i can pair garden fresh okra with garden sweet tomatoes! yum! a texas 1015 onion is best here but any sweet onion will do. if you can't get your hands on a sweet onion, try adding just a pinch- large pinch of granulated sugar to the dish. i love to douse this with black pepper but please salt and pepper to taste. cooked this way you will not have the slime issue! enjoy!

1. place all ingredients in a dutch oven and cook over over medium heat until onion and okra is just crisp tender or done to your liking
2. taste and add salt and pepper as desired
3. the salt seems to add to the slime
4. also , stir only as much as you need the more you stir the slimier it can get
5. serve with hot sauce if desired
6. oamc
7. simply reheat when needed
demonstrations.review: This was delish.  I served it with Jambalaya (#42412) and cornbread for a delicious meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked pasta with asparagus  pasta al forno con asparagi

i love fresh asparagus recipes.  got this one out of 100 pasta sauce recipes.  serve with some crusty bread and a salad and you have a great dinner. it turns out great!


1. wash asparagus
2. remove any tough stalks and cut into short lengths
3. you may want to split the length in half
4. melt about 3 tbs of butter in pan and cook the asparagus over a low heat for about 20 min
5. every so often , add a little chicken stock to keep it moist
6. when the asparagus is done , season to taste
7. while the asparagus is cooking , process the ricotta cheese with the oil
8. cook the pasta for half the time stated on the package
9. drain and immediately toss in the remaining butter and half the parmesan
10. butter a deep oven dish
11. make a thin layer of pasta , then one of asparagus , then one of pasta again and then one of ricotta
12. repeat , finishing with the layer of pasta
13. beat together the eggs and the remaining cheese and pour over the top
14. sprinkle with black pepper
15. bake in a medium oven , 350 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: Too much butter for me.  I like ricotta cheese, but didn't think it did anything for this dish.  I won't make this one again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: Best meatball recipe I have found.   I used 1 lb. beef and 1 lb. ground pork.  My family ate all of them with spaghetti and bottled marinara sauce!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s low fat oven baked zucchini sticks

a recipe that goes back years and a great way to use up all that zucchini left over from summers crop, you may adjust all seasonings to taste --- if you are a garlic lover then you may increase to 1 teaspoon, i also add in a pinch of cayenne pepper for a little heat --- use only dry breadcrumbs for this --- if your seasoned breadcrumbs already have salt added then omit the 1/4 teaspoon salt --- as one reviewer mentioned that she dipped the sticks into ranch dressing so you might want to give that a try using a low fat dressing or dip :)

1. in a bowl combine bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , garlic powder , salt and pepper
2. mix well
3. in another bowl , beat egg / s lightly
4. dip zucchini sticks into eggs , then into breadcrumb mixture
5. transfer to a greased baking sheet that has been coated with nonstick spray
6. bake at 425 degrees f for about 20-25 minutes , or until lightly browned
demonstrations.review: My kids LOVED these. Their only complaint was there wasn't enough of them.  Next time I'll double the recipe!  They were very crispy.  Nif must have done something wrong for hers not to turn out crispy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s marinade for grilled steak

this marinade will produce the most tender and not to mention the best tasting steak and it's enough for up to four steaks about 1-1/2-inches thick --- just remember to bring the steaks to almost room temperature before grilling this will relax the meat fibers and make for a more tender juicy steak ---  the amounts may be doubled but keep the garlic at the same amount, for best results it is recommended to not substitute any ingredients, do not add any salt to the marinade and do not salt the meat until ready to grill --- this marinade may be used for any cut of steaks.

1. mix all the marinade ingredients together in a bowl
2. pour over steaks
3. cover tightly and place the steaks in the refrigerator for minimum 4 hours or even better for 24 hours
4. remove the steaks from the fridge
5. bring the steaks down to almost room temperature before grilling
6. season steaks with steak seasoning or seasoning of choice if desired
7. grill for 6-12 minutes turning 3-4 times or until desired doneness
demonstrations.review: I like to double the recipe for 4 ribeye steaks.  This marinade is so much better than anything you can buy at the grocery store!

target.recipe_text:
mexican green chili chicken

this is another of those oh so simple dishes that are great for those busy week nights.

1. cut tortillas in strips
2. mix together soups , milk& chilies
3. make layers in a large baking dish , starting with the tortillas at the bottom , then chicken , then soups and ending with the cheese
4. bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour
target.review:
this is very good super easy i love spicy so i use mexican chilli powder when i cooked the chicken,i forgot the milk opps!it still was great
and i also add some thinly cut tortills on top i loved it thanks for posting

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican cubed steaks

can't remember where i got this recipe, but it is wonderful and a different way to cook cubed steaks.

1. coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
2. add oil
3. place over medium high heat until hot
4. add steaks
5. cook 2 minutes on each side combine picante sauce , lime juice , and pepper
6. pour over steaks
7. cover , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
8. sprinkle with cilantro
demonstrations.review: this where just what i wanted the best

demonstrations.recipe_text:
paula deens italian chicken sticks

i was watching paula deen on food network the other day and she made these and they looked so good.

1. preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. in a pie plate or platter , combine the bread crumbs , parmesan , thyme , basil , oregano , salt , garlic powder , and red pepper
3. dip the chicken strips in the melted butter , then dredge them in the bread crumb mixture
4. place the chicken strips in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet
5. bake for 20 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
6. serve the chicken sticks hot with marinara sauce , or serve hot or cold with honey mustard
demonstrations.review: this are really floverful and not hard to make at all

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy enchiladas  beef or chicken

these easy enchiladas are my husband's favorite recipe of mine. because of the many different options, it is very versatile.

1. if using chicken , boil chicken in water
2. then rinse and shred with fork
3. add onion and garlic
4. if using ground beef , brown with onion and garlic , drain
5. add next 7 ingredients
6. in another skillet , heat oil
7. add tortillas , one at a time , for 10 seconds on each side
8. drain on paper towel
9. in 10x13 baking pan , pour just enough enchilada sauce in the bottom to coat the bottom of the pan
10. fill each tortilla with a spoonful of meat mixture
11. cheese , onions , and / or olives can be put inside each enchilada at this time , if desired
12. roll tortilla and place seam side down in pan
13. continue with remaining tortillas
14. pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and top with cheese
15. at this time , pan may be refrigerated for several hours or overnight
16. bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes
17. top with sour cream
18. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: i made it with beef omg it was sooo good i never knew i could make something soo good the only thing i did wrong was i didnt sprey the bottle of the pan so it kind of stuck but they were very good thanks for posting it

demonstrations.recipe_text:
t r c

my husband was in okinawa, japan for two years and he lived on taco, rice, and cheese. this is our version of the recipe. my husband likes to eat it with ketchup, i like it with hot sauce and sour cream. for a spicier version, try spanish rice instead of white. hope you enjoy!!!

1. cook rice according to directions
2. brown beef in skillet
3. add taco seasoning mix according to package's directions
4. serve seasoned beef over rice
5. top with cheese
6. ketchup , hot sauce , sour cream optional toppings
7. leftovers taste delicious over nachos !
demonstrations.review: this was really good.it was easy for me to make,and i need that because i am a beginner cook

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken souiza cornbread bake

this is one of our favorties and is a great crowd pleaser!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. grease 9x13 inch baking dish
3. melt margarine in a small skillet over med-high heat
4. saute onion and garlic until tender , 4 to 6 minutes
5. set aside
6. in a large bowl , combine corn , cream style corn , salt and eggs
7. beat in muffin mix
8. fold in cooked onion mixture
9. pour into prepared baking dish
10. in a large bowl , combine chicken , green chiles , sour cream , salt and pepper
11. spoon over corn mixture to within 1 inch from edge
12. sprinkle top with cheese
13. bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes , or until edges are golden brown
demonstrations.review: uh my god i loved this soo much

target.recipe_text:
crema de fruta

this is a sweet  filipino  cake recipe that's usually served during fiestas.  it's a delicious recipe that leaves no leftovers during celebrations and still makes your crave for more.i've also tried substitute sugar here after it's cooked and it's still good. note:  recipezaar doesn't make me post properly at the left side the proper amount of ingredients hence i had to put it at the right side. glazed gelatin mixture calls for: 2 packets of unflavored gelatin.

1. custard filling:
2. combine and stir constarntly sugar , flour , yolks , milk 1 / 2 cup water in a saucepan until it thickens and becomes creamy
3. make sure there are no lumps
4. remove from heat and cool
5. gelatin glazed topping:
6. mix last 5 ingredients in a saucepan , heating and mixing for 5-10mins until dissolved
7. remove from heat and cool
8. to assemble:
9. arrange ladyfingers side by side in a single layer on top of a medium sized pyrex dish
10. spread 1 / 2 of the custard filling on top of first layer making sure to even it out
11. arrange1 / 2 canned fruits on top of custard
12. repeat layering: ladyfingers , then custard , then fruits
13. pour gelatin mixture on top of the final layer
14. completely covering the fruits if possible
15. chill in the fridge until the gelatin is set
16. serve
target.review: This was awesome! I had 8 guests, so I ended up making a whole recipe, and half more. We only ate 2/3rds of it, b/c it is very filling. I was confused on the gelatine, b/e one packet was only .25 oz. I must have used a different brand than the author did. I ended up putting 2 oz in. I also couldn't find Fruit Cocktail Syrup. There definitely isn't 1 1/2 cups in a can after you drain it. I ended up buying two cans, just for the juice. It all came out alright, but next time i'll just use tropical flavored Jello mix. It'll save alot of time, and a little money.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kevin s best corned beef

this is the best corned beef you will ever have. 

1. use a 14 to 20 qt
2. pan
3. coarsely chop enough onions and carrots to make 1 cup each
4. in pan , place onions and carrots , corned beef with any liquid from meat , vinegar , stout , mustard seed , coriander , peppercorns , dill , allspice , and bay leaves
5. add water to barely cover beef
6. cover pan and bring to a boil over high heat
7. simmer till meat is tender when pierced , 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours
8. meanwhile , cut remaining onions into wedges
9. cut remaining carrots into 2 inch lengths , halve them lengthwise if large
10. cut cabbage in half through cores , then into wedges
11. scrub potatoes
12. add onions , carrots and potatoes to tender corned beef , place cabbage on top
13. cover and return to simmering over high heat
14. reduce heat and simmer till cabbage is tender when pierced , 15 to 20 minutes
15. with slotted spoon , scoop out vegetables onto warm serving dishes
16. using tongs and a slotted spoon , remove beef to a cutting board
17. cut off fat
18. slice meat across grain , place on warm platters
19. serve meat and vegetables with mustards
demonstrations.review: We had a total of 9 folks over on St. Pattie's day for this, and everyone loved it!!!!! It felt good to do the seasonings myself. Will continue to use this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asian style honey vegetable stir fry

i love this recipe, you can change the vegetables around to suit your tastes. ww points 3.

1. in small bowl , combine honey , stir fry sauce and crushed red pepper flakes
2. set aside
3. in wok or large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
4. add vegetables and toss while cooking , about 2 to 3 minutes
5. add honey sauce , stir until all vegetables are glazed and sauce is bubbly hot , about 1 minute
6. serve as a vegetable side dish or over steamed rice or noodles for a main dish
demonstrations.review: We liked it! Needed more salt though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
family favorite beef stew

really easy and inexpensive dinner that the entire family enjoys. even my picky four year old! this recipe is a mixture of many other recipes i have tried in the past. i have also used red cabbage at the end, and found it tasty for the adults, the children weren't terribly impressed with that addition though. edit*** i have used this recently after trying new experiments and this recipe needs something i think. something savory, maybe a couple anchovies? i do not know, but please experiment! i am also cutting the v8 to 2 cups as the 3 cups in the slow cooker seems to be too watery.

1. place vegetables in bottom of crock pot
2. toss beef with flour , shake off excess
3. saut beef in hot oil , optional step but recommended
4. place beef on top of vegetables mix juice , onion soup mix , garlic powder and worcestershire sauce
5. pour on top of mixture
6. cover and cook on high 20-30 minutes
7. finish cooking on low for 8 hours
8. mix in salt and pepper to taste and serve
demonstrations.review: Loved it, and the three kids ate it all up too!!! Didn't brown the meat or use flour. I just threw everything into a pot with water and boiled it for 40 minutes. Added celery too.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lumpia stuffed wrappers  lumpia labong

posted for the zaar world tour-philippines.
from the "best of international cooking" cookbook. i haven't had a chance to make  these yet. note: this recipe was originally posted with instructions not to fry the lumpia. however, after one reviewer tried the recipe as written, and claimed the lumpia not very appetizing, i decided to edit the recipe to include frying instructions.

1. prepare sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a small saucepan
2. stir over medium heat until slightly thickened
3. heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or large skillet
4. add garlic and onion
5. saute until transparent
6. add pork , shrimp , bamboo shoots , cabbage , and salt
7. stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes , adding more oil if needed
8. stir in bean sprouts
9. keep warm
10. keep wrappers covered until used
11. top each wrapper with a lettuce leaf and 1 to 2 tablespoons filling
12. fold end of wrapper over stem-end of lettuce
13. roll wrapper and filling , with some of the lettuce and filling extending from open end of wrapper
14. in wok or skillet , heat about 1" of peanut oil to 375f
15. fry lumpia , 2 or 3 at a time , until golden brown , turning frequently
16. drain lumpia on paper towels
17. arrange filled wrappers on a platter
18. serve with lumpia sauce
demonstrations.review: This was a big rave at our dinner party last night. Everyone loved them. I did fry them. I also got help on how to roll from the website: http://www.yumsugar.com/128657 since i was all new to this. It took me about 10 tries, but i finally got the hang of it. Some of the wraps i doubled up on, to provide more stability. Everyone loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
barley beef vegetable soup

nan

1. place the first 10 ingredients in a soup kettle
2. bring to a boil , then simmer for about 3 hours
3. skim soup until clear while simmering
4. remove soup bone
5. add all remaining vegetables and simmer for about 30 minutes longer
6. let soup stand for about 15 minutes before serving
7. i love making homemade soups and bread on cold wintry days
demonstrations.review: Loved it! And so did our neighbors.

target.recipe_text:
asian ground beef  pepper and onion saute

a recipe i found on www.allrecipes.com that i modified to fit my allergies and our tastes.  we like our oriental food saucy, so i made extra sauce and added water chestnuts for dd.  this has a kick to it from the ginger, red pepper flakes and the chili paste. makes 6 1-cup servings.  this is a ww friendly recipe, if you use 96% lean ground beef.  points value per serving as calculated on the ww website is 3.

1. spray a large skillet with cooking spray
2. over over medium heat , cook and stir the ground beef until evenly browned
3. drain and set aside
4. add the peppers , onion , garlic and ginger
5. season with parsley , red pepper , and salt
6. cook and stir until tender
7. return the beef to the skillet
8. in a small bowl , mix together the beef stock , soy sauce , molasses , chile paste , and worcestershire sauce
9. cook until heated through and sauce comes to a boil
10. combine water and cornstarch and add to skillet
11. stir constantly until sauce is thickened
12. serve over the cooked rice
target.review: Great flavor. I didn't have any chili paste and didn't want to run to the store. So sad. Anyways, I meant to add celery and didn't. I took it out of the fridge and forget. I guess I'm losing my mind.  I think it would have added a little extra crunch, but we loved this. It would be good made with chicken or steak, too and served over rice. Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttered egg noodles  best ever

the creamiest buttered egg noodles you will ever taste. always a hit and easy to prepare.

1. bring water , 2 boullion cubes and 1 / 2 stick of butter to boil using med to high heat
2. add egg noodles
3. cook until noodles are desired texture
4. during last minute of cooking add remaining 1 / 2 stick of butter
demonstrations.review: This is so good. I know my family will be asking for this again. I made it as stated but added a can of chicken broth and used the whole 12 ounce package of egg noodles along with a little extra butter. Yum.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best apple cake

this is my dh favorite cake, i have tried many apple cakes over the years and this is a winner!! so moist and dense, with a caramel taste, cannot say enough, just try it and see.

1. in a large bowl combine flour , sugar , soda and salt
2. make a well in the center and set aside
3. in a medium bowl combine eggs , oil , apple juice and vanilla
4. stir in apples and nuts
5. add the egg mixture to dry ingredients , just until moistened
6. spread batter in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan
7. bake at 350f for 45-50 minutes
8. in a small saucepan combine the brown sugar , butter and cream
9. cook and stir till bubbly and all of the sugar is dissolved
10. cool slightly
11. drizzle warm sauce over cake , when it has cooled for 5 minutes , so it can seep into the cake , keeping it moist
demonstrations.review: My 9 year old son and I just finished making this and we tried our first pieces. We love it. Ryan especially loved it since he helped to make it. I usually don't bake sweets but this caught my eye. A great rainy day project for the two of us and he can't wait to make it again. We changed nothing about this recipe. My husband will be home tomorrow and I can't wait until he tries it. He loves that I like to cook but wishes I would bake desserts. I usually buy them. We made short work of dicing the apples with my vidalia onion chopper. If you've never tried this chopper, you should. Kids love it and it really simplifies prep work.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swirled strawberry bread

fresh strawberries make this so good.

1. make swirl first
2. mix all ingredients together until smooth
3. set aside
4. grease and flour one 9x5 loaf pan
5. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. make bread
7. combine dry ingredients
8. combine strawberries , margarine , egg , and water
9. mix strawberry mixture into dry ingredients just till moistened
10. pour all but 2 cups into prepared loaf pan
11. pour cream cheese swirl mixture over strawberry batter ,
12. top with reserved strawberry batter
13. cut through batter with a knife to create swirl
14. bake 1 hour and 10 minutes
15. cool on wire rack for 10 minutes , remove from pan , cool completely before cutting
16. store tightly wrapped in plastic in refrigerator
17. keeps several months if wrapped well and frozen
demonstrations.review: I have made this 2 times but the first time I didn't read the directions properly and didn't swirl the cream cheese into the batter. I put in a bottom layer of batter, then the cream cheese mixture and then more batter. It had a nice center, which was wonderful. I also added the cinnamon to the cream cheese mixture and left out the nutmeg. I used 1 cup of strawberry puree from fresh strawberries since I keep this frozen in my freezer for breads and cakes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
almost white castle hamburgers

these are really close to the real thing. my family was in heaven! they're great for dinner, football parties, or kid's birthday parties. i'm not real fond of white castle myself but i gobbled these up.  note:  to freeze: assemble hamburgers less the condiments. flash freeze, wrap in plastic wrap, put in a ziplock bag and label.
to heat: microwave until heated through.

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. hamburgers: mix first 6 ingredients and press into an ungreased 10 by 15 inch jelly roll pan
3. prick with a fork
4. bake for 10 minutes
5. drain off juices
6. cool
7. cut into 24 squares
8. place squares on dinner rolls
9. combine mustard and ketchup and spread on rolls
10. top with pickles and cheese , if desired
11. this makes 12 servings of 2 hamburgers each
demonstrations.review: This tasted just like white castles except WORD OF WARNING...I used ground sirloin 90/20 and after baking mopped up extra fat with paper towels. The buns did not have the inner slightly soggy taste or texture. I also used slightly less onion dip and minced an onion and sprinkled one pan with onion on top and one pan with onion on bottom before baking. No difference in my opinion. I also spread the beef mixture on the sheet and used my rolling pin on top of the wax paper to cover the pan and then pricked with a fork. Next time, I will go against my instinct to mop up the fat and leave it to soak into the bun. It didn't matter so much because my people scarfed them down.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bread machine pizza dough with whole wheat flour

this dough turns out crusty on the outside and soft on the inside, just what my family likes. no one even noticed that it was made with half whole wheat flour. after trying numerous recipes, i was told this was the keeper. from the bread machine cookbook by donna rathwell german.

1. add ingredients in the order given into the bread machine pan
2. start dough cycle
3. once the dough is done remove it from the pan onto a floured work surface
4. roll dough to fit the shape of your pan
5. this recipe makes two 14 inch round pizzas
6. brush lightly with olive oil and add toppings
7. you can hold this dough , with just the olive oil , for a couple of hours in the fridge covered in plastic wrap
8. bake in a preheated 450 degree oven for 10-12 minutes
9. this recipe is the large sized recipe
10. it also comes in small and medium
demonstrations.review: Love it! I made the dough in my bread machine. Used this for a white sauce spinach pizza. Will make again. Turned out perfect.

target.recipe_text:
best blueberry crisp

this is wonderful served warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream --- you will love this crisp!

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. prepare an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
3. spread the blueberries in the bottom of the prepared baking pan
4. in a small saucepan over medium heat combine the sugar , cornstarch , water and 2-3 tbsp lemon juice
5. cook and stir until thick and clear , then add in the vanilla
6. pour over , then gently stir in the cooked mixture with the blueberries
7. in a bowl combine the flour with oats , brown sugar and cinnamon
8. add in the melted butter
9. mix until crumbly
10. sprinkle over the top of blueberries
11. bake for 30-35 minutes , or until blueberry mixture bubbles and the topping is brown
12. serve with ice cream-- enjoy !
target.review: When looking for new recipes for a particular dish, I usually save several variations to try out before deciding which one to keep. This was the first blueberry crisp recipe I tried, and after trying this, there won't be any need to try others. It was simple, easy to prepare, and just delicious. I had three pints of blueberries to use before they went bad, and this was the perfect recipe for them. The only difference (temporary) was I didn't have cornstarch, so substituted flour, and it worked fine. This has definitely gone to the "keeper" file. Thanks so much, Kittencal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy parmesan garlic mushroom chicken

use thinly sliced chicken breasts to be ready in 30 minutes

1. sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper to taste
2. in a large skillet add olive oil and cook the chicken on medium high heat for 3-5 minutes on each side or until brown on each side and no longer pink in center
3. remove chicken and set aside
4. add the mushrooms and cook until tender
5. set aside
6. to make the sauce , add the butter and melt
7. add garlic and cook until tender
8. whisk in the flour until it thickens
9. whisk in chicken broth , heavy cream , parmesan cheese , garlic powder , pepper and salt
10. add the spinach and let simmer until the sauce thickens and spinach wilts
11. add the chicken and mushrooms back to the sauce and serve over pasta
demonstrations.review: This looked like a very tasty meal, and with a couple of tweaks (out of necessity), turned out very nicely, served over farfelle.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken tortellini soup with mushrooms and spinach

i wanted some soup one winter night and came up with this one using what i had on hand.  i served it with toasted italian bread and topped with parmesan cheese.  hope you enjoy it!

1. in a large pot , heat the butter until melted
2. add the carrots , celery , onions , and garlic
3. saute until tender , about 8 minutes
4. add the mushrooms , fresh thyme , and mrs dash
5. saute another 5-8 minutes
6. add the broth and heat to almost boiling
7. add the tortellini and chicken and simmer until the tortellini are cooked through
8. add the spinach leaves and simmer for 5 minutes until the spinach is wilted
9. serve hot , topped with parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: This has become my go-to "chicken soup" recipe. It's very filling, easy to make, and just plain tastes wonderful. I didn't have Mrs. Dash's so I substituted the same amount of Herbs de Provence, which gave the soup and nice, delicate flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple tomato sandwich

i am only posting such a simple recipe because i actually somehow lived 29 years of life before my husband introduced me to the tomato sandwich. if you've only used tomatoes as an accessory in your sandwiches, and not as the featured ingredient, you are truly missing summer as it was meant to be tasted. note: after many years, i have solidly converted to mayo for this sandwich, with fresh ground black pepper too.  (oct 2012)

1. toast bread
2. slice tomato
3. when bread is adequately toasted , liberally spread both sides with miracle whip
4. lay tomato slices on one side of bread
5. salt tomato to taste
6. slap that baby together and savor summer at its best !
demonstrations.review: This is simply the best summer food ever, and it's so nice to see I'm not the only one who likes their tomato sandwiches served up like this!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best banana bread

you'll never need another banana bread recipe ever again!

1. remove odd pots and pans from oven
2. preheat oven to 350 / 180
3. cream together butter and sugar
4. add eggs and crushed bananas
5. combine well
6. sift together flour , soda and salt
7. add to creamed mixture
8. add vanilla
9. mix just until combined
10. do not overmix
11. pour into greased and floured loaf pan
12. bake at 350 / 180 for 55 minutes
13. keeps well , refrigerated
demonstrations.review: After following the instructions, especially the first one about the pots and pans (love it!), this was absolutely delicious, moist inside, slightly crunchy crust. Next time I'll add walnuts for sure. You can't go wrong with this one!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best taco salad

i got this recipe from a friend more than 20 years ago and it remains a family favorite espcially on hot summer days.  i cook the beef early in the morning.  sometimes even chop all of the ingredients then, too, so all i have to do is throw everything together when it is time for dinner.  teenagers especially love this.  that is a bonus!  have yet to find anyone who doesn't love this super easy salad for dinner.

1. brown ground beef , drain grease , adding taco seasoning and following directions on package
2. chill
3. when ground beef is cold , place in a large bowl and add all remaining ingredients
4. mix well and serve
demonstrations.review: The calorie content seems very high for one serving. Not for someone trying to watch their diet.

target.recipe_text:
onion parmesan roasted red potatoes

very easy, very little prep. i use to buy a product made by lipton, which came in a bottle and you poured it over your diced potatoes and baked/grilled the dish. they have since discontinued the product, so i have found this to be the next best thing.

1. combine all ingredients in a large plastic bag , seal and shake until well coated
2. empty bag into a 13x9 dish , cover and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. uncover and bake 15 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
4. i think they even taste better more browned and crispy , so you may want to turn up the temp after uncovering and cook them longer
5. you could also make this on the grill , covered in foil in an aluminum pan
6. grill for 1 hour , turning potatoes occasionally
target.review: Delicious. Taste was right on. I used extra virgin olive oil. I think next time I'll mix the oil, soup mix and parmesan first, then add to potatoes for a smoother consistency.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttermilk pancakes

this is our favorite pancake recipe. i got it from williams-sonoma site. try it.. it's great.

1. in a bowl , using an electric mixer , beat the eggs on medium speed until frothy
2. add the buttermilk , melted butter and vanilla and mix well
3. add the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt , and beat on medium speed just until blended
4. you can also mix this together using a wooden spoon or whatever you have
5. heat lightly greased griddle at 350 degrees
6. pour about 1 / 3 cup of the batter onto griddle for each pancake
7. cook until the tops of the pancakes are covered with tiny bubbles and the batter is set , about 4-6 minutes
8. flip pancakes and cook until the undersides are golden brown , about 4 minutes more
9. repeat with remaining batter
demonstrations.review: Yum! These were great! I doubled the vanilla & added chopped pecans. This was my first time making pancakes from scratch... very easy & came out perfect! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken dinner pot pie

my sister never liked frozen pot pies but she loves this one.

1. heat oven to 425 degrees
2. prepare pastry , cut top into lattice strips
3. melt butter in large skillet over low heat
4. stir in flour , salt , pepper and thyme
5. cook , stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly
6. remove from heat
7. stir in chicken broth and cream
8. heat to boiling , stirring constantly
9. boil and stir for one minute
10. stir in chicken and vegetables
11. pour into pastry lined pie pan
12. cover with lattice top
13. cover edge with 2-3 inch strips of foil to prevent excessive browning
14. remove foil for the last 15 minutes of baking
15. bake for 35 to 40 or until crust is brown
demonstrations.review: DELICIOUS! I will NEVER buy frozen pot pie again! I also added some diced potatoes and my frozen veggies included peas, carrots, green beans & corn.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bourbon chocolate pecan pie

southern living; my father-in-law's favorite.

1. whisk together eggs and next 7 ingredients until mixture is smooth
2. stir in pecans and morsels
3. pour into piecrust
4. bake on lowest oven rack at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until set
demonstrations.review: Awesome pie! Too much filling for 1 crust though. I added a few more pecans and made 2 pies. Nothing wasted... everyone loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chipotle roast for tacos   sandwiches

crock pot recipe. beware - this is spicy, but is an excellent shredded beef for tacos, sandwiches or enchiladas!

1. place chuck roast in large crock pot and sprinkle with the salt and pepper , chili powder and cumin
2. add the remaining ingredients and simmer on high for 5 hours or on low for 7-8 hours
3. shred the meat with a fork and simmer on high for additional 10-15 minutes
4. serve in enchiladas , tacos or on crusty rolls with the juice for dipping
demonstrations.review: Absolutely AMAZING! I added about a cup of medium salsa, a few dashes of Worcestershire and another half cup or so of beef broth. The flavor was incredible. Like some others, I was concerned about the heat when I first tasted the juice, but once the meat was shredded and absorbed the juice, it was perfect! I made shredded beef quesadillas with this, and it was better than what I get from any restaurant! My kids each gave it two thumbs... and two big toes up, lol. They said it was too good for just two thumbs.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jalapeo bites

these are a bit reminiscent of stuffed jalapeño peppers but much easier to make. i found this in the junior league celebrations cookbook.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. combine the cream cheese , parmesan , jalapeo peppers and egg yolks in a bowl and mix to form a paste
3. shape a 1 / 2 tablespoonful at a time into 1 / 4-inch rounds and roll in the bread crumbs
4. place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
5. serve warm
demonstrations.review: Very good! I used about 4 oz parm & 4 oz sharp cheddar. I doubled up on the jalapenos (jarred) and added some cayenne, garlic powder, pepper & onion powder and a couple teaspoons of the liquid from the jarred jalapenos. These had a bite to 'em, but that's how we like 'em!

target.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
target.review: Great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
szechuan noodles with spicy beef sauce

tired of using ground beef the same old way? try this spicy dish! feel free to double the sauce if you like it really saucy! update: the hoisin sauce is quite sweet, so you might start off with just a little and work your way up!

1. brown ground beef in a large skillet , stirring until it crumbles
2. drain and keep warm
3. pour sesame oil in pan and heat till hot
4. saute onion and next 4 ingredients hot sesame oil until tender
5. combine cornstarch and beef broth , whisking until smooth
6. stir broth mixture , hoisin sauce , and soy sauce into onion mixture
7. bring to a boil , stirring constantly
8. boil , stirring constantly , 1 minute
9. stir in ground beef
10. toss with hot cooked pasta , and sprinkle with sliced green onions
11. yield: 4 servings
demonstrations.review: Loved this!! made with thin whole wheat spaghetti and extra crushed red peppers...we love spicy!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
another pork chops and beer recipe

this is one of our favorites. the first time i made them, i did not let them simmer long enough. they will be falling off the bone when they are done. if you need to add liquid, add beef broth as too much beer will give it a bad taste.

1. salt , pepper , garlic salt chops , then dredge in flour
2. place in frying pan with oil , make sure the oil is already hot
3. brown on both sides , add onions , cook for about 2 minutes
4. add beef broth and beer , cover and let simmer about 45 minutes until chops are very tender
demonstrations.review: baked in the oven on very low for about 2 hrs, used wheat flour. Great recipe. nice for a cold winter night!! made with some homemade wheat bread and red skin mashed potatoes

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tortellini tomato spinach soup

really healthy soup, good to use when there's no time to spend in the kitchen!

1. in a soup pot , heat olive oil over medium high heat
2. saute the onion and garlic , stirring often until onions are translucent , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. add broth and tomatoes , turn heat up to high , and bring to a boil
4. add the tortellini and cook according to package instructions
5. when tortellini is almost done , add spinach and taste , adjusting seasonings with salt and pepper
6. serve immediately
7. garnish each serving with a sprinkling of parmesan
demonstrations.review: We had to make a lot of additions to this soup, but we realized that prior to beginning cooking.  Turned out amazing with additions of carrots, garlic powder, oregano, salt, pepper, hot italian sausage, and canellini beans. Great starting point for sure!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet potatoes with pecan praline streusel

it wouldn't be the holidays without them!  this casserole side dish can be made with just a hint of sweet or decadent enough for dessert!   the pecan streusel caramelizes on top to make a pecan-pie like topping.  this is one of those family recipes that you may need to play with the ingredient amounts a bit.

1. wash and skin potatoes , chop into large chunks
2. boil potatoes until tender and mash
3. stir in butter , cinnamon , brown sugar and mini marshmallows to taste
4. mix in a separate bowl , flour , sugar , cinnamon , and pecans , drizzle melted butter over mixture and stir to moisten , mixture should resemble chunky crumbs
5. pour potatoes mixture into casserole dish and cover with a thin layer of mini-marshmallows
6. top with pecan mixture
7. bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly
demonstrations.review: wonderful recipe!! i have been looking for this recipe for quite a while!!  I did not put all of the marshmallows in, as I wanted a less sweet version of the sweet potato part to go with topping which was is more sweet.  Came out great!! my favorite sweet potato recipe by far!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican stuffed shells  oamc

you can add jalapeños, hot sauce or green chilies to this to add a real kick! **edited on october 24 to add instructions for once a month cooking. i usually make these during a cooking blitz and freeze until i need them**

1. brown ground beef and drain
2. add seasoning , water , onion , and 1 / 2 cup of salsa and 1 / 4 cup cheese
3. mix together remaining salsa , tomato sauce , and chili powder
4. spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 9 x 12 baking pan
5. fill each shell with the ground beef mixture and place in pan
6. pour remaining sauce on top
7. sprinkle on the rest of the cheese on top and garnish with green onion
8. cover and freeze at this point
9. defrost overnight and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
10. if desired sprinkle additional cheese on top after baking and return to oven for 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts
demonstrations.review: great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
easy lettuce wraps with dipping sauce

an easy way to make lettuce wraps that taste as good as pf changs.

1. add vegetables to food processor until roughly diced
2. add to skillet with sesame oil and saute until tender
3. add pork and cook through , adding soy sauce as it cooks
4. serve with lettuce , rice and dipping sauce
5. if you have extra meat filling leftover , it freezes very well
target.review: This was excellent!  One head of iceberg lettuce only gave me 4 good rolling leaves for the wraps.  I ended up chopping up the remaining lettuce and making a sort of "one dish meal" for my son.  I mixed the chopped lettuce in with the rice and meat mixture and poured some sauce on it to give it the flavor and it was fabulous!  Thanks for the great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
corn with green chilies

yummy side dish my family begs for time and again! the green chilies are mild and give just the right amount of zip!  enjoy!

1. saute onion and green chilies in the melted that has been melted in a saucepan just until the onion is tender
2. add frozen corn and cook until heated through
3. stir in shredded cheese and salt and pepper to taste and stir until the cheese is melted
4. stir in sour cream to mix well and heat the sour cream up
5. enjoy
demonstrations.review: This dish is spectacular!!  My hubby turns his nose up at creamed corn so he took one look at this and "knew" he wouldn't like it.  Needless to say, he cleared his plate and went back for seconds!  I followed the recipe exactly as written.  Very easy directions and tastes wonderful.  Thank you for the keeper!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
berry  berry good muffins

fresh berries are prolific in the pacific northwest during the summer, but we freeze them to use all year round. these are delectable in them morning or at teatime. the muffin is the perfect support for a mixture of raspberries, blueberries and blackberries, for a change try a single type. fresh or frozen berries can be used. the topping is an extra delight, but can be ommited.

1. preheat oven ot 350 degrees
2. topping:
3. mix dry ingredients together
4. stir in nuts and butter , mix until butter mixture is crumbly , set aside
5. muffins:
6. combine dry ingredients in a large bowl
7. make a well in the center , add milk , butter and egg and mix just until smooth
8. gentley fold in berries
9. spoon into paper-lined muffin cups , fill 2 / 3 full
10. sprinkle with 1 tbls
11. of topping
12. bake 20-25 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean
13. cool 5 minutes , remove from pan , serve warm
demonstrations.review: We loved the flavor of this recipe!  I cut the serving size/ingredients in half and they still came out fantastic!  I would've liked to see them rise higher, but it's just because that's what I'm used to muffins doing.  I will definitely make this recipe again.  Thanks momaphet!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sneak in the veggies cheddar cheese soup

if you have non-vegetable-eaters around, they won't ever guess how much produce you put in this. it's pretty versatile stuff, too. try it topped with bacon bits, sour cream, salsa, tomatoes... almost anything goes with this.

use vegetable broth to make this a vegetarian dish.

it freezes really well, too. to make ahead, just make up until you would add the dairy products, freeze, and add the half and half and cheese when you reheat.

1. roughly chop potatoes , onion , squash , and bell pepper if using
2. add to large stock pot along with carrots , stock , salt and pepper to taste , and turmeric
3. bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium and let simmer until vegetables are tender
4. puree soup using a stick blender , or in small batches in the regular blender
5. add half-and-half and cheese , heat just until cheese melts
6. serve topped however you like
demonstrations.review: I served this last night for dinner with biscuits. My family really enjoyed the taste, but I also added in some extra things. I sautÃ©ed the potato, onion, & carrot in some butter before adding the chicken stock. I also added corn & white kidney beans to the soup. For cheese I used a combination of cheddar, romano, & mozzarella. It came out very good. This is a great recipe because it's so versatile!! Thanks Emmy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken noodle soup bake

this is a little recipe i cooked up, it's just like creamy chicken noodle soup but in a casserole form. delicious and good for you!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f--cook egg noodles according to directions
2. when done , place in greased 2 qt baking dish
3. cook peas and carrots in boiling water for 3 minutes--drain
4. prepare half of the pesto sauce mix
5. add peas , carrots , and chicken to sauce and stir
6. spoon over noodles , sprinkle with chives and parsley and bake 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: This dish was very easy to put together.  I didn't have cooked chicken on hand so it took me a little longer than the time stated.  While the flavor was good I still felt like it was missing something.  I still HIGHLY recommend this recipe but I think next time I make it I might add some cream or some cheese.  Thanks for the great recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
greek penne and chicken

posted for 2006 zaar world tour - greece. this recipe was adapted from a cooking website's newsletter.

1. in a large pot bring salted water to a boil
2. add penne pasta and cook until al dente , drain and set aside
3. using a large skillet and over medium-high heat melt butter
4. add onion and garlic to melted butter and cook for 2 minutes
5. stirring occasionally , add chicken and continue cooking until golden brown , approximately 5-6 minutes
6. reduce heat to medium-low , begin adding drained and chopped artichoke hearts , chopped tomato , feta cheese , fresh parsley , lemon juice , dried oregano , and drained penne pasta to the chicken
7. cook until heated through , approximately 2-3 minutes
8. season with salt and ground black pepper to taste , serve warm
demonstrations.review: Very nice recipe!  I substituted kidney and garbanzo beans instead of chicken and made the dish somewhat vegetarian.  I really enjoyed the flavors as they were very delicate.  I think the addition of Greek Dressing or something else to make it "spicier", not hotter, would really push this recipe to 5 stars.  Very easy to put together and directions are well written.  Thank you for posting this recipe!

target.recipe_text:
vegetarian lasagna

i first had veggie lasagna when i was in hospital, and i just had to find a better recipe! here it is.

1. mix carrots , oregano , and spaghetti sauce together
2. mix ricotta , spinach , and eggs together in separate bowl
3. spread cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of 9 x 13 inch baking dish
4. layer 3 lasagna noodles , remaining sauce , ricotta mixture , sliced zucchini , sliced mushrooms , mozzarella , and parmesan
5. repeat layers with remaining ingredients
6. bake in 350 degrees oven for about 45 minutes
target.review: absolutely delicious! This is going in my files as THE lasagna I make from here on out. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blockbuster vegetarian crock pot black bean soup

this soup is really yummy and healthy too! this makes a main dish accompanied by tortillas, or crusty french bread and a nice salad!caribbean, cuban, mexican and spanish influences! it really is best if the beans are soaked overnight.and depending on your cooker, the soup might need to be cooked longer.

1. soak beans overnight in water to cover
2. if you don't soak the beans overnight:
3. in a large pot over medium heat , place the beans in three times their volume of water
4. bring to a boil and let boil 10 minutes
5. cover , remove from heat and let stand 1 hour
6. drain and rinse
7. in a crock pot , combine soaked beans and 1 1 / 2 quarts fresh water
8. cook for 3-7 hours on high , depending on how hot your cooker gets
9. stir in carrot , celery , onion , garlic , bell pepper , jalapeno , lentils and tomatoes
10. season with chili powder , cumin , oregano , black pepper , red wine vinegar and salt
11. cook on low , 2 to 3 hours
12. stir the rice into the crock pot in the last 20 minutes of cooking
13. puree half the soup with a blender or food processor , then pour back into the pot before serving
14. serve with lime wedges , sour cream , and cilantro
15. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was delicious! I'm making it a second time and cutting back on the heat so the kids will eat it this time by omitting the jalape?os and only using 1/2 tbs of the chili powder.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
southwest black bean and rice  crock pot

this is an easy recipe that can be used as a dip, burrito filling, or entree.  it has everything you need for filling and healthy meal, it's just your choice how you eat it.  :)  i hope you enjoy it cause i just love it.

1. rinse and sort beans
2. mix beans , rice , onion , jalapenos , and water into crock-pot
3. cook on low for 8
4. 5 hours
5. add lime juice , cilantro , tomatoes , corn , and cheese
6. at this time also add 1 / 3 cup of desired cajun seasoning
7. i use lusianne , because it has less sodium
8. continue cooking for another 30 minutes
9. serve warm by itself or , wrapped in a flour tortilla like a burrito , or serve with tortilla chips like a dip
10. add a dab of sour cream and / or guacamole for color , texture , and taste
demonstrations.review: The amount of beans and rice should both be cut in half (8oz of each). I ended up with two HUGE crocks worth after having to add water four times. I didn't notice the seasoning, since it wasn't in the ingredient list and left it out. It was bland as a result. But it was very good and will be even better next time with the seasoning. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s extreme chocolate brownies

if your looking for an everyday run-of-the-mill cake-style brownie then pass this by, this is a a moist chewy extreme chocolate bakery-style brownie that takes little time to make and tastes even better the next day, it's everything a good brownie should be!  --- i have even made these using half brown sugar and half white sugar, the amount of sugar listed will give you a sweet brownie you may reduce the sugar by 1/4 cup or more if desired or if you have a sweet tooth use amount stated --- add in a couple of tablespoons of coffee-flavored liqueur in place of the vanilla if desired -- according to a reviewer oil may be used in place of the butter successfully --- these brownies freeze very well,  they are so simple to make just mix everything by hand, they bake out so rich and sinful! --- see recipe#89207

1. set oven to 325 degrees f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. in a heavy saucepan , bring butter , sugar and water to a boil , stirring constantly until the butter is melted and sugar is dissolved
4. remove from the heat , with a wooden spoon , stir in 2 cups chocolate chips until melted
5. cool slightly , beat in vanilla
6. in a mixing bowl , whisk eggs , gradually add in the chocolate mixture , beating with a wooden spoon until completely mixed
7. mix together flour , baking soda and salt
8. add to the egg / chocolate mixture
9. mix well to combine
10. stir in the remaining chocolate chips
11. spread into prepared baking pan
12. bake for 35-40 minutes
13. cut into squares
demonstrations.review: The 6 year old printed off a terrible brownie recipe from pbskids and Kittencal's recipe rectified the evening! My first brownie baking experience and they came out perfect. The crinkly top that forms as it cools looks like a fancy brownie from a coffee shop. mmmm! Maybe some nuts and marshmellows next time for fun.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegetarian vegan  lucky chili  crock pot yummy

this recipe was posted by my on-line friend. super easy and delish! i highly recommend it!

1. put all ingredients into the slow cooker , and cook on low for 8-12 hours
2. to serve , top with coriander , cheddar cheese , sour cream and salsa
3. the recipe could probably feed about 8-10 people
4. no fat , and very healthy
demonstrations.review: Very easy and delicious . Like Ladypit, I also used dry beans soaked over night and 4 cups of broth. A side of cornbread made this a hearty meal. Thanks! I'm adding this one into my folder of repeats.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my thai sesame noodles

after tinkering with a few different recipes, this is my family's favorite version! sooooo good, i could eat the whole bowl! you can easily add cooked chicken and make it a main dish! the honey is an optional ingredient; leave it out if you don't like the noodles sweet.

1. heat peanut butter in microwave for 20 seconds to soften
2. in a large bowl whisk together softened peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar , sesame oil , sambal oelek and honey
3. add spaghetti , green onions and sesame seeds
4. toss well
5. chill until ready to serve - or serve at room temperature
demonstrations.review: Delicious and easy to assemble. I've made this several times now for the family and once for a potluck. Sometimes with added carrot, brocolli, mushrooms, maybe aome Tofu or meat. Sometimes with rice noodles, sometimes with spaghetti. Thank you for the great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot sweet sour chicken

posted in response to a request; from company's coming slow cooker recipes.

1. combine ketchup , water , vinegar , soy sauce and sugar in slow cooker
2. whisk together well
3. add chicken pieces and stir
4. cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
5. combine cornstarch and second amount of water in a small bowl
6. stir into slow cooker when above times have been reached
7. cook on high , stirring often , for 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened
8. for faster cooking , pour into saucepan and heat on stove , stirring often , until thickened
target.review:
Just made this recipe today, great tasting, will do again but will cut back on brown sugar, its far to sweet. Simple to make,just threw in crock pot and thickened it on stove as susgested at the end, served it over rice with vegs, we enjoyed it.
      Thanks
      Jess96

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled salmon with strawberry salsa

its strawberry season!!! my friend served this last weekend and everyone raved about it, said the flavors were wonderful. my hubby decided we should make this for company this weekend, and i thought i'd share my neighbor's recipe with my friends at zaar. (i have not personally prepared this dish yet). prep time does not include 1 hour chilling time. cook time does not include the time to prepare the charcoal grill.

1. salsa
