12. cook time is split between cooking to potatoes and mixing the salad
target.review: A great dish especially good for those who don't like hard boiled eggs in their potato salad. I use less onion and substitute fat free plain yogurt for the sour cream.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy potato and corn chowder   crock pot

this is a chowder that uses ingredients that i almost always have on hand, so it is quick and easy to throw together before work, and come home to on a nice fall evening.  relatively easy to double as well for extra large families or get togethers.

1. mix all ingredients together in crock pot and cook for 6-8 hours on low
2. serving suggestion: top bowls of chowder with a little extra crumbled bacon and a little shredded cheese
3. yum !
demonstrations.review: The recipe was very easy to follow. I added a little ground clove and cinnamon, but still found it kind of bland. Still, I will make it again, probably doubling the Wostershire sauce and add a couple drops of Tobascco.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
midwest breakfast casserole

diane phillips

1. spray inside of 9-inch square baking dish with cooking spray
2. in a big pan , saute sausage over medium heat until it is browned , breaking it up with a fork , 8-10 minutes
3. drain off fat
4. add in onion
5. saute for another 2-3 minutes
6. sprinkle in the flour
7. stir until the flour is combined and coats the sausage and onion
8. cook for about 2 minutes , stirring constantly
9. slow pour in the milk and stir up the bits from the bottom of the skillet
10. bring to a boil and add in the tabasco
11. stir in 1 cup of cheese and continue stirring until cheese melts
12. cool for 10 minutes
13. add in hash browns , green onions , and eggs , stirring until the mixture is combined
14. pour into prepared dish
15. sprinkle with remaining cheese
16. preheat oven to 350
17. bake for 25-30 minutes , until puffed , golden , and set in the center
18. let rest for 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: Makes a great breakfast or brunch dish for a crowd.  I've used Swiss, Cheddar, and mixtures of cheese.  Smoked gouda made it really special.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramels

i've been making these at christmas time for years.  my family demands them and they are wonderful gifts, much appreciated by all my co-workers.  they are firm, but melt in your mouth and don't stick to your teeth.  they are somewhat time consuming but worth it.  i buy the red and green wrappers or you can cut up and use regular wax paper.

1. melt butter in a large , heavy saucepan
2. add brown sugar and salt
3. stir in corn syrup , mixing well
4. gradually add milk , stirring constantly
5. cook and stir over medium heat until firm ball stage - 245 degrees on a candy thermometer
6. remove from heat and add vanilla
7. pour into a well-buttered jelly roll pan
8. cool 4-5 hours
9. remove from pan , cut and wrap
10. makes about 5 lbs
demonstrations.review: Easy to make with excellent results.  Very creamy.  They really do melt in your mouth.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
d s roasted butternut squash

easy and delicious.

1. peel and chop squash into 2 inch cubes and put in a bowl
2. add all other ingredients and toss
3. spray a cookie sheet with non-stick veg spray
4. put the tray near the bottom of the oven and roast at 350 until tender
demonstrations.review: Excellent side dish. I was out of garlic and substituted about a tablespoon of minced onion. This recipe was a big hit at my house.  Hint: put parchment paper on the cookie sheet to make clean up easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swedish spritz

a great little cookie that my mom and i make every christmas. i love these and the bring back memories of childhood.

1. thoroughly cream the butter and sugar
2. add the egg the vanilla and almond extract
3. beat well
4. sift the flour and baking powder together
5. add to the creamed mixture , mix until smooth
6. do not chill
7. do not double
8. force cookies through a cookie press onto an ungreased cookie sheet
9. decorate the cookies with redhots , sprinkles or whatever you like
10. bake in a 400 oven for 8-10 minutes
11. cool on newspaper
12. these freeze well but shouldnt be left out for more than a week or so
demonstrations.review: Buttery, delicate, everything you want in a Christmas cookie.  I use two colors of dough in the press to obtain a marbleized effect.

target.recipe_text:
sticky pork chops

a mouth watering yummy pork chop asian style. double the recipe, you'll want more. :)

1. heat frying pan over medium heat
2. cook meat for 2 minutes each side , or until meat is well browned
3. remove meat , set aside - keep warm -
4. add cooking wine , soy sauce , ginger , chili sauce / flakes and honey to the same pan without washing the pan
5. cook for 3 minutes
6. return the meat to pan and cook on each side for 1 minute
7. simmer until the sauce thickens , and pork is cooked through
8. serve with rice and greens
target.review: very good! my dh loved it! i had to improvise a little though because i was out of honey. i used sweet chili sauce instead. still very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best ever banana cake with cream cheese frosting

this is one of (if not) the best banana cake i have ever tasted! i thought the oven temp of 275° sounded a little low, but this cake baked up (and rose) beautifully in my oven at this temp after pretty much exactly one hour. i do not know if the little "freezer trick" to this recipe is what ensured its moistness or not, but i did it, and it was exceptionally moist & delicious. would be interesting to see if it still came out as great if this step was skipped. all i know is that i followed this recipe exactly as stated (except that i had no buttermilk, so i subbed with a mix of lemon juice & milk) and i got exceptional results. so moist and yummy...a dense cake, similar in texture to a carrot cake... i personally would not call this frosted banana bread :o)  depending on the amount of frosting you like you can decide whether to half the recipe or not. i used the full recipe and had some leftover. i sprinkled on the chopped walnuts and threw this baby in the fridge and cut it the next day...to die for! i really liked it slightly chilled, but great at room temp too! it got better each day it sat, i always make this cake at least the day before i need or want it.  i was extremely pleased with this cake and will be making it over & over again!! so glad i came across this one!! (on another website).


(* * just to update the recipe, (based on some of the reviews), the baking time may vary based on individual ovens. it was right on for my oven, but some others have stated it has taken 1 hour 10 minutes, 1 hour 20 minutes, and my sister just informed me that it took 1 hour 30 minutes in her oven!!!!!)

1. preheat oven to 275f
2. grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan
3. in a small bowl , mix mashed banana with the lemon juice
4. set aside
5. in a medium bowl , mix flour , baking soda and salt
6. set aside
7. in a large bowl , cream 3 / 4 cup butter and 2 1 / 8 cups sugar until light and fluffy
8. beat in eggs , one at a time , then stir in 2 tsp vanilla
9. beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk
10. stir in banana mixture
11. pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for one hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. remove from oven and place directly into the freezer for 45 minutes
13. this will make the cake very moist
14. for the frosting , cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
15. beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. add icing sugar and beat on low speed until combined , then on high speed until frosting is smooth
17. spread on cooled cake
18. sprinkle chopped walnuts over top of the frosting , if desired
demonstrations.review: Awesome!!!! I love this cake! I am a big bannana bread lover and this is sooooo good!! i made it in to 9in round pans instead of a 9x13. Definitely will be making tihs again very soon!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the great aussie meat pie

contemplating making a pie floater? well here is the recipe for the pie. posted in response to a request for aussie recipes. times are guesses.

1. brown mince
2. add onion finely diced and brown
3. drain off fat
4. add stock cubes crumbled , 1- cups of water , salt and pepper and stir until boiling
5. reduce heat and cover , simmering for an additional 30 minutes
6. remove from heat
7. in a cup combine flour and extra water and stir until smooth
8. add flour mixture to meat and stir until combined
9. return to heat , stir until it comes to a boil and is thickened
10. add worcestershire sauce
11. simmer uncovered for 10 minutes then remove from heat and refrigerate
12. once cool fill in bottom of piecrust
13. put top on and pierce the centre with a knife
14. combine egg yolk with a bit of water and brush over the top
15. follow directions on frozen pie crusts or bake at 400 for 5 minutes then reduce heat to moderate and cook for an additional 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: dh loved it!! reminded him of the ones back home!! very yummy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mimi s banana pudding

my mother-in-law gave me her recipe for banana pudding. i think her's is the best i've tried! um um good!

1. mix cream cheese and eagle brand milk
2. add milk and pudding
3. mix well
4. stir in cool whip
5. save other half for topping
6. in a large bowl , make several layers of pudding mixture , bananas and vanilla wafers
7. top with remaining cool whip
demonstrations.review: absolutely awesome!! very rich and creamy!! i loved it so much!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
candied sweet potatoes

these are so good, we don't wait for a holiday to serve them!

1. peel potatoes and cut into chunks
2. place potatoes in 13x9 baking pan
3. in lg saucepan combine remaining ingredients
4. bring to a boil
5. boil for 2 minutes
6. pour over potatoes
7. cover and bake for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: very yummy!!! i added marshmallows to the top of mine during the last few minutes of cooking.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s best deviled eggs

these have been a favorite for years, when i serve these at my get togethers or make them for socials and large events they are always the first to go and everyone wants the recipe, i suggest to use large, extra large or even jumbo eggs for this, i like to make the yolk filling a day ahead and refrigerate this will blend the flavors --- for a nice presentation place each egg half in a colored paper muffin liner --- all ingredient amounts may be adjusted to taste --- see my recipe#259573

1. slice the eggs in half lengthwise
2. remove the yolks , and set whites aside
3. in a small bowl , mush yolks well with a fork , leaving no small lumps
4. add next 10 ingredients mix well to combine
5. spoon or pipe egg yolk mixture evenly into the whites
6. sprinkle with paprika
7. cover tightly with plastic wrap
8. store in the refrigerator until ready to serve
demonstrations.review: just made these and they are really good! i used mircale whip, usually i use mayo, not sure yet if i like it better or not. but they still taste great. I took Pierre Dance's advice on piping the filling and it worked great!! dont know why i didnt think of that!!

target.recipe_text:
cinnamon rolls

want to be famous for your cinnamon rolls?  after 12 years of working on the perfect cinnamon roll i settled on this... and now i'm famous with all my friends.  lately i've started adding 1/2 cup of sour cream to the dough mixture, and i've really liked the results.

1. in the pan of your bread machine , combine water , melted butter , vanilla pudding , warm milk , egg , 1 t
2. sugar , salt , bread flour and yeast
3. set machine to dough cycle
4. press start
5. when dough cycle has finished , turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a 17x10 inch rectangle
6. beat together butter , brown sugar and cinnamon
7. spread dough with butter mixture
8. roll up dough , beginning with long side
9. slice into 16 one-inch slices and place in buttered jellyroll pan
10. brush outside of rolls with melted butter and sprinkle with additional brown sugar
11. let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 45 minutes
12. meanwhile , preheat oven to 350 f
13. bake for 15 to 20 minutes
14. while rolls bake , beat together cream cheese , softened butter , confectioners' sugar , vanilla and salt
15. remove rolls from oven and top with frosting
target.review: Great cinnamon rolls!  My husband loves these and they are very easy to make.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pete s scratch pancakes

it was the fall of 1987 when pete nyhus walked into our office, just to visit. we started talking about breakfast, and he reached into a wastepaper basket and pulled out a scrap of teletype paper. he wrote out this recipe, and my family has never used pre-mix since.

1. mix the dry items first
2. combine the eggs and melted butter to the milk and slowly stir into the flour mixture
3. let sit at least 10 minutes while heating the pan
4. these will be high , but light and fluffy --
demonstrations.review: The best pancakes ever!  Light and fluffy, just how pancakes should be.  I have tried several other pancake recipes and this is by far the best.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
incredible grill cheese sandwiches

originally from southern living; given to me by my lifelong best friend. comfort food

1. combine first 6 ingredients
2. spread 1 side of bread slices evenly with butter
3. turn 8 slices buttered side down
4. spread evenly with cheese mixture
5. top with ham , if desired , and remaining bread slices , buttered side up
6. in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat , cook sandwiches two at a time until golden , turning once
demonstrations.review: Only grilled cheese my husband will eat now!  I have also added thinly sliced black forest ham which he really like.  I am a vegetarian so I regularly add tomatoes and/or green peppers to my grilled cheese sandwich and it turns out great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
parmesan bow ties

kid favorite.

1. cook noodles according to package directions
2. drain
3. transfer to a serving bowl
4. add the remaining ingredients
5. toss to coat
demonstrations.review: This was so easy and very good!  I used dried pasrsley and added red pepper flakes and it turned out great!  Thanks for another great recipe NurseDi.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white fish in herbed butter

frequently requested, easy to make.

1. mix all but fish in small bowl
2. heat skillet
3. add butter mixture
4. add fish and saute for about 6-7 minutes on each side
5. garnish with lemon wedges
demonstrations.review: Very easy to make, especially if you plan to feed several people.  I melted the butter and then added the seasoning - much easier this way.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s hot chocolate mix

my mom's favorite hot chocolate mix. a little different from other mixes as this one has a box of instant chocolate pudding.

1. mix all together
2. store in airtight container
3. use 1 / 3 mix to 2 / 3 water when making hot chocolate
demonstrations.review: I sent this to my husband while he was in Iraq.  His soldiers loved it!  I made 2 batches and it was gone almost as quickly as it was opened.  I mixed the ingredients and then put them through a food processor, as another reviewer recommended.  Very smooth and creamy - delicious!

target.recipe_text:
baklava muffins

i love baklava and this is a delightful treat that brings the same flavors through.    from how to be a  domestic goddess by nigella lawson.

1. preheat oven to 400f degrees
2. mix all the filling ingredients together in a small bowl , set aside
3. in a large bowl , mix together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and sugar
4. mix the egg , melted butter and buttermilk
5. make a well in the dry ingredients and add gently mix in the wet ingredients
6. fill 12 miffin cups 1 / 3 full , add a scant tablespoon of filling , cover with more muffin mixture until 2 / 3 full
7. sprinkle any remaining filling on top of the muffins
8. bake for 15 minutes
9. put the muffins onto a rack to cool and drizzle with honey
target.review: These are really good, DEFINITELY USE THE LINERS. They are easy and super fluffy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
melt in your mouth chicken breasts

the mayonnaise make these chicken breast very moist and tender--enjoy!

1. mix mayonnaise or yogurt , cheese and seasonings
2. spread mixture over chicken breast and place in baking dish
3. bake at 375f for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: This recipe is really easy, my 11 year old, who loves to cook and I made it. It was a little bit salty I didn't anticipate the saltiness of the parmesan, perhaps I would have used a little less seasoned salt. We doubled the recipe for our family and had a little left over which I enjoyed in a salad the next day. Thanks for a yummy & quick recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
teriyaki marinade for london broil

my mother-in-law made this for dinner one night and i just had to have the recipe. it made the most tender london broil. plan to marinate overnight. prep time includes marinating time.

1. combine marinade ingredients and pour into a large zippered freezer bag
2. pierce london broil several times with sharp fork and place in bag with marinade
3. refrigerate overnight or at least 8 hours
4. grill for 10 to 15 minutes per side or according to desired doneness
demonstrations.review: Yummy & Easy. great with the jalapeno in it. I I grilled this up tonight and was apprehensive about using london broil but it was tender and flavorfull. Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork chops with apricot sauce

from all you magazine.  i haven't tried this one yet, but it looks good to me.  it says you can use honey or orange marmalade in place of apricot jam, or a flavored mustard.  and it says it's good with a tablespoon or two of chopped fresh rosemary or thyme.
i don't know why recipezaar and the magazin show such a huge difference in nutritional information, but the recipe shows:  per serving:  310 calories, 13g fat (2g sat.), 60mg chol., 0g fiber, 21g pro., 28g carb., 577mg sod.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. mist a baking dish with cooking spray
3. season pork chops with salt and pepper
4. warm oil in a lare skillet over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
5. add chops and cook until nicely browned , about 3 minutes per side
6. transfer chops to prepared baking dish and cook through in oven , 10 to 20 minutes , depending on how thick the chops are
7. pour off fat from skillet and add chicken broth
8. bring to a boil over high heat , stirring with a wooden spoon or heatproof spatula to pick up any browned bits on bottom of skillet
9. boil rapidly until liquid is reduced by half , 3 to 5 minutes
10. add apricot jam and bring mixture back to a boil
11. cook sauce , stirring , until thick and syrupy , about 2 minutes
12. stir in mustard
13. lower heat on stove to medium and returned cooked pork chops to skillet along with any accumulated juices in baking dish
14. turn pork chops several times in sauce to coat
15. spoon remaining sauce over chops and serve hot
demonstrations.review: Thanks for the recipe good sauce husband liked it and he is not generally a pork lover. I agree my chops were extra thick and we did need 20 minutes in the oven.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
greek chicken and cucumber sauce

greek chicken and cucumber sauce

1. combine marinade ingredients and pour over chicken
2. marinate in the fridge for up to 24 hours
3. remove chicken from marinade and grill over medium heat for 5 -7 minutes per side
4. serve with rice , or oven roasted potatoes , and cucumber sauce
5. makes 4 servings
6. after marinating , thread the strips onto skewers and grill for 5 - 7 minutes per side
7. cucumber sauce:
8. in a strainer mix cucumber and salt and set aside for at least 15 minutes
9. squeeze excess liquid from cucumber
10. blend grated cucumber with remaining sauce ingredients and refrigerate until needed
11. serve with greek chicken
12. gently squeeze the excess liquid out of the mixture
demonstrations.review: Loved this recipe! The only difference is that I used chicken thighs which were soooo good. I made this with the sauce and kittencal's greek salad. Thank you for this yummy recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the ultimate salmon fillets

living on the west coast, we have eaten a great deal of salmon. this is absolutely the best way we have found to cook it. it is so moist and the flavor is fantastic! many reviewers have said that they think the cheese, especially the cheddar is unnecessary, and i have to admit that i omit the cheddar cheese myself. the flavour is a little too strong and it is extra fat that is not needed. i do like the sprinkling of parmesan with the paprika because it looks so nice when it is broiled. using light mayonnaise and light sour cream or yogurt tastes just as good as the full fat versions and cuts down fat and calories even more. thanks for all the great reviews!

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. if frozen , partially thaw fillets and cut into serving size pieces
3. place in a greased baking dish
4. combine sour cream or yogurt , mustard , onion , dill , and mayonnaise
5. season with salt and pepper
6. spread mixture over fish
7. bake 20 minutes per inch of thickness of fish if frozen or 10-12 minutes if thawed
8. when just done , sprinkle with the cheeses and a dash of paprika
9. broil 1 minute or until the cheese is bubbly and flecked with brown
10. serve with lemon wedges
demonstrations.review: Everyone is right this is delicious! I messed up just like the prev review and added the parmesan to the sauce mixture, followed all of the rest exactly. It still turned out really well. Also I used all low cal ingredients, but you could not tell at all. We wil be making this again for sure. My three little girls loved it.

target.recipe_text:
chocolate cupcakes with chocolate frosting

i can't seem to get enough chocolate lately and these cupcakes were among my victims. this recipe comes from a chicago bakery called sweet mandy b's and these cupcakes will make you happy!

1. cupcakes: sift the flour , cocoa , baking soda , baking powder and salt into the bowl of a heavy mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
2. add sugar
3. turn the mixer on low and add , in order
4. water , milk , eggs , oil and vanilla
5. scrape down the sides of the bowl and beat on medium , briefly , to achieve a smooth batter
6. scoop the batter into muffin tins lines with paper baking cups
7. each cup should be about half full
8. slide the tins onto a baking sheet and bake at 325 until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 30 minutes
9. while cupcakes are cooling , prepare the frosting
10. frosting: cream the butter in the bowl of a mixer , using the paddle attachment
11. beat in the corn syrup , vanilla and salt
12. with the machine off , spoon in the cocoa
13. carefully turn the mixer on low so as to avoid death by cocoa inhalement
14. do likewise for the sugar , in three parts
15. last , add the cream then beat until fluffy
16. when the cupcakes are completely cool , frost generously and shake on some sprinkles if you like
target.review: These cupcakes taste good but did not work out. After reading reviews I was careful to not overfill and they still overflowed. They stuck to the top of the pan and the tops of the cupcakes pulled off when I tried to carefully release them. They also stuck to the wrappers and crumbled. I really wish these would have worked out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic and onion dip

really fast and easy dip that's sure to draw a crowd every time you put it out.

1. stir sourcream , mayo and sugar in a bowl
2. add remaining spices , stir till well combined
3. adjust seasoning to taste
demonstrations.review: This was a very tasty dip. I left out the onion powder and used a sauteed onion instead. I am sure it would be just as good with the powder. Thanks for sharing the recipe. Everyone loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
awesome baked ham

i love this recipe because it is so easy and it calls for hardly any ingredients, and i always have these ingredients in my pantry. this recipe came from a good friend's mother, who was always asked to bake the ham for get-togethers and family dinners. now i get those requests. people who ordinarily aren't too fond of ham rave over this one. after i carve, i spoon a little of the glaze over the meat in the platter - yummmm!

1. in a medium size mixing bowl , mix yellow mustard and brown sugar until you have a thick"paste"
2. take all wrappers off of ham and trim away excess fat
3. line baking pan with aluminum foil
4. place ham on foil and spread brown sugar / mustard paste on top
5. fold and seal foil
6. do not open again until ham is done
7. bake at 350 for 4 hours
8. let set for about 1 hr then carve
9. one of the best tasting hams you will ever have !
demonstrations.review: I followed your directions exactly. My family loved it! This really is an awesome baked ham. Thank you for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
any fruit fast fat free cobbler

this fabulous dessert is 3 ww points a serving and can be made with fresh, canned, or frozen fruit. it is adapted from a recipe in the 

1. combine all of the ingredients except the fruit in a bowl
2. pour it into an 8x8 pan coated with cooking spray
3. add the fruit right on top
4. the crust will come up over the fruit and cover it
5. bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes
demonstrations.review: Very easy to make and it was very delicious. thank you for sharing the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy baked sweet potato  fries

this recipe is adapted from a weight loss websites newsletter. posted for 2006 zaar world tour - mexico

1. preheat oven to 450f with aluminum foil or parchment paper , line a cookie sheet
2. in a medium bowl , combine sweet potatoes with olive oil and seasonings
3. mix well to evenly coat potatoes
4. place potato strips on the foil or parchment lined cookie sheet and leave space between strips for even baking
5. bake for approximately 15 minutes or until potatoes become crispy
6. turn strips every 5 to 7 minutes as needed
7. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: These were good but next time I will add a bit more of the spices. Thanks for sharing this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy beans and weenies cups for kids

kids of all ages would enjoy these! adjust all ingredients to taste

1. set oven to 400 degrees
2. in a bowl mix together pork and beans with sliced hot dogs , bbq sauce , brown sugar and onions
3. remove the dough from the package and press each biscuit into a greased muffin cup
4. fill each cup with the bean / hot dog mixture
5. bake for about 10-12 minutes
6. sprinkle each with grated cheddar cheese and serve
demonstrations.review: Great idea to make this in a biscuit cup. It was very good but I thought the bbq sauce was a bit to much (it could have just been the brand I used) but next time I will use less.

target.recipe_text:
gnocchi with chicken sausage  bell pepper  and fennel

from cooking light. april 2008. trader joe's has the most wonderful chicken sausages that would be perfect for this dish.

1. cook the gnocchi according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. drain the gnocchi in a colander over a bowl , reserving 1 / 4 cup cooking liquid
3. keep gnocchi warm
4. heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. add sausage to pan
6. saut 3 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring frequently
7. remove sausage from skillet using a slotted spoon
8. heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in pan
9. add fennel , bell pepper , and onion to pan
10. cook 13 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
11. add sausage , gnocchi , cheese , black pepper , and reserved cooking liquid to pan
12. cook 1 minute or until cheese melts , stirring constantly
13. remove from heat
14. stir in parsley
target.review: This was delicious, the flavours were lovely. I think I may have put twice as much sausage, fennel and reserved water to make it go further. Believe all ingredients were followed. Threw a bit of chilli in because we had some that needed to be used. Gnocchi was the baby gnocchi which I prefer since it seems to go further. Thanks for a great dinner.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
arroz de coco e papaia  angola

this recipe is from week nine of my food blog, "travel by stove." i am attempting to cook one meal from every country on earth, and angola is my ninth stop. this is an angolan side dish made from rice, coconut milk and papayas.

1. thin the coconut milk with the water
2. add the rice , salt and cinnamon
3. bring to a boil , then cover and reduce heat
4. simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is done
5. fluff the rice with a fork and let stand covered for 10 minutes
6. meanwhile , cut and seed the papaya , then finely dice it
7. mash half of the dice and keep the other half as-is
8. put both the mashed papaya and the diced papaya into the rice and mix , warming over the stove
demonstrations.review: This rice was amazing! The flavours were so delicate but the little bursts of papaya were so great. I served this with your recipe #466888 made for My Food Odyssey.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pizza for wine tasting

cheese and fruit plates-uh, so 20th century. impress your guests to this berry-bursting, cheese-oozing taste sensation on your favorite crust or flatbread. or, surprise your honey with a bottle (or two!) of good wine, romantic movie, candles and this pizza and see what happens. add grilled chicken or thinly sliced prosciutto and it's filling enough that you won't have to go out for dinner.

1. preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. slice cherries in sixths , removing the pits , so they're roughly the same size as the blueberries
3. mix together all berry sauce ingredients
4. cut brie in thin quarter-inch pieces
5. spread mascarpone evenly across pizza crust , then drizzle berry sauce evenly across the top , then place brie slices across the top , evenly-spaced
6. bake for 12-15 minutes or until crust starts to turn golden and brie is melted
7. sprinkle caviar across the top , if desired
8. cut in thin slivers and serve hot
demonstrations.review: Wow, this was amazing. I think I had too much sauce for my pizza base, but no worries, I will adjust for next time. Totally delish and looking forward to making again with chicken next time. Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet potato curry with spinach and chickpeas

this a wonderfully full flavored, vegetarian curry. the recipe is adapted from a recipe that i received in an email from vegetarian times.

1. you may choose to cook the sweet potatoes however you prefer
2. i like to peel , chop and steam mine in a veggie steamer for about 15 minutes
3. baking or boiling work well too
4. while sweet potatoes cook , heat 1-2 tsp of canola or vegetable oil over medium heat
5. add onions and saut 2-3 minutes , or until they begin to soften
6. next , add the curry powder , cumin , and cinnamon , and stir to coat the onions evenly with spices
7. add tomatoes with their juices , and the chickpeas , stir to combine
8. add cup water and raise heat up to a strong simmer for about a minute or two
9. next , add the fresh spinach , a couple handfuls at a time , stirring to coat with cooking liquid
10. when all the spinach is added to the pan , cover and simmer until just wilted , about 3 minutes
11. add the cooked sweet potatoes to the liquid , and stir to coat
12. simmer for another 3-5 minutes , or until flavors are well combined
13. transfer to serving dish , toss with fresh cilantro , and serve hot
14. this dish is nice served over basmati or brown rice
demonstrations.review: Very yummy and easy, put spinach in last so it was less wilty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai chicken fried rice with basil   kao pad krapao

another delicious way to enjoy fried rice, fragrant with the heady aroma of basil!

1. in a wok or large skillet , stir-fry garlic in oil until golden
2. then add chilies and chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked
3. add rice , sugar , fish sauce , and soy sauce , and stir-fry , mixing gently
4. when well mixed , add shallots , basil leaves and cilantro
5. cook another minute or so , and serve
6. if you desire , serve with lime wedges , chile sauce , fish sauce , or soy sauce at the table
demonstrations.review: This is soooo yummy. Easy to prepare. I only but a little bit of chilli in since I'm a sook. I used palm sugar as well. Thanks for sharing. I'm looking foward to doing this one with prawns as well.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
broedlaewend  romanian beef soup

a romanian beef soup adapted from the balkan cookbook by inge kramarz.

1. saute onion in oil for 10 minutes
2. add meat and saute for 5 minutes
3. add broth and simmer for 1 hour
4. add potatoes , salt , pepper and bay leaves
5. simmer for 20 minutes
6. remove bay leaves
7. remove 1 / 2 cup broth from the soup and slowly stir in the flour , add the flour mixture to the soup
8. simmer for 3 minutes
9. add vinegar , cream and parsley
10. stir , remove from heat and serve
demonstrations.review: This was magnificant, i followed recipe exactly. Didn't state what type of vinegar was used, so i used red wine. I really liked how the flour portian made a sort of 'gnocci' texture in there. Definately want to make sure you break that mixture up so you don't just get one big chunk. Thanks for a great recipe, can't wait to make it again.

target.recipe_text:
creamy cajun chicken pasta

n'awlin's style of chicken with an updated alfredo sauce.

1. place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
2. in a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. reduce heat add green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
4. pour over hot linguine and toss with parmesan cheese
target.review: Followed recipe except for substituting fresh basil for the dried and using olive oil in place of the butter.  Was very tasty. Next time I would add way more cajun seasoning and I found the sauce to be on the thin side, rather than creamy. Will make again, will work on the creaminess.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with fettuccine alfredo

juicy chicken with a great creamy alfredo sauce. very easy to make!

1. cook fettuccine according to package
2. drain
3. while fettuccine is cooking , prepare chicken
4. heat 12-inch skillet
5. add 2 tbsp butter
6. flatten chicken slightly
7. salt and pepper chicken
8. roll in flour , add to skillet
9. cook and brown until juices run clear , about 10 minutes
10. remove from skillet
11. add to skillet 2 tbs butter , onions , and garlic
12. cook 1 minute
13. add cream , cook for 3 minutes until reduced a bit
14. add cheese , parsley , and red pepper flakes
15. stir well
16. add last 1 tbsp butter and stir well
17. bring back chicken and coat with sauce
18. place chicken on plates , put fettuccine in sauce and swirl around to coat well
19. add to plate with chicken
demonstrations.review: Was looking for a fast fettuccine alfredo recipe, made this with shrimp instead of chicken, left out the flour and parsley, came out fantastic.  It was devoured :) Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tortellini tomato spinach soup

really healthy soup, good to use when there's no time to spend in the kitchen!

1. in a soup pot , heat olive oil over medium high heat
2. saute the onion and garlic , stirring often until onions are translucent , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. add broth and tomatoes , turn heat up to high , and bring to a boil
4. add the tortellini and cook according to package instructions
5. when tortellini is almost done , add spinach and taste , adjusting seasonings with salt and pepper
6. serve immediately
7. garnish each serving with a sprinkling of parmesan
demonstrations.review: I decided to use this recipe because of the great reviews and because I was looking for a recipe that would use up my tomatoes and fresh spinach.  I did not have tortellini, so I used chicken instead and a 1/2 cup of rice that I added with the broth. I know this changes the recipe, but it also shows the versatility it has when you just don't have certain ingredients on hand.  I also upped the amount of garlic cloves because my boyfriend and I love garlic :)  The soup was fantastic topped with fresh mozzarella cheese.  I will definitely try it with cheese tortellini next time.  I also used fresh tomatoes because I did not have canned.  Thanks for a great one :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garden vegetable soup

nan

1. spray a large saucepan with non-stick cooking spray
2. saute the carrot , onion and garlic over low heat until softened , about 5 minutes
3. add broth , cabbage , green beans , tomato paste and simmer , covered about 15 minutes or until beans are tender
4. stir in zucchini and heat 3-4 minutes
5. serve hot
demonstrations.review: This soup is delicious! I added corn, mushrooms, and upped the amount of garlic.  I left out the green beans and zucchini because I did not have any.  I added half a can of stewed tomatoes because I was out of tomato paste and thought it would add depth to the flavor.  Also sauteed the cabbage with the carrot, onion, and garlic.  Came out great!  Added mozzarella cheese and croutons once it was ready to serve and everyone loved it :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken makhani  indian butter chicken

wow! i just finished making this and it tastes incredible! it tastes better than the chicken makhani at my favorite indian restaurant! you can make this as mild or spicy as you wish by adjusting the cayenne. serve with basmati rice and naan bread. i got the recipe from allrecipes.com.

1. heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat
2. saute shallot and onion until soft and translucent
3. stir in butter , lemon juice , ginger garlic paste , 1 teaspoon garam masala , chili powder , cumin and bay leaf
4. cook , stirring , for 1 minute
5. add tomato puree and cook for 2 minutes , stirring frequently
6. stir in half-and-half and yogurt
7. reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes , stirring frequently
8. season with salt , pepper and cayenne
9. remove from heat and set aside
10. heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large heavy skillt over medium heat
11. cook chicken until lightly browned , about 10 minutes
12. reduce heat and season with 1 teaspoon garam masala and cayenne
13. stir in about 1 / 3 of the sauce and simmer until liquid has reduced and chicken is no longer pink , about 5 minutes
14. pour the rest of the sauce into the chicken
15. mix together cornstarch and water , then stir into the sauce
16. cook for 5 to 10 minutes , or until thickened
demonstrations.review: I was craving some Indian food and this seemed fast & easy enough.  Turned out fantastic!  Left out onions/shallots because I did not have any, used 4 tbs. butter, cut a lemon in half, squeezed the juice into sauce then cooked the lemon along w/ the sauce, used two tsp. of garam masala & cumin.  Did not have tomato puree, subbed 2 tbs. tomato paste with 1 cup water.  This is a great recipe to play around w/ and make it more spicy/buttery according to your tastes.  Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai style ground beef

a wonderful recipe from cooking light.  a delicious way to use ground beef.  you can make it spicier by using more red curry paste.

1. heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. coat pan with cooking spray
3. add leek
4. saut 5 minutes
5. add garlic
6. saut 1 minute
7. add beef
8. cook 7 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring to crumble
9. stir in curry paste and tomato sauce
10. cook until half of liquid evaporates
11. add milk and next 4 ingredients
12. cook 2 minutes or until slightly thickened
13. serve with the rice
demonstrations.review: This is a very delicious recipe! I like to make it a bit more spicy by adding red chili paste and sometimes substitute onions for the leeks.  I make it a few times a month, as my boyfriend and I just love it :) update: added mushrooms along with a tablespoon of curry powder, and a tablespoon of minced ginger and it definitely gave it the flavor that I was looking for. :)

target.recipe_text:
low fat carrot cake muffins  that don t taste low fat

except for the small amount of oil these muffins are low-fat, but you would never know it, they bake out high with tons of flavor and are extremely moist, you may throw in some chopped nuts also --- for greasing see my recipe#78579 --- for more low fat muffin recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. line 12 muffin tins with paper liners or spray tins with non-stick cooking spray
3. in a large bowl mix together first 7 ingredients
4. in a small bowl whisk together egg , oil , milk and vanilla
5. in a medium bowl mix the shredded carrots with the crushed pineapple
6. add in the oil / egg mixture into the carrot / pineapple mixture
7. mix well to combine , then add to the dry ingredients
8. mix just until combined
9. add in the raisins and chopped nuts
10. divide the mixture between the 12 muffin tins
11. bake for about 20-25 minutes , or until the muffins test done
target.review: Awesome recipe! I used 100% whole wheat flour and soy milk and got great results! These were easy to make and really did not taste low fat - they were very moist!!! I will definitely make these again! Thanks Kittencal for this great recipe!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
healthy no bake cookies

i played around with my family's no bake cookie recipe and produced a single portion of this cookie that i feel is healthy enough to eat as a meal.  they’re still very good but are much healthier. i keep getting asked for the recipe, so i finally decided to measure out the exact portions and post the recipe. this recipe is very flexible! when i make them i never measure out anything and i often add more or less of ingredients and they still taste great.  i sometimes leave out the wheat germ and flax seeds and just add more oatmeal.  i have made these replacing the sugar with about 3 tablespoons of honey.  i have changed the recipe from 1 tsp. to 1 tbsp. of cocoa powder.

1. heat milk , sugar and cocoa powder over high heat until boiling , stirring constantly
2. take off heat and stir in vanilla and peanut butter
3. stir until peanut butter has melted completely
4. stir in wheat germ and oatmeal
5. drop by large spoonfuls onto wax paper or eat immediately
6. as i
7. if you don't have wheat germ or flax seed , just use more oatmeal
8. the recipe above should work out just perfectly and does most of the time , but if your cookies come out crumbly , use less oatmeal next time
9. if they never set , use more oatmeal next time
demonstrations.review: Great recipe!! I used soy milk to make them non dairy but otherwise i followed the recipe exactly and was pleased with the results! Thanks Shagun!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
light carrot cocoa snack cake    brownies

a very light, low calorie snack cake. i agree with the reviewers, not a browie at all, but that was the name on the recipe, so i stuck with it. super easy, and a healthy way to get some carrots into a dessert!

1. preheat oven to 350 and spray a 9 inch square pan with sprayable oil
2. mix cocoa , flour and baking powder in a bowl
3. mix in shredded carrots and sugar
4. in another small bowl , mix egg whites , milk , apple sauce and vanilla
5. lightly beat with fork and add to dry ingredients
6. mix just until blended
7. pour batter into pan and bake for 20-25 minutes
8. cool and cut into squares
demonstrations.review: Great Recipe! This was very easy make and was almost guilt free. I used 100% whole wheat flour and soy milk instead of skim milk and still got great results! Thanks Kasha for this wonderful recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
new york crumb cake

i adopted this recipe from the recipezaar account. the previous owner said this recipe comes from martha stewart. it's a delicious cake!!

1. place rack in center of oven , and preheat oven to 325f lightly brush a 9-by-12 1 / 2-inch baking pan with canola oil , dust with flour , and tap to remove excess
2. set aside
3. in a medium bowl , sift together 1 1 / 2 cups flour , the granulated sugar , baking powder , and salt
4. set aside
5. in a second bowl , whisk together the egg , milk , canola oil , and vanilla
6. using a rubber spatula , fold dry ingredients into egg mixture
7. spread batter evenly into prepared pan , and set aside
8. in a medium bowl , combine remaining 2 1 / 2 cups flour , brown sugar , and cinnamon
9. pour melted butter over flour mixture , and toss with a rubber spatula until large crumbs form
10. top batter evenly with crumb topping
11. bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the cake tests done
12. turn the pan once during baking
13. transfer pan to a wire rack to cool
14. dust with confectioners' sugar
15. using a serrated knife or bench scraper , cut into 3-inch squares , and serve
demonstrations.review: Awesome crumb cake! The cake batter is thick but it bakes nicely. I baked the batter for 10 minutes and then sprinkled on the topping and baked for an additional 20 minutes for a perfect crumb cake. I used canola oil for the topping and used whole wheat flour and the recipe came out delicious! Thanks Courtly - will definitely be making again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple oat coffee cake

i like to have this for breakfast.

1. heat oven to 350f degrees
2. grease square pan , 9 9 2 inches
3. prepare oat streusel
4. set aside
5. beat remaining ingredients except apples in large bowl with electric mixer on low speed 30 seconds , scraping bowl frequently
6. beat on medium speed 2 minutes , scraping bowl occasionally
7. stir in apples
8. spread half of the batter in pan
9. sprinkle with half of the streusel
10. top with remaining batter
11. sprinkle with remaining streusel
12. bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. serve warm
14. garnish with apple slices
15. oat streusel-----------------------
16. cut margarine into oats , flour and brown sugar , using pastry blender or fork , until crumbly
17. stir in nuts
demonstrations.review: This recipe is fantastic! I made some healthy changes which included using all whole wheat flour and 1/4 cup oil and 1/2 cup applesauce instead of the margarine and also decreased the sugar to 1/3 of a cup. It smells and tastes great and will surely make again! Thanks Mirj!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stir fry chicken with garlic sauce

nice and simple. prep time includes marinating time.

1. combine garlic , soy sauce , water , honey , 1 tablespoon oil , cornstarch and black / red pepper
2. stir chicken into marinade and mix to coat
3. cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours , stirring once to twice
4. in large skillet , heat remaining oil
5. using slotted spoon , transfer chicken to skillet
6. stir-fry about 5 minutes
7. add reserved marinade
8. continue to cook and stir about 30 seconds until thickened
9. remove to platter
10. garnish with green onion
11. serve with snow peas , if desired
demonstrations.review: AMAZING! My hubby considers this one of his favorite dinners and I love it too! I double the marinade and put one in a separate container bec using the marinade the chicken was in is not healthy. I added brocolli and whole wheat pasta for a delicous hearty dinner!

target.recipe_text:
baked rigatoni   sausage  tuscan style

i saw this on a cooking show a long time ago - i think it was ciao italia, but i'm not sure.  it's very easy to make, and the addition of the cannellini beans makes a big difference in taste and heartiness, in my opinion.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in dutch oven over medium-high heat , cook sausage with the minced garlic until sausage is not longer pink and crumbled
3. drain
4. stir in tomato sauce , beans and italian seasoning
5. reduce heat and simmer until heated through , about 5 minutes
6. meanwhile , cook rigatoni according to package directions , just until al dente
7. drain and lightly butter
8. add cooked pasta to the meat sauce and toss until well coated
9. spray a 13x9x2-inch baking dish with pam
10. pour half of the pasta mixture in pan
11. sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese evenly on top
12. repeat
13. sprinkle grated romano cheese on the top
14. cover with foil and bake for 20 5- 25 minutes or until cheese is melted
15. garnish with chopped parsley and serve with crusty garlic bread and a salad
target.review: This dish was fabulous! It was simple to make and came out of the oven looking beautiful! Wish I had a camera to post a picture of it. The only change I made was to use mild Italian sausage. Yummy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roast beef horseradish spirals

very attractive looking appy! and good too. had some ladies over for a 

1. combine first 6 ingredients
2. place the two tortillas on work surface , spread half of cheese over each , top each with half of the roast beef slices , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border around edges
3. roll up , wrap tightly in plastic wrap
4. refrigerate until firm , 30 minutes or up to 1 day ahead
5. cut diagonally into 1 / 2 inch slices and serve
demonstrations.review: I made some substitutions but, they still turned out well! I used a tub of whipped cream cheese with chives and omitted the green onions. Also used creamy style horseradish sauce because that's what I had on hand. I couldn't find cheese tortillas so, I used sun-dried tomato flavor. A yummy appetizer!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butter brickle ice cream

my husband's favorite flavor.  cooking time includes chilling and freezing time.

1. in a medium sacepan , combine half & half , brown sugar , and butter
2. stir constantly over low heat
3. when mixture becomes bubbly around the edges of the pan , remove from heat
4. chill this mixture along with the bowl of your ice cream freezer
5. before freezing , add whipping cream and both extracts , mix well
6. freeze according to your ice cream maker directions
7. add toffee bits after freezing process
demonstrations.review: This ice cream was so flavorful and pretty simple to make. It's a favorite of my boyfriend and his mom so, I scored big points in making it for them! Thanks for such a great recipe. I plan on making more this week for my grandparents who are visiting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb green bean casserole

what is there not to like?  rich cheese, green beans and mayonnaise with lots of extra flavors rolled into one decadent dish.

1. melt the butter in a skillet and saute the onions , celery and mushrooms until soft
2. mix the mayonnaise and cream
3. mix everything together in a casserole and bake at 350f , covered , for 30 minutes
4. uncover and brown , if desired
demonstrations.review: This was a wonderful and tasty side dish!!! Thanks for sharing. It's nice to have options when you are trying to live a low carb lifestyle!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jolean s k sandwiches  exceptional tuna melts

don't know why my mom called these k-sandwiches, but my sisters and i still use this recipe to this day, and it's always been a favorite in our households...i think you'll be most pleasantly suprised!

1. preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. mix all ingredients in a bowl
3. spoon a generous amount of the tuna mixture onto the bottom half of the hot dog buns and cover with the top half
4. cut the filled sandwich buns in half
5. wrap each full sandwich bun in foil
6. place on cookie sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes
7. yum ! cheese melts perfectly every time !
demonstrations.review: Made these for dinner tonight and they were great! A little messy but, a fun summer sandwich!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy meat and cheese stromboli

this is from 30 minute meals on food network.  a simple, quick snack for the sunday football game or movie night.

1. pre-heat oven to 400 degrees
2. break open the tube of dough and remove it from container
3. dust your hands and lightly coat the dough with cornmeal then roll out onto work surface
4. stretch out dough , then cut the thin rectangular dough into 4 equal square pieces
5. cover each piece of dough with: 6 slices pepperoni , 1 1 / 2 slices cheese , 1 1 / 2 slices hot ham and 2 slices genoa salami
6. roll each piece on an angle from corner to corner making a long roll that is thicker in the middle and thinner on each end
7. brush rolls with extra-virgin olive oil then mix sesame seeds , cheese and seasonings in a small cup , sprinkle and pat the mixture into the dough
8. bake until evenly golden , 12 to 15 minutes then serve
9. if desired , serve with marinara sauce
demonstrations.review: This stromboli was so easy to make and tasted better than anything you can order out!!! We sliced them and served as part of our New Year's Eve spread...everyone raved about them!!! This is a keeper for sure!!!

target.recipe_text:
to die for crock pot roast

amazing flavor, and so simple! no salt needed here. in fact, you may wish to use half the ranch dressing mix to cut back on the saltiness. found this crock-pot pot roast recipe on of a website called www.recipegoldmine.com. it's all the rage there, so i thought i'd try it.

1. place beef roast in crock pot
2. mix the dried mixes together in a bowl and sprinkle over the roast
3. pour the water around the roast
4. cook on low for 7-9 hours
5. use onion soup mix instead of ranch
6. add one cup , of red wine
7. add potatoes , carrots , mushrooms , celery and onion 2-3 hours before end
target.review: Easy and good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
balsamic chicken thighs

this is a quick and easy recipe that never fails to please even my picky dds. since chicken thighs are usually inexpensive it makes a economical meal. i like to serve these with some type of rice side dish and a green salad.

1. spray large frying pan , preheat
2. rinse and pat dry thighs
3. season with salt and pepper
4. brown well on all sides
5. cover , reduce heat to medium and cook for approximately 25 minutes , or'til thighs are done depending on size
6. add shallots , cook for 2-3 minutes , until they soften
7. stir in balsamic vinegar , cook for about 1 more minute , turn chicken to coat thoroughly
8. spoon sauce over thighs to serve
demonstrations.review: Simple and extremely tasty.  What more can you ask for?  I can even do this one by heart!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mahogany beef stew

you will not believe the deeply satisfying flavour of this stew. this is our favourite wintry stew dish - comfort food to the max.  the cooking time is more or less accurate, but it really depends on the cut of meat used -  not everyone used chuck, and then, not all chuck is the same!  you really have to poke and prod and taste to get it to where you want it...but that's what cooking is all about, isn't it? ;-)

1. heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in heavy large pot over high heat
2. sprinkle meat with salt and pepper
3. add meat to pot
4. saut until brown on all sides , about 10 minutes
5. push meat to sides of pot
6. reduce heat to medium
7. add 2 tablespoons oil to pot
8. add onions
9. saut until golden brown , about 15 minutes
10. mix meat into onions
11. add 1 cup wine , tomatoes with juices , garlic , herbs , hoisin sauce , and bay leaves
12. bring to boil
13. reduce heat to low , cover pot and simmer 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
14. add carrots and 1 cup wine
15. cover
16. simmer 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
17. uncover , increase heat to high
18. boil until sauce is slightly thickened , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes longer
19. reduce heat to medium , add cornstarch mixture and simmer until sauce thickens , stirring occasionally , about 8 minutes
20. discard bay leaves
21. season stew with salt and pepper
22. transfer stew to large bowl
23. sprinkle with parsley and serve
24. excellent with buttered egg noodles
demonstrations.review: We really liked this.  I made it last night, put in the refrigerator and had it tonight for dinner.  I think the overnight stay in the refrigerator only enhanced the deliciousness.  I didn't add any cornstarch, and served it over egg noodles.  Thank you, Evelyn!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey mustard dressing  another one

this is absolutely wonderful on any salad.  very easy to make and will keep in a covered jar in the refrigerator for several weeks.  the parsley is a nice change.  got this from best of the best of arkansas and altered it a little for our taste.  i don't have any idea how many servings you get, but it makes a little over 2 cups of dressing. cooking time is chill time.  hope you enjoy.

1. combine all ingredients , except oil
2. add oil slowly , whisking it constantly
3. refrigerate for at least an hour to let the flavors blend
4. this dressing just keeps getting better the longer it sits
demonstrations.review: YUM!!  We all loved this!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best ever waffles

every sunday morning, my mom and i used to get up early and make these wonderful waffles. this recipe has been in the family for years, and i will definitly be passing it down to my children.

1. in a large mixing bowl , whisk together all dry ingredients
2. separate the eggs , adding the yolks to the dry ingredient mixture , and placing the whites in a small mixing bowl
3. beat whites until moderately stiff
4. set aside
5. add milk and melted butter to dry ingredient mixture and blend
6. fold stiff egg whites into mixture
7. ladle mixture into hot waffle iron and bake
demonstrations.review: Wow-ee!  Crisp on the outside and tender in the middle.  Very, very good.  I prepared the recipe just as posted, I've always thought that the egg seperating thing was a hassle, but not so much when the results are this good.  Thanks, Elaine!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
melt in your mouth chicken breasts

the mayonnaise make these chicken breast very moist and tender--enjoy!

1. mix mayonnaise or yogurt , cheese and seasonings
2. spread mixture over chicken breast and place in baking dish
3. bake at 375f for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: This is very good, and very easy.  I'm reviewing recipes for a dinner for 300 that I have to cook for my church and this one's on the top of the list.  I'm going to try it again and add the mustard, as I thought it needed just a little more punch, but is perfectly good as is, as well.

target.recipe_text:
cauliflower fritters

just trust me. these are so addictive. you can eat them hot or i like to eat them cold the next day for lunch.

1. in the microwave , cook the cauliflower in a covered dish with two tablespoon of water until soft
2. drain the cauliflower and mash with the back of a fork or potato masher
3. add the egg , salt and pepper , and enough flour until you can form patties
4. about 1 / 4 cup
5. add enough oil to coat the bottom of a skillet
6. over medium high heat , brown the caulflower patties
7. eat !
target.review: I picked this recipe to prepare for the PAC 2008.....and to my surprise these were very good!!! I didn't microwave my cauliflower, I steamed it in my steamer, but I think I might have overdone it. When I mashed the cauliflower, it was really wet and sticky; I added about 1/2 cup of flour, the egg, and then seasoned it.  I was pleasantly surprised and will definitely be making these again....they were so easy!!  I wonder if broccoli would be great too?  Hmmm....we'll have to make that and see.  Thanks for sharing the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best albondigas soup

this albondigas soup recipe was given to me from my mother-in-law. it's definitely one my favorite soups. honestly, it's better than most restaurants that i've tried.

1. make the meatballs first: combine everything and mix thoroughly
2. form meatballs and roll between your palms
3. you should make around 20 to 24 meatballs , set aside
4. combine chicken broth , onion , celery , tomatoes and their liquid , cumin , oregano and cilantro leaves in a large pot
5. bring to boil , and reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
6. drop meatballs in the soup
7. return to simmer and cook another 10 minutes
8. add zucchini and cook 10 minutes
9. season with salt and pepper , to taste
10. you could top the soup with cooked rice , or just by itself
demonstrations.review: I've been fighting a cold and wanted soup....I tried this recipe tonight and it was so flavorful.  Although I doubled it, since I have a huge family to feed and want leftovers for the next day; it tasted wonderful.  I also added diced potatoes, frozen corn, and some cooked rice to the broth.  Very hearty and filling, thanks for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
uncle bill s whipped shortbread cookies

these are very easy to make shortbread cookies. they are so good that they melt in your mouth, you hardly have to chew them. i have been making them for over 35 years.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a mixing bowl and using an electric mixer , combine butter , flour , icing sugar and vanilla extract
3. mix until mixture is a smooth consistency
4. prepare cookie sheets with parchment paper
5. spoon out dough onto parchment lined cookie sheets by teaspoonfuls or by tablespoons for larger cookies , spacing about 2 inches apart
6. cut maraschino cherries into quarters and place one piece in the middle of each cookie , alternating with red and green cherries
7. bake in preheated 350 f oven for 13 to 15 minutes or until bottom of cookies are lightly browned , do not overbake
8. remove from oven and let cool on cookie sheet for about 5 minutes
9. transfer onto wire racks to finish cooling
10. store in a container with a lid and separate each layer with wax paper
11. use sprinkles , half an almond or half a cashew or chocolate to the top of the cookies before baking
12. a thumbprint in the cookie , filled with your choice of jam is very tasty
13. it has been suggested that the cookies be refrigerated for at least 1 / 2 hour before baking for a different texture
demonstrations.review: I made these to send out as part of my cookie exchange, but didn't really care for them.  They were too bland for my taste.  I can't compete with the numerous 5-stars, but this is just my opinion. My family just picked the cherry off the tops and left part of the cookie behind.....that said it all for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana bread w chocolate chips

the chocolate chips really compliment the banana flavor. after trying numerous banana bread recipes, this is the first one that never gets thrown out! very moist!

1. mix the sugar , shortening , egg and banana together
2. put the flour , salt and baking soda in a smaller bowl
3. stir slightly
4. combine with banana mixture
5. stir in nuts , and chocolate chips
6. pour into two greased and floured loaf pans
7. bake at 350f for 35 minutes or until bread springs back
8. i have also added crushed pineapple for a change
demonstrations.review: I made this today and it was so moist and full of flavor.  The chocolate chips added that extra special MMMMMMMM.  The only thing I did differently was cut back the sugar to 1 3/4 cups and omitted the nuts, just because of preference.  It still tasted FANTASTICO!!  I think from now on I'll just buy old bananas to make this bread....Thanks for sharing!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker macaroni   cheese

this paula deen recipe is another family favorite

1. boil the macaroni in a 2 quart saucepan in plenty of water until tender , about 7 minutes
2. drain
3. in a medium saucepan , mix butter and cheese
4. stir until the cheese melts
5. in a slow cooker , combine cheese / butter mixture and add the eggs , sour cream , soup , salt , milk , mustard and pepper and stir well
6. then add drained macaroni and stir again
7. cook for 3 hours , stirring occasionally
demonstrations.review: According to my kids....THIS IS THE BEST MAC N' CHEESE they've ever had.  It was moist and so creamy and not dried out at all.  I did double the recipe, cause my kids just love mac n'cheese, but I only added 3 eggs, and it still came out wonderful!!  Thanks for sharing this recipe....this is a definite keeper for every holiday.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
our thanksgiving treat baked crab rangoon

i loooovvveeee crab rangoons! i usually get them just a few times of year, since they are fried and i'm serious about my waistline :) these are baked and much better for you; you can "save" at least 80 calories on each crab rangoon. so enjoy and make them often!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. mix crab meat , cream cheese , onions and mayo
3. spray 12 medium muffin cups with cooking spray
4. gently place 1 won ton wrapper in each cup , allowing edges of wrappers to extend above sides of cups
5. fill evenly with crab meat mixture
6. sprinkle with paprika
7. bake 18 to 20 minute or until edges are golden brown and filling is heated through
8. serve warm
9. garnish with chopped green onions , if desired
demonstrations.review: One word....YUMMY!!  Made these for PAC Fall 2008 and will definitely make them again for the upcoming holidays.  Thanks for sharing!!

target.recipe_text:
greek baked shrimp with feta

this is a delicious recipe, and one i have enjoyed many times. it would make an excellent appetizer for entertaining as well as a great dinner idea!

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. remove shells from shrimp , leaving last segment and tail intact
3. remove vein
4. rinse and dry
5. in a pan saute onion in oil until transparent , , add garlic and green onion and cook 2 minutes more
6. to the onions add the tomatoes , wine , half the parsley , oregano , and salt and pepper to taste
7. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes until thickened
8. pour half the sauce into a shallow casserole , and arrange the shrimp on top
9. pour the rest of the sauce on , and sprinkle crumbled feta over the shrimp
10. bake at 450 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until prawns are pink and feta is lightly browned
11. garnish with remaining parsley and serve
target.review: Made it with cous cous for a quick and easy meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sea scallops with sauce meuniere

delectable pan-seared sea scallops, with a classic french browned butter and lemon sauce! quick and easy recipe.

1. rinse scallops in cold water
2. pat dry with paper towels
3. in a large saute pan , heat 3 tablespoons butter on high heat until sizzling
4. add scallops
5. immediately reduce heat to medium , and cook scallops 2 to 3 minutes per side until lightly browned , turning once
6. melt the rest of the butter in with the scallops then add the chopped green onions and the garlic , tossing to coat and saute for 2 minutes
7. add the wine and cook for 1 minute more
8. remove from heat and season with salt and cayenne
9. sprinkle with the snipped parsley
10. serve hot with a generous squeeze of fresh lemon
demonstrations.review: Simple and delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken paillardes with mustard cream   tarragon sauce

a french dish shamelessly stolen from the web!

1. sprinkle each chicken breast with 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
2. heat the olive oil in a large skillet over med-high heat
3. add the chicken and saut until cooked through , turning just once depending upon the thickness , 6-10 minutes total time
4. transfer to a plate and keep warm
5. pour the wine into the skillet to deglaze the pan and cook , stirring to scape up the brown bits , until the wine is reduced by half , about 1 minute
6. whisk in the cream , mustard and tarragon and cook , continuing to whisk , about 2 minutes until thickened
7. pour any juices that have accumulated on the plate into the sauce and whisk to combine
8. divide the chicken among 4 serving plates and pour some sauce over each portion
demonstrations.review: Easy and delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
black eyed pea gumbo

this is so simple, either crock pot or stovetop! a friend of mine served this a few weeks ago on a very cold sunday and i've made it three times since! spice it up or tone it down as you like. i like spicy foods so i add a lot of tabasco? to my bowl! some people like to add okra as well for the real gumbo look...i hope you enjoy this!

1. slice bell pepper , celery and uncooked sausage
2. put all ingredients except rice in a crock pot
3. cook on high for at least 3 hours then add cooked rice and cook for an additional 30 minutes
4. if you make this on the stove top the cooking time will be approximately 45 to 60 minutes
5. i leave the rice out and allow each person to put in as much as they like in their bowl and pour the gumbo over it
6. if there is any left over , i add the remaining rice
7. if it is needing additional broth the next day , i add tomato juice or tomato sauce
demonstrations.review: Delicious and easy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kurdish kubbeh khamoustah

stuffed dumplings in soup

1. fry the meat cut in small piece , in a small amount of oil
2. grind preserving the texture
3. prepare the dough for the koubbebot , by mixing all ingredients
4. wet your hands , and shape walnut size pieces of it , like a thin
5. circle , fill with 1 tsp of meat and seal
6. at this stage , you can freeze the kubbeh patties
7. heat the oil , fry the garlic until gold , add the scallions and the
8. pazzi mix well
9. cook about 10 minutes
10. cover with water and continue to cook
11. i usually replace the salt with some soup powder
12. when almost done add lemon juice and lemon salt to taste
13. add the koubbebot to the boiling soup , and continue cooking about 15
14. minutes
demonstrations.review: This recipe takes a little while to put together.  I wouldn't recommend it if you've only got thirty minutes.  However, once it's done, it's super tasty!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
corned beef and cabbage in guinness

the irish butcher at my market gave me a new (to me anyway) recipe for corned beef & cabbage; he told me to cook it in guinness draught. (guinness stout will make the dish bitter).  since everyone raved about it, i thought i'd share the recipe he gave me. 

note: some reviewers have mentioned that the broth/sauce is very salty. it is important to rinse your corned beef in cold water before cooking it to remove some of the excess salt from the corning process. (i usually soak mine in cold water for a bit depending on the brand - some are much saltier than others).  --- i have tried 5 times today to change the wording of the last ingredient on the list from "1-2lbs carrot, peeled and cut into 3-inch pieces" to "1 - 2 pounds of carrots, peeled and cut into 3-inch pieces". every time the change "goes through," it does not reflect the new wording. grrrrrrr!

1. rinse corned beef under cold water , and pat dry
2. in a dutch oven , or other large pot with a cover , brown corned beef well on all sides over high heat
3. pour guinness over the meat , and add enough water to just cover the brisket
4. add the onion , garlic , bay leaf , cinnamon , cloves , allspice and pepper to the pot
5. bring pot to a boil and skim off any foam
6. reduce heat to a simmer
7. cover pot and simmer for 3 hours
8. add carrots , then potatoes and then the cabbage wedges to the pot
9. cover pot , and continue cooking until meat and vegetables are tender
10. remove meat and vegetables to warm serving platter / dishes , leaving the cooking liquid / sauce in the pot
11. over high heat , bring the cooking liquid to a boil , and cook until the amount of liquid is reduced by half
12. slice the corned beef
13. serve with the vegetables and the sauce on the side
demonstrations.review: Delicious!  This particular recipe was hard to half though, so only make when feeding four or more people.

target.recipe_text:
super healthy hummus

taken off a website, don't have the reference. an excellent hummus, the only one i make anymore. you really need a blender or food processor to get the consistency right. 1/4 cup = 1 point ww.

1. combine everything in blender or food processor and process until smooth
2. the blender gives the best result
3. if you need more liquid to make a nice consistency , add a bit more yogurt
4. chill
5. serve with pitas or as a veggie dip
target.review: This was excellent and so easy to make. I did add some diced kalamata olives to it also

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked pork chops with onions and chili sauce

this is a quick pork recipe that i throw together fairly regularly because it's easy, requires few ingredients and is a big hit with the kids.

1. preheat oven to 375
2. pound the chops thin with a meat tenderizer
3. heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and brown the chops lightly on each side
4. move the chops to a shallow baking dish
5. scatter the sliced onions over the chops , sprinkle with brown sugar and pour the chili sauce over all
6. bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes
7. i usually flip them midway through so that they cook evenly in the sauce on both sides
8. smother chops with onions and sauce and serve
demonstrations.review: I have made this twice and it is always a hit. I also have grilled the pork chops first then saute the onions and made the sauce on the stovetop and poured it over the chops.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast in a mug

i came across this recipe and had to give it a try. what a delicious and easy way to have eggs. this is a great recipe to teach the kids to make so they can make breakfast on their own. *i wanted to add that veggie spray works well and i most often use 1 whole egg and 1 egg white mixed together for a healthier approach- you can't tell the difference!

1. place butter in 12 oz
2. microwave safe mug or small bowl
3. microwave on high 30-45 seconds , or until melted
4. add egg , milk , salt and pepper
5. stir or whip with a fork
6. microwave one egg on high 35 to 45 seconds
7. two eggs 1 1 / 4 to 1 3 / 4 minutes , or until eggs begin to set , stirring with fork to break apart after half of the time
8. remove eggs when they are still soft and moist
9. let stand about 2 minutes
10. while eggs are standing crumble bacon and add to eggs
11. eggs will firm up while standing
12. if desired sprinkle with shredded cheese during standing time
demonstrations.review: Very easy. I added cheese to the mix and cooked 1 min 30 sec and then mixed it and then another 30 seconds and it was done

demonstrations.recipe_text:
long john silver s fish batter

mom got this recipe from somewhere a long time ago and passed it on to me. just multiply the amounts according to how much fish that you have to fry.

1. sift dry ingredients
2. add water and mix well
3. use to coat fish or chicken filets
4. cover the fish completely
5. deep fry until a nice golden brown
demonstrations.review:
This was excellent !! Light, crispy and stuck to the tilapia I made for dinner.
Next time I will add more salt and also some pepper, maybe cayenne
or old bay just to give it more flavor

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ranch chicken thighs

needed a quick & easy weeknight meal. this is adapted from an old taste of home magazine. the chicken is tasty & juicy, with a nice crunchy crust. you won't miss the skin!  
eta -- some say this is too bland.  the ranch dressing is not enough seasoning.  i do add season salt to taste (nature's seasonings) to the bread crumb mixture for more flavor.  hopefully as a cook, you will know what to add to suit you and your family's taste.

1. in a shallow bowl , combine crumbs , parmesan cheese , cornmeal , italian seasoning , and seasoned salt
2. dip chicken into salad dressing , then coat with crumb mixture
3. place chicken in a greased 13x9 baking dish
4. bake , uncovered , at 375 degrees for 45 minutes or until juices run clear
demonstrations.review: My family loved these !!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken scaloppine with lemon glaze   low fat and delicious

this is a wonderful lower-fat restaurant-quality dish that is easy to make, i also like to add in a few tablespoons of capers and cook with the lemon glaze if you are a lover of capers then add them in as it really adds to the flavour of this dish ---  this lemon sauce is not a heavy creamy sauce which is what makes this dish lower in fat, it is more like a glaze that soaks into the chicken, and i would strongly suggest to double or even triple the glaze i most always do, and please be certain to use only dry breadcrumbs as fresh will not stick to the chicken as well --- this is *very* good!

1. in a small bowl or shallow dish whisk together mustard and eggs
2. set aside
3. combine the dry bread crumbs with poultry seasoning , garlic powder and seasoning salt
4. spread on a piece of waxed paper
5. dip the breasts firstly in egg / mustard mixture then coat well with the crumb mixture , pressing downs with hands to adhear the crumbs to the breast
6. heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
7. add in the chicken and cook for about 5 minutes on each side , or until it is no longer pink inside
8. remove and transfer to a plate to keep warm
9. for the glaze
10. in the same skillet add in the broth , lemon juice and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt bring to a boil scraping any brown bits from the pan
11. add in lemon slices and parsley
12. mix to combine for about 1 minute
13. spoon the glaze / sauce over chicken
14. delicious !
demonstrations.review:
This was sooo good and also easy.
Big Hit, will be making it again.

I agree must double the sauce !!

target.recipe_text:
easy crock pot stuffing  dressing

when i used to stuff the turkey with my dressing, there was never enough so i had to make some of it in a casserole dish too.  but that batch never came out the same, so i decided to adapt my recipe slightly and make it all together in the crock pot.  it came out great (lots of compliments) and i didn't have to bother with stuffing (and unstuffing) the bird.  in fact, i got to sleep in just a little longer because i didn't have to make the stuffing until after the bird was already in the oven (bonus).  you can also prepare it through step 3 in advance.  i make this recipe to go along with a 20 lb turkey, so if i make it right after the bird goes in the oven the timing is about perfect.

1. brown ground beef and drain grease
2. melt butter in saucepan and cook celery and onion until tender
3. combine stuffing cubes , ground beef and celery onion mixture in extra large bowl or roasting pan
4. add chicken broth and mix well
5. i like my stuffing pretty moist and the amount needed can vary depending on how dry the bread cubes are
6. i generally use about 5 cups , but adjust this to your liking
7. it will not dry out in the crock pot like it does in the oven , so make about as moist as you want it to be when it is done , then add about 1 / 4 cup more
8. you can always add a litte water later if it looks too dry , but it will be a bigger ordeal if it is too soupy for you
9. place stuffing in crock pot and place turkey neck and giblets on top to help flavor the stuffing
10. cook on medium-low for about 4 hours
11. remove turkey neck and giblets before serving
target.review: Excellent!   Tastes great, easy to make and perfect for keeping stuffing warm and moist.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
unbelievable baked buffalo wings

here's a healthy alternative to fried wings: one of my famous recipes! the meat will fall off the bone! unbelievable!

1. fill a large pot half way with water and then add the first 4 ingredients
2. bring water mixture and wings to a boil and then boil for 15 minutes
3. transfer wings to an oven safe container coated with cooking spray
4. bake wings on "broil" for 15 minutes on each side
5. while waiting for wings , combine the hot sauce and margarine in a microwave safe container and cook in microwave for 2 minutes or until melted
6. when wings are done , shake 'em up with the sauce and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I don't think you can tell the difference between baked and fried with this cooking method.
