6. combine mix with egg and milk , mixing well
7. fill muffin pan 1 / 2 full , bake for 15-20 minutes
demonstrations.review: I found this recipe after my grandma gave me a ten pound bag of cornmeal. I am so thankful, this is wonderful. It's great with chili or soul food. I made a great mistake with regular Jiffy that I do with this now. I double the milk and it's not so dry, more moist. This is a definite keeper.

target.recipe_text:
yes  virginia there is a great meatloaf

absolutely delicious meatloaf and sauce! those who claim they don't believe there can be such a thing as a great meatloaf will love this. based on a meatloaf given to me by a dear friend, virginia strehl, memphis, and leesburg, fla. nita holleman, 2000

1. meatloaf: combine meat loaf ingredients and place into a loaf baking dish
2. smooth out top
3. sauce: combine sauce ingredients and pour on top and sides of meatloaf
4. bake at 350f about 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes or until done
5. enjoy !
6. the addition of 1 or 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet makes this recipe very good
7. recipe should be"plump" from the addition of the milk or half & half
8. it should not be runny
9. a second batch of sauce served hot is good to serve with the meatloaf
10. nita's
11. it is wise to have some fat added to the deer -- especially to ground deer
12. maybe 25 % fat , , otherwise your results will be poor
13. i don't know about some of the other game meat some are using
14. please consult an expert
15. the recipe is delicious as it stands ! enjoy ! nita holleman
target.review: This is a good comfort food recipe.  Good stuff! Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s marinade for grilled steak

this marinade will produce the most tender and not to mention the best tasting steak and it's enough for up to four steaks about 1-1/2-inches thick --- just remember to bring the steaks to almost room temperature before grilling this will relax the meat fibers and make for a more tender juicy steak ---  the amounts may be doubled but keep the garlic at the same amount, for best results it is recommended to not substitute any ingredients, do not add any salt to the marinade and do not salt the meat until ready to grill --- this marinade may be used for any cut of steaks.

1. mix all the marinade ingredients together in a bowl
2. pour over steaks
3. cover tightly and place the steaks in the refrigerator for minimum 4 hours or even better for 24 hours
4. remove the steaks from the fridge
5. bring the steaks down to almost room temperature before grilling
6. season steaks with steak seasoning or seasoning of choice if desired
7. grill for 6-12 minutes turning 3-4 times or until desired doneness
demonstrations.review: Excellent marinade!  I always have this when we have steak!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caribbean rice

in the caribbean, coconut, mango, and rice are staples. they appear on menus in all kinds of forms. combine them all in the same dish and you have something special. the sweetness of the mango and coconut makes this dish suitable for curries, chicken, fish , and pork, all common caribbean ingredients. enjoy!

1. heat oil in a large saucepan and add coconut
2. cook , stirring constantly until very lightly browned add minced onion
3. continue cooking and stirring 1 minute longer
4. add rice , stir to coat
5. add broth and bring to a boil
6. cover and reduce heat to low
7. simmer 25 to 30 minutes until rice is tender
8. remove from heat and stir in mango
9. sprinkle with chives
demonstrations.review: We had this with Sticky Ginger Lime and Chili chicken (recipe #412514) and it was a really good compliment. This makes a lot so next time I would halve the rice and chicken broth but keep the remaining ingredients the same. This would be good with some fresh cilantro too! Very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted asparagus with mushrooms

simple understated elegance for your table.

1. preheat oven to 425
2. in a non-stick baking baking sheet with sides , toss the asparagus and mushrooms with the oil and season with salt and pepper
3. spread the vegetables in a single layer
4. roast for 10 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and browned , turning once or twice
5. place vegetables on a serving platter
6. sprinkle vegetables with vinegar and toss gently to combine
7. season with additional salt and pepper as desired
8. serve warm or at room temperature
9. makes 4 servings
demonstrations.review: Quick, easy and delicious!  Thanks for helping my dinner dilemma!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
coconut papaya rice

for safe keeping have not tried yet

1. heat all ingredients except papaya to boiling in 2-quart saucepan , stirring once or twice
2. reduce heat
3. cover and simmer 19 minutes
4. remove from heat
5. fluff rice lightly with fork
6. cover and let steam 5 to 10 minutes
7. mash half of the papaya
8. reserve 2 tablespoons chopped papaya
9. stir mashed papaya and remaining chopped papaya into rice
10. heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture is hot
11. sprinkle with reserved papaya and , if desired , additional cinnamon
12. substitution
13. if youre in the mood to experiment , go ahead and replace the papaya with an equal amount of chopped mango
demonstrations.review: Flavorful rice dish.  I added a dash of allspice.  I served it with a jerk marinaded chicken breast and plantains fried in peanut oil.  A good addition to a tropical meal!  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandma s buttermilk waffles

well, someone's grandma, but not mine. from gooseberry patch hometown favorites.

1. in a mixing bowl , add flour , baking powder , salt , and soda
2. stir to mix
3. add in eggs , buttermilk , and butter
4. mix well
5. pour batter into a preheated prepared waffle iron
6. cook until steaming stops and waffles are crisp and golden
demonstrations.review: Thanks grandma!  These were really good waffles, I followed the advice of others and reduced the salt to 1/2 tsp. as I generally do not have unsalted butter on hand and found it perfect!  Delicious!

target.recipe_text:
uncle bill s whipped shortbread cookies

these are very easy to make shortbread cookies. they are so good that they melt in your mouth, you hardly have to chew them. i have been making them for over 35 years.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a mixing bowl and using an electric mixer , combine butter , flour , icing sugar and vanilla extract
3. mix until mixture is a smooth consistency
4. prepare cookie sheets with parchment paper
5. spoon out dough onto parchment lined cookie sheets by teaspoonfuls or by tablespoons for larger cookies , spacing about 2 inches apart
6. cut maraschino cherries into quarters and place one piece in the middle of each cookie , alternating with red and green cherries
7. bake in preheated 350 f oven for 13 to 15 minutes or until bottom of cookies are lightly browned , do not overbake
8. remove from oven and let cool on cookie sheet for about 5 minutes
9. transfer onto wire racks to finish cooling
10. store in a container with a lid and separate each layer with wax paper
11. use sprinkles , half an almond or half a cashew or chocolate to the top of the cookies before baking
12. a thumbprint in the cookie , filled with your choice of jam is very tasty
13. it has been suggested that the cookies be refrigerated for at least 1 / 2 hour before baking for a different texture
target.review:
Hi "Uncle Bill",
I made your cookies yesterday and they were EXCELLENT!!  They are melt in your mouth soft and delicious. I plan to make them very often.
Lois

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
demonstrations.review:
Hi Shelley:
This was THE best banana bread that I have ever made. At first, I thought it wasn't done, as it was so moist and soft inside.  My  kids loved it. My husband doesn't usually care for banana bread, but he was the one who ate most of it, and was looking for more the next day.  Yesterday, when we went shopping, we loaded up on the bananas, as I will be making this often. Thank you for posting your fantastic recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon flop

yummy and easy! kids and adults love it :) i don't remember where i got this recipe...i just have it written on an index card, but it has been requested of me many times. makes 2 - 9 inch cakes, so there is enough to go around!

1. preheat oven to 350 and grease well two 9" round pans
2. combine flour , sugar and baking powder
3. add melted butter and milk and stir until well blended
4. divide mixture evenly into two prepared pans
5. sprinkle tops evenly with flour , then brown sugar , then cinnamon
6. push chunks of butter evenly spaced into dough
7. bake for 30 minutes and cool slightly
8. cut and serve right out of pans
demonstrations.review:
Karen, 
Thank you for sharing your recipe.  It was delicious.  My family enjoyed it very much. My children usually don't like to try anything new, but their eyes lit up when they tasted it. This is a new family favorite!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
uncle bill s apple crisp

my grandmother gave me this recipe over 55 years ago and it has been in my family ever since.

1. filling: peel , core and slice apples to a mixing bowl
2. sprinkle with sugar and lemon juice and toss gently to coat
3. arrange apples in a 8" x 8" oven proof baking dish to cover bottom of dish evenly
4. set aside
5. topping: preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. in a mixing bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , allspice , cinnamon and lemon rind
7. using a pastry blender , cut in margarine or butter and blend until mixture is crumbly
8. stir in pecans and mix well
9. sprinkle topping evenly over apples
10. bake in preheated 350 f oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden brown
11. remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before using
12. serve with ice cream or whipped cream
demonstrations.review:
Hi "Uncle Bill":
Your Apple Crisp was the best we've ever tasted.  The lemon juice and rind really gave it a special "Zing".  I have tried other recipes for apple crisp, but this one was by far the best. Thank you very much for sharing it.

Lois

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttery cut out christmas cookies

these are delicious. the cream cheese in the cookie dough really adds a softness, and makes the cookies taste really flaky and rich. they're a great addition to one's christmas cookie recipes.

1. combine the first five ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. beat at about medium speed until well combined and creamy , about 3-4 minutes
3. gradually add flour , and beat until well mixed , about 2-3 minutes more
4. divide dough in half , and wrap each on in plastic wrap
5. refrigerate until firm , at least two hours
6. preheat oven to 375
7. roll out dough half on a lightly floured surface to about 1 / 4" thick
8. keep the other half in the fridge until ready to use
9. cut out the shapes your prefer , using a 2 1 / 2 inch cookie cutter
10. place 1" apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
11. if i'm making christmas cookie shapes , i sprinkle the cookies with red , green , or multi-colored sugars before baking
12. bake for 7-9 minutes or until edges are just slightly browned
13. these cookies may also be baked plain , and decorated with icings after they are cooled
demonstrations.review:
Hi Kozmic:
This was my first attempt ever in making cut out cookies.  Your recipe is AWESOME!  The cookies went so quickly, I didn't even have time to try to decorate them.  Thank you very much for posting your wonderful recipe.
Lois

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlicky chicken soup

this recipe appeared in one of our local newspapers. however, i made some modifications and added some spices and vegetables. turned out real good. a nice light soup.

1. in a large saucepan , heat olive oil over low heat
2. add onion , carrots , celery , bay leaves , thyme and sage and cook until onions softens and becomes translucent , about 8 minutes , , stirring occasionally
3. add garlic and cook for 1 minute on medium-high heat
4. add broth , white pepper , salt , and cauliflower florets
5. increase heat to high and bring to boil
6. reduce heat to low
7. cover pot and simmer until carrots are softened , about 6 - 8 minutes
8. add chicken cubes and bring soup back to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes longer or until chicken is cooked through and there is no pink showing in the chicken
9. adjust seasonings to taste
10. remove bay leaves and discard
11. serve soup hot
12. refrigerate any unused portion
13. i also went very light on the amount of salt used , so the soup could be somewhat bland , add salt to your taste
demonstrations.review:
Hi "Uncle Bill":
This soup is another winner.  I made it on Saturday and my family loved it.  I will have to double it next time, as it disappeared very quickly.  It had just the right amount of garlic and the chicken was so soft and tender.  It is another recipe of yours that I highly recommend.

Lois

target.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
target.review: Why have I not reviewed this recipe before??  I use this frequently when I know I am going to have a busy day.  I personally prefer it with a little less chicken meat, if I am shredding the chicken.  Also, as others have indicated, it makes a great dip when the chicken is shredded.  Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cucumber and cream cheese appetizers

this is so quick and easy. people can't stop eating them.

1. i wash and score the cucumber with a fork along the entire lenth of the cucumber , all the way around , to make a design slice thinly and set aside
2. combine cream cheese , good seasonings italian mix and tabasco sauce
3. spread cream cheese mixture , generously on each slice of cocktail bread , place slice of cucumber and sprinkle the top with dill
demonstrations.review: These were so delicious for a spring party- they drew lots of compliments!  Personally, I found the cream-cheese mix to be a little too salty, so next time I will not use as much of the dressing mix, or look for a version on the shelves with less salt.  I will definitely be using this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
margarita cheesecake pie  easy no bake

totally delicious and refreshing, this creamy margarita cheesecake pie pairs beautifully with a spicy mexican meal of tacos, enchiladas, rice and beans. very easy prep, with no baking required, so it's also a wonderful make-ahead dessert! cook time is chill time. p.s. i sometimes cheat and use a prepared graham cracker crust. i hope you enjoy!

1. to make the crust:
2. crush the pretzels in a food processor and combine the crumbs with the sugar and the melted butter
3. press the mixture into a buttered 9-inch pie dish
4. place the crust in the freezer
5. to make the filling:
6. in the bowl of an electric mixer , beat the softened cream cheese with the sweetened condensed milk until the mixture is smooth
7. stir in tequila , triple sec , lime juice , lime zest and food coloring
8. fold half of the whipped topping into the filling mixture and spoon into the prepared pie shell
9. top with the remaining whipped topping and garnish with lime slices
10. refrigerate the cheesecake 6 hours or overnight
11. freezes well
12. remove from freezer about 15 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: This cheesecake is to die for!  I made it for Cinco de Mayo, and I am SO pleased with this recipe.  I am a nursing mama, so I used orange juice instead of triple sec and only used 1 Tbs of Tequila.  Also, to save time I just used a store-bought graham cracker crust that I had on hand.  I did crumble pretzels on the tops of each sliced as I was serving so there was still some saltiness to it.  I can't wait to make it with the pretzel crust.  I think the cheesecake filling would also make a really delicious pretzel dip, which I am going to try for a party in a couple weeks.  Thanks for such a delicious, versatile recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon glaze cake

this is a good lemon cake and glaze that came from the 

1. combine first six ingredients
2. beat 5 minutes on medium speed
3. pour into greased and floured 10 inch tube pan
4. bake 350 for 1 hour
5. pour over hot cake
demonstrations.review: I made this glaze for yellow cake recipe #108059.  It was absolutely scrumptious!  I hadn't planned to glaze the cake, but since I had baked it in a bunny-shaped mold I was afraid a buttercream frosting would cover up all the contours.  Because of this, my cake was already completely cool by the time I glazed it, and this didn't seem to harm the effects at all.  This glaze got so many rave reviews from birthday party guests- I was so glad I had used it.  Thanks for the post!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
okra and tomatoes  a k a   okra gumbo

i havent seen too many okra recipes on zaar, so i decided to post my favorite.  my grandmother taught me how to make this dish when i was 11, and i've been making it ever since.  its a great along side smothered steak and mashed potatoes, or rice.

1. fry bacon in a large skillet that can be covered , until crisp
2. remove from skillet and drain on paper towels
3. saute onion in bacon drippings until tender
4. add okra and tomatoes , stir to blend
5. cover , reduce to low heat
6. cook for about an hour , or until okra is tender , stirring occasionally
7. do not stir too much or too briskly , because the okra will fall apart
8. season with salt and pepper , to taste
9. my family doesn't like the bacon cooked into it because the bacon becomes soft
10. if you do it my way , you can sprinkle the bacon on right before serving
demonstrations.review: At first I thought this was too simple to really be good.  Plus I have never liked okra.  But after tasting, this recipe blew me away!  The flavors really come together and take the slime away from the okra.  Thank you for sharing this classic.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sausage and bell peppers

easy, simple dish. we like this during the week when we don't have a lot of time and its so good!

1. heat approximately 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large frying pan
2. brown the sausage in the oil until you get a nice color on the outside and you no longer see any"pink"
3. remove the sausage and drain on a paper towel
4. keep the heat going on the pan and add onions and peppers
5. cook the onions and peppers approximately 5 minutes or until onions start to become translucent
6. during this time , slice the sausage down the middle , do not cut all the way through , just enough so you can open the sausage and"fan" them out
7. add salt and pepper over the onion / pepper mixture and turn heat down to simmer
8. place sausage on top of onions and peppers and cover
9. simmer for approximately 15 minutes or until sausage is cooked through
10. serve on italian bread
demonstrations.review: This was very good and super easy.  I added a small can of diced Italian tomatoes just for some more flavor and a soupier mix.  I also diced the sausages because the picture posted  looked so nice!  Thanks for the great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
lemon pineapple crock pot chicken

this is my modification of leanne ely's "lemon pineapple baked chicken" (see www.savingdinner.com)

1. separate pineapple chunks from juice-- place chunks in refrigerator to be served as a side dish with the meal
2. combine pineapple juice , garlic , cornstarch , worcestershire , mustard , thyme , salt , pepper , and lemon juice
3. set aside
4. place peeled , cubed sweet potatoes in bottom of crock pot , and lay chicken breasts on top
5. pour juice mixture over chicken and potatoes
6. cover and cook 4 hours on high , or 8 hours on low
7. reduce cooking time if chicken is thawed
8. remove chicken and sweet potatoes from juices , and place in separate serving dishes
9. keep warm
10. thicken juices on stove top using cornstarch to make a gravy
11. serving suggestions: serve with brown rice and steamed broccoli
target.review: I loved the ease of this recipe. Very yummy, and my daughter, the picky one, finished off her plate. My family struggled with the sweet potato (although I loved it).  I think next time I might try 2 large potatoes, to accomodate my familys taste.  Thanks for the recipe.  This is going in my file.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
veal francese

this dish is very popular with a lemony kinda twing to it. it's not hard to make and is wonderful to the palette.

1. preheat oven to 180 degrees f
2. heat olive oil and butter in large skillet over medium high heat
3. dredge veal in flour
4. mix eggs , parmesan , salt , pepper
5. dip floured scaloppine into egg batter and place in hot pan
6. cook scaloppine in batches being careful not to crowd the pan
7. cook until nicely browned
8. remove to a platter and keep warm in oven
9. repeat , adding more oil and butter to pan as needed until all are cooked
10. when done return all to the pan and sprinkle with lemon juice
11. cook for 1 more minute
demonstrations.review: Wow, We hadn't tried veal in our home until now.  My husband informed me it was a keeper and my son said I am the best cook in the world.  My picky six year old even loved it.  It went really well with garlic bread and caesar salad.  Nice quick meal.  Thanks a bunch.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemony herbed drumsticks

i use my crockpot all the time!

1. put drumsticks in a large plastic bag
2. mix all remaining ingredients together and add to the drumsticks , turning bag to cover all
3. refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours or overnight
4. put everything in the crock pot and cook for 5 to 6 hours on low
5. place drumsticks in a baking pan and broil for a few minutes to brown , then serve
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe, thank you so much.  Such a nice change to Chicken Legs.  My kids gobbled this up in no time, I'm going to have to make a double batch the next time, because they all wanted more.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my mama s meat sauce

this is probably the first thing that i ever learned to cook. my mother used to cook it while i took a nap as a child, and the smell would wake me up. it's really garlicky and the wine gives it a nice flavour. it also freezes really well. enjoy!

1. saut onions in oil
2. add beef and brown before stirring in all seasonings
3. add tomatoes , paste , and cloves
4. stir and add alcohol if using
5. cover and let cook on a low fire for 2 hours or more
demonstrations.review: Thank you for sharing this recipe.  It is the only meat sauce I'm allowed to make in our house now, my husband loves it as does my son.  Any other meat sauce is bland in comparison.  I have also made double batches of it so I can freeze the second batch.  It freezes well and is still gobbled down by the family.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian sausage crockpot soup

this is a robust, easy to make soup. one of my favorite's.

1. 1
2. brown susage , onion , & garlic , drain
3. 2
4. in slow cooker add: everything except orzo and parmesan
5. 3
6. cook on low for 8 hrs or on high for 4 hours
7. 4
8. set pot to high and add orzo for 20 minute
9. 5
10. serve with parmesan cheese in top
demonstrations.review: When my husband says Print it, I know I have discovered an awesome recipe.  Made this last night for my family and inlaws and was pleased with the results... I cooked it just as instructed, easy, quick and delicious. Thank you William!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brown sugar glazed salmon

this tangy entree is prefect for weeekday dinners and weekend entertaining. the sweet basting sauce is made while salmon starts baking in the oven.

1. cut salmon width-wise into 4 pieces
2. place in a foil-lined15x10x1-inch baking pan
3. sprinkle with salt & pepper
4. bake uncovered at 425 degrees for 10 minutes
5. meanwhile , in a small saucepan , combine the brown sugar , soy sauce , mustard and vinegar
6. bring to a boil
7. brush evenly over salmon
8. broil 6-inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork , enjoy
demonstrations.review: Easy, quick and yummy.  My whole family loved it.

target.recipe_text:
potato kielbasa skillet

a very hearty, tasty supper. this is very easy to make and a real pleaser.

1. in dutch oven , brown potatoes , kielbasa , onion and peppers in oil
2. add seasonings and water
3. bring to a boil
4. cover tightly and cook for 20 minutes on low , stirring occasionally
5. uncover and put cheese on top
6. simmer until cheese is melted
target.review: This was just great. Very tasty and satisfying. I had leftovers this morning, and I just threw it in a skillet and heated it thru then added some beaten eggs and it was awesome again!  Thanks Mizz Nezz!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ann lander s meatloaf

adapted over the years for my family's taste. original recipe calls for 8 oz. tomato sauce instead of chili sauce over the top. if you don't like sauce on top of your meatloaf, then leave it off. this is an old recipe, written long before msg (accent) was determined to be evil. use at your own risk.

1. mix all ingredients together except bacon and chili sauce
2. put in loaf pan
3. cover with bacon strips
4. pour chili sauce over top
5. bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: You know, I can cook a lot of things, and honestly, I have had good success at it, and am even crowned "the best cook in the family" but meatloaf, well I've always had trouble with the meatloaf. Probably just over-thinking it. I have tried COUNTLESS recipes, always dissapointed, never quite achieving the taste and texture I wanted. No more! This little recipe was delicious! I couldn't believe it! And STUPID SIMPLE! I am no longer meatloaf challenged, I have found "my" recipe!<br/><br/>Thanks so much for allowing me to no longer be afraid of a large hunk of ground meat!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco ritos

this recipe comes from denver fire fighters favorites cookbook published in 1976. this is a quick and very tasty dish and you can increase ingredients to make a larger batch, if needed. it's always been a big seller in my house.

1. brown ground beef and drain off grease
2. add refried beans
3. remove from heat
4. soften tortilla in microwave for 20-25 seconds
5. place 2 tbspns
6. of ground beef mixture and 1 tspn
7. of onion on tortilla and roll like a burrito
8. place in shallow roasting pan
9. repeat filling and rolling instructions until you fill approximately 8 tortillas
10. mix mushroom soup and green chile enchilada sauce together and pour over rolled tortillas in pan
11. top with both cheeses
12. bake in 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and everything is hot
13. allow to stand about 5 minutes
14. serve with toppings , as desired
demonstrations.review: DH Approved! (that's HUGE!) He said he liked it better than tacos! Great Man-food. I made as directed, with the exception of adding the onion to the ground beef before browning, and I doubled everything except the sauce. I have plenty for leftovers, and am looking forward to having it again tonight! I Topped with Pico De Gallo, Sour Cream, and Black Olives. The only thing I might change, is next time I want to try baking these without the sauce, warming the sauce up, and pouring it over the top, and then adding the cheese. I think I might achieve the firmer, crispier texture I find myself looking for. I'll update my review once I have tried it. Thanks for posting what is sure to become a regular meal around here!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
I hate to always be in the majority.. I will admit that I was a little concerned when I made this based on how it looked.. honestly, a littly funky. But the taste, and texture is OUTSTANDING! Very filling, VERY easy. I doubled the recipe, and I chunked the chicken (not frozen) because I though it might cook a little faster, (I had a late start.) and since I doubled it, I had a 24oz jar of salsa, and added a can of Rotel. Ziiiipy!
I also served this over spanish yellow rice, I don't know if it is available in all areas, but down here in Florida, it is everywhere! Really a great quick meal. Thanks so much for sharing this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy no fail make anytime turkey gravy

i have been using this recipe for many years, my family loves this gravy and i have served it to dinner guests over the holidays and always receive rave reviews! --- you don't need to make this gravy using all pan drippings, if you do not have 4 cups of drippings you may mix with chicken broth to make the 4 cups, or it may be made with only chicken broth, please see note on the bottom of the recipe--- this may be made slightly ahead and kept uncovered on top of the stove until ready to serve, just whisk before using if you have any left over this gravy freezes very well or you may reduce all ingredients down to half and for a thinner gravy reduce flour by 1 tablespoon  --- also see my recipe#314890
for more of my recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. drain the pan drippings for the roasted turkey through a fine strainer
2. let sit and then remove any fat from the top of the drippings
3. add in chicken broth or water to make 4 cups if necessary
4. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine or butter
5. add in lots of black pepper
6. add in 1 / 2 cup flour plus 3 tablespoons
7. constantly whisk for about 3 minutes over low heat
8. slowly add in the 4 cups turkey broth / drippings
9. whisk constantly over medium-low heat until bubbly and thickened
10. use right away or keep warm over lowest heat setting , whisk again before serving
11. options to make this gravy using all chicken broth prepare as directed using 4 cups low sodium chicken broth and 1 tablespoon chicken boullion powder ---- or you may add in low sodium chicken broth omitting bouillon powder to pan drippings to make up 4 cups
demonstrations.review:
NEVER, EVER, EVER AGAIN will I buy turkey gravy in a jar! This was SOOOOO easy, and frankly the surprise hit of my Thanksgiving meal! Super tasty, and again I say.. EASY! I made it with recipe # 199612 (Kittencal's simply perfect roast turkey) and had plenty of broth/pan drippings to use! Thank you, Thank you Thank you! 

: ) Yay! I can make gravy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with muenster cheese

this is an excellent, delicious, superb dish! everyone asked for this recipe when i made it for christmas dinner. you can add fresh sliced mushrooms too if you want before you layer the cheese on it. (the prep time includes refrigeration time)

1. cut up chicken breast in bite sizes pieces
2. beat 2 eggs
3. soak chicken for 1 hour hour in refrigerator
4. drain after done soaking , and coat chicken in seasoned bread crumbs
5. brown in butter
6. spray 9x13 pan and put chicken in , add white wine
7. cover with sliced cheese
8. bake at 350 covered with foil for 15 minutes
9. bake uncovered for additional 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was VERY good, and VERY easy. I added some grated Parm to the bread crumbs, and used a seasoned Panko. I think the next time I will add a little lemon zest too. I think it needed a touch of "brightness", but it was truly excellent. Can't wait to try with different cheeses as well.

target.recipe_text:
bratwurst and sauerkraut supper

nan

1. in a large skillet , saut onions in margarine until tender
2. add the potatoes , sauerkraut , wine , broth , brown sugar , vinegar , mustard , caraway seeds , bay leaf and pepper
3. cover and simmer for 35-40 minutes or until potatoes are tender
4. stir in the bratwurst
5. heat through
6. discard bay leaf
target.review: This was great!  I'm a true mustard-aholic so I think I actually put in a little more mustard and it was wonderful.  I used venison garlic bratwurst to add another layer of flavor.  Very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican chicken   stuffing

nan

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. mix water and margarine in 13x9 baking dish until margarine is melted
3. stir in the stuffing mix and 1 / 4 cup of the salsa
4. arrange chicken over stuffing mix
5. pour remaining salsa over chicken
6. bake , covered , for 30 minutes , or until chicken is thoroughly cooked
7. sprinkle cheese over top and bake uncovered an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese is melted
demonstrations.review: I made this dish to use up some extra stuffing cubes from Thanksgiving and I liked it very much.  Next time, however, I won't add as much liquid to the stuffing.  When it came out of the oven it looked like it was swimming.  It was pretty mushy and my DH wouldn't touch it.  He liked the chicken though very much.  I added some more bread cubes and waited for them to soak up excess liquid and then the stuffing was very good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oatmeal bake

perfect breakfast on the go or snack. for those of us on weight watchers, it's only 3 points for one big slice!

1. mix oatmael and powder
2. add remaining ingredients and mix well
3. pour into sprayed 9" pie pan or sprayed muffin tins
4. bake 45 min at 350f
demonstrations.review: I think this was very good and tasted like a moist cake.  I used regular instead of quick oatmeal and sweetened applesauce instead of unsweetened so mine was a little different, but very yummy!  It was very easy to assemble and quite filling.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttery bread machine rolls

these golden, fluffy, butterfy rolls are great hot from the oven. the dough is very easy to shape. this recipe is from a quick cooking magazine

1. in bread machine pan , put all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is completed , turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
4. divide dough into 24 portions
5. shape dough into balls
6. place in a greased 13 inch by 9 inch baking pan
7. cover and let rise in a warm place for 30-45 minutes
8. bake at 350 degrees for 13-16 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: These are really good!  I just had one fresh out of the oven to test - a little squishy because it was still warm, but yummy!  I'll try using them for roast beef sandwiches later.  I made no changes to the recipe, but had to add a couple tablespoons of flour because it was a bit too wet.  I also made them into 12 larger rolls rather than 24.  These are great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
our favorite lasagna

this recipe comes from the good housekeeping illustrated cookbook and it is the best lasagna recipe we have tried. i don't have any trouble finding the page in my cookbook because it has a few stains and looks worn compared to the other pages. the recipe doubles very easily, i use a 9x13x2-inch glass cake pan and it is always filled to the top. definitely have to have some good crusty bread to sop up the bit of sauce that is left in the pan!

1. in a dutch oven over high heat cook ground beef and onions until beef is browned and juices have evaporated
2. add the tomatoes , tomato paste , sugar , salt , oregano leaves , thyme leaves , red pepper flakes , garlic salt , and bay leaf , heat mixture until boiling
3. reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes
4. discard the bay leaf and spoon off any grease that has accumulated on top of the sauce
5. set aside
6. in another dutch oven boil water , add lasagna noodles , and cook until tender
7. drain well in colander and set aside
8. preheat oven to 375f in a 13x9-inch baking dish add half of the lasagna noodles layering as you go
9. in a small bowl add ricotta cheese and eggs , beat well until combined
10. spoon half of this mixture over the layered lasagna noodles and half of the meat sauce
11. sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese over this layer
12. repeat layers and bake in oven for 45 minutes
13. remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: I'm so happy to find this recipe!  This is the same recipe my mom has made for years and after years of making it myself, I can't find my recipe!  I'm making this tonight for my daughter's birthday dinner - it's such a wonderful lasagna and easy to tinker with if you want to give it some personality.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
golden baked fish

this is a topping rather than a batter.  it was  a recipe from the savings pack in with my taste of home magazine.  

1. place fish in a greased 13-in x 9-in x 2 baking dish
2. sprinkle with pepper
3. beat egg white with salt if desired until stiff peaks form
4. fold in mayonnaise , dill and onion juice , spoon over fish
5. bake uncovered at 425 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until topping is puffed and golden and fish flakes easily with a fork
6. garnish with dill and lemon if desired
demonstrations.review: This was excellent!  I used haddock and tilapia (I preferred the haddock).  My husband was skeptical at first but said it was delicious.  I used Miracle Whip because I like that little zing and I will definitely make this again.

target.recipe_text:
biscuit mini batch for toaster oven

a nice, little batch of fresh, hot, biscuits to make in the toaster oven when you just need a little something. drop biscuits are no more trouble to make than opening a can of dough and you don't have to keep track of expiration dates. of course you could roll them and cut them if you wanted, but i've always liked the crunchy bits you get from the texture of the drop biscuits.

1. pre-heat toaster oven to 425f
2. mix together flour and baking powder
3. work in melted butter
4. add milk and mix into a soft dough
5. drop 6 biscuits onto a small baking sheet that will fit into your toaster oven
6. bake 8-12 minutes or until done
7. pay careful attention to the doneness because toaster ovens arent as reliable in their temperature control as full-size ovens
target.review: This was so easy. My husband didn't like them, though because I used gluten free flour mix and he thought they had a funny taste. But, I thought they were great since I can't have normal biscuits anymore. So easy! I also stuck a little bit of cheese in the center, so it was a nice yummy gooey center.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
french pie pastry

my daughter in law is from france and this is how she makes her pie crusts. i think this is far superior to the ones made with shortening and the crust is much flakier. hope you like it!

1. place flour and salt in food processor and pulse a couple times
2. add butter and process until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. add water 1 t at a time through top feeder and pulse briefly until dough begins to form a ball
4. remove from processor and place on floured surface
5. form into a ball
6. allow dough to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before rolling out
7. on lightly floured surface , roll out dough to fit pie pan
8. place in pan , flute edges and prick bottom of dough several times with a fork
9. place in freezer for 15 to 20 minutes
10. preheat oven to 425 degrees
11. bake pie shell for 15 to 20 minutes or til light brown
demonstrations.review: This was awesome. So easy and perfect!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
once a year potato bake

i call this potato bake once-a-year because that is how often i am allowed to make it. i banned myself not so long ago because i kept making it and hubby and i would eat the whole thing in one sitting and even though it originally came from a 'low-fat' recipe book, eating 8 serves between us everyday is not good for my waist line. so in summary- this is the best potato bake ever! i make it for family get togethers, christmas, birthdays, bbq's because it is so quick and so easy.

1. preheat oven to 210c
2. peel potatoes and slice thinly
3. place 1 / 2 potato slices in a baking dish that has been coated in cooking spray
4. sprinkle 1 / 2 the grated cheese and 1 / 2 the parmesan cheese over the potatoes
5. layer the remaining potatoes on this
6. in a saucepan bring milk to gentle boil and add the sauce sachets and whisk together
7. pour over potato
8. sprinkle remaining cheeses over the dish
9. cover with foil
10. bake for 1 hour , remove foil and cook for a further 10-15 minutes or until potato is cooked
11. if i was going to a party etc where there was an oven available i would cook for 45 minutes at home , leave the foil on whil transporting , and when at the destination i would cook for a further 15 minutes to heat up and soften potatoes , then remove the foil and brown the cheese and serve
demonstrations.review: This was great. I used canned mexican nacho cheese instead of the packets  and milk since I had some I wanted to use up. I did need to add some garlic salt & pepper for some kick. With the nacho cheese, it added a bit of spice which was nice. Definitely not for watching your waistline!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kfc tender roast chicken seasoning mix   copycat   clone

the colonel also had a roasted chicken that was mighty tasty. the chicken was marinated also and then baked with his famous seasonings. the baking process was long it takes 4 hours to bake it. it is baked at 225 for 2 hours till the internal temp was at 175. but for you at home i have updated this to be baked at a higher temperature and be prepared in less time.

1. trim the excess fat from the chicken
2. marinade the chicken in the mixture for 3 to 4 hrs or overnight
3. remove the chicken from the marinade and allow to dry
4. sprinkle the chicken lightly with seasoning
5. place on baking pan and bake at 325f for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hrs till chicken is done
6. allow to sit for 1 to 2 minutes then serve
demonstrations.review:
This was pretty good.
I used it for seasoning on boneless, skinless chicken breast. Sprinkled it on, Baked them in glass dish with drizzled olive oil. Didn't taste like kfc, probably because I used skinless chicken. But, very good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
absolute best ever lasagna

my family's favorite. this is a very meaty lasagna. we prefer it with cottage cheese, but you can easily substitute ricotta.

1. brown ground meat , onion and garlic
2. add salt , pepper , parsley , oregano , basil , chopped tomatoes with juice
3. stirring until well mixed
4. cover and simmer 1 hour
5. cook lasagna noodles according to package directions
6. drain and set aside
7. spray a 13 x 9" baking pan with cooking spray
8. combine riccota cheese , eggs , pepper , 2 tablespoons parsley , parmesan cheese and 1 / 2 1lb of mozzarella cheese
9. in a lasagna pan , layer noodles , meat sauce , and cheese mixture
10. repeat
11. top off with layer of noodles
12. sprinkle evenly with remaining mozzarella cheese
13. make sure to cover noodles completely
14. bake at 375f for 40-60 minutes , or until cheese mixture is thoroughly melted
15. (i cover w / foil for about 40 minutes , then uncover for 15-20 minutes
16. let sit for 15-20 minutes before cutting and serving
demonstrations.review: I served this for a Holiday party. Both kids and adults loved this. The only comment that I received was that they wanted more meat. I didn't use cottage cheese as that's not a favorite in this household. I used a mixture of milk, marscapone and eggs instead. It was wonderful!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with cordon bleu gravy

this is much easier way of getting that great chicken corbon bleu flavor without all the work!

1. cook chicken patties according to package
2. meanwhile in a small to medium saute pan , cook the bacon until crisp over medium heat
3. remove the bacon from the pan and crumble
4. pour enough of the fat in the pan out to leave 2 tablespoons in the pan
5. whisk the flour into the bacon drippings and cook , stirring constantly , for 2 minutes
6. whisk in the milk and bring to a simmer
7. remove pan from heat and stir in the cheese , salt , pepper , and garlic powder
8. pour over the sauce over cooked chicken patties , sprinkle on the crumbled bacon , and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this for dinner tonight. It was ok. DH asked for more gravy and more cheese. I added more garlic salt for additional flavor.

target.recipe_text:
virginia barbecue chicken

summer saturdays in virginia are filled with the smell of this chicken. it is the chicken that all the churches, boy scouts and other organizations fix for fund raisers. it is one of our favorite ways to grill chicken legs or halves. it works really well to grill the chicken and then eat later cold too. great for a picnic!

1. mix all ingredients , except chicken
2. use a small amount to marinade about 5-10 chicken halves or 12-20 drumsticks for a couple hours or over night
3. grill over very medium coals until pieces test done , basting often
4. it works best if you use a grilling pit and allow it to slow cook for a couple hours
target.review: Excellent recipe!  I used a gas grill, cooked the chicken using the indirect method for about 1.5 hours.  Turned out crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple caribbean jerk chicken

i like jerk chicken but often don't have all the exotic ingredients. this simplifies the mix by using dry italian dressing. yummy on the grill!

1. mix all ingredients except chicken in bowl
2. pour over chicken
3. cover and marinate 1 hour or over night in fridge
4. grill it !
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Delicious recipe that was easy and fast.  Just the right amount of spice.  The whole family loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy no fail make anytime turkey gravy

i have been using this recipe for many years, my family loves this gravy and i have served it to dinner guests over the holidays and always receive rave reviews! --- you don't need to make this gravy using all pan drippings, if you do not have 4 cups of drippings you may mix with chicken broth to make the 4 cups, or it may be made with only chicken broth, please see note on the bottom of the recipe--- this may be made slightly ahead and kept uncovered on top of the stove until ready to serve, just whisk before using if you have any left over this gravy freezes very well or you may reduce all ingredients down to half and for a thinner gravy reduce flour by 1 tablespoon  --- also see my recipe#314890
for more of my recipes visit www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. drain the pan drippings for the roasted turkey through a fine strainer
2. let sit and then remove any fat from the top of the drippings
3. add in chicken broth or water to make 4 cups if necessary
4. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine or butter
5. add in lots of black pepper
6. add in 1 / 2 cup flour plus 3 tablespoons
7. constantly whisk for about 3 minutes over low heat
8. slowly add in the 4 cups turkey broth / drippings
9. whisk constantly over medium-low heat until bubbly and thickened
10. use right away or keep warm over lowest heat setting , whisk again before serving
11. options to make this gravy using all chicken broth prepare as directed using 4 cups low sodium chicken broth and 1 tablespoon chicken boullion powder ---- or you may add in low sodium chicken broth omitting bouillon powder to pan drippings to make up 4 cups
demonstrations.review: Great gravy - needed to stir a long time (10-15 minutes) to get it to adequetly thicken.  I used 1/4 tsp pepper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
world s best ribs

this recipe is quite simple and the results are incredible. i usually double the rub recipe and store it in a jar for next time. if you've never tried ribs before, try this recipe. this recipe can be made on the grill or in the oven.

1. mix brown sugar , emeril's essence , salt , pepper , paprika , cumin , garlic and cayenne pepper thoroughly , and sprinkle on both sides of ribs to taste
2. for grilling , carefully wrap in aluminum foil and cook bone side down approximately 1 1 / 2 hours on low temperature
3. no need to turn
4. after ribs become tender , remove from foil and continue cooking on both sides to desired crispness
5. apply barbecue sauce liberally to both sides and allow approximately 10 minutes for barbecue sauce to caramelize
6. brush a second time if desired , and allow to caramelize
7. remove from grill and enjoy !
8. for oven baking , wrap in aluminum foil and place on a cookie sheet in a 275f oven for 4 hours
9. place a pan with water in the oven also to keep them moist
10. remove and discard foil and brush with barbecue sauce and allow 10 minutes to caramelize
11. brush a second time if desired
12. remove from oven and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Easy recipe that tasted delicious.  Be sure to turn the ribs frequently after removing the foil.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bbq brats  n beer

i made this recipe last night for the first time and they are good! this is great if you are having a gang in and want a "do it yourself" style dinner (whatever) have baked beans on the side.

1. put the brats , onions , peppercorns , cloves , garlic in a saucepan , pour in the beer
2. bring to a boil and simmer the brats 15 minutes
3. drain
4. bbq the brats about 10 minutes
5. spray with water while bbqing to form a crisp skin
6. serve on the roll with mustard and hot peppers or other relish or serve them as your meat for dinner
demonstrations.review: Brats turned out great - juicy and flavorful.  Only watch-out is to make sure after boiling in beer to keep the simmer low - otherwise the brats split, losing much of their juice (similarly, need to BBQ on low-to-medium to avoid splitting).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage and kielbasa

my husband didn't think he liked cabbage until i served this. the bacon and onion really give this recipe a lot of flavor.

1. cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp
2. remove bacon
3. crumble , and set aside
4. add next 7 ingredients to bacon drippings
5. cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes , turning cabbage once
6. add sausage and cover and cook an additional 5 minutes or until sausage is heated
7. transfer to a serving dish with a slotted spoon
8. sprinkle with the crumbled bacon
demonstrations.review:
Great easy recipe that tastes great.  My family, who have never liked cabbage raved about this dish, and said they'd pay money for it at a restaurant.

Only suggestion is to watch the red pepper if you're not crazy about spicy food.  I cut it in half (0.5 tsp) and it was still really hot.

That said, great addition to the cook book - thanks!

target.recipe_text:
chili cheese omelette burritos

my 13 year old son made up this breakfast, combining two of his favorites - breakfast burritos and chili cheese omelettes!

1. make sure all your ingredients are ready - chili hot , cheese grated , optional ingredients chopped , eggs beaten
2. heat nonstick skillet over medium high heat
3. add butter to pan
4. when butter is melted , add beaten eggs and scramble
5. when eggs are done , remove pan from heat and quickly heat tortillas over open flame , a few seconds on each side
6. to assemble , place half of scrambled eggs on each tortilla
7. sprinkle with cheese
8. top with chili
9. and add any optional ingredients
10. tuck in both sides of tortilla , and roll up , burrito style
11. serve immediately
target.review: These are a great afternoon treat too! I added plenty of sliced red onion, jalapeno peppers and salsa. Great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
herb  mushrooms

mushroom with fresh sage and thyme.
enjoy over slices of crisp french bread,top a steak or toss into a bowl of spinach to slighly wilt and enjoy as a salad or toss into pasta adding some extra virgin olive oil.

1. in a large pan melt butter and or oil till hot
2. add the onions and mushrooms and stir fry 3-4 minutes
3. add garlic and remaining ingredients stirring for an other 1-2 minutes
demonstrations.review: Very simple, healthy, tasty dish that combines all my favourite flavours!! I omitted the salt, and enjoyed the mushrooms bruschetta-style on rye bread, and also topped my vege burger with a good helping! Thanks for another great recipe, Rita!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kumara  sweet potato    rice patties

a lovely low fat vegetable entree or lunch, which is great served hot or cold. 
nice for a picnic or served in a burger.

1. cook the rice in a large saucepan of salted water until done
2. meanwhile chop & steam or boil the sweet potato until tender , drain well
3. transfer to a large bowl and mash until almost smooth
4. cut the zucchini into small dice add this and all other ingredients to kumara and mix well , season with salt & pepper
5. divide the mixture into equal portions and cook in non stick fry pan lightly oiled for 3 minutes each side , drain on paper towel
6. sprinkle with sea salt and serve on a bed of baby spinach and drizzle with sweet chili sauce
demonstrations.review: These were so yummy! I made a huge batch of them and froze them for meals throughout the week. I topped them with chilli sauce and served with veges and pita bread. Great recipe - thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy veggie burrito for one  vegan

i made this for my sister last night, and she raved so spontaneously that i realised this was probably good enough to post here! :-) personally, i would use less of the bell peppers, but she loves them! you can also add some fresh corn kernels, if you have them... play around with this recipe as much as you want!

1. heat water in a saucepan and saute the onions and bell peppers until the peppers are as tender as you want them
2. add the garlic powder , tomatoes , basil , oregano and cook until tomatoes are soft
3. now add the refried beans and cook until bubbling
4. meanwhile , heat a skillet and heat the tortilla , about 15 seconds on each side
5. remove from the skillet onto serving dish
6. spoon the refried beans mixture into the centre of the tortilla , fold the right and left sides one-third to the centre , then roll up from top to bottom and eat immediately !
7. or , roll it any way you want , and eat immediately !
8. top with salsa , if you like
demonstrations.review:
Brilliant, easy, tasty, healthy meal.
I added chopped fresh chilli, plus some Mexican spices and served with salsa and avocado salad.
Very yummy; will definitely make again - thanks for this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
north african lentil soup

great for a light supper! serve with a crusty baguette spread with some roasted garlic, a tossed salad with wild baby greens and a balsamic vinaigrette and you're on your way! make a double batch and the leftovers freeze well, too.

1. rinse lentils several times in cold water , setting aside to drain
2. heat garlic in olive oil in large saucepan , being careful not to scorch garlic
3. add onion and saffron and cook , stirring , until onions are tender
4. add carrots , celery , and turnip , cooking 10 minutes over low heat
5. add lentils , broth , tomatoes , and parsley
6. season to taste with salt and pepper
7. bring to a boil , then reduce heat and cover
8. simmer over low heat 1 1 / 2 hours until lentils are tender and broth is slightly thickened
9. add lemon juice just before serving
demonstrations.review: A very good lentil soup recipe; great for our cold country winter nights. Served with crusty bread and Mirj's sweet potato pancakes, it was a winner dinner! Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
halloween or fall pumpkin bread

vegetable bread for halloween or fall. full of vegetable nutrients and freezes well. from barbaja's neighbor, j.k.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease 2 loaf pans or 3 medium size disposable gift pans or one large 11 1 / 2 inch size cast iron fry pan
3. the fry pan makes it nice and crusty on the edges and bottom
4. dissolve baking soda and hot water together
5. stir and set aside
6. mix together the following: oil , sugar , eggs , pumpkin
7. then add soda water into it
8. spices
9. flour 1 / 2 cup at a time until all is added stir in between
10. bake for 50-60 minutes until golden brown and done by toothpick test
demonstrations.review: Yummy! I made this for our Queens Birthday long weekend, and it was fabulous.

target.recipe_text:
savory rice pilaf with lavender   apricots

i got this recipe from the herb gardeners at festival hill in round top, texas. it is the most beautiful pilaf and has a lovely taste. just don't tell finicky eaters what's in it.

1. melt butter in medium saucepan
2. gradually add onion and celery
3. cook until wilted
4. add garlic and rice
5. stir until thoroughly coated with butter
6. add broth , ginger , lavender and salt
7. bring to boil
8. reduce heat to low
9. cover and cook without stirring until liquid is absorbed
10. when rice is tender , stir in currants , apricots , and lemon juice
11. remove from heat and let stand covered to soften fruits
12. add nuts and herbs and mix well
13. serve immediately
target.review: This was by far very intresting. I have never used lavender before and I must say it was an aquierred taste for my taste buds.  I think my brain is used to associating lavender with soap or shampoo or lotion thats why it tasted a bit complex on my pallet at first. I did love the dish and will make it again just that I will use less lavender and incress the amounts as my taste buds ajust to it at time goes by. If you have never eaten lavender before I think 2 tablespoons is too much.  Id suggest 1/2 table spoon for first timmers.  I had a hard time finding red curranst, is there a suggestion for a good substition?  Whole foods only has dried black currants because this fruit is not in season. Will that be ok to use or will it throw off the whole taste of the recipe?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
avocado rice

my brother in new zealand sent me this, it's incredibly simple and delicious. i have no idea where he got it, i think he made it up.

1. rinse rice , add coconut , and cook rice according to package directions
2. let cool a couple of minutes when done
3. seed& peel avocado , dice it up , and add to rice
4. add mustard and chili powder
5. stir well and serve
demonstrations.review: Im usually very open to recipes and give them the a re-evaluation on my pallet had I subistituted some ingredients for others, however....I followed everthing to the dot and this recipe just tasted weird. There is just something missing I did not feel like the ingredients mixed well with one another.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
super moist banana nut muffins

this muffin recipe i have adapted from many recipes put together until i got the perfect banana muffin! love these they are great, super moist and yummy!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and lightly butter 24 muffin tins
2. in a large bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
3. set aside
4. with an electric mixer , whip the bananas and sugar together for a good 3 minutes
5. add the soft butter , eggs , and vanilla and beat well , scraping down the sides of the bowl once or twice
6. mix in the dry ingredients just until incorporated
7. fold in the nuts if desired with a rubber spatula
8. spoon the batter into the muffin tins to fill them about halfway
9. bake until a toothpick stuck in the muffins comes out clean , about 20 minutes
10. let cool for a few minutes before turning the muffins out
demonstrations.review: WOW this recipe was spot on.  The results were mouth watering, and just simply gorgeous. I followed the recipe as is.  I did not have pecans so I used walnuts.  I roasted the walnuts and folded half of them into the mixture. I held back the other half to sprinkle them on top of the muffins and the loaf of banana nut bread.  Note *  I did not have any unsalted butter so I just used the regular salted butter and left out the salt that the recipe calls for.  The taste turned out AMAZING.  Usually banana nut bread is always dense  but this recipe was super light and fluffy and moist.  I wished I had taken pics right away half of the muffins are gone now. With the recipe I made 12 muffins and one loaf of banana nut bread. This is now my official Nana Nut Bread recipe. Thank  You!  Im adding pics of what I have left.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
impossible peanut butter cookies

these are the quickest, simplest peanut butter cookies that you will ever make and they taste great!

1. mix peanut butter , sugar , and egg together until smooth
2. drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet two inches apart
3. if desired , roll in extra sugar before placing on cookie sheet
4. press with fork
5. press again in opposite direction
6. bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. do not brown
8. do not over bake
demonstrations.review:
The flavor was good, but I had trouble getting cookie dough to stay together after i pressed it lightly with the fork. I had to add a little flour to keep the peanut dough together. I found that the first batch of cookies were easier to put on the bakeing tray. I suggest working with getting the cookies in the oven asap after you prepare the peanut butter mix. Do not set aside. If  you really must, then stick the mix in the fridge. If not you will find that when the mix warms up with room temperature you will end up with a real greasy like dough that will keep breaking up and is hard to work with. 
This makes a good cookies if you can make it work!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nummy easy key lime pie

easy easy easy!!! and done in about 30 minutes.

1. beat egg yolks with food coloring
2. then mix in sweetened condensed milk
3. then mix in key lime juice and zest
4. pour into graham cracker crust and bake at 325 for about 20 minutes or center is jiggly when shaken slightly , or when knife inserted in center leaves mark
5. chill in freezer for 10-15 minutes
demonstrations.review:
This was really yummy and super easy to make.  Even my hubby said "I loved the lemon key lime pie baby| =0)

 I really miss all the acessabilithy to ingredients that I took for granted in the states.  Here in the England there is no such thing as grahm crackers or grahm cracker crust as I soon found out. I improvised and made my own crust with some cookies or should I say biscuits as the brits like to call them .  Morrisons sells some thing called Honey Teddy Bears. Teddy Bear Biscuits with Honey.  I also used Foxes ginger crinkles. I crushed and combined  both of theses cookies and followed  recipe http://www.recipezaar.com/116887  subistituing my crushed  ginger biscuits and honey teady bears for the grahm crackers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bergy dim sum  10  honey soy braised chicken wings

mmmmm these are tasty wings, sticky but tasty. excellent as an appetizer or part of your dim sum brunch. have them as part of your home cooked chinese dinner.

1. cut wings intp three pieces
2. heat oil in wok and fry the larger joints on high heat for 3-4 minutes or until browned
3. add soy , honey , wine , garlic and ginger , stir well
4. reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the wings are tender
5. towards the end watch the wings carefully , stir frequently to make sure the glaze does not burn
6. serve warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: DH devoured these. He asked me where did you buy this sauce and I said I did not buy it I made it!!! He loved the wings so much that he took some for lunch the next day. I tried to followd the recipe to the T, but I did not have any Chinese wine or dry sherry on hand so I used some white wine that was in the pantry (Pinot Grigio). Also since I was in a rush I cheated by thickening the sauce with (Instant thicking granules by Mc Dougalls) Its' a UK brand but Im sure there must be something similar to that in the US. I love it because I dont' have to worry about clupms when trying to thicken a sauce using corn starch or flour to thicken sauces. THIS IS DEFINATELLY A KEEPER! THANKS FOR SHARING!!!!

target.recipe_text:
ice cream cone cupcakes

this is an excellent treat for the kids; sure to bring a smile to their faces!

1. heat oven to 400f
2. prepare batter for cupcakes per instructions on the box
3. pour scant 1 / 4-cup batter into flat-bottomed ice cream cones so they are a little less than half full , or about half full
4. if you fill the cones too much , the cakes will not have a nice , round top
5. place the cones on a baking sheet and bake for 15 to 18 minutes
6. cool and frost , then decorate with sprinkles as desired
target.review: I don't think I filled them up as much as I was supposed to because they were flat. However, I covered mine with whipped cream, so they still looked big. The edges of the ice cream cones were really crispy, especially the ones on the sides of the pan, closed to the oven. So, next time I might try using a slightly lower oven temp or time, and just making sure the cupcakes get done too. This is a fabulous idea. I'll definitely use this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
olive garden raspberry mousse cheesecake

this is a copycat recipe.

1. filling-preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. mix cream cheese , sugar , eggs and vanilla with electric mixer on medium until thoroughly blended , about 3 to 4 minutes
3. pour into prepared crust
4. place on baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes
5. cool to refrigerated temperature
6. mousse-sprinkle gelatin over cold water , stir and let stand 1 minute
7. micro on high for 30 seconds or until gelatin is completely dissolved
8. combine gelatin with preserves
9. chill 10 minutes
10. cream-whip cream until soft peaks form
11. add 2 t sugar and continue whipping until stiff peaks form
12. measure out 1-1 / 2 c of whipped cream for mousse and set aside
13. refrigerate remainder of cream for topping
14. gently fold raspberry mixture into measured whipped cream
15. spread raspberry mousse on top of chilled cheesecake , mounding slightly in the center
16. chill 1 hour before serving
17. to serve , cut cheesecake into 6 servings and top each piece with a dollop of reserved whipped cream
demonstrations.review: I only had 1/2 a cup of whipping cream, so I decided I would whip it up and just use it for the mousse instead of saving some for topping it. I don't think I had enough whipping cream for it to whip though- you know, like not enough volume or something. It just wouldn't whip so it was fluffy. It got a little poofy, but not like whipped cream should be. I made the mousse part anyway, but left it on the side. All my friends think I have an gift with cheesecake and they reported to me that this was the best one I have ever made (they decided not to try the raspberry mousse on top). So, even just the plain cheesecake was absolutely brilliant. I used a store bought crust this time, but next time I think I will attempt a homemade chocolate crumb crust.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttery bread machine rolls

these golden, fluffy, butterfy rolls are great hot from the oven. the dough is very easy to shape. this recipe is from a quick cooking magazine

1. in bread machine pan , put all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is completed , turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
4. divide dough into 24 portions
5. shape dough into balls
6. place in a greased 13 inch by 9 inch baking pan
7. cover and let rise in a warm place for 30-45 minutes
8. bake at 350 degrees for 13-16 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: The first time I made these the rolls on the edge of the dish were overcooked and the middle was still very VERY doughy. I took them out and removed the outside edge of the rolls and put it back in, but the rolls in the middle got harder than rocks. The second time I decreased the oven temp to 350 degrees and had to cook for more like 20 minutes maybe a little more, but the rolls turned out evenly browned and very delicious. My company that came for dinner loved them!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chinese general chicken   ww core

this is a very tasty version of general tso's chicken.  if you are following weight watchers core, the cornstarch is less than a half point per serving.  on flex, this is about 6 points per serving.

1. cut chicken into 2 inch pieces
2. in a small bowl , mix together chicken broth , cornstarch , splenda , soy sauce , vinegar and ginger
3. set aside
4. heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat
5. add scallions , garlic and pepper
6. cook 2 minutes , add chicken and cook until browned , about 5 more minutes
7. add sauce and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through , about 3 minutes
8. serve chicken and sauce over rice
demonstrations.review: This chicken is AMAZING! I printed off the recipe a few months ago, but hadn't made it until last night, and now I am shooting myself in the foot for waiting! It is so delicious! At first, my sauce wasn't thickening up, but it got there after awhile. My only complaint is that it tasted kinda salty- but that was totally defeated by its amazing flavor. Restaurant General's Chicken doesn't even stand up to it, being totally honest.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blueberry muffins   fat free  sugar free  cholesterol free

this is a recipe i found on the internet and modified to be virtually free of fat, sugar and cholesterol.  while these muffins are not overly sweet, they definitely satisfy!  enjoy!

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. spray muffin tin with cooking spray
3. in a large bowl , combine both flours , baking powder and baking soda
4. mix well
5. in another bowl , combine remaining ingredients except for the blueberries
6. mix well
7. add to dry mixture and again , mix well
8. add blueberries and fold in gently
9. divide evenly into prepared muffin cups
10. bake for 15 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean
11. remove muffins to a rack to cool
12. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: My muffins turned out really dry, chewy, and pretty bitter. They were horrible, but definitely not the best ever. Thanks for posting though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
demonstrations.review: Not like this needs another review, but I'll do it anyway. Another 5 stars. Big surprise. Like the recipe says DO NOT OVERBAKE! The first time I made these, they were overbaked, and in turn were really tough and dry. I'd say it's almost better to pull them out a little early (overcourse not do they aren't cooked). When I took mine out when I was debating whether or not they were done, they turned out chewy and fudgy and moist. Yum. I had people lining up for thirds.

target.recipe_text:
mexican wontons

wonderful appetizer for a crowd!

1. grease 24 miniature muffin cups lightly with oil
2. press one wonton wrapper into each cup
3. brush the wontons with oil
4. bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes , or until golden brown
5. remove from muffin cups and arrange on a baking sheet
6. brown the sausage in a skillet , stirring until crumbly , and then drain
7. combine the sausage , cheddar cheese , monterey jack cheese , salad dressing , red pepper and olives in a bowl and mix well
8. spoon one tablespoon into each wonton
9. bake at 325 degrees for five minutes , or until bubbly
target.review: Made some of these to freeze for the Superbowl.  I left out the red pepper and put in pickled jalapenos in their place.  I also substituted the Cheddar cheese with Mexican blend cheese.  I tested out a couple and they were great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian seasoning   old sub sailor

this replaces the store bought jars and tastes so much better.

1. mix all ingredients in a spice grinder
2. or put in a small bowl and crush with the back of a spoon
3. store in an airtight jar for up to 6 months
demonstrations.review: I make this all the time and use it often.  It's so much cheaper than buying it too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mexican potato salad

potato salad with a tex-mex flair.

1. cook potatoes in boiling water 10-12 minutes or until fork-tender
2. drain
3. rinse with cold water
4. drain well
5. in a large mixing bowl , mix mayonnaise and seasonings
6. add potatoes , celery , pepper , onion , and corn
7. gently mix all together to coat
8. chill
demonstrations.review: I omitted the cilantro (personal preference) and used sweet vadalia onions instead of green onions.  I let the flavors mix together by setting in the fridge for about 8 hrs. before serving.  We really enjoyed it with our Jalapeno burgers!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
southern florida chicken salad sammies sandwiches

a friend's mom passed this on to me.  she and her husband had to relocate to puerto rico for his job and they spent quite a bit of time down there.  when she came home, she brought a ton of new recipes to pass on to us.  she and her husband had this at a small restaurant and they wouldn't give up the recipe.  this is her take on it.

1. mix mayonnaise , sour cream , and tarragon
2. stir in chicken , almonds and celery
3. season with salt and pepper , if desired
4. cover and refrigerate for at least one hour to marry the flavors
5. when serving , divide the chicken salad between 2 bread slices
6. top with lettuce and remaining bread slices
7. serve with a dill pickle and potato chips
demonstrations.review: I loved the sandwich but I made it without the almonds.  The tarragon gave it a nice touch.  I used dried tarragon instead of the leaves.  I also added my chips into my sandwich.  Love the crunch!  A nice dill pickle on the side and I was ready to go!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon apple crostata

this european-style tart is easily shaped on a cookie sheet and has an extra-cinnamony aroma while it bakes. enjoy it warm from the oven.  from the pillsbury website.

1. heat oven to 450f
2. remove pie crust from pouch
3. place flat on ungreased cookie sheet
4. in medium bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup sugar , the cornstarch and cinnamon
5. gently stir in apples
6. spoon apple mixture onto center of crust , spreading to within 2 inches of edge
7. fold crust edge over filling to form 2-inch border , pleating crust as necessary
8. brush crust edge with water
9. sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar
10. bake 15 minutes or until crust is golden brown
11. sprinkle pecans over apple mixture
12. bake 5 to 15 minutes longer or until apples are tender
13. serve with whipped cream
demonstrations.review: If your not good at making crust, this is the recipe to use!  I loved it and so did DH.  I served it with some ice cream and the kids were actually quiet for 5 minutes while they were shoveling it in!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fruit salad pudding

can't recall where i got this recipe many years ago, but i've double & tripled the recipe at times to made it for weddings & special gatherings, & it's always a hit! and the recipe can be varied by using a different flavor of pudding! preparation time does not include time needed to chill.

1. with electric mixer , carefully beat cool whip , sugar & sour cream until stiff
2. add instant pudding & milk , & continue beating
3. when well blended , add drained fruit
4. pour into clear serving bowl & chill
5. when ready to serve , sprinkle coconut over pudding
demonstrations.review: I made this to bring to my moms house for a family outing and it was so refreshing and delicious.  Needless to say I went home with an empty bowl!

target.recipe_text:
veronica s easy spanish rice

dh wanted spanish rice one night so i made the following recipe that i got from betty crocker. omg, it was just like eating my mom's. i forgot how good her spanish rice was!!! try it, you won't be disappointed!!! serve as a meal in its self or as a side dish.

1. in a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. add rice and onion and cook stirring occasionally , until rice is golden brown and onion is tender
3. stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until rice is tender
target.review: This was a huge hit tonight.  It tasted just like the rice served at our favorite Mexican restaurant.  I did add a squeeze of lime juice to it but other than that followed the recipe exactly.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic lime chicken breasts

this came from my friend liz's recipe box. few ingredients but great flavor, chicken always turns out moist. she makes extra to have leftovers for mexican lime chicken soup.

1. whisk together lime juice , oil , garlic , salt , and pepper in a large bowl
2. add chicken , turning to coat
3. marinate chicken , covered and refrigerated , turning once or twice , for at least 2 hours and up to 8 hours
4. put a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees
5. remove chicken from marinade and arrange skin side up , without crowding , in a shallow baking dish
6. season with salt and pepper
7. roast until just cooked through , 25 to 30 minutes
8. if chicken has a skin , turn oven to broil
9. broil chicken about 2 inches from the heat until skin is crisp , about 2 minutes
10. serve with lime wedges
demonstrations.review: This was perfect.  Juicy, flavorful and great on the grill.  Even my uber picky 6 year old ate it and he hates everything.
