I used Cream of Golden Mushroom soup I added 1 beef bulion cube, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce I used cayanne in place of black pepper and at the end I added a few shakes of good smoked paprika. A few snips of chives on top served as garnish


EDIT:
I did this again last night with the following adjustments and it was awsome!!
I browned the meat with onion and 1 packet of Good Seasons Garlic and Herb Salad dressing mix, paprika, and a dash of cayanne and added a package of sliced baby bellas. The addition of the salad dressing mix made for a tasty meal

target.recipe_text:
lemon freeze dessert

this is posted in response to a request. i remember making this when i was about 12 years old, boy does it bring back memories.

1. combine corn flake crumbs , 2 tbsp sugar and melted butter in an 8 inch pie pan
2. mix well
3. remove 1- 2 tbsp of the mixture and reserve for topping
4. press remaining mixture of crumbs to evenly form crust
5. beat egg yolks until thick
6. combine with condensed milk
7. add lemon juice and lemon peel
8. stir until thickened
9. beat egg whites until stiff , not dry
10. gradually add 3 tbsp sugar to egg whites
11. fold gently into lemon mixture
12. pour into pie pan
13. sprinkle with reserved crumbs
14. freeze until firm
15. remove from freezer 10- 15 minutes before serving
target.review: Perfect! Simple ingredients, quick throw-together, and delicious finished product. Can't wait to try it with pineapple! Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
almost candy bars

this starts with a pillsbury devils food cake mix and a lot of good stuff. easy to make and luscious to eat!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in a large bowl combine the cake mix and butter with pastry blender or fork
3. cut butter into cake mix until crumbly
4. sprinkle evenly in bottom of ungreased 15x10x1 pan
5. press lightly
6. sprinkle with butterscotch chips , chocolate chips , coconut and chopped nuts
7. pour condensed milk evenly over ingredients
8. bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes or until light golden brown
9. cool completely
10. cut into bars
demonstrations.review: While I can't rate it exactly as it is written, due to substitutions, the finished product was well received. Instead of a box cake mix, I used the dry ingredients from the chocolate cake I usually make, and didn't use butterscotch because some family members don't care for butterscotch. Used toffee crumbles instead, which worked out well. Pretty easy to make, looks good(was gifted for Christmas), and tastes great, nice recipe, thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
corn  souffle

this is a scrumptious way to serve a corn side dish.

1. combine all ingredients in a big bowl
2. pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch pan
3. bake 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes
demonstrations.review: Can't be beat for potlucks. Fix this, bake it in a disposable aluminum pan, it'll all be gone and no mess afterward. Everybody loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast hash browns

i find this recipe simple and the aroma mmmmm. the secret making hash browns is to partially cook the potatoes first so they do not discolor when you cook them. the cheese in this recipe helps them hang together so you get a golden cake of hash browns not just broken up bits. boil your potatoes ahead of time and it will only take 10-15 minutes to finish them at breakfast

1. boil the potatoes until just barely tender , set aside to cool so you can handle them
2. grate the potatoes
3. spray a non stick skillet with veggie oil and place half the potatoes in it , sprinkle with salt& pepper
4. top with cheddar , green onions& bacon
5. add remaining potatoes , pat down
6. turn heat to high and cook about 5 minutes , shaking pan to keep the potato cake loose
7. using a spatula lift edges carefully to see when the bottom is golden brown
8. place a plate over the skillet and invert the pan getting the potato cake out in one piece , brown side up on the plate
9. spray the skillet with oil again and slide the potato cake back into the pan uncooked side down
10. cook about another 5 minutes
11. slide back onto a plate and cut into wedges
demonstrations.review:
I can really only echo the words of others before me, along with a hearty thank you.
Finally, perfectly presentable and edible hash browns at home, and so easy with the boiling method. Again,thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
flawless pressure cooker brown rice

a simple yet delicious sticky brown rice recipe that pairs well with any meal

1. spray pressure cooker with cooking oil
2. add all ingredients to pressure cooker
3. once pressure is achieved , set timer for fifteen minutes
4. let pressure drop by its own accord and keep lid on until ready to serve
5. this will yield a rice that is not dry , maintains a nice consistency and is far better than any stovetop version
demonstrations.review: Why didn't someone tell me? I started on a quest to prove the value and versatility of the pressure cooker. First, beef roast for filling tacos, etc. Then frioles. Finally, because this recipe intrigued me, brown rice with the intentions of jazzing it with a can or two of Rotel. When the pressure dropped enough to sample, I was truly stunned! Boys and girls, I'd eat this for BREAKFAST!, it's that good. I used half chicken stock,half beef broth, minimal seasoning. Superb recipe, quick, easy and healthy. This one goes in my keepers, thanks so much for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chinese  brown sauce  chicken

i love this recipe and could eat it at least once a week! i think it tastes very close to the brown sauce that is served in chinese restaurants. i have made it with and without the veggies with great success.

1. lightly brown chicken breasts in a small amount of oil
2. remove from pan and add garlic , soy sauce , brown sugar and 1 cup chicken broth
3. stir to mix and return chicken to pan and cover
4. simmer for a few minutes until the chicken is done
5. remove chicken again and add remaining broth , which has been mixed with cornstarch
6. bring to a boil to thicken and return chicken to the pan , coating it well
demonstrations.review: I'm reminded of Emeril, in that you could put this sauce on a car bumper and it would taste good. So easy. I generally add some red pepper flakes, or hot sauce, or both, but that's personal preference. This is a great starter sauce for anyone trying to recreate the taste of Chinese take out at home, on a budget, with generally on hand items, wish I'd found it earlier. Ty for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
cake mix sugar cookies

this tastes like a real cut out cookie and it is easy because it starts with a cake mix. i make these a lot and no one ever guess that it is made with a cake mix. some times i sprinkle the cookies with cinammon sugar before i bake them. cooking time does not reflect chill time.

1. in a large bowl mix cake mix , butter , egg and milk
2. do not over mix
3. shape dough in a ball
4. chill for 2 hours
5. roll 1 / 8 inch on a floured surface
6. cut out with a floured cookie cutters
7. place 2 inchs apart on a cookie sheet that has been very lightly sprayed with cooking spray
8. bake at 375 degrees for 6-10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
9. cool slightly
10. move to rack to cool fully
11. store in airtight container
target.review: I just got through making a batch of these for a Christmas thing I am going to. I used lemon cake mix. They turned out great! And so easy! Will definitely make these again and again. I didn't roll them out at all though. I just kind of made a ball about the size of a golf ball, maybe a litte smaller,  and then slightly flattened it out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheesy potatoes

updated! as i never measure and a not wonderful review, i finally got my mom to write down the recipe. full of flavor, cannot go to a pitch in without it. also very good as leftovers.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. boil potatoes for 20-30 minutes , or until softened
3. peel and dice them , placing them in a large baking dish
4. add velveeta , onion , crumbled bacon , and mayonnaise
5. mix well
6. bake for 45 min to 1 hour
demonstrations.review: This recipe was okay but nothing I would call exceptional. My daughter made these last night. The only saving quality was the bacon. The potatoes were really pretty dry. I think my daughter is going to add some kind of soup to make it creamier to use up the leftovers. But we appreciate your posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sloppy joe taco cups

i haven't made these as yet, it looks so good, i can't wait to try it!
since i have not made this as yet, i am not sure how many biscuits are in the refrigerated buttermilk biscuits dough package, or also the correct size of the package, so i really cannot say what the correct yield would be as yet, i am only estimating 8 biscuits for this and 8 ounce for the weight, correct me if i am wrong! you might want to try my recipe#76616 for this :)

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. separate the biscuits and press into a 3-1 / 2-inch circle
3. place over the underside of a standard-side muffin tin , pressing around the cup to shape into a "bowl"
4. bake for 12-15 minutes or until browned
5. remove and place baked cups on a serving platter
6. in a skillet brown the beef with onions , garlic and green pepper until browned
7. season with salt and pepper
8. add in taco seasoning , water and sloppy joe sauce
9. simmer for 6-7 minutes or until hot and bubbly , stirring occasionally
10. stir in 1 cup cheese
11. mix until combined
12. spoon the cooked beef / cheese mixture evenly between the baked "cups"
13. top with lettuce , tomato and more shredded cheese
14. top with sour cream and sliced olives
demonstrations.review: Tried this last night. I guess I should have used the Grand biscuits. I bought a store brand and they were hard to get over the muffin tins and they baked up hard because they were so thin. The flavors were good but it was a lot of work. Probably won't do this again. Easier to just do tacos.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
copycat olive garden chicken vino bianco

after much searching, this copycat olive garden recipe was found on the web in response to a request.

1. heat oil in non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. season chicken strips with salt and pepper' brown strips in hot oil and remove to a plate
3. stir in onions and garlic and cook until tender
4. then stir in mushrooms and cook until golden
5. stir in wine and bring to simmer
6. stir in tomatoes and return to a simmer
7. season with salt and pepper and return chicken to pan
8. cook over medium heat until sauce begins to thicken
9. finish sauce with cream and parsley
10. serve warm over pasta of your choice
demonstrations.review: I printed this recipe off for my daughter because her favorite dish at Olive Garden is Chicken Vino Bianco. And they don't always have it on their menu. She called to tell me she made it and said it was nothing like what she gets at OG. She did use chicken broth instead of wine because that's all she had, but even with that she said it wasn't very good.  Her son ate it okay because he does like mushrooms. She also didn't like the way the chicken was prepared. Sorry about the review and maybe if she had used wine instead it would have been better.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken vino bianco

this is directly from the olive garden web site. cooking times approximate.

1. heat oil in large saute' pan
2. dust chicken in seasoned flour
3. cook chicken on both sides until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees
4. remove chicken from pan and set aside
5. add 2 tbsp butter to pan
6. add green onion , diced tomato , red onion , mushrooms , garlic , chopped parsley , crushed red pepper , black pepper and salt to pan
7. let saute' for three minutes , stirring constantly
8. add chicken back to pan
9. add white wine , lemon juice and the remainder of the butter
10. allow to come to a boil
11. cook pasta according to directions
12. add drained cook pasta to the pan and toss together and serve
demonstrations.review: I thought I had rated this. I made this for my daughter because this was her favorite OG dish and they don't make it anymore.  It was pretty much spot on.  I don't like the wine taste so when I make it for me I just substitute chicken broth and I love it.  Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sticken chicken

june 3, 2004. tastes great! very easy to make! i started it at 250-300 degrees and then up to 350 so i didn't have to wait so long. the results were still delicious! my family killed it!

1. preheat oven to 200 degrees
2. wash chicken
3. dry thoroughly
4. coat chicken with flour seasoned with garlic salt , paprika and ginger
5. arrange chicken skin side up in a single layer in baking pan
6. roast , uncovered , for 1 hour
7. drain
8. mix other ingredients in a pot over a low flame
9. pour over baked chicken when sugar has suitably melted
10. bake for another 2 hours at 250 degrees or until chicken is done and delicously glazed
11. basting and turning at least once will ensure an evenly coated glaze
demonstrations.review: Just wanted to add my kudos to you on this recipe. I have made it twice. Once with the long method and once with a shorter cooking time as was stated in another review. Both ways were great. Totally love it and my kids, my mother, and my sister all raved about it. Thanks for the recipe.

target.recipe_text:
crisp cucumber freezer pickles

this is a sweet cucumber pickle. these pickles stay crisp for up to a year in the freezer. they are so easy to make and very good.  i have just defrosted a bag (pictured here) after 8 months in the freezer and they are still as crisp as the day i  made them.

1. combine all the ingredients in a bowl
2. stir well , cover and refrigerate for 3 days
3. stir every day
4. pack into freezer containers and cover with brine
5. freeze thaw before serving
target.review: I just put them in a big jar in the spare fridge, haven't tried freezing so far.  They are wonderful!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
uncle bill s mustard pickles

this recipe has been a family favorite for many years. i made some changes to the original family recipe to enhance the flavor of the finished product.

1. wash and finely chop cucumbers
2. seed and dice sweet red and green peppers
3. place chopped cucumbers and peppers in a large bowl
4. sprinkle over with pickling salt , cover and let sit overnight
5. the next morning , drain off the liquid and discard
6. finely chop cauliflower , onion and celery and mix in with the cucumbers and peppers
7. transfer vegetables to a large cooking pot
8. add vinegar and sugar and bring to a boil
9. reduce heat and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until vegetables are just tender , do not overcook
10. in a small bowl , mix mustard and turmeric in a half cup of cold water
11. when vegetables are nearly done , mix in mustard mixture and stir until well blended and bring mixture back to just boil
12. sterilize and prepare canning jars of your choice
13. fill jars to within 1 / 4" of the top of the jars
14. apply lids and screw tops and process according to the method you are most familiar with
15. when jars are sealed and cooled , label and store in a cool , dark place
demonstrations.review: Loved these.   Made several jars to give our dinner guests and they say they're saving them and trying not to eat the whole jar in one sitting.  Going to do it again for Christmas dinner guests!  ( I dont "can" them so it's super easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rosie s eggs mexicana chile casserole

this is great for a weekend breakfast or brunch.if you want to spice it up a bit try adding jalapeño jack cheese. recipe courtesy of the gosby house inn.

1. combine the eggs , butter , flour , and baking powder
2. mix well
3. stir in cheeses and chilies
4. pour into well-greased quiche pan
5. bake in a 400f oven for 10 minutes
6. slice a tomato and place on top
7. return to oven
8. reduce temperature to 350f , bake another 20 minutes
9. serve with sour cream and salsa
demonstrations.review: Easy. Excellent.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
broccoli mandarin salad

this is another really good broccoli salad recipe - with mandarin oranges!  i got this recipe from the cookbook - the best of the best, and more (the best of bridge).

1. for the dressing , in a saucepan , whisk together eggs , sugar , cornstarch and dry mustard
2. add vinegar and water and cook slowly until it is thickened
3. remove from heat and stir in mayonnaise
4. cool
5. for the salad marinate broccoli in dressing for several hours
6. add remaining ingredients and toss well
demonstrations.review: I've made this several times.   It is great for lunch..or a great side for Turkey dinner.  Don't change a thing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon   garlic spinach

this recipe was a side dish at a restraunt we ate at. i ate so much i couldn't finish my salmon. the spinach is not cooked so the flavor is very fresh. since finding this recipe we have gone through 5 pounds of spinach!! (in 2 weeks)

1. in large pot , add olive oil , butter , garlic and the juice of 1 / 2 lemon
2. let cook over low heat for about 20 minutes so the flavors meld
3. take off heat , add spinach , toss well and serve
demonstrations.review: ...with Pasta! was just throwing together a quick meal and at the last minute mixed the spinach recipe in with whole wheat fettucini, added some sun dried tomatoes.  Unbelievable.  Served it with cornmeal-oven-baked cod.  I think it will be a great make ahead,serve at room temperature side dish for summer.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
harvard beets for the freezer  or right away

the only way to eat beets! when i harvest my beets in the fall i always make up a few batches of this for the freezer-they're just as good reheated and it's a wonderful quick veggie for winter! to prepare fresh beets, i cover them with water, cook for 30 minutes to an hour till tender, then peel and cube. this recipe is a swedish family tradition. the long cooking time includes the time the beets need to marinate.

1. mix the sugar , cornstarch , vinegar and water in a pot and boil 5 minutes , stirring often
2. add the beets , toss to coat
3. if you are freezing: put one batch in a quart size bag or container , and make a
4. if you are eating them now: let stand for at least 30 minutes
5. just before serving , add the butter and reheat to the boiling point
demonstrations.review: These were great.  I made a double batch and froze in 4 smaller portions.  Beets are such a mess it is great to make a big batch and have them in the freezer.

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s 5 minute cinnamon flop brunch cake

except for the the milk and small amount in the egg, the cake itself has very little fat and using low-fat milk will keep the fat to a minimum, i have stated the egg as optional, i strongly suggest to add it in for a more cake-like texture --  if you are looking for a fancy cake to serve then this is not it however for the ease of this cake it is darn good and makes a great weekend brunch cake, it's like a combination of a cake and cinnamon bun all in one,  ridiculously simple to make as it's all mixed by hand and takes like 5 minutes to throw together, try adding in some chopped strawberries, apples or blueberries, raisins or dried cranberries, this recipe is a blank canvas, so go ahead and add in fruit, nuts chocolate chips whatever you wish, and to kick this up a notch drizzle recipe#120835 on top :) --- servings are only estimated

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. prepare a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish , or two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans
3. in a bowl mix the 2 cups flour , 1-1 / 4 cups white sugar , milk , vanilla or almond extract , baking powder , pinch of salt and egg until just combined careful not to overmix
4. pour into prepared baking pan / s
5. generously spread brown sugar and cinnamon on top
6. if desired sprinkle chopped walnuts or pecans over top
7. drizzle melted butter over top
8. bake for about 20-25 minutes for 8 or 9-inch round cake pan , and about 30 minutes for a 13 x 9-inch pan
target.review: My 12 yr old daughter has made this several times and turns out great every time.  She is not here today, so I am making it for my mother.  This is such a quick and simple treat that everyone just LOVES

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marinated chinese chicken salad

delicious and easy to prepare

1. mix marinade ingredients in a small bowl
2. place chicken in slow cooker and pour marinade over chicken , coating each piece well
3. cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
4. remove chicken from slow cooker and cool
5. reserve juices and place in a small sauce pan and simmer for 5 minutes then strain if desired
6. shred chicken into bite-sized pieces
7. in a small bowl , combine the dressing ingredients with 1 / 2 cup of the juice from the slow cooker
8. in a large serving bowl toss together the shredded chicken , lettuce , carrots , peanuts , cilantro , and noodles
9. just before serving , drizzle with the salad dressing
10. toss well and serve
demonstrations.review: This was a hit with my family tonight.  The marindade was really yummy, however a bit too much red pepper flakes for me.  I also left off the peanuts because of alergies but used seseme seeds instead. I wasnt sure about the cilantro but it was fit really nicely with this salad. I will be making this one again.  Nice light dinner for watching the calories.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon wrapped chicken  oamc

this is another great way to make something great ahead of time to thaw as needed or eat right now with little effort!

1. flatten chicken to 1 / 2" thickness
2. spread 3 tablespoons cream cheese over each chicken piece
3. dot with butter and sprinkle with salt
4. roll up
5. wrap each with a bacon strip
6. place , seam side down , in a greased pan
7. bake , uncovered , at 400f for 35-40 minutes or until juices run clear
8. broil 6 inches from the heat for 5 minutes or until bacon is crisp
9. if you are making these ahead for future use , freeze these uncooked on a cookie sheet in your freezer
10. when solid , wrap and put in a ziplock bag or vacuum seal desired quantities
11. to cook from frozen state , thaw before cooking and follow directions above
demonstrations.review: YUMMY !!  I made this for supper tonight and everyone had a second helping so that was a good clue that this one was a keeper and pretty simple to put together too.  I think everyone liked having something just a little bit different. I may have cooked it just a tad too long but I will make note of it for next time. We had this with cranberry rice and carrots.  Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken pot pie with 2 crusts

this is old-fashioned, from scratch, comfort food. this has been a family favorite for years. i like to take this to other families when they are in need of a meal. it's always a winner. i like making it with leftover turkey, too! i often add some cooked diced potatoes.

1. heat butter over low heat until melted
2. blend in flour , onion , salt and pepper
3. cook over low heat , stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly
4. remove from heat
5. stir in broth and milk
6. heat to boiling
7. stirring constantly
8. boil and stir one minute
9. stir in chicken and veggies
10. reserve
11. line pie plate with prepared bottom crust
12. pour in filling
13. top with top crust
14. cut slits in center to vent
15. flute edges
16. cook uncovered in 425f oven until crust is brown
17. approximately 30-35 minutes
demonstrations.review:
A big thumbs up!  I always thought something like this might be harder than it was.  This was really easy and really good :)  I used frozen veggies and added in two medium potatos.  I also mixed in some garlic powder ( I cant seem to cook with out it)
Thanks for a great dinner :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon risotto with grilled tiger shrimp

this risotto can be paired with the grilled shrimp or any other seafood or fish. it is also great by itself or as a side dish with grilled lamb or chicken. the recipe can be halved.
from food and drink.

1. pour the stock into a saucepan and place over medium heat , bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer
2. in another saucepan , heat half the oil and all the butter
3. add the shallots and cook gently for 5 minutes , then add the rice and stir until well coated
4. pour in the vermouth and stir until absorbed by the rice
5. add a ladleful of hot stock , keep stirring the simmering rice until the liquid is almost completely absorbed
6. now add another ladleful of stock and continue cooking , adding more stock only when the previous liquid has been completely absorbed
7. after 15 to 20 minutes , the rice will be creamy and cooked but still slightly al dente
8. preheat the broiler and place the shrimp on a baking sheet , shell-side down
9. season them with salt and pepper , then drizzle over the remaining olive oil
10. broil the shrimp just until they turn opaque , 2 to 3 minutes
11. stir the herbs , zest and juice (you should have about 2 / 3 cup into the rice
12. season with salt and pepper , then divide the risotto between 6 plates and top with the cooked shrimp
demonstrations.review: Fabulous recipe!  This one is for sure high up on my favorite shrimp recipes.  I love lemon so this is a great one for me.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy  penne with chicken  spinach and tomato alfredo  soooo good

this is my family's favorite dish that i make. and it is sooo easy! it is enough for 6 adults. or 2 adults and 2 kids, with more than enough to have for dinner the next night, and then lunch for 2 kids the next day. it's also good if you leave out the chicken.

1. thaw spinach completely in a colander lined with a few paper towels
2. this may take a few hours
3. squeeze spinach completely dry
4. set aside
5. cut up chicken into bite size pieces
6. brown in a skillet
7. keep warm
8. cook penne according to package
9. meanwhile , in a medium sauce pan , add both jars of sauce , tomato and spinach
10. bring to a simmer on low heat , stirring occasionally
11. continue simmering for 10 minutes or so
12. when pasta is done , drain and place in a large serving bowl
13. add chicken and stir
14. add alfredo mixture and stir again
15. serve right away with garlic bread
demonstrations.review: yummy!  the family all loved this.  I made as written except I used fresh spinich, choped and added to the sauce.  I'll be making this one many more times to come.

target.recipe_text:
beef roast

very tender, very juicy. makes lots of gravy great over mashed potatoes simple to make. melts in your mouth everyone who's tried this recipe agrees you won't find an easier or better tasting beef roast recipe anywhere.

1. mix gravy , mushrooms , soup mix and italian dressing
2. pour over beef roast
3. bake , covered , for 1 hour 15 minutes per pound at 300f
4. add carrots and / or potatoes during last hour , if desired
5. cooking time is approximate , depending upon how big your roast is
target.review: I used chicken gravy (it's what I hand on hand) & it was still wonderful!  The roast made the gravy end up very beefy & it smelled incredible while cooking!  (I love recipes that make my home smell great!)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wonderful salsa

this is the best salsa recipe i've found so far and i've tried about a dozen. i got it from one of the local hospital cookbooks that are sold in my area. i changed it a bit and have been canning it for years. the reason i plant a garden is for this salsa. we would be lost without it. hope you like it as much as we do.  one of our members who is a food scientist took this salsa to work, tested the ph and found it measured under 4.0 (well within the safety limit for boiling water bath processing).

1. mix all together and bring to a slow boil for 10 minute
2. seal in jars and cook in hot water bath for 10 minute
3. this is a medium salsa
4. this is also a chunky salsa so if you want a smoother salsa cut your veggies into smaller pieces
5. yields 3-6 quarts or pints
demonstrations.review: My husband is allergic to green peppers, so I tried this highly praised recipe without them.  It was still great & it still tasted like salsa!  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s italian melt in your mouth meatballs

cooking the meatballs in simmering pasta sauce  will not only add so much extra flavor to the sauce the meatballs will be melt-in-your-mouth tender, you may of course oven-bake the meatballs for about 25 minutes,  --- don't be afraid to add in more parmesan cheese and a little more milk, there is no need to measure exactly, this recipe is pretty much foolproof, leftover cooked meatballs make a wonderful pizza topping just slice thinly and freeze until ready to use ----- these also make wonderful juicy burgers shaped into patties-- for more of my tried and true recipes check out my food blog at www.kittencalskitchen.com

1. mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. shape into small meatballs
3. drop the meatballs into simmering pasta sauce , do not stir for at least 20 minutes or you will risk breaking the meatballs
4. continue cooking in the simmering sauce for another 20 minutes
5. after the 40 minutes cooking time continue cooking your sauce with the meatballs in for as long as desired
demonstrations.review: I LOVE it when a recipe starts simply by saying "mix all ingredients."  It was fool proof & delicious.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
demonstrations.review: I made with hershey's cinnamon chips I'd had around forever (b/c I couldn't find a good recipe for them.)  This was excellent!  Thanks for such a delicious & simple recipe.  I love it that it's rated so high & yet has very basic ingredients.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco mac   cheese

i came up with this recipe on a night when i was super exhausted after work but wanted to at least attempt to cook something for dinner. this is quick, easy, and delish!

1. make box of macaroni and cheese as directed
2. meanwhile , brown ground beef and drain
3. add taco seasoning / water
4. simmer meat mixture for 5 minutes
5. while simmering , add 1 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tbsp butter
6. mix well
7. drain meat
8. add meat to macaroni and cheese , mix well
9. add shredded cheddar cheese , mix gently 'til melted
10. serve ! yum !
demonstrations.review: This reminded me a lot of hamburger helper, but it was better.  My kids loved it & I was able to quickly make it with things I had on hand.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pumpkin seeds

one of the best things about halloween when i was a kid was the pumpkin seeds baking while we were finishing up the details on the carving. serving size depends on the pumpkin

1. wash your pumpkin seeds
2. boil 1 quart of water
3. after water has boiled , place the clean seeds and 1 / 8 cup of salt into water for 10 minutes- stir the whole time
4. melt 2 tbs of butter
5. drain the seeds and mix them with the butter
6. place the seeds on a 2 layer tin foiled pan and place in oven at 350 f for 30 minutes
7. do not refrigerate seeds- put them in a sealed bowl and leave them on the kitchen table
demonstrations.review: I was intrigued by the other positive reviews & the extra step of boiling, so I had to try them.  Love these!  They really were the best pumpkin seeds I've ever made.  thanks!

target.recipe_text:
tangy slow cooker pork roast

healthy and easy! each serving has 210 calories, 25 g protein, 10 g carbohydrates, 8 g fat, 0 g fiber, 66 mg cholesterol, and 487 mg sodium

i like spicy stuff, so i use 8 dashes of hot pepper sauce

1. arrange onion slices evenly in slow cooker
2. place the roast on top of the onion
3. in a bowl mix together water , sugar , vinegar , soy sauce , ketchup , black pepper , salt , garlic powder , and hot sauce
4. pour over roast
5. cover and cook on high for one hour , then low for 4-6 hours
target.review: Great recipe... smells so good!  I made this with pork tenderloin I bought on sale, skipped the hot sauce since I was sharing this with my 2 year old, served it over rice the first day, and made sandwiches out of it with the leftovers.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheddar zucchini biscuits

i found this recipe in cooking pleasures magazine. they are absolutely delicious little biscuits. i hope you enjoy them.

1. heat oven to 450f line baking sheet with parchment paper
2. combine zucchini and 1 / 4 tsp of the salt in a small bowl
3. let stand 20 minutes
4. discard excess liquid
5. place zucchini in strainer
6. press on zucchini to drain any additional liquid
7. combine zucchini , cheese , green onions and 1 tbsp of the flour in medium bowl
8. whisk remaining 2 cups flour , baking powder and remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt in medium bowl
9. with pastry blender or two knives , cut in butter until mixture resembles small peas
10. stir in zucchini mixture
11. stir in milk just until soft dough forms
12. drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto baking sheet
13. bake 10- 13 minutes or until light brown on top and bottom
14. serve warm
demonstrations.review: Awesome. My husband died and went to heaven

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker pork chops ii

from allrecipes.com.  i haven't tried it yet but my friend sent it and said it was great!

1. in a large bowl , whisk together olive oil , chicken broth , garlic , paprika , garlic powder , poultry seasoning , and basil
2. pour into slow cooker
3. cut small slits in each pork chop with the
4. place pork chops into the slow cooker , cover , and cook on high for 4 hours
5. baste periodically with the sauce
demonstrations.review: Wonderful flavour!  This was so easy to make since it required no chopping of veggies or anything which is great when you are in a HUGE rush to get out the door, but want dinner ready for you when you get home.  Next time I might try throwing some potatoes or yams in there to soak up all that extra yummy sauce, but not sure how that will turn out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple glazed pork roast

this is just scrumptious. the apples really add to the flavor.

1. rub roast with salt and pepper
2. heat oil in frying pan
3. brown pork roast on all sides in hot oil
4. drain well
5. place apple quarters in bottom of crock pot
6. place roast on top of apples
7. combine apple juice , brown sugar and ginger
8. spoon over top of roast , moistening well
9. cover and cook on low 10 hours or high 6 hours
demonstrations.review:
Awesome dish! Based on the other comments, I had a feeling just apples and ginger was not going to be enough flavor for me, so I made a few modifications and it turned out AMAZING!
1. I browned the pork in garlic butter (I used pork tenderloin)
2. I added half a cup of chicken stock to the apples on the bottom of the crock pot for a bit more flavour and salt
3. I didn't have apple juice, so I substituted apple sauce, and also added a couple tablespoons of apple cider vinegar for some zing.

Even my super picky sister loved it, as did my two toddlers. Served it with rice and apple sauce, fresh baked rosemary bread and apple cider vinaigrette salad. Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best apple pie muffins ever

i got this  recipe from a friend.  i make these often and take them to many potlucks, office parties, the cottage, picnics, children's lunch and the list goes on. recipe from the cookbook "just the best."

1. cinnamon could be added to the batter
2. topping: in a small bowl toss together sugar , flour , butter and cinnamon until crumbly
3. set aside
4. muffins: in a large bowl whisk together brown sugar , oil , egg and vanilla until smooth
5. in a separate bowl , sift together flour , soda and salt
6. stir oil mixture into flour mixture alternately with buttermilk
7. fold in apples , mixing just until combined
8. spoon into greased muffin cups filling 3 / 4 full
9. sprinkle topping over evenly
10. bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and tops spring back
demonstrations.review:
Awesome recipe. Will definitely make this again!
I didn't have buttermilk, so I used half sour cream and half milk, and that worked out great. Also used half whole wheat flour, and to make the topping extra crunchy I added some oatmeal and Bran Buds to the topping.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken with brown rice   barley  crock pot

this is a nice warming dish, with boneless chicken, high fiber whole grains and vegetables. great for an evening meal when you don't want to stand at the stove. try this dish with different grain combinations: brown rice, wild rice blend, red rice, pearl barley, bulgar wheat, millet, rye or wheat berries. be sure to add enough broth for cooking your measure of grain. err on the side of too much rather than not enough liquid in the crockpot.

1. spray inside of 6-quart crockpot with cooking spray or add 1 teaspoon olive oil and coat inside of crockpot
2. add chicken , and prepared broth
3. add grains , diced vegetables , and seasonings
4. stir to mix ingredients in the crockpot
5. cover and cook on low heat for 6-8 hours
6. remove bay leaf before serving , and season to taste as necessary
7. 3 1 / 2 cups of broth seemed to be a better choice , but it depends on your crockpot
demonstrations.review: I may have done something wrong, but this recipe turned into a pot full of complete mush for me!  The flavor was good, but the only person who really enjoyed it was my toothless 8-month-old who devoured it by the handfulls!  I've put the leftovers aside to use as baby food!  Next time I'm craving something like this I will just make a chicken stew or soup, and serve it over rice...NOT attempt to cook grains for this long.

target.recipe_text:
slow simmered spaghetti sauce

easy and delicious.

1. combine all ingredients in a 4-quart slow cooker
2. cook , covered , on high , 6 hours
3. serve over spaghetti , chicken , or pork
target.review: This sauce had great flavor, especially if you like Marinara type sauce.  It would also be great if you added some meat though, but I haven't tried it yet.  Maybe next time.  I would definately recommend this recipe to everyone.  Also, my husband really liked it too, and he's usually a "meat and potatoes" kind of guy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
a simple chicken satay

"tourist thai", but very tasty - and not a skewer in sight! the prep time includes the minutes the chicken has spent swimming in the marinade. i found this in a 1980's harrowsmith cookbook, and do it on occasion with chicken breasts.

1. in a food processor , blend all ingredients , except chicken , until smooth
2. marinate chicken pieces in the mixture for at least 2 hours-- i usually cover and leave in the fridge overnight
3. uncover and bake at 350f for 30 to 45 minutes , basting every now and then
4. serves 4
demonstrations.review: This was really yummy!  I only had time to marinate the chicken for about 1/2 hour.  I baked the chicken in the marinade, but I kept it covered so the sauce wouldn't burn to my pan.  It was served over rice for a great meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy chicken in the crock pot

this is so easy and my kids love it--even eating veggies. easy to change based on what you have on hand.

1. put carrots and onions and potatoes in bottom of crock pot
2. place rinsed out chicken on top of veggies
3. move around if needed to close lid
4. sprinkle a little garlic and pepper on chicken
5. do not add any liquid
6. close lid and cook on low about 6 hours
7. put green beans in crockpot and cook 2 more hours
8. serve with mashed potatoes
9. you can also create a sauce by removing everything to serving dish and then adding cream of chicken / mushroom soup using the broth to thin to the right texture
10. the chicken will fall apart
demonstrations.review: This was really great!  I had never made a whole chicken before and I was surprised at how yummy it turned out.  The chicken definitely fell apart.  The vegetables didn't have "great" flavor (in my opinion) but the meal was good anyway.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy chicken and peppers

this is wonderful served over noodles. i use the no yolk ones.

1. in non-stick skillet , cook chicken , green peppers , onion and garlic in oil until chicken juices run clear
2. stir in tomato sauce , tomatoes , and seasonings
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: WOW!!!  I loved the flavor in this sauce.  I made it for dinner last night and my hubby wouldn't stop raving about it.  We served it over linguine and I used stewed tomatoes because I didn't have any diced tomatoes.  I drained them a bit and put them in a food processor to make the sauce less chunky.  Thanks for another great recipe Inez!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mashed red potatoes with garlic and parmesan

the potatoes are ready in our garden, and this is the first recipe i reach for! these are so good!!

1. put potatoes and garlic in lg pan
2. cover with water
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes , until potatoes are tender
5. drain well
6. mash with the butter , milk , and salt
7. stir in the parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: These were a great version of the red potato.  They were very creamy and yummy.  I had to add quite a bit of salt at the end to add some flavor because I didn't use quite enough garlic, but they were still really good.  I had company over and they raved about them as well.  Thanks for another great recipe Inez!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy  creamy hamburger stroganoff

this easy version of stroganoff is so delicious. i have people beg me to make it for them when they come over for dinner. hope you enjoy it!

1. brown hamburger in large skillet with onion and garlic
2. drain out fat and add soup , sour cream , mustard and milk
3. simmer for 5 minutes
4. add salt and pepper for taste , and serve with egg noodles or rice
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe and VERY easy to make.  From start to finish, it only took me 20 minutes.  I substituted fat-free sour cream and low-fat cream of mushroom soup.  I also used extra lean hamburger.  I was worried that it would have a bad flavor with all the fat missing, but it tasted just as good as the recipe I used to make.  Great recipe.

target.recipe_text:
mozzarella hot sauce chicken

easy and very addicting!  i received this recipe from my good friends, brad & sandy, who are in texas.  this i loved so much i made 4 times in a row!!! they suggest using frank's hot sauce but i've made it only with regular tabasco (i add extra) and it works great...  enjoy!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. melt butter on medium low heat in large skillet
3. add tabasco sauce
4. add chicken and cook until done
5. reduce heat to low and simmer until sauce reduces a bit
6. place chicken in baking dish including the sauce
7. sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. cover with mozzarella cheese
9. place uncovered in oven for 20-25 minutes or until cheese is browned
target.review: Very tasty!  I over did with Habanero sauce, but it was still very good.  I used my frying pan and left all the ingredients in it and then put it in the oven, made for a very easy clean up. Next time I will use Tabasco.  Served it with mashed potatoes and corn.  My boys loved it.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick quiche lorraine

from penzey's spices and written by howard helmer, this recipe is so easy a novice can prepare it.

1. preheat oven to 400f using a fork prick the inside of the frozen pie crust
2. bake for 8 minutes
3. remove from the oven and lower oven to 325f
4. meanwhile cook the bacon in a medium skillet on medium heat
5. drain on paper towels
6. add chopped onion and salt and pepper to bacon fat
7. saute over medium heat about 5 minutes
8. increase to heat to high and cook onions until golden
9. transfer onion to pie shell
10. in a large bowl , beat the eggs with the half and half
11. stir in the cheese and cooked bacon
12. pour this mixture into pie shell
13. bake until set , about 40 minutes
14. let stand 10 minutes before slicing
demonstrations.review: Made this for dinner last night and had it for breakfast too!! It is very good and easy to make. I had a frozen pie crust, made up the bacon and onion as directed, but I didn't have half and half so I just used 2% milk and it came out fine. I did throw in some cheddar and jack that I had in addition to the swiss and also some chopped spinach. It turned out terrific!! I would recommend to anyone.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fruit filled coffee cake

i got this recipe a long time ago from a friend at a former job.  i have since taken it in to meetings at work several times, with different variations on the fruit filling (i've even split the coffee cake by using two different  flavors, such as apple on one side & cherry on the other).  no matter what, this coffee cake always disappears!

1. beat together butter and sugar
2. add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. add other ingredients & combine thoroughly
4. spread about 1 / 2 the batter in a 10x15x1" cookie sheet that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray
5. place pie filling on top of batter
6. top the pie filling with remaining 1 / 2 of batter , spreading it out so that most of the fruit is covered
7. bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes
8. let cool in pan on wire rack
9. frost with powdered sugar icing , if desired
demonstrations.review: Very good with cherry pie filling.  I like a lot of filling so I used two cans, probably 1 1/2 would have been better. I toasted some almond slivers and put on top before I drizzled it with powdered sugar icing. It disappeared quickly at my meeting today. I would make it again for a party. Makes a large pan.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
really good vegetarian meatloaf  really

high in fiber and protein, low in fat, easy and really yummy! i've always thought meatloaf looks and smells so delicious and savory so, as a vegetarian, i decided to make a no-meat version! this is basically our favorite meatloaf recipe but with cooked mashed lentils instead of ground meat. the result is a very tasty dinner!

1. add salt to water and boil in a saucepan
2. add lentils and simmer covered 25-30 minutes , until lentils are soft and most of water is evaporated
3. remove from fire
4. drain and partially mash lentils
5. scrape into mixing bowl and allow to cool slightly
6. stir in onion , oats and cheese until mixed
7. add egg , tomato sauce , garlic , basil , parsley , seasoning salt and pepper
8. mix well
9. spoon into loaf pan that has been generously sprayed with pam or well-greased
10. smooth top with back of spoon
11. bake at 350 degrees for 30- 45 minutes until top of loaf is dry , firm and golden brown
12. cool in pan on rack for about 10 minutes
13. run a sharp knife around edges of pan then turn out loaf onto serving platter
demonstrations.review: Delish! I made regular meatloaf for the family and your recipe for me. Turns out that everyone tried yours and loved it!  My sister-in-law can't have dairy, any suggestions for a cheese substitute?  I made the recipe exactly as stated and I cooked it a little longer because I like a crispy top. Thanks for a new healthy recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven fried eggplant  aubergine

this recipe appeared in "cooking light" magazine. this is a non-traditional way to prepare eggplant, but it really cuts the calories.

1. combine first 2 ingredients , stir well
2. spread evenly over both sides of eggplant slices
3. combine breadcrumbs , cheese , and italian seasoning in a shallow bowl
4. dredge eggplant in breadcrumbs mixture
5. place eggplant on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
6. bake@ 425 degrees for 12 minutes
7. turn eggplant over
8. and bake an additional 12 minutes or until golden
demonstrations.review: Nice light taste with a little crunch. I followed the recipe exactly and then added some fresh basil on top. YUMMMMMMM Thanks for posting such a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blackberry cobbler

this is so great. my family can hardly wait for it to come out of the oven. nothing like it.

1. mix blackberries and sugar
2. let stand 20 minutes or until fruit syrup forms
3. mix together flour , baking powder , salt , and milk in ungreased 8 inch square pan
4. stir in butter until blended
5. spread evenly in pan
6. spoon blackberries over batter
7. bake at 375 degrees for 45-55 minutes or until dough rises and is golden
8. serve warm
demonstrations.review: Very easy and delicious!!!  My husband and I ate 1/2 of it when it came out of the oven. Will definitely make again.

target.recipe_text:
cheesy french bread

this is a little different from the usual garlic french breads i've tried. i served this to my daughter for her 28th birthday dinner tonight.   i changed the original recipe up some to fit our taste buds.  original recipe from paula deen's the lady & sons, too cookbook.

1. combine the cheese , mayonnaise , italian seasoning , garlic powder and ground red pepper
2. spread this mixture on the cut sides of the bread
3. place the bread on a baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes , or until the topping is melted and lightly browned
target.review: I had never made French bread with a mayonnaise topping before and now I'm hooked, LOL. I used cheddar cheese and did add more garlic powder.  Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tuna puffs

cute and tasty appetizer, courtesy of big red booaster club

1. heat to boiling 1 cup water and 1 / 2 cup b utter
2. stir in 1 cup flour and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
3. stir all together until mixture leaves pan and forms a ball
4. take off heat and cool , beat in 4 eggs , one at a time
5. beat mixture until smooth and glossy
6. drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet {1 / 2 teaspoon batter 2 inches apart)
7. bake in 450f oven 15-20 minutes
8. cool and split in halves
9. fill with tuna fish salad
10. makes 50-75 puffs
demonstrations.review: These are wonderful little appetizers and very addicting. The tuna salad filling I used was chopped celery, chopped red onion, chopped dill pickles, mayo and tuna. A couple of tricks if you have not made these before: 1. Use a wooden spoon for stirring.  2. After you cut the puffs in half, you'll find they are semi hollow and you may want to remove a little of the center so it holds more tuna salad.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mockdonald breakfast sandwich

i made this because i love mcdonald's egg mcmuffins. it takes as long to make as a bowl of cereal. this makes one but you can make as many as you like at one time. we even have it for dinner after a long day.

1. toast english muffin with cheese
2. brown bacon in pan
3. cook egg
4. build your sandwich
5. enjoy
demonstrations.review: This was a wonderful breakfast sandwich.  I used Franz 100% Whole Wheat English Muffins, which I buttered after toasting.  Also  scrambled the eggs.  DH had sliced American cheese on his and I had sliced Cheddar on mine. This will be a weekly recipe for us!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ultimate bacon cheeseburger

this is a super yummy recipe.  you can use ready to serve bacon if you'd like

1. mix meat and 1 / 2 cup of the barbecue sauce
2. shape into 8 thin patties
3. top 4 of the patties each with 2 bacon slices , 1 tablespoons barbecue sauce and 1 cheese singles
4. top each with second patty
5. press edges of patties together
6. seal with fork
7. grill patties over medium coals 7 to 9 minutes on each side or until cooked through
8. fill rolls with patties and lettuce
demonstrations.review: Very good.  We really like "stuffed" burgers and this fit the bill.  I also precooked the bacon because I don't like how it looks or the texture unless it's fried, LOL.  I broke it into pieces to fit inside the burger. Loved the combination of bacon and BBQ sauce.  Will this one again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
luke s pizza bagels

we enjoy these for a quick lunch for the kids and they just love them.  you can experiment with a variety of toppings or set everything out and let the kids dive in and top their own.  they will have a great time.  we usually just make them as instructed below and they are delicious.  my husband also makes this on leftover hamburger or kaiser buns instead of the bagel.

1. cut the bagels in half and lay on a baking sheet
2. on top of each bagel spread on pizza sauce , making sure to cover all spots
3. top with pepperoni and cheese
4. put in oven at 375 degrees and bake approximately 10 minutes or until cheese and meat are bubbly
demonstrations.review: Very quick and easy lunch. I made them two ways: first was exactly by the recipe.  Second was with Canadian bacon slices, pineapple tidbits and sliced black olives. They were both very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy oven baked beans and pork chops

this is an easy but really tasty pork chop dish --- purchase the thicker size pork chops or you may use 2-3 larger pork steaks, the thinner chops tend to fall apart when baked as they bake too fast, if desired you can top with shredded cheddar cheese the last 15 minutes of baking, also chopped fresh garlic may be added also to the bean mixture -- this may also be cooked in a crockpot, just brown the chops firstly in a skillet.

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. brown the chops in a frypan on both sides with salt , pepper and garlic powder
3. set aside
4. grease an dutch oven or a oven-proof casserole dish
5. in a bowl mix together the pork and beans , chopped onion , chopped green pepper , bbq sauce , ketchup , brown sugar and cayenne pepper
6. layer half of the bean mixture on the bottom of dutch oven
7. lay the pork chops on top of the bean mixture
8. top with remaining bean mixture
9. bake covered or uncovered for about 1 hour and 15 minutes , or until the chops are tender
10. delicious
demonstrations.review: Used a spicy BBQ sauce and boneless chops. So easy to prepare and made me look like a winner, LOL. Very good! Next time we might try using the cheese topping as suggested.

target.recipe_text:
whole wheat honey banana muffins

these muffins are delicious and have a great texture, and they are 100% healthy! no refined flour or sweeteners. we have a big family, so this recipe makes a lot of muffins, but it is easily halved for a smaller group. to make the muffins lower in fat, replace half of the oil with unsweetened applesauce. i also use "white whole-wheat" flour, which is softer than that made with red wheat (but has the exact same nutritional value).

1. stir together dry ingredients
2. beat oil and honey together
3. add eggs and beat well
4. add bananas and beat to combine
5. add dry ingredients to wet , alternating with hot water
6. mix well after each addition
7. spoon batter into 24 greased muffin cups
8. bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes , or until muffins are golden brown and test done
9. remove from oven and cool on rack
target.review: Made half the recipe, which gave me 24 mini muffins, 6 normal muffins, and a very short mini-loaf.  I added some dark brown sugar (a couple Tbsps.) because we've got some serious sweet tooths at our house that wouldn't eat them otherwise. I didn't bother with beating things separately, just mixed the wet ingredients, dumped in all the dry, and mixed till combined.  They are delicious and my 2 year old keeps asking for more.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey curry sole fillet

if you like the sound of this, you are gonna love the taste. no fuss, alot of buzz!

1. oven preheated 350f degrees
2. combine honey , mustard , curry , & butter in small bowl
3. mix well
4. lightly butter shallow baker
5. add sole fillets , slightly overlapping is good
6. top side up
7. pour curry sauce on top
8. bake for 15-20 minutes
9. serve warm , with cilantro and roasted almond pieces on top
10. mm !
demonstrations.review: Very tasty, tasted like honey mustard sauce.  I think next time I'll use a little less mustard and a little more curry (or a medium curry instead of a mild).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey ginger grilled salmon

super easy, sweet and spicy!

1. in a large self-closing plastic bag , combine first six ingredients
2. mix well
3. place salmon in bag and seal tightly
4. turn bag gently to distribute marinade
5. refrigerate 15 minutes or up to 30 minutes for stronger flavor
6. turn bag occasionally
7. lightly grease grill rack
8. preheat grill to medium heat
9. remove salmon from marinade
10. reserve the marinade
11. grill 12-15 minutes per inch of thickness or until fish flakes easily with a fork
12. brush with reserved marinade up until the last 5 minutes of cooking time
13. discard leftover marinade
demonstrations.review: Very tasty.  I think I want to marinate it longer than 30 min. next time for more flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s sit sandwich  aka squishy sorta muffuletta

from my family recipe box, mom loves this sandwich! "this sandwich is a 'smashing success'... in more ways than one. it's a great traveler." you must admit, it is pretty amusing. :) from the family recipe box, dated 3/1/85.  the sandwich keeps well, chilled, and is good for taking along on picnics and camping trips.

1. cut loaf of bread in half horizontally and hollow out the soft bread from both halves , leaving a shell about 3 / 4-inch thick
2. reserve soft bread for another use
3. in small bowl , combine artichoke liquid with mayonnaise and spread onto bread shells
4. in bottom half , layer ingredients at least three times until mounded high , beginning and ending with tomatoes
5. place top half of bread over mound of ingredients
6. wrap entire loaf tightly with plastic wrap
7. this must be assembled at least 2 hours before serving , but can be assembled up to 8 hours before serving
8. refrigerate
9. before serving , place sandwich on a hard surface and sit on it ! this smashes the ingredients together and makes it easier to serve
10. do not omit this step , strange as it seems , as this step is what makes the sandwich delicious
11. slice the loaf into wedges or slices to serve
12. also , regarding the artichoke juice mixture: you can add only half of it to the mayo , if you like - how much of the spread you're going to need depends on the size of loaf you've gotten
13. yum !
demonstrations.review: My husband says this is the best sandwich he has ever had, homemade or from a restaurant.  The mayo/artichoke sauce is amazing.  I think the sandwich works best with a very crusty loaf, as otherwise the chill time can result in it being a bit soggy (still delicious, just difficult to eat).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
leftover turkey salad

something to do with all the holiday bird leftovers...

1. reconstitute cranberries by soaking in hot water for approx 15 minutes
2. drain cranberries well - pressing out water by hand
3. combine all ingreadients in a mixing bowl
4. chill 2 hours to meld flavors
demonstrations.review: Very tasty! I left out the eggs, only because I didn't have any.  I also used leftover whole cranberry sauce rather than reconstituting dried cranberries.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mama s supper club tilapia parmesan

you asked for it. here it is. thanks so much to mama's supper club. wish we could all go there.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in buttered 13-by-9-inch baking dish or jellyroll pan , lay fillets in single layer
3. do not stack fillets
4. brush top with juice
5. in bowl combine cheese , butter , mayonnaise , onions and seasonings
6. mix well with fork
7. bake fish in preheated oven 10 to 20 minutes or until fish just starts to flake
8. spread with cheese mixture and bake until golden brown , about 5 minutes
9. baking time will depend on the thickness of the fish you use
10. watch fish closely so that it does not overcook
11. makes 4 servings
12. broil 3 to 4 minutes or until almost done
13. add cheese and broil another 2 to 3 minutes or until browned
14. thank you mama's supper club in wisconsin
demonstrations.review: Phenomenal.  Perhaps a tiny bit too salty for me, but my husband thought it was perfect.  I used a little extra lemon juice on the fish and a little extra hot sauce in the topping, with 6 filets (which were about 1 & 1/4 lb. all together).  There's a lovely blend of flavors in the topping, lots of layers to it (sour, salty, a tiny bit spicy, a little bit herby, and cheesy).  I will definitely be adding this to our regular recipe rotation.

target.recipe_text:
wild berry rice for rice cooker

this recipe was in my kambrook rice cooker cookbook.  please note that the recipe is in metric cups (250ml) and not rice cooker cups.

1. place rice and 2 cups water into rice cooker and with lid on set cooker to cook
2. once cooked fluff rice and stir in honey , butter and cream
3. close lid and allow to stand to for 10 minutes on the keep warm setting
4. place berries , icing sugar , 1 / 4 cup water and port into the bowl of a food processor or blender and process until smooth
5. fold berry mixture through rice mixture
6. transfer to serving glasses and top with extra berries and cream
target.review: I loved this (rest of crew was finicky).  I used 1 pkg. frozen mixed berries (thawed) and added a bit of almond syrup instead of the port.  This is best served immediately as it does tend to dry out if left to sit too long.  When this is ready to serve, however, I think this is unbeatable.  This will go into my "for company" file.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sue s reuben sandwich

i love these. they are quick and easy to prepare for an easy lunch or light dinner idea, when you want to take it easy.

1. bring corned beef and swiss cheese to room temperature
2. heat sauerkraut until it is warmed to about 120-140 degrees
3. prepare sandwich by first buttering one slice of bread on one side with 1 tbsp butter
4. place bread , butter side down , in a small skillet
5. follow with the following ingredients in this order: 1 slice of swiss cheese , followed by 4 oz
6. corned beef , followed by 1 1 / 2-2 tbsp of thousand island dressing , followed by well drained and warmed sauerkraut , , followed by a pinch of either juniper berries or caraway , followed by the final piece of cheese
7. top the sandwich with the last piece of bread and spread the other tbsp of butter on the outside of the bread
8. heat the sandwich in the skillet on a med-low heat until the bottom side becomes golden
9. flip sandwich with spatula and lightly brown other side
10. remove to plate and slice in half before serving
11. serve with a dill spear and your favorite chips
demonstrations.review: A HIT!  This turned out the perfect Reuben.  DH was very pleased.  we used deli seeded rye bread and also added caraway seed before "toasting" on the stove.  Will definitely use again!  Thanks for sharing.  Reviewed for ZWT6

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swedish pot roast

from a long-time friend's cookbook compilation.

1. rub the spices on all sides of the meat and brown
2. you may add oil , if necessary
3. add onions , brown sugar , bay leaves , vinegar
4. add water to cover the meat
5. place veggies on top
6. cook overnight on low in the crockpot
demonstrations.review: WOW!  There was hardly anything left of our 3-lb. roast and only two of us eating!  The seasonings on this were fabulous!  I didn't use carrots (didn't have any on hand) so used extra potatoes. I took the hint from the other reviews and left a bit of extra time for making gravy from the drippings.  Mix 1/4 c. flour with 1/4 c. water, make sure there are no lumps.  Gradually add 2 c. drippings then heat over medium-high or high heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. - YUM YUM YUM.  Thanks for a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rumlicious rum cake

this cake is not for the weak of heart it's guaranteed to be a crowd winner. i always like to add a shot or two more than what the recipe calls for.

1. preheat oven 350 degrees
2. grease and lightly flour one bundt pan , and evenly distribute the the nuts on the bottom of the pan
3. in a large mixing bowl blend the cake mix , water , oil , 1 / 2 cup rum , eggs , and the instant vanilla pudding
4. pour batter into the greased bundt pan and bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick is instered into the center and it comes out clean
5. 5-10 minutes before the cake is removed from the oven , combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup rum , butter , and sugar into a sausepan
6. heat on stove until th butter melts and the sugar has dissolved
7. once the cake has been removed from the oven slowly pour the entire hot rum mixture over
8. let the cake rest for 10 minutes and then turn out onto a plate
9. cool
demonstrations.review: Easy, Yummy, & MOIST.  I was out of regular rum so I used a combination of Coconut Rum topped off with Vodka.  Rave reviews from the babysitting co-op moms.  Make sure to pour the liquid slowly so the pan doesn't overflow.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
indian style green beans

this is kid friendly, so mildly spiced. from  la leche league int'l - whole foods for the whole family

1. heat 1 / 2-1 tbls oil in large skillet or wok , saute mustard seeds until they pop ,
2. add a little more oil then add vegetables , cook , stiring constantly for 5 minutes
3. mix in seasonings , reduce heat , cover and simmer 8-10 minutes
4. stir in lemon juice and serve
demonstrations.review: Easy, quick dish with ingredients I already had on hand.  I loved this preparation for green beans.  I did use onion powder instead of fresh onion.  It was good but next time I'll use fresh onion.  The lemon juice really adds to the flavor.  Thanks for posting.  This is definitely a keeper.  Made for ZWT6.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
curried lamb

we don't have lamb for dinner very often - usually when we do, it's a traditional leg of lamb when my mother is visiting.  this, however, is a nice, simple, and easily-made variation for when you find less expensive cuts of lamb.

1. soak onion in water until soft about 5 minutes
2. heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat , and add the onion and saute until golden about 4 minutes
3. reduce heat to low , then add coriander , cumin , cardamom , ginger , tumeric , garlic powder , freshly ground black pepper , and ground red pepper , and stir 1 minute
4. add the cubed lamb meat to skillet , then increase the temperature to medium-high and cook , stirring frequently , until meat is evenly browned , about 10 to 15 minutes
5. add stock and salt , reduce temperature to medium , cover , and simmer until meat is tender , about 20 minutes
6. uncover and simmer an additional approx 20 minutes until the sauce is thickened to desired consistency
7. stir in yogurt and lemon juice and serve immediately over cooked rice
demonstrations.review: I didn't change a thing and it was a hit with the whole family.  This dish will be seen again when we want something other than American food as this has somewhat of a Moroccan flair.  Quite delicious!

target.recipe_text:
mac  n cheese and spinach strata  sp5

official contest entry: simply potatoes 5fix.  a combination of 2 of my favorite foods, this creamy, cheesy casserole is made with simply macaroni & cheese and layered with chopped spinach.  buttery and cheesy breadcrumbs top this delicious dish and give it an added punch of flavor.

1. heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. coat a 2-3 quart glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. set aside
4. transfer 1 package of the heated simply macaroni and cheese to the bottom of prepared baking dish and spread evenly
5. top evenly with spoonfuls of spinach
6. cover spinach with 2nd package of macaroni and cheese and spread evenly
7. in a small bowl , combine the breadcrumbs , butter and cheese
8. sprinkle over casserole
9. bake for 30-35 minutes or until hot and bubbly and crumbs are just starting to brown
target.review: Comfort food at it's best ~ relish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the hidden valley pizza  rsc

ready, set, cook! hidden valley contest entry.  this is my version of a mediterranean pizza

1. preheat oven at 400 degrees
2. on medium high heat in a non-stick cooking pan add oil , shallots , ground pork and hidden valley seasoning mix cook ground pork until it is no longer pink drain on paper towel any excess fat
3. spray pizza pan with cooking spray flour hands and stretch dough to fit your pizza pan
4. spread alfredo sauce on pizza dough top with lemon zest spread on pizza dough
5. continue to layer pizza with spinach , mozzarella , and cooked ground pork mixture and parmesan cheese
6. bake in oven for 25 minutes
7. pat dry tomatoes to soak up any excess juice and top pizza with tomatoes and fresh chives
demonstrations.review: Did someone say pizza with Hidden Valley? I'm so there!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
turkey and vegetable ragout with warm polenta rounds  a1

a.1. original sauce recipe contest entry. my ragout features ground turkey simmered in a delicious a.1. sauce, with fresh tomatoes and zucchini. it is served over warm golden polenta, and finished with creamy goat cheese. this dish is comforting and perfect for a weeknight meal!

1. in a large pan , heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil over medium heat
2. saute onion for 3 minutes
3. add garlic and saute for 1 minute
4. add ground turkey to pan
5. sprinkle with italian seasoning , salt and pepper
6. let cook until browned , stirring occasionally
7. add tomatoes and zucchini to the meat
8. let cook for 5 minutes , or until zucchini is softened
9. add a
10. 1
11. original sauce , tomato sauce , lemon juice and chopped parsley
12. stir well and let simmer for 5 minutes
13. in a large non-stick pan , heat remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat
14. slice tube of polenta into 8 rounds of equal width
15. place polenta slices into pan in a single layer
16. let cook until golden on 1 side , about 5 minutes
17. flip over with a spatula
18. cook until golden on other side
19. to serve , spoon turkey and vegetable ragout over polenta
20. top with crumbled goat cheese
demonstrations.review: Now you are talking yumminess!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet   sassy peachy keen tilapia  rsc

ready, set, cook!  reynolds wrap contest entry.  i created this recipe when we had friends coming over for dinner. i wanted to grill out, but keep it simple, light & delicious. these were such a hit. everyone, kids & adults, loved having their own pouch. the flavors blended together perfectly & clean up was a snap!

1. zest & juice lemon
2. in a bowl , add corn , beans , pepper , peach , jalapeno , lemon zest & olive oil
3. season with salt & pepper & toss gently
4. set aside
5. thin preserves with lemon juice
6. stir in pepper flakes & cayenne
7. spray 4 sheets of reynolds wrap with non stick spray
8. brush preserves on fish
9. place each fillet on a foil sheet
10. top with 1 / 4 of corn relish
11. fold foil to form pouches
12. place on a medium grill for 10-12 minutes
demonstrations.review: My kind of 5-star dish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oriental meatball veggie packets  rsc

ready, set, cook!  reynolds wrap contest entry.  packed with flavor, this recipe is so easy to prepare! the reynold's wrap packets make clean up a breeze! it will wow your family!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a small bowl , whisk cornstarch with soy sauce , vinegar , hoisin sauce , ginger , garlic powder and pepper
3. set aside
4. in a large bowl , combine egg , evaporated milk , bread crumbs , onion salt , garlic powder and black pepper
5. crumble beef over mixture and blend well
6. shape into 1-inch balls
7. tear off 4 12-inch pieces of reynold's wrap
8. set 1 / 4 of the vegetables onto center of each piece of foil
9. top each with 1 / 4 of the meatballs and 1 / 4 of the sauce
10. fold foil over mixture and crimp edges to make packets
11. place packets on a cookie sheet
12. bake at 350 degrees f
13. for 30 minutes , or until meatballs are fully cooked
14. to serve , place 1 / 2 cup rice on each of 4 serving plates
15. open each packet over rice
16. sprinkle with sesame seeds
demonstrations.review: Love this recipe ~ way to go~ thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shredded potato baskets with cheese and bacon  5fix

5-ingredient fix contest entry - this is my tasty version of a popular appetizer served at a local restaurant.  the crispy yet chewy "baskets" made with the shredded potatoes (hashbrowns) takes this side dish to the next level and is a family favorite.

1. heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. generously coat 2 6-compartment non-stick muffin tins with cooking spray
3. set aside
4. in a large bowl , combine the potatoes , egg and flour , adding just enough flour so mixture "sticks together"
5. divide evenly among the prepared muffin compartments
6. using the back of a spoon , firmly press potato mixture into bottom and up sides of each compartment , making a "well" in each
7. place in oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until just starting to brown
8. remove from oven and divide shredded cheese evenly among cups and top each with crumbled bacon
9. return to oven and bake another 5-10 minutes or until "baskets" are golden brown and cheese and bacon is hot , melted and bubbly
10. remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes
11. to serve: gently run the
12. release each basket and place on serving platter
demonstrations.review: Crispy and delicious will make again!

target.recipe_text:
enchiladas pollo with green chilies cream sauce

nan

1. place breasts in dutch oven
2. add water to cover , half of onion , bay leaf , peppercorns and salt to taste
3. simmer- mer 45 min
4. cool and drain
5. shred chicken
6. mix with 1 / 2 onion , parmesan and 4 oz
7. jack
8. set aside
9. in blender , combine ortegas , tomatillos cream and egg
10. blend till smooth
11. salt to taste
12. set aside
13. preheat oven to 350
14. soften tortillas in oil
15. place 1 / 8 chicken mixture in each tortilla
16. roll and place in baking dish
17. pour chile-cream mix- mixture over enchiladas
18. sprinkle evenly with 4 oz
19. jack
20. bake 20 minutes at 350
21. top enchiladas with guacamole and serve
22. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
target.review: I couldn't find canned tomatillos, so I just drained some diced tomatoes and used those.  It was great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet orange bbq sauce

from emeril - to go with delicious five spice spare ribs.  makes a great dipping sauce for the ribs - and so easy to make!

1. process in a blender or food processor until smooth - about 15 seconds
2. scrape down sides and pulse two or three times more
3. will keep in the fridge up to two weeks
demonstrations.review: This sauce is spicy but has a perfect blend of flavors that were really enjoyed on our ribs and baked in the oven.  I see myself making more in the future!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled lime shrimp

nan

1. mix together the first 8 ingredients in a bowl
2. add shrimp
3. toss to coat
4. let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes to marinate
5. thread shrimp on metal skewers
6. reserve marinade
7. place skewered shrimp on grill over medium heat
8. cook 3-7 minutes or until shrimp turn pink , turning once and brushing with marinade occasionally
demonstrations.review: We loved these little babies!  We had along with some Lemon Orzo. Excellent dish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
maple glazed ham steak

i found this glaze somewhere on the internet and decided to put it on a ham steak. delicious! i serve this with my favorite macaroni & cheese recipe (#4842).

1. mix together maple syrup , vinegar and mustard in small bowl
2. brush one side of ham steak with mixture and place glazed side down in skillet over medium heat
3. brush top of ham steak
4. cook over medium heat , turning frequently , until cooked through and glaze has thickened
demonstrations.review: No complaints at my house when these were served.  We loved them!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot italian sausage hoagies

my 8 year old races go karts. when racing season is in, we enjoy a crock pot meal every saturday at the track. this is one of my family's favorites.

1. in a skillet over medium-high heat , brown sausage in oil and drain
2. transfer to crock pot
3. add the spaghetti sauce , peppers , water , cheese , oregano and basil
4. cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until sausage is no longer pink
5. fill each hoagie roll with sausage , peppers and sauce
demonstrations.review: I made my own sauce, and then proceeded with the recipe.  The smells coming from the kitchen are making me so hungry!  I did take a taste and it is SO delicious!!!  I am bringing them in the crock pot to my brother's tomorrow for the superbowl.  I love the fact that I could make them ahead and then just lug them out to the car and reheat when I get there!  Less stress for me :)  They will be a huge hit there I am sure!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shirley s date nut pinwheels   christmas

my mom used to make these every christmas for us when i was growing up, and they bring back special memories for me, especially around the holidays. we have been eating these for 50 years!  these are my all time favorite cookies :)  they make a lot of cookies, and the amount really depends on how thick you actually roll the dough, and how thin or thick you cut the cookies.  the cooking time is for each batch of cookies, and the prep time does not include time to chill dough.

1. date filling:
2. combine dates , sugar and water in a pan and cook until thick
3. add nuts to mixture , mix , and let cool
4. set aside
5. cookie dough:
6. cream shortening and add brown sugar gradually
7. add eggs , and beat well
8. add to the other ingredients , and mix
9. divide into 2 parts , and make 2 round balls
10. chill for 1 hr
11. , or until ready to bake
12. preheat oven to 375
13. make 4 balls from the 2 lg
14. balls of dough
15. roll out dough to 1 / 4" thick , and spread date mixture all over the top to the edge of the dough
16. roll into logs
17. cut into slices 1 / 4" thick , and place on greased cookie sheet
18. bake in 375 oven for 10-12 minutes
19. cool on cookie racks and store in a plastic container with lid , or a cookie tin
demonstrations.review: Excellent choice for my Christmas cookies!!!  I made these using pecans and walnut mix and they are moreish for sure!  I have had 3 already this morning and keep going back for more.  My DH keeps eying the dish and going back for a few when I'm not looking.  Sneaky Pete!!!  Good thing they make so many or there wouldn't be enough!  Thanks for sharing with us!

target.recipe_text:
steak sandwich

friday night delight....i like this with an ice cold, grey goose martini. from firefly, a bistro-type restaurant in chicago.
