I doubled the sauce, but had leftovers, so next time I will stick to the recipe amounts.

target.recipe_text:
apple and peanut butter sandwich

i'm trying to eat less carbs and i often have this sandwich for breakfast.  its flavourful, light, crunchy and so simple to make.  i find it filling so i don't want to eat much else.  i like to use a sweet apple on top of the sandwich and sprinkle it with a pinch of pumpkin or apple pie spice, cinnamon or nutmeg over the apples.  you could add whatever spice you like to add to apples.

1. toast the sprouted bread
2. spread on the peanut butter
3. slice the apple and place on the peanut butter
4. sprinkle with your favourite spice
5. eat
6. bon appetit !
target.review:
Mmmm, this was very good. I really liked the flavour combination of the earthy peanut butter with the sweet and sour apple. The cinnamon (which I used because I was out of pumpkin pie spice) added a lovely spicy touch. I used my own bread (Recipe #448813) and really liked it in this sandwich.
THANK YOU SO MUCH for sharing this keeper with us, Chef JoeyZ! I will definitely make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted jalapeno and cheese cornbread

this cornbread is best served freshly baked. the roasted peppers provide a light heat, a good strong cheddar is best for full flavour. i sometimes add two tablespoons of finely chopped onion along with the peppers.  
source: homemakers magazine

1. prepare peppers: over grill or under broiler , roast peppers until skin is charred , transfer to covered bowl and let cool
2. peel , seed and chop finely
3. set aside
4. in 425 degree oven , heat 8 or 9 inch cast-iron skillet while you prepare the batter
5. batter: in saucepan , bring milk to boil , stir in prepared peppers
6. remove from heat and let stand until at room temperature , beat in egg and melted butter
7. in a large bowl , whisk together cornmeal , flours , sugar , baking powder , cumin and salt
8. stir in milk / pepper mixture until just blended
9. fold in cheese
10. remove heated skillet from oven and grease with a little oil , scrape in batter , smooth top
11. return to oven and bake until golden brown on top and bottom , approximately 25 minutes
12. let cool in skillet for 10 minutes , with offset spatula , loosen bottom of bread and remove from skillet
13. serve warm
14. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
This cornbread was totally awesome! The jalapeno added such a great flavour and I really enjoyed the soft yet crusty texture! The dough was easy to work with and your directions super to follow.
THANK YOU SO MUCH for sharing this special recipe with us, Elly!
Made and reviewed for your Cookathon in the Canadian Forum November 2010.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
triple choc cookies

adapted from an edition of  good taste magazine.

1. line 2 baking trays with baking paper
2. pre heat oven to 180c
3. melt dark chocolate and butter on medium heat
4. set aside when smooth and cool for 5 minutes
5. sift flour and cocoa into large bowl , stir in brown sugar
6. make well in centre and stir in cooed choc mixture
7. add eggs and choc chips and stir till combined
8. roll heaped tablespoons of mixture into balls
9. place on trays and flatten with your fingers
10. bake 15 - 18 minutes
demonstrations.review:
OMG, Kate, what are you trying to do to me?! These cookies are absolutely SCRUMPTIOUS!!!
They are rich, decadent, full of chocolate and super addictive. All things that make for a very dangerous recipe! ;)
Mmmm, what a lovely way of making cookies and also easy and quite fast. I found your ingredient amounts and directions perfect and did change only the amount of sugar used (used only 1/2 cup), but thats due to personal taste preference.
I ended up with 33 chunky cookies.
THANKS SO MUCH for sharing this gem of a recipe with us, Kate! Ill surely make it again!
Made and reviewed for Ed'n#8-Make My Recipe September 09.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple and granola scones

granola and apple

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. in a large bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
3. add the butter to the flour mixture and rub it in with your finger
4. stir in 1 / 2 cup buttermilk , the apple and the granola
5. add the remaining buttermilk 1 tbsp at a time until the dough comes together into a ball
6. it should not be too sticky , nor should it be floury
7. add back an additional tablespoon of flour if your dough becomes too wet
8. divide ball into two equal discs about 1-inch thick and cut each disc into quarters
9. place triangular scones on a parchment-lined baking sheet and sprinkle with brown sugar
10. bake for about 20 minutes at 400f until light golden brown
11. the bottoms should be browned
12. cool on a wire rack for at least 5-10 minutes before serving
13. scones can be eaten warm or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: These were very, very TASTY scones. The apple made them soft and fruity yet they still had a wonderfully flaky scones texture. The addition of the granola gave them a slight crunch, which suited them very well. I sprinkled some cinnamon sugar on top, which I thought was great! I also added some raisins to the batter, since I luv the combination of raisins and apples and also thought it would be nice with the granola. That way they had a lot of fruit sweetness so that I reduced the sugar to less than 1/8 cup. That was still sweet enough for me. I will definitely make these often again since they are so yummy and really quick to make as well. I got 11 scones out of the full recipe and they were gobbled up so fast that Ill double it next time, I think. Thanks so much for sharing this gem of a recipe, swirlycinnacakes!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
double chocolate cranberry cookies

oatmeal, 2 kinds of chocolate, dried cranberries and a drizzle on top come together to make one terrific cookie! the sunflower seeds add the salty crunch that you would normally get from nuts. you can take these cookies to schools that are nut-free so they are great for lunches or a gift for a teacher!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. using a hand mixer , cream together butter and brown sugar in a large bowl
3. add the egg and vanilla and beat until thoroughly mixed
4. in a medium bowl , stir together oats , flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
5. slowly add dry ingredients to butter mixture , using the hand mixer set to lowest setting
6. with a spoon , stir in cranberries , sunflower seeds and chocolate chips
7. drop cookie dough by the teaspoonful on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
8. bake cookies for 12 to 15 minutes
9. remove from oven and let sit for 2 minutes before removing and placing on a cooling rack
10. the cooling rack should be on top of a baking sheet or wax paper something to catch the icing drips
11. meanwhile , in a small bowl , mix icing sugar , water and vanilla until smooth
12. if necessary , add tiny amounts of water until mixture can be drizzled
13. when cookies have cooled , dip a fork in the icing mixture
14. let the icing lightly drizzle over the cookies , moving the fork back and forth above the cookies
demonstrations.review:
These cookies are very yummy! They have a slightly caramelly flavour from the white chocolate and that goes great with the spices and cranberries.
The oats lend the cookie a crispy texture, which we all enjoyed and the sunflower seeds added great crunch.
I was a little absent minded while scooping the dough onto the cookie sheet and somehow my scoops must have been rather large, cause I ended up with only 7 cookies from half the recipe. Those spread very much during baking, so that I had big coffee shop style cookies. Thats nice, though, too. :)
I prefer these without the glaze as I found they were too sweet with it on top.
Other than that though a lovely little recipe and great for sharing (which I already did).
THANK YOU SO MUCH for sharing your creation with us and good luck in the contest!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
made from scratch broccoli cornbread

to my surprise, every broccoli cornbread on zaar calls for "cornbread mix" this recipe is completely from scratch and well worth the extra steps!  i don't remember where i found this... i've been making this for years... great with chicken, or chili.

1. in a large bowl mix together the corn meal , flour , salt , baking powder , and sugar together
2. make a well in the center of the bowl
3. melt butter in a small fry pan
4. add onion and saute until onions are translucent
5. in a separate bowl , combine the eggs , thawed broccoli , cottage cheese , and melted butter with onions
6. pour into well of flour mixture
7. stir until just combined
8. pour batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
9. bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes , or until golden brown
demonstrations.review:
This was my first cornbread and Im so happy that I chose this recipe for it. It worked out beautifully and the bread is just plain YUMMY! I only had a German loaf tin on hand (11X3X3 inches), so that my bread had a very different shape than regular cornbread and took way longer to bake (about 75 minutes). But the end result was well worth the wait. IT WAS GORGEOUS! Thank you so much for sharing, kittycatmom!
Made for Potluck Tag February 2009.

target.recipe_text:
easy cinnamon buns

what a treat for the kids when they come home from school or for a sunday brunch. there will never be any of these left over! they are crispy on the outside and lovely and soft inside. very tasty

1. spray a 9 inch baking pan and preheat oven to 425f
2. in a small bowl mix the filling ingredients together , mixing well
3. in large bowl combine the sugar , raisins , flour , salt , baking powder and baking soda
4. add yogurt and oil , mix well together until you have formed a dough
5. on a lightly floured surface knead the dough 8-10 times
6. roll the dough out to a 8" x 10" rectangle
7. brush dough with margarine and sprinkle the filling evenly over the dough
8. roll up jelly roll fashion , pinch seam to seal
9. cut into 12 1-inch pieces
10. place rolls slightly touching in the prepared baking pan
11. bake for approx 17 minutes or until golden
12. place on wire rack for 10 minutes
13. serve warm
target.review:
Thank you Bergy!  I was looking for a yummy cinnamon bun but was reluctant to do all the prep and came across these and had to try them. 
They are delicious, soft and fluffy and incredibly tasty, the way a cinnamon bun should be.  
I did alter the recipe a little after having read the other reviews:  for the batter I substituted Splenda for the sugar, used apple sauce instead of oil and low fat sour cream instead of yogurt (didn't have any yogurt in the house).  
DH loved them and my 2 year old DD  gobbled her bun in a flash!  I will make these again--very soon!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
human puppy chow

this is the best recipe in the world!! it is great to have anytime but it also makes great christmas gifts.

1. in a large sauce pan , melt together butter , peanut butter , and chocolate chips
2. stir until all is evenly distributed and all is completely melted
3. measure out chex into a large bowl
4. pour chocolate mixture over chex and fold until all the chex are completely covered in the chocolate mixture
5. put powdered sugar into large paper bag
6. put chex into the bag with the sugar and shake until all chex are covered
7. add more sugar as needed
demonstrations.review: Amazing flavor and quick!  I substituted Corn Pops for the cereal and omitted the margarine and they turned out wonderfully!  My 2 1/2 year old absolutely LOVES this snack!  Thank you for the post!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegetable quiche cups

this is my version. i think they are good hot or cold and they are not fattening.
i have used regular size muffin tins and also smaller bite size tins so adjust your recipe accordinly as well as cooking time.
also you may use type of cheese and amount for your taste buds.

1. preheat oven 350 degrees
2. spray muffin tins with cooking oil
3. saute first 6 ingredients
4. add shredded cheese to eggs until blended
5. place sauted veggies and ham in bottom of each tin
6. pour egg and cheese mixture over each tin almost to top
7. bake 20 - 30 minutes again depends on size of tins
8. serve hot or cold
demonstrations.review: Made this on a whim as I had eggs, a red pepper and some mushrooms to use.  I substituted egg whites for the eggs (as I didn't have whole eggs in the house), used a low fat cheddar cheese mixture and substituted Canadian bacon.  I followed the advice of Bobbie by spooning in the meat, veggie mixture and cheese to each individual muffin tin to ensure even distribution.  I love the individual serving sizes and the flavor was perfect.  I will make these again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hot and sour soup   easy version

this is a very simple and quick version of a hot and sour soup. it contains many less ingredients than a traditional hot and sour soup, but is great nevertheless.

1. combine broth , tomato juice , soya sauce , bamboo shoots , mushrooms , red pepper , hot pepper sauce and pepper flakes
2. bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes
3. add vinegar , green onion and chicken
4. simmer for 1 minute longer
5. combine cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup water
6. mix well and stir into soup
7. simmer until mixture is slightly thickened
8. slowly add beaten egg in a continuous stream while soup is boiling
9. continue stirring until egg is cooked and looks like threads throughout the soup
10. serve
demonstrations.review: Most Excellent!<br/>I had to adjust this recipe due to a last minute decision to make this and a few items missing in my pantry.  I substituted red wine vinegar for the rice wine vinegar and chives from my garden for the green onions.  I also didn't have any chicken so it was omitted.<br/>All the same, this turned out wonderfully with a great kick of spice and sourness!  It will not disappoint!  Thank you, Martha, for sharing the great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai noodles with spicy peanut sauce

this is a recipe that i've tweeked and adjusted to yield a warm noodle side-dish. it can also stand alone as a main dish. it's quick and easy and full of flavor! i serve it with chicken satay. leftovers are yummy hot or cold.

1. cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions
2. drain and return to pot
3. add 2 tbsp sesame oil and toss to coat
4. set aside
5. heat remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil in heavy pot over medium-high heat
6. add green onions , carrots , stir-fry veggies , garlic and ginger
7. saute until vegetables soften , about 4 minutes
8. add honey , peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar and chili-garlic sauce and mix well
9. simmer sauce 2 minutes
10. pour sauce over pasta and toss well
11. transfer to platter and serve warm
12. garnish with additional green onions , if desired
13. yields 8 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings
14. chili-garlicsauce can be increased or decreased depending on how spicy you like your dish
15. as written , this recipe has some heat , but is still edible for my toddler son
demonstrations.review: This sauce is wonderful!  Just the right amount of zing and loaded with flavor!  DH, who is not a fan of stir fry, loved that this one has noodles.  It was a hit with my family.  I do not have chili sauce in my pantry but took someone's suggestion to use Sriracha sauce and it worked out very well, in my opinion.  I opted to fry up some shrimp on the side to add to the finished product.  I will make this again.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s white cake

7-up or sprite is the secret ingredient that takes this cake to another level, do not allow the soda to go flat pour right from the bottle or can --- this cake bakes out beautiful with no dark over cooked edges --- i recommend to use diet soda regular is too sweet but regular will work fine also ---this also may be baked in two 8-inch round cake pans and it makes the perfect wedding cake!

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. mix all ingredients in a bowl on low speed until blended
3. beat at medium speed for 2 minutes more
4. pour the batter into a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan
5. bake for about 30 minutes or until cake tests done
demonstrations.review: Wonderful cake; so light and fluffy!  This recipe will likely become our staple birthday cake.  I used a star pan and was able to slice it in half, for layering, with no difficulties.  I used a chocolate icing for the filling.

target.recipe_text:
grandma s raisin filled cookies

my grandmother always had these on hand whenever we would come to visit. we always gobbled them up. i never truly appreciated them tho, until i finally was given the recipe and realized the time that went into them. i recommend making the filling one day and the cookies the next.. just saves you that much time. i also like to just underbake a hair... i'll probably be strung and hung for sharing her recipe..:)

1. raisin mixture: soak raisins in hot water
2. when plumb and soft , drain water and grind
3. put in saucepan and add sugar , salt , and water
4. mix the flour with just enough water to make smooth paste , then add to raisin mixture
5. let come to boil , then set off to cool
6. cookie: in large mixing bowl , cream together butter& sugar
7. beat in eggs
8. add milk and vanilla
9. mix until well blended
10. combine dry ingredients together and add to butter mixture
11. roll out onto flour surface to about 1 / 4 inch thickness
12. cut with round cutter
13. lay on cookie sheet , and add 1 tablespoon ground raisin mixture to each cookie
14. top with another round cookie , pinch sides together
15. bake@ 350 8-10 minutes or until just starting to brown
target.review:
Delicious cookies! After reading other reviews, I decided to chill the dough for 2 hours before assembling the cookies. I had absolutely no problem at all with the dough. It was very easy to work with.
Thank you for sharing this recipe. It is one I will use often.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy chile rellenos casserole

a tasty casserole that is great for brunch for a light dinner :)

1. set oven to 325f
2. grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish
3. split chiles lengthwise , and spread in a single layer in bottom of prepared baking dish
4. combine the cheddar cheese with the monterey jack cheese
5. toss to mix
6. sprinkle half of the mixed cheeses and all of the green onions over the chiles
7. in a bowl , beat together the eggs , milk , flour and salt until smooth
8. pour over chiles and cheese
9. bake for 50 minutes , or until done
10. meanwhile , mix salsa with remaining 1-1 / 2 cups cheese
11. sprinkle over casserole , and return to oven for 10 minutes
12. let stand for 10 minutes before serving
demonstrations.review: Everyone in my family enjoyed this dish. And, we all agreed, it would be made again! I followed the recipe exactly, although, next time I think I'll just serve the salsa on the side. Otherwise, it was perfect. Thanks Kittencal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butter balls

there are similar versions to this cookie, but i truly think that if you make mine like directed, you will find that these are the best. they will melt in your mouth. this has been a recipe used in my family since i was a little girl. we always made them for christmas and weddings, but they are good anytime. the key is to use butter and make sure you grind the nuts very fine. i use my kitchen aid grinder attachment, but you can also use a food processor. other versions use just chopped nuts, but i think when they are finely ground that makes the difference. another important step is to bake them at 250 degrees for 45 minutes. again, the other versions don't do this, but i stick with my recipe and am never disappointed. the extra time is worth it! this recipe will probably make 100 balls, depending on how large you make the cookies. the baking time listed is just an estimate. it will vary depending on how many cookies you make and how many you put on a cookie sheet. you can fit quite a bit on a cookie sheet because they really don't spread much.

1. grind walnuts very fine
2. set aside
3. cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. add vanilla
5. add flour and nuts alternately
6. you may have to mix by using your hands to really get it all mixed together well
7. roll into small balls , approximately 1-inch
8. place on cookie sheet , ungreased
9. you can usually fit a lot of cookies on the cookie sheet because they do not spread that much
10. bake at 250 degrees for 45 minutes
11. meanwhile , have a bowl of powdered sugar ready for when the cookies come out of the oven
12. when cookies are brought out of the oven , allow to cool for maybe a minute until you can pick them up without breaking them
13. roll in powdered sugar and place them on wax paper
14. cool
15. i also like to roll them in powdered sugar a second time when they are completely cool
demonstrations.review: I really loved these. My mom had a different recipe she made every year at Christmas. I loved hers too, but they had an after taste I wasn't crazy about. I was looking for a new recipe when I found this one.  It is delicious and so easy! I am replacing my mother recipe with yours!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pasta e fagioli  italian soup  with italian sausage

a delicious version of this popular italian soup. adding the sausage (regular or turkey) makes it a satisfying meal if served with a nice warm baguette.

1. heat olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium high heat
2. cook onion in oil 2 minutes
3. stir in garlic , celery and carrots and cook for 3 minutes
4. add and brown crumbled sausage
5. add basil , oregano and red pepper
6. toss to coat
7. stir in tomatoes and stock
8. bring to a boil
9. reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes
10. if necessary , add an additional cup of stock or water and stir in beans and tiny pasta
11. simmer for 6- 8 minutes or until pasta is tender
12. stir in parsley and serve hot with grated parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: This was so easy to put together and it was delicious. That makes it a winner in my book! I made it exactly as written and I wouldn't change a thing. Thank you for sharing such a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
honey baked ham  copycat

honey baked hams are basted in fruit juices and then glazed with a mixture of brown sugar and honey. here is a copy cat recipe from family circle magazine. have to say, i love honey baked hams. makes 1 7 lb. ham.

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. place ham , cut end down , in a large baking pan
3. mix pear nectar and orange juice in a bowl
4. bake ham for 15 minutes per pound basting frequently with juices
5. mix brown sugar and honey together in a small bowl
6. brush mixture over ham and bake for another hour or until internal temperature reads 140f
7. honey baked ham corporation uses a butane torch to caramelize the glaze to a crust
8. the ham is placed on top of a huge metal drum covered with foil and caramelized
demonstrations.review:
This recipe was delicious. And, it really does taste like the real thing! I too, couldn't find pear juice, so I processed a can of pears until it made juice. It worked wonderfully.
Thanks for a great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
white chocolate chip and macadamia nut cookies

my hubbies favorite cookies!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. cream butter and sugars until fluffy
3. add eggs and vanilla and beat well
4. blend in flour , baking soda and salt
5. stir in white chocolate chips and macadamia pieces
6. drop by teasponfuls onto ungreased baking pans
7. bake for 10-12 minutes
demonstrations.review: Delicious cookies! This truly is my new favorite cookie recipe. I halved the recipe and they came out wonderfully. Thank you for sharing this with us. It really does make a perfect cookie.

target.recipe_text:
simply sour cream chicken enchiladas

easy to assemble, deliciously creamy and a great choice for once-a-month cooking. and there is no canned cream soup in my enchiladas -- hope you give them a try!

1. in a frying pan , cook chicken and onion together in oil over medium-high heat until chicken is just done
2. divide cooked chicken evenly between 8 tortillas
3. add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese to each tortilla
4. roll enchiladas and place seam-side down in a 9x13" baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with no-stick cooking spray
5. melt butter in a medium saucepan
6. stir in flour to make a roux , stir and cook until bubbly , and gradually whisk in chicken broth then bring to boiling , stirring frequently
7. remove from heat
8. stir in sour cream and green chilies
9. pour sauce evenly over enchiladas
10. top with remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese and bake at 400 f for 20 minutes until cheese is melted and sauce near edges of baking dish is bubbly
target.review: This is always popular with guests and family.  I use more cheese.   If I have time I'll simmer the chicken with onions, garlic, peppers and cumin for a while before assembling the enchiladas.  I substitute white rice flour and corn tortillas to make it gluten free for my DH who has Celiac disease.  He can't eat the "cream of" soups because they have wheat in them.  This tastes WAY better anyway!  You might add a comment about the rice flour and corn tortillas and your recipe could be tagged as gluten free.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai noodles with spicy peanut sauce

this is a recipe that i've tweeked and adjusted to yield a warm noodle side-dish. it can also stand alone as a main dish. it's quick and easy and full of flavor! i serve it with chicken satay. leftovers are yummy hot or cold.

1. cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions
2. drain and return to pot
3. add 2 tbsp sesame oil and toss to coat
4. set aside
5. heat remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil in heavy pot over medium-high heat
6. add green onions , carrots , stir-fry veggies , garlic and ginger
7. saute until vegetables soften , about 4 minutes
8. add honey , peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar and chili-garlic sauce and mix well
9. simmer sauce 2 minutes
10. pour sauce over pasta and toss well
11. transfer to platter and serve warm
12. garnish with additional green onions , if desired
13. yields 8 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings
14. chili-garlicsauce can be increased or decreased depending on how spicy you like your dish
15. as written , this recipe has some heat , but is still edible for my toddler son
demonstrations.review: Used this as a base, and it turned out great.  I also used sauteed chicken tenders, and I used fresh veggies (broccoli, carrot, onion, celery) and a can of baby corn.  I used a bit more garlic and ginger, and stirred in a little cornstarchand water to the sauce before adding it to the mix.  Step-Daughter loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
golden chicken nuggets

this is one of my kids favorites. they have said, 'mom, your chicken nuggets are the best!!' for such picky eaters, that is a huge complement.

1. heat deep fryer
2. cut chicken into bite size pieces
3. soak chicken in milk
4. mix flour and seasoning in large bowl
5. dip chicken into flour
6. cook about 12 pieces at a time in fryer for 360 degrees for 6 to 9 minutes or until golden
7. serve with sweet and sour sauce or honey mustard !
demonstrations.review: I used this as a reference but DH has to have gluten free.  I used 1/3 part white rice flour, 1/3 potato starch, and 1/3 crushed gf corn flakes.  I marinated the chicken in buttermilk and Frank's RedHot wing sauce for about an hour and then dipped in the flour mixture.  They turned out light and very crispy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gluten free biscuits

this recipe is from roben ryberg's cookbook you won't believe it's gluten-free!
easy and super yummy! even good re-warmed the next morning(it any left!)
i followed directions exactly except used soy milk and marg. and patted out and cut with a knife, worked fine but might try dropping from spoon like traditional drop biscuits next time, don't know how that would work, i have only done as writen so far....

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. grease a baking sheet
3. in medium bowl , blend all dry ingredients , cut in the butter / marg
4. add milk and vinegar
5. mix together well
6. dough will be soft
7. pat out on prepared pan to 1 / 2 inch thickness
8. cut into square biscuits and separate with the sides of knife
9. bake 20 minutes , will just start to turn brown
10. if you are able to have real butter and desire at this point brush with melted butter
11. makes 6-8 biscuits depending on size
demonstrations.review: These are definately the best gluten free biscuits I have ever made!  No "weird" smell or taste, just good.  My Dad made homemade biscuits when I was growing up and they had a crunchy bottom, which I loved with butter and syrup. To get that crunch, I put about 1/4 cup of dough on a pile of white rice flour and patted it out to a circle 1/2 inch thick.  Then I dipped them in a mixture of bacon grease and peanut oil, and put in the pan.  You don't need to grease your pan first. They were golden brown in 17 minutes and were very yummy.  Thanks for posting!  My husband can now enjoy biscuits and (gluten free) sausage gravy again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken breasts with rosemary

this is so easy to make and can be served over pasta, rice, etc.

1. pat chicken dry and season lightly with salt& pepper
2. dip chicken in flour and shake of excess
3. heat butter and cook chicken 4-6 minutes per side or until no longer pink in the center and lightly browned
4. remove from pan
5. discard any fat from the pan
6. return pan to heat
7. add chicken stock and rosemary
8. cook 2 minutes
9. add cream and mustard
10. bring to a boil
11. cook 4-5 minutes until slightly thickened
12. season to taste with salt and pepper
13. return chicken to pan
14. coat with sauce and heat thoroughly
demonstrations.review: Fabulous!  I have been looking for a recipe similar to the Rosemary Chicken I had eaten at a fancy restaurant in NYC almost ten years ago.  This was very close if not better, and easy to make, too!  I doubled the cream sauce and poured over mashed potatoes and steamed carrots and broccoli.  Also served with #164239 White Asparagus with Mushrooms in Browned Butter.  Everyone cleaned their plates!  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese scalloped potatoes   carrots

i always make these to go along with my glazed ham,it has become quite a favourite. i have passed this recipe(along with my glaze recipe) to both my mother & my sister who both now make them as well. i got it from one of those kraft what's cooking magazines quite a few years ago.

1. heat oven to 375
2. bring water to a boil in a large frying pan , add potatoes , onions , & carrots
3. cover and cook 10 minutes
4. or until tender , drain
5. in a medium saucepan , melt margarine , remove from heat and stir in flour , salt , pepper& cayenne
6. add milk , blending well
7. bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring until thickened and smooth
8. stir in cheese , cook over low heat , stirring constantly until cheese melts
9. in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish , layer half the potato , onion& carrot mixture
10. top with half of the cheese sauce
11. repeat
12. bake , covered for 30 minutes
13. or until potatoes are tender
14. remove cover during last 10 minutes of baking
15. ialways make them this way , but here are a few variations:chili: add 1 tsp chili powder& cumin to saucefrench-tarragon: add 2 tbsp fresh tarragon leaves or 2 tsp dried to sauce
demonstrations.review: This was good!  I divided the recipe and ended up with more sauce than I thought would be appropriate, but it was absorbed and left a good amount of delicious sauce.  I used part cheddar/jack and part swiss cheese, what I had on hand.  When I make it again, I'll saute the onions; just something about boiled onions that I don't like.

target.recipe_text:
ginger me up chicken  low fat honey   ginger chicken breasts

this is a recipe i have been making for yonks now.....i first devised it about 18 years ago, when i was following rosemary connely's "hip & thigh diet"!! it's a very easy low fat chicken dish, which can be pan fried or baked in the oven - i prefer the latter method, it's much easier! serve it with a medley of gently steamed vegetables, rice or pasta. (nb: please note, one of the reviewers has stated that she cooked this in a crockpot!! i would never suggest cooking this recipe in a crockpot, that's why it is not mentioned as a cooking method anywhere in the recipe - only pan-fried or oven baked. thanks! )

1. preheat the oven to 180c or 350f
2. select a sturdy oven dish - preferably non-stick
3. place the chicken breasts into the baking dish
4. mix the honey , mustard , water , ginger & crushed garlic together in a measuring jug
5. pour over the chicken breasts , easing them up slightly so the mixture runs underneath them
6. season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste and bake in the oven for 45 to 60 minutes
7. serve one chicken breast per person with some of the cooking sauce drizzled over the top of the chicken
8. garnish with chopped parsley & serve with a medley of steamed vegetables & pasta
9. to pan fry , heat up a frying pan and add the chicken breasts - dry fry them briefly to give them a bit of colour and add the cooking sauce , mix well and cook for about 20- 30 minutes over a medium heat
10. serve as before
target.review:
Yummy! I doubled the recipe so I'd have a lot of sauce. I accidentally used too much ground ginger, but it actually added to the dish! This is a definite keeper. Thanks!

I didn't use cayenne pepper, but ground some black pepper on top of the chicken so it would look nice.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my best chicken and rice in wine

easy to make. a good mixture of flavors. one of our favorites. this is from pierre franey, my favorite chef. if you like you can add a bay leaf with the mushrooms.

1. brown chicken in butter in a dutch oven
2. scatter onion and garlic over chicken
3. add mushrooms , and cook 5 minutes
4. add chicken broth
5. add wine , cook another 5 minutes
6. add rice , cover and cook 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: DH and I absolutely LOVED this chicken recipe! I used olive oil instead of butter, and used brown rice, so I added more water to the liquid, but overall, I didn't touch the recipe. Thanks for a great meal! I can't wait to make this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beth s pizza crust

this is an excellent crust that requires no time to rise. why order out when you can just throw this pizza together?

1. combine yeast and warm water
2. stir until dissolved
3. add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. let rest 5 minutes
5. roll out to size and shape you need
6. bake at 450 for 15 minutes or until golden
7. a couple
8. instead , i add several good shakes of italian seasoning mix
9. use your imagination , this is hard to mess up
demonstrations.review: Easy and delicious! I also baked the crust 5 minutes before putting the toppings on.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hawaiian chicken kabobs

the marinade is the key to these great kabobs. they only need 1 hour in the refrigerator to marinate.

1. put chicken in large shallow dish
2. drain pineapple , keep 1 / 2 cup juice
3. set pineapple aside
4. mix juice with the next 7 ingredients in small pan
5. bring to a boil
6. reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
7. pour over chicken
8. cover and chill for 1 hour
9. remove chicken from marinade , reserve marinade
10. alternate chicken , pineapple , green pepper , mushrooms , and tomatoes on skewers
11. grill kabobs over hot coals 20 minutes or until chicken is done
12. turn and baste frequently with marinade
13. serve over hot rice
demonstrations.review: I've been making a concentrated effort to use the grill each night and took out chicken cutlets for tonight's dinner. Luckily, when I was trying to figure out what to do with them earlier today, I got an email from recipezaar with grilling recipes - and this recipe was among them!!! Delicious and they looked gorgeous! I took pictures :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crazy crust pizza

whenever you need pizza quick, this is the recipe to go for! it is not a traditional yeast dough crust...it actually starts out with a batter that turns into a crust. it is extremely easy to prepare, very good and you could probably have it done and on your table before the pizza parlor could :)

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. grease and flour a pizza pan or 10 x 15 baking sheet
3. combine flour , salt , oregano , pepper , eggs and milk and mix well
4. pour batter in pan and tilt pan around until bottom of pan is evenly coated
5. sprinkle the cooked meat , onions and mushrooms over the batter
6. bake for 20 minutes
7. remove from oven and drizzle on pizza sauce
8. sprinkle evenly with cheese
9. bake for about 5 more minutes , or until cheese is bubbling
10. slice and serve !
demonstrations.review: Pretty good considering the dough had no yeast and didn't need to be kneaded or rolled out.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vanilla eggless and dairy free vegan cake

this is a simple yellow cake that is easy to make and very tasty. it can also be cut into slices and served with fruit.

1. heat oven to 350f
2. prepare cake pan: line 8-inch round or square cake pan with parchment paper and grease bottom and sides of the pan
3. then flour the pan
4. whisk together flour , sugar , baking soda , and salt
5. add vegetable oil , soy milk , and vanilla extract
6. whisk until no lumps appear and batter is smooth
7. add vinegar , stir about seven times , and quickly pour into pan
8. bake around 30 minutes , until cake begins to pull away from sides and / or toothpick inserted in the center pulls out clean
9. let sit for ten to fifteen minutes , invert , and cool on rack
demonstrations.review: Maybe I did something wrong, but it didn't turn out well.

target.recipe_text:
cinnamon sunrise  bread machine

fresh from the oven, this bread explodes with cinnamon flavor as eye-opening as its namesake. savor it warm and this aromatic loaf will become a classic at your breakfast table. dress it up as french toast and you will never go back to the plain stuff again! brought to you by electric bread (and i love this recipe!!)

1. combine ingredients in your bread machine according to the manufactor's directions
2. makes one 1 1 / 2 pound loaf
3. success hints: great served warm for breakfast !
4. start on a time bake the night before
5. for the fullest flavor use fresh cinnamon
6. frsh spices enhances this bread dramatically
7. this recipe can be made using the regualr , rapid and delayed time bake cycles
target.review: This indeed made a tall, light and airy loaf of bread.  Very good!  I used the basic loaf setting on my bread machine.  As I type this I'm enjoying a slice of toast with apple butter.  I had to cut the slice in half so it would fit in my toaster.  :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamsicle cake   jello cake

this is a very tasty cake. it is so moist. it is a family tradition at my house.

1. bake cake as directed in 9x13 inch pan
2. when done , use fork to punch holes around the entire top of cake
3. let cool
4. in bowl , mix 1 box gelatin , 1 cup hot water , and 1 cup cold water
5. allow the gelatin to thicken
6. pour over the top of cake and refrigerate 2-3 hours
7. mix remaining box of gelatin , pudding , milk and vanilla together
8. beat well
9. fold dessert topping into mixture and spread on top of cake
10. keep refrigerated
11. if you cannot find orange cake mix , use a box lemon and add 1 small envelope of orange drink mix to the batter
demonstrations.review: What a tasty, refreshing cake.  It's exactly what I was hoping for.  I followed the directions exactly except used French vanilla pudding mix.  I can see endless flavor variations with this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy sweet grilled shrimp

the sauce serves as a marinade and dipping sauce for this fantastic summer dish. from the sable and rosenfeld cookbook.

1. soak bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes
2. in a small saucepan combine jelly , garlic , lime juice , worcestershire , jalapeno and chilies
3. cook over medium heat until jelly melts
4. thread shrimp onto skewers , about 4 per skewer if using large shrimp
5. brush both sides of shrimp with jelly mixture and place on a tray to marinate for 30 minutes
6. preheat grill on high and sprinkle shrimp with salt on both sides
7. grill shrimp for 3 minutes per side , brushing with marinade again before turning
8. reduce time for smaller shrimp
9. place remaining sauce in a serving dish for dipping
10. prep time includes time to marinate but not to soak the skewers
demonstrations.review: Excellent!  I also used the apple jelly  and followed the recipe exactly.  I served this with grilled corn on the cob and teriyaki rice.  I used what was labeled as large shrimp but would use jumbo next time (and there will be a next time).

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amazing chicken marinade

this recipe came from allrecipes (ruth crickmer). my whole family loved it even though it cooked too fast. the original recipe said 'high heat' on the grill, which my husband did. it ended up cooking 8 minutes total, charred but not burnt tasting, and very juicy and flavorful. we'll turn down the heat next time for texture, but this is a keeper in our home!

1. in a large , non-reactive container , whisk together ingredients beginning with cider vinegar through salt
2. then whisk in olive oil and pepper
3. place chicken in the mixture
4. cover and marinate chicken in the fridge 8 hours or overnight
5. remove chicken from marinade just before you turn on your grill or broiler to let come up a few degrees
6. discard marinade
7. lightly oil your grill or broiler pan
8. grill or broil about 10 minutes per side
demonstrations.review: This was fabulous!  You could easily use more chicken as this makes plenty of marinade.  I felt a little guilty discarding the amount I did.  I only used half the amount of olive oil to cut down on the fat.  I also marinated in the morning and grilled it for dinner.  My mustard-hating DD said it was the best grilled chicken she'd had in ages and she didn't even use any bottled BBQ sauce for dipping; the flavor stands on its own.  The mix of ingredients is truly magic.  I will be making this often.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh blueberry cobbler

easy and too good for words.

1. add flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar , salt , and baking powder to a mixing bowl
2. stir to combine
3. add in milk and butter
4. stir to combine
5. spread batter into a greased 8-inch square baking pan
6. sprinkle blueberries evenly over batter
7. sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup sugar and drizzle with vanilla
8. bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes or until a pick comes out clean
9. can serve plain or with ice cream on top
demonstrations.review: I followed the directions exactly EXCEPT I messed up when I set my oven to 250 instead of 350.  Had to cook longer, and it STILL was a hit!  Perfect balance of flavors - not too sweet like some blueberry cobblers.  I'll be making this again and again, thanks for an easy, family-pleasing recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hamburgers with brown gravy  total comfort food aka  meat cakes

these are sooooo great (and ez)! i grew up eating these about once a week and they are incredible with mashed potatoes or buttered egg noodles and a veggie. while this recipe is basically my mom's, i have changed one thing...instead of using chopped onion in the burgers, i use an envelope of onion soup mix...it gives them the perfect flavor! this is now one of my family's favorite meals...try it and it will probably become one of your's, too. p.s. these burgers also work for grilling (without the gravy :).

1. combine ground beef , bread , soup mix , salt , pepper , ketchup , garlic powder , parsley and eggs in a large bowl until well mixed
2. prepare each burger with approx 1 / 3 cup of meat mixture and form into patties about 1 / 2 inch thick
3. heat a 12" skillet over med-high heat and fry burgers for about 5 minutes on each side , until they are almost done
4. remove burgers to a plate and discard all but about a tablespoon of drippings from skillet
5. lower heat under skillet and prepare brown gravy with water in a bowl or measuring cup
6. slowly pour into skillet , stirring constantly , scraping up any brown bits from the bottom
7. when gravy has thickened , place burgers back in the pan and cover
8. simmer for about 20 minutes , or until burgers are done
9. serve with mashed potatoes or egg noodles
10. yummy !
demonstrations.review: This came together quickly and easily.  I halved the recipe and we all thought it was delicious.  I served it with buttered noodles and green beans.  True comfort food!

target.recipe_text:
best banana bread

you'll never need another banana bread recipe ever again!

1. remove odd pots and pans from oven
2. preheat oven to 350 / 180
3. cream together butter and sugar
4. add eggs and crushed bananas
5. combine well
6. sift together flour , soda and salt
7. add to creamed mixture
8. add vanilla
9. mix just until combined
10. do not overmix
11. pour into greased and floured loaf pan
12. bake at 350 / 180 for 55 minutes
13. keeps well , refrigerated
target.review: My 10-year old daughter was looking for something to make and found this recipe.  She made it all by herself and it was wonderful!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
anniversary chicken

found this recipe on allrecipies.com (courtesy of vicki frew). i cooked mine for 15 minutes before i added cheese, green onions and bacon bits. i was afraid the cheese would be cooked to much if it was on the whole time.  miss annie is right--after the 1st time i made it i started skipping the browning too and just put raw skinless, boneless chicken breasts in pan and poured the other ingredients over top. cooks up just fine either way.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. in a large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
3. add chicken breasts and saut 4 to 5 minutes each side until lightly browned
4. place browned chicken breasts in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish
5. brush with teriyaki sauce , then spoon on salad dressing
6. sprinkle with cheese , green onions and bacon bits
7. bake for 25 to 35 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear
8. garnish with chopped parsley and serve
demonstrations.review: I made this for some friends last night and they all loved it.  It is so easy to make that one of my girlfriends, who doesn't cook often, asked for the recipe and I am sure she'll have the same good results I had.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon wrapped rosemary chicken

discovered this recipe years ago and is a family favorite. it is a great recipe for beginning cooks because it is very easy with tasty results! for a variation, try other herbs rather than rosemary such as sage, tarragon or thyme.

1. heat the oven to 425f
2. cut chicken breasts into 4-6 ounce pieces
3. sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
4. wrap a slice of bacon around each piece of chicken and place in baking dish
5. sprinkle with rosemary
6. roast for 15 minutes at 425f
7. reduce heat to 375f and continue roasting until done
8. it won't take long--be careful not to over cook chicken
demonstrations.review: Very easy and tasty.  Just be sure to not overcook the chicken.  I served it with rice pilaf, and a salad and it was a quick, easy and tasty meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amazing strawberry  or blueberry  shortcake

found this amazing recipe in a magazine at the dentist and scrawled it on a scrap of paper. on the way home, i stopped by the market to get necessary ingredients and made it for dinner that evening. incredible. i am sure any combination of berries would be wonderful. i am a mascarpone cheese convert--it is a softer, more delicate flavor than cream cheese and perfect in this recipe. hope you enjoy! (prep time includes 1 hour fruit sits in refrigerator).

1. in small bowl , stir together berries , sugar , and lemon juice
2. let sit 30 minutes to an hour
3. near serving time , whip 1 / 2 cup of the heavy cream until soft peaks form
4. mix in 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar
5. in another bowl , stir mascarpone until smooth
6. stir in 3 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , vanilla and remaining 1 / 4 cup of the cream
7. fold mascarpone mixture into whipped cream mixture
8. to assemble: place 2 lady fingers on 8 dessert plates and cover with 2 tablespoons of strawberries , 2 tablespoons of mascarpone mixture
9. repeat with another lady fingers , laying across in the other direction
10. divide remaining strawberries among plates and top with with remaining mascarpone cheese mixture
demonstrations.review: Delicious and easy to make.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
silky chocolate butter frosting

once i tried this type of frosting, i have never gone back to the butter-cream type made with powdered sugar. this is just as creamy and fluffy, but not as gaggy sweet. sweet enough without overpowering the cake. prep times includs 15 minutes for cooling (may take longer depending on air temp).

1. in 2-quart saucepan , combine sugar , flour and cocoa
2. with wire whisk , gradually stir in milk until smooth
3. cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , until mixture has thickened and boils
4. reduce heat to low
5. cook 2 minutes , stirring constantly
6. remove from heat
7. cool completely
8. in medium bowl , with mixer at medium speed , beat butter until creamy
9. gradually beat in milk mixture , melted chocolate and vanilla
demonstrations.review: This was a really good frosting.  My only problem was I didn't think it was thick enough so I added a little powdered sugar--maybe 1 or 1 1/2 cups.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
aunt darlene s macaroni   cheese

the absolute best macaroni and cheese i have ever tasted. my kids love macaroni and cheese and this takes it up a notch! every time i have taken it to a potluck it is gone almost as soon as it is set out.

1. boil macaroni until tender , then drain water completely
2. put macaroni in a large bowl
3. stir in cheese from package and butter as required on box directions
4. stir eggs and evaporated milk together
5. add to macaroni mixture
6. add additional milk until it covers macaroni
7. stir it up !
8. salt and pepper to taste
9. pour the mixture into pan and stir in all of the shredded cheese reserving about 1 1 / 2 to 2 cups shredded cheese for the top
10. cook on 375f until cheese is golden brown
demonstrations.review: I used the Kraft "Deluxe" mac and cheese.  This recipe makes the creamiest, tastiest mac and cheese ever.  Makes a large casserole though--if you don't have a bunch of people to help you eat it, cut the recipe in half!  It would be great for a potluck!

target.recipe_text:
raw apple muffins

i made these years ago everyday in a small cafe i worked at. they are chunky with the batter just holding all the fruit and nuts together.

1. using 3 bowls:
2. combine apples and sugar
3. combine dry ingredients except raisins and walnuts
4. combine liquid
5. mix liquids and apples
6. combine with dry ingredients to moisten
7. add walnuts and raisins
8. bake 25 minutes at 350
9. i've just made them recently and if all the quantities are included and not overbaked , the apples alone make this moist and almost sticky
10. so i hope some will give this recipe a try
target.review: I had to hide these from my husband, he said they're better than cookies!  These turned out really moist and had just the right amount of sweet.  The batter did seem a bit dry, but they cooked up nicely.  I used half whole wheat flour.  They might be nice with some oats, too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet  creamy coleslaw

i never liked coleslaw until i tried my husband's great aunt's. now i can't get enough of it! great with bbq pork sandwiches. you can also use a bag of slaw mix instead of shredding the cabbage and carrots yourself.

1. shred cabbage and carrots into a bowl
2. mix mayonnaise , vinegar and sugar in a separate bowl
3. blending well
4. pour over shredded vegetables and stir to coat
5. chill
6. amounts of dressing ingredients can be adjusted to suit taste but always use the same amount of vinegar as sugar
demonstrations.review: Great flavor. I used a 10 oz. package of cole slaw mix, and it was too much dressing.  Next time will halve the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic beets

feel free to use more garlic with this recipe.

1. wash the beets and boil until tender , about 45 minutes
2. remove the skins by running cold water over the boiled beets , and then slipping of their skins
3. slice the beets and toss with the olive oil , vinegar , garlic , and salt
demonstrations.review: I've never cooked or eaten beets before.  I really liked this recipe, but no one else in my family would eat it.  Maybe they just don't like beets.  Thanks for a great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon teriyaki chicken  quick and easy

i got this one from my ex-husband. it was the one good thing he could cook and i loved it. i think he may have gotten it from a newspaper clipping. i like to serve the chicken over rice. it's great and i never have leftovers.

1. combine all ingredients , except the chicken , in a skillet
2. cook on high for 3-4 minutes on the stove
3. add the chicken
4. simmer for 30 minutes
5. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: We really liked this.  I added some carrots, zucchinni, and pineapple chunks to round out the meal.  It is a bit lemony, but I like lemon and the ginger was a nice addition.  I will make this again.  It's a nice quick chicken dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut squash and barley risotto

typically, risottos are made of refined rice known as aborio.  by using barley instead, you get tons of heart healthy benefits!  barley is a cholesterol lowering soluble fibre.  (recipe found on the heart and stroke foundation of canada website)

1. in a small saucepan , bring the broth to a boil
2. cover , and reduce heat to low
3. heat oil in a medium sized pot over medium heat
4. add onion and saut until tender
5. add squash and saut for another 3 minutes
6. add barley and stir for 2 more minutes
7. add 1 / 2 cup of the boiled broth , and chopped sage
8. simmer , stirring often until broth is absorbed , about 5 minutes
9. add remaining broth slowly , about 1 / 3 cup at a time , allowing it to be absorbed each time
10. cook barley until tender but still firm , about 35-40 minutes
11. remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese and parsley
12. season with salt and pepper to taste
demonstrations.review: We loved this dish.  I followed the instructions as written, except I doubled it for more people.  It took longer for me to make because of step 6...adding in the broth a little at a time and waiting for it to be absorbed. I got tired of waiting and poured it all in and cooked it for about 40 minutes.  It turned out great!  Thanks for a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tofu cinnamon muffins

from cooks.com

1. mix first two ingredients in a large bowl and set aside
2. mix the remaining in a blender
3. pour the blended ingredients into the flour mixture
4. stir well
5. fill oiled muffin tins 2 / 3 full
6. bake at 425 degrees for 12-15 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a good recipe. I made these twice, once as identified here and once with a half cup of blueberries and half a cup of walnuts, and minus the cinnamon. I actually liked the first version better and I am going to try these again becuase I like the fact that there is tofu in there and whole wheat!

target.recipe_text:
easy cole slaw

this is the recipe i turn to most when i make cole slaw.  the recipe comes from stephskitchen.com.

1. combine all ingredients except cole slaw mix in a large bowl and combine well
2. add the cole slaw mix and toss to coat
3. cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend
target.review: WOW!  My husband loves KFC cole slaw and thinks this slaw is great.  He has no idea how simple it is to make, no more deli or KFC cole slaw for us.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
steak marinade  quick and easy

this turns an average grocerty store bought steak into a good restaurant tasting steak. it takes only minutes to prepare and marinade can be for 30 minutes to overnight. ooh, so good!

1. mix it all together and marinade steak for 30 minutes to overnight
2. garlic will be stronger the longer you marinade
3. don't be afraid of the garlic it makes the steak taste wonderful !
4. either grill the steaks or pan fry them in butter
5. either way they're great !
6. i do both
7. i grill them til they're almost done then finish the cooking by pan frying
8. this turns an average grocery store steak into a delicious good restaurant tasting steak
demonstrations.review: So sorry about the low rating.  I followed the instructions to the max, but it was just too salty for us.  Lots of flavor, but too salty.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy asian beef   noodles   ww recipe

this is delicious. it satisfies my craving for lo-mein. i have made with chicken and shrimp as well, just adjust the ramen noodle flavor to match.  from ww cookbook cooking for two, it makes a huge 10 points serving.  i am satisfied with 1/2 a serving.

1. trim fat from steak
2. cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slice
3. heat 1 tsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
4. add steak and green onions
5. stir fry 1 minute
6. remove steak mixture from skillet
7. keep warm
8. heat remaining 1 tsp oil in skillet over medium high heat
9. add slaw
10. stir fry for 30 seconds
11. remove slaw from skillet and keep warm
12. remove noodles from packages
13. reserve 1 seasoning packet for another use
14. add water and remaining seasoning packet to skillet
15. bring to a boil
16. break noodles in half
17. add noodles to water mixture
18. cook noodles 2 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed , stirring frequently
19. stir in steak mixture , slaw , and soy sauce
20. cook until thoroughly heated
demonstrations.review: Nice and easy.  4 stars because it did not have alot of flavor.  I kept tasting and adding seasonings, onion and garlic powder, also some red pepper flakes.  All helped the flavor quite abit.   Will definitely make again and add more seasonings and some vegies.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
macaroni and cheese  4 389

re: the title. just a little joke with so many recipes out there =). the grand kids like this so much better than the commercial version. it is an excellent freezer recipe. we always keep extra in zip lock bags as backup for the kids or as a side dish for a meal.

1. cook macaroni , rinse and drain
2. melt butter in heavy bottomed 2 quart sauce pan
3. add flour , s& p , whisk in and cook until bubbly
4. slowly whisk in milk
5. cook until it starts to thicken
6. add cheeses and mustard and cook until thick
7. pour sauce over macaroni , stir , heat and serve
8. freeze any leftovers
9. when thawed , reheat adding extra liquid until it is the consistancy you like
demonstrations.review: I liked that it was all made on top of the stove and I did not have to bake it.  I am only giving it 3 stars because I thought it was just too bland.  I followed instructions  to a tee. Will add some velveeta cheese to add more flavor to present batch.  I will make again, and add more flavorable cheese.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy enchilada casserole with doritos

i saw this recipe on good morning america and it sounded so easy and tasty. and it was! the first time i made it my husband ate almost 1/3 of it in one sitting. even my toddler son enjoys it. this would be great for those informal group get-togethers also. add some chiles to give it a bit more zip or a pound of browned ground beef or some chicken for another twist.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. crumble 2 / 3 of bag of doritos into mixing bowl
3. mix in the onion , chili , 1 1 / 2 c cheese , enchilada sauce and tomato sauce
4. place into an 8 1 / 2 x 11-inch casserole dish
5. bake for 20 minutes
6. remove from oven and spread on sour cream , remaining doritos and 1 / 2 c cheese
7. bake for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted
8. serve
demonstrations.review: Very good and easy.  Added one pound of browned fround beef, just to make it go farther.  Everyone loved it.  Do not leave leave out the sour cream.  Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted brined chicken

i looked at several recipes for brining and roasting a chicken.  i did not find one that i liked but did like several parts of different recipes so i made up my own.  i had never brines before and wow what a difference.  my dh was shocked as was i at how moist the chicken was.

1. mix all ingredients for brine in a container and place whole washed bird in liquid make sure it is completely immersed
2. refrigerate over night
3. next morning take bird out of brine , rinse and pat dry
4. add seasoning to skin of bird and place back in fridge until ready to roast
5. i roasted my chicken for 60 minutes at 400 degrees
demonstrations.review: WOW, This really works great. I forgot to preplan and start brine the night before, I was able to brine the chicken for about 5 hours.  It was wonderful, lots of flavor and very moist.  Cann't wait to try it again with a longer brine.  I also put a couple of turkey thighs in a separate container to brine and they came out great too.  Thanks for this great recipe!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot apple butter

this is just one of my comfort foods. i love it slathered on homemade biscuits. mmmmmmmm...so good.

1. place apples in a large bowl
2. combine sugar , cinnamon , cloves and salt
3. pour over apples and mix well
4. place in crock pot , cover and cook on high for 1 hour
5. decrease heat to low
6. cover and cook on low for 9-11 hours or until thickened and dark brown
7. stir occasionally
8. uncover and cook on low for 1 hour longer
9. if desired , whisk until smooth
10. spoon into freezer containers , leaving 1 / 2-inch head space
11. cover and freeze
target.review: Great stuff, I used 6 lbs. of Gala and only used half of the sugar-its just great with only 2 cups.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ground beef gyros

this is a great summer meal and quick and easy to put together and tastes wonderful. refreshing served with the cucumber sauce and is even low in fat. i think this came from quick cooking. it's a favorite in our house.

1. in a bowl , combine first 5 ingredients
2. cover and refrigerate
3. in separate bowl , combine ground beef and seasonings
4. mix well
5. shape into 4 patties
6. grill , covered , over medium to high heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until meat is no longer pink , turning once
7. cut patties into thin slices
8. stuff into pitas
9. add lettuce , cucumber , tomato , and onion
10. serve with yogurt sauce
demonstrations.review: Really good, next time I will increase the cucumber in the sauce and decrease the onion. It was tasty and since I am not eating bread I made mine into a salad, my husband loved his pita and thought this was a fast easy option. I will make it again for sure. Thanks Cyrene.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
applesauce cake

this recipe came from king arthur flour, its wonderful, the molasses really add to the rich flavor.

1. in a mixing bowl , beat together the oil , eggs , molasses and applesauce till smooth
2. add the flour , sugar , salt , baking powder , soda , cinnamon and nutmeg
3. beat till smooth
4. pour batter into a lightly greased and floured 9x13 in baking pan
5. place cake in a preheated 375 degree oven
6. bake for 25 minutes or until it tests done
7. remove and cool completely ona wire rack
8. just before serving dust with powdered sugar
demonstrations.review: This was an easy quick cake.  It was delicious with a dollop of homemade whipped cream.  Just sweet enough to take care of the sweet tooth.  I also replaced some of the oil with more applesauce.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry cheesecake ice cream  for electric ice cream machine

posted by request. recipe is from the recipe book that came with my ice cream machine. prep time includes 1 hour chilling and 1/2 hour freezing times.

1. blend all ingredients until smooth
2. chill ingredients for about 1 hour , or until cold
3. turn on ice cream machine and set it to chill the freezing / mixing bowl for 5 minutes
4. spoon the cooled mixture into the freezing / mixing bowl of machine
5. set the freezing timer to the 30 minute maximum setting
6. push start button
7. when timer rings , spoon ice cream into dishes and enjoy
demonstrations.review: Great flavor! I did make the classic rookie mistake by not creaming sugar and cream cheese together first. Yummy stuff!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
romano s macaroni grill rosemary bread

this is an attempt to immitate the excellent bread that is served in the macaroni grill restaurant.

1. place yeast , sugar and water in large bowl or food processor and allow mixture to become bubbly
2. mix in 1 t butter , salt , and 2 cups of flour
3. add one tablespoon of the fresh chopped rosemary
4. knead for about 10 minutes by hand or in food processor about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic
5. add more flour if necessary
6. oil a bowl , put dough in it and cover with a towel
7. let dough rise in a warm place for one hour until doubled
8. punch down dough and divide in half
9. let dough rest about 5 minutes
10. spray baking pan or cookie sheet with cooking spray
11. shape the dough into 2 small rounded oval loaves
12. sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon of rosemary over the loaves and press lightly into the surface
13. let loaves rise again until doubled , about 45 minutes
14. preheat oven to 375f
15. bake for 15 to 20 minutes , until lightly browned
16. carefully remove from oven , brush with remaining butter
demonstrations.review: This was the easiest bread I've ever made.  My picky son even liked it. It was super fantastic.  I will make it again and again! I've never been to Macaroni Grill so I cant compare but it is a 10*** in  my book!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spiced cod fillet on the grill

cod is a delicious fish, with a mild flavour and white firm flesh. after buying cod, (and most fish in general), always rinse off the fish with cool water when you get home and pat dry and then rewrap. store it in the coldest part of the fridge and for no more then 2 days.

1. dust cod with cumin , salt , pepper and cayenne
2. spread mustard over fish
3. if grilling use the butter to baste , this of course means you'll need to melt the butter
4. grill for about 3 minutes per side
5. you could alternatively broil for 3-4 minutes per side in the oven
6. in this case , place the fish on a broiling pan and dot each fillet with butter before putting it in the oven
7. either way the fish flesh will be white , firm and flake easily with a fork when done
8. serve with lemon wedges
demonstrations.review: It was fine the first day, not anything to write home about so I would only give it 2.5 stars but the second day I used the leftovers for fish tacos and it tasted much better. It really makes a difference what you pair it with. Now a 4 star. Thanks.

target.recipe_text:
sauteed apples

a very good accompaniment to pork dishes.

1. melt butter with 3 tblsps water over moderate-low heat in a large skillet
2. add salt and sugar and cook apples , covered , for 3-5 minutes , or just until tender
3. increase heat to moderate and season apples
4. cook , uncovered , until tender and bottom layer is lightly golden
5. invert apples onto platter and slide back into skillet to brown other half
target.review: This was perfect. I used Braeburn apples and a smidge of honey instead of the sugar. Also, I added some Vietnamese cinnamon...de-licious.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut squash fries

5oz.fries=  65 calories, 0g fat, 6mg sodium, 16.5 carbs, 4g fiber, 3g sugar,  1.5g protein

1. pre-heat oven to 425 degrees
2. peel and de-seed your butternut squash
3. slice squash in half
4. cut it up into french fry shapes
5. place on a cookie sheet sprayed with non-stick spray
6. cover lightly with kosher salt
7. place tray in your pre-heated oven and bake for 40 minutes or so , flipping halfway through baking process
8. fries are done when they are starting to brown on the edges and get crispy
9. serve with ketchup or syrup if desired
demonstrations.review: Yummy! Kind of like sweet potato fries...be warned, don't julienne the squash too thinly.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
boursin cheese  homemade

boursin-style cheese can easily be made at home. not just more economical, but fresher and tastier.  rub all the dried herbs used between your fingers before adding.

1. have cheeses and butter at room temperature
2. crush garlic
3. mix cheeses , butter and garlic
4. add remaining ingredients , mix well
5. pack into a container just large enough to hold the boursin and store in refrigerator
6. to serve , bring to room temperature
7. serve with crackers
demonstrations.review: Delightful, very fragrant, saved me a bundle and made a huge amount of Boursin Cheese! Will do again...and again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marvelous broccoli salad

you may want to make a double batch of this salad. there won't be any left!!

1. combine all ingredients for salad
2. combine dressing ingredients
3. add to salad just before serving and toss
demonstrations.review: I really loved this, much sweeter than I anticipated, but still really great. Make sure you chop up the broccoli so it's bite sized.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple roasted butternut squash cinnamon soup

booyah!  this velvety soup is a sweet and savory bowl of comfort with a surprising cinnamon kick.

1. roast the butternut squash , flesh side down onto a lightly oiled roasting pan for 40 to 45 minutes in a 425 degree oven
2. in the mean time , sautee the onion , ginger , and garlic in butter until soft
3. add the broth , simmer for ten minutes
4. add pulp from the butternut squash
5. puree in a food processor or blender
6. return to pan
7. add cream , salt , pepper , and a pinch or 2 of cinnamon
8. simmer until heated through
demonstrations.review: Amazing, restaurant quality. This beats every butternut squash soup I've ever tasted.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot sugared nuts

easy way to make a delicious treat! use your favorite nuts: pecans, walnuts, cashews--whatever!

1. preheat crock pot on high for 15 minutes
2. in preheated crock pot stir the nuts and butter until mixed well
3. add the powdered sugar , stirring to coat evenly
4. cover and slow-cook on high for 15 minutes
5. reduce the heat to low and slow cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the nuts are coated with a crisp glaze
6. transfer the nuts to a bowl
7. in another small bowl , combine the spices and sift them over the nuts , stirring to coat evenly
8. let cool before serving
demonstrations.review: This is the perfect 3 pm work snack. One little handful of these stave off my appetite until dinner. I added a little salt to mine, because I like things sweet AND salty. Thanks for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
the day after thanksgiving turkey stir fry

a good way to use up leftover turkey from thanksgiving or christmas. i make sure i buy a turkey big enough to make this the next day.
originally an adopted recipe

1. sauce: combine all ingredients in small bowl
2. stir_fry: combine 2 tbsp sauce and the turkey in a bowl
3. let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature
4. heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. add onion
6. stir-fry for 2 minutes
7. add sweet potato , broccoli and pepper
8. stir-fry for 2 minutes
9. add cup water
10. cover and cook 6-8 minutes until sweet potato is tender
11. add remaining sauce and heat while stirring gently to combine
target.review: Easy, flexible, and great results.  The sauce is deliscious and the use of sweet potato really complements all the different flavours.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
samosa soup

this soup was the product of an insatiable craving for samosas and no indian restaurant nearby. making indian appetizers is way too much work and the overpowering stench of a deep fryer is enough to permeate your home for days. so, i created this soup which tastes just like a samosa - and it's low fat too! this was quick and easy to prepare and quite good. it tasted very similar to a nice spicy samosa and was complemented nicely by storebought nan bread.

1. heat oil in a large saucepan and add the potatoes , garlic and onion
2. saute over a low heat for 5 minutes
3. add the cayenne pepper , cumin , garam masala and cilantro
4. stir well
5. add the vegetable stock and bring mixture to a boil
6. cover the pan , reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
7. add peas and continue to cook the soup for another 5 minutes
8. ladle into four individual serving bowls and spoon a tablespoon of yogurt on top of each
9. enjoy
demonstrations.review: Very nice.  Easy, fairly mellow flavors, and healthy.  My only complaint is that it was a little thin; I stupidly stirred yoghurt in beforehand which didn't help the texture.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lentil curry

my mother passed this recipe on to me. really healthy and very satisfying. also freezes really well.

1. rinse lentils in strainer and sort through , removing debris
2. heat 1 tbs broth in medium soup pot
3. saute onion in broth over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently , until translucent
4. add garlic , carrots , celery , and cabbage
5. continue to saut for another couple of minutes
6. add curry powder and mix to bring out its flavour
7. add rinsed and drained lentils , broth and tomatoes
8. bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium low , and simmer uncovered until lentils and vegetables are tender , about 30 minutes
9. add cilantro and season with salt and pepper to taste
10. serve over rice / toast / etc
11. i rarely have fresh cilantro so substitute 1-2tbs dried coriander
12. usually end up forgetting it altogether though
13. i play fast and loose with the quantities - very forgiving recipe
14. servings are a guess , i tend to make lots and use up all the vegies i can find
demonstrations.review: This was excellent.  The cabbage and lentils are most essential, otherwise i just threw in some vegetables from my fridge.  I would recommend more curry powder, and make sure you don't skimp on the cabbage because it cooks down and tastes marvelous.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
black forest coffee cake

this is soooo good. yes 2 tbsp. vanilla extract is correct.

1. in a large mixing bowl beat the eggs
2. add the sugar , oil , milk and vanilla
3. mix in the flour and baking powder , when blended add the chocolate chips
4. pour into a greased 13x9x2 baking pan
5. drop cherry pie filling by the teaspoonfuls in even rows into the batter
6. with a pastry blender combine the bisquick , sugar and butter to form loose crumbs , add the chocolate chips
7. sprinkle the topping evenly over the top of the cake
8. bake 375' for 55 minutes to 1 hour or until cake is golden brown and when tested done with toothpick
demonstrations.review: I didn't rate this because I made some significant changes to the recipe.  This is a nice idea, but each layer is so sugary it is overkill to me.  I found that the flavors just didn't blend like they do in a black forest cake.  However, I brought this to a german class and got positive feedback.  So for those who could stand to OD on sugar, chocolate chips, and cherries, go for it, otherwise, skip dessert.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rosemary potato bread

this is wonderful with soups and smells heavenly whilst baking!

1. dissolve the yeast in the milk for 15 minutes
2. mix the potato , oil , salt , rosemary and yeast mixture
3. stir in the reserved cooking liquid and then the flour to form a stiff dough
4. knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic
5. cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size
6. place in a greased loaf tin and leave until the dough has risen above the rim of the tin
7. bake at 200c / 400f for 10 minutes then reduce the heat to 190c / 375f for 40 minutes
8. cool on a wire rack
demonstrations.review: Despite the fact that my yeast didn't work and the recipe turned out more like biscotti, I enjoyed this bread for the wonderful aroma and ease of making.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick amish friendship bread or muffins  no starter required

i love this bread and i had a craving for it, but didn't want to wait the month it took for the starter to be ready, so, i modified it a bit. it might not be quite as tasty as the original, but it's great if you want it in a hurry! i like to use butterscotch pudding for a different, but really nice flavor! hope you enjoy!

1. mix "starter" ingredients together
2. mix oil , milk , eggs , and vanilla with the "starter"
3. in a separate bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , salt , baking soda , vanilla pudding mix , and nuts
4. add to liquid mixture and stir thoroughly
5. pour into two large well-greased 9x5 inch loaf pans , one bundt pan , or 48 muffin tins
6. bake at 325f for one hour or until done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I tasted little difference between this bread and the same bread that took a friend a month.  I used chocolate pudding and that gave it even more richness.

target.recipe_text:
zucchini and tomato hominy harmony

this mexican-inspired dish can be served with tortillas or over rice.

1. saute the onion in the butter over medium heat until the onion is tender
2. add the remaining ingredients and cook uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the zucchini is tender , about 10 to 15 minutes
3. serve immediately
target.review: This dish was even better the next day. I had mine with brown rice (cooked with taco seasoning), sour cream, and cheddar on top.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mashed red potatoes with garlic and parmesan

the potatoes are ready in our garden, and this is the first recipe i reach for! these are so good!!

1. put potatoes and garlic in lg pan
2. cover with water
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes , until potatoes are tender
5. drain well
6. mash with the butter , milk , and salt
7. stir in the parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: A good basic recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
snow cream

lovely project for children, just make sure your snow is from a non-polluted area.

1. add sugar to cream and flavor highly with vanilla
2. stir in newly fallen snow till thick as ice cream just before serving
3. any kind of juice may be substituted instead of cream
demonstrations.review: My mother would always make snow cream with sweetened condensed milk instead of the cream and sugar...mmmmmmmm!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh balsamic asparagus salad

this is a very tasty fresh salad, crisp and tangy! i love this stuff. :)

1. trim the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces
2. thinly slice the mushrooms
3. simmer the asparagus in 1 / 2 cup of water with a pinch of salt until it is tender
4. while the asparagus is simmering , whisk the lemon juice , vinegar , dijon mustard , and garlic together
5. gradually add the olive oil and then the black pepper
6. once you have drained the asparagus and let it cool , gently toss it with half of the dressing to coat it well
7. toss the remaining dressing with the basil and the mushrooms , and sprinkle the mixture over the asparagus
8. season to taste with salt , garnish with freshly grated parmesan or mizithra cheese , and serve
demonstrations.review: This blew me away! So so tasty! Best the day it's made. I loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy baked potato wedges

we love these potatoes, they are simple to make and taste great!

1. wash potatoes , cut into wedges
2. place potatoes skin down in a baking dish
3. mix the next 6 ingredients together and brush onto potatoes
4. bake at 350 for 1 hour
