6. once the grill is heated , lower the grill temp to medium then grill on indirect heat with grill closed for 20-30 min or until juices run clear
demonstrations.review: What a wonderful and flavorful chicken thigh recipe! I didn't have fresh thyme but used dry and it wasy nice. Instead of garlic powder I used 3 cloves fresh pressed garlic. I did not use onion powder as I didn't have any, but it tasted great anyway. Instead of chili powder I used ground cayanne pepper as that's what I had on hand. I let it marinate for about 2 1/2 hours. I planned to grill it but it started raining so I broiled them instead. I preheated a broiler pan (sprayed with Pam for Grilling) in the oven and set to broil for about 5 minutes. I then added the chicken thighs skin side down and broiled about 8 inches from the coil and left the door ajar. After 15 minutes I turned the chicken and broiled for 15 minutes more. The skin crisped up very nicely was a nice alternative when I couldn't grill. Nice job Duch!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked blue cheese chicken

excellent! if you like blue cheese you will love this dish. i make it often for just the family or dinner parties and everyone always comments on how good it is. i like to serve this chicken with baked potatoes or a rice dish and a green salad. enjoy!

1. mix together the blue cheese , sour cream and garlic
2. set aside
3. lightly salt chicken breasts
4. dredge each one in the flour , dip in the beaten egg , then roll in the bread crumbs
5. place the butter& oil in a non-stick skillet and heat over medium-high heat
6. brown chicken breasts on both sides then place in a lightly greased baking dish
7. pour the blue cheese mixture over the breasts
8. cover and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 45-60 mins or until chicken is tender
demonstrations.review: This recipe was okay, for me it lacked flavor.  I scaled it down to suit 2 chicken breasts and used light sour cream.  Perhaps it needed more blue cheese, but I used 3 oz so I'm not sure.  I also added some fresh rosemary to sauce to help spark it up.

target.recipe_text:
how scallops are supposed to be made

scallops don't need sauces or breading to be perfect. this method is fast, easy, healthy, and most of all, delicious! i love these scallops with some couscous or a simple pasta with olive oil, parmesan, and basil/oregano. enjoy!

1. preheat a large skillet over med-high to high heat
2. add oil
3. pat down scallops with a paper towel to remove excess moisture
4. sprinkle salt and pepper over one side of the scallops
5. place scallops on the hot skillet
6. do not touch , move , or tinker with the scallops at all
7. sprinkle salt and pepper over the other side of the scallops
8. cook scallops 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until caramel in color
9. squeeze the lemon juice over the pan
target.review: Used Bay Scallops!  Just like Joes Stone Crab!!  I added a bit of butter and think the lemon juice should be saved for after the scallops are plated so as to not lose the carmelization.  Use high heat and a copper skillet if you have one!! Soo good!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
blender hollandaise sauce

this is a quick, easy and virtually foolproof hollandaise sauce. the recipe can be doubled and if there happens to be left overs you can reheat in the microwave.

1. place egg yolks , lemon juice and pepper in blender container and blend until lemon color
2. turn blender to high and very slowly add butter , blend until thick , about 30 seconds
3. to serve , heat sauce slowly in top of double boiler over hot water
4. an excellent addition to cooked veggies , fish or poached eggs
5. to reheat in the microwave: pour the sauce into a microwave safe glass measuring cup
6. heat at 30% power until heated through , stirring after every 30 seconds
demonstrations.review: Great and easy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramelized onion   gorgonzola mashed potatoes

i love this recipe! it came from southern living magazine and is one of my family's favorite. it takes a little bit of time to prepare and cook but is well worth the effort. very unique taste with the gorgonzola and the sweetness of the onions. enjoy!

1. bring potato , 1 teaspoon salt , and water to cover to a boil in a dutch oven
2. cook 20 to 25 minutes or until tender
3. drain and keep warm
4. melt 2 tablespoons butter with oil in a skillet over medium heat
5. add onion , and cook , stirring often , 12 to 17 minutes or until tender
6. add garlic , and cook 3 minutes
7. stir in rosemary
8. remove from heat
9. mash potato with a potato masher
10. stir in 1 / 2 cup butter , half-and-half , and cheese until blended
11. stir in onion mixture , remaining 3 / 4 teaspoon salt , and pepper
12. spoon enough mixture into a decorative , ovenproof dish or 13- x 9-inch baking dish to fill bottom
13. pipe or dollop remaining mixture over top
14. broil , 3 inches from heat , 5 minutes or until top is lightly browned
15. garnish , if desired
demonstrations.review: Yummy!!  Used Red Skin potatoes and skim milk.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chimichurri

this too easy sauce, of argentine origin, makes your steak taste like it was just dragged through the garden! great on rare, chargrilled, flank steak.

1. pulse parsley in processor to chop
2. add remaining ingredients and blend
3. separate sauce into equal parts
demonstrations.review: Yummy!  Had the butcher run a Flat Iron Steak through the tenderizer then marinated 1/2 a day in the sauce.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brined roast pheasant   outdoor wisconsin  style

brining really is the way to go with pheasant, to keep it moist and also to 

1. heat together the water and salt until salt is dissolved , then allow to cool to room temperature for about a half hour
2. add the sugar , syrup , onions , garlic , cloves , and lemon and cayenne pepper
3. add pheasant , cover and refrigerate overnight
4. the next day , preheat oven to 350 degrees f
5. place brined pheasant in a roasting pan breast up and insert a tablespoon of the butter under the breast skin
6. rub the rest of the butter all over the pheasant , then roast uncovered for about 1-1 / 2 hours
7. check after an hour , though
8. baste frequently !
9. and if you like , to keep the breast meat moist , you can cover it with bacon strips as well
demonstrations.review: My husband took the brine to the hunt and put 6 birds around noon.  Cooked  them slowly on the Green Egg with prosciutto and chorizo on top.  Fantastic!  We'll try brining the rest for 24 hrs.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
our favorite italian beef

this is our favorite italian beef recipe, it is great for a party, the holidays, gametime, or your family anytime. it also freezes well, and i think tastes even better after being frozen. we serve it on a crusty sweet bread, but any sub or hard roll will do..you want something that will hold all those delicious juices

1. put roast in crockpot , season lightly with salt , pepper , and garlic powder
2. add seasoning mixes , beer , and both peppers w / juices
3. if there is no liquid covering entire roast , add enough to just cover top of the roast
4. cook in crockpot , on low , for a minimum of 8 hours
5. remove roast from crockpot , allow to cool to touch
6. "pick"meat , seperate and remove the fat , the roast should just fall apart into pieces
7. put meat back into crockpot , cook an additional 6-8 hours
8. i usually cook this the first 8 hours the day before i want to serve this , then the additional cooking is done the day i want to serve it
demonstrations.review: The family loved this!  I first seared the sirloin on all sides then added the rest of the ingredients to the "dutch oven".  I cooked it overnight at  170 degrees, shredded the meat in the morning then continued it all in the dutch oven at 170 the whole day.  Can't wait for the freezer leftovers

target.recipe_text:
candy cane cake

your little elves’ eyes will light up when they see—and taste—this pretty peppermint bundt cake.

1. heat oven to 350f
2. generously grease and flour 12-cup fluted tube pan
3. in large bowl , beat cake mix , water , oil and egg whites with electric mixer on low speed 30 seconds
4. beat on medium speed 2 minutes , scraping bowl occasionally
5. pour about 2 cups batter into pan
6. pour about 3 / 4 cup batter into small bowl
7. stir in food color and peppermint extract
8. carefully pour pink batter over white batter in pan
9. carefully pour remaining white batter over pink batter
10. bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. cool 10 minutes
12. turn pan upside down onto wire rack or heatproof serving plate
13. remove pan
14. cool cake completely , about 1 hour
15. in small bowl , mix all icing ingredients
16. stir in additional milk , 1 teaspoon at a time , until smooth and spreadable
17. spread icing over cake
18. sprinkle top with crushed candy
target.review: This is a great cake.  I brought it to work today and have gotten lots of compliments on it.  It was very easy to prepare.  I bought Classic White frosting from the store.  I heated it in the microwave and just kind of drizzled it on, and then sprinkled crushed candy canes on top.  I should have waited a bit longer to do that part though, cause my frosting was still warm and the candy bled a bit.  It still looked pretty though!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crumb topped banana muffins

these are so good. we love the topping.

1. in a large bowl , mix the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
2. mix bananas , sugar , egg and melted butter
3. stir into dry mixture until thoroughly combined , then stop mixing
4. fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. combine brown sugar , flour , and cinnamon topping ingredients
6. cut in cold butter until crumbly
7. sprinkle over muffins
8. bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes , until muffins test done
9. cool in pan for 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: These are soooo good.  I've made them twice now.  The topping is excellent.  My muffin cups always seem to be a little more than 3/4 full, but I just pile it in and they always turn out fine.  Thanks so much for posting.  I'm not sure as though I'll ever make plain old banana bread again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
harvest caramel corn

this is caramel corn with an holiday twist! it's very addictive! i love making this and putting in small decorative bags and give as gifts to friends and teachers.

1. dissolve the sugar , margarine , corn syrup and salt until firm ball stage
2. remove from heat and add spices and baking soda
3. pour over popcorn , stirring well
4. spread evenly on baking sheet and bake at 250f 45-50 minutes stirring every 15 minutes until done
5. cool
demonstrations.review: Great popcorn.  Love the flavors.  Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hidden valley ranch oyster crackers

these are really good to snack on, but be careful, they are quite addictive.

1. mix salad oil and dressing mix together
2. add remaining ingredients and stir to coat
3. place in a warm oven for 15-20 minutes
demonstrations.review: These are absolutely scrumpous!  They have got to be the best snack ever.  So cheap to make and super easy.  I used about 3/4 cup of a heart healthy vegetable oil, and used generic store brand crackers.  I will definately be making these again, and again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simply sour cream chicken enchiladas

easy to assemble, deliciously creamy and a great choice for once-a-month cooking. and there is no canned cream soup in my enchiladas -- hope you give them a try!

1. in a frying pan , cook chicken and onion together in oil over medium-high heat until chicken is just done
2. divide cooked chicken evenly between 8 tortillas
3. add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese to each tortilla
4. roll enchiladas and place seam-side down in a 9x13" baking dish that has been lightly sprayed with no-stick cooking spray
5. melt butter in a medium saucepan
6. stir in flour to make a roux , stir and cook until bubbly , and gradually whisk in chicken broth then bring to boiling , stirring frequently
7. remove from heat
8. stir in sour cream and green chilies
9. pour sauce evenly over enchiladas
10. top with remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese and bake at 400 f for 20 minutes until cheese is melted and sauce near edges of baking dish is bubbly
demonstrations.review: Great recipe!  I used 10in tortillas cause that was all I had, so I only got 4 of them filled.  I also only used 2 chicken breasts cut up, so I cut back on the sauce alittle bit.  Very yummy!  Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker cheesy chicken

almost too easy, the chicken cooks in a creamy, cheesy sauce that is delicious over noodles. this freezes well, too

1. place chicken breasts in the crock pot
2. mix the undiluted soups together with the garlic powder and pour over chicken
3. cover and cook on low 6-8 hours , until chicken is tender
4. serve with the delicious sauce over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: I can't believe how good this was for as easy as it was!  I was doubtful; it did seem to good to be true, but turned out to be very tasty.  I figured my husband would think it was bland and add a bunch of spices to his, but he didn't!  I used 3 frozen breast (thawed), and cut the soup back to 1 can of each kind.  The chicken was completely covered while it cooked (about 8 hours) and fell apart when I scooped it out.  I ended up shredding it and mixing it all up.  Served with egg noodles.  Thanks for posting!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot chili pork chops     a must try

i found this recipe on the web somewhere and decided to try it. it is absolutely wonderful and the meat just falls off the bones. as my husband describes it "they are succulent!" this is a must in our family at least every other week!

1. cook onions in oil until lightly brown
2. add garlic , worcestershire sauce , chili powder , water , ketchup and salt and pepper
3. cover and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes
4. arrange pork chops in crock pot , pour sauce over the chops
5. cover and cook on low heat for 6-7 hours
6. i find that the longer you cook them , the more tender they are
7. i normally serve them with mashed potatoes and a vegetable
8. i put the sauce over the mashed potatoes
target.review: WE LOVED this!!! We had boneless loin chops so that is what we used. We were short on time so we cooked them on high for 4 hours and they were perfect! So tender and yummy! We will be making these again and again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dumplings

these are easy to make and are the richest and fluffiest i have had!

1. mix together in a bowl the flour , salt and baking powder
2. bring to just a simmer in a small saucepan the butter and milk
3. add the milk mixture to the dry ingredients
4. stir with a fork or kneed by hand 2 to 3 times until the mixture just comes together
5. divide the dough into about 16 small puffy dumplings
6. roll each piece of dough into a small rough ball
7. gently lay the formed dumplings on the surface of your stew or soup
8. cover and simmer for 10 minutes
9. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Husband and I both loved it! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
basil pesto

this is a wonderful lemon-flavored pesto. this was my first taste of pesto and i've never gone back!

update as of 2/13/04
i'm glad that you all like this.  i freeze this now and keep it on hand for my spaghetti sauce or others sauces.  it freezes great!

1. mix everything together in food processor except the oil and lemon
2. once everything is mixed well , drizzle with lemon and oil
3. mix until well blended
4. serve on pasta or just about anything that needs a pick me up
5. will keep in refrigerator for 2-3 days
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I used 3 cloves of garlic and walnuts as I didn't have any pine nuts. It was great! We made a pesto, tomato and broccoli pizza with it. It was fantastic! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kelly s southwestern beef stew

thick, rich and hearty beef stew that is anything but bland, if you know what i mean! it took me several years to perfect this recipe, and i'm proud to say that it was recently published in taste of home magazine! i'm a midwest meat and potatoes kind of girl, and always liked beef stew, but it was always just "ok". even people that say they don't care for spicy foods really liked it! hope you try it! enjoy!

1. in large ziplock baggie or large mixing bowl , combine flour , paprika , chili powder , garlic powder and salt
2. add meat and shake / toss til all is coated
3. in large heavy-bottomed pot that has a lid , brown meat over med-high heat in the 4 tbsp crisco
4. add next 8 ingredients , cover and simmer for about 45 minutes , stirring only occasionally , til meat is tender
5. add carrots and potatoes , recover and simmer another 25-30 minutes or til tender
6. add corn , heat through
7. remove bay leaf , or , leave it in there and whoever happens to get it has to do the dishes !
8. )
9. can add or sub peas and / or green beans if desired
10. you can also add 1 rib of celery , sliced , at the same time you add the potatoes and carrots if desired
11. if you like it on the thick side like we do , just mix 1-2 tablespoons cornstarch with equal amount of cold water , stir into pot while simmering to thicken even more
12. simmer , stirring , for several minutes
13. do this at the very end
14. stir gently so you don't wreck the green beans if added
demonstrations.review: Great flavor! My husband and I loved it. I only used one onion. I needed more beef broth probably because I made it in my electric skillet which I think cooks hotter than the stove top. I used frozen corn and frozen green beans. Due to needing more beef broth I did not need the corn starch and it was good and thick. I served it with #26110 (Southern Buttermilk Biscuits). Very yummy dinner! Thank you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s easy and delicious ranch parmesan chicken

there are plenty versions of this recipe, this is mine and can be on your table in less that an hour, my family loves this chicken! --- the ranch dressing is the secret it holds in all the flavor and moistness while the chicken is baking and also adds flavor, i find that hidden valley ranch dressing works the best but kraft or any other brand will do, i sometimes top the baked chicken with mozzarella cheese or cheddar, but that is optional --- although i have only made this using breasts i imagine that chicken pieces could be used although you would have to increase the breadcrumb mixture slightly, you can marinate the chicken breast in the ranch dressing for a few hours in the fridge, although you will need more than 1 cup of dressing if you are marinating .... *note* to avoid a soggy bottom crust, place the chicken breasts onto a flat rack on top the baking sheet, also it is important not to bake the chicken in a small baking pan, if you do not have a rack bake on a large baking sheet so any juices in the pan will spread out and not accumulate under the chicken causing a soggy bottom ---------------
for low-fat option: use low-fat ranch dressing and omit the melted butter on top or use a healthy butter alternative such as smart balance 50/50 blend.

1. set oven to 400 degrees
2. in a shallow bowl mix together the dry breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese , seasoned salt , black pepper and garlic powder
3. dip the chicken into the ranch dressing to coat both sides
4. coat in the breadcrumb mixture
5. place in a single layer onto a greased baking sheet or line with non-stick foil
6. lightly drizzle the melted butter over each breast
7. if desired you can sprinkle black pepper over the chicken pieces
8. bake uncovered for about 30-35 minutes or until the chicken is cooked)
demonstrations.review: This is a WONDERFUL recipe! We made it with 2 bone in chicken breasts, that made the cooking time around an hour. We used Ken's Ranch dressing which really isn't my favorite and I still loved it. Thank you so much!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cabbage for those who dislike cabbage

this is so much nicer than plain steamed or boiled cabbage. try it on the cabbage haters in your family and see if it converts them.

1. in a large skillet , heat butter and oil over medium heat
2. add cabbage , garlic and brown sugar to pan
3. saut until the cabbage is limp , about 5 minutes or so
4. reduce heat to medium-low and stir in vinegar
5. cook , stirring very often , for approximately 20 minutes
6. taste and if cabbage is too crunchy for you , continue to cook for a few more minutes
7. add salt and pepper to taste and serve
demonstrations.review: I didn't leave any stars because I think we didn't like it b/c we don't like cabbage. I had some to use and hoped this recipe would change our minds but it didn't. So sorry. Thanks for the recipe, though. I always enjoy trying something new even if it doesn't work for us.

target.recipe_text:
taco bell quesadillas

i used to love these when i was younger, i could eat two in one sitting! i haven't had fast food in a year or two, but these taste like i remember taco bell's quesadillas tasting. i hope you enjoy it as much as i do.

1. combine sauce ingredients and stir until smooth
2. grill chicken in vegetable oil and cut into thin slices
3. preheat skillet over medium heat
4. one at a time , lay tortilla into hot skillet and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup of each shredded cheese and 1 / 2 cheese slice on one side of the tortilla
5. arrange about 1 / 4 cup chicken slices over tortilla on the same half covered with cheese
6. on the empty side , spread about one tablespoon of sauce
7. fold over , and press gently with spatula
8. cook until cheese is melted and slice each into 4 pieces
target.review:
This is WONDERFUL stuff!  I followed the recipe completely as is and it could not be any better!  I had made it a couple months ago, and somehow I must have been distracted, and I misread the 3/4 t sugar for 3/4 CUP and without thinking about it until it was too late I measured 3/4 cup and mixed it with the spices! Lets just say BLECK!  Poor Hubby was eating his and did not say a word until i took a bite and said "Gross!"  
The EXACT recipe turned out  much much better!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s most requested chocolate pie

this chocolate pie is not only a southern traditional dish, but my mom has to make 2 to take to church lunches. most people go back for dessert only to find all the pie gone - the smart ones get their piece on the first trip through. this is pie is also served as "birthday cake" on most everyone's special day. and the only way to top it off is with a piled-high meringue!

1. combine all ingredients except butter in a saucepan
2. cook over medium heat until thick like pudding , stirring constantly to prevent scorching and lumping
3. when mixture becomes thick , remove from heat and add butter
4. stir to combine
5. if lumping does occur , beat filling with a whip
6. pour into pie shell
7. make meringue according to your favorite recipe and top pie , sealing the edges with the meringue
8. bake to brown meringue
9. best if allowed to cool to lukewarm or room temperature
demonstrations.review: This recipe has never failed me!  For those of us who grew up on Moms Sunday dinners and down home cooking, this is THE chocolate pie  that was set on every one of those tables!  I hvae enjoyed so many of Amy's recipes the past couple of yrs, I'm sorry she is no longer with us to continue sharing her wonderful recipes and bright sense of humor that is so evident in most of her reviews and descriptions.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
taco bell mexican pizza copycat recipe by todd wilbur

a friend gave me this recipe and it was an immediate hit with our family and friends. adapted from www.topsecretrecipes.com

1. cook the ground beef over medium heat until brown , then drain
2. return meat to pan and add the salt , onions , paprika , chili powder and water
3. let mixture simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes , stirring often
4. heat oil in frying pan over medium-high heat
5. when oil is hot , fry each tortilla for about 30-45 seconds per side and drain on paper towels
6. be sure to pop any bubbles that form when frying so that the tortilla lays flat in the oil
7. tortillas should become golden brown
8. heat refried beans
9. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
10. stack each pizza by first spreading 1 / 3 c beans on one tortilla
11. next add 1 / 3 c meat , then another tortilla
12. top the second tortilla with 2 t of salsa
13. divide the tomato , cheese , onions and olives evenly and top in that order
14. bake for 8-12 minutes
demonstrations.review: I have made this several times now and it is devoured each time!  It is almost exactly like Taco Bells, but my family thinks it is better!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy seven layer rice casserole

since there is no precooking the ground beef for this casserole it comes together quite easy, just layer ingredients and bake in just one dish, i always season the ground beef with seasoned salt, black pepper, fresh garlic and a few tablespoons of parmesan cheese but that is only optional, you can even sprinkle cheddar cheese in the middle also when layering :)

1. set oven to 450 degrees f
2. butter a 2 qt casserole dish
3. layer each ingredient in order given starting with the uncooked rice on the bottom of casserole dish , ending up with the bacon on top
4. cover , bake for 1 hour
5. uncover and continue cooking for 20-25 minutes longer
6. top with shredded cheddar cheese the last 5 minutes of baking
demonstrations.review:
This was delicious! I made it last night and it got 5 stars all the way!  You know how some of the ground beef and rice recipes can be a bit lacking in flavor but you justy can't put your finger on what it needs? Well if you follow this recipe, plus add the garlic, seasoning salt, and parmesan you will not be lacking flavor of any sort! 
The only thing I did differently was I microwaved the bacon before adding it to the casserole.  Also, I only had 93% lean gr beaf, so i did have to use paper towels to absorb just a bit of grease, so next time I will be sure to use at least a 98% lean beef.
Thanks for another keeper Kittencal!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
why i joined zaar carrot cake

on october 2, 2001, i discovered the recipezaar web site. i immediately joined so i could post a request for a recipe i had lost. in less than an hour, i had a reply: this recipe. unfortunately, i never posted it into the database -- until now. my mistake. this cake was the reason i joined, and the friendly response i received was the reason i stayed!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. grease and flour a 9x13 inch pan
3. mix flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
4. make a well in the center and add sugar , oil , eggs and vanilla
5. mix with wooden spoon until smooth
6. stir in carrots , coconut , walnuts and pineapple
7. pour into 9x13 inch pan and bake for about 45 minutes
8. don't panic , the centre will sink a little
9. allow to cool
10. when cool , ice the cake
11. you can certainly use your favourite cream cheese frosting to ice this cake , but the one i've included is highly recommended
12. to make the frosting: cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
13. add the icing sugar and beat until creamy
demonstrations.review: OH Boy was this a huge hit at our Christmas Eve dinner!!!  It was the star of dinner!  There were nothing but "MMmmmmmm's" as everyone from  young to old took their first bites!  I was a bit worried to throw caution to the wind and take a dessert I had never made before, but  I'm glad I trusted the 180 reviewers because it is an absolutely delicious and impressive cake!!!  Be ready to be showered with compliments if you take this to a gathering!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zucchini heaven casserole

we like to call this summer in a dish at our house. it's not your usual zucchini casserole. it's a big hit at home and for potlucks. never any leftovers. this will be a summertime tradition at your house also. once you try it you're hooked!

1. rinse zucchini and squash , slice lengthwise and quarter
2. boil in salted water until just tender
3. drain and set aside
4. in large nonstick skillet , saut chopped onion , green pepper , and mushrooms in butter until tender
5. add diced tomatoes , flour and sugar
6. cook and stir about 3 minutes until slightly thickened
7. coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray
8. add zucchini and squash
9. top with vegetable mixture
10. top with cheese
11. top with enough bread crumbs to cover with a medium thickness
12. dot with butter
13. bake at 350f until bubbly and golden brown
demonstrations.review: This was great! I made some changes to suit our tastes by adding garlic, italian seasoning, and a jalepeno pepper, and did not use mushrooms, also only 1 TBS of sugar was used, and I let the cooked zucchini drain in the colander for at least 30 minutes, so it wouldn't be watery. Everybody loved it.  Thank you for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
creamy white frosting

a good friend passed this recipe to me back in the early 80's. i was so impressed with the flavor and texture that i had to have the recipe. it taste and looks like whipped cream. "give it a try and see if i lie." please follow the directions...and it is regular granulated sugar...not powdered...=) note: you need to cook the milk/flour mixture for at least 30+ minutes to get to the right consistency...once it cools it's like a paste... i made 1/2 recipe and it covered a 9 inch pan cake...

1. mix the first three ingredients together in a sauce pan
2. cook over medium heat until thick , stirring constantly
3. remove from heat and cool completely
4. cream sugar , shortening and vanilla
5. add cooled flour / milk mixture by the spoonful beating after each spoonful
6. frost cake
target.review: This is a great frosting with no egg whites.  It took about 10 minutes of beating on speed 4 of my mixer for it to fluff up nicely.  I used it on a lemon layer cake, and it was the perfect balance.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tuscan chickpea soup

i have tweaked this cooking light inspired vegetarian dish, just a little to boost flavor, added a few calories, but boy it really is worth it. i have adapted this recipe for the crockpot, but all you really need to do for stove top is cook the chickpeas completely before starting and simmer the soup for 30 minutes.

1. soak dried garbanzo beans in water to cover overnight
2. rinse and inspect the beans and set aside
3. in a skillet heat the olive oil over medium heat , add the garlic and onion and cook of 10 minutes stirring frequently
4. put the onion mixture , garbanzo beans , and next 5 ingredients in your crockpot
5. simmer in the crockpot for 2 to 4 hours
6. to make the soup thicker , blend 4 cups of the soup in a blender , 1 cup at a time then place all 4 cups back into the soup
7. stir in the balsamic vinegar and let the soup simmer another 15 minutes
8. place the soup in bowls and sprinkle with parmesan
demonstrations.review: This soup was good, but was a little too bitter after the vinegar was added, even though I love balsamic vinegar.  Next time I will add only half the amount and I bet it turns out perfect!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft  spicy  heavenly ginger cookies

i found the original recipe for these cookies on allrecipes.com, and modified it to be vegan, as well as by changing the spices slightly. they are truly delicious cookies, and very easy to make.

1. in a large bowl , cream together the margarine and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy
2. stir in the molasses
3. mix the water and baking soda and stir
4. sift together the flour , salt , and dry spices
5. add gradually to the sugar-margarine mixture
6. gradually stir the sifted ingredients , along with the ginger and raisins , into the molasses mixture
7. shape dough into walnut sized balls , and roll them in the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar
8. place the cookies 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet , and flatten slightly
9. bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes
demonstrations.review: Great cookie!  Loved the soft texture and the crunchy edges.  Mine didn't crack like the picture, but that's OK, they are delicious anyway!  Left out the cloves as I am not a fan, but otherwise followed the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
orange honey vinaigrette

my adaptation of a light salad dressing from the cookbook, "the new american diet."  i particularly enjoy this on a salad with baby spinach, wild rice or both.

1. combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. blend with a wire whisk
3. can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week
demonstrations.review: Fantastic light dressing! I used honey-mustard since I had no dijon and I added a teaspoon of ground flax to thicken it a little.  Great over green salad with dried cranberries and walnuts. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sesame coconut cookies

i don't know where these came from but they are good.

1. spread the coconut and sesame seeds on a pan and toast in a 300 degree fahrenheit oven for 20 minutes or until brown
2. sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together
3. beat oil and brown sugar
4. add egg and vanilla
5. add oil mixture to flour mixture
6. add toasted coconut and sesame seeds
7. shape dough into a log
8. wrap and put in refrigerator overnight
9. next day , cut roll into rounds
10. bake in a 350 degree fahrenheit oven until brown , 10 to 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: Tis cookie was very interesting. I only had 1/2 cup of sesame seeds so that is what I used, but I thought it was plenty.  Very strong sesame flavor. It was a crunchy cookie when it cooled.  OK, but not my favorite. Maybe I will try again with chopped almonds...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swiss carrot cake

i found this on another site and really enjoyed it. apparently it's common in switzerland. it's lighter than the american style carrot cakes, a bit thinner and has a distinct lemon flavour. it also doesn't have any added fats and very little flour, if you're trying to avoid wheat. the original calls for icing the cake but i don't think it's necessary. it's sweet enough on its own.

1. grease and flour a 9 inch square cake pan
2. preheat oven to about 180 degrees celsius
3. beat the egg yolks into the sugar thoroughly
4. add lemon juice and the zest , the carrots , almonds , flour , raisins and baking powder
5. mix well
6. beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the cake mixture with a large spoon
7. pour the batter into the pan
8. bake until the cake tests clean and the top has a nice golden colour
9. in a fan oven this only took me about 20 minutes but the original recipe says to bake for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: I left out the zest and added a little cinnamon and nutmeg and it turned out great. Very moist and quite sticky. No frosting needed.

target.recipe_text:
egg salad sandwich   simple and delicious

egg salad that is tasty and satisfying. it is the most requested sandwich in our household.

1. place boiled eggs into a small bowl , mash about half of them with a fork
2. stir in the green onions , miracle whip and dry mustard powder
3. sprinkle with salt and pepper to suit your tastes
4. makes 2 sandwiches
target.review: Made for the I Recommend Game.  I've never cared for egg salad, but my husband loves it.  I was out of Miracle Whip so I used Hellman's instead and also used a tad more mustard powder.  I was so surprised that I actually liked this too.  Finally a recipe that isn't bland and my hubby and I can both enjoy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
balsamic honey glazed chicken breasts

this is based on a recipe from diane kochilas' book, against the grain, a cookbook featuring good carb mediterranean recipes. my version differs in that i used a george foreman grill for cooking the chicken.

1. preheat an electric grill for high heat
2. when hot , brush the cooking surfaces with olive oil or use nonstick cooking spray
3. season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper , add to grill and cook until lightly browned , in two batches , if necessary
4. remove chicken from grill and set aside
5. in a large skillet , add the onions and garlic , and cook on low heat until wilted , about 6 to 7 minutes
6. add the tomato puree and broth and bring to a boil
7. transfer the chicken breasts to the skillet
8. cover and simmer for 30 minutes , or until the chicken is tender
9. remove the chicken breasts to a platter and tent with aluminum foil to keep warm
10. whisk together the vinegar and honey in a small bowl and pour into the pan , stirring
11. simmer for 5 to 10 minutes , until the sauce is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup
12. drizzle the sauce over the chicken and garnish with chopped parsley
demonstrations.review: Wow, this turned out yummy.  I used thin chicken cutlets, so I didn't cook for the full time in the sauce, just added them in for the last few minutes.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
twisted sisters creamy cucumber salad

when i arrived in iceland, this was my dh’s 1st food request & i went thru a lot of rz cucumber salad recipes to be sure it wasn’t a duplicate. siggi & my sister named this because it was original w/me & because of my twissis internet identity. for best results, don’t make this a dy ahead, but do allow at least 2 hrs for the flavors to blend & the “cream” to develop from the finished ingredient mix. i promise you’ll like this. (stated time does not include refrigeration time)

1. peel & slice cucumbers in 1 / 2 in thick slices
2. then half ea slice & transfer all slices to a lrg mixing bowl
3. roughly dice red onion & add to the bowl
4. quarter tomatoes , remove seeds , rough dice the tomato meat & add to the bowl
5. thinly slice 1 / 2 green pepper , cut slices in 1 in strips & add to the bowl
6. toss prepared veggies to achieve a good distributional mix
7. add last 6 ingredients to bowl , mix well & refrigerate at least 2 hrs
8. if thinly sliced , most cucumbers wilt & do not retain their crunch
9. -- when all ingredients have been combined , the mixture will appear dry & lack a creamy texture or appearance
10. do not panic that will begin to change almost immediately
11. if you reduce further , you will likely lose any salt component in the mix
demonstrations.review: I used a sweet onion and left out the green pepper.  The salad turned out super.  Can't wait to make it in the summer, bet it's very refreshing on a hot day!  Thanks for the great recipe.  Made for football pool Week 14.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
senora lopez s sangria

i got this recipe from my spanish teacher, who was from bogota, in the early 1970s.  because of the long chilling time, the fruit gets kind of funny-looking, but it's wonderful to eat when the sangria is gone!  i'm guessing at the number of servings.  prep time does not include chilling time.

1. combine wine , sugar , and fruit in a large punch bowl
2. cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours , or overnight
3. just before serving add peach brandy and sparkling water
demonstrations.review: Yummy, oh how I love Sangria!  I'll be making this alot once the weather warms up.  Made for your Football Pool conference win.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
feta cheese  apple  and spiced pecan salad

these pecans can be eaten alone as a snack or appetizer!  but they are delicious on the salad.

1. for the pecans: combine the butter , salt , cinnamon , ground red pepper , and a dash of hot sauce in a medium bowl
2. add the pecans , stirring to coat
3. spread in a single layer on an ungreased baking sheet
4. bake at 300 degrees for 15 minutes , stirring once
5. cool completely on baking sheet on a wire rack
6. for the salad: combine the lettuces , apple , cheese , and spiced pecans in a large bowl
7. toss gently , and set aside
8. for the dressing: combine the olive oil , vinegar , mustard , salt and pepper in a jar
9. cover tightly , and shake vigorously
10. pour dressing mixture over the lettuce mixture
11. toss gently
12. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This salad was so great.  Next time I'll top with some grilled chicken to make a nice lunch.  Thanks for posting.  Mad efor 1,2,3 hits.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
penne a la betsy  pioneer woman recipe

from pioneer woman, her little sister, betsy's recipe.  i loved this!  made with milk instead of cream and it was great. would be even better with the cream, of course ; )

1. cook pasta to desired doneness , set aside
2. cook shrimp in 1 tbs butter and some olive oil
3. remove to a plate
4. add more butter to pan , cook onion and garlic until tender
5. put cooked shrimp on cutting board , cut into small pieces
6. add wine to skillet , cook for 2 minutes
7. add tomato sauce and mix well
8. add cream and stir well , mix in cut up shrimp
9. add cooked pasta and fresh herbs
10. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Made this for dinner last night and it turned out great.  My hubby said it was his new favorite pasta and my 2 year old gobbled it up.

target.recipe_text:
homemade hamburger buns  bread machine

you will never want to buy hamburger buns again after trying this recipe. easy to do using a bread machine and so awesome! you can also top rolls with sesame seeds after brushing with melted butter.

1. place all ingredients , except butter , in pan of bread machine according to manufacturer's directions
2. select dough setting
3. when cycle is complete , turn out onto floured surface
4. cut dough in half and roll each half out to a 1" thick circle
5. cut each half into six 3 1 / 2" rounds with inverted glass as a cutter
6. place on greased baking sheet far apart and brush with melted butter
7. cover and let rise until doubled , about one hour
8. bake at 350 for 9 minutes
9. some reviewers baked these anywhere from 12 to 30 minutes
target.review: I LOVE this recipe!  I've used it to make both hamburger and hotdog buns & they are a hit every time!!!!  My friends think I'm super mom because I make homemade buns!  If only they knew how easy it is!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the best cranberry chutney

i know there's a thousand cranberry chutney recipe's out there, but this one is truly the best!  best if made a day in advance to really let the flavors meld.  i never really measure the spices either, so i am guessing about 1/2 tsp. of each.  taste the cranberries after letting them set for awhile and re-season if necessary. prep time does not include refrigeration time. enjoy!  update: when i posted the original recipe i forgot about the sugar you need in the water for the cranberries.  thank you to chef sydney mike for pointing out my error!

1. bring a pot of water with the 1 / 2 cup of sugar to a boil and boil cranberries until they pop , usually just a few minutes
2. be careful not to over boil or they will be mushy
3. add all other ingredients except raisins and mix well
4. let set in fridge at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours
5. stir in raisins just before serving
demonstrations.review: This was great!  I added about 2 tablespoons of sugar because the orange wasn't too sweet and the lemon was really strong, but my family loved it!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vegan vegetarian salad

this salad is not only for the vegetarian, but works well for healthy conscious individuals, dieters, and fast food eaters.

1. mix romaine , bean sprouts , and vegetables in large bowl
2. right before serving , mix yogurt , lemon juice , salt & pepper and jalapeo
3. pour over salad
4. can top with tofu , nuts , or whatever you wish
demonstrations.review: The topping wasn't my favorite, but I love the use of the oranges and sprouts!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pine nut and leek stuffing

a mediterranean recipe that is great for holidays

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. place bread cubes on a baking sheet , and toast 5 to 7 minutes or until barely golden
3. melt butter in a large skillet
4. add leeks and celery , and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until softened
5. add pine nuts , and cook a few minutes more
6. transfer to a large bowl and add bread cubes , herbs , salt , pepper , and chicken broth
7. toss well and adjust seasoning
8. reduce oven to 325f
9. transfer stuffing to baking dish , and bake 20 minutes until heated through and lightly browned on top
demonstrations.review: This was great!! I would suggest doubling the recipe for large groups, but otherwise, outstanding!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the most incredible chicken spaghetti

from a local community cookbook; family favorite,

1. in a large dutch oven , fill 1 / 2 full with water
2. add salt and pepper if desired
3. add chicken breast halves
4. bring to a boil
5. cover and reduce heat
6. simmer 1 hour or until chicken breasts are done
7. remove chicken breasts , reserving broth , and allow chicken to cool
8. chop chicken meat into bite-size pieces and set aside
9. return chicken broth to a boil
10. add spaghetti noodles and cook until desired doneness
11. drain and set aside
12. saute onion and green pepper in butter until tender
13. combine onion mixture , cream of chicken soup , mushrooms , and cheeses
14. mix well
15. add spaghetti and chopped chicken
16. mix well
17. pour into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish
18. bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was great!  I also sauted celery with the onion and bell pepper and doubled the spaghetti and added a can of cream of mushroom soup and a can of rotel for some spice.  It was great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut squash saute

the hardest thing about this recipe is peeling the squash.  i've tried different ways to peel it but i keep going back to my trusty sharp paring knife.

1. cook bacon in a 12 inch skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until it is crisp
2. stir in onion and cook about 2 minutes until it is crisp-tender
3. stir in squash , thyme and pepper
4. cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until squash is tender
5. stir in spinach until just wilted
demonstrations.review: My family ate this whole dish Christmas day!!! I used a potato peeler to peel the squash and it worked fine. :-)

target.recipe_text:
bread machine cinnamon buns

bread machine cinnamon buns.

1. put yeast in bread machine first on bottom , then flour , sugar and salt
2. then melt butter in microwave
3. add beaten egg , milk and water
4. pour onto dry ingredients in bread machine on the dough setting
5. when dough is done , put it onto a lightly floured surface
6. knead in enough flour to make it easy to handle
7. if it is too elastic , cover and leave 10 minutes
8. use floured rolling pin to roll out dough on floured surface
9. roll out into rectangular shape to approx 1 / 4-inch thick
10. use filling and spread over entire surface of dough with spoon
11. roll up dough
12. cut into circle with a sharp knife about 1-inch thick
13. place these in a greased 9x13-inch pan
14. cover with a tea towel and leave in a warm place for approx 30 minutes , until double in size
15. bake in a 350 oven for about 25 minutes , light brown on top
16. when done , make glaze and swirl over buns
target.review:
I wish I could give this more than a 5 star rating. Its FANTASTIC!!! 
My first time making dough in my bread machine for cinnamon buns.:)
I doubled the glaze cause we love lots of glaze on cinnamon buns. I was surpised of the way the ingredients went into the machine but I fellowed the recipe as called for and it turned out wonderful. This is certainly going to be put into "My familys favorite Zaars recipe" book cause I will be making this from now on. 
Thanks for sharing this outstanding recipe :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oriental curried rice salad

i have taken this salad to many pot lucks and it is always well received. there is a nice mix of flavours in the dressing. i hope you enjoy it!

1. cook the rice according to package directions and cool
2. cook the peas and cool
3. chop celery and onion
4. mix the rice , peas , celery and onion
5. while the rice is cooking mix all the ingredients for the dressing
6. mix the dressing into the rice mixture
7. cool for several hours
demonstrations.review:
I really enjoyed this it reminds me of Recipe #102061, just doesn't have the chow mein noodles or the shrimp.
I did cut down the curry powder cause I didn't want to over powder the flavor.
Thanks for sharing the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peach down side up cake

in the winter this reminds me of a sunny summer day.  it could also be used for a coffee cake.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. stir together dry ingredients
3. melt 3 tablespoons margarine
4. pour into a 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish
5. sprinkle with brown sugar
6. pour peaches over brown sugar
7. cream together 1 / 3 cup margarine with white sugar until light and fluffy
8. blend in egg and vanilla
9. add combined dry ingredients alternately with milk , mixing well after each addition
10. spread batter over peaches
11. bake at 350f for 40 to 45 minutes or until wooden toothpick comes out clean
12. immediately invert onto serving plate
13. serve warm with vanilla ice cream
demonstrations.review: WoW! This is a awesome cake! Made to share with friends at the  lake and  BOY! was it a big hit.  DELICIOUS! We all think this ranks better than a upside down pineapple cake. It's quick and so easy to make. Thanks so much for sharing this amazing recipe :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
scalloped potato pie

this is a very tasty recipe and different. you could serve it with some sort of meat if you wish, but we never do, we are always totally satisfied just with this and a salad.

1. heat oven to 375f
2. peel potatoes
3. thinly slice them to make 4 cups
4. cover with water
5. melt butter , saute onions in this
6. stir in salt , pepper , dry mustard , and flour until blended
7. stir in half and half or milk and cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until thickened
8. stir and boil one minute
9. remove from heat
10. line a 9 inch pie tin with pastry
11. drain potatoes
12. pat dry
13. using 1 / 3 cup each , layer potatoes , cheese and sauce in crust
14. repeat layers twice
15. cover with top crust
16. flue edge and vent top
17. glaze with a little milk or beaten egg yolk if desired
18. cover edge with foil
19. bake 25 minutes
20. remove foil and bake 30 to 35 minutes longer
demonstrations.review:
Really good potatoe pie Marie! DH loved it. Made up very nice. I fellowed recipe as it called but changed the milk alittle.
I used 1c. half- half milk with 1/2c whipping milk. I like the richer flavor of whipping cream.  
Thanks for sharing your recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic pimento cheese

i remember reading about making pimento cheese with garlic in the newspaper years ago but i do not remember whose recipe this was. everybody loves this pimento cheese.

1. grate the cheese
2. add the pimentoes with juice and the garlic
3. add 1 cup mayonnaise plus whatever amount of mayonnaise you need to add to get the consistency that you want
4. refrigerate
demonstrations.review: This is a delicious pimento cheese. I did add some chopped onion and green bell pepper along with a little dill relish.  I let it chill in the ref. and than used it with recipe#388470. We had a delicious dinner!  Thanks for sharing the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
loaded red potato skins

these are great as an appetizer or cut the recipe in half to serve as a side dish for a dinner serving about 4-6 guests. serve with sour cream on the side. cooking time includes cooking of bacon.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. place potatoes on a large baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes or until tender
3. cool to touch
4. cut each potato in half , then cut a thin slice from the bottom of each potato
5. with a small spoon or a melon ball scooper , scoop out potato pulp , leaving about a 1 / 4 inch shell
6. set shells aside and reserve pulp
7. in a medium bowl , lightly mash the pulp
8. stir in remaining ingredients
9. spoon the filling into the shells
10. place back onto baking sheet and broil for 3 minutes or until golden and heated through
demonstrations.review:
Great appetizer! It was a huge hit today for Game day at our house. Easy to make too. I will be making these many more times. 
I did leave out the basi leaves but only because I got so busy that I forgot to add it. But they still were very delicious. Thanks so much for sharing the recipe.

target.recipe_text:
sweet and sour stir fry shrimp with broccoli and red bell pepper

you can use 1/2 cup water in place of 1/4 cup each broth and water. this recipe will feed 3-4 people but can easily be doubled. to save some time prepare all the veggies in advance. adjust all ingredients to taste. serve with cooked rice.

1. in a large wok heat oil over medium-high heat
2. add in the sliced carrots , onion , red bell pepper , garlic and dryed chili flakes
3. stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes
4. in a small bowl whisk together , water , broth , soy sauce , vinegar and brown sugar
5. add to the skillet
6. bring to a boil
7. add in uncooked shrimp and brocccoli florets , cook for about 2-3 minutes , or until the shrimp are pink in colour and the broccoli is just crisp-tender
8. in a small cup whisk together cornstarch
9. add to the simmering sauce and cook until thickened
10. serve topped sesame seeds then topped chopped green onions
target.review: Easy and really flavorful.  We enjoyed this recipe for dinner tonight.  The only modification we made was to use "No Chicken Broth", which is a chicken broth substitute for vegetarians.  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
green beans with lemon garlic seasoning

quick & easy recipe for green beans bathed in a lemon-pepper and garlic sauce.  very simple. from southern living's 40 years of our best recipes cookbook.

1. place first 3 ingredients in a dutch oven
2. cover and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes
3. drain
4. melt butter in a dutch oven
5. add garlic and lemon pepper , and saute mixture over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes
6. add green beans , and saute 5 minutes
7. sprinkle with chopped parsley
demonstrations.review: Loved, loved, loved this recipe!  Bean are my favorite veggie, and my standby method of cooking them is to boil until soft and then put butter and salt on them.  I will definitely start making them this way though, as it wasn't much more effort to press the garlic, chop a little parsley, throw in some lemon pepper, and salt to taste and the effect was outstanding.  I used pole beans and three cloves of garlic (we love garlic), and just filled up water in my stockpot to boil the beans until they tasted tender (didn't really time them).  Quick, easy, and delicious!  Served as a side to Recipe #399350 399350.  Made for ZWT6.  Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted broccoli with grated manchego

how can this be anything but fantastic?  everyday food, october 2006. this makes a wonderful side dish!

1. preheat oven to 450f
2. trim 1" from end of broccoli stalks
3. cut off florets , and separate into large pieces
4. use a vegetable peeler or pairing knife , peel the outer layer of stalks
5. thinly slice crosswise
6. divide broccoli , garlic , oil and red-pepper flakes between 2 large rimmed baking sheets
7. season with salt
8. roast until broccoli is crisp-tender and beginning to brown , 20-25 minutes , rotating sheets from top to bottom and tossing broccoli once halfway through
9. remove from oven
10. sprinkle broccoli with lemon juice
11. toss to coat
12. serve topped with manchego
demonstrations.review: We really enjoyed this roasted broccoli.  It was easy to prepare and we loved the combination of garlic, red pepper flakes, and manchego.  I would definitely make this again. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken in balsamic barbecue sauce

i found this recipe on-line while looking for south african recipes and it stated:  "adapted from south african gourmet food and wine by rosen & loon"

1. combine all ingredients except chicken
2. marinate chicken in half the sauce for 3 hours or overnight
3. put remaining marinade aside
4. remove chicken from marinade , place chicken in foil-lined pan and broil until nicely browned about 10- 20 minutes per side , or grill on the bbq
5. heat reserved marinade and pour over chicken
6. serve
demonstrations.review: Made this recipe tonight for dinner and loved it!  This is an easy to prepare, great tasting recipe that uses ingredients that I typically have on hand.  I followed all steps and ingredients as posted and marinated my chicken for about 6.5 hours.  We cooked the marinated chicken on the BBQ and then spooned lots of warmed sauce over the top of the cooked breasts.  It was delicious.  I served with grilled asparagus and a caprese salad.  I will definitely make this again.   Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
moroccan spiced lamb chops

from today's paper this looks like another great weeknight meal

1. in a small bowl combine spices
2. sprinkle on both sides of lamb chops , save the rest for another dish
3. heat oil in skillet , add lamb and cook 5-10 minutes per side for med rare to medium
demonstrations.review: We served this last night for dinner and enjoyed it.  It is an interesting rub.  We followed Uncle Bill's suggestion and added garlic cloves and fresh rosemary. Thanks for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted asparagus with feta

very simple to make and so flavorful- this is a real treat!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. heat olive oil , minced garlic , lemon zest , oregano , and red pepper flakes in a small pan over low heat until garlic becomes golden and oil becomes fragrant
3. remove from heat and allow to cool
4. bend asparagus gently until it breaks at a natural point and discard ends
5. toss asparagus pieces with infused olive oil and place in a single layer on a baking sheet
6. season asparagus with salt and pepper
7. sprinkle asparagus with crumbled feta cheese
8. roast at 400f for 12 minutes or until cooked to your liking
9. sprinkle with chopped parsley and squeeze the lemons over the asparagus , being careful to catch the seeds
10. serve hot
demonstrations.review: This dish was easy to prepare and had a nice mix of ingredients.  We felt the addition of the lemon juice and parsley at the end was a little overpowering and threw off the dish.  We would omit those if we were to make this again.

target.recipe_text:
thai style roast chicken

tender chicken roasted in thai flavours.

1. wash and dry chicken
2. combine all ingredients except chicken
3. pour mixture inside and over chicken
4. cover and allow to marinate in fridge for at least 1 hour
5. move to a wire rack baking tray
6. bake , uncovered , in preheated 180c oven for 1 1 / 2 hours or until cooked , brushing occasionally with pan juices
target.review: Very  juicy and flavorful fresh out of the oven, as were the leftovers.   I used low fat coconut milk, increased the chopped cilantro (stems and all) to 1/2 cup, decreased the fish sauce by half (to lower the sodium content), and increased the green curry paste to replace the heat and flavor from the small fresh chili I didn't have on hand.  Since my chicken was over 4 lbs., I roasted it 1.5 hours at 350* and 30 minutes at 375*.  Leftover meat was great in a salad with Thai flavors and in a soup (I cooked the chicken carcass  in chicken broth for an hour, removed the bones, skimmed off the fat, and added green curry paste, fresh minced cilantro stems, cut green beans, white corn kernals, slivered bamboo shoots, the last of the leftover chicken meat, and a cup of leftover cooked rice to the broth.  Brought it to a simmer, and it, too, was fabulous.   I can't wait for the weather to cooperate so I can roast  the chicken outdoors on my charcoal grill.  Thank you so much for sharing  this recipe, Jewelies! It's a real favorite.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chinese roasted chicken

when i first left home i shared a flat with a chinese girl and this is one of the ways she would cook chicken. the marinade is sticky and yummy and smells wonderful.

1. marinate chicken pieces in all the other ingredients for at least 2 hours , turning pieces now and again
2. arrange in a single layer in a roasting dish and cook in a moderate oven for 30 minutes , turn pieces and cook a further 25 minutes
3. serve hot or cold
demonstrations.review: This has become a favorite recipe :)  Using chicken legs only, I baked them on a rimmed, foil-lined, lightly-oiled baking sheet. And I'm glad I did because the chicken has a tendency to stick to the pan.  I really like the marinade flavors and the fact that leftover cold chicken remains flavorful.  Thank you, Andria!  Lynnie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pulehu tri tip steak

here's a recipe i got when i went to hawaii - tri-tip steak is one of the newer cuts of beef, and is pretty tender.

1. combine spices and rub into meat
2. let sit for 30 minutes
3. broil or grill the steaks , turning every 4 minutes
demonstrations.review: I made this using about 6 oz. of tri-tip and about 1 tsp. each salt, sugar and coursely ground black pepper, with a couple of good shakes of garlic powder. I grilled the steak on my Le Creuset grill pan, cooking for 4 mins. on each side.  Great flavor, and easy, too.  Thanks, Chris!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled salmon with chili lime sauce

we just love salmon and really enjoyed this recipe for it, which was adapted from quick & easy vietnamese. you can sub another meaty fish, if you wish, such as tuna or halibut.

1. to marinate the fish , combine the oil , ginger , garlic , shallots , fish sauce , soy sauce , and sugar in a medium bowl
2. stir until sugar is dissolved and everything is mixed well
3. place the salmon fillets in the bowl and turn to coat with the marinade
4. cover and set aside for 20 to 30 minutes , or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day
5. to prepare the sauce , combine all ingredients listed for the sauce in a small bowl
6. stir to dissolve the sugar and mix everything well
7. to cook the fish , build a hot charcoal fire or preheat a gas grill
8. place the fish carefully on the grill for about 5 minutes on each side , depending on the thickness of the fish and how well you like it done
9. transfer to a serving platter alongside the chili-lime sauce and serve hot or warm
demonstrations.review: I, too, reduced the fish sauce (am watching my sodium intake).  And due to inclement weather here in the Great Northwest, I cooked the marinated salmon on a shallow-rimmed, thick cedar plank meant for the kitchen oven (as opposed to the thin-type of cedar plank meant to burn/smoke over an outdoor fire or grill). It was wonderful!  I really enjoyed the unique flavor of this dish, and  a I can't wait to prepare salmon this way on my charcoal Webber grill for family and friends. Thank you for sharing this outstanding recipe, GaylaJ!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
decadent chocolate  cookie bars

these cookie bars are very easy to make and are like death by chocolate times 3!!! my mother-in-law gave me this recipe. warning: may be addictive!!!!! sassycook

1. crust:
2. combine flour , sugar , cocoa , and butter
3. use two knives or pastry blender
4. mixture will be crumbley
5. press firmly into a 13x9 pan
6. bake at 350 for 15 minutes
7. filling:
8. in saucepan combine both pkgs of semi-sweet choc chips , vanilla , milk , and nuts if using
9. stir until well melted
10. pour over prepared crust
11. topping:
12. sprinkle milk chocolate chips on top and press on to top of filling
13. bake for 20 minutes
14. cool at least 10 minutes(will be hard to wait after smelling this bake ! cut into bars and enjoy , i cut into very small bars , this is very rich , and ya might overdose yourself on chocolate ! enjoy , sassycook
demonstrations.review: I think these sweet confections would please the most ardent of  chocoholics :)    My food processor made quick work of the crust, and I used a double boiler to melt together the chocolate and condensed milk.  I stirred in the vanilla AFTER the chocolate was melted so its flavor wouldn't dissipate.  Alongside fresh strawberries, the bars made a pretty and tasty combination for dessert on Mother's Day.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy chipotle  honey  mustard  grilled chicken

this tender chicken is slightly sweet & spicy! you can kick it up by adding an extra chipotle pepper and you can leave the seeds in. cooking time depends on how thick the breast are.

1. in medium bowl , combine all ingredients except chicken and garnishes
2. reserve 1 / 3 cup mayonnaise mixture
3. grill or broil chicken , brushing frequently with remaining mayonnaise mixture , until chicken is thoroughly cooked , turning once
4. serve chicken with reserved mayonnaise mixture and garnish with diced red peppers and cilantro
demonstrations.review: Outstanding!  I doubled the sauce and marinated a 2 1/2 lb. bone-in turkey breast half in 3/4ths of the sauce for 8 hours.  I then grilled the turkey breast using the indirect method on a charcoal grill - no need for basting - and cooked it until it reached a temp. of 180F on an instant read thermometer.  The sauce/marinade made the turkey breast really moist and juicy, and it was very flavorful (maybe a little too spicy for children).  I never did serve the reserved sauce, but I think I'll use it as a spread on sandwiches I'll make of the leftover turkey.  Can't wait to make this recipe when entertaining.  Thank you, Rita L.!  Lynnie

target.recipe_text:
denny s style french toast

i do not remember where i got this recipe, but my husband says it tastes just as good as what he had at denny's. i am just amazed at all of the great reviews on this recipe!! my family loves it, so i thought i would share it here and i'm so glad i did because it seems you all love it just as much!!! thanks to all of you who have tried it!

1. mix together the eggs , milk , flour , sugar , vanilla , salt& cinnamon
2. heat a large skillet , or griddle
3. when the skillet is hot , add 1 tablespoon butter
4. if the butter smokes , your pan is too hot
5. turn down the heat
6. dip each slice of bread into the batter for 30 seconds on each side
7. let some of the batter drip off , then put in skillet
8. cook each slice 1 1 / 2-2 minutes per side until each side is golden brown
9. add more butter , if necessary , to cook all of the slices
10. to serve , put on plate , dust with powdered sugar
11. serve with butter & hot syrup
target.review: Very good

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s fluffiest scrambled eggs

once you make these eggs you will *never* go back to your old way again, this is the way the higher end restaurants prepare their eggs ----for six eggs you may increase the milk by 1 tablespoon, do not add in more than 1/4 teaspoon baking powder --- if you are not afraid of some extra calories for 4 eggs use 2 tablespoons whipping cream in place of low-fat milk :)

1. in a bowl whisk the eggs vigorously with milk , baking powder , salt and black pepper until very well combined
2. let stand at room temperature for 5-7 minutes
3. heat butter until sizzling over medium-high heat in a large skillet
4. whisk eggs again briefly then mix in the cheese
5. pour into the hot skillet , stirring constantly with a small heat-proof spatula until they have reached desired consistency
demonstrations.review: Fluffy and flavorful.  My family devours these eggs.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kinda like chick fil a sandwiches

i say kinda because chick-fil-a pressure cooks their chicken but this recipes calls for frying.  the taste is pretty good.  if you love chick-fil-a, you'll like this!!
7/8/08  per reviews, i have changed the amount of salt on the recipe.  the original recipe states 2 tbsp, but it does seem like alot, so i have changed it to 1 tbsp.  thanks for all the reviews!!

1. in a small bowl , beat egg and stir in milk
2. in a separate bowl , combine flour , powdered sugar , pepper and salt
3. dip each piece of chicken in milk mixture until moistened
4. roll chicken in flour mix until completely coated
5. fry in oil until chicken is golden brown
6. serve with grilled buttered buns and pickles
7. make 4 sandwiches
8. you can cut chicken into bite size pieces and make chicken nuggets
9. they are great too !
demonstrations.review: Tastes like the real thing!  I love these sandwiches.  Now if only I could get my hands on their lemonade recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
delicious fried chicken breast

better than fast food takeout, brining is the key to this tender juicy chicken, any leftovers can be stuffed in between a crusty bun topped with mayo, mustard and a leaf of lettuce, this also works well using bone-on chicken pieces but frying time will need to be adjusted ---  plan ahead the chicken needs to soak in the buttermilk for 8-24 hours (24 hours is even better). try to purchase large thick chicken breasts for this to make the slicing in half easier, use a sharp knife for slicing. i usually serve this with my recipe #149547 --- if you cannot find old bay seasoning, use 2 teaspoons of seasoning salt in place of regular salt --- you will *love* this fried chicken! :)

1. soak the chicken breasts in the buttermilk and salt for 8-24 hours
2. when ready to make the breasts , mix all coating ingredients together , and coat each chicken breast
3. place oil in a 10-inch heavy-bottomed skillet up to about 1 / 3 of the pan
4. heat to about 350f , then reduce heat a bit just before frying the breasts
5. cook / fry about 8 minutes per side
demonstrations.review: I love this chicken.  It's the best buttermilk chicken I have ever tasted.  I make it every week.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
doctored up vanilla pudding casserole

this pudding is so good, it has a very good texture and the taste is to die for.

1. line the bottom of a 13 by 9 by 2-inch dish with 1 bag of cookies and layer bananas on top
2. in a bowl , combine the milk and pudding mix and blend well using a hand held electric mixer
3. using another bowl , combine the cream cheese and condensed milk together and mix until smooth
4. fold the whipped topping into the cream cheese mixture
5. add the cream cheese mixture to the pudding mixture and stir until well blended
6. pour the mixture over the cookies and bananas and cover with the remaining cookies
7. refrigerate until ready to serve
demonstrations.review: I normally make my banana pudding with vanilla wafers but this looked really good so I tried the chessman cookies instead.  I don't eat bananas so I didn't try any but my DH and guests raved over this pudding.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amazing buttermilk garlic mashed potatoes

my aunt made these for me 11 years ago. except for the garlic. i added that because i add garlic to almost everything.
these are so different but so good.

1. add potatoes and garlic to a pot and cover with water
2. add salt and bring to a boil
3. reduce heat and simmer until fork tender
4. drain and add back to the pot
5. mash with the remaining ingredients
6. add the buttermilk gradually in case you need less
demonstrations.review: Didn't know what to expect because of the buttermilk but boy was I surprised.  These are great!!!

target.recipe_text:
chocolate chocolate chip cake

a luscious, luxurious, sinfully rich chocolate lover's dream from our local paper.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. grease a 12 cup bundt pan
3. in a large bowl , mix cake and pudding mixes , sour cream , oil , eggs and water
4. stir in chocolate chips and pour batter into prepared pan
5. bake for 50 to 55 minutes
6. serve plain , sprinkled with confectioner's sugar or drizzled with warm icing
target.review: My family loved this cake.  It was so easy and quick to put together.  I served it still warm so the chocolate chips were soft.  It is a very moist, rich and chocolate lovers dream cake.  I will definately make this one again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
weight watchers key lime pie

my mom made this dessert for thanksgiving the first year i was a weight watcher and it went better then the pecan or pumpking pies.
3 points per serving. sorry, this recipe isn't core.

1. in a large bowl , dissolve gelatin in boiling water
2. stir in yogurt with wire whisk
3. fold in whipped topping with wooden spoon
4. spread in crust
5. refrigerate for at least 2 hours
demonstrations.review: This is really good.  My entire family loved it even my kids.  Doesn't taste like typical low fat desserts.  I did not put it in the crust to save on calories though, instead just whipped it up in the bowl and we ate it like jello.  I  think you can just about make it with any flavor jello and complimentary yougert.  Think I will try strawberry next.  Thank you so much for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mint brownies

very minty, rich brownies. i created this recipe by combining several others, and adding a few other things. if the mixing directions look odd, it's because i mix this recipe with a rubber spatula, not a mixer, a wooden spoon ought to work well too. you could use a mixer if you wanted to though.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. mix together melted butter , sugar , cocoa , vanilla , and baking powder
3. add an egg , it helps to beat at it with the spatula and break it up some , before you actually stir it in
4. stir in 1 / 3 c flour
5. repeat egg and flour process until you have added it all
6. stir in chopped mints and chocolate chips
7. mix well
8. pour into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan and bake for 30 minutes
9. do not over-bake !
10. it's better to err on the side of slightly under-baked than over-baked with these
11. cut into 16 to 24 squares , depending on how big you like your brownies
12. for plain brownies , replace andes mints with 1 c pecans and increase chocolate chips to 1 c
demonstrations.review: These brownies are wonderful.  Someone brought a similiar pan to work before and I never got the recipe, but I think these are even better.  The only changes I made were since we really love the minty taste of them I also added 1/2 tsp. of peppermint extract to the batter and sprinkled some powdered sugar over them just to make a pretty serve.  Thanks for submitting this one!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spice mayonnaise cake

moist and spicy. requested by my mom. she had me leave the nutmeg out as she could not eat that, so i heaped the measures of the other spices.

1. mix in order listed
2. pour into greased and floured 9x13 cake pan
3. bake 25- 30 minutes at 350 degrees
demonstrations.review: This cake is fabulous.  I didn't have any eggs or butter and really was craving a simple flavorful easy cake.  This one did the trick.  The mayonnaise made it very moist and nice mixture of spices. It took me a whole 35 minutes from start to finish.  I topped it with a simple vanilla and powdered sugar frosting while it was still a little warm and it made a nice smooth glazy frosting instead of anything too thick.  Will definately make this cake again.  Thank you for posting.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
harissa  harisa  haresa  arabic semolina cake

i was looking for a varition of our families harissa recipe but was suprised that zarr did'nt have anything close to what we love to make every ramadan and special occasion. us palestinians love sweets. so here it is and enjoy!

1. mix the semolina , the sugar and the butter in a large bowl
2. use your hands to corporate the butter with the other ingredients until mixed well
3. mix the yogurt and the baking soda in a separate bowl
4. wait a few minutes until the yogurt doubles in size
5. when the yogurt has doubled pour the yogurt mix on top of the semolina mix
6. use your hands again to mix
7. after you combined the two mixes , press the mix down on a small jellyroll pan or a 9x13 pyrex baking dish
8. cut a diamond or square design in the cake witha butter knife
9. if using almond place one in each piece
10. bake at 400 degrees for 30min to 45 mins until its a bronze brown color
11. pour cold syrup on top while its hot so it can absorb all through
12. if using ground pistashios sprinkle a little on top of each square
13. for the syrup:
14. mix all the ingredients for the syrup and place in saucepan on high until it boils
15. if using citric acid use only the the
16. then reduce the heat to medium for 45 min to 1 hour until it coats a metal spoon
demonstrations.review: Thank you so much for this recipe.  I have made several harissa cakes before but this one is by far the best we have ever eaten.  My DH had an invitation and I made this for them and they ate the entire pan.  He said they were crazy about it.  Very nice with some tea.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot hamburger  n potato casserole

easy and inexpensive, but so yummy!

1. spray crock pot with non stick vegetable spray
2. layer potatoes , onions and hamburger until all is used , sprinkling each layer very lightly with salt and pepper
3. mix soup and milk together and pour over top
4. cook 3 to 4 hours on high
demonstrations.review: This was yummy.  I was getting low on  groceries and needed  something to whip up for dinner and came across this recipe that had ingredients I always have on hand.  I threw it in the crockpot and when I got home the house smelled wonderful as soon as  I opened the door.  My family loved it.  Inexpensive meal for the family, but doesn't taste like it.  Will definately make this again.  Thanks!!!

target.recipe_text:
salmon fillets w green sauce

this is a very simple yet elegant dinner when served with some steamed broccoli, small wedges of baked squash, a tossed salad and french bread.  the sauce keeps for a few days and is great on other seafood, or just eaten out of the bowl with a spoon.  don't let the anchovy paste scare you....i hate anchovies, but it gives the sauce a great flavor, you don't even know it's in there.  
i had this at a friends house when i was in oregon on business, and she used fresh salmon filets.  it was sooooooooo good, so i begged her for the recipe.

1. mix wine , olive oil , lemon juice , salt , pepper , thyme , marjoram and 2 tbsp parsley together and pour over salmon filets
2. marinate at least three hours , turning occasionally
3. bake salmon at 400 degrees for 15-20 minutes
4. while your salmon filets are marinating , make the sauce
5. place spinach , remaining parsley , watercress and green onions in a food processor and blend will
6. add lemon juice , mustard , basil and tabasco and blend again
7. add mayonnaise and blend
8. fold in capers
9. taste for seasoning and refrigerate until chilled
target.review: My DH and I really loved this sauce.  It was very delicious and refreshing.  I could not find watercress so I substituted arugula.  I am normally a great lover of capers so I did not drain them.  This is probably the reason why I thought the sauce was better (I tasted before adding the capers) without them.  This sauce would be great on almost any type of fish or even chicken.  Definitely a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
herb roasted salmon

nan

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. line baking sheet with foil , coat it with cooking spray and set the salmon , skin-side down , on the foil
3. sprinkle the salmon with spices and herbs
4. arrange the lemon slices down center of the fillet
5. cover the salmon loosely with a piece of foil and roast in the center of the oven for about 20 minutes , depending on the thickness of the fillet
demonstrations.review: Excellent recipe!  I skinned the Salmon (our personal preference) and rubbed all over with Olive Oil.  I used dried herbs along with a little Mrs. Dash.  I sprinkled the juice of one lemon on to the Salmon after adding the herbs and let it marinate for about an hour.  I did not add salt, but perhaps next time I will use just a little.  We try to limit our sodium intake.  This recipe was sooooo easy and the combination of flavors was outstanding!  Thanks, Dancer, for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken thighs diablo
