i really love this dish and hope you enjoy it too. the red and yellow sweet peppers, along with the bright green beans, combine for a very pretty presentation. credit goes to gene lee, who first submitted this recipe to family circle. i modified it a bit to my tastes.

1. mix ingredients for the sauce and set aside
2. cook pasta according to package directions
3. drain and keep warm
4. in a large skillet or wok , cook and stir green beans and sweet peppers in hot oil for five minutes
5. push veggies to the side if using a wok
6. otherwise pour them in with the pasta to free up the skillet
7. add a little oil to the skillet if needed , to continue
8. add the garlic , ginger , and black pepper
9. when oil is hot , add the shrimp and cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until they are opaque
10. add sauce to skillet
11. finally , add pasta , green beans and sweet peppers back into the skillet and heat through
12. to serve , top with sesame seeds and green onions
demonstrations.review: This was a very easy dish to prepare and it was tasty for our dinner. I used whole wheat spaghetti pasta and oyster sauce instead of plum sauce because we didn't have any. I also omitted the ginger since we didn't have any on hand, but the dish is still good without. The red chili paste gives a great kick and a must if you like your food a little spicy - I used 1 tsp. I only wish the bell peppers didn't lose their nice, bright color when cooking in the wok (we used yellow and orange bell peppers). I suppose you can cook the bell peppers less than the 5 minutes instructed. Thanks for the simple and delicious recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberry cream cheese bars

i was looking for something to do with a strawberry cake mix that i had hanging around.  i found these in a cookbook, quick fixes with cake mixes.  as the into says "if you like cheescake or pastries with cheese filling, you'll really like these..."

1. preheat oven to 325 degrees and spray a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with vegetable spray or non-stick cooking spray
2. in a large bowl , combine the cake mix , butter and 1 egg
3. mix well
4. press the mixture into bottom prepared pan
5. in a medium bowl , beat cream cheese with remaining eggs and sugar until mixture is smooth and well blended
6. pour the mixture over cake mix batter and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until light brown on top
7. cool , cut into bars and enjoy
demonstrations.review: Everyone really enjoyed these bars and it was easy to make. I followed the recipe, but used 1.5 cups of powdered sugar instead of 2. I also wanted to cover up the bare cream cheese layer since it doesn't look the most appealing, so I crushed graham crackers and mixed with some melted butter to sprinkle on top. It is a great addition to the recipe. If you spread less cream cheese on top, I think swirling the cream cheese into the cake would look really nice too and make it less rich. This dessert is addicting!

target.recipe_text:
linda a guadalajara   style burritos

linda'a guadalajara - style burritos

1. brown hamburger and onion
2. add beans , spices and chili sauce
3. mix together and heat on low flame while shredding cheese
4. place about 1 / 2 cup on flour tortilla
5. top with shredded cheese and roll up
6. place seam side down on plate in micro-wave
7. heat on "re-heat" for 1 minute until cheese melts
target.review: The cinnamon made it interesting.  I may use less next time, but it gives the dish a distinct flavor.  I also added shredded cheddar to the tops of the rolled burritos before reheating.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet  n  sour chicken

this is an excellent recipe from better homes and gardens.

1. in a crock pot combine carrots , green pepper and onion
2. sprinkle tapioca over vegetables
3. place frozen chicken pieces on top of vegetables
4. for sauce , in a small bowl combine undrained pineapple , brown sugar , red wine vinegar , soy sauce , bouillon granules , garlic powder , and ground ginger
5. pour sauce over chicken pieces
6. cover and cook on high heat setting for 5-6 hours
7. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: I love anything that I can make in the crockpot!  This was a very good.  I omitted the green pepper for personal taste.  The tapioca gave the sauce the right texture.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
minute rice s spanish rice with beef

nan

1. brown meat , breaking the pieces and stirring
2. add corn , water , tomatoes and seasonings
3. bring to a boil
4. stir in rice
5. cover and remove from heat
6. let stand 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: Wonderful comfort food!  Good on a cold night.  Very easy to make.  Don't omit anything, all of the flavors are necessary to make this great dish.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
coffee brined chicken breasts

try this for really moist chicken on the grill. prep time doesn't reflect brining time. this is from fine cooking.

1. combine the brine ingredients , except coffee in a saucepan , heat until sugar and salt dissolve pour into a large bowl , stir in coffee , refrigerate until cool
2. add chicken and use a small plate to keep it submerged 2-3 hours
3. heat grill to high
4. remove chicken from brine , blot with paper towels , and brush with oil or butter on both sides grill 4-8 minutes , moving halfway to create grill marks
5. turn over and grill 4-6 minutes more until done
demonstrations.review: I had a hard time getting the flavor from this since I used a charcoal grill.  The chicken was very moist and cooked very well.  The combination of the ingredients seemed weird (and smelled odd), but worked well together.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chinese chicken bake

i got this recipe off of a crisp rice cereal box and it is great! simple and easy!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. combine margarine and onion powder
3. gradually add cereal , stirring until all pieces are evenly coated
4. set aside
5. combine pineapple , chicken , soup , celery , green onion and soy sauce
6. stir in 1 cup reserved cereal mixture
7. pour into ungreased 2qt
8. baking dish
9. sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 cups cereal mixture
10. bake 30 minutes or until top is lightly browned
demonstrations.review: My husband ate the entire casserole save the small bowlful that I ate!  This was not really my thing, but he loved it.  That is reason enough for me to make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mary s chicken

this recipe was given to me by my girl friend mary, and is delicious....has a sweet and sour flavor. we ate this chicken with brown rice and a green veggie. the sauce is awesome over the rice!!!! yummy!!!!

1. in 9x13 glass baking dish , mix with a whisk: onion soup mix , cranberry sauce , and catalina dressing
2. place chicken in the mixture
3. then flip chicken , so that it is coated
4. bake at 325 degrees for 45-60 minutes
demonstrations.review: Nice dish.  I used Fat Free Catalina dressing.  Everything turned out well.

target.recipe_text:
cappuccino smoothies

nan

1. combine instant coffee and water in a small mixing bowl until coffee is dissolved
2. place coffee mixture and all other ingredients into a blender
3. process until smooth
target.review:
Yummy and so easy! I didn't have dry choc. milk mix so I used the squeeze bottle of Hershey's choc. syrup. And I used regular coffee instead of instant, just make sure they get mixed in very hot water I used one tbl spoon of coffee to 2 tbl spoons of boiling water. This went into two tall smoothies. 
I will try this many times with different flavor coffees. Much cheaper than Starbucks! ;)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pork and cider stew  a crock pot recipe

the pairing of sweet potatoes, carrots and apples go perfectly with the pork shoulder and make a nice counterpoint to the cider.  it's also really fast and easy to get together.

1. layer sweet potatoes , carrots , onion , pork , and apple in a 3 1 / 2-quart or larger slow-cooker
2. stir flour , salt , sage , thyme and pepper in a small bowl to combine
3. add apple cider
4. stir until smooth
5. pour over meat and vegetables
6. cover and cook on low 7-9 hours until pork and sweet potatoes are tender when pierced
demonstrations.review: This was very easy to throw together in the crock pot. I put it on low and left for 8 eight hours, It made the whole house smell wonderful !! The Stew was great and had a wonderful taste, but the sweet potatoes cooked to much as you can see in the picture they cooked almost completely down to nothing.I think 6 1/2 hours would have done the job.Or if your at home just add later.<br/>Out of 7 people in the house all but one loved it. And she does not like a sweet flavor with meat. This has a very sweet broth to it. Served with salad and warm crusty bread this was a fabulous dinner in my book. I also doubled the broth, just my preference to have more broth to dip bread into.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crunchy roasted pepitas  pumpkin seeds

pepitas, dark green hulled pumpkin seeds, can be found at natural foods stores and specialty stores.  the seeds “pop” when toasted.  serve them slightly warm for the best flavor.

1. position a rack in the center of the oven to 325f toss the seeds with the olive oil on a baking sheet large enough to hold them in a single layer
2. spread in an even layer and roast the seeds in the oven , stirring occasionally , until golden , 13 to 15 minutes
3. remove the pan from the oven and immediately toss the seeds with the coriander , salt , dill , pepper , and cayenne , if using
4. let cool for 10 minutes
5. transfer to a small serving dish or two and serve
6. if youre working ahead , refresh the pepitas for a minute or two in the oven before serving
7. makes 1 cup
8. fine cooking
demonstrations.review:
This was great, I cut out the dill and black pepper and added chili pepper. Wow so good!!! 
Thanks, these wont last long.I'm going to have to carve another pumpkin, Happy Halloween !

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian sausage pie  low fat low cholesterol

we found out my husband has very high cholesterol, and we have had to become creative. we took an origianl family recipe, and modified using regular mild italina sausage with turkey sausage, heavy cream with low fat milk, etc.

1. brown sausage , and ground to small pieces drain& rinse with hot water
2. set aside
3. preheat oven to 375 mix remaining ingredients in a med size bowl setting aside 1 / 4 c of cheese
4. pour mixture into pieshell , and bake for 35 minutes
5. add remaining cheese , and bake for another 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was so easy to make ! I used 1//2 lb  fresh turkey sausage with jalapenos and left out the hot sauce. As I didn't have cornstarch, I used  1 1/2tbl spoon of flour. And I added a top crust which added 15 min to the baking time. My husband, myself, and my neighbors loved it!! I will be making this again. Thanks so much for an easy versatile recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot savory bean and spinach soup

this recipe is from fitness magazine.

1. in a 3 1 / 2- or 4-quart slow cooker , combine vegetable broth , tomato puree , beans , rice , onion , basil , oregano , salt , pepper and garlic
2. cover
3. cook on low heat setting 5-7 hours or on high heat setting 2 1 / 2 to 3 1 / 2 hours
4. just before serving , stir in spinach or kale and sprinkle with asiago cheese
demonstrations.review:
I made this with the spinach, it was not a hit in my house. Very bland and just kind of blah.
I have enough left over for dinner again. We wont waste it, but I will not make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheesy chicken pot biscuit cups  low fat  low cal

a weight watchers recipe i obtained from a message board at www.dwlz.com. 

per serving of 2 each: 230 calories, 6 gm fat, 2 gm fiber. ww points per serving : 5

you could also add more veggies to make this more "pot pie-ish". this may change your point count, depending on what you add.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. separate biscuits and place each biscuit in a cup of an ungreased 12-hole muffin pan , pressing dough up sides to edge of cup
3. in a medium bowl , combine chicken , chicken soup , cheddar cheese , parsley flakes , and black pepper
4. mix well to combine
5. evenly spoon chicken mixture into prepared biscuit cups
6. bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
7. remove from oven
8. place muffin pan on a wire rack and let set for 2-3 minutes
9. serve at once
demonstrations.review:
My grandson and I had the best time making these little chicken pot pies. And he came up with adding a tater tot cut into threes on top of each pot pit. And we just added a few froz veggies too. Thankyou so much for this recipe idea!!!
And everyone really loved them!!

target.recipe_text:
oatmeal cranberry white chocolate chunk cookies

this was my son's first year in 4-h.  i talked him into making this cookie.  every kid brings chocolate chip cookies to the fair.  anyway, he received a blue ribbon and the judge committed to him that this was a unique cookie not your everyday chocolate chip.  recipe source was ocean spray

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. in a mixer , beat butter or margarine and sugar together until light and fluffy
3. add eggs mixing well
4. combine oats , flour , baking soda and salt in a separate bowl
5. add dry ingredients a little at a time to the butter mixture , mixing well after each addition
6. stir in by hand the cranberries then the white chocolate chips
7. drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. bake 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
9. cool on wire rack
target.review: Love these cookies! Not too sweet. Made them for my Christmas Baskets, and looked beautiful! Will be making again!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jalapeno and cheddar cornbread

flavorful with chiles, this would go great with ham & beans or grilled steak.

1. preheat the oven to 375f
2. lightly grease an oblong 9 x 11 baking pan or coat with cooking spray
3. in a large mixing bowl , combine cornmeal , salt , sugar , and baking soda
4. stir in cheese , corn , jalapeos , buttermilk and eggs , just enough to blend
5. stir in the melted butter
6. pour the batter into the pan and bake for 30-35 minutes , or until the cornbread is golden and an inserted toothpick comes out clean
7. remove from oven and let cool in pan 15 minutes then cool on wire rack
demonstrations.review: This was a decent recipe.  The type of jalapeno's we used were extremely hot!  A little crumbly too.  Overall, it was okay.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fannie farmer s classic baked macaroni   cheese

to me fannie farmer's recipe is the only "real" macaroni & cheese. it's from my 1946 edition of "fannie farmer's boston cooking school cookbook". with time on it's side - this recipe is hands down the best for traditional, homemade baked macaroni & cheese - comfort food.

please note: if you use cheap cheese you will end up with a bland and flavorless dish!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. cook and drain macaroni according to package directions
3. set aside
4. in a large saucepan melt butter
5. add flour mixed with salt and pepper , using a whisk to stir until well blended
6. pour milk and cream in gradually
7. stirring constantly
8. bring to boiling point and boil 2 minutes
9. reduce heat and cook 10 minutes
10. add shredded cheddar little by little and simmer an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese melts
11. turn off flame
12. add macaroni to the saucepan and toss to coat with the cheese sauce
13. transfer macaroni to a buttered baking dish
14. sprinkle with breadcrumbs
15. bake 20 minutes until the top is golden brown
16. (you can also freeze this recipe in zip-lock bags for later use - once you have mixed the macaroni along with the cheese sauce allow to cool to room temperature before adding to your freezer - i generally pull it out the night before and allow macaroni and cheese to reach room temperature
17. i then add the macaroni and cheese to a buttered baking dish , sprinkle with bread crumbs and then bake for 20 to 30 minutes , until golden brown on top and bubbling
demonstrations.review: Outstanding recipe! I used FF Evaporated Milk instead of the cream, and we used Wisconsin Smoked Cheddar. Tasted amazing! It was creamy and gooey! I will defiantely be making again and again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
french toast casserole

make certain to use 1 to 2 day-old bread for this, i strongly suggest not to double the amounts and bake in a larger baking dish, make two separate recipes and bake in two 8 x 8-inch casserole dishes, if you prefer a sweeter taste then increase the sugar amount.

1. set oven to 350 degrees f
2. generously grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan
3. sprinkle the bread cubes into the baking pan , then sprinkle the raisins over the bread
4. in a bowl whisk together the eggs with milk 2 tablespoons brown sugar , salt and vanilla
5. pour evenly over the bread cubes
6. sprinkle the butter cubes over the top
7. allow to stand for 15 minutes
8. in s small bowl combine the remaining 2 tablespoons brown sugar with 1-2 teaspoons cinnamon
9. sprinkle over the top
10. bake for 45-50 minutes or until golden
11. serve warm with maple syrup or pancake syrup
demonstrations.review: Very Good, and so easy! It went together in a flash.  We used soft Italian bread, cubed up.  I drizzled mine with syrup and loved it.   Great way to serve French Toast to a larger group of people in a flash!! Its a keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
weight watchers general tso s chicken

great ww recipe from a meeting. 8points plus per serving.

1. in a medium bowl , whisk together broth , cornstarch , sugar , soy sauce , vinegar and ginger
2. set aside
3. heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
4. add scallions , garlic and pepper and cook 2 minutes
5. add chicken and cook until browned all over , about 5 minutes
6. add reserved sauce and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through , about 3 minutes
7. serve chicken and sauce over rice
8. yields about 1 cup of chicken and sauce and 1 / 2 cup of rice per serving
demonstrations.review: Very good! More like a typical chinese brown sauce than General Tso's.  I made 1.5 recipes of the sauce and added two heads of broccoli and served it with brown rice instead.  Very tasty!! Great way to get a healthy, Chinese fix at home!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb oatmeal pancakes

very satisfying!!

1. place all ingredients in a blender
2. blend until smooth
3. spray a frypan with veggie spray
4. pour batter into frypan making two large cakes or 4 smaller cakes
5. cook until bubbles aprear around the edges and the edges look dry
6. flip and cook the other side
7. serve hot with margarine and lemon or syrup or jam or freeze and reheat in a toaster
demonstrations.review: They were decent.  I would add splenda next time.  This is my first time making oatmeal pancakes, and after a few adjustments, these are a very different and satisying meal. I spread the pancakes with light butter and sprinkled with a cinnamon and splenda mixture, yummy!

target.recipe_text:
chorizo potato frittata

delicious, lightly spicy frittata--great anytime!  rr archived recipe.  :) yummy!

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. heat a 12-inch , nonstick , oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat
3. add evoo and chorizo , and cook until the chorizo is crispy , about 3 minutes
4. add the sliced potatoes and onions , and continue to cook , stirring frequently for about 5 minutes
5. add the garlic and continue to cook for 1 minute
6. beat eggs together with half-and-half then whisk in the salt and pepper
7. pour the eggs over the filling and let the eggs set
8. using a spatula , raise eggs off the bottom of the skillet , allowing more of the liquid egg to settle
9. when the frittata has set , sprinkle with the cheese and transfer to the oven
10. cook for 10-12 minutes until top is deep golden brown
11. remove and let stand 5 minutes
12. garnish with parsley , if desired , then cut into wedges and serve
13. enjoy !
14. )
target.review: Made for ZWT3.  This was very good and somehow very filling!!  I am a salt lover so added more once on my plate.  Could be enhanced with ketchup as well! (Maybe that is just my Canadian way of thinking, not sure, but we are ketchup users in this household!)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
raspberry summer sensation dessert

my kids saw this in kraft's "what's cooking magazine" and decided to make it for dessert when we had their teachers over for lunch. this is a simple make-ahead dessert that appeals to the eye and the stomach! cook time is freezing time.

1. line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with foil , spoon sorbet into pan and put in the freezer for 10 minutes
2. pour milk into a large bowl and add dry pudding mix
3. whisk until well blended and fold in whipped topping
4. spread pudding mixture over sorbet in pan
5. freeze for at least 3 hours or overnight
6. wrap securely and label if freezing longer than 24 hours
7. unmold loaf pan onto a serving platter and top with fresh raspberries just before serving
8. it will be easier to cut if it rests for 15 minutes
9. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was great Pam!!  I made it with chocolate fudge pudding, rasp sherbert with a few strawberries on top (the only fruit I had on hand!)  SO delish...  I did find that the sherbert melted farely fast, maybe the gelato or sorbet would work better for me next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
walt s teriyaki marinade and dipping sauce

this is an old way of making a teriyaki sauce with honey instead of sugar, giving it a more pleasing sweetness.  it's great for marinading and dipping with any kind of meat dish.

1. blend ginger , soy sauce , honey , garlic , and onion in a bowl
2. add meat to marinade for at least one hour or refrigerate meat in marinade overnight
3. after marinating meat , drain the marinade and add it to a 1 / 2 cup of water
4. bring it to a boil for 3-5 minutes and use it for a meat dipping sauce during the meal
5. excellent for pork , beef or chicken
demonstrations.review: A new fave!  Thanks :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
guacamole with sour cream

my guacamole is very free-form, but here are the basics:  figure about 1/2 large avocado per person. i don't care whether i'm using haas or regular avocados - some people do. pick ones that give to mild pressure but are not mushy. if you can't find any that are ripe, get hard ones and keep them in a paper bag for a couple of days until they ripen.

1. cut the avocado in half , scoop out the flesh with a spoon
2. mash 3 / 4 of it well and chop the remaining 1 / 4 coarsely
3. mix it into the mashed portion
4. mix all remaining ingredients together
5. serve immediately , or cover with plastic wrap , pressing wrap firmly to surface of guacamole and refrigerate up to 4 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: This deserves 10 stars if it could!  My first time making guacamole and it was delish!  I had three med avocados so adjusted the ingredients accordingly, also did not have olives on hand.  Thank you SO much for posting :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
microwave potatoes

easy and quick!

1. melt the 2t butter in a 2 qt
2. glass baking dish in the microwave
3. scrub potatoes and cut into thin slices
4. place in baking dish and toss to coat with butter
5. cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 5 minutes
6. add onions and peppers , cover with wrap , and microwave for 3-4 more minutes on high
7. stir in parmesan cheese , recover , and microwave on high for 3 more minutes
8. uncover , sprinkle with paprika , and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: My family loved these!!  Thank you for a great recipe...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mint thins  ritz

these look really festive! there is also a variation for chocolate and peanut butter thins.

1. microwave chocolate in small microwaveable bowl as directed on package
2. stir until completely melted
3. blend in extract
4. dip crackers in melted chocolate , completely coating crackers with chocolate
5. carefully scrape off excess chocolate
6. place on waxed paper-covered baking sheets
7. sprinkle with crushed candy
8. refrigerate 30 minute or until chocolate is firm
9. chocolate-peanut butter cookies
10. omit peppermint extract and candy cane
11. spread each cracker with a thin layer of peanut butter before dipping into the melted chocolate
demonstrations.review:
These are absolutely great and so Christmasy :)
I was about to post this recipe but it is already done!  
I used a leftover Easter bunny, and it covered the whole box of crackers!  To melt I just chopped it up and stuck it in my little dipper crockpot.  Thanks for posting this recipe!

target.recipe_text:
blueberry breakfast sauce  quick and easy

this is a wonderful blueberry syrup recipe that is very simple to put together. my whole family loves it.

1. in a 2-qt
2. saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch
3. gradually stir in water
4. add blueberries
5. bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
6. boil for 1 minute , stirring occasionally
7. serve warm or cold over french toast , pancakes or waffles
target.review: Just as stated...quick, easy and very good.  Made baked french toast to serve this on. So glad I did.  Thanks,Chris.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven fried garlic chicken

i gave this recipe from the "365 ways to cook chicken" cookbook an a+! it's easy and you'll probably have most of the ingredients already on hand.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. in a shallow bowl , blend together bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , parsley , salt , and pepper
3. in a small saucepan , heat butter and garlic over very low heat until butter melts
4. remove from heat
5. brush chicken pieces with garlic butter , then roll in bread crumb mixture to coat
6. place chicken skin side up on a large foil-lined baking sheet
7. mix together any remaining crumb mixture and butter and sprinkle over chicken
8. place in oven and bake 1 hour
demonstrations.review:
I'm not crazy about chicken, but
this was absolutely deeelish!!!! 
A definite "keeper"

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s cowboy soup

this recipe is quick, easy and sooo good. my mom gave this recipe to me years ago and everyone who has eaten it has begged me for the recipe.

1. brown meat on med heat
2. drain grease
3. add all other ingredients and cook until potatoes are tender
4. serve with cornbread or crackers
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Very good soup! Followed recipe exactly as written. Will be making this again.  Thanks, txgammi.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
legal seafood style baked scallops

whenever we get back to the boston area, it's a priority to to have a meal at legal seafoods.  i recently "re-discovered" this recipe buried in old newspaper clippings. i had tried to recreate it in the past but now know i was missing the most important ingredient - buttermilk. i made it again after posting the recipe so i have edited the original description. it's even better than i remembered, you might want to try just a dash (or more) of cayenne pepper. it's delightful !

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. place scallops in a bowl , season with salt and pepper , add thyme and buttermilk and toss to coat
3. place scallops , with buttermilk , evenly in the bottom of an oven proof dish , sprinkle with cracker crumbs and top with melted butter
4. bake for 20 minutes , squeeze lemon over scallops and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: We've had these twice and can't rave enough about how good they are. Used dried thyme as that was all I had, but otherwise followe the recipe to the letter.  Delicious!!!  Thanks Lorac.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
martha washington balls

this candy is always made for christmas at our house. they taste a bit like almond joy candy bars. they are very yummy. i really don't have any idea how many this recipe makes, but i know it is a lot. these make great gifts placed in a holiday tin.

1. combine all ingredients except chocolate chips
2. refrigerate over night
3. shape coconut mixture into walnut-size balls
4. freeze until firm
5. melt chocolate chips in a double boiler
6. pierce balls with a tooth pick or wooden skewer , dip balls into chocolate
7. lay on wax paper
8. refrigerate until set
9. store in an airtight container
10. i don't care for the wax , so i don't add it
11. it's just a personal preference
demonstrations.review: Have made these many times over the last 20 years. Excellent candy and makes a lot!  I found that freezing the balls before dipping is helpful.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hominy  bacon and eggs scramble

quick breakfast dish, with that something extra. i sometimes omit the green pepper or for holidays use both red and green bell peppers.you may use more or less cheese as you prefer.

1. fry bacon in skillet
2. set bacon aside
3. reserve two tbs bacon drippings , turn heat down ,
4. drain hominy , add to skillet along with the green pepper
5. allow to cook until pepper is tender , about 5 minutes on med heat
6. beat eggs and pour over hominy mixture in skillet
7. stir until eggs are just set
8. crumble bacon and add to mixture
9. sprinkle cheese on top
demonstrations.review:
I started making this back in the 60's, sans the green pepper, and it's been a favorite ever since. Hominy is a staple in my pantry just for this recipe which I have often. It's a fast and very easy meal anytime...breakfast lunch or dinner. Sometimes I just use bacon bits and a little bacon fat (which I keep in my refrigerator). Butter is good too. So glad to see it posted.
Thanks Angelfan.

target.recipe_text:
refreshing mojito  by the pitcher mojitos

this is a refreshing cuban drink. it's hard to stop drinking these on a hot summers day. i made these for the fourth of july and we went on to 3 yes 3 pitchers! if you don't have a muddle stick try a mortar and pestle or the end of a wooden rolling pin. please use fresh lime if you cannot go ahead and try the already bottled lime juice but if you do think about that when you rate this recipe! i did both and there's nothing like fresh! same goes for the fresh mint if you need to you can use frozen but i don't recommend extract. and for the sugar real granular is what helps muddles the lime and extract the mint oils from the leaves.

1. place lime juice , mint and sugar into a pitcher
2. using a muddle stick mash to release mint oils , and dissolve sugar into juice
3. add rum and lots of ice topped with club soda
4. adding more club soda to glasses if a lighter drink is desired
5. garnish with fresh mint and lime slices
target.review: Wow! This was a huge hit at out party last night. What a great drink. The measurements were perfect for us, not too sweet, and very refreshing! I do recommend fresh lime juice, that's what we used and honestly, I can't imagine it any other way! Thanks Rita!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
eric s easy grilled chicken

i love my brother's grilled chicken and for years, he would never give up the recipe. i finally whined him to death so here it is. i don't think he wanted me to know how easy it is to make. marinates overnight.

1. in a bowl , add the italian dressing , teriyaki sauce and minced garlic
2. stir to combine
3. add the chicken breast halves
4. cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight
5. grill over hot coals for approximately 10 minutes on each side or until juices run clear
demonstrations.review: This was a really great recipe- Thank you. I'm always looking for a new twist on the "chicken on the grill" entree!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian pepper and sausage dinner

it seems like i make this with my eyes closed already. the family loves it as well as guests. you can make as much as you want and if you are lucky to have leftovers, it's better the second time around. enjoy!

1. in a large , skillet brown the sausage until it is cooked through
2. drain the fat and drain the sausage on paper towels
3. in the same pan heat your olive oil add and saut the peppers , and onions , until the onion is translucent , then add the garlic and saut gently but do not brown your garlic
4. this will make the dish bitter
5. the vegetables should be tender
6. stir in the tomatoes , spices , romano cheese and sausage
7. cover the pan and simmer all over a medium-low heat for 8-10 minute
8. if your mixture seems too thick you can add a little water or red wine
9. while the meat mixture is cooking , the pasta can be prepared as per directions
10. you do not want to overcook your pasta
11. you want a little firmness to your noodles
12. when you are ready to serve use a large platter
13. the noodles first , then spoon the meat mixture over
14. mix slightly
15. sprinkle with the parigiano-reggiano and place your fresh basil leaves atop
16. this goes well with a full bodied red wine , a green salad with italian oil and vinegar dressing , and most of all a good hard crusted peasant bread
demonstrations.review:
This was great,husband gave me a hard time for stopping at the store to grab peppers, but I insisted!I hate improvizing with the 1st time around.  He was sure quiet during dinner. When finished he said,
Great recipe! I'll be transfering this to a special recipe card!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chocolate bundt cake

if you like chocolate, this is the cake for you. this cake is sooooooo rich.. i have to resist making it every week because i'll eat it all. i don't remember where it came from because i've had it for years

1. mix well all ingredients except choc chips
2. when well blended , stir in choc chips
3. pour into well greased bundt pan
4. bake at 350 for 1 hour
5. cool in pan on wire rack for 30 minutes
6. turn out on serving platter
7. when cool sprinkle with powdered sugar
demonstrations.review: Not surprised to see this one here. This is in my recipe box, under "Too Much Chocolate, Chocolate cake". It is a great cake and has become a favorite. I like to dust it with powdered sugar and serve.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy  festive chocolate holiday pretzels

this came from family fun magazine, it's super easy, next to no mess. great activity to do with kids. excellent alternative to messing around with melting chocolate and dipping pretzels.

1. preheat oven to 170 degrees
2. open the bags of pretzels and remove all the unbroken pretzels
3. place them on waxed paper-lined cookie sheets in a single layer
4. unwrap hugs , place one on each pretzel , repeat for an entire cookie sheet
5. do only one type of candy per sheet , as the hugs melt much quicker than the kisses
6. repeat using the hershey kisses
7. place cookie sheet / s in the preheated oven , bake for 4 minutes for the sheet of pretzels and hugs , 5-6 minutes for the pretzels and kisses
8. immediately upon removing from the oven , place one m-n-m on top of each pretzel / chocolate
9. place cookie sheet in freezer for 8-10 minutes , to allow chocolate to re-set
demonstrations.review: Really goo and very easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
zesty oven baked fries

as good as fried and more healthy to boot!

1. heat oven to 450
2. spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. combine all dry ingredients and combine with potatoes , tossing to coat
4. drizzle with oil , tossing again to coat
5. arrange potatoes in a single layer on baking sheet and bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown
demonstrations.review: Great Fries, I've made them using this recipe about 4 times. They are really good. I don't buy frozen fries any more. It is a savings too since potatoes are versatile anyway. Enjoy!

target.recipe_text:
cheese and broccoli stuffed chicken breast

what can i say but mmm. i tried this one day instead of chicken kiev and it's been a fave ever since.

1. take each chicken breast and cut in half leaving a small amount attached in back as to allow for stuffing
2. fry each side just until the chicken is no longer pink
3. set aside cup of cheddar cheese
4. in a bowl mix the rest of the ingredients together stirring gently just to combine
5. take the cheese and broccoli mixture and stuff chicken quite full
6. fasten with toothpicks along edges or tie loosely with butchers twine
7. place in a baking pan and cover with remaining cheese
8. cook in a 350 oven for 20 to 25 minutes
target.review: This is a great recipe!  I didn't have quite enouch chedder cheese, so I just substituted with more mozzarella.  I also only had half breasts so instead of stuffing them  I just piled the chesse and broccoli mixture on top of the chicken breast. This will become a regular in my house!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon  n eggs crescent sandwich

this is a pillsbury bake off recipe. it is so good.

1. heat oven to 375 degrees
2. separate crescent dough into four large rectangles
3. place two rectangles in ungreased 8-or9-inch square pan
4. press over bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides to form crust , sealing perforations
5. place cheese slices over dough
6. sprinkle with bacon and onions
7. blend celery salt , milk and eggs
8. pour over bacon and onion
9. separate remaining crescent dough into triangles
10. arrange triangles over bacon-egg mixture
11. do not seal
12. bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and filling is set
demonstrations.review: It sounded really good, but just wasn't. My kids wouldn't eat it. I didn't add the onion (personal taste). Probably won't make again, sorry.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
new year fried rice

i got this recipe from a kikkoman booklet. i made it for the first time around 1993 and it was so good i never tried another fried rice recipe ever since.

1. cook bacon in wok until crisp
2. add green onions , red peppers and peas stir fry 1 minute
3. add egg and scramble
4. stir in rice and cook until heated , gently separating grains
5. add soy sauce
6. cook until heated through
7. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This is my new favorite fried rice recipe! I followed the directions exactly and add some shredded chicken for a complete meal. Thanks for sharing!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mean chinese chicken lo mein

i absolutely love this recipe! it is fairly inexpensive and it serves many people. it comes from the chinese village cookbook by rhonda yee.

1. par boil linguine noodles for about 3 minute
2. rinse with cold water and drain
3. marinate chicken for 15 minute in 1 t cornstarch 1 t light soy sauce and 1 t sherry
4. have a pot of hot water ready
5. heat wok
6. add 2 t vegetable oil and reheat
7. add garlic
8. brown and discard
9. add chicken with marinade
10. stir until 3 / 4 done
11. add sauce mixture and stir until thickens
12. add green onions and sesame oil
13. mix well and keep warm
14. drop noodles into hot water
15. stir for about 1 minute to heat
16. drain well and add to meat and sauce in the wok mixing well
demonstrations.review: Very Good! I also add veggies - carrots and snow peas. Also doubled the sauce. Thanks for the recipe!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best twice baked potatoes

family favorite - tried and true - the only recipe we use.

1. microwave the potatoes until done
2. allow to cool a bit
3. slice about a 1" strip of the skin off the top of each potato
4. carefully scoop out the pulp , placing in a large bowl , and leaving potato shells intact
5. mash the potato pulp along with the margarine
6. add milk , sour cream , cheese , salt and pepper
7. combining well
8. spoon the mixture back into the potato shells , piling high
9. top with the crumbled bacon or bacon bits
10. bake at 400 for 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: These are great! I made this for Valentine's day for my husband with Steaks(Melt in your mouth - recipe# 64805) and it was a wonderful meal! Thank you for the recipe ~ a definite keeper!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fettuccine al aglio

this is a very flavorful pasta dish that i happened to come across. and for those of you who don't know italian, 'al aglio' (al ah-lyoh) means 'with garlic'.

1. prepare pasta according to package directions , omitting salt
2. drain and return to pan
3. meanwhile , heat oil in a large skillet over medium- high heat until hot
4. add garlic and red pepper
5. cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes or until fragrant
6. stir in undrained tomatoes
7. bring to boil
8. reduce heat to medium and cook 5 to 7 minutes or until sauce is thickens slightly
9. toss cooked pasta with tomato mixture and basil in pasta pan
10. place in serving dish and sprinkle with cheese
demonstrations.review: This was good! The only change I made to the recipe was that I used dried basil instead of fresh, but it turned out great! I served with pork chops marinated in italian dressing. Thanks for sharing!

target.recipe_text:
lamu style mahi mahi

i received this recipe from my pastor's wife. it is too sophisticated for my kids, but if you like spicy food, i think you will enjoy this. i have only made it with mahimahi, but it should work with any firm white fish.

1. in a small bowl , mix garlic , lime juice , cumin , and pepper into a paste
2. spread mixture onto fish& let sit for 20 minutes
3. heat oil in a large skillet and saute fish over moderate heat for 8 minutes , turning it over halfway through the cooking time
4. drain onto paper towels
5. serve garnished with lime slices
target.review: Wow-- even my 6 and 3 year old girls gobbled this up. I made it according to the directions and served it over rice with mild fresh salsa and a corn, black bean, avocado salad with cilantro. Thanks Judy from Hawaii for this nice spring/summer meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
veronica s easy spanish rice

dh wanted spanish rice one night so i made the following recipe that i got from betty crocker. omg, it was just like eating my mom's. i forgot how good her spanish rice was!!! try it, you won't be disappointed!!! serve as a meal in its self or as a side dish.

1. in a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. add rice and onion and cook stirring occasionally , until rice is golden brown and onion is tender
3. stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until rice is tender
demonstrations.review: This was great! I made the rice tonight and put it in our rice and bean burritos with cheddar cheese-- so good and very easy!  I added some more chili powder to it. That was the only change I made. Thanks for the great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tavern on the green s chicken francais

from the tavern on the green restaurant, new york city

1. pound chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap to make uniform thickness for even cooking
2. dredge chicken breasts in flour , shaking off excess
3. heat clarified butter in saut skillet over medium-high heat
4. place chicken in pan and saut until cooked halfway through , about three minutes
5. reduce heat to medium
6. turn chicken over and add minced shallots and garlic
7. cook for one minute until you can smell the aroma of garlic , and then add wine to deglaze pan
8. season with salt and pepper
9. add mustard and stir into sauce
10. let sauce cook for two minutes to reduce , and then add heavy cream
11. let sauce cook for another two minutes to thicken sauce slightly
12. serve with chardonnay
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe-- very quick and delicious. My husband loved it! I substituted the heavy cream for half-and-half as above review did and it still tasted great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peacock vegetables

serve this colorful vegetable blend at your next dinner party, potluck, or luncheon.

1. place first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
2. combine parsley and next 5 ingredients in a jar
3. cover tightly and shake vigorously
4. pour over vegetables and toss well
5. spoon vegetables in an ungreased 13x9 in baking dish , and bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
6. serve warm , or at room temperature
demonstrations.review: I love how the vegatables stay a bit crunchy without being undercooked. Delicious and beautiful on the platter. Thanks for a great and healthy recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
green beans with cherry tomatoes

this makes for a pretty dish and is easy to assemble. if you don't have the fresh vegetables on hand, you can easily adapt with canned goods. i get requests for the recipe all the time.

1. cook beans in water , until tender
2. in a fry , melt butter and add garlic salt , sugar , basil , salt and pepper
3. swish cherry tomato halves around until barely soft and heated , but not squishy
4. add the drained beans and mix well
demonstrations.review: Thanks, Merlot, for this wonderful recipe. I always have trouble with side dishes but this one was so colorful and the spices and tomatos really jazzed it up!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken vino bianco   tastes just like olive garden

wanted to have a recipe that tasted just like olive garden's dish that i could use at home.

1. heat oil in skillet on med-high heat
2. lightly dredge chicken breats in flour , season with salt and pepper and brown sides in skillet and remove onto plate until later
3. stir in onions , garlic , and butter , cook until tender
4. then add mushrooms and cook until golden
5. stir in wine and bring to a simmer
6. return chicken to the pan , and cook over med-high heat until chicken is done
7. add tomatoes and cook until tender
8. serve over cooked fetticuine or liguine noodles
demonstrations.review: My husband and I really enjoyed this chicken dish. So easy and really tasty! The tomatos really added flavor. I served the chicken over egg noodles (yolk free)

target.recipe_text:
reeses squares   5 ingredients   no bake  reese s

these bars are extremely rich and not for people with a fear of chocolate and peanut butter (if those people actually exist)!!! very easy no bake 5 ingredient recipe!

1. combine graham crumbs , sugar and peanut butter and mix well
2. blend in melted butter until well combined
3. press mixture evenly into a 9 x 13 inch pan
4. melt chocolate chips in microwave or in double boiler
5. spread over peanut butter mixture
6. chill until just set and cut into bars (these are very hard to cut if the chocolate gets "rock hard"
target.review: These tasted very good, I only used half the amount of sugar though and they were still plenty sweet enough. I may lessen the amount of sugar even more the next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut squash leek soup

i got this recipe from cooking light. i made it according to the recipe directions, except it was the first time i cooked with leeks and i think i used a little of the dark green parts. the magazine picture showed it as orange, and mine came out a little oniony, and green, but it was still good. i'd love reviews to see what you think.

1. remove white papery skin from garlic head
2. wrap in foil and bake at 350 for 1 hour
3. cool 10 minutes
4. separate cloves and squeeze to extract garlic
5. discard skins
6. heat oil in a large saucepan over med-high heat
7. add leek & saut for 5 minutes or until tender
8. stir in garlic , squash , water , broth , salt & pepper
9. bring to a boil
10. reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until squash is tender
11. place half the mixture in blender
12. remove the center piece on blender lid to allow steam to escape
13. cover the opening with a towel and blend until smooth
14. repeat for remaining mixture
demonstrations.review: I omitted the water, but doubled the broth. I also used lovetoeat's suggestion of adding carrots. Since I didn't have any garlic I sauteed some onions in with the leek and the end result was delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana and kiwi muffins

these are moist and yummy, not too sweet - perfect for breakfast or a light snack. makes 12 muffins or 24 mini muffins.

1. combine the first 6 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. set aside
3. mix yogurt , milk , oil , egg , vanilla and mashed bananas together in a smaller bowl until well-combined
4. add wet mixture to the dry mixture , mix until just combined - lumps are ok
5. now stir in chopped kiwi gently
6. you may also add chopped nuts if you like
7. bake in a pre-heated oven at 375f or 180c for 25-30mins
8. cool in pan for 10mins , then remove and cool thoroughly on wire rack
demonstrations.review: The chopped kiwi reminded me of raspberries believe it or not. It was much better than I had expected. So if anyone is wondering how big to cube the kiwi my suggestion would be the size of a rasberry.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
stir fried shrimp in garlic sauce

this has a great garlic flavor and tastes delicious with or without the heaters!

1. in a small bowl , mix together chicken broth , vinegar , soy sauce , sesame oil , chile paste and sherry
2. set aside
3. in another small bowl or cup , stir together the tbsp of cornstarch with the 3 tbsp of water and set aside
4. heat the oil over medium-high heat in a wok
5. add ginger and garlic and sizzle briefly , then add vegetables and thai chilies
6. stir-fry vegetables for approximately 3 minutes , then add the shrimp
7. cook the shrimp 2 minutes or until it curls and turns opaque or pink
8. add the sauce mixture and cook 1 minute more
9. then stir in the thickener and stir-fry until mixture thickens , about 1 minute
10. serve with hot cooked rice
demonstrations.review: absolutely delicious!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my no roll pie crust

the only pie crust i will use anymore. its flaky and slightly sugary and oh so easy to do. note: due to some major discrepencies please use a good quality oil, preferably a vegetable and a good name brand like mazola, it may not seem like it will make a difference but in the end it will, also use new oil not something that has been sitting around for a while.

1. mix dry ingredients together with a fork in a pie pan
2. make a well in the center and add the oil and milk
3. mix with a fork til it makes a ball
4. flatten and press into the pan in pie crust shape and flute the edge
5. bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes until golden
6. one crust pie , excellent for cream pies and crumb topped baked pies
demonstrations.review: I found this to be way to salty (it has 4 times the amount of salt as other recipes), the process was different, but I liked how it went together. However all in all I don't think I will ever use this recipe again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asparagus fried rice

we often have fried rice in various guises, either as accompaniment or as a one-dish light meal. in this version, fresh asparagus gives nuttiness and crisp texture that cannot be achieved with the canned product.

tip: 1. it is essential for the cooked rice to be loose-grained. either pre-wash the rice in cold water to remove the free starch or allow cooked rice to cool to room temperature and then fluff with two-pronged fork. attempting the latter with unwashed warm rice will result in a sticky mush. cooking time does not include cooking the rice as this step can be done in advance.

2. a non-stick or seasoned carbon steel wok is most suitable for stir-frying rice.

variations: 1. replace the asparagus with chopped mushrooms, fresh peppers, bacon, ham, canned tuna or any other ingredient, or any combination. also add scrambled raw egg to the rice while constantly stirring in final stages of frying for added flavour.

2. replace red onion with white, green or spring, or shallots as and when available.

3. spiciness is varied by adding more or less crushed chillies and using fresh green or red chillies add to colour.

4. rice can be cooked in any stock of your choice, or add two teaspoonsful of any soup powder mix to the water in which the rice is cooked to achieve subtle variations in taste.

1. stir-fry onion , garlic and asparagus in oil or butter over high heat until asparagus is crisp-tender
2. add cooked rice and chillies and stir-fry until rice is heated through
3. season to taste
4. serve hot
demonstrations.review: pretty good, I added hot banana peppers instead of red chile and flavoured with soya sauce.

target.recipe_text:
oven french fries

a healthy way to make french fries - once you try these you'll never go back to the old "frying" method! enjoy!!

1. wash potatoes and cut them into semi-thin strips
2. place strips in a bowl and add cool water to cover the potatoes
3. wash out some of the"starch" and then drain the potatoes well
4. mix in the olive oil and sprinkle with salt
5. mix all of the potatoes well so that they all get coated evenly
6. spray a cookie sheet with pam and then place the potatoes on top
7. cook at 350f for approximately 20-25 minutes serve and enjoy !
target.review: Sooo good!! Thank you for a simple and quick recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beer batter for fish  shrimp   onion rings

great for a fish fry. mushrooms and other veggies go great too, as well as chicky tenders, and squares of marinated tofu. experiment and have fun! makes enough for 1 pound of seafood.

1. mix flour , salt , and baking powder in a bowl using a fork
2. beat beer , egg and oil together in a separate bowl
3. stir into flour mixture until well blended
4. batter should be pretty smooth and moderately thick
5. dip fish , shrimp , or onion slices in coating and deep-fry in hot oil that has been heated to 350 degrees , until it becomes golden
6. drain , and serve while hot and crispy
7. this recipe also works well with chicken tenders and vegetable pieces
8. whatever you like to coat with beer batter
demonstrations.review:
Great recipe! I used it for chicken strips and fried mushrooms! I can't wait to use it for onion rings!!

Thanks again!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bacon wrapped jalapeno poppers

these bacon-wrapped jalapeno poppers are unbelievably good! you'll love them!

1. cut stems off of peppers and cut them all in half longways
2. remove seeds from peppers
3. fill each pepper with cream cheese and sprinkle cheddar cheese on top
4. wrap 1 / 2 slice of bacon around each pepper half
5. place on baking sheets and place in 450 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until bacon is fully cooked
6. remove and serve when cooled
7. enjoy !
8. i always freeze them after they are made for about 20 minutes to a hour before putting them in the oven or on the grill
9. doing this will keep the cheese from melting out as much
demonstrations.review:
D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S! 
So glad that you can do these in the oven, rather than on a grill.

Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s chocolate frosting icing

a wonderful frosting i have used for years made in very little time with perfect results and 100% better than any canned, this frosting is so good you will find yourself eating a fair amount of it before even using it to frost with! --- choose the amount of cocoa powder you desire for either a light, medium or dark frosting, and make certain to sift the cocoa powder and the confectioners sugar before using for the recipe--- this frosting *freezes* very well so double the recipe and freeze one batch for next time --- *note* for an ultra creamy fluffy milk chocolate frosting add in 1 to 1-1/2 cups thawed cool whip topping at the end of mixing the frosting and beat on low speed until blended ------- also see my recipe#80118 ---- recipe#282040 --- recipe#90142

1. cream the butter in a small bowl
2. blend in the cocoa powder , vanilla , confectioners sugar , alternately with the cream
3. beat with an electric mixer , until the desired texture is achieved
demonstrations.review: Delicious, Easy, Quick! Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buttermilk biscuit bubble pizza

a change from regular pizza, you may adapt this recipe to your liking by changing the ingredients :)

1. set oven to 375 degrees f
2. grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. in a bowl combine the pasta sauce with the green pepper , onion , olives and mushrooms
4. cut each biscuit into four even pieces with kitchen shears
5. arrange half of the biscuit pieces in the greased baking dish
6. spread half of the sauce on top of the biscuits
7. top with the full amount of pepperoni
8. then sprinkle half of the mozza cheese on top of the pepperoni
9. repeat the layers
10. sprinkle with a little grated parmesan cheese on top of the mozza cheese
11. bake for about 20-25 minutes or until the sides are golden brown
demonstrations.review:
I was alone for dinner, finally! and thought I would treat myself.
Being a broke college student, I had 2 cans of flaky biscuits, some cheddar cheese, a tomato sauce can, 1/2 bag mozzarella cheese, a handful chopped jalapenos, 1/2 chopped garlic clove, some pepper and grated parmesan cheese.....and BAMMMMM!!!
YUMMY GREATNESS BUBBLICIOUS!!!!
Thank you so much for your recipe because I look forward to making larger portions and adding various vegetables/meats to entertain my families over the holiday!!!

It's like Santa Claus gave me a gift and it was your recipe!
Thanks Kittencal!
****(P.S.- I've been using your Chocolate Fudge Icing for 1 1/2 years with my homemade devils food cake, and if it weren't for your recipe AGAIN, people at work/family wouldn't be begging for more! Our work party was almost 3 weeks ago and people still begging me to bring the fudge iced devil food cakes!)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamsicle freeze

exactly like the orange julius in the mall, without the stomach curdling mixture of acidic orange juice and milk/ice cream.... i also included variations including different fruit, like peaches & cream, strawberries & cream, etc. i tried for years to figure out this recipe, beginning at around age 12! i finally got it one day at age 25 and now my 11 year old daughter whips them up for herself and friends after school or for breakfast.

1. add all ingredients into blender and blend on high until no ice chunks are left
2. makes about tall glasses
3. i don't recommend replacing the powdered creamer with milk , as the acid in the orange juice will curdle the milk !
4. powdered milk may be used in emergency !
5. strawberries& cream version: replace orange juice with strawberries
6. peaches& cream: replace orange juice with canned or fresh peaches
7. add vodka for a tasty , refreshing cocktail on a hot summer evening !
8. be creative !
9. there are so many ways to change this recipe to make the most delicious frozen drink that kids & adults will love !
demonstrations.review:
Thanks for sharing! Now I don't need to go to the Mall haha
I also did what BJK said about mixing 1/2 water 1/2 Sprite and it did just the trick!
Really good with vodka also! :)

target.recipe_text:
fresh mint and ginger lemonade

i love the gingery-zing, and the mint flavour that this delicious lemonade has. very refreshing. 40 minutes passive cooking time is actually steeping time.

1. combine chopped mint , ginger and honey in medium bowl
2. add boiling water and allow to steep for 30-40 minutes
3. strain into 4-cup glass measuring cup , pressing on solids to extract liquid
4. add lemon juice and enough cold water to measure 4 cups total
5. fill glasses with ice cubes
6. add lemonade
7. garnish with mint leaves and fresh lemon slices
target.review: Very good and refreshing.  Next time I will add a little more lemon juice.  Loved the mint/ginger combination. The honey gave it just the right amount of sweetness.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
jekyll island shrimp

named for the island off the coast of georgia, this dish can serve as a rich appetizer or an elegant main dish!  this comes from my "america cooks" cookbook!  i love it for it's simplicity and elegance!  hope you enjoy!  update:  i have prepared this dish using frozen, cooked shrimp and as suggested by the comments from a reviewer, the shrimp were a little tough.  since the cooking time is to melt the butter and for the topping to get crisp, i would suggest reducing the cook time or using uncooked shrimp.  i can say, even though the shrimp i used were a little tough, the taste was delicious!  hope this helps!  thanks!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. arrange the cooked shrimp in individual dishes or a shallow casserole dish
3. combine the remaining ingredients except the lemon wedges , mixing well
4. spread this mixture over the shrimp , completely covering the shrimp
5. place in preheated oven for approximately 20 minutes or until the the butter melts and the crumbs become crisp
6. garnish with the lemon cut into wedges or slices
demonstrations.review: This recipe sounds good except for one thing.  If you baked already cooked shrimp for 20 minutes they will be very tough.  I have found that in recipes such as this you can substitute raw shrimp and when they are baked for this long they will be perfectly cooked and not tough.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dirty shrimp in butter beer sauce

herby, spicy shrimp with a kick, in a buttery-beer "sauce". fast, easy and delicious, serve as an appetizer, or a dinner over rice or with lots of crusty french bread to soak up all the tasty, herbalicious sauce!

1. saute garlic and herbs in butter until garlic is slightly browned
2. add shrimp , stirring constantly , until shrimp are pink and done
3. pour in beer , simmer 1 minute more , and serve !
demonstrations.review: Very good.  Loved the spiceness of this dish.  Served over rice.  Next time I will thicken the sauce with a little bit of corn starch.  Will have it again soon.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tilapia  sole or flounder  with capers and almonds

a company-worthy fish dinner with lemon, capers and almonds. recipe is from the newspaper.

1. mix flour , salt and pepper
2. coat fish in flour mixture , shaking off the excess
3. in a large nonstick skillet , melt 1 1 / 2 tsp butter in 1 tsp of the oil
4. cook the filets in batches over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes per side or until golden crisp
5. turning once
6. transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
7. repeat for each batch adding additional oil and butter as needed
8. add remining 1 tbsp butter and the almonds to skillet
9. cook 2 minutes or until golden
10. add capers and lemon juice cooking 1 minute or until heated through
11. pour sauce over fish and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Had this for dinner tonight and will definitely make it again.  I did add some Old Bay Seasoning to the flour along with pepper.  In our household Old Bay and seafood goes together.  Great recipe! Thanks.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
asian pork tenderloin

light and tasty! you'll never guess that you're eating healthy!!

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. remove all visible fat from pork
3. place in a shallow baking pan
4. in a small bowl , whisk together remaining ingredients except sesame seeds and onions
5. brush honey mixture over pork
6. sprinkle with sesame seeds
7. bake uncovered for 45 minutes
8. to serve , slice thinly and garnish with green onions
demonstrations.review: Was very moist and tender but I thought it had very little flavor from the marinade.  The foil underneath the meat is an absolute must. Easy and quick to make.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sunday dinner corn pudding

i clipped this from an issue of mr. food's magazine. this is so easy, but the end result tastes like you really fussed!

1. preheat the oven to 350
2. lightly grease a 2-quart casserole
3. in a large bowl , mix together all the ingredients
4. pour the mixture into the greased casserole
5. bake the pudding for 1 hour and 10 minutes , until firm in the center and golden
demonstrations.review: Very easy to put together.  Wasn't quite what I was expecting for corn pudding.  Taste was fine.

target.recipe_text:
honey  chicken

i just love chicken...this is an easy, fast, tasty dish to prepare with few ingredients. it makes lovely moist, tender and crispy chicken breasts. this lovely simple dish is very versatile, if you'd like to add garlic, shallots, sweet onion, red pepper flakes, candied ginger or herbs by all means do so.  my dh & i eat a lot of spicy dishes so every now and then we enjoy a simpler, subtler fare.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish combine the butter , honey and mustard
3. put baking pan in oven to melt butter , making sure to blend everything together well
4. next roll chicken in butter mixture
5. place in baking dish with skin side down
6. bake for 45 minutes in preheated 375 degree fahrenheit oven
7. baste every 15 minutes with sauce
8. after 45 minutes turn chicken and bake 30 minutes more until crispy
9. serve with garlic mashed potatoes and green beans
target.review: Didn't care much for this chicken. I tried to eat my whole piece but could not do it. Husband said they were ok but i think he was trying to cheer me up, he will eat anything to make me feel better. It is really missing something... But nonetheless three stars for how easy it was to cook, and looks very pretty when plated. Sauce was just average to me. Maybe garlic would help this out? I will try it another night and experiment with it. Either way, Thanks for your recipe and i will adjust this to my liking.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy lemon parfait

this is a lovely summer dessert from fine cooking.

1. combine cream cheese sugar and salt in a bowl
2. beat with an electric mixer until smooth
3. add heavy cream and beat on low speed , scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed
4. increase the speed to medium and beat until soft peaks form
5. add lemon juice and zest and stir to blend
6. in 4 wine glasses or parfait bowls layer bottoms with berries , top with cream , layer with more berries
7. top each glass with a dollop of cream and garnish with mint
demonstrations.review:
Fabulous parfait. Used strawberries and crushed shortbread cookies to garnish, and they were very pretty and tasted wonderful. Didn't take long to whip up, and everyone loved them. Thank you! ;)

Next time i will double and make mixed berry parfaits. I think they would be lovely!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
vanilla   jam swirls

a delicious buttery cookie that tastes lovely and looks great, layed out on a plate to have with a cuppa or fill a nice glass container full of these little cookies and give as a gift to someone special. i hope you like them as much as i do.
this is a recipe ive had for ages in a hand written little recipe book..you know the kind!

1. preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. place butter , sugar and vanilla in a bowl and beat till light and fluffy
3. add egg and beat well
4. add plain flour , rice flour and baking powder and mix to a dough
5. turn out dough and knead gently
6. roll out to 40 x 25cm , spread jam over dough leaving a 4cm edge to enclose the jam , roll up
7. place in fridge for 30 minutes then slice into 1cm cookies
8. bake at 180degrees celsius for 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: I liked these although they seemed like a lot of work. It wasn't hard to make, but I had problems with the jam coming out when I tried to roll it. It was a little messy, and they oozed a little when I sliced them. But after they baked, they were beautiful and I was very pleased. I used Blackberry Jam, and I cant argue about how good these taste! I put a lot of them in my hubby's lunchbox. Very pretty cookie, and the dough was wonderful. Thanks! ;)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
funfetti cookies

this recipe is a favorite from the pillsbury bake-off. it is a simple cookie recipe that always pleases my family. it is also much more economical than buying those sprinkle cookies from the grocery store.

1. heat oven to 375
2. in large bowl , combine cake mix , oil and eggs
3. stir by hand until thoroughly moistened
4. stir in decorator sprinkles from the cake mix
5. shape dough into 1-inch balls
6. place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
7. flatten to 1 / 4 inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in flour
8. bake at 375 for 6 to 8 minutes or until edges are light golden brown
9. cool 1 minute
10. remove from cookie sheets
11. spread frosting over slightly warm cookies
12. immediately sprinkle each with decorator sprinkles from frosting
13. store in tightly covered container
demonstrations.review: I love how easy these are! The are fantastic. I like using the French Vanilla Mix, and I have my own collection of sprinkles and fancy decorating supplies, so I never buy the frosting with sprinkles. I have also made these with the Cherry Chip Mix, and they were great for valentines's day. I love how soft they bake up and easy to decorate. Nice recipe!  ;)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
egg salad blt

two of my favorite sandwiches made into one! what could be better than that!  this can be made lighter by removing a bit of the egg yolk.  
delicious sandwich!  found on cooking light.com

1. combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl , stirring well
2. coarsely chop eggs
3. add eggs to mayonnaise mixture
4. stir gently to combine
5. arrange 4 bread slices on a cutting board or work surface
6. top each bread slice with 1 / 2 cup egg mixture , 2 bacon pieces , 2 tomato slices , 1 lettuce leaf , and 1 bread slice
7. serve sandwich immediately
8. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Great sandwich to have for lunch! I make these all the time but I always use use my own egg salad recipe. (So no star rating) I like these with texas toast bread, and I grill them. I have always liked the bacon with this combo. Sometimes I like to omit the lettuce though, when I am just not feeling it. I was happy to see this recipe on here today, and I always thought it was a strange sandwich, but I just love the flavor. :) Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh blueberry cobbler

easy and too good for words.

1. add flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar , salt , and baking powder to a mixing bowl
2. stir to combine
3. add in milk and butter
4. stir to combine
5. spread batter into a greased 8-inch square baking pan
6. sprinkle blueberries evenly over batter
7. sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup sugar and drizzle with vanilla
8. bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes or until a pick comes out clean
9. can serve plain or with ice cream on top
demonstrations.review: Looked wonderful, and tasted great!

target.recipe_text:
roasted asparagus with balsamic brown butter sauce

i got this recipe from cooking light and it is our very favorite way to have asparagus. in the summer we grill the asparagus on the barbeque and then drizzle it with the sauce. i guessed at the serving size

1. arrange asparagus in a single layer on baking sheet
2. toss to coat with olive oil
3. sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. bake at 400 degrees for approximately 12 minutes or until tender
5. just before asparagus is done , melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat
6. cook for 3 minutes or until lightly browned , shaking pan occasionally
7. do not burn the butter or let it get too brown , should be golden brown
8. remove from heat
9. stir in soy sauce , and vinegar
10. drizzle over asparagus , tossing well to coat
11. serve immediately
target.review: Asparagus is on sale here so I loaded up on it.  I didn't want to grill it, like we normally do, so this recipe was perfect!  Very flavorful.  Will definately make this again.  Thx.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grace s guava cake

much better than good old momma's apple cake! this recipe happened when my cousin jess happened to be sleeping over and we decided to make ourselves a tasty midnite snack. you 

1. grease baking pan and preheat oven 180 c or 350 degrees f
2. cream butter , sugar , and almond essence
3. add eggs , one by one , followed by the guava pulp
4. add the flour / baking powder mixture , little by little
5. when it's all in , beat on high speed for approximately a minute
6. clean mixer
7. fold in shredded guava using a spatula
8. bake 45-55 minutes
9. decorate when cool
10. to make topping , combine powdered sugar , almond extract , guava juice , and lime juicetill smooth
11. glaze over cooled cake , then top with peanuts and coconut
demonstrations.review: Only two stars but probably only because I made it, its all my fault!  Mine came out like a big cookie! It never did rise and I went over the recipe and discovered I never added the cooking oil.  Could that have been the reason it didn't rise?  When was I suppose to add it? I also substituded Splenda brown sugar. And I used the convection mode on my oven. My guava tree is producing the smallest guavas ever and it was alot of labor to deseed those little things. I didn't frost it but my hubby is still eating it anyway.  It smelled great in the oven.  I really flubbed this one so I probably won't make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hats off graduation treat

sweeten up any graduation celebration with these clever grad caps.

1. invert a mini peanut butter cup , top it with a dollop of peanut butter , and cover it with a chocolate covered graham cracker
2. for the tassel , tightly roll up a portion of fruit leather , snip some fringe on one end , and use a little water to moisten the other end
3. attach the moistened end to the graham cracker
demonstrations.review: I made these for our graduation party for my two nephews and everyone thought they were very cleaver and tasted good to boot!  I used cut up black and red licorice roll ups that I found in the grocery store bulk candy bin for the tassels.  Unwrapping the peanut butter cups was the hardest part, very cute and easy to make.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
arizona hobo potatoes

easy dish to accompany steaks, burgers, chops, ribs, etc. on the grill.

1. grills vary widely , so you may need to experiment with the heat setting
2. for my propane grill , i use medium-high heat , or even high heat , high enough to sear / brown the meat dish when i throw them on the grill
3. )
4. wash potatoes and cut into slices 1 / 4 inch or so with skin intact
5. slice onion into thin slices , then separate into rings
6. on heavy duty aluminum foil , about 18" to 24" long , put in the center a layer of potatoes
7. follow with a layer of onion rings
8. sprinkle with salt , pepper , and a hint of garlic
9. repeat layers , dotting each second layer with butter
10. wrap the foil securely around the layers
11. should make a packet about 15"-18" long and 10" wide
12. put the foil package on the grill about 45 minutes to an hour before the intended serving time
13. its okay if the bottom layer caramelizes
14. some will love those bottom pieces !
demonstrations.review: What a wonderful aroma - the other campers all wanted to know what that wonderful smell was coming off our grill!  And they taste terrific too.  Have used both fresh and granulated garlic, both taste great.  Using real butter is a must.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
healthy cheesy broccoli casserole

this is a little healthier version.  i'm not sure who gave me the recipe, but it is quick and easy, and my nephew who is 5 will eat it.

1. stir the flour , milk , chicken broth , mustard , and onion flakes in a glass baking dish
2. microwave on high for 4-6 minutes , stirring well every 2 minutes until the cream sauce is thick and bubbly
3. while cooking the cream sauce , steam the broccoli for about 4 minutes
4. mix the cheese into the cream sauce
5. put the broccoli and diced chicken in a 9 x 13 pan
6. pour the cheese sauce over the top
7. mix the cornflakes and parmesan together , and pour over the top
8. broil until golden brown
demonstrations.review: Made this yesterday and it was wonderful! My husband ate two servings and wanted more.  I was looking for a recipe to use up left over grilled chicken and this worked great.  I halfed the recipe so it only took half the time in the micowave.  In addition to some broccoli, I added my leftover green beans and topped it with my leftover stuffed mushrooms, chopped up. I didn't have corn flakes, so I mixed the parm cheese with panko flakes and topped it all off.  Thank you so much cowbells27, this was quick and easy and I had (almost) everything on hand.  Will definately make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rich beef and barley soup

this is a rich soup almost stew. very filling. great crock pot meal served with a salad and some crusty bread.

1. brown beef in a skillet 1 / 2 at a time
2. drain well
3. mix everything in crock pot
4. cover and cook on low 9-10 hours or 4 1 / 2-5 hours on high
demonstrations.review: I have this same recipe and its wonderful.  The most flavorful B & B soup I've made so far.  For my last batch I made it with leftover prime rib roast cut up into small pieces with the fat removed.  I also sauted the vegetables that I diced and added a couple cloves of garlic just because we love garlic.  Next time I'll add mushrooms.  Thanks for posting here.

target.recipe_text:
special roasted veggies

i made this dish to go with lasagna one day,i needed something just a little bit different to add to the dinner in addition to the usual garlic bread and salad. i think they liked this better than the lasagna.

1. put potatoes and carrots in greased baking dish
2. drizzle with olive oil
3. add basil , oregano , salt , pepper , paprika and toss till coated
4. bake at 425 f degrees for about 20 minutes
5. add zucchini and garlic
6. stir up and return to oven for another 20 minutes or until veggies are tender
7. add the cheese and return to oven till melted and garnish with parsley if desired
target.review:
Made this last night to go with hot dogs as a healthier substitute for the usual french fries. It was delish! I'm not a huge fan of zucchini, but the potatoes and carrots with the spice mix were out of this world.

I added an onion, doubled the amount of garlic, and substituted parmesan cheese for the mozzarella.

Even DH, who is not a veggie lover, ate this up and requested it for a future meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panera s cream cheese potato soup

this is my favorite recipe for potato soup.  it's a copycat of the one they use to serve at the st. louis bread company (panera).  the recipe originally called for shredding your potatoes, but i never could get them to cook that way. i know they should cook faster, but i never could get it to work.

1. combine broth , potatoes , and spices
2. boil on medium heat until potatoes are tender
3. smash a few of the potatoes to release their starch for thickening
4. reduce to low heat
5. add cream cheese
6. heat , stirring frequently , until cheese melts
demonstrations.review:
YUM YUM YUM! I wish I could give this recipe more than 5 stars. It is so delicious.

I made a couple of minor adjustments: I didn't have seasoning salt or white pepper, so I just used regular kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper. I also reduced the cayenne pepper to just a dash. And I used homemade chicken stock instead of broth. I also sprinkled some shredded cheddar cheese on top of each serving.

This will be a keeper in my house! The cream cheese ends up tasting a little like sour cream (a popular potato topper), so even my husband, who hates cream cheese but loves sour cream, gobbled it up and went back for seconds and thirds. Thank you for this fantastic recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ww 0 point weight watchers cabbage soup

you can eat as much of this 0-point weight watchers cabbage soup as you like. it's so good for you.

1. spray pot with non stick cooking spray saute onions carrots and garlic for 5 minutes
2. add broth , tomato paste , cabbage , green beans , basil , oregano and salt & pepper to taste
3. simmer for a about 5-10 minutes until all vegetables are tender then add the zucchini and simmer for another 5 or so minutes
4. i have tried different variations
5. leaving out green beans
6. adding chopped green onions in addition to the yellow onion
7. all very good
8. you can customize it a bit
demonstrations.review: Man, was this good. I left out the zucchini (donâ€™t care for it) and used beef broth. I didnâ€™t feel like there was enough broth in the final product, so Iâ€™ll probably add another cup of broth or water next time. This doesnâ€™t stand on its own for a meal (I was hungry again an hour after eating two bowls of the soup), but itâ€™s great for taking the edge off your hunger so you eat less later on. The soup tastes even better the next day. Thanks for this great recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s alfredo sauce
