7. bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marinade for grilled vegetables

a tasty marinade for grilled vegetables. the recipe comes from bon appetit.

1. combine all ingredients and mix well
2. marinade cut vegetables for 3 to 4 hours and then grill or brush marinade onto vegetables as you grill
3. yield 1 cup marinade
demonstrations.review:
I made vegetable shish kobobs after marinating them in this...  All I can say is MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM!!!
I used green peppers, onions, red peppers, mushrooms and shrimp.. a must have!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy baked potato wedges

we love these potatoes, they are simple to make and taste great!

1. wash potatoes , cut into wedges
2. place potatoes skin down in a baking dish
3. mix the next 6 ingredients together and brush onto potatoes
4. bake at 350 for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Yummy, yum yum yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tomato and basil bruschetta

my first culinary 

1. whisk together chopped garlic , vinegar , salt , pepper , and basil
2. when combined slowly drizzle in oil
3. add tomatoes and let sit for 20 minutes at room temp
4. meanwhile back at the bat cave , toast the bread
5. this can be done either in the toaster or under the broiler
6. when the bread is toasted rub each piece , on one side , with the whole garlic pieces
7. place the bread on a cookie sheet and top with tomato mixture
8. sprinkle on a little cheese and broil till the cheese melts
9. serve immediately
10. the tomato mixture also makes a wonderful vinegrette for an an
11. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Definitely worth five stars.  Has restaurant quality taste.  Easy to make!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yes  virginia there is a great meatloaf

absolutely delicious meatloaf and sauce! those who claim they don't believe there can be such a thing as a great meatloaf will love this. based on a meatloaf given to me by a dear friend, virginia strehl, memphis, and leesburg, fla. nita holleman, 2000

1. meatloaf: combine meat loaf ingredients and place into a loaf baking dish
2. smooth out top
3. sauce: combine sauce ingredients and pour on top and sides of meatloaf
4. bake at 350f about 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes or until done
5. enjoy !
6. the addition of 1 or 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet makes this recipe very good
7. recipe should be"plump" from the addition of the milk or half & half
8. it should not be runny
9. a second batch of sauce served hot is good to serve with the meatloaf
10. nita's
11. it is wise to have some fat added to the deer -- especially to ground deer
12. maybe 25 % fat , , otherwise your results will be poor
13. i don't know about some of the other game meat some are using
14. please consult an expert
15. the recipe is delicious as it stands ! enjoy ! nita holleman
demonstrations.review:
This is the best meatloaf I have ever made... At first I was worried about the vinegar smell rising from the oven.. but the brown sugar leveled everything out...

Thank you sooo much for this recipe... I will be making this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
why i joined zaar carrot cake

on october 2, 2001, i discovered the recipezaar web site. i immediately joined so i could post a request for a recipe i had lost. in less than an hour, i had a reply: this recipe. unfortunately, i never posted it into the database -- until now. my mistake. this cake was the reason i joined, and the friendly response i received was the reason i stayed!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. grease and flour a 9x13 inch pan
3. mix flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
4. make a well in the center and add sugar , oil , eggs and vanilla
5. mix with wooden spoon until smooth
6. stir in carrots , coconut , walnuts and pineapple
7. pour into 9x13 inch pan and bake for about 45 minutes
8. don't panic , the centre will sink a little
9. allow to cool
10. when cool , ice the cake
11. you can certainly use your favourite cream cheese frosting to ice this cake , but the one i've included is highly recommended
12. to make the frosting: cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
13. add the icing sugar and beat until creamy
demonstrations.review: This was the best carrot cake that I have ever had!!!  Thanks so much for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
herbed pork tenderloin

this special pork is tender and juicy and seasoned just right.

1. mix the first 11 ingredients
2. rub over the pork
3. put on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
4. bake , uncovered , at 400 for 45 minutes
5. remove from oven , cover with foil and let set for 10 minutes
6. slice into servings
target.review: This recipe was outstanding.  We grilled it over charcoal, we wrapped the pork in tin foil and added a little red wine, thank you for sharing this recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
to die for crock pot roast

amazing flavor, and so simple! no salt needed here. in fact, you may wish to use half the ranch dressing mix to cut back on the saltiness. found this crock-pot pot roast recipe on of a website called www.recipegoldmine.com. it's all the rage there, so i thought i'd try it.

1. place beef roast in crock pot
2. mix the dried mixes together in a bowl and sprinkle over the roast
3. pour the water around the roast
4. cook on low for 7-9 hours
5. use onion soup mix instead of ranch
6. add one cup , of red wine
7. add potatoes , carrots , mushrooms , celery and onion 2-3 hours before end
demonstrations.review: This was outstanding, my husband raved.  Definitely a recipe we will have often, thank you for sharing

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken agrodolce  an italian sweet and sour chicken

this is such a unique italian chicken dish. chicken breasts are briefly sauteed, then simmered in a sauce of honey, balsamic vinegar, wine, orange and lemon juice. toss in a few toasted pignoli, and you've got a quick and delicious dinner with risotto or cappellini.

1. in a large plastic bag , combine flour and chicken breasts , toss to coat
2. in a large skillet , saute floured chicken breasts in olive oil with the whole garlic , bay leaves and allspice berries until chicken is browned
3. remove chicken to a plate
4. to the skillet , add honey , vinegar and wine
5. cook to reduce slightly , about 10 minutes on medium-high heat
6. return chicken to skillet , add orange and lemon juices , salt and pepper , and cook about another 20 minutes or until chicken is done and sauce is reduced slightly
7. remove garlic , bay leaves and allspice berries from sauce
8. add pignoli and heat through , another 5 minutes or so
9. delicious with angel hair pasta or a nice risotto
demonstrations.review: We made this chicken for dinner and it was totally outstanding, I loved the sauce. It had such a great flavor and went well over angel hair pasta, thank you for sharing

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken scaloppine with lemon glaze   low fat and delicious

this is a wonderful lower-fat restaurant-quality dish that is easy to make, i also like to add in a few tablespoons of capers and cook with the lemon glaze if you are a lover of capers then add them in as it really adds to the flavour of this dish ---  this lemon sauce is not a heavy creamy sauce which is what makes this dish lower in fat, it is more like a glaze that soaks into the chicken, and i would strongly suggest to double or even triple the glaze i most always do, and please be certain to use only dry breadcrumbs as fresh will not stick to the chicken as well --- this is *very* good!

1. in a small bowl or shallow dish whisk together mustard and eggs
2. set aside
3. combine the dry bread crumbs with poultry seasoning , garlic powder and seasoning salt
4. spread on a piece of waxed paper
5. dip the breasts firstly in egg / mustard mixture then coat well with the crumb mixture , pressing downs with hands to adhear the crumbs to the breast
6. heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
7. add in the chicken and cook for about 5 minutes on each side , or until it is no longer pink inside
8. remove and transfer to a plate to keep warm
9. for the glaze
10. in the same skillet add in the broth , lemon juice and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt bring to a boil scraping any brown bits from the pan
11. add in lemon slices and parsley
12. mix to combine for about 1 minute
13. spoon the glaze / sauce over chicken
14. delicious !
demonstrations.review: My husband loved this recipe, thank you.  I haven't had a bad recipe from you yet!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
low carb chicken parmesan

while on the south beach diet, this dish satisfies my craving for the standard chicken parmesan dish.....but this recipe is missing the breadcrumbs. but it's so good you won't miss the breadcrumbs! in the world of low carb dieting, i like to serve this with a green veggie and/or tossed salad.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. spray a shallow , small baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. season each side of breast with garlic salt and italian seasoning to your liking
4. place in casserole dish
5. spoon pasta sauce equally over top of each breast
6. bake for about 45 minutes
7. sprinkle equally with cheeses and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese are melted
demonstrations.review: This was outstanding, we had this over angel hair pasta and my husband loved it, thank you for sharing this recipe

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oven roasted vegetables  south beach

an excellent phase 1 recipe from the south beach diet.

1. preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. cut zucchini , summer squash , red pepper , yellow pepper and asparagus into bite-size pieces
3. put all vegetables in a large roasting pan , and toss with the oil , salt and black pepper
4. spread in a single layer
5. roast for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are lightly browned and tender
demonstrations.review: I loved these veggies and so did my picky husband.  Thank you for the recipe!

target.recipe_text:
creamed spinach and tortellini casserole

a rich and creamy casserole that is quick and easy to put together and to complete the meal add garlic breadsticks and a caesar salad. the original recipe source was meals.com, however i have modified it to suit our tastes with great results.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. grease a large casserole dish
3. combine pasta , creamed spinach , cheese , mushrooms , garlic and black pepper in a large bowl
4. transfer mixture into prepared casserole
5. top with reserved tomatoes , sliced and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is golden brown
target.review: This is our new favorite casserole! Great and easy to prepare - everyone devours this! Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana pineapple streusel muffins

mmmmmm... my 2 most favourite things--all in one muffin!! recipe can also be made into 2 medium-sized loaves, if you wish. enjoy!!!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. streusel topping: combine sugar , flour , and cinnamon
3. with a pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture resembles crumbs
4. set aside
5. batter: combine flour , salt , baking soda , sugar and cinnamon
6. stir in pecans
7. combine eggs , vegetable oil , mashed bananas , drained crushed pineapple and vanilla extract in separate bowl
8. add to flour mixture , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
9. do not over stir
10. fill paper-lined muffin tins a little more than half full
11. sprinkle tops with streusel mixture
12. bake about 25 minutes
13. let cool for 10 minutes , then remove and finish cooling on wire racks
14. batter can be used to make 2 medium-sized loaves
15. bake at 350 degrees f
demonstrations.review: These are great! It makes an incredibly moist muffin, probably the best banana muffin I have ever had! Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
raspberry buttermilk muffins

serve these moist muffins warm with a little butter.    phoenix 0880 made these (2/6/07) and figured they are 4 ww points for 1 if you make 12.

1. combine flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. add egg and buttermilk
4. mix just until dry ingredients are moistened
5. fold in berries
6. fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups two-thirds full
7. bake at 400for 20 minutes or until browned
demonstrations.review: Great muffins! I used frozen berries since that was all I could get at the time and had no problems. The buttermilk adds a nice tangy flavor and keeps everything moist. They were a big hit!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yes  virginia there is a great meatloaf

absolutely delicious meatloaf and sauce! those who claim they don't believe there can be such a thing as a great meatloaf will love this. based on a meatloaf given to me by a dear friend, virginia strehl, memphis, and leesburg, fla. nita holleman, 2000

1. meatloaf: combine meat loaf ingredients and place into a loaf baking dish
2. smooth out top
3. sauce: combine sauce ingredients and pour on top and sides of meatloaf
4. bake at 350f about 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes or until done
5. enjoy !
6. the addition of 1 or 2 teaspoons of kitchen bouquet makes this recipe very good
7. recipe should be"plump" from the addition of the milk or half & half
8. it should not be runny
9. a second batch of sauce served hot is good to serve with the meatloaf
10. nita's
11. it is wise to have some fat added to the deer -- especially to ground deer
12. maybe 25 % fat , , otherwise your results will be poor
13. i don't know about some of the other game meat some are using
14. please consult an expert
15. the recipe is delicious as it stands ! enjoy ! nita holleman
demonstrations.review: This was a terrific meatloaf and I usually don't particularly like meatloaf. I loved the sauce but I think I would drop the vinegar back just a little next time. I also think I would drop the half & half back just a little next time too since I ended up a little on the mushy side. The flavor was excellent though and it improved each day. Great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gingery green beans

these are very nice with and kind of meat and the fragrance amazing.

1. in large skillet , over medium heate , saute mushrooms in butter 5 minutes
2. stir in ginger and cook 30 seconds longer
3. stir in salt , pepper and beans and 2 tablespoon water
4. cover and cook over medium heat until beans are crisp tender , about 7 minutes
demonstrations.review: Excellent! I had to use canned green beans since it was all I had at the time but it was still great! Will definitely make again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pierogies casserole

kind of like one big perogie, very tasty

1. preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. cook noodles until just soft
3. rinse , set aside
4. lay 4 noodles in bottom of greased 9x13 pan
5. combine cottage cheese , egg and 1 teaspoons onion salt
6. spread over the 4 noodles in pan
7. lay 4 more noodles over top
8. combine the dill , cheese , mashed potatoes and 1 teaspoons onion salt
9. spread on the noodles in the pan
10. lay final 4 noodles on top
11. heat butter in a skillet and saute the onion and bacon until onion is soft and bacon bits are nearly cooked
12. pour over top of final noodle layer
13. cover and bake 1 / 2 hour and serve with sour cream
demonstrations.review: Just like it promised! I admit I was hesitant when I saw the cottage cheese since I'm not a big fan of cottage cheese but you couldn't even tell! Would definitely make this again.

target.recipe_text:
shrimp in adobo sauce

shrimp a la diabla (

1. cover the chiles with hot water and let them sit for 15 minutes or until softened
2. combine chiles and 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup of the water they were soaking in , onion , garlic , cilantro , and cumin in a blender and puree to a smooth paste
3. saute the chile mixture in the oil for 5 minutes , add the vinegar and sugar , and bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer until the sauce is very thick , about 5 to 8 minutes
5. add shrimp to sauce and toss to coat , then simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until shrimp are done
target.review: I made it exactly like the recipe.  It had good flavor, though I might try to make it a little hotter and spicier next time.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
nutty drunken cod

for those who like cheese and wine,so does this fish! try brandy or white vermouth instead of the wine,for more crunch substitute flaked almonds for the pine nuts.we enjoy this with a nice glass of sauvignon blanc.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. wash the cod , pat dry with paper kitchen towel
3. sprinkle with the lemon juice , salt and flour them
4. melt the butter in a frying pan , fry the fish a few minutes on both sides until golden
5. place them in an ovenproof dish , top them with the peppers , bacon and the brie
6. pour over the wine , sprinkle with the pine nuts and then the with the parmesan cheese
7. bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the oven
demonstrations.review: One of the best recipes for fish we've had. Scrumptious! Didn't have the pine nuts, fabulous anyway.  Also, used red bell peppers and Mondavi's Cabernet Sauvignon - perfect with the brie. I put some previously cooked new potatoes in the dish with the fish and they were great with the cheese & wine. Thanks so much - we'll do this a lot!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy potato dill salad

the potato salad my family grew up on.

1. cut potatoes into halves or quarters
2. add the rest of the ingredients to make a super creamy combination
3. can be made a day ahead , add more pepper or grainy mustard as desired
demonstrations.review: Fantastic!  Had it with barbecue - the flavor is just the perfect compliment.  We refrigerated it overnight as well and added more pepper.  Really great recipe, thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
two chile green rice

i created this rice to accompany a cuban pork roast. it's well-seasoned with chile powder and serrano peppers, plus green onions, oregano, lime juice and a healthy heaping of cilantro. it's not particularly 

1. saute green onions and serrano peppers 2 minutes in olive oil
2. add the rice and saute another 2 to 3 minutes
3. add lime juice , chile powder and oregano and continue sauteeing another minute or so
4. pour in water , add cilantro , bring to a boil then reduce heat , cover and simmer on very low heat for 15 minutes or until rice is done
5. salt to taste
demonstrations.review: I used this recipe to go with Jerk Chicken - it turned out great.  I really liked the lime and serranos with the green onions. The lime doesn't overwhelm at all, I was afraid it might, but it just blended perfectly. Great recipe, very tasty, thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potatoes in sweet sour tomato gravy

this is something we normally cook at my inlaws place...the masalas quantity may vary...as per the quality and your taste...this is the approx. measurement i use...try and let me know...use the chili mildly if you dont want a really hot curry...preparation time includes boiling the potatoes...

1. heat oil in a wok / kadai
2. crackle the mustard seeds , throw in the cinnamon sticks
3. add the curry leaves and the chopped tomatoes , stir and cover with a lid
4. cook with the lid on for 10 minutes
5. remove the lid and mash the tomatoes to form a not-so-fine paste
6. when the oil starts coming out of the tomatoes add in all the dry powders and the sugar
7. stir for a minute or two
8. add in the potatoes and stir
9. pour the water and bring to a boil
10. the consistency of the preparation should not be very thick or watery
11. serve with hot paranthas or any type of bread
demonstrations.review: These were absolutely delicious.  We served them with a lemon/plum chicken recipe and it was just outstanding.  Great flavor, really spicy but certainly not overwhelming!!  I used the ketchup, too. Thanks!  We'll be doing this a lot.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
salmon mollee

this is a lovely curry-like recipe but the beauty of this dish is that it doesn't use any exotic and hard to find ingredients. it also opens itself up to substitutions. you can adjust the spices to your taste and might like to try jumbo shrimp instead of salmon. i have also used cooked salmon in this recipe, just add it right at the end of cooking and reduce the overall simmering time accordingly.

1. mix the turmeric and salt in a bowl and roll the fish in the mixture
2. leave to sit while you make the sauce
3. if using cardamom pods or whole cloves , crush to a fine dust
4. melt the butter or oil in a frying pan and add onion , garlic , ginger and spices , cooking gently for 2-3 minutes until onion starts to soften
5. add the coconut milk and cinnamon stick , simmering gently until thick
6. taste and adjust with lemon juice
7. you can let the dish sit for up to 15 minutes at this point if you want to delay dinner a bit
8. add the fish to the sauce , gently stirring it to loosen the turmeric and cover the fish
9. cook for 10 minutes over a medium heat or until the salmon is just cooked
10. garnish with coriander and serve over rice or , if you prefer , very thin , cooked asian noodles
demonstrations.review: My husband and I used cod.  As Sackville Girl suggests, the sauce goes very well with any alternative, shrimp would be great.  Didn't add the lemon because cod just isn't as fishy as salmon.  The sauce in this dish is just to die for IF you love aromatic spices and some heat and the rice was perfect with it.  Thanks so much for a definite keeper dish, Sackville!!!

target.recipe_text:
my family s favorite sloppy joes  pizza joes

i've tried many recipes, this is the best. i once 'dec-tupled' (10x) this recipe to sell sandwiches at a craft fair at my church. people were waiting in line to buy leftovers. freezes well, goes up to the lake or camping well and is a hit on halloween...it's no-fail. easy to double, triple, etc. i've been making joes this way for over 20 years.
***03-08-09, i just reinvented this recipe tonight when i went to make it for dinner and found i didn't have an 8-oz. can of tomato sauce (shame on me).  the family was upset with me when i subbed an 8-oz. can of pizza sauce and told them to suck it up and call them 'pizza joes' and then served them up with shredded mozzarella cheese on the toasted buns, top and bottom.  they loved it.  i left out the bbq sauce in this preparation and just used a 1/2 cup ketchup.  pizza joes are good to go!

1. in a large skillet , brown ground beef , celery and onion
2. drain the fat , who needs it ?
3. stir in remaining ingredients , simmer covered , 15-20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. if joes appear too'loose' , leave cover off and let moisture evaporate
5. cook until it's the consistency you like for serving on toasted buns , with french fries and cole slaw
target.review: My whole family thought this was great. I doubled the recipe and the only change I made was to  use celery seeds instead of celery cause that's what I had on hand. The kids just loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the ultimate strawberry shortcake

the perfect summer dessert. not your ordinary strawberry shortcake!

1. wash , stem , and cut strawberries in half
2. add sugar
3. toss to mix well
4. chill
5. beat cream cheese and powdered sugar well
6. fold in whipped topping and cake cubes
7. spread cake into an ungreased 13x9 dish
8. cover and chill for at least 2 hours
9. cut cake into squares
10. top with strawberries
demonstrations.review: My family loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
classic baked spaghetti

i looked everywhere for an easy baked spaghetti that did not use mushrooms or cream of mushroom soup (husband is allergic). i am happy to say i found it. you could add mushrooms, green pepper, olives, etc. to this dish for added variety, but i like it just the way it is! this makes a great family meal...just add a tossed salad and some garlic bread, and dinner is ready in about an hour.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. cook noodles in boiling water
3. drain
4. meanwhile , brown ground beef and garlic over medium heat
5. drain
6. combine browned ground beef , spaghetti sauce , and oregano
7. spray a casserole dish with cooking spray
8. place 1 / 3 of noodles in bottom of dish
9. top with 1 / 3 of spaghetti sauce mixture , and 1 / 3 of cheese
10. repeat twice , ending with cheddar cheese
11. bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Used ground turkey. Also used Italian seasoning instead of oregano. Everybody loved it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
simple caribbean jerk chicken

i like jerk chicken but often don't have all the exotic ingredients. this simplifies the mix by using dry italian dressing. yummy on the grill!

1. mix all ingredients except chicken in bowl
2. pour over chicken
3. cover and marinate 1 hour or over night in fridge
4. grill it !
5. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was very good. I used chicken tenders that I marinated overnight. Cooked them on my George Foreman grill. Next time I'll use more red pepper. Quick and easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
wonderful salsa

this is the best salsa recipe i've found so far and i've tried about a dozen. i got it from one of the local hospital cookbooks that are sold in my area. i changed it a bit and have been canning it for years. the reason i plant a garden is for this salsa. we would be lost without it. hope you like it as much as we do.  one of our members who is a food scientist took this salsa to work, tested the ph and found it measured under 4.0 (well within the safety limit for boiling water bath processing).

1. mix all together and bring to a slow boil for 10 minute
2. seal in jars and cook in hot water bath for 10 minute
3. this is a medium salsa
4. this is also a chunky salsa so if you want a smoother salsa cut your veggies into smaller pieces
5. yields 3-6 quarts or pints
demonstrations.review: Great stuff! I used 5 lbs. tomatoes, unpeeled & undrained. Took reviewers' suggestions and used celery for some of the green pepper, and added carrots. Used 8 oz. can roasted garlic tomato sauce; cut the sugar to 1/4 cup. The taste was great after it sat for a couple of days. I'll be making lots of this.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana banana bread

why compromise the banana flavor? my banana bread is moist and delicious with loads of banana flavor! ultimate comfort food, and it's wonderful toasted!! (make sure to use bananas with a lot of black on them for the best flavor! the blacker the bananas, the stronger the banana flavor of the bread.)

1. preheat oven to 350
2. lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. in large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. in separate bowl , cream together butter and brown sugar
5. stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. stir just to moisten
8. pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean
10. let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack
demonstrations.review: This was just okay. Family asked me not to make again.

target.recipe_text:
skillet  fiesta  dinner

wonderful skillet meal.

1. in a skillet , cook turkey or beef and onion and drain fat
2. stir in taco seasoning , water , tomatoes and corn and bring to a boil
3. add rice
4. reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
5. sprinkle with cheese , cover and let stand until the cheese is melted
target.review:
Everyone in my family really liked this - seven of us, ages 5-39. I made this following the directions - minus the onion because I didn't have one and with regular rice instead of instant. I allowed it to simmer 22 minutes instead of 5 and the rice was fully cooked. I also added some left over rice from the night before (heated before added). Before adding the cheese I put the food into a 9x13 baking dish. After I added the cheese I put it in the oven @ 375 for about 5 minutes. The cheese was melted and nice & stringy.

I agree that it needs a little kick or spice to it, especially because when you hear or read "Fiesta" in a dish you think of course about Mexican food - but I also think of spicy. I had read the previous reviews and opted to not add additional spices because I wanted to taste for myself what it needed. I think red pepper flakes might do the trick.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy beef stroganoff   ground beef version

this is one of my family's favorites. unlike most recipes, this one calls for ground beef. serve over noodles or rice.

1. in a large , deep skillet , add onions and beef and brown until no longer pink
2. drain off fat
3. stir in remaining ingredients , except sour cream , reduce heat , cover and simmer 20-25 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. remove from heat when mixture thickens to desired consistency and let sit for a few minutes
5. then add sour cream and mix well until blended
6. serve immediately over hot noodles
7. edit: if you prefer your stroganoff mixture a little thinner , increase the milk from 1 / 2 cup to 3 / 4 cup
demonstrations.review: I double this recipe for my family of 7 (ages 6-39) and it was all eaten!! Everyone loved it. I was out of parsley so I substituted Celery Salt. I also used 2 tsp of Onion Powder instead of an onion, and omitted the sliced mushrooms. I went with the "runnier" version and used 1 1/2 cups of milk (remember I doubled my recipe). I think the consistency was perfect. Served over Jasmine Rice and butter. DELICIOUS.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bobby flay throwdown red velvet cupcakes and cream cheese icing

i saw this recipe on the food network show bobby flay throwdown. he challenged a lady who has a cupcake store. this is the recipe she uses and says she sells the most of. you want to make these huge. she makes them to feed 2 people. opening them up and cutting them in half like a regular cake. the icing recipe makes alot,,,but plan to use a heaping scoop on top of the cupcake. since you cut it in half and eat it with a fork every forkful can dip into the icing. i double the cocoa amount for more flavor. also,,it calls for 2 tbs of red food coloring, it does make it very red,,but even 1 tbs will make it red enough.

1. for the cupcakes:
2. preheat oven 350 degrees f
3. sift together flour , baking soda , salt , and cocoa powder into a bowl and set aside
4. in a mixer fitted with paddle attachment , mix oil , sugar , and buttermilk until combined
5. add eggs , food coloring , vinegar , vanilla and water and mix well
6. add the dry ingredients a little bit at a time and mix on low , scraping down sides occasionally , and mix until just combined
7. be sure not to over mix , or the batter will come out
8. tough
9. line a 16-cup cupcake pan with paper liners , scoop the batter into the liners and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until the toothpick comes out clean
10. let cool
11. for the cream cheese frosting:
12. whip the butter and cream cheese together in a mixer fitted with a paddle attachment until creamed
13. gradually add powdered sugar to the mixture and scrape down the bowl as needed
14. add the vanilla and mix until combined
15. the frosting can be used right away , or stored in the refrigerator up to a week
16. frost cooled cupcakes with the cream cheese frosting
demonstrations.review:
These are 10 star cupcakes! I am not kidding!

I have made this several times since they were shown on "Throwdown with Bobby Flay" and they are YUMMMY! 

I made them last year for my sons 2nd birthday.  Everyone, including my mother who does NOT like cream cheese, enjoyed them.  I did not however make them this year for his birthday - resulting in some very disappointed guests. 

The frosting is super rich - my friends and family refer to it to "Shay's (cause they dont know better!) 1,000 pound frosting"!!

Make them, you wont be sorry!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
san  francisco pork chops

something a little different. the red pepper flakes give it just a little kick.

1. trim fat from pork chops
2. heat 1 t oil in skillet
3. brown chops on both sides
4. remove chops and saute garlic for one minute being careful not to burn
5. combine 2 t oil , sherry or broth , soy sauce , brown sugar , and pepper flakes
6. return chops to skillet
7. pour mixture over top
8. cover tightly
9. simmer over low heat till chops are tender and cooked through
10. add 1-2 t water , if needed , to keep sauce from cooking down to much or burning
11. turn chops once
12. remove chops to platter
13. stir in cornstarch
14. cook till thickened
15. pour over chops and serve with buttered egg noodles
demonstrations.review:
I used bone in pork chops.  The only other thing I altered was the garlic.  I didn't have any fresh garlic on hand so I used minced garlic from a jar. 

All in all this was a pretty good recipe.  DH said "that was excellent", which in our house is the equivelent to three thumbs up.  And the kids (ages 7, 9, and 12) all asked for seconds!!!! The chops were tender and the sauce was good, although next time I will only use half as much soy sauce - it was too much for my  taste.   Then again, perhaps with fresh garlic the soy wouldnt seem so overpowering.  I will definitely make this again and let you know how they turn out.

Thanks for sharing!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
strawberries with devonshire cream

quick, easy and delicious!  this is from my "deep in the heart" cookbook.  this cookbook is published by the dallas junior forum and is full of wonderful recipes!  if you try this, i hope you enjoy!

1. whip cream cheese until softened
2. gradually add cream until the mixture is smooth
3. next stir in the vanilla extract
4. add powdered sugar to taste
5. wash and hull the strawberries and place in a separate bowl
6. keep berries and cream mixture in the refrigerator until ready to serve
7. when serving , dish the strawberries into individual serving dishes , such as bowls or goblets
8. spoon the cream over the berries and serve !
9. may garnish with a mint leave if desired
demonstrations.review:
Wow!

I made this for dessert tonight and it was a hit!

Once I made the cream mixture, it tastes too cream cheesey for me (and I LOVE cream cheese).  So, I added another cup of cool whip (light cool whip, no one noticed) and another 1/2 tsp vanilla.  As for the powdered sugar I uses approx. 6TBS all together. 

When it was time to serve it, I whipped it again with the mixer.  It was creamy and delicious.  

I think the cream mixture would be fantastic as a dressing for fruit salad.  

Thank you so much! This will surely be served at our house again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
belly buster

this recipe is in about its third or fourth generation, passed down from grandma to mom to me. it became my children's favorite, and now my grandchildren love it. it was a staple in each household, with or without the hamburger. the children named it 

1. this recipe can be made vegetarian , leave out the hamburger and add 2 cups of fresh mixed vegetables , i
2. e
3. broccoli , mushrooms , spinach , carrots , etc
4. cook elbow macaroni "al dente" , according to instructions on box , drain , add to large casserole
5. scramble fry hamburger with spanish onion and garlic , if using , until no longer pink , drain any fat through colander , add drained mixture to casserole
6. add cheese soup , no water , to casserole
7. add tomatoes to casserole
8. add salt and pepper to taste
9. mix thoroughly , in casserole , to evenly distribute ingredients
10. spread grated or sliced cheddar evenly over top of casserole
11. preheat oven to 400 degrees , bake , uncovered for 30 minutes or util bubbling around edges of casserole and cheese topping is melted and slightly browned
12. serves 4-6 or with a salad 8
demonstrations.review:
One word: YUM! 

This was absolutely delicious - and as advertised, very filling! For the most part I followed the recipe as it was given.  I used approx. 1.25 pounds of hamburger and added bread crumbs spirinkled with olive oil to the top.  This gave it an extra crispy, extra yummy topping.  

Next time I will add some hot links and perhaps some bell peppers.  

This is definitely a great recipe and can be used as a base for many meals! 

Thank you for sharing.

target.recipe_text:
linda s cheesecake stuffed strawberries

omg.. these are like heaven in your mouth!  talk about great taste sensations...  i made these for one of my cooking and recipe events that i hold monthly, and these were a huge hit... a must try for sure!  you can use low fat cream cheese to make these lighter if you like.  you can also dip the ends with any kind of finely chopped nuts, mini chocolate chips, graham cracker crumbs, sprinkles, or dip the ends in chocolate or drizzle with chocolate.  you might even try adding some cocoa powder to the cream cheese and make it a chocolate filling.  the sky is the limit here, just use your imagination!

1. place cream cheese in a bowl , and microwave for 30 seconds , so that it's soft
2. whip together the cream cheese , vanilla , and sugar
3. in the center of each strawberry , using a sharp knife , make a hole in each one , as deep as you can without going out the bottom
4. spoon or pipe the filling into each hole
5. dip cheesecake end of strawberry into chopped almonds , making sure you completely cover the cheesecake filling with the nuts
6. lay strawberries in a pretty serving dish
7. sprinkle with any leftover nuts around the dish
8. chill , and serve
9. makes 24 servings
target.review: I had to add a lot more powder sugar to make the filling taste like more than just cream cheese.  It was pretty tasty, but I think I'll stick to my cream cheese/marshmallow cream mixture that I think is tastier.  Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: This was just okay, I tried serving it with rice which didn't taste that great, but then I put it into tortilla shells (soft) and served them and they were a lot better.  I don't have any suggestions for improvements, I guess it just wasn't my style.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy garlic penne pasta

this is a delicious, super quick side or main dish. i got it from the back of a pasta box and it is yummy!

1. melt butter and add garlic in a medium sauce pan
2. cook over medium for 1 minute
3. add flour and cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. stir in broth and milk and cook , stirring frequently , until sauce boils and thickens
5. add parsley , salt , pepper and cheese
6. stir until cheese is melted
7. toss hot pasta with sauce and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This turned out pretty bland.  The sauce was pretty thin, and it didn't taste like much more than noodles.  =/

demonstrations.recipe_text:
carrot  cake  tea sandwiches

the taste of carrot cake without baking. a fresh little sandwich to serve with tea or as a snack. very much enjoyed by my toddler.

1. trim crusts off of bread
2. combine frosting , cream cheese , carrot and nuts
3. spread filling evenly on bread , top with another slice of trimmed bread to create sandwiches
4. slice sandwiches into quarters , and be creative with the shapes , long fingers , squares , triangles , or use cookie cutters to create other fun shapes
5. chill for at least an hour before serving
demonstrations.review: Very good and simple to make.  Thanks for the idea!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
english muffins topped with bananas and cinnamon sugar

this was one of my favorite after school snack, lunch or breakfast. this brings back so many memories. kid comfort food! makes you feel young again!

1. mix cinnamon and sugar
2. spread butter on the cut side of the 4 halves of the toasted muffins
3. place bananas on the buttered muffins top with the cinnamon and sugar mixture
4. adjust cinnamon and sugar to your taste
demonstrations.review: This was okay, but I think adding peanut butter would have made it more of a 4 or 5 star recipe. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon chicken and rice

a quick, healthy meal and great tasting.

1. in a skillet , cook chicken , onion , carrot , and garlic in butter for 5 to 7 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
2. in a bowl , combine cornstarch , broth , lemon juice , and salt until smooth
3. add to skillet
4. bring to a boil
5. cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. stir in rice and peas
7. remove from heat
8. cover and let stand for 5 minutes
demonstrations.review: It's always awesome when you can find a meal both yummy and healthy - and this fits the bill! This will definitely be on the menu again soon, thanks!

target.recipe_text:
celeriac soup with coriander and chilli

i created this for a contest for a british cooking magazine. it's a spicy soup with a middle eastern flavour, great for warming your belly when the cold weather rolls in. you could also substitute a root vegetable like turnip for the celeriac.

1. in a large saucepan , saut the onion , chilli and garlic in the olive oil for 2-3 minutes over a medium high heat
2. stir in the cumin and season with salt and pepper
3. add the celeriac , along with the chicken broth and water
4. bring up to a boil , then reduce the heat , cover the pan and let simmer for 10-15 minutes or just until the celeriac is cooked
5. remove from the heat and use a handblender or food processor to puree the soup until smooth
6. stir in most of the chopped coriander and milk
7. adjust the seasoning with more salt and pepper , if needed
8. ladle into bowls , sprinkle over a few coriander leaves and serve immediately
target.review: This is an excellent soup for a cool fall supper.  I used a jalapeno pepper instead of the red chile since that's what I had.  I didn't remove any of the seeds but we like things a bit on the spicy side.  I used a potato along with the celeriac since I didn't have quite enough and 4 cups of chicken broth to use up the box.  I served it with cornbread. My husband loved it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chilled cream of sorrel soup

a great summer soup

1. in a soup or large saucepan , melt butter and cook onion until tender
2. add potatoes and sorrel and combine with onions
3. add stock , pepper , tarragon and a little salt
4. bring soup to boil
5. reduce heat and cover , simmer gently until potatoes are cooked , about 30 minutes
6. puree soup in a blender chill thoroughly
7. stir in cream
8. taste and adjust seasoning
9. adjust consistency with additional cream or chicken stock if necessary
demonstrations.review: I haven't tried this recipe yet, but the directions don't tell you what to do with the hard-boiled eggs.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mu shu chicken patties with seared napa cabbage

this is from everyday with rr. yet another burger for me to try! :) turkey can be used in place of the chicken.

1. in a medium bowl , mix the chicken with the scallions , ginger , tamari , garlic and grill seasoning
2. form into 8 small patties
3. in a large nonstick skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil , 1 turn of the pan , over medium-high to high heat until smoking
4. add the patties and cook until well done , about 5 minutes on each side
5. transfer to a plate
6. add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil to the skillet and heat to smoking , then add the cabbage and stir-fry until wilted
7. season with salt and add the sesame seeds
8. pile the cabbage on plates and serve with 2 chicken patties per person
9. pass the hoisin sauce around the table
demonstrations.review: I made 1/2 the amount of chicken patties which I actually made with turkey.  This was about the right amount unless you have a lot more cabbage.  My husband and I both really enjoyed the dish.  Plus its easy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
moms  endive dandelion dish

my mom made this wonderful meal a lot. i think she said it was a german (she was german-irish) dish..if she was lucky enough, she picked dandelons to use instead of endive.....she served it as a main meal. my hubby really loves it. looks like it's time for me to make it again after so many years...gbgbeve.....

1. wash , & dry endive and tear into bite-sizes
2. put into large bowl and add the hard-boiled eggs , onion , potatoes
3. brown bacon till very crisp , remove bacon from skillet
4. drain on paper towels
5. leave bacon drippings in skillet on low
6. mix together in a jar / glass the dressing ingredients
7. pour dressing into drippings and heat this til almost boiling
8. pour over endive , toss
demonstrations.review: I was looking for a recipe that used dandelions that we got from our CSA farm.  This recipe was a good choice.  I thought the dish needed a bit more vinegar.  My husband liked it just the way it was.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sausage and cheese crescent squares

nice appetizer that is also easy to make. i often use the cream cheese with chives instead of the plain cream cheese.

1. heat oven to 375f
2. unroll 1 can of dough into 2 long rectangles and place in ungreased 13x9-inch glass baking dish , press over bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides to form crust
3. brown sausage and onion in large frying pan over medium heat until thoroughly cooked , remove sausage from the frying pan and discard the fat
4. add cream cheese to same frying pan and cook over low heat until melted
5. add cooked sausage , stir to coat , add the chopped sage if using
6. spoon evenly over crust in baking dish and sprinkle with the cheese
7. unroll the second can of dough on work surface
8. press to form 13x9-inch rectangle , firmly press perforations to seal and carefully place over cheese
9. bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
10. cool for 10 minutes then cut into squares
demonstrations.review: I used reduced fat crescent rolls, cream cheese and cheddar cheese and the squares were still excellent.  I took them to a party and they were very well received.  I did use the fresh sage leaves as well as fresh chives and thought they were both great additions to the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
breakfast oatmeal muffins

these muffins are a great way of using up leftover oatmeal. i always make extra oatmeal so that i can treat us to a batch of these the next day.

1. mix together dry ingredients
2. beat together wet ingredients
3. stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients , just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. fold in raisins
5. spoon into 12 greased muffin cups
6. bake at 350f for 18 minutes
demonstrations.review: I must have had larger size muffin cups because I only got 12 muffins.  They were delicious but rather high in fat.  Next time I make them I may try to decrease the fat and sugar a bit.  I also added 1/4 cup of flaxseed meal to increase the fiber.

target.recipe_text:
golden five spice  sticky chicken

a really easy, deliciously sticky, chicken dish, with warm, aromatic flavours.

1. whisk together the marinade ingredients
2. put the chicken into a dish , then pour over the marinade , mixing to coat it
3. cover and then chill for at least 20 minutes or up to 24 hours if you have time
4. heat the oven to 180 / 160 / gas 4
5. lift the chicken out of the marinade into a roasting tin
6. roast for 40 minutes , then pour over the remaining marinade and cook for a further 30 minutes until golden and sticky
target.review: I love 5 spice seasoning so when I saw this recipe I had to try.  I used chicken breast because my family doesn't like the dark meat and it was just delish.  Served with rice and vege and there was nothing left but empty dishes to wash.  Thanks for a great addition to my chicken recipe collection.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
meatball and macaroni stew  low fat low cal

i think this came from cooking light originally. it is very rich tasting and filling. i usually make about 40 tiny meatballs instead of 18 big ones. each cup has 168 calories, 12.6 g protein, 4.3 g fat, 21.3 g carbohydrate, 21 mg cholesterol, 445 mg sodium

1. combine muffin and milk in large bowl
2. stir well , and let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
3. add beef , parmesan , parsley , pepper , salt , and egg white and stir well
4. shape mixture into 18 1-inch meatballs
5. cover and set aside
6. coat a dutch oven with cooking spray
7. heat over medium til hot
8. add onion and garlic
9. saute 10 minutes until tender
10. add basil , oregano , bay leaf , and cook 1 minute
11. stir in tomatoes , chicken broth , wine , sugar , and salt
12. bring to a boil
13. add meatballs
14. reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , 15 minutes or until meat is done
15. discard bay leaf
16. to serve , stir in macaroni
demonstrations.review: This turned out really good.  I had some meatballs I had purchased and in a hurry to make dinner.  Had everything else on hand.  I did add some veges, carrots, celery, zuccini because I needed to use them up.  I served a nice crusty bread with it so we could sop up the broth.  It is one that I will fix again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy crab cakes

these are delicious crab cakes that my mom makes..i think she got the recipe from a co-worker.  it goes well with a black bean soup.

1. in a bowl , combine red pepper , green onion , mayo , lemon juice , salt , garlic powder , and cayenne pepper
2. stir in crab , egg , and 1 / 3 c of the breadcrumbs
3. divide and form mixture into 4 balls
4. roll crab balls in remaining breadcrumbs
5. flatten into cakes about 1 / 2 inch thick
6. in a skillet , melt butter over medium heat and fry crab cakes 3-4 min per side , or until golden
demonstrations.review: Loved this recipe.  It is almost like the one my mom used when I was growing up.  If you have leftover cakes they make great cold crab cake sandwiches.  I usually double the recipe so we can have left overs.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
quick grapefruit marmalade

a quick recipe for one bottle of marmelade, i use it to avoid canning - just put it in any bottle and refrigerate after making.  it's best when it's first made though, and still warm.
i like my marmelade tart - if you find it's too sour for your tastes, just use more sugar.  
note: you don't need any gelatin, there's plenty of natural gelatin in the peel of all citrus fruits.

1. slice the grapefruit very very thinly with a sharp knife , into flat slices
2. then cut these into strips , and cut the strips into smaller bits
3. keep all the juice that flows out , if it's a juicy grapefruit
4. bring 6 cups of water to a boil , and then add the grapefruit slices and juice
5. keep at a low boil , adding the sugar
6. continue boiling for quite some time , until it begins getting thicker
7. the tricky part is knowing when to stop boiling
8. if you wait too long , it will become too thick when it cools
9. the important thing to know is it thickens a bit when cooling , so you have to stop it before it reaches the desired consistency
10. i put a porcelain dish in the fridge , then pour a little onto the dish - if it congeals a little , then it's ready
11. before you bottle it , eat it with bread while it's still warm - it's delicious !
12. pour in any clean bottle , and refrigerate
demonstrations.review: Wonderful recipe for that last grapefruit that no one wants.  Now I buy extra just to make this.  Very good and easy.  I prefer marmalade to jelly so I am going to make this often.  I think I will try this recipe with oranges just use 2 or 3 instead of grapefruit.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
the  only  bbq salmon

this recipe is by david veljacic a canadian bbq champion. you need time to marinade the salmon overnight in the fridge. it is a fantastic recipe.  please read the review by wayne in vancouver -i am sure that he knows what he is talking about i suggest that you try it his way. i copied this recipe from either a vancouver paper or local magazine.  next time i make it i will do as wayne suggests and if that works i will rewrite the recipe to reflect his comments - thanks wayne

1. chop the garlic cloves finely , sprinkle with salt and grind together with the flat of the knife
2. combine with the parsley , tomatoes and olive oil and store , covered in the fridge overnight
3. prepare the bbq and oil the grill
4. with a sharp knife cut two lengthwise slits in the fillet , cut to , but not through , the skin
5. spread half the garlic mixture over the fillet and into the slits
6. place skin side down on the bbq grill at low temp with the lid closed for 10-15mins
7. spread the remaining garlic mixture over the fillet , close lid , increase the temperature to medium and cook another 15mins or until the flesh seperates into natural moist sections when pressed with a fork
demonstrations.review: I used this recipe with Mahi Mahi and it was soooo good.  It was so simple to make and cook.  You can prepare the night before and when you get home from work heat the grill, while cooking throw a salad together and you have a nice light supper. Next time I make this I am going to use the salmon but didn't have any on hand today.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
darrell s crock pot  meatloaf

for the man in the house.

1. in a bowl , beat egg and milk
2. stir in bread cubes , onion , green pepper , salt and pepper
3. add beef and mix well
4. shape into a round loaf
5. place in a 5 qt crock pot
6. spread ketchup on top of loaf
7. arrange carrots around loaf
8. peel a strip around each potato and place potatoes over carrots
9. cover and cook on high for one hour
10. reduce to low
11. cover and cook for 7-8 hours or until meat is no longer pink , and vegetables are tender
demonstrations.review: Was looking for something different to take to a carry-in luncheon.  Well this sounded good and everyone loves meatloaf.  So I gave it a try, added a bit of worchestire sauce to meat mix because I always do in regular meatloaf, didn't have potatoes but had plenty of carrots so used more of them.  Since we meet early and I go to bed very late, I actually let it cook during the night.  House smell wonderful when I woke up and so I had to have a taste.  It was very good.  Everyone at lunch just loved it and wanted the recipe.  We like easy but good tasting recipes because we like free time for fun.  This one fits the ticket.  Thanks for another great crock pot recipe.

target.recipe_text:
easy enchiladas  beef or chicken

these easy enchiladas are my husband's favorite recipe of mine. because of the many different options, it is very versatile.

1. if using chicken , boil chicken in water
2. then rinse and shred with fork
3. add onion and garlic
4. if using ground beef , brown with onion and garlic , drain
5. add next 7 ingredients
6. in another skillet , heat oil
7. add tortillas , one at a time , for 10 seconds on each side
8. drain on paper towel
9. in 10x13 baking pan , pour just enough enchilada sauce in the bottom to coat the bottom of the pan
10. fill each tortilla with a spoonful of meat mixture
11. cheese , onions , and / or olives can be put inside each enchilada at this time , if desired
12. roll tortilla and place seam side down in pan
13. continue with remaining tortillas
14. pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and top with cheese
15. at this time , pan may be refrigerated for several hours or overnight
16. bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes
17. top with sour cream
18. enjoy !
target.review: We used chicken and Pepper Jack cheese the first time making these and my wife and I loved them!  Thank you!  Tony

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon twist cookies

my favorite.  easy to make and keeps well.

1. mix and divide into 10 balls
2. mix together cinnamon and sugar
3. roll dough into part of the sugar mixture
4. roll into circle
5. cut shapes into 16 pie shaped portions
6. roll up each piece starting at the wide end
7. bake at 350 for 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: One of my favorites and my wife really loves them too, so we decided to make them and top with some sugar glaze before having for breakfast... Yes breakfast :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
seasoned rice mix

great for holiday gifts. multiply recipe and divide prepared mixture into 1 cup amounts, put in decorative jars or just zipper bags with the preparation directions attached. good to keep on hand for yourself too!

1. mix all ingredients together
2. recipe makes 3 cups
3. divide prepared mixture into 1 cup portions to give as gifts
4. put in airtight containers
5. recipe can be mul
6. directions for gift card:bring 2 cups water and 1 t butter or margarine to boil
7. stir in rice mix
8. cover , reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is done
9. makes 6 servings , 1 / 2 cup each
demonstrations.review: Great recipe for rice mix.  We really enjoyed this since it is so low in sodium and still tasty! Tony

demonstrations.recipe_text:
panini sandwiches

when i got my george foreman grill, i made up this recipe to be like the ones that i had bought. it has been a big hit with everyone.

1. start heating the grill
2. place 1 slice of mozzarella on each of 4 slices of bread
3. place 1 slice of provolone on each of the other 4 slices of bread
4. top the mozzarella with pepperoni , salami and pepperoncini
5. top the provolone with turkey , ham and cheddar
6. place the two halves of the sandwiches together
7. brush the top of the first sandwich with the melted butter
8. place the sandwich butter side down on the grill
9. brush the other side with melted butter
10. grill till bread is toasted and the cheese has melted
11. continue with the other sandwiches
12. a george foreman grill works great with these sandwiches but even a stove top grill would work
demonstrations.review: Who could resist one of these!  Not I or my wife.  We had this for lunch and enjoyed it totally!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
shirley s stuffed celery with nuts

simple to make, and really tasty morsels to munch on during the christmas and thanksgiving holidays, this recipe has been a family tradition at our table for many years!

1. put cream cheese in a bowl in the microwave for 45 secs
2. to soften
3. add milk , and mix well
4. add walnuts , and mix well
5. cut stalks of celery into thirds , and wash and dry well ,
6. stuff celery with cream cheese mixture , and refrigerate
demonstrations.review: Through the years we have made celery stuffed with peanut butter and some with cream cheese, but this sounded so good I had to try it for our Thanksgiving dinner this year.  It was such a great addition to our plates and I loved the crunch of the nuts with the creaminess of the cream cheese.  This is another addition that our Thanksgiving table won't be without again.  Yummy!  Tony

demonstrations.recipe_text:
steak tampiquena  mexican steak

i enjoy the blend of green chile and cheese. in this recipe it takes your steak south of the border for an authentic mexican steak. no visa or passport required!

1. heat olive oil in pan
2. sautee onion , garlic and tomato for 3 minutes or until tender
3. set mixture aside
4. preheat oven to broil
5. cut green chile into long strips and set aside
6. sprinkle seasoning salt on both sides of steak
7. broil steaks on one side
8. remove from oven and place mixture of tomato , onion and garlic evenly on unbroiled side of steaks
9. top with 2-3 strips of green chile
10. next , place a slice of cheese on top of each steak broil until steak is done and cheese is melted
11. serve and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Very tender and delicious steak with a little kick!  We enjoyed it with some Mexican rice and cornbread.  If you like Mexican, you will love this!  Tony

target.recipe_text:
quicky ground turkey or beef casserole

easy and yummy!

1. preheat oven to 425
2. brown and drain ground beef
3. add in garlic , oregano , tomato sauce , salt and pepper
4. cook noodles according to package while beef mixture simmers
5. drain noodles and return to pot
6. stir in sour cream
7. in buttered dish , layer noodles , beef mixture and cheese
8. bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is completely melted
target.review: Easy and yummy is correct!  Few changes I made (just to use what I had on hand):  quinoa penne for pasta, turkey for meat, 1/2 cup greek yogurt instead of sour cream and Mexican blend cheese.  Thanks for an easy meal!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
impossible peanut butter cookies

these are the quickest, simplest peanut butter cookies that you will ever make and they taste great!

1. mix peanut butter , sugar , and egg together until smooth
2. drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet two inches apart
3. if desired , roll in extra sugar before placing on cookie sheet
4. press with fork
5. press again in opposite direction
6. bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. do not brown
8. do not over bake
demonstrations.review: Great!  I added a handful of dark chocolate chips to half the mix to try something different.  Worked great and even my son who does not like peanut butter liked these!  Thanks for an easy recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
marinated cucumbers  onions  and tomatoes

this recipe is from womack house, a long ago country kitchen in fulshear, tx. it tastes like summer!

1. combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. toss well to mix
3. refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: Great recipe, super easy! My husband does not eat tomatoes, so I used banana peppers instead- it was awesome! Thanks for sharing.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
dangerously delicious microwave chocolate pudding for one

in the mood for chocolate....this is quick and delicious. i love it warm right out of the microwave.

1. mix together milk , salt and cornstarch in microwave safe bowl
2. stir in chocolate chips
3. put in microwave uncovered for 40 seconds on high
4. stir until chips are well melted& blended
5. heat another 30 seconds
6. keep a close eye on it so it doesn't bubble over
7. at this point if it has not thickened , keep going for 20 seconds intervals , stirring between each one until thickened
8. do keep an eye on it at all times
9. eat it right away or let it cool
demonstrations.review: Super easy!  The whole family was craving some chocolate, so I wanted something quick and small.  This was perfect!  I did double the recipe.  I used arrowroot powder instead of starch, and dark chocolate chips (bc that was all I had).  Figured out it was too dark for my son about half way through - yes, I licked the spoon!  I added about a tbsp of honey and a teaspoon of cane sugar and it was great!  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
homemade bisquick mix

this recipe appeared in the kansas city star food section some years ago. try this and you'll never buy the boxed bisquick mix again!

1. sift flour , baking powder and salt three times into a large bowl
2. cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs
3. store mixture in airtight container in the refrigerator up to 4 months
4. use whenever your recipe calls for "bisquick mix"
demonstrations.review: Love this recipe!  Was glad to find it on here.  I used freshly milled whole wheat flour and unsalted butter instead of shortening - in hopes of it being a little healthier!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whatever floats your boat  brownies

these are absolutely the chewiest, moistest, fudgiest brownies ever! i have tried adding so many different things to the batter, and they always comes out great.  they are also great without any add-ins! but by varying the add-ins, you can make different brownies every week (or day!!) super easy prep! so, add "whatever floats your boat" and you will not believe how yummy they come out :) oh, and the recipe doubles just fine--use a 9 x 13 inch pan instead and add a few more minutes of baking!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. grease an 8 inch square pan or line with foil
3. in a medium bowl combine melted butter and cocoa and stir until cocoa is dissolved
4. add sugar and mix well
5. add eggs one at a time and stir until well combined
6. stir in vanilla , flour and salt until you no longer see any flour
7. fold in "whatever floats your boat" !
8. spread in pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. do not over-bake -- your brownies will come out dry
10. adjust time / temp accordingly for your oven
11. if you do the knife / toothpick test , it should come out with moist crumbs , not clean
12. cool completely before cutting into squares
13. for vegetarian omit the marshmallows
14. for double recipe , bake in 9x12 pan and add 5 minutes to baking time
demonstrations.review: Thanks for the awesome recipe!  I had to hide these from my husband to make them last.  I used 100% whole wheat flour, dark chocolate chips and miniature marshmallows.  They were a little strong for my son the first night, but after they sat overnight, he said they were great!

target.recipe_text:
cranberry nut pie

this pie has become a holiday tradition for us. it has a nice tangy/sweet taste, and it is great with whipped cream. it's also pretty easy as pies go.

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. prepare pie crust in pie and crimp the edges
3. in a large bowl combine cranberries , brown sugar , nuts , 3 t
4. flour , and cinnamon
5. spoon cranberry mixture into pie shell
6. beat egg until thick
7. gradually add sugar and beat well
8. beat in 1 / 2 cup flour and butter
9. pour butter mixture over cranberry mixture in pie crust
10. cover crust edges with foil and bake for 20-25 minutes
11. remove foil and bake for 20-25 additional minutes
target.review: This was a really good pie.  I used a regular size pie crust and should have used a deep dish.  I couldn't fit all the cranberries in but it turned out wonderfully.  I took it to a Christmas potluck and it was the first item to disappear.  Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hot spinach and artichoke dip  lower than normal fat

made with lower fat ingredients. thicker texture (not runny). dip freezes well. if you haven't tried this type of dip yet, you don't know what you're missing! cook time is for microwave.

1. drain any liquid that may be sitting on top of the sour cream
2. mix everything together well
3. bake it at 350 degrees , stirring once or twice , until heated through
4. if lazy , hungry , or just plain impatient , use the microwave
5. this mix freezes well
6. there is no need to bake before freezing
7. you may want to freeze this recipe in four 2-cup containers
8. serve with tortilla chips or pita
demonstrations.review: What a GREAT dip! I made it for a party and had numerous requests for the recipe. The only change I made was to add some Tabasco sauce. I baked it, but then reheated in the microwave when it got cold. It worked great both ways so next time I'll just "nuke" it instead. This is definitely a KEEPER!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cornmeal blender waffles

cornmeal just adds that extra crispness that i love so much! i love these with some good quality all-fruit preserves. yum!

1. preheat your waffle maker and set oven temp to"warm"
2. place all ingredients in a blender container
3. cover and process at med-high speed until dry ingredients are moistened
4. do not overblend
5. pour 1 / 2 cup batter over grids
6. close waffle maker gently and bake until steam no longer escapes
7. remove waffle with a fork and place on baking sheet to keep warm in the oven
8. garnish as desired and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Thanks for the great recipe. I love crispy waffles and these fit the bill. To make them a little healthier I used 2 egg whites in place of the egg, unsweetened applesauce instead of the oil and replaced 1/2 of the sugar with Spenda. They were delicious!  This is definitely a keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lorri s pineapple coleslaw

we have a restaurant here in el paso, tx called the cattleman's steakhouse. it is world famous for it's steaks, slaw and beans. this is my rendition of their wonderful slaw. simple, yet mighty tasty (and fattening)! enjoy...

1. mix cabbage and pineapple
2. mix cream , mayo , sugar and vinegar
3. add cream dressing to cabbage and pineapple
4. salt and pepper to taste
5. store covered in refrigerator 1-2 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: I made this for a potluck at work and received rave reviews. It wasn't overly sweet so it would go well with just about anything. I substituted Splenda for the sugar and used non fat mayo and half and half. The dressing still tasted rich and fattening even though it wasn't. This is definitely one I will make again. Thanks for the great slaw!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
christmas chili

from u of alabama's 

1. place beef , onions and bell peppers in large dutch oven
2. sprinkle with 1 tablespoons chili powder , 1 tablespoon garlic powder , and basil
3. using a wooden spoon , blend together and brown very slowly
4. you may drain if desired , but mine didnt have a lot of grease , so i didnt bother
5. place tomatoes in food processor and process just long enough to cup up large pieces
6. put tomatoes , beans and beer in with meat and bring to a low simmer
7. add remaining chili and garlic powder
8. add pepper
9. cook slowly for at least 2 hours
10. serve with cheese and onion
demonstrations.review: Being an Alabama fan (ROLL TIDE) I had to try this. It was very good chili. I thought it was a little on the sweet side so I added more chili powder and garlic to "offset" this. I also added about 1 TBSP cumin as well. Thanks for the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
my cousin s butter pecan pound cake

my cousins made this cake for a family picnic...one taste and everyone was scrambling for pens and paper to take down the recipe...maximum yum!

1. preheat oven to 350
2. mix all ingredients except for the morsels and nuts until smooth
3. stir in the morsels and pecans
4. bake in a greased and floured bundt pan for 50-60 minutes or until cake tests done
demonstrations.review: I made this for my in-laws last weekend. They are all huge pound cake fans (that's the dessert they make 99% of the time - even on birthdays!). Everyone LOVED it and I loved that it was so easy to bake. This recipe is definitely a keeper. I will be making it again.

target.recipe_text:
chickpeas and rice

this is a recipe that i got from a vegetarian cookbook and made a few modifications to.  we have fallen for this dish and now make it a few times a month.  my two year old also loves it.  we tried it out on some non-vegetarians and they all loved it.

1. cook water , rice , thyme , and bay leaf and set aside
2. heat olive oil and half of the butter in a skillet and then add chickpeas
3. when chickpeas start to lightly brown add parsley and the sun-dried tomatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes
4. add oregano , basil , salt , and pepper and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes
5. remove from heat and mix rice and chickpeas together until rice is a golden color
6. mix in remaining butter and parmesan cheese
target.review: Great recipe!! Made exactly as written and LOVED it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
apple cranberry cottage cheese

this recipe is modified from a recipe i found in the kraft foods website for healthy eating. you can use other dried fruits in place of the cranberries although i haven't. also, use nonfat cottage cheese to cut back the calories even more. the applesauce adds the moisture that nonfat cottage cheese needs. i use the recipe as a side for brunch menus. guests always rave about it.

1. mix the applesauce and cottage cheese
2. add the cranberries and stir
3. dust with cinammon sugar to taste
demonstrations.review: This wa a great idea! I never thought of combining the two..I used blueberry applesauce and put some fresh blueberries on top...yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
broiled polenta with mushrooms and cheese

i love mushrooms and was really drawn to this recipe.  i haven't tried it yet.  it comes from the cookbook moosewood restaurant cooks at home, and i am posting it for the zaar world tour.

1. if you use the porcini mushrooms , pleace them in a bowl , cover with the boiling water , and set aside for about 10 minutes
2. in a saucepan , bring the 3 cups water and salt to a rapid boil
3. add the cornmeal in a thin , steady stream , whisking to prevent lumps
4. lower the heat to simmer for about 10 minutes , stirring often to prevent sticking until the polenta thickens
5. while the polenta cooks , strain the porcini mushrooms and rinse them
6. heat the oil in a skillet and saute the 1 1 / 2 cups mushrooms , garlic , and porcini on medium heat until the oil is absorbed , stirring occasionally
7. stir in the wine and add salt
8. simmer gently for another minute or two
9. preheat the broiler
10. spread the polenta in and oiled pie plate or casserole dish
11. sprinkle the mozzarella on the polenta
12. spoon the sauteed mushrooms over the mozzarella and finish with a layer of the smoked cheddar and / or provolone
13. add pepper to taste
14. broil for 3-5 minutes until cheese is golden brown , and serve bubbling hot
demonstrations.review: This was great!  I cooked the polenta in chicken broth and did one layer of 1/2 cup shredded cheese and topped w/ mushrooms and  2 tbsp grated pecorino romano cheese...very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chai spice biscotti

originally from cooking light?

1. combine flour , sugar and spices in a large bowl
2. combine oil , juice and eggs
3. add to flour mixture and stir until well-blended
4. turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
5. knead lightly 7 or 8 times
6. divide dough in half
7. shape each portion into an 8" long roll
8. place rolls 6" apart on greased baking sheet
9. flatten each roll to 1" thickness
10. bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
11. remove rolls from baking sheet
12. cool 10 minutes on wire rack
13. cut each roll diagonally into 15 slices
14. place cut side down on baking sheet
15. reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees
16. bake 10 minutes on each side
17. the cookies will be slightly soft in the center but will harden when cool
demonstrations.review: Nice cookie...I followed pretty much to a T, but decreased sugar to 1/2 cup and used canola oil and only 2 eggs. Personally, I thought the chai spice was subtle, the texture was nice...I will make it again! :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fabulous fat free frozen yogurt

yummy! a light and refreshing hot weather treat. easy to make, and guilt-free too!

1. freeze the yogurt , and the fruit , if you are starting with fresh
2. it is best to put the yogurt into an ice-cube tray
3. puree the frozen yogurt and fruit in a food processor with the remaining ingredients , except the sugar
4. they should be thoroughly blended
5. taste , and process in as much sugar as seems good to you
6. spoon into serving dishes and return to the freezer until dessert time
7. if you wish to keep the yogurt in the freezer for up to a week , you may do so , in a covered container
8. it will need to sit out at cool room temperature for 30 minutes to an hour before serving , or it will be too hard
demonstrations.review: Great way of making your own frozen yogurt with the ability to control the sugar. I didn't use any white sugar only fruit-sweetened jam....sooo good!! Thanks for the great recipe..I will be making this all the time and the different combinations are endless

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cottage scrambled eggs

my favorite way to make scrambled eggs. the softest, lightest eggs ever.

1. put eggs , cottage cheese , salt and pepper into blender
2. blend until smooth
3. in a small fry pan , melt enough butter to coat bottom
4. pour eggs into fry pan
5. without stirring , gently push cooked portion to center and continue until all eggs are fully cooked but not dry
demonstrations.review: Great way to get plenty of protein! I made a single serving for myself...just 1 egg and 2 tbsp fat free cottage cheese with salt and pepper. I paired it with w whole wheat english muffin...a very filling and healthy breakfast!

target.recipe_text:
greek seasoning

great for seasoning roast chicken, lamb, beef, potatoes or meats for the grill.

1. combine all ingredients
2. store in an airtight container until needed
3. goes well on chicken , lamb , and beef
target.review:
Nice seasoning.  I made this to use in recipe#204299  because I was out of commercial seasoning.  Guess What!  I won't be buying greek seasoning ever again.  I will be making it using this recipe.  

Thanks for the easy tasty seasoning.

MADE FOR ZWT4 FOR DAFFY DAFFODILS

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sudanese cinnamon tea

this is a lovely simple recipe for traditional cinnamon tea as it is drunk in sudan. you can reduce / increase the servings easily also.  posted for zwt 4.

1. place 4 cups of boiling water in a tea pot with the tea & allow to brew for a few minutes then stir
2. place 1 cinnamon stick & 1 sugar lump in a tea cup & pour the tea slowly over them
3. serve with an additional bowl of sugar lumps for guests to add if they like
demonstrations.review:
This was a quite nice spice tea.  I did add the cinnamon stick to the tea pot while the tea was brewing because I love the taste of cinnamon.  Overall, very nice.

MADE FOR ZWT DAFFY DAFFODILS

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon cream shrimp and pasta

lemony cream sauce with pasta, vegetables and shrimp. if you love lemons, this sauce is to die for. i cut this recipe in half for 2 and it worked out just fine with a little leftover.

1. bring water to boil with salt
2. add broccoli for 3 minutes to cook
3. remove and blanch in cold water
4. add pasta to water and cook to desired taste
5. meanwhile , saut 1 tbs garlic in olive oil , cooking 1 minute on low heat
6. add 2 cups heavy cream and reduce over medium heat
7. add juice of 2 lemons and zest of 2 lemons along with 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper
8. allow to reduce by half 10-12 minutes
9. when sauce is close to ready , add cooked shrimp to sauce just to warm the shrimp
10. drain pasta
11. toss in cherry tomatoes , broccoli , arugula and the lemon cream sauce
12. garnish with fresh parmiganio reggiano
13. serve immediately
demonstrations.review:
I really enjoyed this.  It was easy to make and very tasty.  I used fat-free half & half since I am watching the waistline so it wasn't quite as rich as I know it should be.  Still loved it!  I also used spinach instead of arugula since that is what they had at the store.....very nice!

Made for ZWT3

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet and hot mustard

this is from "the frugal gourmet celebrates christmas". i made the entire "swedish winter feast" for a past christmas and it was wonderful! i'll post the other recipes next. the whole meal is: swedish corned pork roast, swedish sauerkraut, swedish green split peas with bacon, mashed rutabaga, turnip, and potato & sweet and hot mustard, served with rye bread. i expected not to like anything and ended up loving everything! this is an excellent mustard. it will keep for a week refrigerated.

1. in a small stainless steel bowl , mix the mustard and the vinegar until smooth
2. allow to sit for 3 hours
3. combine the mustard mixture with the sugar and eggs in the top of a double boiler
4. bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes , stirring regularly until thickened
5. store in refrigerator
demonstrations.review:
I really enjoyed this mustard.  It was not what I expected but so much better!   My husband loves mustard and this was a nice surprise for him!  

Thanks for the interesting recipe!  We will make this again!

MADE FOR ZWT4

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lemon   vanilla curd cake  irish cheesecake

delicately flavoured cheesecake made with cottage cheese.
