1. preheat oven to 350f , warm a baking sheet and grease a loose-bottomed flan tin
2. roll out the shortcrust pastry until thin , then line the flan tin with the dough , trimming off any excess
3. chill pastry case in the fridge
4. cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy , then beat in the egg yolks , flour , lemon rind , lemon juice and sieved cottage cheese
5. mix well , then spoon into the pastry case
6. mix topping ingredients together and spread on top of the curd filling
7. place the flan tin on the warmed baking sheet and bake for approximately 1 hour or until the top is lightly browned and slightly firm
8. dust with powdered sugar and serve cool but not chilled
demonstrations.review: This was a lovely cheesecake.  The lemon taste was wonderful and I believe that the cottage cheese gave it a wonderful texture.  This receipe was easy to make and I plan on making it again in the future!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh seafood salsa

i adapted this recipe after having the lobster-shrimp ceviche at san pedro restaurant in hudson, wisconsin. you'll find many uses for this versatile dish. you can substitute the shrimp and scallops with lobster or any hearty white fish. all measurements are approximate. the seafood cooks in the lime juice...there is no need to cook it ahead.

1. chop all fresh ingredients and place in a large bowl
2. add the chopped seafood
3. slowly add lime juice until everything is just covered
4. you may need more than is recommended in the ingredients list
5. add seasoning salt , pepper , and red pepper flakes
6. feel free to add tomatoes , corn , or anything else you might like
7. it is also okay to use all shrimp or all scallops or to substitute in just about any other shellfish or white fish that you like
8. refrigerate at least 3 hours
9. you can drain off a little of the lime juice if you like , but i don't find this necessary
10. season with salt and pepper to taste
11. serve with tortilla chips or as a garnish to a fish dish
12. i'm sure you can find many uses for this delicious salsa !
demonstrations.review: Really enjoyed this recipe.  I just used shrimp because that is what I had.  I also used 4 cloves of garlic, 2 tomatoes and approximately 8 limes since they were very small.  My husband and I both loved the recipe!!  Thanks for making our mouth and stomachs happy!

target.recipe_text:
chex party mix scramble

this is better than the original 

1. mix cereals , nuts , and pretzels in lined copier paper box gently to keep from breaking
2. mix salts , oil , and worcestershire sauce in bowl and drizzle over cereals , nuts , and pretzels til coated
3. bake in large turkey roaster at 250 degrees for 2 hours stirring every 15 minutes
4. cool thourghly and store in air tight containers
target.review: This is exactly the way we always made this at Christmas minus the Pecans.  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
melt in your mouth chicken breasts

the mayonnaise make these chicken breast very moist and tender--enjoy!

1. mix mayonnaise or yogurt , cheese and seasonings
2. spread mixture over chicken breast and place in baking dish
3. bake at 375f for 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: I really wanted to like this but the sauce cooked off the chicken while cooking and we were left with plain chicken breasts and a very greasy sauce we tried to spoon over the chicken.  We just didn't care for this one.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hot dish

my mom made this all the time when i was growing up.  it's another comfort food dish--very tasty.  you can so easily add other ingredients to taste and the dish is transformed into another lovely creation.  my mom made it with the following simple few ingredients. i now make it with garlic, onion and cheese.

1. cook noodles al dente
2. meanwhile brown meat and drain fat
3. combine noodles , beef , tomatoes and spices and serve
4. you can also add a can of kidney beans if you'd like
demonstrations.review: My Mom made this all the time too!  Sometimes she added a little bit of chopped green pepper and onion if she had it.  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy corn salad

this is an easy, comforting recipe that only uses 5 ingredients!

1. mix all ingredients in a small bowl
2. season with the basil or try other herbs
3. i like cumin , or you might try dill weed
4. add salt and pepper to taste
5. cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
6. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: We really liked this!  I will make this often this Summer when there is an abundance of fresh Corn and Tomatoes.  Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
poverty meal

when i was a child, my family used to eat this at least once a week due to the fact that it is inexpensive and a little goes a long way. we also added fresh herbs or sometimes whole kernel corn. its even better the next day and it freezes well.

1. saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent
2. brown ground beef and drain
3. add ground beef , tomatoes , water , raw macaroni , salt and pepper to the onion and garlic mixture
4. cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. if desired , top with parmesan cheese
6. serve with crusty bread and a salad
demonstrations.review: We must have grown up in the same family.  Mom raising 2 small children suddenly on her own found things tight. This is what my Mom called Sicilian goulash .  I still make it when I need some comfort food and this is all I have in the pantry.  Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mommy mc muffins

my family prefers these over mcdonalds any day! (they came up with the name :) since there are six of us, the recipe makes six, but of course you can make as many as you like. i sometimes use bacon, ham or sausage instead of the canadian bacon, whatever i happen to have! sometimes we even have these for a quick dinner, but they are mostly a weekend breakfast treat!

1. lightly fry the canadian bacon slices in a 12 inch skillet and set aside to keep warm
2. melt butter over medium heat in same skillet
3. fry eggs in the butter over low-medium heat , breaking yolks before flipping
4. top each egg with 2 slices of canadian bacon and 1 slice of cheese
5. when cheese has melted , place egg on english muffins
6. repeat with remaining eggs , if necessary
7. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: These were very good!  They were quick and easy and tasted a whole lot better than McD's! The only thing I did different was to use Pam instead of butter.  I will make these often!

target.recipe_text:
ground chicken beef with potatoes   spinach

a wonderful main dish that can be easily served with rice, bread or naan. it is my own invention by combining two of my mom's recipe's. spice level can be adjusted to suit your own personal taste, the recipe without changes is about medium spicry. please don't be intimated by all the ingredients or steps, it's quite delicious!

1. heat up the oil in a pot
2. on medium high heat fry the onions till they release their water and begin to shrivel
3. then add the ginger , garlic , jalapeno , fenugreek , cumin , cumin powder , coriander powder , turmeric powder and chili powder
4. slowly add about 1 / 4 cup of the water since the spices will pop and try to stick to the bottom
5. cook and stir for approx 2-3 minutes
6. then add the chopped tomato , stir and cook till it softens
7. add your choice of ground meat and potatoes with 1 / 4 cup more of the water , stir really well , cover and cook on medium for 15 minutes
8. add the spinach , tomato paste , salt and pepper to taste
9. stir well again till it coats the entire mixture
10. add the remaining water , cover and cook for another 5 minutes till the spinach releases any water and wilts down to a dark green
11. when done , turn up the heat to high and dry out any water in the pot
12. serve hot
target.review:
Made for Spring 2010 PAC.

This dish was tasty and easy to prepare.  I wish the chef had said how she serves it, because I couldn't figure it out.  It ends up being a mixture kinda the texture of scrambled eggs with a lot of stuff in it.  It seemed odd to just plop it on a plate.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ginger lime salad dressing

from crazy sista cookbook by lulu buffet. this is a great dressing, it keeps well, and is also yummy over blackened grouper or on a grilled shrimp salad. can also be used as a great marinade for grilling chicken or fish.  cook time is chill time.

1. combine all ingredients in a glass jar or plastic container
2. shake well until dressing is combined
3. refrigerate until ready to use
4. shake well before serving
5. keeps well in refrigerator
demonstrations.review:
Made for Spring 2010 PAC

Wow, this is good, but boy oh boy is it tart.  I had to add an extra tsp fine sugar to get it to my taste. I served it on a salad of grilled shrimp over baby and field greens, and orange bell pepper.
BTW, you don't have to buy fine sugar for this, I just put regular sugar in my spice grinder and it turned into a fine sugar right away.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
summer macaroni salad

great side dish for a bbq-my dh loves this salad!

1. cook macaroni according to package directions , drain and rinse in cold water , set aside
2. in a small bowl , mix mayo , dried onion , mustard , sweet pickle juice
3. next toss sweet pickles , celery , green pepper , eggs , peas with macaroni
4. add mayo mixture , mix well
5. fold in cheddar cheese cubes
6. refrigerate for at least 2 hours
7. stir before serving , enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
This is so different than the way I have always made mac salad.  It is beautitul in the bowl and delicious.  
I had to use fresh red onion as I didn't have onion flakes.  I used about 3 T finely chopped.

Thanks for this great recipe that will become a BBQ staple for the summer.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
ramen beef casserole

posted in response to the january topic of the month.  this is simple and is very easy to adapt to personal tastes.  inexpensive for college kids or if finances are just running low.

1. pre-heat oven to 375
2. in a bowl , combine crusted noodles , 1 packet of seasoning , sour cream , soup water , milk , and onion
3. stir and pour into a 9x9 oven-safe casserole dish
4. brown meat and drain grease
5. add meat to ramen and stir to combine
6. cover and place in oven , do not put on cheese and french onions
7. after 20 minutes , take casserole out and mix , sprinkle french onion over top
8. place back in oven uncovered and cook for 10 minutes
9. take it out and sprinkle cheese on it
demonstrations.review:
I was just craving something but I didn't know what.  I had some top ramen and I knew that some folks had used that to make other dishes, so I searched Ramen Casserole, and I found this one.

It is from our dearly beloved Amy.
What a shout out from God it was.

Please click on her name and read her page.

The Dish:  It was really good!  A bit too salty for my taste, that is the reason for 4 stars.  There is no added salt, but the ramen seasoning and the heavily salted cream of mushroom soup are both salty. I think that if there is a low sodium cream of mushroom soup, that would solve the problem.

I didn't use the French's French Onions because I hate them. Instead I used a scant dusting of crushed sour cream and onion potato chips.  For the cheese, I used a pre-packaged cheese crumbles, consisting of jack, cheddar, and colby.

We miss you Amy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
curried lamb with yogurt

serve with rice, chutney and chappatis. do other eastindian dishes if you wish like a nice lentil dish. make the day ahead and reheat. freezes well too

1. combine all the spices , mix well
2. toss with the onion and the lamb
3. place all the ingredients except the yogurt into a large skillet and simmer covered for apprx 1 1 / 2 hours or until the lamb is tender , add a bit more water if necessary
4. stir in the yogurt
5. serve
demonstrations.review:
I was looking for a lamb dish that I often order at an Indian restaurant, and all I could remember was that the "stew" had yogurt in it.  

This was it almost exactly, I think the one I get has some tomato as well, but this was simply fabulous.  Thank you.  

I didn't change a thing except for having to use ground ginger.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mutter pulao  rice pilaf with peas

this pakistani side dish is superb, it goes great with pretty much anything and is easily enjoyed by itself too. serve with some yogurt or achar and it's great!  it may look a little overwhelming to make but it's actually quite easy.

1. in a pot , heat up the oil on medium high heat
2. add the onion and cook till it softens , becomes translucent and releases its water
3. do not brown or dry out
4. add cloves , bay leaf , cardamom , peppercorn and cumin
5. fry for about a minute or so
6. add turmeric powder , coriander powder and chilli powder
7. stir and fry a bit
8. if it looks a little dry add a little bit of the chicken stock that you have aside
9. add the garlic and ginger paste , stir fry a minute or two
10. add the peas and chicken stock and let it warm up but not to a boil
11. add rice and salt to taste
12. stir well
13. increase heat to high
14. let the rice come to a boil and let boil for 5 minutes
15. give a quick stir , cover with lid and turn heat down to medium and let cook for 15 minutes
16. turn the stove off
17. do not uncover the rice or move it from the stove
18. let it sit in its steam for 5-10 minutes as the stove cools down allowing the rice to become fluffy
19. serve hot !
demonstrations.review:
Made for Spring 2010 PAC
I liked this very much, however, for me, it came out a bit too mushy, but I accept full responsibility for that, I may have overcooked the rice.
The flavor was terrific and I will make this again.

target.recipe_text:
heavenly banana oatmeal chocolate chip cookies

i found this recipe on another website (http://snider.mardox.com/).  they are definitely my favorite cookies!  i especially like how moist they are.  the number of cookies is a rough estimate - sorry 'bout that!

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. mix together the flour , sugar , salt , baking soda , cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. beat in softened butter until the mixture is crumbly
4. add egg , banana , and quick oats to bowl and mix well
5. add chocolate chips and walnuts
6. spoon onto greased cookie sheets
7. bake for 13-15 minutes , then place on a rack to cool
target.review: Easy to make...great taste. Will definitely make these again - thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peanut butter chocolate dessert

mind blowing delicious!! needs to chill at least 3 hours.

1. put 16 cookies in a heavy duty zip-lock bag and crush
2. pour crumbs into a bowl
3. add butter and toss to coat
4. press crumb mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 9-inch square dish
5. in a bowl , beat cream cheese , peanut butter , and 1 cup powdered sugar until smooth
6. fold in half of the cool whip
7. spread over crust
8. sprinkle with chopped peanut butter cups
9. in another bowl , beat the milk , pudding mix and remaining powdered sugar on low for 2 minutes
10. fold in the rest of the cool whip
11. spread over the peanut butter cups
12. crush the remaining cookies and sprinkle over the top
13. cover and chill for at least 3 hours
demonstrations.review: Absolutely delicious! I made this as a dessert for our superbowl party and everyone loved it. It is very rich, but very tasty. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fiery pork loin

pork loin marinated in a spicy chipotle mixture and grilled or rotisseried.  this has some fire to it!  pork can also be roasted in oven.  prep time includes marinating.

1. place all marinade ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. if pork loin needs to be tied , do so now
3. place pork in a large zipper-type plastic bag
4. pour marinade over roast and seal bag
5. turn it several times to get meat covered
6. refrigerate for at least 4 hours , turning occasionally
7. prepare grill or indoor rotisserie
8. remove roast from marinade and put on spit
9. cook roast 1-1 1 / 2 hours , or until internal temperature reaches 150f baste occasionally with marinade
10. let roast rest 10 minutes before carving
11. put reserved marinade in small saucepan and heat to boiling
12. serve with sliced meat
demonstrations.review: Made tonight for dinner and it was really good. I had a 2lb pork sirloin roast, so I divided all the marinade ingredients in half, threw it all in the crockpot and let it cook on low for about 8 hrs. Very tender and full of flavor. If you are really looking for a "fiery" taste, don't cut back on the chipotles. I found this had nice flavor, but not what I would call spicy or "fiery". Thanks for sharing - will definitely make again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
razz ma tazz bars

white chocolate, raspberries and almonds.  yummy.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. grease and sugar a 9x9-inch pan
3. melt butter in medium , microwaveable bowl on high power for 1 minute
4. stir
5. add 1 cup morsels
6. do not stir
7. beat eggs in large mixer bowl until foamy
8. add sugar
9. beat until light lemon colored , about 5 minutes
10. stir in morsel-butter mixture
11. add flour , salt and almond extract
12. mix at low speed until combined
13. spread 2 / 3 of batter into prepared pan
14. bake 15 to 17 minutes , or until light golden brown around edges
15. remove from oven to wire rack
16. spread jam over warm crust
17. stir remaining morsels into remaining batter
18. drop tablespoons of batter over jam
19. sprinkle with almonds
20. bake 25 to 30 minutes , or until edges are browned
21. cool completely in pan on wire rack
22. cut into bars
demonstrations.review: Just made this recipe last weekend. Found it on the back of a Nestle white morsels package and just had to try it. Glad to find it on zaar as this is a definite keeper. The only thing I noticed that it a little different is the nestle recipe calls for 1/2c sugar instead of 1/3c used in this recipe. Everyone certainly loved these and I will be making them again! Thanks for posting!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
weight watchers  caramel apple fluff

this is so good.  it really tastes like caramel apples!!!  estimated 2pts per cup

1. mix dry pudding and pineapple
2. add apples and cool whip
3. refrigerate for about 2 hours before serving
demonstrations.review: Made this for Thanksgiving and it was wonderful!  I've seen various versions of this recipe, so I modified this one a little. I added 1c chopped peanuts and everyone loved it.  You could leave out the pineapple, but it does a great job of keeping the apples from turning color.  I used Granny Smith apples, but I think any apple would work well. I might try a combination of half red and half green next time. Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roast  sticky  chicken

beautiful and delicious, this incredibly moist roasted chicken puts kenny roger's roasters, boston market, and other rotisserie style chickens to shame! please don't let the word 

1. blend all spices together and set aside
2. remove neck and giblets from chicken cavity , rinse well inside and out , and pat dry with paper towels
3. rub with spice mixture , both inside and out , then stuff cavity with onions
4. wrap in a resealable"food grade" plastic bag , tie closed , and refrigerate overnight
5. remove from plastic bag and place in a shallow baking pan
6. roast uncovered in a 250 f oven 5 hours
7. if the chicken contains a pop-up thermometer , ignore it
8. this recipe is safe
9. according to the united states department of agriculture food safety and inspection service , a whole chicken should reach an internal temperature of 180 f
10. for more info check out their"thermy" campign web site !
11. baste with drippings every 30 minutes after the first hour
12. let rest for 10 minutes before carving
demonstrations.review: Made this today for dinner and loved it!  The only thing I did differently was instead of oven roasting, I put it in the crockpot and cooked on low all day. Meat fell off the bone and was a wonderful flavor. Will certainly make again.

target.recipe_text:
4th of july grilled salmon  or chicken

a friend of mine made this at last year's 4th of july celebration, and after much begging and groveling, shared this super-easy, fun, and very yummy recipe, which you can easily double or triple for a big crowd!   the cold left-overs (if any) the next day are fabulous!  try this with chicken!!  grill 4 chx breasts 4-5 min ea side, then finish in 350 degree oven in covered pan with butter & olive oil for +/-20 min.  oh!  magnificent (great sandwiches w/tomato, cream cheese, and avocado).

1. into a large zip-lock bag , make marinade out of peanut oil , soy sauce , vinegar , onions , brown sugar , garlic , ginger , red pepper flakes , sesame oil and salt
2. combine well , and insert fish or chicken
3. seal and marinate in refrigerator 4-24 hours
4. oil and preheat grill on medium-high heat
5. grill fish ~5 minutes per side , until fish just flakes with a fork
target.review: One thing that's nice about Florida, is that you can grill out even in the cooler weather, and so I decided to make this salmon and am I glad I did!  My DH, DD and her DD and I went into silent mode as we ate this, eating it up so fast, it was gone in a flash!  I can't remember when I have enjoyed a meal more, and when my grandaughter likes something, you KNOW it's good!  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet  creamy coleslaw

i never liked coleslaw until i tried my husband's great aunt's. now i can't get enough of it! great with bbq pork sandwiches. you can also use a bag of slaw mix instead of shredding the cabbage and carrots yourself.

1. shred cabbage and carrots into a bowl
2. mix mayonnaise , vinegar and sugar in a separate bowl
3. blending well
4. pour over shredded vegetables and stir to coat
5. chill
6. amounts of dressing ingredients can be adjusted to suit taste but always use the same amount of vinegar as sugar
demonstrations.review: I added in some finely chopped fresh broccoli too and it was awesome!  This is a keeper at my house!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
swedish roast potatoes

these make a nice change from traditional roast or baked potatoes.

1. preheat the oven to approx 210c
2. cut across the potatoes at around 1 / 8 inch intervals , slicing about 3 / 4's through the thickness of the potatoes
3. put a baking tray on the hob and heat up the butter and olive oil until sizzling
4. turn the potatoes in the fat well
5. arrange cut side up and again spoon over the fat
6. sprinkle well with the sea salt and put in the oven for approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes until the flesh is soft
demonstrations.review: These were so good with our steak. Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mood beef  portuguese beef stew

this is another emeril's mom (hilda) recipe.  great way to make a thick and hearty beef stew.  an excellent all-in-one meal!

1. in a dutch oven or heavy skillet heat the olive oil over high heat
2. season the beef with 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt and the black pepper
3. saute the beef , in batches if necessary so that the pan is not crowded , until well-browned on all sides , about 4 minutes
4. transfer the beef to a plate and set aside
5. add the onion and green peppers to the skillet and cook , stirring frequently , until softened and caramelized around the edges , about 6 minutes
6. add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
7. add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
8. add the tomatoes , water , bay leaf , crushed red pepper and remaining 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
9. return the beef to the pan and bring the sauce to a boil
10. reduce the heat to medium-low and cook , partially covered , for 1 1 / 2 hours or until the meat is very tender
11. add the ditalini to the gravy and cook until tender , about 25 minutes
12. add the parsley
13. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: This is very similar to a recipe my mom used to make.  Flavors were great and just spicy enough for us.  Flavors blended nicely.  My DH and I both loved it.  Served in large bowls over whole potatoes cooked in with the meat, this was comfort to the max!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hearty portuguese kale soup

this is a very flavorful soup that is a comfort food for my family. the recipe was given to me by my portuguese mil over 30 yrs ago. her mother had passed it on to her. this soup is easily stretched to make more servings. the chorizo gives the broth a good base for adding another can of beans or more pasta or a little water. soul warming for a cold night, serve with a warm crusty bread. a great next day soup. freezes well.

1. remove casing from sausage and cut into smaller than bit sized pieces
2. heat oil in a heavy soup pot
3. saute the sausage& onion just until the fat is rendered , about 3 to 5 minutes
4. drain on paper towels
5. add other ingredients except kale , & pasta
6. bring to boil and simmer 10 minutes
7. add kale , and pasta and simmer about 8 minutes until both are tender
8. taste for seasoning- depending on how spicy your sausage is , add salt and pepper to taste
9. serve piping hot
demonstrations.review: I used homemade chicken stock to prepare the soup and doubled it like one of the other posters suggested.  The result was a very yummy soup that we truly enjoyed.  The sausage gave it such a nice flavor.  Along with all the other ingredients this soup is packed with all kinds of tastes that were very pleasing to the palate!   This is so good I placed it into my favorites so I have it handy for next time!  Thank you Bitsie!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon buttermilk waffles

a light and tender waffle with just a hint of cinnamon and cardamom. delicious served with fruit or fruit syrup with whipped cream. we like this with lingonberries.

1. mix dry ingredients in a small bowl
2. in a separate bowl , whisk eggs until well blended
3. stir in the buttermilk and butter
4. stir in the dry ingredients until well mixed , adding enough of the milk to make the batter thin enough to flow from a spoon
5. i use the whole 1 / 4 cup
6. bake in a lightly oiled waffle iron until medium brown , about 3 minutes in mine
7. serve hot
demonstrations.review: What a great breakfast these made when the grandchildren came for a sleepover.  My DH thought he had died and gone to heaven.  They are so light and delicious.  Served them with strawberries and whipped cream.  Could have been a dessert!  Delicious.

target.recipe_text:
marinara

a very simple but tasty marinar.  traditionally marinaras are not cooked a long time but i tend to let this simmer for a few hours, it makes the house smell yummy. i use crushed tomatoes and puree the onions because i have picky eaters but you can use chopped tomatoes and onions.

1. in a large sauce pan saute olive oil , onions , and garlic until soft
2. add salt , pepper , oregano , and basil , stir
3. add tomatoes and sugar
4. slowly bring to a boil then simmer covered over low heat 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours
5. makes 10 cups
6. freezes well
target.review: Yummy, I used this to make Recipe #27436

demonstrations.recipe_text:
raspberry scottish shortbread   vegan

this is from lindsay wagner (the bionic woman) and ariane spade's vegan cookbook "high road to health".  it is more like a bar with jelly than a shortbread, that name has always confused me,but maybe i'm missing something.  anyway, it is one of the few actual recipes i use, which is a problem when you want to share.  i love eating this raw-the real maple syrup makes it!!! also it is easy to make- i put the actual directions in but i just put in dry ingredients, then wet, then mix, nothing step by step.

1. preheat the oven to 350
2. sift the flour and salt
3. add the oil to the dry ingredients and mix well
4. add the maple syrup and vanilla and mix thoroughly
5. lightly oil a 9x9 pan
6. cover bottom with half the batter , pressing it firmly into place with fingers
7. spread the jam evenly over the batter to cover loosely cover with remaining batterpress gently and bake for 35 minutes
8. let cool 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: OMG!  This recipe is a keeper!  I made these for my office because we are all dieting at the moment and craving sweets and these are perfect!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fresh cream of mushroom soup

this quick and easy recipe is so much better than the canned stuff. great as a first course, or with salad or sandwiches. of course, you can use it in your favorite recipes, too.  to make it thicker, use less stock and/or use heavy cream instead of the half-and-half cream or milk.

1. lighly saute mushrooms in butter
2. add flour and stir constantly for about 5 minutes
3. slowly add stock , stirring until all is incorporated
4. simmer about 10 minutes
5. add cream , stir and serve
demonstrations.review: I just love this recipe!  This is not the first time I have tried it.  I am a repeat offender, I added a 1/2 teaspoon of Rosemary and a pinch of salt this time and it really spiced it up!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy burrito casserole

satisfy your craving for something different tonight. it's good and fairly easy. this is stuff i usually have on hand too.

1. brown ground meat / turkey & onion
2. drain
3. add taco seasoning and stir in refried beans
4. mix soup and sour cream in a separate bowl
5. spread 1 / 2 sour cream mixture in the bottom of a casserole dish
6. tear up 3 tortillas and spread over sour cream mixture
7. put 1 / 2 the meat bean mixture over that
8. add a layer of cheese
9. you could put some hot sauce on this now
10. repeat the layers
11. sprinkle cheese over the top and bake , uncovered , at 350f for 20-30 minutes
demonstrations.review: My husband loved this!  It is kind of like a "Mexican Lasagna"  Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
moroccan citrus fruit salad

summer is the perfect time for this healthy dessert salad! choose ripe and heavy fruit for the best results. salad needs to marinate for at least two hours for best results, so plan accordingly.

1. peel oranges and grapefruits and remove pith
2. cut in between membranes to release fruit sections into a bowl
3. squeeze juice from leftover membranes into a small bowl
4. add orange juice , orange flower water , honey , vanilla bean seeds and cinnamon to the bowl of membrane juice and whisk
5. strain juice over fruit and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight
6. garnish with mint leaves and serve
demonstrations.review: Great stuff! I had some ground clove on hand so I added about 1/8 teaspoon just for some extra spice!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crawfish  shrimp etouffee

i made this for dinner tonight and i just had to share, it was so good.prep time considers the time it takes to make stock, but you can always use water. serve this with hot sauce on the side, some like it hot! you can also make this with crawfish only, as i did in this photo.

1. for shrimp stock , place 2 lbs of shrimp shells and tails into a stockpot , add 3-4 quarts of water
2. add celery , onion , garlic , carrots , bring to boil
3. lower to simmer and cook 3-4 hours , adding water if needed
4. drain through a sieve , discarding solids
5. for the etouffee: heat 6 tbs oil and flour together in a heavy pan until it turns brown , stirring for 15-20 minutes
6. add onion , stir , celery , peppers and seasonings , stirring , until vegetables are softened
7. add shrimp stock and stir in slowly
8. mixture will be very thick , so you can adjust the thickness to your liking by adding extra stock , simmer 10 minutes
9. add shrimp , cook 5 minutes , add crawfish
10. cook on simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through
11. serve over rice
demonstrations.review: Good stuff!  We enjoyed it very much!

target.recipe_text:
classic apple pie

use your favourite apple variety, just make a note to alter the amount of sugar based upon the sweetness of the apples used!

1. pastry for double crust pie-------------
2. combine flour , lard and salt with a pastry blender or fork until balls are the size of a large pea
3. add cold water by the spoonful and blend until the bowl starts to clean itself as you work the dough
4. then it is ready for rolling
5. preheat oven to 450f
6. combine sliced apples with sugar , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg and lemon rind
7. line pie plate with unbaked pie crust , trim pastry , crimp to edge of pie plate
8. fill pie crust with apple mixture and dot with softened butter
9. brush crust edge with water and place pie crust top on top of pie , crimp to the bottom crust
10. make some slits in the top crust for steam to escape
11. bake for 10 minutes
12. turn oven down to 350f and bake for 45 minutes longer
target.review: Wonderful pie thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
gingerbread  for cookies or a  gingerbread house

this dough is very easy to work with.  we use this gingerbread to make our annual gingerbread houses.  one recipe makes 3 fair sized gingerbread houses.  this is also works excellent for gingerbread people. from good housekeeping dec 94

1. in a medium saucepan , heat sugar , molasses , ginger , allspice , cinnamon , and cloves to boiling , stirring occasionally
2. remove from heat
3. stir in soda
4. stir in margarine till melted
5. with a fork , stir in egg , then flour
6. on a floured surface , knead dough till mixed
7. divide dough in half , wrap half with plastic wrap
8. set aside
9. roll half the dough , with a rolling pin , slightly thinner than 1 / 4 inch
10. cut with cutters
11. bake at 325f on a cookie sheet for 12 minutes
12. cool on a wire rack
13. makes about 3 dozen 3" gingerbread people
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe. Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled honey garlic pork chops

nan

1. combine ketchup , honey , soy sauce and garlic
2. set aside
3. lightly season pork with salt and pepper
4. brush each chop with sauce to coat
5. cook chops on greased grill 4 to 6 inches from medium-hot coals or on medium setting , basting with sauce often , for about 5 minutes on each side or until meat is cooked through
demonstrations.review: I made this for my husband and I last night, it was awesome. I'm planning on having my parents over and making it for them. Thanks so much!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pumpkin roll ii

source: times-republic recipe anthology, watseka, il 1990  40 min cook time includes cooling time for the cake part

1. beat eggs and sugar
2. add pumpkin and lemon juice , mixing well , then dry ingredients
3. spread batter into a greased and waxed-paper-lined 10x15 jelly roll pan
4. bake at 375 for 15 minutes
5. remove , allow to cool 15 minutes
6. roll cake in tea towel or waxed paper and cool 10 more minutes
7. filling: beat cream cheese and margarine
8. add sugar and vanilla
9. beat till smooth
10. unroll cake and spread filling evenly
11. re-roll and chill at least one hour before serving
demonstrations.review: I made this for christmas it was wonderful. Thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sirloin steak kabobs

kabobs are a little more work, but are so worth it. great for company because everything can be prepared up to the grilling and you are good to go. cooking time is according to how you like your steak done.

1. mix together first nine ingredients for marinade
2. add meat , stir to coat , then cover and refrigerate overnight
3. alternate cubes of meat with pepper squares , small onions , tomatoes and mushrooms
4. place on charcoal grill , turning often until meat is done to your liking
demonstrations.review: This was a wonderful recipe! Thank you!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
no bean chili

no bean chilli made with hamburg and sausage.

1. cook the ground beef and sausage
2. drain off fat
3. when fully cooked , transfer to crock pot
4. stir in remaining ingredients
5. cover and cook on low setting for 8-10hrs
6. top with grated cheese and sour cream
demonstrations.review: This Chili is great! I loved it. I don't normally like chili but omitting the beans, i now love it! Everyone else in my family did too. Thanks!

target.recipe_text:
martha s rice salad

i came across this recipe of martha stewart. it's very tasty.

1. place cooked rice in medium bowl and keep warm
2. mix together red onion and vinegar in a small bowl
3. let sit 5 minutes
4. strain onion in a sieve , discarding vinegar
5. place lemon juice , oil , garlic , salt and pepper to taste in another small bowl , and whisk to combine
6. drizzle lemon mixture over warm rice
7. add reserved onion , dill , and lemon zest
8. toss to combine
9. serve
target.review: This was yummy! I used basmati rice and cooked it in chicken broth to give it more flavor and it came out really good. It is a little tart, so if you like things sweeter, I would add maybe a pinch of sugar or honey. I will make this again- thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy one bowl low fat breakfast cookies

these are good for you and they seem to stick with you. i like to use craisins and dried apples. this came from lowfatcooking.about.com credited to fiona haynes

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in a large bowl , combine flour , oats , baking powder , baking soda , salt and sugar
3. add egg whites , applesauce and vanilla
4. mix well with a wooden spoon
5. fold in dried fruit
6. drop by tablespoon full on to baking sheet lined with parchment or silicone mat
7. bake for 12 minutes or until lightly golden
demonstrations.review: Excellent! I also used regular flour for this and it worked fine. I also omitted the applesauce since I didn't have any, and it didn't seem to affect the taste. These were so easy that my 10 year old son helped me make them and really seems to enjoy eating them, too! Thanks for a great new recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
brownie swirl cheesecake

delicious cheesecake with a twist. enough chocolate to fill your craving and a different impressive idea.

1. grease bottom of 9-inch springform pan
2. prepare basic brownie mix as directed on package
3. pour batter evenly into springform pan
4. bake at 350f 15 minutes
5. beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla , mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended
6. add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
7. pour over brownie layer
8. spoon melted chocolate over cream cheese mixture
9. cut through batter with knife several times for marble effect
10. bake at 350f for 35 minutes
11. loosen cake from rim of pan
12. cool before removing rim of pan
13. chill
14. decorate with whipped cream and chocolate flakes
demonstrations.review: This recipe is delicious.  This was my first experience baking a cheesecake and it was a huge hit with a big crowd!  The only thing I needed to adjust was the baking time, mine took almost an hour just for the cheesecake layer.  Next time I would also use more brownie mix to make a thicker layer for more chocolate flavor.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet noodle kugel

i make this for holidays, goes great with brisket or turkey. we eat this as a side dish, but when i sent this recipe in to be published in a community cookbook they classified it as a dessert

1. preheat oven to 350
2. boil noodles , rinse in cold water , set aside
3. add remaining ingreds to large bowl and mix well
4. add noodles , mix well ,
5. grease a 13x9 inch baking dish , pour in mixture and bake 30 minutes until top is browned
demonstrations.review:
This recipe was OK...I used thin noodles instead of broad noodles because I find kugel holds together better that way. I loved the use of dried fruit (I used a variety of diff. ones) and I followed the other reviewers' advice and used a 9x9 pan and it came out just fine like that- not too dry.
I also sprinkled some corn flake crumbs mixed with cinnamon/sugar on top for a crunchy topping. I will probably make this again as my family seemed to like it.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
graham streusel coffee cake

from a little taste of texas cookbook.  this is a very moist coffee cake.

1. mix crumbs , pecans , brown sugar , cinnamon and butter
2. set aside
3. blend cake mix , water , oil and eggs on medium speed for about 3 minutes
4. pour half of batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
5. sprinkle with half of the reserved crumb mixture
6. spread remaining batter evenly over crumb mixture
7. sprinkle batter with remaining crumb mixture
8. bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes
9. cool
10. mix powdered sugar and water and drizzle glaze over cake
11. serve
demonstrations.review: I loved this cake!  I am a big fan of  yellow cake mixes (I know, not very sophisticated!) and this was a nice variation on a very easy mix. I left the graham crackers a little coarse to give it more texture and I actually like the way it came out.  Next time I might try golden grahams cereal instead, since I love that, too!  I will definatley make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
challah recipe for the kitchen aide

easy and right in the mixing bowl. turn out beautifully every time.

1. mix and proof the first 3 ingredients in the mixer bowl
2. add the rest of the ingredients
3. mix on speed 2 for 5 minutes with dough hook
4. place in greased bowl and let rise , covered in a warm spot until about double in bulk
5. punch down , shape and place on greased baking sheet
6. let rise again for about 1 / 2 hour
7. you may glaze with egg yolk and 1 tbspn of water just before baking
8. bake at 400 for 15-20 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was a great recipe.  I even gave it my sister in law who is new at baking and she loved the consistency of the dough and the easy ingredients.  I halved the recipe once and it came out great!

target.recipe_text:
creamy ranch chicken and potato soup  rsc

ready, set, cook! hidden valley contest entry.  this is a delicious and satisfying soup that is a snap to put together even on the busiest weekdays.  the hidden valley ranch seasoning mix easily adds another layer of flavor to the soup.

1. peel and cut the potatoes into 1 / 2-inch cubes , place into a large stockpot
2. add in the shallot , garlic and chicken broth
3. bring to a boil over high heat , lower heat to medium and cook until potatoes are tender , approximately 15 minutes
4. remove pot from heat
5. using a large mesh strainer or slotted spoon , remove about half of the potatoes / shallots / garlic from the pot and place onto a large plate
6. set aside
7. using an immersion blender , blend the contents of the pot until smooth
8. add in the hidden valley ranch seasoning mix , continue to blend until fully combined
9. place pot back over medium heat
10. add in the cheese and stir until cheese has melted into soup
11. add in the reserved potato mixture , the chicken , lemon juice , salt and pepper
12. continue to cook until heated through , approximately 2 minutes
target.review: Sounds absolutely delicious and a quick and easy recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
california bacon ranch pizza  rsc

ready, set, cook! hidden valley contest entry.  a delectable pizza with an avocado ranch white sauce, chicken and bright notes of tomato and citrus!  i came up with this recipe to use up some avocado for a friend who wanted something a little different!

1. pre-heat oven to 350f
2. in a heavy skillet , heat olive oil
3. while oil is heating , season chicken with salt , pepper , and lemon zest
4. stir well to combine
5. brown chicken in skillet until no longer pink , 6-7 minutes on medium high
6. remove chicken with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
7. set aside and keep warm
8. mix together avocado , lemon juice , ranch dip mix , mayonnaise , greek yogurt and cream cheese
9. set aside to flavor for 5-10 minutes
10. while avocado ranch sauce is sitting , spread pizza dough out onto a large pizza pan bake pizza crust 6-7 minutes or until just starting to brown on top
11. remove from oven
12. spread avocado ranch sauce generously onto warm crust
13. sprinkle cooked chicken , diced red onion , bacon pieces and diced tomatoes on top of ranch sauce
14. top with both cheeses
15. return pizza to oven
16. bake an additional 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted and pizza is hot through
demonstrations.review: Oh Yum!!! Love this pizza creation.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
buffalo chicken and noodle ramekins  rsc

ready, set, cook! hidden valley contest entry.  i created this tasty recipe that features elbow noodles in a ranch sauce, topped with diced chicken, buffalo wing sauce and blue cheese! i like that it is quick to prepare and it will wow any buffalo wing lovers!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. spray 8 ramekins with non-stick cooking spray
3. heat olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat
4. add shallots and celery
5. cook and stir for 2 minutes
6. remove from heat
7. stir in yogurt and dip mix
8. add noodles and stir
9. divide noodle mixture among the ramekins
10. top with diced chicken
11. spoon buffalo wing sauce over chicken
12. sprinkle with crumbled blue cheese and bread crumbs
13. bake at 350 degrees f
14. for 20 minutes , or until heated through
demonstrations.review: Quick, easy and very tasty!!! What a creative recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mediterranean tilapia pockets  rsc

ready, set, cook!  reynolds wrap contest entry.  these dinner pockets will take you on a mediterranean adventure as soon as you open the foil and get your first smell of pure yumminess!  they are perfect for a quick, easy and delicious dinner meal after a long day with the kids or work.  i hope that you will give them a try.  cooking with passion, sw :)

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. rub filets with 1 / 2 of the olive oil and 1 / 2 of the greek seasoning
3. wrap 1 slice of prosciutto around each filet
4. place 1 filet on 1 sheet of aluminum foil
5. combine tomatoes , zucchini , olives , capers , parsley , mint , lemon juice & zest and remaining spice blend in a small mixing bowl
6. toss
7. place equal amounts of tomato mixture on top of each filet
8. top with goat cheese and black pepper
9. take the 2 opposite ends of foil , bring them together over filet and fold edges 2-3 times down and seal
10. fold in 2 remaining open ends and seal
11. place aluminum pockets on a large oven proof sheet pan
12. bake for 15-20 minutes
13. allow to rest for 5 minutes
14. unseal and serve
demonstrations.review: Wonderful flavors you put together!  This is the way I cook most my fish....Love It!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mac  n cheese and spinach strata  sp5

official contest entry: simply potatoes 5fix.  a combination of 2 of my favorite foods, this creamy, cheesy casserole is made with simply macaroni & cheese and layered with chopped spinach.  buttery and cheesy breadcrumbs top this delicious dish and give it an added punch of flavor.

1. heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. coat a 2-3 quart glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. set aside
4. transfer 1 package of the heated simply macaroni and cheese to the bottom of prepared baking dish and spread evenly
5. top evenly with spoonfuls of spinach
6. cover spinach with 2nd package of macaroni and cheese and spread evenly
7. in a small bowl , combine the breadcrumbs , butter and cheese
8. sprinkle over casserole
9. bake for 30-35 minutes or until hot and bubbly and crumbs are just starting to brown
demonstrations.review: Sounds wonderful!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crispy shrimp stuffed pork meatballs   rsc

ready, set, cook! hidden valley contest entry.  i wanted to do something creative for an appetizer -- so i came up with this.  these meatballs are packed with so much flavor!  the bread crumbs help keep the outside crispy & the ranch is layered all throughout the whole thing.  thesse were easy to make & absolutely delicious!

1. in a bowl , mix bread crumbs , parmesan & 1 tablespoon hidden valley original ranch dip mix
2. set aside
3. place shrimp on a plate & sprinkle with 1 teaspoon hidden valley original ranch dip mix
4. in another bowl ,
5. mix pork with half of the bread crumb mixture & egg
6. mix well
7. add 1 / 2 of chives to remaining bread crumbs
8. place one shrimp in the center of a scoop of pork & tightly form into balls
9. roll balls in remaining
10. bread crumbs
11. fry meatballs in a non stick skillet for 10-12 minutes until cooked thoroughly
12. while
13. meatballs are cooking , add remaining hidden valley original ranch dip mix & remaining chives to greek
14. yogurt
15. mix well
16. drizzel yogurt in martini glasses
17. place meatballs in glass & serve immediately
18. serves 4
demonstrations.review: Creative presentation and full of great flavors!

target.recipe_text:
sauteed  mushrooms with garlic

a must with steak! you may adjust the amount of garlic to taste :)

1. melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. add in garlic and cook stirring for 2 minutes
3. add in the sliced mushrooms and cook stirring for about 4-5 minutes
4. sprinkle with lemon juice then season with salt and pepper
5. delicious !
target.review: I love mushrooms and these were delicious. I could sit and eat the whole pound on my own of these. I make mushrooms this way all the time but never thought to add lemon juice. It added a real nice flavor and put on my grilled burgers. Kittencal is there any recipe of yours that doesn't taste good ?? So far I have not come across any. Every recipe is so delicious. You are one talented woman chef, thank you so much for your posts.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chinese pork chops

tasty but requires marinating time.

1. mix all ingredients , except crumbs and chops
2. marinate chops in mixture for a minimum of 3 hours
3. coat chops with corn flake crumbs and bake on a cookie sheet at 350 for about 45 minutes
demonstrations.review: These were very moist pork chops. Marinated them for the whole day. I did add some extra garlic and I too only had Special K on hand to coat them with. They turned out delicious. I made them with Chinese green beans and Chinese spaghetti. Every thing went well together. I will definitely be making these again. Thanks for posting a great recipe Graybert.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s famous greek salad

be prepared for the best greek salad on the planet! --- plan ahead the dressing needs at least 2 or more hours to blend the flavors, i sometimes add in 1/4 cup parmesan cheese to the dressing for a more cheesy dressing, all amounts may be adjusted to taste ----  to marinade the salad allow to sit at room temperature before serving, see bottom of instructions --- you will find this and many more of my recipes posted here http://kittencalskitchen.com/2009/04/13/kittens-famous-greek-salad/  ---also see my recipe #359292

1. for the dressing
2. in a processor or use a wire whisk process / whisk the olive oil with lemon juice , 2 teaspoons dried oregano , garlic , dried , basil , red wine vinegar , salt and sugar until smooth
3. season with black pepper
4. chill in fridge for a couple of hours before using to blend flavors
5. place the salad ingredients in a large bowl
6. pour dressing over
7. toss to combine
8. if desired allow the salad to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving , or you can refrigerate for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Fantastic Kittencal !! Another delicious recipe. I used about 3/4 cup oil and put in some paremesan cheese too. For the salad ingredients I used a red pepper because of choice and used Campari tomatoes (a little bigger than cherry) just so much more flavor for me. I have yet to find a good tomatoe in this area at any time of year. This made for a very fantastic lunch for us. I just added an egg on the side to make it more filling of a lunch. Thanks again Kitten for a wonderful meal.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
upside down rhubarb muffins

i found this in a country cooking cookbook. it is not overly sweet which is why i enjoy it.

1. combine rhubarb , melted butter and brown sugar in a small bowl
2. divide amongst 12 greased muffin cups
3. beat together butter , sugar and egg until fluffy
4. combine flour , baking powder , salt and nutmeg and add to creamed mixture alternately with milk
5. stir just to moisten
6. spoon into muffin cups , on top of rhubarb mixture
7. bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 to 25 minutes
8. invert on cooling rack and leave pan over muffins for a few minutes so all rhubarb moisture runs out
9. serve warm
demonstrations.review: These muffins were absolutely Yummy !!!  Took 20 minutes in my oven. Your right they are not overly sweet at all. They were perfect, I just love rhubarb. Thanks for sharing this recipe Pink Diamond.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lobster   mango sandwiches

clipped from gourmet magazine's "you aked for it" section, and originally came from the mezzanine restaurant.you can subsitute bacon for the pancetta if you prefer, simply cook it without the honey, then drizzle with honey after cooking. you need a good hearty crusty bread for this recipe, but sliced rather thin.  this is a wonderful, decadent, special sandwich.  simply luscious.  i used real lobster and french poulaine bread for this.  i think jumbo shrimp would also work, as would lump crabmeat.  this is a very large sandwich... very much a meal on its own.

1. brush honey over pancetta slices , heat a skillet over fairly high heat , add a tiny drop of oil and cook pancetta just a few seconds on each side until it gets crispy , drain on paper towels
2. combine lobster , mango , cucumbers , mayo , salt and pepper to taste
3. in another bowl , mix together lettuce , sun dried tomatoes , and basil
4. grab some long toothpicks and 2 plates -- you will be stacking 2 sandwiches
5. spread a little extra mayo on 2 of the toast slices , then top each with the lobster mixture , another piece of toast on top of that , then the lettuce mixture , the pancetta , then the remaining toast pieces
6. stick 2 long toothpicks into each sandwiches to hold them together , then use a serrated knife to cut each sandwich into halves
7. remove toothpicks before eating
demonstrations.review: This was a delicious unique sandwich. The flavor of the lobster and mango mixture was so good. I had used pancetta because my friend doesn't like bacon. I had also bought 2 lobster tails which I steamed and it had the right amount I needed.  I found it easier to dice the sun dried tomatoes rather than slicing. I had bought Chicago Italian bread and it worked out perfectly, I just lightly toasted it in the oven under the broiler for a few seconds each side. Thanks HeatherFeather for this great recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
lobster thermostat

or did i mean 

1. preheat oven to 400f
2. thaw the lobster tails , remove the meat from the shells and cut into 1-inch medallions
3. steam the lobster until almost done
4. then mix with cheese and chives and place in a 16-ounce casserole dish
5. heat the chicken stock and cream in a small pot over medium heat
6. make a roux with melted butter and flour
7. add to the chicken stock and cream while stirring constantly
8. cook until the sauce is thick and creamy , add wine and white pepper
9. pour the sauce over the lobster and then bake at 400f for 10-12 minutes or until the lobster if fully cooked and cheese is melted
demonstrations.review: This is definitely getting 5 stars. It was absolutely delicious. I was lucky lobster tails were actually on sale this week...yippee..So I made this dish for my DD and myself. I made this dish for the two of us for under half of what this would of cost in the restaurant for just one person. We both just loved it tremendously. Her first time trying lobster anything and she surprised me by eating all of it. I had just made some buttered noodles and layered the lobster on top. The sauce was so good. I was quite surprised at how quick this all came together. I can see this dish being a great one for when company is around. I forgot to take the pic of it in it's actual dish, it looked fantastic. These pics don't give it the due justice. Thanks so much for this recipe Mille. It was well enjoyed.

target.recipe_text:
oven fried garlic chicken

i gave this recipe from the "365 ways to cook chicken" cookbook an a+! it's easy and you'll probably have most of the ingredients already on hand.

1. preheat oven to 350
2. in a shallow bowl , blend together bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , parsley , salt , and pepper
3. in a small saucepan , heat butter and garlic over very low heat until butter melts
4. remove from heat
5. brush chicken pieces with garlic butter , then roll in bread crumb mixture to coat
6. place chicken skin side up on a large foil-lined baking sheet
7. mix together any remaining crumb mixture and butter and sprinkle over chicken
8. place in oven and bake 1 hour
target.review: Definitely a solid recipe. The only big issue I had with the recipe is that my chicken dried out.... I was pretty surprised by that after reading no other reviewers with this issue. Regardless, the breaking was fantastic. Next time I'll use chicken thighs instead of breasts and I'm sure that'll fix the problem. Served with mashed potatoes and gravy and green beans with garlic.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grilled maple chipotle pork chops on smoked gouda grits

from southern living.  the sweetness of the pork and the salty of the gouda grits make this a perfect combination.

1. whisk together first 4 ingredients , and set aside
2. sprinkle pork chops evenly with salt and pepper
3. grill , covered with grill lid , over medium-high heat 20 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 155 , turning once
4. baste with half of barbecue sauce mixture the last 5 minutes of cooking or when meat thermometer registers 145
5. spoon smoked gouda grits evenly onto 6 serving plates
6. top each with a pork chop , and drizzle evenly with remaining barbecue sauce mixture
7. gouda grits:
8. bring first 4 ingredients to a boil in a medium saucepan
9. gradually whisk in grits
10. cover , reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , 5 minutes or until thickened
11. add cheese and butter , stirring until melted
demonstrations.review: While a good recipe, I don't think I'll ever make it again. I didn't particularly love the grits (I may just not be a grits person.) but the pork chops were actually pretty great. So if you love grits, this is probably a great recipe for you.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pad thai  thai stir fried noodles

a native thai woman made this for a thai cooking class. this is how she learned to make it from her mother. we tasted the dish and it was great. we did not have pad thai sauce with it but she said the store bought type was fine. vegetables or tofu may be substituted for the chicken. she noted that overcooked noodles do not stir-fry well and do not look good. if using fresh noodles, instead of dried, they will cook in less than 1 minute.

1. boil noodles until just soft
2. drain water and place noodles in separate bowl
3. meanwhile , heat 3 tbsp oil in wok on high heat
4. add garlic , shallots , oyster sauce , chicken and stir-fry until cooked
5. move mixture to 1 / 2 of wok and add eggs on empty 1 / 2 of wok
6. cook eggs
7. mix eggs and chicken
8. add noodles , fish sauce , vinegar , soy sauce , black pepper and brown sugar , stirring quickly so that noodles do not stick together
9. stir in bean sprouts , green onion and peanuts
10. garnish with fresh cilantro and a quick squeeze of lime juice
11. serve immediately , with pad thai sauce , as desired
demonstrations.review: I love this dish. I don't remake a lot of dishes but this one deserves it. Really solid recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
thai noodles with spicy peanut sauce

this is a recipe that i've tweeked and adjusted to yield a warm noodle side-dish. it can also stand alone as a main dish. it's quick and easy and full of flavor! i serve it with chicken satay. leftovers are yummy hot or cold.

1. cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions
2. drain and return to pot
3. add 2 tbsp sesame oil and toss to coat
4. set aside
5. heat remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil in heavy pot over medium-high heat
6. add green onions , carrots , stir-fry veggies , garlic and ginger
7. saute until vegetables soften , about 4 minutes
8. add honey , peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar and chili-garlic sauce and mix well
9. simmer sauce 2 minutes
10. pour sauce over pasta and toss well
11. transfer to platter and serve warm
12. garnish with additional green onions , if desired
13. yields 8 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings
14. chili-garlicsauce can be increased or decreased depending on how spicy you like your dish
15. as written , this recipe has some heat , but is still edible for my toddler son
demonstrations.review: Great recipe! I made the recipe as is except for using fresh veggies instead of frozen. My only suggestion is to not plan on eating this as leftovers the next day as the noodles and veggies get a bit soggy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
japanese mum s chicken

we have a japanese girl, tomoko, living with us, and tonight she and i cooked a japanese dinner for us and her friends. she phoned her mum,toshiko, in japan for this, as it's her favourite recipe, and i wanted to share it here. it's simple and so good, and tomoko, who is only 16, did such a good job of cooking this, then translating the recipe to english for me.

*the liquid will thicken to a glaze if you are patient. it just takes a bit of time. if you feel your chicken is cooked (and going to overcook) remove it before going on to reduce the liquid. same thing, if you must use breast meat, remove it (so it doesn't dry out) and continue reducing the liquid . if you do it this way rather than thickening with cornstarch you will get a richer glaze and not need to add stock or broth instead of the water. it just takes patience. and note: a glaze is sticky and coats the meat, this is not a sauce.

1. place all the ingredients in a saucepan over a high heat
2. bring to the boil , then reduce to a simmer for about 20 minutes
3. remove any scum that rises to the surface
4. increase the heat , turning the drumsticks frequently in the liquid , and cook until the liquid has reduced to a sticky glaze
5. arrange the chicken on a serving platter , remove the garlic clove and chili from the liquid , and spoon the glaze over
demonstrations.review: Yum yum yum! Couldn't have loved this more! Just be prepared for a messy meal and have the napkins ready. I chose to double the sauce to put over rice and I don't actually think that was the right decision, it really is best as a glaze. Served with snow peas (great choice) and white rice, which probably wasn't the perfect pairing. Next time I'll pair this dish with something other than white rice...just not sure what yet. Maybe a light Asian soup or salad...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken  shrimp and andouille jambalaya

a cajun classic, meal in one pot! have the hot sauce ready to splash on. serve with some crusty french bread, a nice crisp salad, and some of your favorite wine. :)

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. in a large pan or dutch oven , brown chicken in hot oil on both sides
3. remove and drain
4. add andouille , onion , celery , bell pepper , thyme , oregano , paprika , salt , and cayenne pepper to the pan , cooking and stirring for about 5 minutes until onions are tender
5. add rice , tomatoes with juice , and broth
6. bring to a boil
7. place rice mixture in a baking dish or oven-proof casserole
8. top with chicken
9. cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 40-45 minutes or until rice and chicken are done and tender
10. stir in shrimp , parsley , and green onions
11. cover and cook 5-8 minutes longer or until shrimp curl and turn bright pink and serve
demonstrations.review: So simple, yet so delicious! The only thing I did differently than the recipe was not adding shrimp. I'm sure shrimp would have been delicious if fresh but all I can really get where I am is frozen. Highly recommend this recipe!

target.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken vindaloo

for the vegetarian version: use your favorite veggies, omit the cinnamon stick. this is my sister's recipe (thank you najla! xoxo), she made it on the stove top. it's really yummy!!

1. puree first 10 ingredients in a blender
2. pour into the crock pot , add tomato sauce , cinnamon stick and onion and mix well
3. add chicken and turn to cover
4. cook on low for 5 hours
5. sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving
6. serve with rice or rolls , enjoy !
target.review: followed it exactly and it was wonderful,i love indian food and the fact it was in the crockpot was great,thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cheese and garlic drop biscuits

these are very similar to red lobster's cheddar bay biscuits but a lot better than the recipes that start with bisquick, in my opinion. the kids adore them.

1. combine flour , salt , baking powder , cream of tartar , sugar and 1 / 8- 1 / 4 teaspoons garlic powder in a mixing bowl
2. cut in shortening using a pastry blender
3. mix milk and then cheese into mixture with a wooden spoon
4. drop by large spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet
5. bake at 425f for 10-12 minutes
6. mix melted butter and 1 / 8 teaspoons garlic powder together and brush on warm biscuits as soon as you remove them from the oven
demonstrations.review: WOW!!!!They are dead on!!!!so simple yet so light and delicious. My only complaint is the recipe doesn't make enough LOL.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
sweet sub style sandwich bread

my family loves this bread recipe.  it's easy to make and it is so different from other recipes.  it's a slightly sweet bread and makes a fantastic sub-style sandwich.  the guys at my husband's job beg me to make this.

1. put ingredients in bread machine in order recommended by manufacturer
2. process on dough cycle
3. when cycle is complete , remove from machine to floured cloth or board
4. cut dough into six pieces and shape each piece into a long loaf
5. place on a greased baking sheet
6. cover and let rise 20 to 30 minutes
7. bake at 350 for 15 to 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: tried these for the first time today,i'm making meatball subs using meatball recipe #1693.they were easy to do and i will definatly be keeping this recipe ,thanks!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
portuguese chourico and kale soup  adapted from rachael ray

there are a couple of other sausage and kale soups on 'zaar, but none like this.  it is a just a bit spicy and filling and soothing and a meal in itself. (ok, maybe with an apple for fruit...or apple pie! :-)

1. heat the olive in a pot over medium high heat
2. add potatoes and onions , cover and cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. add garlic , bay leaves , and kale to the pot
4. cover pot and wilt greens for about 5 minutes
5. season with salt and pepper
6. add beans , tomatoes , sausage , and broth to the pot and bring soup to a full boil
7. reduce heat back to medium and cook 5 to 10 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
demonstrations.review: This wonderful,so full of flavour ,it is this recipe that made us fall in love with chorizo.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
50  whole wheat bread

this is our "everyday" lunch bread. i make it every night for the next day. i originally got it from the oster bread machine recipe book but i adapted it somewhat. the 100% whole wheat recipe was just too heavy for our family. it makes a 2 lb loaf. once i started making this bread, i couldn't go back to store bought!

1. put the ingredients into the bread machine pan in the order listed
2. select the whole wheat bread cycle
3. remove from the pan when it's done and let cool for 15 minutes before slicing
4. during the summer i reduce the yeast to 1 tsp because it seems to rise so much more during the summer than the winter
5. or you could increase the salt slightly so if you're getting a really huge loaf try one of these 2 things and it should be better for you
6. for some reason atmospheric pressure makes a difference in how a bread rises
7. enjoy !
8. thanks for all your great reviews ! another thing i've been doing to make this even healthier is adding 2 tablespoons of ground flax seed with the flour
9. it doesn't really change the flavour but adds some good for you omega 3s !
demonstrations.review: excellent!!my machine doesn't make great whole wheat bread but this rose well and had a great light even texture!!it was good to find a 2lb recipe too.by the way i used olive oil instead of margarine for health reasons and brown sugar in place of honey just because i'd run out .excellent any more 2lb recipes bring them on!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chimichurri

this too easy sauce, of argentine origin, makes your steak taste like it was just dragged through the garden! great on rare, chargrilled, flank steak.

1. pulse parsley in processor to chop
2. add remaining ingredients and blend
3. separate sauce into equal parts
demonstrations.review: Amazing,my husband is completely hooked.We had it on steaks the first day and used it to marinate chicken the second day.Thanks for posting!

target.recipe_text:
kittencal s parmesan orzo

this makes a great side dish with chicken or fish, the dried chili flakes are only optional i like to add in for a little heat you may omit if desired, use a good quality chicken broth for this, make certain to saute the orzo until just lightly browned it really improves the flavor of this dish! ;)

1. melt butter in a medium heavy saucepan over medium heat , add in onion , thyme and red pepper flakes saute for about 3 minutes
2. add in orzo and cook stirring with a wooden spoon until orzo is slightly browned
3. add in garlic and cook for 2 minutes
4. slowly add in the chicken broth
5. bring to a boil , reduce heat to low
6. cover and simmer until the orzo is tender and the liquid is absorbed
7. mix in the parmesan cheese , salt and black pepper
8. transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with more parmesan cheese if desired
target.review: This was a long awaited, well worth the wait recipe. I served it alongside Recipe #167498 and good lordy was it delicious! I set it on top of some melted mozzarella and marinara sauce left over in the pan from baking the Parmesan. It was so good my DH was trying to trick me out of my dinner to eat mine too!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red enchilada sauce

a very basic and mild red enchilada sauce that can be used in many ways. can easily be made hotter by adding spices, jalapenos or using hot chili powder. it is quick and easy.

1. mix spices and flour in olive oil in saucepan over medium heat until fragrant and starting to brown
2. slowly add chicken broth and tomato sauce and cook and stir until thickened
3. use as red sauce over any beef , game , cheese or poultry enchiladas
4. a good mild sauce than can be easily"warmed" up by adding jalapenos , chipotles or other spices
demonstrations.review: This was a fantastic enchilada sauce. I halved the recipe and it was a little thin so I added 2 teaspoons of flour and it came out perfectly. Thank you so much for sharing this recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
classic from the box all bran muffins recipe

the same recipe that used to be on the box years ago.

1. stir flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. set aside
3. in large mixing bowl , combine all-bran cereal and milk
4. let stand 5 minutes or until softened
5. add
6. egg and oil
7. beat well
8. add flour mixture , stirring only until combined
9. portion batter evenly into twelve 2 1 / 2-inch muffin-pan cups coated with
10. cooking spray
11. bake at 400 degrees for about 15-20 mins or until lightly browned
12. serve warm
13. yield: 12 muffins
14. this from the all-bran cereal box !
demonstrations.review: I've been looking for this recipe for quite some time now and it's just as tasty as I remember. My mother used to make these when I was little and because of her little tweaks they were tasty treats! She added 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and a half teaspoon each of allspice and cloves. I did the same this time and they turned out perfect. Even my husband loved them!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
time to spare ribs

these ribs are so tender they fall off the bone. packed with flavor. very easy dinner.

1. preheat oven to 325f degrees
2. shake flour in the oven cooking bag
3. place the bag in a 13x9x2 inch baking pan
4. add bbq sauce , onion and bell pepper
5. squeeze the bag to blend ingredients
6. cut the ribs into serving size pieces and place in the bag
7. turn the bag to coat the meat with the sauce
8. arrange ribs in a single layer
9. close with a nylon tie
10. make a few slits in the top of the bag
11. bake 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender
12. variation: add ribs and beans dinner ingredients
13. relax , it is not burning
demonstrations.review: I absolutely hate to give low reviews, usually I know I'll like something before I even attempt to make it. I thought this sounded great and it got wonderful reviews, but for me they turned out bland and tough. I used 3.5 lbs pork spareribs, trimmed of most fat, and Bullseye BBQ sauce. I don't know if it was the recipe or some unforeseeable occurrence I don't know about, but they had very little flavor and tasted more boiled than baked. I think there was just too much moisture in the bag even with cutting the slits on top.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
krafts baked crab rangoon

i found this on the kraft website and have decided that i am going to make this for christmas eve.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. mix crab meat , neufchatel cheese , onions and mayo
3. spray 12 medium muffin cups with cooking spray
4. gently place 1 won ton wrapper in each cup , allowing edges of wrappers to extend above sides of cups
5. fill evenly with crab meat mixture
6. bake 18 to 20 minute or until edges are golden brown and filling is heated through
7. serve warm
8. garnish with chopped green onions , if desired
demonstrations.review: I found this recipe and was ecstatic that I could have one of my favorite appetizers without deep frying everything, but it's just not quite the same. I know when cooking low-fat and baking things vs. frying you give up a little bit of the original taste, but the won-ton skins just got brittle and tasteless. The filling was great but the skins...too hard and flavorless for me. Thanks for posting this recipe from Kraft, but I think I'll have to stick with my deep fried rangoons and only eat one or two.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
portabella parmesan

this was adapted from everyday italian. giada's mother is a vegetarian and this is one of her favorites!

1. place a grill pan over medium-high heat or preheat a gas or charcoal grill
2. drizzle 3 tablespoons of olive oil over both sides of the mushrooms , rubbing it in good
3. sprinkle the mushrooms with salt and pepper
4. brush olive oil on the grill to prevent the mushrooms from sticking
5. grill until the mushrooms are heated through and tender , about 5 minutes each side
6. preheat the oven to 400f
7. spread 1 / 2 cup of the marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9"x13" baking dish
8. place the grilled mushrooms on top of the marinara sauce and top with the remaining marinara sauce
9. sprinkle with the mozzarella and parmesan cheeses and top with the butter pieces
10. bake until the cheese melts and the top is golden , about 15 minutes
11. serve and enjoy !
demonstrations.review: Hol-y Cow. This is probably the best recipe I've tried on 'Zaar. Given the chance I'd easily give it 10 stars. I made it as directed with only one change, I added about two spoonfuls of breadcrumbs on top of the caps before adding the mozzarella. These were so good my DH was actually trying to trick me out of the rest of my dinner so he could eat it. Thank you so much for sharing this, it'll become a regular addition to our menu. - Made alongside Recipe #244861

target.recipe_text:
ham and noodle skillet

easy skillet dinner that kids generally love.  uses up leftover ham.   
i usually double this recipe.

1. cook noodles according to package directions
2. drain
3. in large skillet , melt butter and saute onion until soft
4. to skillet , add light cream , cheddar cheese , cream cheese , peas , ham and parsley
5. reduce heat to low
6. cook , stirring frequently , until cheese melts and mixture is hot and thickened
7. toss with hot cooked noodles
8. season to taste with salt and pepper
target.review: Comfort Food!  I love this because it is an excellent way to use extra ham.  I used reduced fat cream cheese and fat-free cream and it was still rich.  Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bbq meatballs  courtesy of pioneer woman

these really are so delicious, folks. they’re almost like little “meatloaf balls”, with a lot more flavorful surface area than a big slice of meatloaf. and the sauce is just a classic sweet/sour ketchup concoction and it makes you think of grandma. my kids love this dish, which is a miracle. and they’re delicious warmed up the next day and placed on a toasted sandwich bun with melted mozzarella on top. yikes.
*note that these meatballs are not in the same category of regular italian meatballs that would go in spaghetti and meatballs—those have more of a breadcrumb/parsley/parmesan flair. these are more in the comfort food/meatloaf category. if you’d like to serve them with pasta, regular egg noodles tossed in a tiny bit of melted butter would be divine.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. combine ground beef , oats , milk , 3t very finely minced onion , salt and black pepper
3. roll into medium-small balls and place on a cookie sheet
4. place sheet in freezer for five minutes
5. after 5 minutes , remove meatballs from freezer and immediately dredge in unseasoned flour
6. brown meatballs in canola oil until just brown
7. place into a baking dish
8. combine all sauce ingredients
9. pour over meatballs and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
10. serve with egg noodles , mashed potatoes , or crusty french bread
demonstrations.review: I love Pioneer Woman (thepioneerwoman.com).  This recipe was really good.  I made mine with ground venison so I reduced the cooking time by 15 minutes.  My son said it tasted EXACTLY like the meatballs in the meatball sandwiches at his SCHOOL.  Not exactly the review I was going for, but I was pleased he tried and enjoyed them.  I doubled the recipe and froze the other half of the meatballs for another time.  Thanks for reposting this recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
world s best grilled steak

tender juicy steaks on the grill are one of life's pleasures. this is the best marinade we have ever come across. it is the perfect blend of flavors and it leaves the meat tender without being overpowering.
note: i'm not sure of the origins of this recipe, i don't see a duplicate.  will post a picture.

1. blend all ingredients , pour over steaks
2. marinate 3 hours , turning frequently
3. grill to your liking
demonstrations.review: Our new favorite marinade!  I used reduced-sodium soy and only had time to marinade for an hour before grilling.  I will definitely make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
velveeta broccoli rice casserole

a good dish to serve as a side on a holiday or everyday occasion.

1. saute onion in butter until soft
2. add cream of chicken soup , milk and velveeta
3. heat the mixture until the cheese melts
4. add rice to the mixture
5. prepare the broccoli according to package directions
6. add to soup mixture
7. pour in a greased casserole and top with slices of velveeta
8. bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Pretty Good!  I used 2 cups of instant rice and didn't top it with Velveeta.  My son liked it so much he was willing to try the broccoli and he liked it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chickpea and fresh tomato toss

nan

1. rinse and drain chickpeas
2. place them in a bowl
3. add the tomatoes and onions
4. whisk remaining ingredients together
5. toss with chickpea mixture until coated
6. serve right away or refrigerate for up to 2 days
demonstrations.review: A yummy and an easy side dish to assemble.
