when you make your roast, save about 1/2 cup of au jus for this casserole.

1. in a sprayed or buttered casserole dish mix the roast beef , au jus , soup , cooked rice , 1 / 2 cup of shredded cheese and milk
2. melt the butter
3. add the bread crumbs to the butter and mix together
4. spoon the topping over the roast beef mixture and add 1 / 2 cup of cheese over the topping
5. bake in 350 degree oven for 25-30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Gotta love these easy versatile recipes!! I didn't have any au jus sauce from the roast so I used packaged beef broth, didn't have any cream of any kind soup but I did have condensed beef vegetable soup so I used that!  It was probably a bit runnier than it should have been but still very good!  I will make it again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
leftover roast beef soup  leftover steak too

this is great for my family because there aren't very many of us and sometimes a roast is just too much. soup is always a popular option here, and is a great way to warm up on a cold day. you could also use leftover steak in this, sliced thin.

1. in a large pot , cook onions , celery , mushrooms and garlic in butter or oil until onions are golden
2. stir in the chopped cooked beef
3. add the beef broth , and the worcestershire , stirring to mix , and seasoning to taste with salt and pepper
4. bring mixture to a boil and stir in uncooked egg noodles
5. reduce heat and cook , stirring occasionally , for 10-12 minutes or until noodles are tender
demonstrations.review: What a good, versatile recipe!  I didn't have celery so used carrots and since I had some potatoes I needed to use up I used them instead of the noodles.  When my dh saw it was soup, he wasn't happy (he isn't big on soup), but after tasting it, he said was good and that I should make it again!

target.recipe_text:
teriyaki sticky chicken   ww 4 points

a winning recipe from ww!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in a small bowl , combine the ketchup , brown sugar , vinegar , teriyaki sauce and mustard
3. spray and 8x8 inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
4. place 1 / 2 of the sauce into the bottom of the baking dish
5. place the chicken breasts on top of the sauce and cover the chicken with the remaining sauce
6. bake uncovered for 40 minutes , or until the chicken is done and the sauce has thickened
7. divide any sauce that is in the dish evenly over each piece of chicken
8. serve with rice for additional points
target.review: this was great!!! Never used teriyaki sauce before but this was absolutely delicious and would be good on porkchops as well. Thanks for a good recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kfc chicken secret spices

i've never tried this, just saw it on another board and had to snatch it up! there are actually 11 spices in the above combination, but an additional 3 ingredients were necessary to get that special flavor.

1. place all ingredients in blender and pulse for 3-4 minutes to grind well
2. store in an airtight container
3. makes about 3 / 4 cup
4. to use with flour , add 1 oz mix to 1 cup of flour for coating chicken
demonstrations.review: It made a nice, spicy coating for chicken , but I did not find it tasted like KFC. Did anyone else change the amount of anything in the ingredient list? I cooked it in the oven , maybe deep frying made the difference?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
whole wheat breakfast muffins

yummy, healthy, easy to prepare muffins.

1. mix in order as listed
2. do not over beat
3. spoon into greased muffin tins
4. bake at 350 degrees for 19 minutes
demonstrations.review: The taste was great, but mine did not look like any muffin I have made before..they were flat and lumpy. I followed the recipe as given , adding a few chopped walnuts. My husband wouldn't eat them- said they looked funny. Any ideas what I did wrong?

demonstrations.recipe_text:
easy dutch apple pie

the first apple pie i ever made; easy and simple directions. and real apples, no canned apple pie filling! i made this for dessert when company was over and i figured if i screwed up, i could always pass it off as apple cobbler with ice cream served over it, but it came out great, looked and tasted like a real apple pie!

1. combine flour , brown sugar , butter / margarine and oats
2. set aside 1 cup for the topping
3. press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 9 inch pie plate
4. set aside
5. for the pie filling: combine sugar , cornstarch and water in a saucepan until smooth , bring to a boil
6. cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened
7. remove from heat and stir in apples and vanilla
8. pour filling mixture into crust and top with the 1 cup crumb mixture
9. bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown
demonstrations.review: It took me a little more to prepare this than specified but it was worth it. Made an outstanding pie and was so easy to do! Next time may cut the flour & add more oatmeal to the crust. Is going to be a favorite in my home from now on.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fat free pancake

a healthy yummy breakfast treat for those avoiding fat. this makes one large pancake. you can multiply the recipe for multiple servings.

1. mix first four ingredients and enough milk to make a runny batter
2. spray a pan with olive oil spray
3. pour batter onto pan
4. fry on each side at medium heat for about 45 seconds
5. top with berries , honey , etc
demonstrations.review:
After reading the other reviews I was all syked to try this recipe this morning. I must have done something wrong as what I ended up with was a rubbery texture/tasting pancake...I slathered it with jam and ate it anyway (it was very filling) but I think maybe I didn't put enough milk in? Can someone tell me how much they use- just how runny is it supposed to be? After I let batter sit like someone suggested it got thicker again...I'd like to give it another go if I can get some help here

Debbie

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mom s secret ingredient meatloaf

my mother made the best meatloaf in town, but would never share her recipe saying it was just a basic meatloaf recipe with a 

1. mix ground chuck with breadcrumbs
2. add salt , pepper and egg
3. mixing with you hands now , add the heinz chili sauce and the milk
4. seperate the mixture in half and form 2 loaves
5. they will both fit comfortably in a 13" by 9" pan
6. mix the topping together and spread on the top and the sides of the loaves
7. cook at 375 for one hour or 400 for 45 minutes
8. check for firmness
9. let rest for ten minutes before cutting
10. if you have stale bread you can lay 2 slices under each loaf and it will soak up the grease so your meatloaf is a bit leaner upon serving
11. also , you can use the chili sauce on top of the meatloaf instead of catsup
12. this makes it spicier but my mother never did this because it would have given away her"secret ingredient" -- and the kids probably will like it better with catsup on top
13. enjoy !
demonstrations.review:
I made this the other evening and it was a big hit with the boyfriend. I thought the cheese was a nice touch. The meatloaf was really juicy & tasty and I will be throwing away my old recipe. I have a senistive stomach and I did get some indigestion (chili sauce ??) but it was worth it !

debbiec

target.recipe_text:
simple brioche

full of carbilicious deliciousness :p

1. in a bowl , mix the flour with the yeast , make a hole in the middle
2. add the warm milk mixing with the
3. add the sugar and a pinch of salt , then add the soft butter , piece after piece , waiting each time that each piece is asborbed
4. then one by one , add the eggs , mixing well between each
5. work the dough until it is elastic and detaches from your fingers more easily
6. cover and let rest in a warm place , away from drafts , for two hours , until it doubles in size
7. work the dough again for 10 min and divide it in four balls
8. place them in a greased rectangular mold and cover
9. let rise for an hour again
10. preheat the oven at 400f
11. brush the brioche with the egg yolk mixed with a dash of sugar
12. with a pair of scissors , make small cuts at the top of each ball
13. place in the oven to bake for 10 min at 400 c , then reduce the heat to 350 f and bake for about 20 to 30 minute
14. remove , unmold and let cool on a rack
target.review: The baking time is too long and 10 minutes at 400 F browns the top, sides and bottom too much. I'd suggest 6 minutes at 400 F and 20 minutes at 350 F. Also, add a bit of water to the 'egg paint' so that it's less icky thick. Overall, a lovely textured bun with a pleasant, subtle taste.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
indonesian beef rendang  rendang sapi

rendang sapi is one of the most popular dishes from padang, west sumatra. padang is known by their delicious meals made from coconut milk. you can make it spicy or mild, depend how you like it.i like it because the taste is really strong and aromatic. however,  it takes a bit longer time to cook so that the beef will be soft and tender. but it is definately worth to try =^_^=

1. grind or blend shallot , garlic , ginger , galangal , peppercorn and turmeric into paste
2. cut the beef into small but thick slices square
3. put the beef , spice paste and all other ingredients into a wok and bring slowly to the boil , stirring constantly to prevent the coconut milk from separating
4. cook over low heat , stirring from time to time , until the meat is very tender and all the sauce has evaporated
5. continue cooking the beef , which will fry in the oil that has come out from the coconut milk , until brown
6. serve with warm basmati or jasmine plain rice
demonstrations.review: Wonderful! Sounds very much like the Malaysian Rendang except that the Malaysian one has added dry-fried grated coconut towards the end of cooking time. I do wonder what the Salam leaves are, though. Tip for those trying it for the first time: If the Rendang gets dry before the beef is tender, just add a bit of water. (You can also reduce the amount of coconut milk if it's too 'strong' for you.)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cranberry bars

if you're from wisconsin you have to love cranberries. this is one of my favorite bar recipes and it mixes up very fast and is sooo good.

1. this is good with a powder sugar glaze or lightly sifted powder sprinkled on top
2. beat together eggs , butter , sugar and vanilla
3. add flour and baking powder and mix well
4. fold in nuts and cranberries
5. mixture will be cookie-consistency
6. spread into prepared 8x8 pan
7. bake@ 350 degrees 40-45 minutes
demonstrations.review: Rather too sweet. It's a good thing the cranberries added tartness.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
salmon pate spread

serve this pate with slices of party rye or cracker or your choice or with cucumber or other vegetable slices for a low-calorie variation. originally from a january 1981 issue of bon appetit magazine in the "food processor complete technique" section.

1. mince parsley using on / off turns
2. transfer to small bowl and set aside
3. mince onion by dropping through feed tube with machine running
4. add all remaining ingredients except salt and pepper and blend using on / off turns , then mix until smooth
5. taste and adjust seasonings
6. transfer to small serving bowl or shape into a mound on a small platter
7. cover and refrigerate overnight
8. sprinkle with parsley before serving
demonstrations.review: Sounds wonderful, but I will do it with smoked salmon and leave out the liquid smoke. Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft snickerdoodle cookies

these snickerdoodle cookies are so delicious, and they have the best texture. they are so fast to put together too! i actually got it from an old recipe that my great grandma had clipped out of a newspaper. grandma always knows best!

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. mix softened butter , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , 1tps of vanilla extract and eggs thoroughly in a large bowl
3. combine flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt in a separate bowl
4. blend dry ingredients into butter mixture
5. chill dough , and chill an ungreased cookie sheet for about 10-15 minutes in the fridge
6. meanwhile , mix 3 tablespoons sugar , and 3 teaspoons cinnamon in a small bowl
7. scoop 1 inch globs of dough into the sugar / cinnamon mixture
8. coat by gently rolling balls of dough in the sugar mixture
9. place on chilled ungreased cookie sheet , and bake 10 minutes
10. remove from pan immediately
demonstrations.review: The most interesting feature of this cookie is the light and tender texture -- thanks to the cream of tartar, I'm guessing. The taste is nice (buttery!) but not particularly remarkable. I'd add vanilla, ground ginger, clove, cardamom and nutmeg to it -- oh, dear, I've turned it into a ginger spice cookie. ^_^ Guess I like spicy! By the way, I didn't cool the dough or the sheet and the cookies still kept their shape more or less.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
soft chewy molasses cookies

these are rich, sweet, chewy cookies.

1. preheat oven 350f
2. mix on low speed electric mixer shortening , molasses , 1 cup sugar and egg
3. cream mixture
4. slowly add the remaining ingredients except 1 / 2 cup of white sugar
5. mix on medium
6. get 1 / 2 cup white sugar and pour into plate
7. by teaspoonful roll dough into ball then into sugar
8. place each cookie on greased baking sheet
9. bake 5-10 minutes
10. you are looking for cookie to puff up and start to crack slightly
11. take out as soon as cookies appear to have cracks allover
12. this will ensure you have a chewy cookie
demonstrations.review: Reduced the sugar by a third (still used full amount of molasses) and it was still pretty sweet! Had to be very careful as to the time in the oven. The cookies flattened nicely and you can barely lift them off the baking paper as they were still soft while hot. Mine took about 12 minutes in a 175 degrees C oven. Love the crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside texture and subtly spicy taste. Thanks, FarahC!

target.recipe_text:
fruit salad with pudding

i get compliments on this fruit salad wherever i take it. it is super easy to make and a great dish to bring to a potluck or family party. kids love it too. everyone asks "what's in the sauce"? the secret ingredient is the vanilla pudding mix.

1. in a large bowl , combine peaches , pineapples , and vanilla pudding mix
2. this includes the juices from the cans
3. mix well until pudding is dissolved
4. stir in strawberries , banana , blueberries , grapes , and sugar if desired
5. chill
target.review: Great recipe. This was very fast and easy to make and loved by everyone.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
rhubarb crisp

mom's recipe! easy to make and easy to eat.

1. combine rhubarb , sugar , flour and cinnamon and put into 8" x 8" x 2" glass baking dish
2. combine flour , brown sugar , rolled oats and melted butter and sprinkle streusel over rhubarb mixture
3. bake at 375 for 35 minutes
demonstrations.review: Great recipe, great topping  and very easy to put together. This did not last long and I will be   adding this to my cookbook! Thanks

demonstrations.recipe_text:
killer baked beans

it is a recipe i came up with by playing around and everyone loves them. i have them when i have barbecues or with a catfish or chicken fry!!! as far as taste it all blends in and is just awesome.

1. mix pork and beans , brown sugar , onion , worcestershire sauce , mustard , barbecue sauce , and liquid smoke together in baking pan
2. place bacon on top
3. bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for an hour or so !
4. yummmmm !
5. hope you enjoy
6. we have people over for barbecues and they are gone in no time
7. can never seem to make enough !
demonstrations.review: These beans are killer.Only thing I did different was to fry the bacon and onions in a skillet and added a small bell pepper! Will definitely be making again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spicy pretzels

my daughter got this recipe from her friends mom . the small pretzels work the best. and for some reason , the oil definitely makes a difference! we've made them with crisco, and we've made them with other brands, and they don't taste the same!
*** seems to be too hot for a few people , please adjust the cayenne pepper if you don't like hot***

1. put pretzels in a roaster pan
2. mix together the crisco oil , dressing mix , salt and cayenne pepper
3. pour over pretzels
4. toss thoroughly !
5. bake at 200 for 1 1 / 2- 2 hours
6. stir about every 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: Great recipe.Everyone loved them! Used a little over a pound of pretzels!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
garlic oven fries

great tasting oven fries.

1. preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. toss the potatoes with the olive oil
3. spread in a roasting pan and roast for 45 to 50 minutes , tossing occasionally , until cooked through and golden brown
4. just before the potatoes have finished roasting , melt the butter in a small saute pan
5. add the garlic and saute over medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes , until garlic begins to soften
6. set aside
7. transfer the potatoes to a large serving bowl and drizzle the garlic and butter over them
8. season generously with salt and pepper and toss to combine
9. keep warm until ready to serve
demonstrations.review: These fries are great. I left the skins on mine and also added some Parmesan cheese at the end. Very easy to make and very tasty!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked ziti

good italian comfort food!

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. cook ziti according to package directions
3. drain
4. set aside
5. mix ricotta , egg , parsley , 1-1 / 2 cups of the mozarella cheese , and parmesan cheese in a large bowl
6. mix cooked sausage and pasta in with ricotta mixture
7. mix in 3 / 4 jar of sauce
8. transfer mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish
9. top with the rest of the sauce and mozarella cheese
10. bake for 30 to 35 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
11. to freeze: cover dish with foil and freeze
12. when frozen you can pop it out of the container and put in a freezer bag if desired
13. to heat: thaw
14. preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
15. cover and bake for 20 minutes
16. uncover and bake for 10-15 minutes more
demonstrations.review: I thought this turned out great. Very fast and easy to put together. I used ground turkey and cottage cheese and it turned out great. Will make again for sure.

target.recipe_text:
sauteed spinach with red onion  bacon   blue cheese

we love this recipe, it's so good and easy to make. if making 4 servings it works better to use a dutch oven instead of a large skillet, and add 1 to 2 minutes to the spinach-cooking time. leave out the bacon for a vegetarian dish. the recipe comes from eatingwell.com.

1. heat oil in large nonstick skillet or dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. add onion and saute until beginning to soften
3. add garlic and saute until fragrant , about 30 seconds more
4. add spinach and cook , stirring , until just wilted
5. remove from heat
6. stir in bacon and sprinkle cheese on top , serve immediately
target.review: So delicious!  Even my 2-yr-old daughter couldn't get enough of it!  Thanks!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roast chicken with cumin  paprika and allspice

the middle eastern spices infuse a wonderful, exotic flavor to the chicken. the aroma of this roasting in your oven may inspire you to belly dance!

1. preheat oven to 375
2. rinse chicken
3. pat dry
4. place chicken on rack in large roasting pan
5. stir oil and next 7 ingredients in small bowl to form paste
6. rub spice paste all over chicken
7. roast chicken 1 hour
8. squeeze juice from lemon halves over chicken , place lemon halves inside main cavity
9. continue to roast until chicken is cooked through and thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 175 , about 1 hour longer
10. transfer to platter , let stand 15 minutes
demonstrations.review: Delicious!  I didn't have any allspice, but I read that a mix of cinnamon and nutmeg is a good alternative, so that's what I used.  I cooked only 2 chicken breasts, but slathered the entire amount of seasoning all over them.  Yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
miso  glazed salmon

from cooking light (november 2002).

1. preheat broiler
2. combine first 4 ingredients , stirring with a whisk
3. arrange fish in a shallow baking dish coated with cooking spray
4. spoon miso mixture evenly over fish
5. broil 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork , basting twice with miso mixture
6. sprinkle with chives
demonstrations.review: I just finished eating this salmon, and it's a keeper!  My husband and I devoured it, and then picked at the little flakes left behind, wishing I'd made more.  The best part is that it only took about 10 mins start to finish!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
special green bean casserole

great for holiday dinners.

1. saute onion in butter
2. add flour , salt , sugar and pepper
3. mix in sour cream , beans and cheese
4. pour into 9x13 baking dish
5. top with cornflakes
6. bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
demonstrations.review: I love this recipe!  I never make the cream of mushroom version anymore.  I do add a jar of mushrooms to the mix though.  Don't be afraid of the swiss cheese- the suace turns out creamy and tangy.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mama s supper club tilapia parmesan

you asked for it. here it is. thanks so much to mama's supper club. wish we could all go there.

1. preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. in buttered 13-by-9-inch baking dish or jellyroll pan , lay fillets in single layer
3. do not stack fillets
4. brush top with juice
5. in bowl combine cheese , butter , mayonnaise , onions and seasonings
6. mix well with fork
7. bake fish in preheated oven 10 to 20 minutes or until fish just starts to flake
8. spread with cheese mixture and bake until golden brown , about 5 minutes
9. baking time will depend on the thickness of the fish you use
10. watch fish closely so that it does not overcook
11. makes 4 servings
12. broil 3 to 4 minutes or until almost done
13. add cheese and broil another 2 to 3 minutes or until browned
14. thank you mama's supper club in wisconsin
demonstrations.review: This is my new favoriter tilapia dish.  The topping is very flavorful.  I did have a lot of butter floating aorund the baking dish after it cooked, so less could definately be used without affecting the recipe.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red lobster cheddar bay biscuits

don't you just love the copycat recipes? here's another one, and if you like red lobster's biscuits, this is the recipe for you. they may not be the exact biscuits, but you will not notice a difference in the taste.

1. heat oven to 450
2. combine baking mix , water and grated cheese in a bowl
3. roll out on a lightly floured surface , until 1 inch thick
4. cut biscuits , and place on an ungreased pan
5. melt butter and spices together
6. brush the biscuits with the butter and bake for 8 to 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: I made these with refigerated biscuits and just mashed some cheddar into each one, using the same butter mixture in this recipe to coat them.  They really did turn out just like Red Lobster's, and are so easy and quick to make!

target.recipe_text:
to die for crock pot roast

amazing flavor, and so simple! no salt needed here. in fact, you may wish to use half the ranch dressing mix to cut back on the saltiness. found this crock-pot pot roast recipe on of a website called www.recipegoldmine.com. it's all the rage there, so i thought i'd try it.

1. place beef roast in crock pot
2. mix the dried mixes together in a bowl and sprinkle over the roast
3. pour the water around the roast
4. cook on low for 7-9 hours
5. use onion soup mix instead of ranch
6. add one cup , of red wine
7. add potatoes , carrots , mushrooms , celery and onion 2-3 hours before end
target.review: Such great flavor; I make this at least once a week or so! I drool every time I even think about making it! My 1 year old daughter LOVES it too! Just falls apart, yum!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crumb topped banana muffins

these are so good. we love the topping.

1. in a large bowl , mix the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
2. mix bananas , sugar , egg and melted butter
3. stir into dry mixture until thoroughly combined , then stop mixing
4. fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. combine brown sugar , flour , and cinnamon topping ingredients
6. cut in cold butter until crumbly
7. sprinkle over muffins
8. bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes , until muffins test done
9. cool in pan for 10 minutes
demonstrations.review: Wow; what a muffin! Very yummy, even with wheat flour!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mashed red potatoes with garlic and parmesan

the potatoes are ready in our garden, and this is the first recipe i reach for! these are so good!!

1. put potatoes and garlic in lg pan
2. cover with water
3. bring to a boil
4. reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes , until potatoes are tender
5. drain well
6. mash with the butter , milk , and salt
7. stir in the parmesan cheese
demonstrations.review: I added about 1/2 cup of light sour cream also and made them extra yummy! Thanks for the recipe!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
roasted kielbasa   potatoes

another recipe from mom. these are good and easy to throw together.

1. preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. mix all ingredients in a large bowl
3. pour into a 9x13" baking pan
4. cook in oven , covered with foil for approximately 1 hour
5. you can stir after 1 / 2 hour of cooking
demonstrations.review: I added 1/2 sliced green bell pepper, 1 Tbsp minced garlic and 1 chopped meium onion; and WOW~ my husband didn't leave a trace of it for leftovers!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s moist cheddar garlic oven fried chicken breast

this is for serious garlic lovers. the chicken bakes out so moist and tender! grated cheese may be sprinkled on top of the breast the last 5 minutes of cooking if desired but that is optional. double all ingredients for more than four breasts and adjust the amount of garlic to suit taste. for the coating amount you might be able to get away with 5 or maybe 6 very small chicken breasts, but i would suggest to increase the amount slightly --- to take this dish to yet another level, about 10 minutes before the cooking time is finished, drizzle the top of the chicken with a little pasta sauce, then sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top. return to oven for about 10 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked and sauce is hot and cheese has melted. for a lemon-garlic flavor add in 3 tablespoons lemon juice to the melted butter/garlic mixture ---  *note* for a healthier alternative smart balance butter blend may be used in place of the melted butter --- you will love this chicken!
visit my food blog, www.kittencalskitchen.com, for more of my recipes.

1. preheat oven to 350f
2. butter an 11 x 7-inch pan
3. in a bowl , combine melted butter with fresh minced garlic , 1 teaspoon garlic powder and salt
4. in another bowl , combine the dry breadcrumbs with 1 / 2 cup finely grated cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon garlic powder and coarse ground black pepper
5. dip chicken in butter mixture
6. then in crumb mixture
7. place in prepared pan and bake uncovered for 35-45 minutes or until cooked through , larger breasts may take more time
8. top with shredded cheddar or mozzarella the last 5 minutes of cooking (this is only optional
demonstrations.review: Sensational! My husband requests this alot! Great flavor and so easy to make!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
oprah winfrey s deviled eggs

best i've ever had!!

1. hard boil eggs
2. cut each in half lengthwise
3. remove yolks and place in bowl with all other ingredients
4. mix well
5. spoon into egg whites and sprinkle with parsley & paprika
6. cover and refrigerate at least one hour or more
7. serve chilled
demonstrations.review: Can't get enough. I mean, I love deviled eggs but these are ridiculously good!!

target.recipe_text:
baked pineapple casserole

this is fantastic served as an accompaniment to ham, and very easy to make too! this may also prepared a day ahead, refrigerated, and baked the following day.

1. set oven to 350 degrees
2. grease a 1-1 / 2-quart casserole dish
3. cream butter and sugar
4. add in eggs
5. beat until combined
6. stir in drained crushed pineapple and bread cubes
7. pour into prepared baking dish
8. bake for 45 minutes , until lightly browned
9. serve hot or cold
10. delicious !
target.review: I made this for Easter Sunday brunch.  It was out of this world and received rave reviews!!!  I substituted Challah bread for the white bread and zipped it under the broiler for a few minutes at the end to get the top browned and crunchy.  Thanks for the recipe Kittencal, I knew if it was your recipe, it would be a hit!!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
best ever banana cake with cream cheese frosting

this is one of (if not) the best banana cake i have ever tasted! i thought the oven temp of 275° sounded a little low, but this cake baked up (and rose) beautifully in my oven at this temp after pretty much exactly one hour. i do not know if the little "freezer trick" to this recipe is what ensured its moistness or not, but i did it, and it was exceptionally moist & delicious. would be interesting to see if it still came out as great if this step was skipped. all i know is that i followed this recipe exactly as stated (except that i had no buttermilk, so i subbed with a mix of lemon juice & milk) and i got exceptional results. so moist and yummy...a dense cake, similar in texture to a carrot cake... i personally would not call this frosted banana bread :o)  depending on the amount of frosting you like you can decide whether to half the recipe or not. i used the full recipe and had some leftover. i sprinkled on the chopped walnuts and threw this baby in the fridge and cut it the next day...to die for! i really liked it slightly chilled, but great at room temp too! it got better each day it sat, i always make this cake at least the day before i need or want it.  i was extremely pleased with this cake and will be making it over & over again!! so glad i came across this one!! (on another website).


(* * just to update the recipe, (based on some of the reviews), the baking time may vary based on individual ovens. it was right on for my oven, but some others have stated it has taken 1 hour 10 minutes, 1 hour 20 minutes, and my sister just informed me that it took 1 hour 30 minutes in her oven!!!!!)

1. preheat oven to 275f
2. grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan
3. in a small bowl , mix mashed banana with the lemon juice
4. set aside
5. in a medium bowl , mix flour , baking soda and salt
6. set aside
7. in a large bowl , cream 3 / 4 cup butter and 2 1 / 8 cups sugar until light and fluffy
8. beat in eggs , one at a time , then stir in 2 tsp vanilla
9. beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk
10. stir in banana mixture
11. pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for one hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. remove from oven and place directly into the freezer for 45 minutes
13. this will make the cake very moist
14. for the frosting , cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
15. beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. add icing sugar and beat on low speed until combined , then on high speed until frosting is smooth
17. spread on cooled cake
18. sprinkle chopped walnuts over top of the frosting , if desired
demonstrations.review: This cake was moist and delicious.  My 14 year old niece made this cake for our mother's day luncheon and it was fabulous!!!  Will definately be making this cake again and again

demonstrations.recipe_text:
weight watchers 4pt  cola chicken

this chicken is absolutely delicious! serve over rice and enjoy!

1. in a skillet , mix ketchup and cola
2. add chicken and onions
3. bring to a boil and cover
4. reduce heat to medium and let cook for 45 minutes
5. remove lid and simmer until thickens
demonstrations.review: I had this at a party, it was made with legs and thighs, it was delicious! I made this recipe this evening, minus onions because I didn't have them on hand.  The family really enjoyed it.  I served it with rice and poured the extra sauce on the rice, huge hit!!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s perfect pesto

i have experimented with many ingredient amounts for pesto, i have finely found the one that has a perfect balance of flavor --- this will keep covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days, if you are storing it in the refrigerator i suggest to place a 1/2-inch layer of oil on top of the pesto and cover with a lid or you may freeze --- the success of this recipe will depend on the quality of parmesan cheese that you use, if possible try to use a good quality freshly grated cheese it really will make a difference with the taste of the pesto, and please use only kosher salt --- for red pesto; reduce the basil to 3 cups, and add 1/2 cup chopped oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes to the blender along with other ingredients.

1. combine the basil , olive oil , pine nuts and garlic cloves in a blender
2. blend until a paste form , stopping often to push down the basil
3. add in the parmesan cheese and kosher salt
4. blend until smooth
5. transfer to a bowl
6. if not using right away store the clean leaves in a sealed plastic bag with a slightly damp paper towel , the leaves should keep well refrigerated for up to 2 days
demonstrations.review: I had a whole bunch of basil that my sister had given me and didn't know what to do with it.  I have never made pesto before.  Like a lot of the other reviewers, I had walnuts, no pine nuts.  Gave it a whirl (literally lol).  I left out the salt and used whole peppercorns.  Oh my word, this was delicious.  I ate some of it with a spoon, used it on angel hair pasta and I even used it on my omelet in the morning!!!!  My sister tried it and loved it.  This beats store bought pesto hands down!  Kittencal, you've done it again.  I love love love your recipes.  Thanks so much for sharing!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
black russian bundt cake

i'd poke larger (then fork size) holes in this cake since it is a bundt, so more glaze soaks into the cake.

1. grease and flour 12-cup bundt pan
2. preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. in large bowl , combine cake mix , sugar , pudding mix , oil , eggs , vodka , kahlua and water
4. mix at low speed for 1 minute
5. beat 4 minutes more at medium speed
6. pour into pan
7. bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out dry , 60 to 70 minutes
8. let cake cool in pan for 10 minutes then take out of pan
9. meanwhile , prepare glaze by mixing powdered sugar with 1 / 4 cup kahlua
10. put cake on wire rack or cake plate
11. poke holes in cake with fork and slowly pour glaze over cake
demonstrations.review: A friend at work made this cake for my birthday and there was not a crumb left.  I made it for my husband's birthday and took the suggestion of Chef #444733 and substituted a dark chocolate cake mix, oh my!!!  So moist and delicious.  Very easy to make.  A keeper!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
baked pesto chicken

delicious hot from the oven, this flavor-packed chicken is also wonderful cold. made ahead and refrigerated for up to three days, this dish is perfect for a picnic.

1. preheat the oven to 375f coat a 13" x 9" baking pan with cooking spray
2. in a shallow bowl , combine the bread crumbs , tomatoes , and pepper
3. spread the pesto on the top side of the chicken breasts , then dip in the bread-crumb mixture , pressing to coat evenly
4. arrange the chicken , breast side up , in the prepared pan
5. drizzle with the reserved tomato oil
6. bake for 40 minutes , or until a thermometer inserted in the thickest portion registers 170f and the juices run clear
demonstrations.review: This recipe was very easy to make, smelled delicious while it was cooking.  I ate it cold and it was very tasty.  I passed the recipe on to my sister and I will definately make this again.  Thanks Chef Emanuela!!!

target.recipe_text:
roasted lemon chicken

this recipe is very easy to prepare.

1. cut up 1 lemon into 8 pieces and rub the outside of the chicken with the peel side of the pieces and then put the lemon pieces into the chicken with the garlic
2. season with salt and pepper
3. pour a mixture of half of the olive oil and half of the butter on top and pour the rest inside of the chicken
4. roast for 1 1 / 2 hours in a preheated oven of 325 degrees
5. half-hour before chicken is done roasting pour the juice from the second freshly squeezed lemon over the top and sprinkle the chicken with the chopped parsley and return the chicken to the oven to finish roasting
target.review: Very easy to prepare. The end result is TO DIE FOR! I got RAVE reviews from guests the first time I prepared this dish! This is to be a new favorite in my home! Thank you for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
peach skewers

this sounds so good, an easy summer time treat to have with any bbq. the recipe comes from meals in minutes for people with diabetes.

1. preheat grill or broiler
2. slice peaches in half and remove pit
3. cut each half into 3 slices
4. mix allspice and splenda together and toss peach slices in mixture , making sure all of the slices are coated
5. place slices on skewers and grill or broil 3 minutes , turn fruit over and grill or broil , serve warm
demonstrations.review: This is our NEW FAVORITE as a healthy dessert prepared on the grill. Can also make in the broiler. We love these and my friends request that I make them at every BBQ!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
grandma betti s lipton meat loaf

this is a recipe of my grandma's. it is simple and fast, but tastes great!

1. preheat oven to 375
2. in large bowl combine ground beef , lipton onion soup mix , ketchup , bread crumbs , and water
3. in shallow baking pan shape into a loaf
4. bake for 45 minutes or until done
demonstrations.review: This is fantastic, just like my grandma used to make! I used Milk instead of water and cooked in my crock-pot on low for 10 hours - it came out MOIST and DELICIOUS!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cinnamon coffee cake   kaffeekuchen

another great german recipe!

1. mix first three ingredients until crumbly
2. remove 1 / 2 c mixture and mix with cinnamon and nuts
3. reserve for topping
4. add baking soda and baking powder to step 1 mixture and stir to mix it all in evenly
5. add vinegar to milk to sour the milk
6. stir egg into the milk and stir vigorously with a fork to blend the egg
7. add to the dry mixture and stir just until blended
8. spray or grease a 9x13 pan and pour mixture into pan
9. top with reserved topping
10. bake at 350 degrees until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Outstanding! I did not have nuts, but it didn't need them! I used Soy Milk and Lemon Juice instead of the vinegar. Turned out PERFECT! This is a keeper! Highly recommended! Thanks for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yummy mashed potato bake

this is a great way to use up any left-over mashed potatoes....goes wonderful with any meal....just mix and bake, so easy to prepare.

1. preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. grease a 9-in square baking dish
3. in a large bowl , mix mashed potatoes with cream cheese , onion , eggs and flour
4. beat at medium speed until well blended , then at high speed until light and fluffy
5. add salt and pepper
6. spoon into prepared baking dish
7. top evenly with canned onions
8. bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes
demonstrations.review: Loved this recipe! I used up left over mashed potatoes, it was very easy to prepare. We didn't have french fried onions, and didn't need them. This is great even without that topping. I've already made this several times. Thanks so much for sharing!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
amazing chicken marinade

this recipe came from allrecipes (ruth crickmer). my whole family loved it even though it cooked too fast. the original recipe said 'high heat' on the grill, which my husband did. it ended up cooking 8 minutes total, charred but not burnt tasting, and very juicy and flavorful. we'll turn down the heat next time for texture, but this is a keeper in our home!

1. in a large , non-reactive container , whisk together ingredients beginning with cider vinegar through salt
2. then whisk in olive oil and pepper
3. place chicken in the mixture
4. cover and marinate chicken in the fridge 8 hours or overnight
5. remove chicken from marinade just before you turn on your grill or broiler to let come up a few degrees
6. discard marinade
7. lightly oil your grill or broiler pan
8. grill or broil about 10 minutes per side
demonstrations.review: I will never buy store made marinade again! This is FANTASTIC and easy to throw together with everyday ingredients. It makes even the toughest chicken incredibly tender! LOVE THIS!!

target.recipe_text:
eggplant  aubergine    appetizer     romanian style     vinete

annie swore by mazola oil... annie is my  mother; her children all affectionately called her annie.   
eggplant was relatively inexpensive.  it was used frequently in various romanian recipes prepared in my home.  i developed a taste for the eggplant's distinctive flavour and enjoy it to this day.

1. broil eggplant on all sides until well cooked -- turning frequently as it cooks
2. scrape the purple skin off , and discard skin
3. mash eggplant well with a wooden spoon ,
4. add salt and pepper , to taste
5. mix grated onions with one tsp of mazola oil
6. add to mashed eggplant
7. add remaining 1 / 4 cup of oil to eggplant slowly , stirring constantly
8. add lemon juice
9. mix well , and serve as an appetizer on crackers or other bread rounds
target.review:
GREAT !! 
We have this at our home often. My husband is romanian & this is his favorite! 
I first made it this way & now add mayonnaise instead of oil. 
I do think this is an acquired taste as most of my extended family & friends dont like it :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potato kielbasa skillet

a very hearty, tasty supper. this is very easy to make and a real pleaser.

1. in dutch oven , brown potatoes , kielbasa , onion and peppers in oil
2. add seasonings and water
3. bring to a boil
4. cover tightly and cook for 20 minutes on low , stirring occasionally
5. uncover and put cheese on top
6. simmer until cheese is melted
demonstrations.review:
It was GREAT! and I even forgot to add the cheese!! :)
Even my picky 7 yr old ate it (after picking out the onions & peppers). 
I added fresh mushrooms & use garlic olive oil instead of veg. oil & served with french bread. Quick & YUMMY dinner!
This is a keeper at our house.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
beef patties in onion gravy

good 

1. combine all patty ingredients
2. mix thouroughly with your hands and shape into 4 patties
3. spray a non-stick skillet , and brown patties on both sides
4. add dry onion soup mix and 1 1 / 2 cup water
5. cover pan tightly and simmer for 20 minutes
6. remove patties to a plate
7. in a gravy shaker or jar , combine 1 / 2 cup water with 2 tbs
8. flour
9. stir flour and water into onion gravy
10. stir constantly with a whisk until it comes to a boil
11. boil 1 minute
12. return patties to pan
13. serve with mashed potatoes or hot cooked noodles
demonstrations.review:
SUPER! The whole family enjoyed.
I followed the recipe but added fresh mushrooms & onions while cooking the beef patties ... it was a great addition to the gravy!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mediterranean fettuccine with shrimp and spinach

i got this off the back of some store-brand fettucine noodles and gave it a try. dh said to make sure i kept the recipe! it is very rich and i usually decrease the salt and dried basil to help that a bit, and i thinned it down just a bit with milk, but otherwise it's a fancy-looking dish with very little effort.

1. combine sour cream , feta , red pepper , salt , garlic , and basil
2. set aside
3. cook fettucine according to pkg directions , but after first 8 minutes , add spinach and shrimp to boiling water / pasta
4. boil 2 more minutes
5. drain thoroughly
6. add hot pasta / shrimp mixture to sour cream mixture
7. toss lightly
8. serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Very good ... quick & simple! I loved the feta cheese.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken pesto

this was my daughter's favorite dish (along with some of her friends). she enjoyed it so much that we had to make it a weekly recipe.

1. prepare pesto sauce according to package direction
2. heat oven to 350 degrees
3. spray rectangular dish with no-stick spray
4. moisten chicken with water , shake off excess , and coat complete with bread crumbs
5. place chicken in baking dish
6. spread pesto sauce evenly over chicken breasts
7. cover each breast with slice of provolone cheese
8. spread mushrooms over cheese
9. bake in oven for 45- 50 minutes
10. serve with pasta
demonstrations.review: Turned out good ... although the youngest wouldnt eat it! Served with fettucine alfredo, will make again sometime .

demonstrations.recipe_text:
tender london broil

tender and nicely seasoned.

1. take meat and score not all the way through , slice across and then across again to make criss cross pattern
2. rub meat with dry rub
3. place all marinade ingredients it storage bags toss add meat
4. refrigerate over night
5. heat grill to medium high
6. place meat on hot grill for 4 minutes then turn 1 / 4 turn for 4 more minutes
7. then flip and cook for 4 minutes turn 1 / 4 turn for 4 more minutes
8. remove from heat let sit for 10 minutes
9. slice against the grain very thinly
demonstrations.review:
This is GREAT!
This was my first time making London Broil & everyone enjoyed.
It's a keeper!!

target.recipe_text:
chocolate crisps  cookies

another from my old hand written cookbook of recipes i made when my girls were young for after school snacks or lunch boxes. yield depends on size of spoon used to put mix on trays.

1. bring to a boil ina pot the butter and sugar
2. addd the dry ingredients , vanilla and cocoa which has been mixed with a little hot water
3. place spoonfuls of miture onto cold baking tray and flatten lightly with a fork
4. bake at 350'f for 12-15 minutes
5. remove from oven and cool on a wire rack
target.review: SOOOO YUMMY!!  Brings back all sorts of memories!  Really easy to make and one batch has filled the tin!  Thx mum :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
yoghurt cake

a good lunch box cake. i picked this cake recipe up many years ago at a school tuck shop meeting. makes me think i am eating healthy because it has plain yoghurt in the recipe. *wink*

1. cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. add lemon rind and egg yolks and beat well
3. sift flour , fold in alternately with yoghurt , then add chopped mixed peel
4. beat egg whites until soft peaks form , then fold in lightly to the cake mix
5. spoon into a greased 9" x 5" loaf tin
6. bake in a moderate oven for 50 to 60 minutes
7. when cold , sprinkle with sifted icing sugar
demonstrations.review: It came out of the oven about an hour ago, and already half of it is gone!!  This cake is DELICIOUS!!!  Lovely and moist and so easy to make.  It will definitely be added to my regular baking in the future - THANKS!!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
any fruit fast fat free cobbler

this fabulous dessert is 3 ww points a serving and can be made with fresh, canned, or frozen fruit. it is adapted from a recipe in the 

1. combine all of the ingredients except the fruit in a bowl
2. pour it into an 8x8 pan coated with cooking spray
3. add the fruit right on top
4. the crust will come up over the fruit and cover it
5. bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes
demonstrations.review: This was so easy to make and tasted superb! No one had any clue that is was so low in fat!  I used Feijoas and apple - SOOOOO YUMMY!!!  This will certainly be made again and again...

demonstrations.recipe_text:
minado s perfect sushi rice

this is the recipe for sushi rice that i have learned from my father, the sushi chef at minado sushi. it's not really a secret recipe, many restaurants prepare rice this way, but it produces really great rice. more of a technique than anything. this is a response to a request in the forum and i hope you guys like it!

1. ignore the directions on the bag that the rice came from and rinse the rice only 3-5 times
2. the water does not have to run clear
3. place rice to drain in a strainer
4. drain for one hourin the winter , 30 min in the summer
5. while rice is draining , combine vinegar , sugar , salt and mirin together in a bowl and mix well
6. if using a kelp leaf , it should be about 2 in long
7. wipe it lightly , cut small slits to make it look like a comb and add it to a pot along with the water
8. add rice to the pot
9. bring quickly to a boil and then reduce to a simmer
10. cover the pot and don't touch it until the end , no peeking
11. cook for 15 minutes before removing the pot from the heat but keep the lid closed
12. let rice rest for 10 min and then remove the cover
13. place in a glass dish to cool and lightly fan the rice while adding the vinegar mixture
14. mix rice gently , careful not to break it
15. sushi rice is best used at body temperature
demonstrations.review: OhMiGosh - DELICIOUS!!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
banana  carrot   pineapple cake aka sunshine cake

this is a lovely iced cake  (lighter version of a carrot cake) or have as a buttered loaf. i can kid myself that it is good for me because of the ingredients :)
i saw this made on tv on the aww fresh cooking site (i think) and had to try it. it was a bit of a hit & miss with the ingredient amounts but i think i have them right as this is what i made mine with. i find i like to get all ingredients prepared first as then it is much easier to mix it altogether.  leave until cold before slicing)

1. preheat the oven to 180c
2. for the cake , line a 20cm cake tin , or for a loaf , line a large loaf tin
3. in a large bowl beat the eggs , sugar and lemon zest together until creamy
4. slowly add the oil while beating continuously
5. sift the flour , salt , and baking powder together and stir into the creamed mixture
6. fold in the banana , carrot , pineapple and chopped nuts until incorporated
7. spoon mix into prepared tin and bake for 55-60 minutes or until firm to the touch
8. remove from the oven and allow to sit for 10 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack
9. allow to cool and if a cake , ice and keep in an airtight container , or , if a loaf , wrap in plastic wrap to store , or place in an airtight container
10. serve the loaf either plain or buttered
11. icing:
12. in a medium bowl beat the cream cheese , icing sugar , lemon zest and juice until smooth
13. spread over the cooled cake and decorate with pecan or walnut pieces
demonstrations.review: Absolutely DELICIOUS!!  Not sure what the previous reviewer must have done to this cake, but it was lovely and moist and gobbled up in about 5 mintues flat.  Plenty of requests for the recipe too.  Soooo easy to make, and the cream cheese icing just adds to the MMMMMMmmmmmm factor  :)  I'll definately be making this again soon.  THANKS!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramelized garlic chicken

nan

1. heat oven to 500 degrees
2. line shallow roasting pan with foil
3. spray foil with nonstick cooking spray
4. heat oil in small nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until hot
5. add garlic
6. cook 1 to 2 minutes or until garlic begins to soften
7. remove from heat
8. stir in brown sugar until well mixed
9. place chicken breast halves in sprayed foil-lined pan
10. spread garlic mixture evenly over chicken
11. bake at 500 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear
demonstrations.review: Absolutely delicious!  I doubled the recipe like other reviewers and it was just divine - will definitely be making this one again - THANKS :)

target.recipe_text:
so simple punch

this is a very simple, but tasty punch. it is also fairly inexpensive, which is great when a large quantity is needed. you can changed the flavor of drink mix used in order to obtain a desired color of punch. i recommend freezing rings of pineapple juice or the punch for use in chilling in the punchbowl.

1. in a large punch bowl combine drink mix , pineapple juice , sugar and water
2. stir until dissolved
3. just before serving , stir in the ginger ale
target.review: This was a great punch for my DD's college graduation party.  I refilled the bowl 4 times, as it was hot and everyone was really thirsty!  Loved the combination of flavors from the juice and drink mix.  I also added an ice ring (Recipe #285411) to keep it nice and cold!  Thanks for sharing it with us!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
italian white lasagna

this is some lasagna! rich, with gouda, cheddar, cream cheese, and mozzarella, you won't be disappointed! posted in response to a request for a good italian lasagna! you may leave out the meat for vegetarian!

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. brown beef , celery , onion and garlic in a 1 tbls
3. oil
4. drain
5. stir in seasonings
6. add cream cheese and cream
7. cook over low heat until smooth
8. add wine , shredded cheddar and gouda
9. stir together egg and cottage cheese , set aside
10. layer cooked noodles , part of meat mixture , cottage cheese , half mozzarella
11. repeat until all is used
12. top with mozzarella
13. bake on top rack for 40 minutes
14. enjoy !
demonstrations.review: I made this recipe for my daughters going away to college dinner, and it was a big hit!  I loved the flavors of all the cheeses and the addition of wine in the recipe.  This is one recipe I will be adding to my favorites Sharon.  Thank you!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy burrito casserole

satisfy your craving for something different tonight. it's good and fairly easy. this is stuff i usually have on hand too.

1. brown ground meat / turkey & onion
2. drain
3. add taco seasoning and stir in refried beans
4. mix soup and sour cream in a separate bowl
5. spread 1 / 2 sour cream mixture in the bottom of a casserole dish
6. tear up 3 tortillas and spread over sour cream mixture
7. put 1 / 2 the meat bean mixture over that
8. add a layer of cheese
9. you could put some hot sauce on this now
10. repeat the layers
11. sprinkle cheese over the top and bake , uncovered , at 350f for 20-30 minutes
demonstrations.review: Instead of the refried beans I used brown rice mixed with Rotel tomatoes.  This was a killer meal.  We devoured it!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
caramelized chicken wings

nan

1. preheat oven to 375f
2. place chicken in a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. mix the oil , soy sauce , ketchup , honey , garlic , salt and pepper and pour over the chicken
4. bake at 375f for one hour or until sauce is caramelized
demonstrations.review: Made for my DD's graduation party from college.  These wings were devoured!  There was a good mix of flavors, which made for very tasty and satisfying wings!  I couldn't leave these alone!  Everyone else felt the same way.  Lots of compliments and positive comments about these wings!   Will make again for a snack or along with some other sides for dinner.  Yummy! Thanks for sharing your recipe with us!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
mama s bar b que  barbecue  chicken

this was a favorite dish my mother always cooked for my family.  she shared this dish at church suppers and reunions...now this generation enjoys it.  a good mix of flavors!

1. brown chicken pieces slowly in salad oil and remove from skillet
2. in same skillet cook onion and celery just until tender , but not browned
3. add remaining ingredients and simmer for 5 minutes
4. place chicken in baking pan and pour sauce over all pieces
5. bake uncovered in 325 degree oven for approximately 1 hour
6. baste with sauce after 30 minutes and just before serving
demonstrations.review: They aren't kidding, this is wonderful chicken!!! I made up the sauce then basted my chicken with it as it was cooking on the grill.  I saved about half of it and cooked it for awhile on the stove, to pour over the top before serving.  Yummy chick chick!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
linda s fiesta crab wheels

here is a recipe that i love, and have made several times. great for showers, parties, and family get togethers!  preparation time does not include chilling time in the fridge.

1. drain crab meat , and set aside
2. put the cream cheese into a glass dish , and microwave for 45-60 secs
3. , to soften
4. blend softened cream cheese with black olives , chilies , and green onions
5. gently fold in crab meat
6. spread crab mixture over entire surface of each tortilla with a thin coating
7. roll tortillas up , and wrap tightly in plastic wrap
8. refrigerate at least 4 hours
9. when ready to serve , cut each tortilla into 1 / 2" slices
10. put on a serving dish , and garnish with lime wedges and jalapeno slices
11. to spice it up a little more , you can also add jalapenos into the mixture , to your taste
12. if you like it more on the mild side , remove the seeds and the white part of the jalapeno , then cut into strips and dice into small pieces
13. you can make and freeze these ahead of time
14. just take out well before serving time , to thaw out
demonstrations.review: These tiny appetizers are packed with flavor and they looked so pretty on the table too!  They were fully enjoyed at my daughter's college graduation and I got asked about 10 times for the recipe. (Just so happened I made copies, because I knew how good they were. :) You don't have to wait for a party to have these though.  They are great for a snack while playing cards or watching the game, or any old time for that matter.  We loved them.  Thanks for sharing the recipe with us!

target.recipe_text:
greek potatoes  oven roasted and delicious

these potatoes are a staple in our home. whether accompanying roast lamb or chicken, or just on their own, we have them a couple of times a week. they are delicious and the ones that get overly-brown in the pan and stick a bit are mine!  clean up is a little tricky with this recipe, unless you line your pans with foil, but i find that just filling the pan up with hot, sudsy water and forgetting for an hour (something i apparently have no problem doing ;-)) helps a lot.

1. preheat oven to 420f a reviewer has suggested spraying the baking pan with pam - that sounds like a great idea !
2. put all the ingredients into a baking pan large enough to hold them
3. season generously with sea salt and black pepper
4. make sure your hands are very clean and put them in the pan and give everything a toss to distribute
5. the garlic will drop into the water / oil solution but its flavour will permeate the potatoes , and this way , it won't burn
6. bake for 40 minutes
7. when a nice golden-brown crust has formed on the potatoes , give them a stir to bring the white underside up , season lightly with a bit more sea salt and pepper and just a light sprinkling of oregano
8. add 1 / 2 cup more water if pan appears to be getting dry , and pop back into oven to brown other side of potatoes
9. this will take about another 40 minutes
10. do not be afraid of overcooking the potatoes- they will be delicious
target.review: Wow, I figured 196 people couldn't be wrong but I was a little skeptical about adding lemon to my potatoes.  I loved it.  Thanks for the great recipe.  I think we used a little less potato so we cut the oil in half and the water down a little too.  And I put my fresh oregano to use.  It needed a trim.  The tough to clean dish is worth it.  Thanks again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kittencal s famous greek salad

be prepared for the best greek salad on the planet! --- plan ahead the dressing needs at least 2 or more hours to blend the flavors, i sometimes add in 1/4 cup parmesan cheese to the dressing for a more cheesy dressing, all amounts may be adjusted to taste ----  to marinade the salad allow to sit at room temperature before serving, see bottom of instructions --- you will find this and many more of my recipes posted here http://kittencalskitchen.com/2009/04/13/kittens-famous-greek-salad/  ---also see my recipe #359292

1. for the dressing
2. in a processor or use a wire whisk process / whisk the olive oil with lemon juice , 2 teaspoons dried oregano , garlic , dried , basil , red wine vinegar , salt and sugar until smooth
3. season with black pepper
4. chill in fridge for a couple of hours before using to blend flavors
5. place the salad ingredients in a large bowl
6. pour dressing over
7. toss to combine
8. if desired allow the salad to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving , or you can refrigerate for 1 hour
demonstrations.review: Thanks for the great recipe.  It was perfect.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
leftover chicken santa fe salad

adapted from woman's day magazine. i changed all of the ingredients to lower fat versions, but the original called for the full fat stuff, so by all means use whichever you prefer. good way to use up a little leftover corn and chicken. if you prefer to not buy pre-bagged salad, just add a little shredded red cabbage,carrots, and sliced radishes to your favorite salad greens. you may also sub any type of cooked beans you prefer - chickpeas, kidney beans, black-eyed peas, etc. shredded leftover pork or turkey would also be nice in this.

1. mix dressing together in a large bowl
2. add chicken , beans , corn , and salad greens and toss well to coat
3. place about a small handful of tortilla chips onto 4 serving plates , then portion out the salad on top
4. place a dollop of sour cream on top of each and sprinkle with some shredded cheese
demonstrations.review: My husband and I look forward to leftover chicken now.  And it presents nice enough that we even invite friends over.  Thanks, this has become a regular in our house now.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
butternut pumpkin chicken soup

this soup is delicious its sweet and creamy with a hint of spice coming through. friends and family cant get enough of it.

1. peel and cube butternut place in a medium pot with water
2. cook until butternut is soft
3. pure in blender
4. melt butter or ghee on medium heat add garlic and spices stir a minute or so until fragrant add chicken cubes and cook with the lid on till done , not forgetting to stir
5. add cooked chicken to pureed butternut
6. scrap and grate carrots add to pured butternut
7. add uncooked pasta to pured butternut
8. adjust salt , pepper and water depending on taste and consistency of soup required
9. allow to boil on medium heat until pasta is cooked stir from time to time to prevent pasta sticking
10. add cream and coriander before serving gently heat to infuse all flavours
11. serve hot
demonstrations.review: Loved it.  Thanks for the great recipe.  It is a definite keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
spiced peach   apple crisp

this makes a nice dessert for that late summer into fall transition. the cinnamon and nutmeg complement both fruits, and a little orange zest gives this crisp a nice fresh flavor.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. place tablespoon of butter in an 8x8 baking dish and place in oven while preheating to melt butter
3. take out and wipe it around the dish thoroughly
4. set aside
5. toss together the peaches , apples , orange zest , 3 tablespoons of brown sugar , and the cinnamon and nutmeg
6. layer mixture in the buttered dish
7. combine flour , 1 / 4 cup brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup butter until mixture looks crumbly
8. sprinkle on top of the fruit mixture and bake uncovered at 375 degrees f for about 30 minutes or until fruit is tender and topping is browned a bit
demonstrations.review: I totally agree that would be a great late summer early fall desert but I had peaches and and apples that needed to be used so I tried it.  It isn't something I want to eat all the time but it is bursting with personality.  I made a double batch and reduced the brown sugar by a quarter.  My fruit was so ripe I should have cut it in half but a little ice cream fixed that.  Thanks for the fun recipe, it's a keeper.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
potato salad with chipotle peppers a man s salad

warning warning !! this tex mex salad is very spicy !!!  use your best judgment in how much chipotle peppers you use. taste as you add just don't dump them all in. each pepper has it's own heat level. yes us girls love it too! ;)

1. mix first 7 ingredients together
2. toss in remaining ingredients except 1 tablespoon bacon and salt and pepper
3. mix well
4. taste to see if you need to add salt and pepper
5. i myself like lots of pepper
6. top with bacon bits
7. chill& serve
demonstrations.review: What a great change from my regular potato salad.  I am definitely keeping this one.  Thanks for sharing it.

target.recipe_text:
crock pot chicken with black beans   cream cheese

i love this crock-pot chicken recipe for two reasons: one, my family loves it and two, it is so easy to make! i got this recipe from my sister. she has two children of her own, and they love it too! it's also the best leftovers in the world -- if there are any!

1. take 4-5 frozen , yes , frozen , boneless chicken breasts put into crock pot
2. add 1 can of black beans , drained , 1 jar of salsa , 1 can of corn drained
3. keep in crock pot on high for about 4-5 hours or until chicken is cooked
4. add 1 package of cream cheese and let sit for about 1 / 2 hour
5. all done and enjoy !
target.review: Yum!  I just made this tonight, and really enjoyed it.  I used a hot salsa, and next time I think I'll stick with medium.  I also used fat free black beans and cream cheese since the fat content was a bit high for me, and it still tasted fantastic.  I added some fresh cilantro, chopped onion and green pepper for the last hour or so, and next time I think I'll add even more.  Overall, great!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
chicken stroganoff   crock pot

nan

1. put frozen chicken in bottom of crock pot
2. mix soup , sour cream , and onion soup mix
3. pour over chicken
4. cook on low for 7 hours
5. serve over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: Probably the easiest thing I've ever made!  Good flavor, I added some chopped onion which I think was a nice addition.  The sauce was a little thin for my taste, but that may have been due to the fact that I didn't have a full lb of chicken.  I will probably make this again!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
kelly s french silk chocolate pie

this pie is to die for, and my most requested pie, too! easy to make, very rich! happy to share! enjoy! :)

1. in microwave , melt chocolate , set aside to cool
2. in medium bowl , cream butter , gradually add sugar , cream well
3. mix in melted , cooled chocolate and vanilla
4. add eggs 1 at a time , beating 5 minutes each , and scraping sides of bowl often to incorporate all sugar
5. spoon and smooth into pie crust
6. chill until set , about 1 hour
7. serve topped with cool whip , chocolate shavings and a maraschino cherry
8. double this recipe for a 9-inch deep dish pie
9. variations: add , in addition to vanilla , 1 teaspoons peppermint extract , tint cool whip pink for valentines day , green for st pattys day
10. top with crushed peppermint sticks / candy canes just before serving for christmas
demonstrations.review: I made this for my boyfriend for valentines day, and he loved it. It wasn't quite as fluffy as I had hoped, but  I don't have an electric beater so I had to whip it by hand.  That could have been the issue.  Also, I would not recommend using the cool whip in the spray can, it got super melty on top within minutes.  Overall, he loved it- and next time I'll be sure to use an electric mixer!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
slow cooker cheesy chicken

almost too easy, the chicken cooks in a creamy, cheesy sauce that is delicious over noodles. this freezes well, too

1. place chicken breasts in the crock pot
2. mix the undiluted soups together with the garlic powder and pour over chicken
3. cover and cook on low 6-8 hours , until chicken is tender
4. serve with the delicious sauce over rice or noodles
demonstrations.review: Hmm.  It was okay, but I didn't love it as much as I expected to. Better on noodles than on rice.  I think that maybe it needs some more spices, but I'm not sure what.  I don't think I'll make it again unless I can figure out what to add.  It was easy, though.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
creamy garlic penne pasta

this is a delicious, super quick side or main dish. i got it from the back of a pasta box and it is yummy!

1. melt butter and add garlic in a medium sauce pan
2. cook over medium for 1 minute
3. add flour and cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. stir in broth and milk and cook , stirring frequently , until sauce boils and thickens
5. add parsley , salt , pepper and cheese
6. stir until cheese is melted
7. toss hot pasta with sauce and serve immediately
demonstrations.review: Yum!  Made this tonight with my boyfriend, and it was a perfect quick-yet-totally-homemade dish.  I used three cloves of garlic instead of two, which seemed like the perfect amount.  I also added some dry Italian seasoning.  I'm only giving it four stars because I think it could have used a little something extra for a "pop"- next time I'll add more freshly ground pepper and Italian seasoning. Overall, yummy :)

demonstrations.recipe_text:
crock pot buffalo chicken pasta  slow cooker

i saw this recipe on a parenting forum and modified it. you can sub low fat ingredients, but please don't use fat free. adjust the hot wing sauce to your liking (heat and amount) i actually add more than 1/2 cup. enjoy!

1. season chicken salt and pepper and put it in the crock
2. add the chicken soup and hot sauce and stir
3. cook on low 4-6 hours or high 2-3
4. stir in cheeses and sour cream and turn off the crock pot
5. boil pasta according to package instructions , drain well and add to the chicken / sauce mixture
6. stir well and serve !
demonstrations.review: LOVE this!  I used quite a bit more hot sauce (Frank's) for more spice, and feta instead of blue cheese.  So rich even with healthy request chicken soup, and light sour cream.  And I only had to cook the chicken on low for about 3 hours and it was perfect.  Was even better reheated as leftovers!  Yum :)

target.recipe_text:
chicken rice   veggie casserole

one dish wonder, no pre-cooking, just throw it together and throw it in the oven.

1. preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. stir the rice , onion , garlic , broccoli , cauliflower , chicken broth , tomato soup , brown sugar , vinegar and worcestershire together in a 9x13 baking dish
3. combine the flour , garlic powder , salt and pepper together then toss the chicken in that mixture
4. place the seasoned chicken on the rice mixture and cover the baking dish with foil
5. bake covered for 45 minutes
6. remove foil and sprinkle with shredded cheese , bake uncovered for 10-15 minutes , until most of the liquid is gone and the cheese is bubbly
target.review:
Very good.  I used spaghetti sauce instead of the tomato soup.  My rice was crunchy though....
I used long grain brown rice.  But everything else was very good.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
red lobster cheddar bay biscuits copycat

these are copycats of the delicious "cheddar bay biscuits" served at red lobster.

1. heat oven to 450 degrees
2. mix bisquick , milk and cheese until a soft dough forms
3. drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet
4. bake 6-8 minutes or until golden brown
5. mix butter or margarine and garlic powder
6. brush mixture over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet
demonstrations.review: Absolutely addictive!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
bisquick

oh yes, it's a copycat and it works!!! saves $ also. di

1. combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. add the shortening and mix with an electric mixer on medium speed until all shortening is blended with the flour
3. use the mix as you would the real thing
4. pancakes-stir 2 cups of your bisquik with 1 cup milk and 2 eggs in a bowl until blended
5. waffles-stir 2 cups of your bisquik with 1 1 / 3 cups milk , 1 egg and 2 t veg oil
6. biscuts-preheat oven to 450 stir 2 1 / 4 cups your bisquik with 2 / 3 cup milk
7. makes 9
demonstrations.review: I'm sorry I followed the recipe exactly.  Except I used brown flour (multi grain).  I made biscuits and they were disgusting!  Maybe its because I did not use white flour, but this definitely did not present itself with the desired results.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
cornflake chicken

my family loves this recipe.  it's very moist and so easy to make.  you can add your favorite spices and make it your own.  you can make these into chicken nuggets for you kids too!  i love making things with my toddler.

1. salt and pepper your chicken breasts
2. mix first three ingredients together in a shallow bowl
3. coat chicken breast with this mixture , then cover with crushed cornflakes
4. place chicken breasts in lightly greased pyrex baking dish
5. can be made up to 1 day ahead
demonstrations.review:
Very good...except the recipe is incomplete.  There is no heat time or duration!

I cooked it at 300 for 30 minutes.

Used honey mustard instead if mustard...lite mayo, very good!

demonstrations.recipe_text:
parmesan crusted tilapia

fast, easy and healthy! this recipe is for 2, but i have easily doubled it for more.  this bakes so quickly that i often make a bunch of these fillets and eat them leftover for lunches.

1. thaw and wash tilapia fillets if frozen
2. pat dry on paper towels
3. combine crumbs , parmesan , italian seasoning and garlic powder on a plate , mixing well
4. on a different plate , pour 1 tbsp lemon juice
5. working 1 at a time , place a fillet on the plate in the lemon juice , sprinkle with desired amount of kosher salt , black pepper , and garlic powder
6. turn the fillet over in the lemon juice and sprinkle seasoning on the other side
7. dredge fillet in the parmesan mixture patting it all over to coat
8. place in an oiled baking dish , repeat with remaining fillets
9. sprinkle a little lemon juice over fillets and drizzle or spray them lightly with olive oil
10. bake at 425f for about 20 minutes or until they easily flake with a fork and edges are browning
11. you can also bake these faster at 450f
demonstrations.review:
I found this delicious.  I used crushed Buttery Garlic Club Crackers!  Delicious! 
Served alongside angel hair pasta, this was a new favorite for my family.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
noreen s chicken

this recipe is from my ex mother in laws friend, noreen. they are both great ladies! this is so easy and wonderful!

1. place chicken breast halves in a baking dish , wrap 2 slices of bacon around each breast and bake at 400 degrees for approx 40 minutes or until juices run clear
2. drain off fat
3. sauce: in a sauce pan , melt 3 tblsp of butter , bring to boil and add 3 tblsp of flour , stir until blended , this will be the roux
4. reduce heat and slowly add 2 cups of milk , 1 tsp salt and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
5. cook until thickened
6. pour over chicken breasts and broil until brown and bubbly
7. it has had rave reviews at dinner parties !
demonstrations.review: This was delicious.  The sauce was delectable!  I'm definitely going to file this away for future meal times!

target.recipe_text:
christina s killer dip

this is my sister's dip. she got the recipe while backpacking in europe a few years ago. she is now forced to make it at every party she has. people smell it cooking and stand drooling by the oven until it comes out! (many have not been able to wait for the cooling part and burned their mouths to get to it first).  you might have to make 2 portions.

**note: please check the sodium content before you choose a ranch dressing mix, because it will affect the flavor! some people have complained it is "too salty". please also make sure you are using only a 1 ounce packet; there are other sizes from various manufacturers. too much mix throws off the balance of flavors. my sister and i always use the hidden valley ranch original and we do not have any problems with it :)

you can also substitute half the sour cream for prepared ranch dressing and skip the dry mix. it will come out a bit wetter.

1. defrost the spinach
2. place it in a colander and press it until as much moisture as possible is removed
3. mix all ingredients , and blend well
4. put it in a shallow baking dish in the oven for 20 minutes at 350f
5. remove from oven
6. while still hot top it with remaining cheese , heat in oven again for 5 minutes
7. remove and cool below lava stage and serve
8. goes well with tortilla chips
target.review: This recipe is so easy and so good.  Be prepared it does come out of the oven very hot.  If you are lucky and have leftovers, they are great warmed up in microwave. How can you go wrong with only 5 ingredients?  Definitely use a longer, shallow bowl with lots of surface area.  Will make this again and again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
hearty tuscan white bean soup

this is a really easy tuscan style white bean and spinach soup.  i prefer it meatless, but mini meatballs can be added.

1. heat the oil in a 4 quart soup pot over medium heat
2. add the onion , garlic , carrots , celery and thyme and cook until the vegetables are tender , about 10 minutes
3. add the chicken broth , tomatoes and bay leaf
4. drain the beans and roughly mash 1 / 2 a can of beans
5. add the beans and mashed beans to the pot
6. squeeze the water from the thawed spinach and add to the pot
7. season with salt and pepper and simmer for at least 10 minutes and up to 30 minutes
8. add the macaroni and cook until tender according to package directions
9. serve sprinkled with grated parmesan and / or pecorino romano
demonstrations.review: This is very easy to make and quite nutritious.  It is even better the next day.  It is simple and you can taste all of the ingredients.  Hubby and I both enjoyed it very much.  Will definitely make this again.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
pan fried onion dip

from the barefoot contessa cookbook. this is great for parties. we have really enjoyed this recipe. great with chips or veggies!

1. cut the onions in half and then slice them into 1 / 8-inch thick half-rounds
2. heat the butter and oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
3. add the onions , cayenne , salt , and pepper and saute for 10 minutes
4. reduce the heat to medium-low and cook , stirring occasionally , for 20 more minutes until the onions are browned and caramelized
5. allow the onions to cool
6. place the cream cheese , sour cream and mayonnaise in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat until smooth
7. add the onions and mix well
8. taste for seasonings
9. serve at room temperature
demonstrations.review: I used sweet onions and it was great.  The kosher salt is needed and the cayenne gives it just enough kick.  Anyone who likes heat may want to add a bit more or some other heat source.  It is fabulous.  My husband and I both loved it.  Although I consider it more of a soft spread than a dip.  Definitely eat with a plain or buttery cracker and not a salty chip.  Will make again and share with friends.

demonstrations.recipe_text:
fudge filled bars

i like to make these when i need something that travels well. very good! very easy!

1. mix oats , flour , brown sugar and salt
2. add butter and mix until crumbly
3. stir in pecans
4. set aside 1-1 / 2 cup for topping
5. press remaining into a greased 13x9 baking pan
6. in saucepan combine milk , chips and shortening
7. cook and stir over low heat until melted
8. spread over crust in pan
9. sprinkle with reserved topping
10. bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes , until edges golden are brown
